papers.title: Read It Back: Pretrained MLLMs Are Zero-Shot Reward Models for Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose SpectraReward, a training-free reward function that turns pretrained MLLMs into off-the-shelf reward models for image-generation reinforcement learning. Instead of asking the MLLM to judge a generated image or answer decomposed verification questions, SpectraReward measures how well the original prompt can be recovered from the generated image through a single image-conditioned, teacher-forced forward pass. We use the average image-conditioned prompt log-likelihood as the reward, directly reusing the MLLM's pretrained image-text alignment ability without preference labels, reward-model fine-tuning. We further introduce Self-SpectraReward, a special case for unified multimodal models where the policy's own understanding branch serves as the reward model for its generation branch, forming a closed-loop self-improving framework without external reward models or external knowledge. Extensive experiments validate SpectraReward through a broad image-generation RL study covering two diffusion models, three RL algorithms, nine reward MLLM backbones from four MLLM families spanning 4B to 235B parameters, and five out-of-distribution text-to-image benchmarks. Results show that both SpectraReward and Self-SpectraReward significantly and consistently improve generation performance and outperform prior MLLM-derived reward training methods. Further analysis reveals that larger reward MLLMs are not always better, while Self-SpectraReward can match or surpass much larger external reward models, suggesting that reward-policy alignment is a key factor for effective image-generation RL. Project Page: https://huangrh99.github.io/SpectraReward/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SpectraReward，一种无需训练的奖励函数，将预训练多模态大语言模型（MLLM）直接用作文本到图像生成强化学习的奖励模型。通过计算图像条件下原始提示的似然（image-conditioned prompt log-likelihood）来评估生成图像质量，无需偏好标签或微调。还提出 Self-SpectraReward，让统一多模态模型的理解分支为生成分支提供奖励，形成自我改进闭环。实验覆盖两个扩散模型、三种 RL 算法、九种 MLLM 骨干（4B-235B）和五个分布外基准，显著提升生成性能。
Motivation: 现有基于 MLLM 的图像奖励方法需要偏好标签或分解验证问题，且通常需要微调奖励模型，成本高且难以泛化。本文旨在直接复用 MLLM 已有的图像-文本对齐能力，实现零样本、无需训练的奖励函数。
Method: SpectraReward：从生成图像出发，通过 MLLM 的图像条件教师强制前向传播，计算原始提示的逐词平均对数似然作为奖励分数。Self-SpectraReward 使用统一多模态模型的理解分支为生成分支提供奖励，无需外部模型。
Result: 在两个扩散模型、三种 RL 算法、九种 MLLM 骨干（4B-235B）和五个分布外文本到图像基准上，SpectraReward 和 Self-SpectraReward 一致显著提升生成性能，优于先前 MLLM 衍生奖励方法。更大奖励 MLLM 并不总是更好，Self-SpectraReward 可匹配或超越更大外部奖励模型。
Conclusion: 预训练 MLLM 可作为零样本奖励模型用于文本到图像生成强化学习，奖励-策略对齐是有效训练的关键。Self-SpectraReward 提供了无需外部奖励模型的自我改进框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Latent-Identity Tuning in Text-to-Image Personalization Models
papers.abstract_en: Generating and editing a person's face demands high precision, as even minor modifications can significantly alter a subject's perceived identity. Current personalization and editing methods built on general-purpose text-to-image models, however, often lack the precision required for fine-grained facial edits. We present a method for fine-grained identity tuning in text-to-image personalization models. Unlike standard image editing, which operates on a given image, identity tuning modifies the latent representation of a specific identity, enabling the generation of diverse images that consistently depict the same edited identity. To enable fine-grained latent identity tuning, we explore the latent space of a pre-trained, frozen encoder for text-to-image personalization. Our approach requires no additional training. Instead, it leverages the existing architecture of a frozen encoder to uncover latent semantic directions. This space consists of a set of latent tokens that play distinct roles in capturing different aspects of an identity and often correspond to specific spatial or semantic facial regions. We show that meaningful directions can be identified within this space and within subspaces defined by selected tokens, enabling localized, fine-grained, and semantically coherent edits. We validate our approach through qualitative and quantitative experiments that demonstrate diverse localized facial edits while preserving cross-image identity consistency. Project page at: https://garibida.github.io/IdentityTuning/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需额外训练的潜在身份微调方法，通过探索预训练冻结编码器的潜在空间，发现语义方向以实现细粒度的面部编辑，同时保持跨图像的身份一致性。
Motivation: 现有文本到图像模型在面部编辑中缺乏精度，难以进行细粒度的身份编辑而不改变主体感知身份。
Method: 利用预训练冻结编码器的潜在空间，识别一组潜在token及其子空间中的语义方向，实现局部、细粒度且语义一致的编辑，无需额外训练。
Result: 定性和定量实验表明，该方法能实现多样化的局部面部编辑，同时保持跨图像的身份一致性。
Conclusion: 该方法展示了在冻结编码器潜在空间中进行身份微调的可行性，为细粒度面部编辑提供了新途径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Requential Coding: Pushing the Limits of Model Compression with Self-Generated Training Data
papers.abstract_en: Compression is fundamental to intelligence. A model that can represent its training data as a short code has discovered regularities that enable generalization. Large neural networks may learn functions far simpler than their parameter counts suggest, but it is challenging to construct codes that realize this simplicity. Parameter-based methods such as quantization produce code lengths that scale with model size, insensitive to how much information the parameters store. Prequential coding bypasses this issue by compressing the training trajectory, but codes the exact data sequence regardless of how much the model learns, yielding large codes when the data has high entropy. We introduce requential coding, where a teacher model selects training samples drawn from the student's own distribution. The student's code records only these selections, which cost bits only where teacher and student disagree. The resulting code length is independent of parameter count and data entropy, and often orders of magnitude shorter than the prequential counterpart, with an advantage that grows with scale. This compression sheds light on phenomena inaccessible to prior compressors. Holding loss fixed, larger models and ensembles compress to much smaller sizes despite more parameters. Plugged into a PAC-Bayes bound, the requential code yields state-of-the-art generalization guarantees for billion-parameter LLMs, outperforming bounds built on aggressive post-training quantization even granted zero error. The bound tightens with scale in the compute-optimal regime, as models become increasingly compressible relative to dataset size. The same code predicts that models gradually overfit when trained for multiple epochs. It also isolates the learnable information in a dataset from its unpredictable, random content, revealing that lower-entropy text holds far more learnable structure than higher-entropy image data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出requential coding，一种通过教师模型从学生自身分布中选择训练样本来压缩模型的新方法。编码长度与参数数量和数据熵无关，通常比prequential coding短多个数量级，并且随模型规模增长优势扩大。将requential code用于PAC-Bayes界，在十亿参数大语言模型上获得了最先进的泛化保证，且界随规模在计算最优区域中收紧。该编码还揭示了下熵文本比高熵图像数据包含更多可学习结构。
Motivation: 现有的参数压缩方法（如量化）的编码长度随模型大小缩放，无法反映参数实际存储的信息量；而prequential coding的编码长度取决于数据熵，当数据熵高时编码很大。需要一种编码长度独立于参数数量和数据熵的压缩方法。
Method: 提出requential coding：教师模型从学生自己的分布中选择训练样本，学生编码仅记录这些选择，仅在教师和学生不一致处消耗比特。编码长度与参数数量和数据熵无关。
Result: 在固定损失下，更大的模型和集成可以压缩到更小的尺寸，尽管参数更多。基于requential code的PAC-Bayes界在十亿参数大语言模型上取得了最先进的泛化保证，优于激进的训练后量化（即使零误差）。该界在计算最优区域随规模收紧。
Conclusion: Requential coding推动了模型压缩的极限，提供了独立于参数和数据熵的短码，并揭示了模型规模与可压缩性的关系，以及数据集中的可学习结构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Metacognition in LLMs: Foundations, Progress, and Opportunities
papers.abstract_en: Metacognition is a foundational component of intelligence critical to effective learning, problem solving, decision-making, communication, and more. In recent years, it has become increasingly recognized as a cornerstone of capable, transparent AI systems. Yet while LLMs have made significant progress across diverse real-world tasks, it is not yet clear when, how, or to what extent they can exhibit or be endowed with effective metacognitive abilities, nor how such abilities can be adapted to advance the fundamental capabilities, reliability, and intelligence of AI systems. This paper bridges this gap by presenting the first comprehensive overview of the current state of knowledge on metacognition for LLMs. We analyze and taxonomize the landscape of this emerging field and summarize recent technical advancements, including methods and benchmarks to measure and evaluate LLMs' metacognitive abilities, techniques to elicit, improve, and apply metacognition in LLMs, and findings and implications of ongoing research. We also discuss applications, open questions and challenges, and promising directions for future work. Our aim is to provide a detailed and up-to-date review of this topic and stimulate meaningful research and discussion. An organized list of papers can be found at https://github.com/yale-nlp/LLM-Metacognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次全面综述了大语言模型（LLM）中的元认知（metacognition）研究，包括其定义、评估方法、提升技术及未来方向。
Motivation: 尽管元认知是智能的核心组成部分，但LLM能否以及如何展现元认知能力尚不明确，缺乏系统综述。
Method: 通过分类学分析现有文献，总结元认知能力的测量基准、激发与改进技术，以及应用前景。
Result: 梳理了LLM元认知的研究进展，提供了论文列表和开放问题。
Conclusion: 元认知是提升LLM可靠性、透明度和能力的关键方向，但评估标准、训练方法等仍面临挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Invariant Learning Dynamics of Transformers in Inductive Reasoning Tasks
papers.abstract_en: We present a theoretical framework to explain the emergence of inductive reasoning abilities in Transformer language models. While previous works on Transformer learning dynamics have so far been mostly tied to specific tasks, we study a generalized class of inductive tasks that unifies several synthetic tasks known in the literature, including in-context n-grams and multi-hop reasoning. In this class, we theoretically prove that the training dynamics of attention models can be confined to a highly interpretable, low-dimensional invariant manifold. On this manifold, the learning dynamics are captured by a handful of interpretable coordinates rather than millions of parameters, making both theoretical and empirical analysis more tractable. Using this framework, we characterize how data statistics govern the competition between in-context and in-weights learning, we study how random initializations determine the `winning' circuit when multiple solutions are possible, and we demonstrate that the coordinate frame associated with the manifold can be used to automatically detect which circuits have been learned in trained models. By casting circuit formation as a low-dimensional dynamical phenomenon, we take a step toward a predictive theory of how Transformers learn.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个理论框架来解释Transformer语言模型在归纳推理任务中的学习动力学。作者研究了一类广义的归纳任务，统一了多种合成任务（如上下文n-gram和多跳推理），并理论证明注意力模型的训练动力学可被限制在高可解释的低维不变流形上，使得学习动态仅由少数可解释坐标决定。利用该框架，作者刻画了数据统计如何控制上下文学习和权重内学习之间的竞争，研究了随机初始化如何决定'胜出'电路，并展示了流形坐标可用于自动检测训练模型中学到的电路。
Motivation: 以往关于Transformer学习动力学的研究大多局限于特定任务，缺乏统一理论来理解归纳推理能力的涌现机制。
Method: 提出一类统一的归纳任务，并证明Transformer的训练动力学可以投影到一个低维不变流形上，利用该流形上的少数坐标简化分析。
Result: 理论证明了学习动力学在低维流形上的可解释性，展示了数据统计影响学习模式、初始化决定电路选择，并可以用流形坐标自动检测已学电路。
Conclusion: 通过将电路形成建模为低维动力学现象，向Transformer学习的预测性理论迈进一步。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Minimalist Retargeting-Guided Reinforcement Learning Recipe for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Recent work in humanoid whole-body control has found success with a simple recipe: retarget human motion to robot kinematic references, then train policies via reinforcement learning (RL) to track them. But how does this recipe transfer to dexterous manipulation? The answer is not obvious, as manipulation involves complex, contact-rich dynamics and requires delicate regulation of contact modes and forces. We present REGRIND, a minimalist retargeting-guided RL pipeline that learns dexterous manipulation policies from a single human demonstration. REGRIND retargets human hand-object motion to a robot reference that preserves hand-object spatial and contact relationships, trains a residual RL policy in simulation to track object-centric keypoints along that reference, and transfers the resulting policy zero-shot to hardware with careful system identification. The resulting policies produce fluid, human-like behavior on two different multi-fingered hands across contact-rich tool-use tasks, including operating a pair of scissors and turning a screwdriver. Through systematic hardware experiments, we identify and analyze the key factors that govern sim-to-real transfer in dexterous manipulation, offering practical guidance for retargeting-based learning in contact-rich settings. Videos and code are available at https://yunhaifeng.com/REGRIND.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出REGRIND，一种极简的重定向引导强化学习流水线，从单个人体演示学习灵巧操作策略。方法将人手-物体运动重定向为机器人参考，训练残差强化学习策略跟踪物体中心关键点，并通过系统辨识实现零样本迁移到真实多指手。在剪刀操作和螺丝刀转动等任务中产生类似人类的行为。
Motivation: 人体整体控制中成功的重定向+强化学习简单配方是否适用于灵巧操作尚不明确，因为操作涉及复杂、接触丰富的动力学和精细的接触模式与力调节。
Method: REGRIND流水线包括三个步骤：从单个人体演示重定向人手-物体运动以保持空间和接触关系；在仿真中训练残差强化学习策略跟踪物体中心关键点；通过仔细的系统辨识实现零样本迁移到硬件。
Result: 在两种多指手上，剪刀操作和螺丝刀转动等接触丰富工具使用任务中产生流畅、类人的行为。通过系统硬件实验识别并分析了影响仿真到现实迁移的关键因素。
Conclusion: 该工作为重定向引导的接触丰富环境学习提供了实用指导。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: 人体整体控制中成功的重定向+强化学习简单配方是否适用于灵巧操作尚不明确，因为操作涉及复杂、接触丰富的动力学和精细的接触模式与力调节。
summary_sections.method: REGRIND流水线包括三个步骤：从单个人体演示重定向人手-物体运动以保持空间和接触关系；在仿真中训练残差强化学习策略跟踪物体中心关键点；通过仔细的系统辨识实现零样本迁移到硬件。
summary_sections.result: 在两种多指手上，剪刀操作和螺丝刀转动等接触丰富工具使用任务中产生流畅、类人的行为。通过系统硬件实验识别并分析了影响仿真到现实迁移的关键因素。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作为重定向引导的接触丰富环境学习提供了实用指导。

papers.title: A Durability and Cross-Language Transfer Benchmark for a Validated Teaching-Feedback Classification Protocol
papers.abstract_en: Institutions collect far more open-ended teaching-evaluation feedback than they read. A prior study introduced a validated protocol for classifying such comments by thematic category and sentiment, built from a documented annotation guide, an intra-annotator reliability measurement, stratified cross-validation, and a held-out evaluation on a Spanish institutional corpus with a frozen-encoder design. Two questions limit its reuse: whether a protocol fixed to 2019-era frozen embeddings stays competitive as representation methods advance, and whether it transfers to a second language. We re-run it on the original Spanish data across three representation generations, sparse lexical features, frozen transformer embeddings, and prompted large language models, and transfer its sentiment task to English with a balanced 45,000-comment corpus checked against an aspect-labeled education dataset. Treating paired comparisons as descriptive, we find the protocol durable: a 2026 frontier model posts the highest thematic F1 on the hardest Spanish task, yet shows no sentiment advantage over a cheap model and no descriptive separation from it on English, so model choice is a deployment decision, not a property of the method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文检验一个已验证的教学反馈分类协议（thematic category and sentiment）的持久性和跨语言迁移能力。通过在西班牙语原始语料上对比三种表示方法（稀疏词特征、冻结Transformer嵌入、提示LLM）以及将情感任务迁移到英语（45,000条评论），发现协议是持久的：前沿模型在西班牙语最难任务上取得了最高的主题F1，但在情感上无优势，且在英语上与廉价模型无显著区分，因此模型选择是部署决策而非方法属性。
Motivation: 已有的教学反馈分类协议是否能在表示方法进步后保持竞争力？以及能否迁移到另一种语言？
Method: 在西班牙语数据上重新运行该协议，使用三种表示生成方法（稀疏词特征、冻结Transformer嵌入、提示大语言模型），并将情感任务迁移到英语，使用一个平衡的45,000评论语料库，并与方面标注的教育数据集对照。
Result: 2026前沿模型在西班牙语最难任务上取得了最高的主题F1，但在情感任务上未显示出优于廉价模型的优势，且在英语上两者无描述性分离。
Conclusion: 该协议是持久的；模型选择是一个部署决策，而非方法的固有属性。

papers.title: Inside the Unfair Judge: A Mechanistic Interpretability Account of LLM-as-Judge Bias
papers.abstract_en: Existing studies of LLM-as-judge scoring bias work predominantly at the input-output level: they perturb inputs, measure score deltas, and propose prompt-level mitigations. We argue that the same biases admit a representation-level account in the judge's hidden state, complementary to the input-output view and operationally useful in ways it does not afford. We report three findings, across seven judges, seven bias types, and nine benchmarks. Geometry: baseline judging inputs occupy a tight activation manifold while biased inputs are displaced along a low-dimensional, type-specific subspace that sharpens with depth and is recovered consistently by three families of estimators. Causal control: steering hidden states along this subspace drives scoring in both directions, forward shifts reproducing biased scoring on clean inputs and reverse shifts restoring baseline scoring on biased ones, while matched-norm random directions produce shifts an order of magnitude smaller. Operational: a simple linear projection onto the same bias-direction features anticipates judge failures on three entirely unseen benchmarks, substantially outperforming text-based alternatives. Reading bias as activation geometry, rather than as input-output noise, unifies geometric structure, causal control, and operational prediction within a single framework. The project page is available at https://xzx34.github.io/unfair-judge/
papers.comment: 58 pages, 13 figures, 30 tables; project page: https://xzx34.github.io/unfair-judge/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从表示层面解释LLM作为裁判时的评分偏见，发现偏见位于隐藏状态的低维子空间，通过几何分析、因果控制和线性投影统一解释。
Motivation: 现有LLM评分偏见研究局限于输入-输出层面的扰动和缓解，缺乏对内部表示机制的理解。
Method: 使用七个法官、七种偏见类型和九个基准，通过几何分析（激活流形位移）、因果控制（沿偏见子空间操控隐藏状态）和操作预测（线性投影于未见基准）进行统一框架研究。
Result: 偏见输入被位移到低维、类型特异子空间；沿该子空间操控可双向改变评分；线性投影在三个未见基准上显著优于文本替代方法。
Conclusion: 将偏见视为激活几何而非输入-输出噪声，统一了几何结构、因果控制和操作预测。

papers.title: Evidence-Backed Video Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Current Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) excel in question answering (QA) but largely operate as black boxes, providing textual answers without verifiable visual grounding. Existing explainability efforts rely on textual rationales or sparse bounding boxes, which struggle to capture complex video dynamics such as occlusions and non-rigid deformations. We propose Evidence-Backed Video Question Answering (E-VQA), a novel task requiring models to jointly output a semantic answer and precise spatio-temporal evidence: temporal segments and dense, tracked object segmentation masklets. To support this, we introduce ST-Evidence, the first human-verified benchmark for both discriminative and generative pixel-level grounding. Evaluations of state-of-the-art models reveal a critical decoupling between QA accuracy and true visual perception that scaling alone fails to bridge. To address this, we develop scalable, automated generation pipelines to create ST-Evidence-Instruct, a 160k-scale dataset bridging high-level reasoning with fine-grained grounding. Fine-tuning grounded Video LLMs on this data yields substantial gains over the corresponding size-matched UniPixel baselines (e.g., +27.2 t-mean and +13.8 J&F on a 7B model), establishing a robust baseline for explainable, evidence-backed video understanding. Code and data are available at https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/EVQA.
papers.journal_ref: ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出证据支持的视频问答（E-VQA）任务，要求模型同时输出语义答案和精确的时空证据（时间片段及密集跟踪对象分割掩码）。为支持该任务，作者构建了首个经人工验证的像素级定位基准ST-Evidence，并开发自动化生成流水线创建16万规模的数据集ST-Evidence-Instruct。在7B模型上微调后，相比同尺寸基线获得+27.2 t-mean和+13.8 J&F的显著提升。
Motivation: 现有视频大语言模型（Video LLMs）在问答中缺乏可验证的视觉定位，其可解释性依赖文本理由或稀疏边界框，难以处理遮挡、非刚性变形等复杂视频动态。
Method: 定义E-VQA任务，构建ST-Evidence基准和ST-Evidence-Instruct数据集，通过自动化流水线生成细粒度时空标注，并微调基于视频LLM的定位模型。
Result: 在7B模型上微调后，相比同尺寸UniPixel基线，t-mean提升27.2，J&F提升13.8，表明模型在细粒度定位与高层推理之间的耦合得到改善。
Conclusion: 作者强调缩放规模本身无法弥合QA准确率与真实视觉感知之间的差距，而E-VQA任务和数据集为可解释、有证据的视频理解建立了稳健基线。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Beyond the Single Camera: Agentic Multi-View Reasoning in Sports Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on single-view video understanding benchmarks. However, sports videos involve dense occlusion, rapid motion, and complex interactions that are difficult to resolve from a single viewpoint. In practice, sports events are recorded from multiple camera angles, providing complementary evidence used by referees. Yet, no existing benchmark evaluates MLLMs on multi-view sports video understanding. To address this gap, we introduce SportMV-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark built from official match recordings, through a dedicated pipeline combining LLM-based generation, MLLM-based verification, and human filtering to ensure quality and consistency. SportMV-Bench containing 787 multi-view video bundles and 2592 question-answer pairs across three categories: Perception-Aware Recognition (PAR), Rule-aware Event Interpretation (REI), and Adjudicative Decision Reasoning(ADR). Our analysis shows that current MLLMs fail to effectively exploit multi-view information, with the bottlenecks lying in fine-grained visual perception and view selection rather than logical reasoning or domain knowledge. We propose SportMV-Agent, an agentic framework that orchestrates an iterative loop of active view selection, perception tool execution, and evidence-grounded reasoning, achieving a significant 14.46% relative improvement over the strongest MLLM baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对现有多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 在体育视频理解中缺乏多视角评估的问题，本文提出 SportMV-Bench 基准和 SportMV-Agent 代理框架。基准包含 787 个多视角视频包和 2592 个问答对，涵盖感知识别、事件解释和裁决推理三类任务。实验表明当前 MLLMs 未能有效利用多视角信息，而所提代理框架通过主动视角选择、感知工具执行和证据推理的迭代循环，相比最强基线获得 14.46% 的相对提升。
Motivation: 体育视频存在密集遮挡、快速运动和复杂交互，单视角难以解决；实际赛事使用多角度拍摄，但缺乏评估 MLLMs 多视角理解的基准。
Method: 构建 SportMV-Bench 基准（结合 LLM 生成、MLLM 验证和人工过滤）并提出 SportMV-Agent，一个包含主动视角选择、感知工具执行和证据推理的迭代代理框架。
Result: 当前 MLLMs 在多视角体育视频理解中性能有限，瓶颈在于细粒度视觉感知和视角选择；所提代理框架实现 14.46% 的相对提升。
Conclusion: 该工作揭示了多视角信息在体育视频理解中的重要性，并提供了基准和代理方法以推动该方向研究。

papers.title: Input-Aware Dynamic Backdoor Attack Against Quantum Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs) are a promising framework for quantum machine learning on near-term quantum devices, but their security risks remain insufficiently understood. Studies have shown that QNNs are vulnerable to backdoor attacks, yet existing quantum backdoors mostly rely on a fixed trigger shared by all poisoned inputs. This fixed-trigger design is a major weakness because many defenses detect or weaken the repeated patterns such triggers leave in data representations. Although input-aware dynamic backdoors have been studied in classical neural networks, transferring them to QNNs is difficult because quantum learning introduces new obstacles. In particular, measurement compresses the post-ansatz quantum state into a limited classical output, weakening supervision for a trigger generator, while individual density matrices fluctuate with the input and make per-sample contrastive learning unstable. To address these challenges, we propose Q-DIBA, the first input-aware dynamic backdoor attack for QNNs. Q-DIBA jointly trains a classical trigger generator and a victim QNN through a three-mode mini-batch strategy that supports clean behavior, attack activation, and trigger specificity. To provide stable quantum-level supervision, Q-DIBA introduces an ensemble density contrastive loss that operates on post-ansatz quantum states before measurement and contrasts mode-averaged density matrices rather than individual samples. Experiments on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST across multiple QNN architectures show that Q-DIBA achieves high clean accuracy, strong attack success, and high cross-trigger accuracy, demonstrating effectiveness, stealthiness, and input specificity. The attack also remains resilient against defenses including visual inspection, spectral-signature detection, and fine-tuning, suggesting that input-aware quantum backdoors are an important threat to secure QNN deployment.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Quantum Computing and Engineering (QCE 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个针对量子神经网络（QNN）的输入感知动态后门攻击方法Q-DIBA。该方法联合训练一个经典触发器生成器与受害QNN，通过三模式小批量策略支持干净行为、攻击激活和触发器特异性。为解决量子测量压缩和单样本密度矩阵波动带来的监督困难，引入集成密度对比损失（ensemble density contrastive loss）作用于测量前的后拟设量子态。在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST上的实验表明，Q-DIBA在保持高干净精度的同时实现高攻击成功率和跨触发器准确率，并能抵抗视觉检查、谱特征检测和微调等防御。
Motivation: 现有量子后门攻击大多使用固定触发器，易被基于重复模式的防御检测；而输入感知动态后门在经典网络中有效，但迁移到QNN时面临测量压缩导致触发器生成器监督弱、单样本密度矩阵波动导致对比学习不稳定等障碍。
Method: 提出Q-DIBA，联合训练经典触发器生成器和受害QNN，采用三模式（干净、攻击激活、触发器特异性）小批量训练策略；并引入集成密度对比损失，在测量前对模式平均后的密度矩阵进行对比学习，提供稳定的量子级监督。
Result: 在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST上多个QNN架构下，Q-DIBA实现了高干净精度、高攻击成功率和跨触发器准确率，且能抵抗视觉检查、谱特征检测和微调等防御。
Conclusion: 输入感知动态后门攻击对QNN构成重要威胁，现有防御方法不足以应对，表明安全部署QNN需关注此类攻击。

papers.title: LoRA-Based Cascaded Multimodal Fusion for Action Recognition in Medical Training Environments
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a cascaded Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA)-based multimodal fusion framework for action and activity recognition in healthcare-oriented training environments. The proposed architecture combines parameter-efficient modality-specific adaptation with sequential fusion, enabling modalities to be integrated in stages without retraining previously learned components. Rather than assuming a fixed fusion structure, the framework first integrates more closely related modalities and then incorporates additional heterogeneous modalities, supporting scalable adaptation across datasets with different modality sets.We evaluate the framework on two healthcare-oriented training environment datasets: NurViD and the Nurse Training dataset. Across these datasets, preliminary results suggest that the proposed cascaded fusion strategy improves over individual modality models and provides competitive performance relative to previously reported dataset-specific baselines. Overall, these findings indicate that cascaded LoRA-based fusion is a promising parameter-efficient approach for integrating heterogeneous modalities in medical training action and activity recognition tasks. github: https://github.com/anonymous0-ai/LoRA-Based-Cascaded-Multimodal-Fusion-.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于级联低秩适配（LoRA）的多模态融合框架，用于医疗培训环境中的动作识别。该框架通过参数高效的分模态适配和顺序融合策略，逐步集成相关模态，无需重新训练之前学习的组件。在NurViD和Nurse Training两个医疗培训数据集上的初步结果表明，该策略优于单模态模型，并与先前数据集特定基线性能相当。
Motivation: 现有医疗培训场景中的动作识别面临多模态数据异构性强、模态组合变化大的问题，而固定融合结构难以灵活扩展，且全参数微调成本高昂。
Method: 提出级联LoRA融合架构：首先对每个模态应用LoRA进行参数高效适配，然后按相关性顺序逐步融合异构模态，支持不同数据集间模态集合的可扩展调整。
Result: 在两个医疗培训数据集上，级联融合策略相比单模态模型有性能提升，且与先前报道的基线方法相比具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 级联LoRA融合是一种有前途的参数高效方法，适用于医疗培训动作识别中异构模态的集成，但当前结果仅为初步，需进一步验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HASTE: A Platform for Rapid Post-Disaster Building Damage Assessment
papers.abstract_en: When a large disaster strikes, responders need a map of which buildings are damaged within hours. The models that do well on public benchmarks assume matched before-and-after imagery and a training set drawn from similar past events, and neither is usually available for a new disaster in its first day. We present HASTE (High-speed Assessment and Satellite Tracking for Emergencies), a no-code web platform that lets analysts who are not machine learning engineers produce per-building damage maps from post-disaster satellite imagery. HASTE implements two methods that share one interface. The first requires the user to label polygons over the post-disaster scene, trains a small semantic segmentation model on that single scene, runs it over the whole image, and joins the per-pixel output to existing building footprints. The second embeds every footprint with a pretrained vision model, requires the user to label a handful of buildings, and fits a logistic regression in the browser that scores the rest of the scene in seconds. We describe the platform, both methods, and the engineering that supports them. We also report preliminary experiments on xBD showing that foundation-model embeddings pooled over footprints separate damaged from intact buildings using post-disaster imagery alone, matching a fully supervised ResNet-50 baseline with a twentieth of its labels. HASTE and its predecessors have supported more than thirty real-world disaster responses since 2023, spanning earthquakes, hurricanes, cyclones, floods, wildfires, and tornadoes, delivering results to humanitarian partners within hours to days of imagery becoming available. We close with the directions we think are most promising, including vision-language assessment, active learning, and damage models for roads and other infrastructure. HASTE is open source at https://github.com/microsoft/haste.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍HASTE，一个用于灾后快速建筑损坏评估的无代码网络平台。平台支持两种方法：一种需要用户标注多边形并训练语义分割模型，另一种使用预训练模型嵌入和逻辑回归。初步实验显示，仅用灾后图像，基础模型嵌入可区分损坏/完好建筑，与全监督ResNet-50基线匹配，但标签量仅为1/20。该平台已支持30多次真实灾害响应。
Motivation: 灾后数小时内，应急人员需要建筑损坏地图。现有模型依赖前后对比影像和类似历史事件的训练集，新灾害发生时通常无法立即获得。
Method: 提出HASTE平台，实现两种方法：1）用户标注后训练小规模语义分割模型，输出逐像素结果并匹配建筑足迹；2）用预训练模型嵌入每个建筑足迹，用户标注少量样本后，浏览器中训练逻辑回归。
Result: 在xBD上初步实验表明，仅用灾后图像，基础模型嵌入可区分损坏与完好建筑，与全监督ResNet-50基线性能相当，但标签量仅为1/20。平台已支持30多次真实灾害响应。
Conclusion: HASTE是开源平台，未来方向包括视觉-语言评估、主动学习以及道路等其他基础设施的损坏模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cycle-World: Mitigating Error Accumulation in Long-term Video World Models via Reverse-Prediction Cycle Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive diffusion models have enabled high-quality video generation, yet their sequential nature inherently suffers from error accumulation. In long-horizon video synthesis, minor prediction deviations compound over time, inevitably leading to unconstrained generative drift, structural collapse, and severe visual degradation. To address this, we propose Cycle-World, a novel framework designed for stable and temporally consistent long-video generation. Our approach tackles error drift by enforcing strict temporal reversibility across both the training and inference phases. Theoretically, we demonstrate that forward generative drift can be strictly bottlenecked by a cycle-consistency objective. During training, we integrate an efficient reverse-prediction model to implicitly embed causal constraints into the forward generator, compelling it to produce reversible sequences that tightly adhere to the natural video manifold. At inference time, we repurpose this frozen reverse model as a runtime corrector. Through gradient-based cycle guidance, it iteratively refines the generated latent representations, actively suppressing accumulated errors before they are committed to the historical context. Extensive experiments on the VBench benchmark demonstrate that Cycle-World's dual-phase synergy significantly mitigates error drift, achieving state-of-the-art overall generation quality and long-horizon temporal consistency in 60-second synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Cycle-World提出一种新框架，通过强制时间可逆性来缓解自回归扩散模型在长视频生成中的误差累积问题。该方法在训练时集成逆向预测模型，在推理时作为运行时修正器，通过循环一致性指导抑制累积误差。在VBench基准上60秒合成任务中达到最先进效果。
Motivation: 自回归扩散模型用于长视频生成时，由于顺序预测导致误差累积，引发生成漂移、结构崩溃和视觉退化。
Method: 提出Cycle-World框架，包含训练阶段的逆向预测模型和推理阶段的循环梯度指导。训练时通过循环一致性目标约束正向生成器，使其生成可逆序列；推理时冻结逆向模型作为修正器，迭代精炼潜在表示。
Result: 在VBench基准上，60秒视频合成任务中，Cycle-World显著减轻误差漂移，达到整体生成质量和长期时间一致性的最先进水平。
Conclusion: 摘要强调训练-推理双阶段协同可以有效缓解长视频生成中的误差累积问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Improved Global Ocean Heat Content Estimation by Modeling Vertical Spatio-Temporal Dependence
papers.abstract_en: Estimating ocean heat content (OHC) with reliable uncertainties is critical for understanding and monitoring the evolution of Earth's climate, as the ocean has stored most of the energy accumulated in the climate system due to Earth Energy Imbalance. Here, we use Argo profiling float data from 2004-2022 to map OHC. As fewer Argo observations are available deeper in the water column, previous studies have partitioned the ocean into at least two pressure layers and mapped each separately, which complicates the estimation of uncertainties when the maps are summed to get the total OHC. In this work, we consider the case of two pressure layers and propose an improved mapping and uncertainty quantification method using bivariate locally stationary Gaussian processes and conditional simulations to map the two sections jointly while accounting for the correlation between them. We find that modeling this correlation results in improved OHC anomaly mapping and up to a 15 percent reduction of global OHC anomaly uncertainties in comparison to mapping the two layers separately without accounting for their dependence. These estimated uncertainties are essential to analyze the statistical significance of OHC anomalies on both regional and global scales, which we demonstrate using several climatological case studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对海洋热含量（OHC）估计中的不确定性量化问题，提出一种改进的映射与不确定性估计方法。利用2004-2022年Argo剖面浮标数据，将海洋分为两个压力层，采用双变量局部平稳高斯过程联合建模两层之间的时空依赖关系，并用条件模拟生成多个实现。摘要报告该方法相比单独映射两层且忽略相关性，可使全球OHC异常不确定性降低15%。
Motivation: 传统方法将海洋分为至少两个压力层并分别映射，导致求和获得总OHC时不确定性估计复杂化，且未考虑层间相关性的潜在信息。
Method: 提出双变量局部平稳高斯过程（bivariate locally stationary Gaussian process）与条件模拟（conditional simulations），对两个压力层的OHC异常进行联合映射，同时建模层间相关性。
Result: 摘要报告联合建模层间相关性使全球OHC异常不确定性降低最多15%。
Conclusion: 论文强调所估计的不确定性对区域和全球尺度OHC异常的统计显著性分析必不可少，并通过多个气候案例研究进行了论证。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: MicroCharNet: Less is More for License Plate Character Detection
papers.abstract_en: License plate character detection is a crucial component of intelligent transportation systems, where high accuracy and computational efficiency are required for real-time deployment. Although recent deep learning-based methods have substantially improved detection performance, many high-accuracy models rely on large-scale architectures that incur substantial computational overhead, limiting their applicability to resource-constrained devices. In this paper, we propose MicroCharNet, an ultra-lightweight model specifically designed for license plate character detection. The proposed architecture employs a compact backbone composed of C2f blocks, integrated with CoordAtt module to enhance feature extraction while preserving spatial information. A lightweight C3k2-based neck fuses multi-level features, followed by a single-level anchor-free detection head that enables end-to-end prediction. Experiments conducted on the UFPR-ALPR dataset demonstrate that MicroCharNet achieves competitive detection accuracy with only 0.08M parameters and 0.096 GFLOPs, while outperforming several recent YOLO-based baselines. Hardware-level evaluations further confirm its efficiency for real-time deployment on edge devices. These results indicate that carefully designed ultra-lightweight architectures can effectively balance accuracy and efficiency in license plate character detection. The source code is available at https://github.com/chequanghuy/MicroCharNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MicroCharNet，一种用于车牌字符检测的超轻量模型，采用紧凑的 C2f 骨干、CoordAtt 模块、C3k2 颈部以及单层无锚检测头。在 UFPR-ALPR 数据集上仅用 0.08M 参数和 0.096 GFLOPs 达到有竞争力的精度，优于若干 YOLO 基线，并适合边缘设备实时部署。
Motivation: 现有高精度车牌字符检测模型依赖大规模架构，计算开销大，难以部署在资源受限设备上。
Method: 设计超轻量架构：紧凑 C2f 骨干集成 CoordAtt 增强特征提取并保留空间信息；轻量 C3k2 颈部融合多级特征；单层无锚检测头实现端到端预测。
Result: 在 UFPR-ALPR 数据集上，MicroCharNet 仅 0.08M 参数和 0.096 GFLOPs，检测精度优于多个 YOLO 基线。
Conclusion: 精心设计的超轻量架构可在车牌字符检测中有效平衡精度与效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Transformer-Guided Swarm Intelligence for Frugal Neural Architecture Search
papers.abstract_en: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) has automated the design of deep learning models but traditionally requires massive computational resources, often measured in thousands of GPU-days. In this paper, we propose a frugal and memetic NAS framework designed to democratize architecture design on consumer-grade hardware. Our approach combines the global macro-search capabilities of an autoregressive Transformer controller, trained via Reinforcement Learning (RL), with the local micro-exploitation of an Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) algorithm. To prevent premature convergence during the RL phase, we introduce a dynamic entropy mechanism that forces topological exploration upon detection of performance stagnation. Evaluated on a standard GPU (NVIDIA RTX 3060), our hybrid method effectively resolves the "cold-start" problem inherent in metaheuristics. By algorithmically penalizing network depth, our framework actively mitigates model bloat: on the CIFAR-10 dataset, it discovers an efficient architecture reaching 84.85% accuracy with only $\sim$174,000 parameters (significantly smaller than standard baselines like ResNet-20) in 3 hours of search time. Furthermore, we demonstrate the framework's flexibility by applying it to credit card fraud detection, directly optimizing the F1-Score on highly imbalanced tabular data to reach a F1-Score of 0.71 with a compact network of $\sim$4,600 parameters. These results suggest that our approach can yield tailored, accessible, and highly parameter-efficient deep learning models suitable for edge deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种节俭的迷因式神经架构搜索（NAS）框架，结合自回归Transformer控制器（通过强化学习训练）与人工蜂群（ABC）算法的局部微调。在消费级GPU（RTX 3060）上，该方法在CIFAR-10上3小时内发现仅17.4万参数的架构，准确率84.85%；在信用卡欺诈检测任务上，以4600参数达到F1-score 0.71。
Motivation: 传统NAS需要数千GPU天，成本高昂；现有元启发式方法存在冷启动问题和模型臃肿。本文旨在在消费级硬件上实现高效、节俭的NAS。
Method: 结合Transformer全局搜索（RL训练）与ABC局部优化；引入动态熵机制防止RL阶段过早收敛；通过惩罚网络深度抑制模型膨胀。
Result: CIFAR-10上84.85%准确率，17.4万参数，搜索时间3小时；信用卡欺诈检测F1-score 0.71，4600参数。
Conclusion: 该方法可在消费级硬件上快速生成参数高效的深度学习模型，适合边缘部署，但摘要未提及其他数据集或泛化性局限。

papers.title: MM-ToolSandBox: A Unified Framework for Evaluating Visual Tool-Calling Agents
papers.abstract_en: We introduce MM-ToolSandBox, a benchmark and evaluation framework for visually grounded tool-calling agents. The framework provides a stateful execution environment spanning 500+ tools across 16 application domains, supporting multi-image, multi-turn tasks where agents must ground progressively arriving visual inputs into executable tool calls while handling realistic conversational phenomena (goal revisions, error corrections, state mutations). An automated scenario generation pipeline produces diverse, visually grounded scenarios through information-flow-guided planning and multi-stage quality filtering, yielding 258 human-verified nominal scenarios and 50 variants targeting interactive UI applications. Evaluating 12 state-of-the-art models, from 4B open-weight to frontier proprietary systems, shows that current models still lack robust visual tool-calling capability: even the best model achieves below 50% success rate. Our failure analysis further reveals that visual precision, not only planning, is a primary bottleneck for capable models: 53% of failures stem from incorrect information extraction from images despite otherwise correct task workflows. A planning-to-precision crossover emerges with scale: smaller models fail at deciding what to do, while larger models fail at perceiving what they see, suggesting fundamentally different research directions for improving models at different capability levels. The framework and the benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/apple/ml-mmtoolsandbox
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MM-ToolSandBox，一个用于评估视觉工具调用智能体的统一基准和框架。它提供包含500+工具的状态化执行环境，覆盖16个应用领域，支持多图像、多轮任务，并通过自动化场景生成管道创建了258个人工验证场景和50个变体。评估12个当前最优模型（从4B开源到前沿闭源）发现，即使最佳模型成功率也低于50%，且失败主因是视觉精度不足而非规划错误。
Motivation: 现有评估缺乏系统衡量多模态模型在真实动态环境中进行视觉工具调用能力的方法，尤其是处理多轮交互、状态变化和错误修正等实际现象。
Method: 提出框架包含三部分：状态化执行环境（支持500+工具、16个领域）、自动化场景生成管道（基于信息流引导规划和多阶段质量过滤）、以及258个验证场景和50个UI变体。
Result: 评估12个模型，最佳模型成功率低于50%；53%的失败归因于图像信息提取错误；发现规划-精度交叉现象：小模型主要失败在决策，大模型主要失败在感知。
Conclusion: 视觉精度而非规划是当前视觉工具调用智能体的主要瓶颈，不同能力级别的模型需要不同的研究重点。

papers.title: Relaxing Faithfulness with Intervention-Only Causal Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery algorithms learn a network that describes the causal dependencies among random variables. A common workflow involves first utilizing conditional independence properties on observational data to determine partially directed causal relationships, then applying interventions to orient the unknown causal directions. A critical assumption for the first step is faithfulness: a requirement that causally linked variables exhibit statistical dependence. Many natural systems include buffering and stabilizing pathways that cancel out to achieve systemic robustness. This cancellation of pathways violates faithfulness, leading causal discovery algorithms to incorrectly remove causal dependencies. In this paper, we argue that hard interventions contain information about the presence/absence of causal linkage that is overlooked in the first stage of structure discovery. We show that a mild assumption -- called intervention-immediacy faithfulness -- that allows cancellations, is sufficient to nonparametrically identify causal structures with hard interventions. These results position interventions as the primary carriers of information about causal structure, which should take precedence over conditional independence testing. To flip the paradigm, we also specify equivalence classes when the identification criteria are not met due to limitations in the scope of interventions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对因果发现中标准 faithfulness 假设因路径抵消而被违反的问题，提出干预-即时忠实性（intervention-immediacy faithfulness）假设，允许抵消存在，并证明在硬干预下可以非参数地识别因果结构。文章主张将干预作为因果信息的主要载体，优先于条件独立性测试。
Motivation: 标准 faithfulness 要求因果关联的变量必须统计依赖，但自然系统中缓冲和稳定路径的抵消效应会导致违反该假设，使因果发现算法错误地移除真实依赖。
Method: 定义干预-即时忠实性假设（允许路径抵消），证明仅依赖硬干预即可非参数识别因果结构；当干预范围有限时，给出相应的等价类描述。
Result: 理论结果表明，干预中包含的因果连接信息足以替代条件独立性测试，从而放宽 faithfulness 假设。
Conclusion: 论文认为干预应成为因果结构发现的首要信息源，干预-即时忠实性比标准 faithfulness 更弱且更适应实际系统。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Introducing Human-Centeredness in AI-Assisted Lexicography
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a human-centered artificial intelligence (HCAI) framework for AI-assisted lexicography. While generative AI offers significant opportunities to enhance lexicographic work, it also raises concerns regarding the future role of lexicographers and the preservation of linguistic and cultural diversity. Drawing on HCAI principles and previous applications in other language professions, the paper identifies four interrelated dimensions through which AI integration in lexicography can be understood and critically examined: the augmented lexicographer, the sociotechnical context of AI integration, bias, and the design of AI-powered lexicographic tools. The framework argues that AI should augment rather than replace lexicographers, combining high levels of automation with meaningful human control. It further emphasizes the importance of preserving professional agency, mitigating AI-generated biases, and designing tools around the needs of lexicographers. By doing so, the paper provides a foundation for future research and the beneficial integration of AI into lexicographic workflows.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the XXII EURALEX International Congress 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个人工智能辅助词典编纂的人本中心人工智能框架，强调AI应增强而非取代词典编纂者，结合自动化与人类控制。框架涵盖增强型词典编纂者、社会技术背景、偏见和工具设计四个维度，旨在保护职业自主性、减轻AI偏见并围绕词典编纂者需求设计工具。
Motivation: 生成式AI为词典编纂带来机遇，但也引发关于词典编纂者未来角色及语言文化多样性保护的担忧，需要引入人本中心原则。
Method: 基于人本中心AI原则及先前在语言专业中的应用，识别并分析AI整合词典编纂的四个相互关联维度：增强型词典编纂者、社会技术语境、偏见及AI驱动工具设计。
Result: 框架论证表明AI应增强而非取代词典编纂者，需保持高水平自动化与有意义的人类控制，并强调保护职业自主性、减轻偏见及以用户为中心的设计。
Conclusion: 该框架为未来研究及AI有益整合进词典编纂工作流提供了基础，但未提供实证结果或具体系统实现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Encoder-Side Neuron Identification and Amplification for Acoustic Perception in Large Audio-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large audio-language models (LALMs) often underperform on fine-grained, non-semantic attributes of speech, such as a speaker's emotion, despite strong performance on speech content. Improving this without the cost of retraining calls for an effective inference-time intervention, yet most existing methods intervene only after the audio encoder and operate at a relatively coarse granularity. The encoder itself, where acoustic information is first extracted from the waveform, remains largely unexplored, especially at the level of individual neurons. We introduce IAAN, Identifying and Amplifying Acoustic Neurons, a training-free and label-free method that scores each feed-forward neuron in the audio encoder by contrasting its activation on the real waveform with that on a noise reference lacking the real audio's acoustic information. IAAN then amplifies a small set of the highest-scoring neurons at inference. Across ten non-semantic speech attributes, IAAN improves average accuracy by 25.7 points on Audio-Flamingo-3, 21.4 on Qwen2.5-Omni, and 9.7 on Kimi-Audio. It also improves a model already explicitly fine-tuned to prioritize acoustic evidence. In controlled comparisons, both the encoder locus and neuron-level selectivity prove necessary for this gain. Intervening after the encoder, at the decoding side or inside the language model, yields little to no improvement, or even deteriorates accuracy. The improvement also depends on which specific neurons are amplified, not merely on their number, confirming that IAAN's acoustic score succeeds in identifying the neurons that matter. These results show that a small, precisely targeted intervention inside the audio encoder is an effective and largely untapped way to strengthen the acoustic understanding of LALMs, opening a new direction for inference-time methods that improve acoustic perception through neuron-level access to the encoder.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IAAN方法，通过对比音频编码器前馈神经元在真实波形与噪声参考上的激活，识别并放大对声学感知重要的神经元，无需训练或标签。在多个非语义语音属性（如情绪）上显著提升大音频-语言模型（LALMs）的准确率，且仅在编码器内进行细粒度干预有效。
Motivation: 现有LALMs在处理语音的非语义声学属性（如情感）时表现不佳，且推理时干预方法大多在编码器之后进行，粒度较粗，编码器内部的神经元级别探索不足。
Method: IAAN：通过前向传播计算每个前馈神经元在真实波形与噪声参考下的激活差异，得到声学重要性分数，然后在推理时放大分数最高的少量神经元。
Result: 在Audio-Flamingo-3、Qwen2.5-Omni和Kimi-Audio上，平均准确率分别提升25.7、21.4和9.7个百分点；对已微调优先声学证据的模型也有改善。编码器内和神经元级别的干预必要性通过控制实验验证。
Conclusion: 在音频编码器内进行小范围、精确的神经元级干预，是增强LALMs声学理解的有效且未被充分利用的方向，为推理时方法开辟新路径。

papers.title: StoryTeller: Training-Free Narrative Grounding for Long-Form Audio Description
papers.abstract_en: Long-form audio description (AD) requires more than describing visible actions: it must preserve characters, events, relationships, and story context across scenes so that blind and low-vision (BLV) audiences can follow a film. Modern video-language models (VLMs) are effective on short clips, but they often treat each moment independently, producing descriptions that miss who characters are, why events matter, and how the current scene connects to earlier narrative context. We propose StoryTeller, a training-free framework for story-aware long-form AD. Instead of relying only on local visual cues, StoryTeller maintains a verified narrative memory that carries forward story-relevant information across scenes, enabling later descriptions to remain coherent, grounded, and contextually informative. Given only raw video and a movie title, StoryTeller can optionally retrieve public movie metadata to resolve names and story context, while accepting only facts that are supported by the video through semantic filtering and VLM verification. The method requires no subtitles, scripts, AD transcripts, aligned captions, character banks, precomputed face identities, or task-specific fine-tuning. To evaluate whether generated AD preserves narrative information, we introduce StoryAD-QA, a question-answering benchmark that tests whether a language model can answer story-context questions using only the generated descriptions. Experiments on standard AD benchmarks and diverse long-form videos show that StoryTeller consistently improves narrative coherence, factual grounding, and story comprehension over strong baselines in automatic, QA-based, and human evaluations.
papers.comment: Accepted to the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StoryTeller 是一个无需训练的框架，用于长篇幅音频描述（AD），通过维护验证性的叙事记忆来保持跨场景的叙事连贯性和事实基础。该方法仅依赖原始视频和电影标题，可选项去公共元数据，无需字幕、脚本等额外信息。实验在标准 AD 基准和长视频上，自动评估、QA 和人类评估显示叙事理解显著提升。
Motivation: 现代视频语言模型（VLM）在短片段上表现良好，但处理长AD时往往独立对待每个时刻，忽略角色、事件和故事上下文，导致描述缺乏连贯性和上下文信息。
Method: StoryTeller 维护一个验证性的叙事记忆，通过语义过滤和 VLM 验证，仅保留视频支持的事实，并跨场景传递故事相关信息，无需训练或微调。
Result: 在标准 AD 基准和多样化的长视频上，StoryTeller 在自动评估、QA 基准（StoryAD-QA）和人类评估中持续改进了叙事连贯性、事实基础和故事理解，性能优于强基线。
Conclusion: StoryTeller 证明利用验证性的叙事记忆可以显著提升长AD的叙事一致性，且无需额外训练数据或任务特定微调，为盲人和低视力观众提供更连贯的观影体验。

papers.title: An Exact Instrument for State Usage in Selective State-Space Models, and the Input-Driven Migration It Reveals
papers.abstract_en: Selective state-space models such as Mamba route information through a bank of first-order modes whose input coupling is set by a learned selection mechanism. We give an exact instrument for measuring how a trained model uses these modes. Because the state matrix is diagonal, each channel's output decomposes exactly into per-mode contributions, and a per-(layer, channel, window) Gram tensor yields the exact output error of dropping any subset of modes, offline, at any budget. Validated against the reference implementation to a relative error of $2.3\times10^{-7}$ on the Mamba-1 family where it is exact, the instrument predicts a layer's deployed pruning error to a median relative deviation of $5\times10^{-7}$ over $4{,}464$ configurations, its floor set by the reconstruction. Applying the instrument across the Mamba-1 family (130M--2.8B), the deployed 7B Falcon-Mamba, and Mamba-2, we find that trained models re-allocate their state space with the input: which modes carry the signal migrates across contexts, and at the most affected layers a per-input oracle roughly halves the output error of a fixed mode set. Frozen-signal counterfactuals attribute the migration primarily to the input-dependent write map $B_t$; the timestep usually identified with selectivity carries almost none of it. Input-scheduled mode pruning on this measurement outperforms static, Hankel-based, and layer-adaptive rankings at every scale from 130M to the deployed 7B Falcon-Mamba, and at half the state budget it matches the unpruned model. Because the scheduler reads each window's mode usage from a first pass, this demonstrates realizable headroom; we claim no deployed compute or memory saving.

TL;DR: 本文为选择性状态空间模型（如Mamba）提供了一种精确的状态使用度量工具。由于状态矩阵是对角的，每个通道的输出可精确分解为各模式贡献，并通过Gram张量离线计算删除任意模式子集的输出误差。在Mamba-1家族上验证相对误差2.3e-7，预测剪枝误差中位数相对偏差5e-7。应用该工具发现状态空间随输入重新分配：信号承载模式在上下文间迁移，输入调度模式剪枝在半状态预算下匹配未剪枝模型。
Motivation: 现有方法无法精确测量选择性状态空间模型中每个模式的贡献，需要理解模型如何使用其状态空间。
Method: 利用对角状态矩阵，将每个通道输出精确分解为每个模式的贡献；构造每(层, 通道, 窗口)的Gram张量，可离线精确计算删除任意模式子集的输出误差。
Result: 工具在Mamba-1家族上验证相对误差2.3e-7，预测剪枝误差中位数相对偏差5e-7。发现输入驱动模式迁移，输入调度模式剪枝在半状态预算下匹配未剪枝模型。
Conclusion: 输入调度模式剪枝展示了可实现的空间，但未声称实际计算或内存节省。

papers.title: Evaluating RE Practices for Explainability: Synthesizing Insights from Daimler Truck into an Explainable RE Framework Proposal
papers.abstract_en: Explainability has emerged as a critical requirement for AI-based systems, particularly in safety-critical and regulated domains. Although prior research has proposed frameworks, patterns, and user-centered approaches to support explainability, there is limited empirical understanding of how existing Requirements Engineering (RE) practices support explainability requirements across the RE lifecycle, especially in an industrial context. This paper reports early findings from an ongoing industry-based study investigating how explainability requirements are elicited, specified, and validated using established RE techniques. We conducted a multi-phase qualitative study with eight practitioners at Daimler Truck, employing think-aloud protocols and moderated group discussions across requirements elicitation, specification, and validation steps. Our preliminary analysis reveals recurring challenges across all steps, including conceptual ambiguity during elicitation, limited testability and expressiveness during specification, and fragmented validation due to vague criteria and regulatory uncertainty. These findings indicate that current RE practices provide limited support to systematically address explainability requirements. The paper contributes empirical insights into step-specific and cross-cutting challenges and outlines a research vision toward developing an empirically grounded RE framework for explainable AI-based systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过戴姆勒卡车公司的多阶段定性研究，调查了需求工程（RE）实践如何支持AI系统的可解释性需求。研究发现，在需求获取、规格说明和验证过程中存在概念模糊、可测试性不足和验证碎片化等挑战，表明现有RE实践难以系统性地处理可解释性需求。论文贡献了步特定和跨领域的经验性挑战，并提出了一个基于经验的AI可解释性RE框架的研究愿景。
Motivation: 尽管已有可解释性的框架和模式，但对工业背景下RE实践如何支持可解释性需求的实证理解有限。
Method: 采用多阶段定性研究，包括出声思维协议和有节制的小组讨论，涉及戴姆勒卡车的8名从业者，覆盖需求获取、规格说明和验证步骤。
Result: 初步分析揭示了需求获取中的概念模糊、规格说明中的可测试性和表达性不足、以及验证中的碎片化问题，表明当前RE实践对可解释性需求的支持有限。
Conclusion: 论文贡献了步特定和跨领域的挑战经验，并提出了基于实证的AI可解释性RE框架的研究路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Expressivity to Sample Complexity: Narrow Teachers for Transformers via C-RASP
papers.abstract_en: A theoretical understanding of Transformers is crucial to better understand the capacities and limitations of large language models (LLMs). There is much work analyzing the expressivity of attention-based models. By proposing handcrafted weights or using computational complexity arguments, a large amount of past theoretical works have sought to characterize which tasks are and which are not in the hypothesis class of Transformer models. However, little work investigates the learnability of such solutions. In this work, we make progress towards this goal. Inspired by recent loss landscape analysis work, we propose preliminary sample complexity bounds for learning C-RASP constructions with Transformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Transformer的表达能力和可学习性之间的差距，提出从C-RASP（一种受正则语言启发的编程语言）构造中学习Transformer的初步样本复杂度上界。该工作受损失景观（loss landscape）分析启发，为理解Transformer在特定任务上的样本效率提供了理论视角。
Motivation: 现有理论研究多关注Transformer的表达能力（哪些任务可被表示），但对其可学习性（需要多少样本才能学到）研究不足。
Method: 借鉴C-RASP编程语言的定义，结合损失景观分析工具，推导了从C-RASP构造中学习Transformer的样本复杂度边界。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，仅提出了一种理论框架。
Conclusion: 该工作是向理解Transformer可学习性迈出的初步一步，但尚未给出实际应用中的样本数量估计。

papers.title: From Global to Factor-Wise Expert Composition in Discrete Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion models offer a powerful framework for solving complex reasoning tasks, particularly through compositional generation, which combines multiple pre-trained experts to generalize beyond their individual training data. Recent theoretical corrections introduce time-dependent mixing weights to better align composed diffusion dynamics with the intended target. However, these methods are fundamentally limited by working on a per-sample basis, treating each generated state monolithically and ignoring the potential spatial or functional specializations of different experts. In this work, we address this limitation by proposing FactorDiff - a factor-wise composition framework for diffusion models. We posit that samples can be further decomposed into smaller factors, and propose a sampling process that dynamically routes each factor to the most relevant expert. We instantiate this framework with spatial/pixel-level compositions and validate it on the ARC-AGI benchmark, demonstrating that simple factor-specific routing consistently outperforms complex global scalar weighting schemes on tasks that require logical consistency and spatial disentanglement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对离散扩散模型组合生成中忽略专家专门化的问题，提出因子级组合框架FactorDiff，将样本分解为因子并动态路由到最相关专家，在ARC-AGI基准上验证了像素级组合，显示简单因子特定路由优于全局加权方案。
Motivation: 现有组合扩散方法基于每样本权重，无法利用不同专家的空间/功能专门化，限制了对复杂推理任务中逻辑一致性和空间解耦的能力。
Method: 提出FactorDiff，一个因子级组合框架，将样本分解为更小因子，采样过程动态路由每个因子到最相关专家，具体实例化为空间/像素级组合。
Result: 在ARC-AGI基准上，简单因子特定路由始终优于复杂的全局标量加权方案，尤其在需要逻辑一致性和空间解耦的任务上。
Conclusion: 因子级专家组合可以更好地处理空间解耦和逻辑一致性的任务，且简单路由规则比全局加权更有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Higher-Order Cell Tracking Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing lineages from live-imaging microscopy requires linking cell detections across time, including through cell divisions. A common approach is to construct a candidate graph and associate cell segmentations (nodes) across frames. However, these and other existing methods overlook two structural obstacles in candidate tracking graphs: (i) cell divisions entangle distinct lineage paths in the node embedding space, and (ii) edges sharing a node have near-random label agreement, so the candidate-graph topology carries no useful information for graph neural networks to aggregate. We propose the \textbf{Higher-Order Cell Tracking Transformer} (HOCT), an edge-centric architecture in which candidate cell links attend to one another under a 3D geometric prior, resolving both issues. Evaluated on the Cell Tracking Challenge and a bacteria division benchmark, HOCT achieves state-of-the-art results without deep pre-trained image encoders. Moreover, the proposed approach is easier to fine-tune, quickly reducing tracking errors by 59% with 400 annotations in a human-in-the-loop setting, outperforming LoRA fine-tuning of competing transformer baselines (6.75% improvement).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Higher-Order Cell Tracking Transformer (HOCT)，一种边为中心的Transformer架构，用于从活体成像显微镜中重建细胞谱系。HOCT通过3D几何先验让候选细胞链接相互关注，解决了候选追踪图中细胞分裂导致的节点嵌入纠缠和边标签一致性问题。在Cell Tracking Challenge和细菌分裂基准上取得最先进结果，无需深度预训练图像编码器；在人工循环中，仅需400个标注即可将追踪误差降低59%，优于LoRA微调的Transformer基线（提升6.75%）。
Motivation: 现有细胞追踪方法在构建候选图时面临两个结构障碍：细胞分裂使不同谱系路径在节点嵌入空间中纠缠，以及共享节点的边标签近乎随机一致，导致图神经网络无法有效聚合信息。
Method: 提出HOCT，一种边为中心的Transformer架构，候选细胞链接在3D几何先验下相互关注，从而同时解决嵌入纠缠和边标签随机性问题。
Result: 在Cell Tracking Challenge和细菌分裂基准上达到最先进性能；在人工循环场景中，使用400个标注即可快速减少59%的追踪误差，比LoRA微调Transformer基线提升6.75%。
Conclusion: HOCT无需深层预训练图像编码器即可实现高精度细胞追踪，且易于微调，适合人类辅助的标注场景。

papers.title: Paradoxes of Game Theoretic Equilibria and Price of Anarchy
papers.abstract_en: For decades, static solution concepts (Nash, Correlated, and Coarse Correlated Equilibria) and the Price of Anarchy (PoA) have formed the bedrock of algorithmic game theory, with no-regret learning proving fast convergence to such game-theoretic equilibria. We show that reducing multi-agent learning to static equilibrium and black-box regret analysis obscures underlying dynamic disequilibrium and game theoretic bounds. First, interior Nash equilibria lack $C^1$ vector field information, meaning agents cannot distinguish aligned from strictly opposing incentives. Inheriting this geometry, the worst-case pure Nash equilibria dictating robust PoA bounds manifest as topologically unstable strict saddles, and in canonical congestion games, as global repellers supported on almost everywhere strictly dominated strategies. Anchoring efficiency guarantees to these unstable states causes algebraic sensitivity; we prove that accommodating all strictly positive affine costs renders the PoA unbounded. Furthermore, projecting learning trajectories onto the discrete simplex of correlated play systematically accommodates non-rationalizable behavior. Evaluating dynamics via Coarse Correlated Equilibria or proximal refinements fails to preclude strictly dominated strategies. Moreover, optimal $O(1/T)$ swap-regret minimization does not preclude macroscopic turbulence, manifesting as chaotic limit sets even in minimal games. Finally, we examine the non-atomic limit of congestion games. Though considered highly stable with tight sub-linear $Θ(p/\ln p)$ PoA bounds (where $p$ is the polynomial degree), we prove that under discrete-time learning, the unique equilibrium destabilizes into Li-Yorke chaos and global attractors whose time-averaged inefficiency degrades exponentially as $2^p$. These results necessitate re-evaluating worst-case equilibrium frameworks for dynamically grounded metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示将多智能体学习简化为静态均衡和遗憾分析忽视了动态不均衡和博弈论界。论文证明纯纳什均衡在拓扑上是不稳定的严格鞍点，在拥塞博弈中甚至为全局排斥子，导致价格无政府状态（PoA）对成本函数敏感。同时，关联均衡和粗关联均衡无法排除严格劣势策略，而最优遗憾最小化也无法避免混沌。在非原子拥塞博弈中，离散时间学习下唯一均衡失稳为Li-Yorke混沌，时间平均效率指数级恶化。
Motivation: 现有算法博弈论依赖静态均衡概念（纳什、关联、粗关联均衡）和价格无政府状态（PoA）作为标准效率度量，但多智能体学习动态中这些概念可能掩盖底层的不均衡和实际效率界限的不稳定性。
Method: 通过理论分析和博弈论反例，证明纯纳什均衡是拓扑不稳定的严格鞍点，在拥塞博弈中为全局排斥子；指出关联和粗关联均衡无法排除严格劣势策略；展示最优swap-regret最小化仍允许混沌动力学；最后分析非原子拥塞博弈在离散时间学习下的混沌失稳行为。
Result: 1）内部纳什均衡缺乏C1向量场信息；2）最坏情况纯纳什均衡对应不稳定严格鞍点，在拥塞博弈中几乎处处是严格劣势策略的排斥子；3）包含所有严格正仿射成本时PoA无界；4）粗关联均衡和近端精炼无法排除严格劣势策略；5）最优O(1/T) swap-regret最小化不能阻止混沌极限集；6）非原子拥塞博弈在离散时间学习中唯一均衡失稳为Li-Yorke混沌，时间平均效率按2^p指数级恶化（p为多项式度数）。
Conclusion: 这些结果要求重新评估基于最坏情况均衡的框架，转向动态基础指标来度量多智能体系统的效率。

summary_sections.result: 1）内部纳什均衡缺乏C1向量场信息；2）最坏情况纯纳什均衡对应不稳定严格鞍点，在拥塞博弈中几乎处处是严格劣势策略的排斥子；3）包含所有严格正仿射成本时PoA无界；4）粗关联均衡和近端精炼无法排除严格劣势策略；5）最优O(1/T) swap-regret最小化不能阻止混沌极限集；6）非原子拥塞博弈在离散时间学习中唯一均衡失稳为Li-Yorke混沌，时间平均效率按2^p指数级恶化（p为多项式度数）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 这些结果要求重新评估基于最坏情况均衡的框架，转向动态基础指标来度量多智能体系统的效率。

papers.title: When Local Monitors Miss Compositional Harm: Diagnosing Distributed Backdoors in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: As multi-agent, tool-using LLM systems are deployed, a common safety net is a runtime monitor that checks each message, tool call, or step on its own. We show this net has a fundamental hole. A distributed backdoor splits a harmful payload across agents, so every local check passes while the assembled object is the attack. The monitor can be right on every step and still miss the attack. The problem is not splitting itself: split fragments can still leak suspicious tokens or provenance edges. The hard case is \emph{local benignness}. No fragment carries the harm, and what is left looks like ordinary benign traffic. We formalize this as an \emph{observability boundary}: a monitor catches only what its view can tell apart from benign traffic. We prove that once the fragments look benign in the monitored view, no detector on that view can catch them, however strong it is. Across a controlled testbed, an external benchmark, and end-to-end agent runs, local monitors lose the signal exactly as local evidence disappears, and it returns only when the monitor sees the assembled object. A monitor trained only on benign traffic recovers the attack's code structure across held-out encodings (0.874 mean AUROC). A decoded-view gate, given the encoding family, blocks every tested attack. But seeing more is not enough: full-trace monitors and decoders still fail unless they reach the representation where the payload is exposed. Local safety is not global safety when harm is compositional, and the open problem is finding that representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了多智能体LLM系统中运行时监控（runtime monitor）的根本漏洞：分布式后门（distributed backdoor）将有害载荷分散到多个智能体的消息中，每个本地检查都正常通过，但组合后构成攻击。作者形式化了可观测性边界（observability boundary），证明当碎片在监控视角下看起来是良性的时，任何检测器都无法捕获。实验表明，只有当监控看到组合后的对象时，信号才会恢复；但即使看到更多，也需要到达暴露载荷的表示层面才能检测。
Motivation: 现有运行时监控逐个检查消息或工具调用，但分布式后门利用组合性（compositional harm）规避检测，作者旨在形式化这一漏洞并探索检测条件。
Method: 通过形式化可观测性边界，定义碎片在监控视角下与良性流量不可区分则无法检测；并在受控测试台、外部基准和端到端智能体运行中实验验证。
Result: 本地监控在碎片看似良性时完全丢失信号，仅当监控看到组合对象时信号恢复；仅用良性流量训练的监控在保留编码上可恢复后门代码结构（平均AUROC 0.874）；给定编码族的解码视图门可阻断所有测试攻击。
Conclusion: 局部安全不等于全局安全，当危害是组合性时，开放问题在于找到暴露载荷的表示层面。

papers.title: Playful AI in Professional Email: A Field Experiment on Tone and Recipient Engagement
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly reshaping workplace communication, yet whether AI-assisted writing changes how recipients actually behave, and through what channel, remains unknown. Here, in a randomized crossover field experiment, 121 employees across six companies sent work emails under three conditions over three weeks: unaided writing, GPT-5 rewriting in a playful tone, and GPT-5 rewriting in a professional tone. Across 16,880 emails, playful editing increased emotional positivity (B=+0.068, p<0.001), and professional editing decreased it (B=-0.041, p<0.001), yet neither condition directly altered open rates, reply rates, or response times. Instead, within-sender positivity strongly predicted both opening (OR=2.05) and replying (OR=3.32, p<0.001), a significant indirect pathway through which AI editing shaped behavior, in the absence of any direct effect. These findings suggest that AI-assisted communication shapes workplace engagement not through its use, but through the emotional tone of the language it produces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过随机交叉现场实验，研究了AI（GPT-5）改写邮件语气（有趣 vs. 专业）对收件人行为的影响。实验涉及6家公司121名员工，共16880封邮件。结果显示，有趣语气增加情感积极性，专业语气降低积极性，但两者均未直接影响打开率、回复率或响应时间。然而，发送者内部的情感积极性强烈预测收件人行为（打开OR=2.05，回复OR=3.32），表明AI通过改变语言情感语调间接影响职场参与度。
Motivation: 大型语言模型正在重塑职场沟通，但AI辅助写作如何以及通过何种渠道改变收件人实际行为尚不清楚。
Method: 采用随机交叉现场实验设计，121名员工在3周内分别使用无辅助、GPT-5有趣语气改写、GPT-5专业语气改写三种条件发送工作邮件，收集16880封邮件数据进行分析。
Result: 有趣编辑增加情感积极性（B=+0.068, p<0.001），专业编辑降低情感积极性（B=-0.041, p<0.001）；两种编辑均无直接效应（打开率、回复率、响应时间），但发送者内积极性显著预测打开（OR=2.05）和回复（OR=3.32, p<0.001），存在间接路径。
Conclusion: AI辅助沟通对收件人行为的影响并非来自AI本身的使用，而是通过AI产生的语言情感语调这一间接渠道实现的。

papers.title: HiFi-LLP: High-Fidelity, Low-Cost Latency Predictors with Confidence for Robust HW-NAS
papers.abstract_en: With deep neural networks (DNNs) increasingly deployed on edge devices, hardware (HW)-aware optimization techniques--such as HW-aware compression and HW-aware neural architecture search (HW-NAS)--have become essential. These methods rely on real feedback from the target hardware to tailor DNN architectures for efficient deployment. While the search can be parallelized, latency measurements via hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) remain a bottleneck due to their sequential nature. Recent approaches use latency predictors to replace costly HIL feedback, but challenges persist: (1) platform-specific predictors often require tens of thousands of samples, and (2) inaccurate predictions can mislead the NAS process. To address this, we introduce HiFi-LLP, a high-fidelity, low-cost latency predictor based on graph attention networks, augmented with a confidence metric. HiFi-LLP outperforms prior platform-specific predictors by up to 9 percentage points (p.p.) in the 10% accuracy bound and achieves a Spearman's rank correlation of up to 0.996 across six devices in the LatBench dataset. We further propose a hybrid NAS framework that routes low-confidence predictions to HIL, achieving up to 8.6$\times$ speedup compared to typical NAS while maintaining a competitive Pareto front.
papers.comment: Published in the Proceedings of the 2025 IEEE 38th International System-on-Chip Conference (SOCC)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对硬件感知神经网络架构搜索（HW-NAS）中延迟测量瓶颈问题，提出基于图注意网络（GAT）的高保真低成本延迟预测器 HiFi-LLP，并引入置信度度量。在 LatBench 数据集上，HiFi-LLP 在6种设备上 Spearman 秩相关达 0.996，10%精度边界内优于先前平台相关预测器达9个百分点。进一步提出混合NAS框架，将低置信度预测路由到硬件在环（HIL）测量，实现相比典型NAS高达8.6倍加速同时保持竞争力帕累托前沿。
Motivation: 现有延迟预测器需要大量样本且预测不准确会误导NAS过程，导致实际部署效率低下。
Method: 提出基于图注意网络的延迟预测器 HiFi-LLP，并增加置信度度量；进一步构建混合NAS框架，对低置信度预测使用实际硬件测量。
Result: 在LatBench数据集上，HiFi-LLP在6种设备上Spearman秩相关达0.996，10%精度边界内比先前方法提高最多9个百分点；混合NAS框架实现高达8.6倍加速，且帕累托前沿与典型NAS相当。
Conclusion: 摘要强调HiFi-LLP通过置信度度量实现高保真低成本延迟预测，混合NAS框架有效平衡搜索速度与精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NeuralActuator: Neural Actuation Modeling for Robot Dynamics and External Force Perception
papers.abstract_en: Differentiable simulators have advanced policy learning and model-based control, yet actuator dynamics remain an important source of sim-to-real error. This is particularly acute on low-cost platforms, where the linear current-to-torque relation $τ= K_tI$ becomes unreliable during commanded-target tracking because of friction, hysteresis, backlash, and thermal effects. We present NeuralActuator, a neural actuator model that jointly predicts (i) a simulator-equivalent generalized-effort surrogate for trajectory propagation on low-cost servo platforms, (ii) external force with a contact-probability gate for sensorless force perception, and (iii) a motor-condition score for the supervised joint. We also introduce the Neural Actuation Dataset (NAD), collected with a twin-arm teleoperation system that records robot states and actuator telemetry together with external-force labels. The torque-surrogate head is trained through differentiable simulation from pose trajectories without direct generalized-effort labels, while the force, gate, and motor-condition heads receive direct supervision. A Transformer captures temporal dependencies while supporting real-time inference. We evaluate NeuralActuator on a 5-DoF OpenManipulator-X, a 6-DoF SO-101, and a 7-DoF Franka Emika Panda, spanning three actuator families and platforms costing approximately USD 500 to over USD 30,000. The low-cost platforms support dynamics and force evaluation, while the offline Franka experiment provides an additional payload-force-estimation benchmark. Experiments further demonstrate its application for motor condition estimation on OpenManipulator-X and improved behavior-cloning performance when NeuralActuator is used as a pretrained module.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NeuralActuator，一个神经执行器模型，用于机器人动力学建模和外力感知。该模型联合预测广义力代理、外部力（带接触概率门）和电机状态，并在低成本和高成本机器人平台上验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 可微仿真器在策略学习和模型控制中取得进展，但执行器动力学（如摩擦、滞后、热效应）导致的 sim-to-real 误差在低成本平台上尤为严重，线性电流-转矩关系不可靠。
Method: 提出 NeuralActuator，使用 Transformer 建模时序依赖，包含多个输出头：转矩代理头通过可微仿真从位姿轨迹训练（无直接标签），外力、接触门和电机状态头有直接监督。同时发布了神经执行器数据集（NAD）。
Result: 在 OpenManipulator-X、SO-101 和 Franka Emika Panda 三个平台上评估，低成本平台支持动力学和力估计，Franka 提供额外载荷力估计基准。实验还展示了电机状态估计应用以及作为预训练模块改进行为克隆性能。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确强调局限性，但指出该方法在多种平台上有效，并可用于力估计和电机状态估计，且能提升下游行为克隆性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GFR-SAM: Training-Free Referring Camouflaged Object Segmentation via Cross-Image Prompting
papers.abstract_en: Referring Camouflaged Object Detection (Ref-COD) requires segmenting hidden targets guided by reference cues. While supervised methods are annotation-heavy and training-free approaches via sparse point-prompting are sensitive to localization errors, we propose GFR-SAM, a robust three-stage training-free framework. GFR-SAM shifts the paradigm from fragile point-matching to a "Generate-Filter-Refine" pipeline. First, we introduce In-Context Exemplar-guided Segmentation, empowering SAM3 with cross-image inference to generate candidate masks via holistic visual exemplars, bypassing its native intra-image constraints. Second, a Region-Global Contrastive Filtering module ranks candidates through DINOv3-based prototypical alignment, effectively suppressing background distractors. Finally, a Geometric-Semantic Refinement module synergizes bounding box and text prompts to recover fine-grained boundaries and enhance instance recall. Evaluated on the R2C7K benchmark, GFR-SAM outperforms existing training-free methods by 8.7\% in weighted F-measure ($F_β^w$) and competes with supervised state-of-the-art counterparts. Ultimately, this work underscores the potential of unlocking SAM3's latent capability for cross-image In-Context prompting, establishing a robust, training-free paradigm that effectively bridges the gap between general-purpose foundation models and specialized, label-intensive perception tasks without the need for task-specific fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GFR-SAM，一种无需训练的参照伪装目标分割框架。通过跨图像上下文提示（cross-image prompting）利用SAM3生成候选掩膜，结合区域-全局对比过滤和几何语义细化模块，在R2C7K基准上比现有无训练方法提升8.7%加权F-measure，达到与有监督方法竞争的性能。
Motivation: 现有参照伪装目标检测依赖密集标注，且基于稀疏点提示的无训练方法对定位错误敏感，需要鲁棒且无需微调的解决方案。
Method: 提出“生成-过滤-细化”三阶段框架：1)上下文示例引导分割实现跨图像推理生成候选掩膜；2)区域-全局对比过滤模块基于DINOv3原型对齐排序候选；3)几何语义细化模块结合边界框和文本提示恢复精细边界。
Result: 在R2C7K基准上，GFR-SAM在加权F-measure上比现有无训练方法高8.7%，与有监督方法竞争。
Conclusion: 本文展示了无需微调即可利用SAM3的跨图像上下文提示能力，弥合通用基础模型与专业标注密集型任务之间的差距。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出“生成-过滤-细化”三阶段框架：1)上下文示例引导分割实现跨图像推理生成候选掩膜；2)区域-全局对比过滤模块基于DINOv3原型对齐排序候选；3)几何语义细化模块结合边界框和文本提示恢复精细边界。
summary_sections.result: 在R2C7K基准上，GFR-SAM在加权F-measure上比现有无训练方法高8.7%，与有监督方法竞争。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文展示了无需微调即可利用SAM3的跨图像上下文提示能力，弥合通用基础模型与专业标注密集型任务之间的差距。

papers.title: Time-Lag-Aware Deep Reinforcement Learning for Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling in PPVC Module Factories
papers.abstract_en: Prefabricated prefinished volumetric construction moves most building work into module factories, whose production floor operates as a flexible job shop. A major complication is decisive: long post-operation time-lags caused by concrete curing, watertightness ponding tests, and paint drying, during which a module is blocked while its workstation stays free. On benchmark instances grounded in an official national prefabrication guidebook, these lags inflate even the optimal reference makespan by about 67% on average, and ignoring them at decision time, then repairing to feasibility, is worse than every dispatching rule. We adapt a state-of-the-art dual-attention deep reinforcement learning solver through three minimally invasive, individually ablatable extensions: lag-aware dynamics with an admissible reward bound, two anticipatory lag feature channels, and liveness-masked operation- and station-type embeddings. With every extension disabled the implementation reproduces the original solver exactly, so all gains are attributable to the adaptations. We release a public, guidebook-grounded benchmark generator. On held-out instances the learned policy is the strongest solver-free scheduler: it reaches within about 4% of a constraint-programming reference and beats every dispatching rule and a genetic-algorithm metaheuristic, with its advantage widening under capacity contention, and a single size-mixed policy carries this lead across the trained range of factory sizes. It needs no solver, model, or license in the loop and re-plans within seconds of a disruption; where an exact solver can be deployed, that solver remains the quality ceiling, a boundary we map explicitly.

TL;DR: 本文针对预制建筑模块工厂中的柔性作业车间调度问题，提出一种时间延迟感知的深度强化学习求解器。该问题中，混凝土养护、水密性测试和油漆干燥等导致长时间后操作延迟，使最优调度周期平均增加约67%。作者在现有双注意力DRL求解器基础上，添加了三种可单独消融的扩展：延迟感知动态（含可容许奖励界）、两个预期延迟特征通道以及活性掩码的操作和工位类型嵌入。在基于官方预制指南的基准实例上，学习策略在不依赖求解器的情况下，达到约束编程参考的约4%以内，优于所有调度规则和遗传算法，且优势在容量竞争下扩大，单一混合规模策略可跨工厂规模泛化，重调度仅需数秒。
Motivation: 现有柔性作业车间调度方法忽略长时间后操作延迟，导致调度方案严重次优，且事后修复比简单调度规则更差。
Method: 对现有双注意力深度强化学习求解器进行三种最小侵袭扩展：延迟感知动态（引入可容许奖励界来反映延迟惩罚）、两个预期延迟特征通道（提供前瞻性信息）、以及活性掩码的操作和工位类型嵌入（确保可行性）。
Result: 在官方指南构建的基准实例上，学习策略达到约束编程参考的约4%以内，优于所有调度规则和遗传算法，且优势在容量竞争下扩大；单一混合规模策略可跨工厂规模泛化，重调度仅需数秒。
Conclusion: 该方法无需外部求解器或模型即可快速重调度，但精确求解器仍然是质量上限，论文明确刻画了这一边界。

papers.title: Active Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Background: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) enables effective policies to be trained from large, previously collected datasets and subsequently improved through limited online interaction. This offline-to-online RL (O2O-RL) paradigm is particularly promising in nonstationary domains where interaction is costly or potentially hazardous. Standard O2O-RL pipelines train multiple candidate policies offline, evaluate them using off-policy or online evaluation, and then deploy and fine-tune the policy with the highest estimated value. However, as in offline pretraining, fine-tuning performance is highly sensitive to the choice of algorithm and hyperparameters, making it risky to commit to a single policy. Objectives: We study active policy selection for fine-tuning under a limited interaction budget in O2O-RL settings. To our knowledge, this is the first work to address this problem. Methods: We formulate the problem by identifying a fundamental trade-off between allocating online interactions to policy evaluation, which helps identify high-performing policies, and allocating them to fine-tuning, which improves policy performance. We then propose an approach that balances this trade-off by actively selecting policies for fine-tuning based on upper-confidence bounds on their future performance. These bounds are derived from locally linear performance forecasts fitted to observations obtained through online evaluation. Results: Across a diverse range of experiments, the proposed approach consistently outperforms existing O2O-RL baselines. Conclusions: Actively selecting and fine-tuning policies uses limited online interaction budgets more effectively than either committing to a single policy or dividing the budget equally among all policies. Our framework also advances offline RL toward practical deployment in real-world systems where online interaction is costly or risky.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究离线到在线强化学习（O2O-RL）中的主动策略选择问题，旨在有限在线交互预算下，通过平衡策略评估与微调之间的权衡来提升性能。作者提出一种基于上置信界（UCB）的主动策略选择方法，利用局部线性性能预测来指导在线交互分配。实验表明，该方法在多个基准上优于现有O2O-RL基线。
Motivation: 标准O2O-RL管线在离线训练多个候选策略后，仅选择一个策略进行微调，但微调性能对算法和超参数敏感，风险较高。现有方法未考虑如何在有限在线交互预算下主动选择策略进行微调。
Method: 将在线交互分配给策略评估（识别高绩效策略）与微调（提升策略性能）之间的权衡公式化，提出基于上置信界（UCB）的主动策略选择方法，通过拟合局部线性性能预测来推导未来性能的上界，并据此分配交互。
Result: 在一系列实验中，所提方法持续优于现有O2O-RL基线，更有效地利用了有限的在线交互预算。
Conclusion: 主动选择和微调策略比固定单一策略或均分预算更有效，推动了离线RL在在线交互成本高昂或风险高的实际系统中的部署。

papers.title: CatRetriever: Contrastive Representation Learning for Slab-to-Bulk Retrieval in Generative Catalyst Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Inverse design is an emerging data-driven paradigm for efficiently navigating vast chemical spaces to discover new materials with targeted properties, and in the context of heterogeneous catalysis, surface generative models have recently advanced this goal by directly generating catalyst surface-adsorbate structures. However, these models typically operate at the slab level and do not provide the corresponding parent bulk structure, making it difficult to assess bulk-dependent properties such as formation energy, surface energy, crystallographic symmetry, and synthesizability. Here, we address this missing slab-to-bulk connection as a retrieval problem and introduce CatRetriever, a contrastive representation learning model that aligns slab and bulk crystal representations in a shared latent space. From a slab query, CatRetriever accurately retrieves plausible parent bulk candidates with R@1 > 91% and R@3 > 98% on both the in-distribution and holdout evaluation sets. We further extend the CatRetriever framework into an adsorption energy targeted bulk discovery pipeline that combines bulk retrieval, generative search space expansion, and adsorption energy distribution analysis. This workflow evaluates candidates by both structural compatibility with the query slab and their ability to access the target adsorption energy range across diverse surface environments. CatRetriever therefore provides a scalable route for connecting catalyst generative models with physically plausible and adsorption energy compatible bulk catalyst discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CatRetriever，一种对比表示学习模型，用于在生成催化剂发现中将 slab 表面结构与对应的 bulk 晶体结构对齐到共享潜在空间，实现从 slab 查询检索 parent bulk 候选。在分布内和保留测试集上，R@1 > 91%，R@3 > 98%。进一步将 CatRetriever 扩展为吸附能目标 bulk 发现流程，结合检索、生成搜索空间扩展和吸附能分布分析。
Motivation: 表面生成模型通常只生成 slab 级别的催化剂结构，不提供对应的 parent bulk 结构，导致难以评估 bulk 依赖性质（如形成能、表面能、可合成性）。现有方法缺少 slab 到 bulk 的连接。
Method: 采用对比学习（contrastive representation learning）方法，将 slab 和 bulk 晶体表示在共享潜在空间中对齐。从 slab 查询出发，通过最近邻检索获取 plausible parent bulk 候选。进一步构建吸附能目标发现流程，结合检索、生成模型扩展搜索空间和吸附能分布分析。
Result: 在分布内和保留测试集上，检索 top-1 准确率（R@1）> 91%，top-3 准确率（R@3）> 98%。表明模型能准确检索出合理的 parent bulk 结构。
Conclusion: CatRetriever 提供了一种可扩展的途径，将催化剂生成模型与物理合理的、吸附能兼容的 bulk 催化剂发现连接起来。有助于评估 bulk 依赖性质并实现目标吸附能范围的筛选。

papers.title: SVI360: Spherical Video Interpolation
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the problem of omnidirectional video interpolation, which plays an essential role in applications such as virtual reality and immersive video enhancement. Existing video interpolation methods are not well-suited for spherical videos, as they have difficulty handling severe distortions close to the poles. To address this issue, we propose SVI360, a dual-branch framework that combines the image frame and its rotated orthogonal view to deal with these distortions. The core methodological aspect of the approach is to reinforce equivariance of the flow displacements between the original and orthogonal views to improve intermediate frame prediction. Experiments show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in interpolation quality while maintaining accurate optical flow in four different public benchmarks. Code and pre-trained models are available at: https://icb-vision-ai.github.io/video360_interpolation/
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Code and trained models are available at: https://icb-vision-ai.github.io/video360_interpolation/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对球面视频（360度视频）插值中靠近极点处的严重畸变问题，提出SVI360双分支框架，结合原始图像帧及其旋转正交视图，通过强化光流位移的等变性（equivariance）来改善中间帧预测。实验在四个公开基准上表明该方法在插值质量和光流准确性上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 球面视频在虚拟现实等应用中至关重要，但现有视频插值方法难以处理靠近极点处的严重畸变，导致插值质量下降。
Method: 提出SVI360双分支框架：一个分支处理原始图像帧，另一个分支处理其旋转正交视图，通过强化两个视图之间光流位移的等变性来提升中间帧预测。
Result: 在四个公开基准上，该方法在插值质量和光流准确性方面均优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: SVI360通过正交视图和等变性约束有效解决了球面视频的畸变问题，为沉浸式视频增强提供了有效方案。
