papers.title: GB-SVFBP: Gaussian-Based Shift-Variant FBP neural network
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a Gaussian-Based Shift-Variant filtered backprojection (FBP) neural network, which is designed for the efficient reconstruction of non-circular trajectory cone beam computed tomography. The traditional differentiable shift-variant FBP model consists of a filtering component and a backprojection process. The filtering component includes operations such as weightings, differentiations, a 2D Radon transform, and a 2D backprojection. The proposed methods build on this framework by introducing a trainable 2D Gaussian model to represent the trajectory-related part in the filtering process, achieving a substantial reduction in the number of trainable parameters. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model reduces the parameter count by 99%, while only sacrificing a slight amount of reconstruction quality. Furthermore, the training time for each trajectory is reduced to one-fourth of the original, significantly accelerating convergence. These enhancements demonstrate a considerable augmentation in the model's practicality and effectiveness, making it a valuable asset for real-world applications.
papers.comment: Accepted for poster presentation at the 18th International Meeting on Fully Three-Dimensional Image Reconstruction in Radiology and Nuclear Medicine (Fully3D 2025), Shanghai, China, May 27-30, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于高斯的移位变分滤波反投影（FBP）神经网络，用于非圆形轨迹锥束CT的高效重建。通过引入可训练的2D高斯模型表示滤波过程中的轨迹相关部分，参数数量减少99%，训练时间降为原来的四分之一，重建质量略有牺牲。
Motivation: 传统可微分移位变分FBP模型需要大量参数，计算效率低，尤其对于非圆形轨迹锥束CT重建。本文旨在减少参数数量并加速训练，同时保持重建质量。
Method: 在可微分移位变分FBP框架基础上，引入可训练的2D高斯模型来替代滤波过程中的轨迹相关部分，从而大幅减少参数。
Result: 参数数量减少99%，每个轨迹的训练时间减为四分之一，重建质量仅略有下降。
Conclusion: 该方法显著提升了模型的实用性和有效性，适用于实际应用。

papers.title: Actor as Its Own Critic: Unifying Region Understanding and Localization via CycleGRPO
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces Actor as Its Own Critic, a unified reinforcement learning framework, Cycle Group Relative Policy Optimization (CycleGRPO), that jointly optimizes region understanding and localization for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Unlike existing separate pipelines, we leverage the inherent duality between the two tasks to construct a self-evaluating reinforcement learning paradigm: "region $\to$ text $\to$ region''. Specifically, a single MLLM first acts as the actor to generate region captions, then immediately transitions to a critic to ground its generated text back in the spatial domain. Therefore, CycleGRPO requires only region inputs, e.g., masks or bounding boxes, entirely bypassing the need for textual ground truths. A quality-aware token-level cycle-consistency reward is employed to assess the semantic discriminability of text captions via their physical localization accuracy. Empirically, built upon SAMTok, our CycleGRPO framework successfully bootstraps both capabilities simultaneously. Without any task-specific fine-tuning, the framework yields consistent performance gains across a wide range of benchmarks, including region captioning, region VQA, grounded dialogue, and referring segmentation. Overall, CycleGRPO offers a straightforward and scalable way to advance pixel-level capabilities in MLLMs. Code and models are released at https://github.com/devinxzhang/CycleGRPO.

papers.title: DiffEEG: A Self-Supervised Denoising Diffusion Model for Learning EEG Generic Representations
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning for EEG-based seizure detection faces critical challenges: severe annotation scarcity and extreme class imbalance, where ictal events comprise less than 10\% of clinical recordings. We present DiffEEG, a 9.6M-parameter self-supervised foundation model that addresses both limitations through denoising diffusion pre-training and reinforcement learning (RL)-based fine-tuning. Pre-trained on 1.3M unlabeled segments from the Temple University Hospital Seizure Corpus (TUHSZ), DiffEEG learns generic neural representations via a 1D U-Net with multi-head self-attention. For downstream adaptation, a reinforced decision layer employs policy gradient optimization to directly maximize F1-score, prioritizing sensitivity to rare seizure events over overall accuracy. Under strict patient-wise evaluation (279 patients, Leave-One-Fold-Out), DiffEEG achieves 61\% accuracy and 59\% F1 for 4-class seizure subtyping, and 81\% accuracy with 85\% weighted F1 for binary detection, maintaining clinically viable seizure recall (59\%) despite extreme imbalance (6.7\% prevalence). Segment-level evaluation establishes an upper bound of 97.6\% accuracy, confirming strong architectural capacity. DiffEEG demonstrates that diffusion-based pre-training combined with metric-aware reinforcement learning enables clinically deployable seizure monitoring with minimal labeled data requirements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DiffEEG，一个9.6M参数的自监督基础模型，用于EEG癫痫检测。通过去噪扩散预训练（在1.3M无标签TUHSZ片段上）和基于强化学习（RL）的微调（直接优化F1分数）解决标注稀缺和类别不平衡问题。在严格的患者-wise评估下，4类癫痫分型准确率61%、F1 59%，二分类检测准确率81%、加权F1 85%，癫痫召回率59%。段级评估上限97.6%准确率，表明架构能力强。
Motivation: 基于深度学习的EEG癫痫检测面临严重标注稀缺和极端类别不平衡（癫痫事件少于临床记录的10%），现有方法难以处理。
Method: 使用1D U-Net加多头自注意力作为骨干，通过去噪扩散自监督预训练学习通用表示，再用增强决策层进行强化学习微调，直接最大化F1分数。
Result: 在279患者的留一折交叉验证中，4类癫痫亚型分类准确率61%、F1 59%；二分类检测准确率81%、加权F1 85%；癫痫召回率59%（患病率6.7%）。段级评估上限准确率97.6%。
Conclusion: 扩散预训练结合指标感知的强化学习可以在极少标注数据下实现临床可用的癫痫监测。

papers.title: Structure-Feature Aligned Graph Learning via Alternating Constrained Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a constrained two-view framework for node prediction that aligns structure-conditioned GNN embeddings with a structure-free feature prior learned by an anchor model. Conventional Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) couple feature transformation and neighborhood aggregation, which renders them vulnerable to topology noise and heterophilous connections. To decouple this dependency, our framework utilizes an independent anchor network to capture intrinsic attribute features via a self-supervised reconstruction objective. Furthermore, we propose a Channel-Split Adaptive Gated GNN (CSAG-GNN) that dynamically routes representations between global spectral smoothing and local spatial discrimination through a node-wise gating mechanism. We propose a stable cyclic alternating optimization strategy to solve the resulting coupled bi-level objective, preventing mutual representation drift during training. Empirical results on both homophilous and heterophilous benchmarks show balanced performance gains and structural robustness over competitive baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个约束双视图框架，用于节点预测，通过交替约束优化对齐结构条件的GNN嵌入与无结构特征先验。框架使用独立锚定网络通过自监督重建目标捕获内在属性特征，并设计通道分割自适应门控GNN（CSAG-GNN），通过节点级门控机制动态路由全局谱平滑与局部空间辨别表示。采用稳定循环交替优化策略求解耦合双层目标，避免训练中表示漂移。在同质性和异质性基准上均取得平衡的性能提升和结构鲁棒性。
Motivation: 传统GNN耦合特征变换和邻域聚合，易受拓扑噪声和异质性连接影响，需要解耦特征与结构依赖。
Method: 提出约束双视图框架，包括：1) 独立锚定网络通过自监督重建学习无结构特征先验；2) CSAG-GNN通过节点级门控动态选择全局谱平滑或局部空间辨别；3) 循环交替优化策略稳定求解双层目标。
Result: 在同质性和异质性基准上均取得平衡的性能提升和结构鲁棒性，优于竞争基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提框架有效对齐结构和特征表示，在多种图结构下具有鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Heuristic Learning for Active Flow Control Using Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Active flow control involves nonlinear dynamics, partial observations, and computationally expensive simulations, making controller design particularly challenging. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has emerged as a powerful framework for such problems, but its success typically relies on large numbers of simulator interactions and produces neural-network policies whose decision process often remains difficult to interpret. In this work, we investigate a different paradigm: instead of optimizing neural-network parameters, we use modern coding agents to search directly for explicit executable feedback laws. We introduce a constrained heuristic-learning protocol in which an agent iteratively proposes, evaluates, and revises controller implementations while interacting exclusively through the public benchmark interface. The proposed framework is evaluated on 13 active flow-control benchmarks spanning one, two, and three-dimensional problems and compared against the strongest available DRL baselines under identical simulation budgets. The discovered heuristic controllers match or outperform the best DRL policy in 10 of the 13 environments while remaining compact, interpretable, and directly inspectable. Beyond aggregate performance, the resulting controllers reveal physically meaningful feedback mechanisms, transfer successfully across more challenging configurations, and remain competitive under varying Reynolds and Rayleigh numbers, actuator counts, and observation sparsity. These results suggest that heuristic learning through coding agents constitutes a credible and complementary alternative to conventional reinforcement learning, combining competitive performance with physically interpretable controller representations. Prompts and source code are available at https://github.com/DonsetPG/fluid-heuristic-learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于编码智能体（coding agents）的启发式学习框架，用于主动流动控制（active flow control），直接搜索显式可执行反馈律，而非优化神经网络参数。在13个一至三维主动流动控制基准上，该框架在10个环境中匹配或超越最强深度强化学习（DRL）基线，同时生成的控制器紧凑、可解释且可直接检查，并展现出跨配置迁移能力。
Motivation: 深度强化学习在主动流动控制中依赖大量仿真交互且策略难以解释，而传统启发式方法缺乏自动搜索能力。本文旨在探索一种替代范式，通过编码智能体自动发现可解释的显式控制律。
Method: 引入约束启发式学习协议：编码智能体通过公共基准接口迭代提出、评估和修订控制器实现，在固定仿真预算下搜索紧凑的显式反馈律。
Result: 在13个基准中，10个环境下的启发式控制器匹配或超过最强DRL策略，且控制器具有物理意义的反馈机制，能在不同雷诺数、瑞利数、执行器数量和观测稀疏性下保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 启发式学习通过编码智能体构成传统强化学习的可信补充，兼具竞争性能与物理可解释性。代码已开源。

papers.title: MonkeyOCRv2: A Visual-Text Foundation Model for Document AI
papers.abstract_en: Mainstream visual encoders are pretrained on natural images and cannot be effectively applied to document images without document-oriented adaptation, as dense text and fine-grained character strokes demand character-level visual perception. We present MonkeyOCRv2, a visual-text pretrained model for document AI. First, we construct MonkeyDoc v2, to our knowledge the largest document-image pretraining corpus, comprising 113 million images spanning 17 languages. Second, we propose a pretraining strategy that jointly learns image-to-text generation and pixel-level document reconstruction: the former aligns visual representations with textual content, while the latter preserves character strokes and layout details. Extensive experiments are conducted on five representative document analysis tasks, including text recognition, formula recognition, text detection, document tampering detection, and overlapping text segmentation. Replacing the original encoders with MonkeyOCRv2 consistently improves performance across all five tasks. Finally, we validate its effectiveness as the vision encoder of multimodal large language models on the more challenging tasks of document parsing and document understanding. Kept frozen and paired with a lightweight language model, it yields a 0.7B document parsing model that sets a new open-source state-of-the-art on MDPBench, a recent benchmark spanning digital-born and photographed documents across 17 languages, surpassing the previous best 3B dots.mocr by 2.8% absolute with a vision encoder roughly 11$\times$ smaller. The frozen encoder also powers a document understanding model that outperforms counterparts built on CLIP, DINO, and SAM across eight benchmarks under identical training settings. These results suggest that document-oriented visual pretraining can serve as a foundation for document intelligence in its own right.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MonkeyOCRv2，一个面向文档AI的视觉文本预训练模型。构建了最大的文档图像预训练语料库MonkeyDoc v2（1.13亿图像，17种语言），并提出联合学习图像到文本生成和像素级文档重建的预训练策略。在五个文档分析任务上一致提升性能。作为多模态大语言模型的视觉编码器，冻结后与轻量语言模型配合，在MDPBench上以0.7B模型超越之前最佳3B模型2.8%绝对值，编码器小11倍。
Motivation: 主流视觉编码器在自然图像上预训练，无法直接有效应用于文档图像，因为密集文本和细粒度字符笔画需要字符级视觉感知。
Method: 构建最大文档图像预训练语料库MonkeyDoc v2（1.13亿图像，17种语言）。提出预训练策略：联合学习图像到文本生成（对齐视觉表示与文本内容）和像素级文档重建（保留字符笔画和布局细节）。
Result: 在文本识别、公式识别、文本检测、文档篡改检测、重叠文本分割五个任务上一致提升。作为视觉编码器用于文档解析，在MDPBench上以0.7B模型超越之前最佳3B模型（2.8%绝对提升），编码器小11倍；文档理解模型在8个基准上超越CLIP、DINO、SAM。
Conclusion: 面向文档的视觉预训练可以作为文档智能的基础。

papers.title: Technical Report on the CVPR 2026@AdvML Workshop Challenge
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language agents (VLAs) are increasingly used to interpret complex driving scenes and support safety-critical reasoning. This report presents the CVPR 2026@AdvML Workshop Challenge on adversarial multimodal attacks against autonomous-driving VLAs. Built on DriveLM-style multi-view visual question answering, the challenge represents each scene with six synchronized camera images and a structured collection of driving-related question-answer pairs. Participants generate adversarial images and suffix-only textual perturbations that induce model responses to deviate from reference answers while preserving image fidelity and limiting textual cost. The competition comprises two phases, with Phase II adding a hidden black-box model to assess transferability. We describe the task design, submission rules, evaluation protocol, and leaderboard results, and then examine five leading submissions for which technical reports were available. Across these reports, several recurring patterns emerge: image-side attacks are favored by the suffix penalty; scene-level, multi-view optimization is more effective than treating views in isolation; QA types and graph structure provide useful priors for allocating attack budget; feature-space objectives can improve black-box transfer; and typographic content embedded in camera images exposes a persistent vulnerability in driving VLAs. These findings provide a practical reference for future robustness evaluation and defense design in multimodal autonomous-driving systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是CVPR 2026@AdvML Workshop挑战赛的技术报告，聚焦于针对自动驾驶视觉语言模型（VLA）的对抗性多模态攻击。挑战基于DriveLM风格的多视角视觉问答，通过生成对抗性图像和文本扰动使模型输出偏离参考答案。报告描述了任务设计、提交规则、评估协议和排行榜结果，并分析了五个获胜方案的共通模式，包括图像侧攻击、多视角优化、利用QA类型和图形结构分配攻击预算、特征空间目标提升黑盒迁移性，以及相机图像中排版内容的脆弱性。
Motivation: 自动驾驶VLA在安全关键推理中日益重要，但易受对抗攻击威胁。现有攻击方法缺乏针对多模态VLA的标准化评估平台，该挑战旨在系统评估和推动对抗性攻击与防御研究。
Method: 构建基于DriveLM的多视角视觉问答数据集，每场景使用六张同步相机图像和结构化问答对。攻击者需生成对抗图像和仅后缀文本扰动，使模型响应偏离参考答案，同时保持图像逼真度和限制文本成本。挑战分两阶段，第二阶段引入隐藏黑盒模型评估迁移性。
Result: 报告展示了排行榜结果，并总结了五个顶级方案的共同发现：图像侧攻击因后缀惩罚而更受青睐；场景级多视角优化优于单视图；QA类型和图形结构有助于分配攻击预算；特征空间目标可改进黑盒迁移；相机图像中的排版内容暴露了VLA的持久漏洞。

papers.title: Single-Teacher View Augmentation: Enhancing Knowledge Distillation with Student-Guided Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) typically relies on the fixed perspective of a single teacher, limiting the diversity of supervisory signals. While multi-teacher distillation addresses this by aggregating knowledge from multiple models, it incurs prohibitive computational and storage costs. To balance efficiency and diversity, recent research has focused on generating virtual views from a single teacher. However, existing methods face a trade-off: random perturbation approaches offer efficiency but lack controlled diversity, while structured augmentation methods require multi-stage training and incur linear parameter growth. We observe that this trade-off stems from a common design choice: using the teacher's strong but static features to generate views. Instead, we propose Shift-Augmented Knowledge Distillation (SAKD), a simple yet effective framework that leverages the student's evolving features as a dynamic condition for perturbation generation. This shift in perspective enables single-stage training while producing adaptive, diverse views through a parameter-free cyclic shift. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet demonstrate that SAKD consistently outperforms random perturbation methods and achieves accuracy on par with two-stage approaches, while using significantly fewer parameters and eliminating pre-training requirements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的知识蒸馏方法SAKD，通过利用学生网络的动态特征生成适应性视图，克服了传统单教师蒸馏视角固定和随机扰动缺乏控制的问题，在CIFAR-100和ImageNet上达到与两阶段方法相当的精度且无需预训练。
Motivation: 单教师蒸馏视角固定限制了监督信号的多样性，多教师蒸馏成本高，现有单教师视图增强方法在效率和多样性之间存在权衡，作者指出这一权衡源于使用教师静态特征生成视图。
Method: 提出Shift-Augmented Knowledge Distillation (SAKD)，利用学生网络的演化特征作为动态条件，通过无参数的循环移位生成适应性多样化视图，实现单阶段训练。
Result: 在CIFAR-100和ImageNet上，SAKD一致优于随机扰动方法，精度与两阶段方法相当，且参数量显著减少，无需预训练。
Conclusion: SAKD通过切换视角（使用学生特征而非教师特征）有效平衡了效率与多样性，为单教师蒸馏提供了一种简单而有效的改进方案。

papers.title: Advancing Optimal Subset Oracle via Learning Relaxation of Neural Set Functions
papers.abstract_en: Learning neural set functions is pivotal to a wide range of important applications, including compound selection in AI-driven drug discovery and product recommendation. Recent work has introduced optimal subset oracles to implicitly learn set functions under practical weakly supervised settings, where model parameters are optimized through mean-field variational inference. However, these frameworks rely on Monte Carlo sampling to estimate gradients of the evidence lower bound when updating the variational distribution. Repeated sampling across iterations incurs substantial computational overhead, while the resulting stochasticity can destabilize the optimization trajectory. In this work, we reinterpret the evidence lower bound as a continuous relaxation of the set function and learn a surrogate objective that replaces sampling-based ELBO gradient estimation during variational optimization. The learned surrogate provides stable and efficient gradients throughout the continuous domain, thereby reducing computational overhead and accelerating inference. Furthermore, we establish an approximation guarantee for the proposed framework under submodular maximization and characterize its connection to variational free energy. Experiments on a variety of real-world tasks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对弱监督设置下通过最优子集 oracle 隐式学习神经集函数的框架，重新解释证据下界 (ELBO) 为集函数的连续松弛，并学习一个替代目标函数，在变分优化过程中替代基于采样的 ELBO 梯度估计。该方法提供稳定高效的梯度，减少计算开销并加速推理，同时建立了子模最大化下的近似保证以及与变分自由能的联系。实验在多种真实任务上显示了一致的改进。
Motivation: 现有最优子集 oracle 框架依赖蒙特卡洛采样估计 ELBO 梯度，反复采样导致巨大计算开销，且随机性破坏优化稳定性。
Method: 将 ELBO 重新解释为集函数的连续松弛，并学习一个替代目标函数，在连续域中提供稳定梯度，替代采样估计。
Result: 在多种真实任务（如化合物选择和产品推荐）上，该方法相对于现有基线取得一致改进，并降低了计算开销。
Conclusion: 所提框架通过连续松弛替代采样梯度估计，在保证近似性能的同时提升效率，适用于弱监督集函数学习。

papers.title: Training-Free Off-Screen Player Imputation for Broadcast-Based Spatial Football Analytics
papers.abstract_en: Spatial football metrics such as pitch control assume access to the positions of all 22 players, yet the most widely available source of positional data -- the broadcast main camera -- shows only 10-16 of them at any moment. We quantify the resulting distortion with an open, reproducible benchmark: a simulated broadcast viewport applied to open full-pitch tracking data (Metrica Sports; three matches, one held out from method development). Ignoring off-screen players -- the visible-only baseline implied whenever a video-based game-state-reconstruction (GSR) pipeline adds no imputation layer -- inflates hidden-zone pitch-control error to 25.1-26.9 percentage points and a mean absolute control-share error of 11.1-13.4 points across the three matches. We then evaluate a ladder of training-free, online imputation baselines that use only observations from the match being analysed. The best overall on these decision-relevant metrics, role-anchored centroid voting (each visible player votes for the full-team centroid by subtracting its running role offset, attenuating the viewport-induced subset bias), roughly halves hidden-zone error (to 12.2-13.8 points) and cuts control-share error to 28-48% of the ignore policy at every viewport width from 36 m to 60 m in all three matches. For occlusions <=9.6 s -- the regime of the closest learned prior work -- it reaches binwise median position errors of 3.3-8.9 m; but 50-57% of hidden-player observations lie beyond that regime. Integrated end-to-end into a broadcast-video GSR pipeline, imputation moves a downstream possession-quality score (Space-Creation Index) by 15.6 and 17.2 points on two real World Cup broadcast windows, flipping the verdict class in one.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/nowayfootball/offscreen-impute
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文量化了广播主镜头中离屏球员缺失导致的球场控制指标失真，并提出一种无需训练的在线插值基线方法（role-anchored centroid voting）。在公开数据集Metrica Sports上，该方法将隐藏区控制误差从25-27个百分点降至12-14个百分点，控制份额误差降至忽略策略的28-48%。对于短于9.6秒的遮挡，位置误差为3.3-8.9米；在真实世界杯广播窗口上，插值使下游空间创造指数移动15.6-17.2分，并翻转一个窗口的判定类别。
Motivation: 现有空间足球指标假设全部22名球员位置已知，但广播主镜头只能看到10-16名球员，忽略离屏球员会严重扭曲指标，而缺乏对此问题的量化基准和有效插值方法。
Method: 提出一种无需训练、仅基于当前比赛观测的在线插值方法：角色锚定质心投票（role-anchored centroid voting），每个可见球员通过减去其角色偏移来投票全队质心，以减轻视口引起的子集偏差。
Result: 在Metrica Sports三个比赛数据上，该方法将隐藏区控制误差从25.1-26.9个百分点降至12.2-13.8个百分点，控制份额误差降至忽略策略的28-48%；对<=9.6秒遮挡，中位数位置误差为3.3-8.9米，但50-57%的离屏观察超出该范围。在真实世界杯广播窗口上，插值使空间创造指数移动15.6和17.2分，并翻转一个窗口的判定类别。
Conclusion: 论文强调离屏插值对于广播视频足球分析的必要性，提供了一个可复现基准和有效的无训练基线，并指出多数离屏观察时长超出先前学习方法的适用范围。

papers.title: Condition-Stratified Robustness Analysis of Post-Hoc Calibration Methods for Probabilistic Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Post-hoc calibration is widely adopted to correct probability estimates from trained classifiers, yet most evaluations report aggregate performance without testing whether that performance holds across distinct operating conditions within a single dataset. We present a pre-registered, condition-stratified robustness analysis comparing temperature scaling (TEMP) and isotonic regression (ISO) across four controlled conditions (C1--C4). Four hypothesis groups are evaluated: discrimination deltas with Holm-corrected multiplicity control (H1), Brier score differences (H2), calibration slope outcomes (H3), and AUROC differences under best-condition setups (H4). TEMP-minus-ISO discrimination deltas remain small across all conditions (-0.0155 to 0.0139), with Holm-adjusted p-values of 0.9895 everywhere. TEMP Brier differences are consistently negative (C1: -0.0002 through C4: -0.0074), while ISO shows sign reversals. TEMP calibration slopes stay closer to unity in every condition (range 0.7597--0.9493) than ISO slopes (0.1364--0.2726). AUROC differences shift from near zero in C1 (-0.0004) to positive in C4 (0.0264). These results establish that in-dataset robustness is condition-dependent and metric-specific. No claim of external transportability is made.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对温度缩放（TEMP）和等渗回归（ISO）两种事后校准方法进行了条件分层鲁棒性分析，在四个受控条件（C1-C4）下比较了判别差异、Brier分数、校准斜率和AUROC差异。结果表明鲁棒性依赖于条件和具体指标，TEMP在多个指标上表现更稳定。
Motivation: 现有事后校准方法的评估通常报告聚合性能，未检验性能在数据集内不同操作条件下的稳定性。
Method: 采用预注册的条件分层鲁棒性分析，比较TEMP和ISO在四个受控条件下的表现，使用Holm校正控制多重比较。
Result: TEMP与ISO的判别差异在所有条件下很小（-0.0155至0.0139），Holm校正p值为0.9895；TEMP的Brier分数始终为负，ISO出现符号反转；TEMP校准斜率更接近1（0.7597-0.9493），ISO斜率较低（0.1364-0.2726）；AUROC差异从C1的-0.0004变化到C4的0.0264。
Conclusion: 数据集内的鲁棒性是条件依赖和指标特定的，未声称结果的跨环境可迁移性。

papers.title: Random Label Prediction Heads for Studying Memorization in Deep Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a straightforward yet effective method to empirically study memorization in deep neural networks for classification tasks. Our approach augments each training sample with auxiliary random labels, which are then predicted by a random label prediction head (RLP-head). RLP-heads can be attached at arbitrary depths of a network, predicting random labels from the corresponding intermediate representation and thereby enabling analysis of how memorization capacity evolves across layers. By interpreting the RLP-head performance as an empirical estimate of Rademacher complexity, we obtain a direct measure of both sample-level memorization and model capacity. We leverage this random label accuracy metric to analyze generalization and overfitting in different models and datasets. Building on this approach, we further propose a novel regularization technique based on the output of the RLP-head, which demonstrably reduces memorization. Interestingly, our experiments reveal that reducing memorization can either improve or impair generalization, depending on the dataset and training setup. These findings challenge the traditional assumption that overfitting is equivalent to memorization and suggest new hypotheses to reconcile these seemingly contradictory results. The source code is available at https://github.com/MarlonBecker/RandomLabelHeads
papers.journal_ref: ICLR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种通过辅助随机标签预测头（RLP-head）来研究深度神经网络记忆化的方法。RLP-head可附加在网络的任意深度，从中间表示预测随机标签，从而分析记忆能力在各层的变化。将RLP-head的性能解释为Rademacher复杂度的经验估计，获得样本级记忆化和模型容量的直接度量。基于该方法，进一步提出一种基于RLP-head输出的正则化技术，可减少记忆化。实验表明，减少记忆化既可能提升也可能损害泛化能力，具体取决于数据集和训练设置，挑战了过拟合即记忆化的传统假设。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏直接度量深度神经网络中逐层记忆化程度的方法，难以区分过拟合与记忆化之间的关系。
Method: 为每个训练样本附加辅助随机标签，通过随机标签预测头（RLP-head）预测这些标签；RLP-head可嵌入网络任意深度，利用中间表示预测随机标签；将RLP-head的准确率作为Rademacher复杂度的经验估计，用于量化记忆化和模型容量。
Result: 实验表明，减少记忆化的正则化技术在不同数据集和训练设置下对泛化能力的影响不同，有时提升泛化，有时损害泛化。
Conclusion: 这些发现挑战了过拟合即记忆化的传统假设，提示需要重新审视记忆化与泛化的关系。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种通过辅助随机标签预测头（RLP-head）来研究深度神经网络记忆化的方法。RLP-head可附加在网络的任意深度，从中间表示预测随机标签，从而分析记忆能力在各层的变化。将RLP-head的性能解释为Rademacher复杂度的经验估计，获得样本级记忆化和模型容量的直接度量。基于该方法，进一步提出一种基于RLP-head输出的正则化技术，可减少记忆化。实验表明，减少记忆化既可能提升也可能损害泛化能力，具体取决于数据集和训练设置，挑战了过拟合即记忆化的传统假设。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有研究缺乏直接度量深度神经网络中逐层记忆化程度的方法，难以区分过拟合与记忆化之间的关系。
summary_sections.method: 为每个训练样本附加辅助随机标签，通过随机标签预测头（RLP-head）预测这些标签；RLP-head可嵌入网络任意深度，利用中间表示预测随机标签；将RLP-head的准确率作为Rademacher复杂度的经验估计，用于量化记忆化和模型容量。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明，减少记忆化的正则化技术在不同数据集和训练设置下对泛化能力的影响不同，有时提升泛化，有时损害泛化。
summary_sections.conclusion: 这些发现挑战了过拟合即记忆化的传统假设，提示需要重新审视记忆化与泛化的关系。

papers.title: Tropical Circuits with Scalar Multiplication Gates
papers.abstract_en: We study tropical circuits with scalar multiplication gates, that is, algebraic circuits whose gates implement $\max$, $+$, or multiplication with a positive constant. For such circuits, we prove exponential size lower bounds for computing maximum weight directed spanning trees and maximum weight bipartite perfect matchings. As a corollary, we obtain an exponential size separation between monotone and non-monotone maxout neural networks, which generalize the popularly used ReLU neural networks. One conclusion from this is that neural network models with enforced convexity constraints, such as input-convex neural networks (ICNNs), sometimes need to be exponentially larger than their unrestricted counterparts in order to express the same functions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带有标量乘法门的热带电路，即实现了 max、+ 或与正常数相乘的代数电路。证明了计算最大权重有向生成树和最大权重二分完美匹配的指数级大小下界，并由此得到单调与非单调最大输出神经网络之间的指数级大小分离，表明输入凸神经网络（ICNN）等强制凸性约束的神经网络有时需要指数级更大的规模才能表达相同函数。
Motivation: 热带电路的理论下界对于理解神经网络的计算能力至关重要，尤其是单调与非单调神经网络的表达能力差异尚未充分探索。
Method: 通过热带电路框架，利用标量乘法门，对最大权重有向生成树和最大权重二分完美匹配问题建立指数级大小下界，并以此导出神经网络模型的大小分离结果。
Result: 证明了热带电路在计算上述两个组合优化问题时需要指数级规模；作为推论，单调最大输出神经网络在某些函数上必须比非单调版本指数级更大。
Conclusion: 该结果揭示了强制凸性约束（如ICNN）可能导致神经网络表达能力受限，需要更大规模才能等价于无约束网络。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive Routing for Efficient Diffusion Transformer-Based PNI Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Perineural invasion (PNI) is a critical prognostic factor in cholangiocarcinoma. However, its preoperative prediction from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) remains challenging due to subtle imaging features that extend beyond tumor boundaries into surrounding regions. Conventional convolutional neural networks are limited in capturing long-range spatial dependencies. Transformer-based architectures improve global modeling of volumetric MRI by aggregating spatially distributed contextual cues, yet capturing subtle and noise-sensitive patterns in peritumoral regions remains challenging. Diffusion-based classifiers offer an alternative formulation by leveraging denoising-based class scoring to better capture such subtle patterns. However, these approaches introduce substantial computational overhead due to the combination of transformer-based modeling and iterative denoising processes. To address these challenges, we formulate PNI prediction as a diffusion-based classification problem and implement the denoising network using a transformer-based representation. To improve computational efficiency, we introduce adaptive routing across attention heads, spatial tokens, and MLP width. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves an AUC of 0.731 with 257.57 GFLOPs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于扩散Transformer的自适应路由方法，用于术前预测胆管癌的神经周围侵犯（PNI）。该方法将PNI预测建模为扩散分类问题，并通过自适应路由（跨注意力头、空间token和MLP宽度）降低计算开销。实验表明，该方法在MRI数据上实现0.731的AUC，计算量为257.57 GFLOPs。
Motivation: 术前从MRI预测PNI具有挑战性，因为成像特征细微且超出肿瘤边界。现有Transformer虽能捕捉全局依赖，但计算成本高；扩散分类器可捕捉细微模式，但迭代去噪进一步增加开销。
Method: 将PNI预测公式化为扩散分类问题，使用Transformer作为去噪网络，并引入自适应路由机制（动态选择注意力头、空间token和MLP宽度）以提高计算效率。
Result: 摘要报告AUC为0.731，计算量为257.57 GFLOPs。
Conclusion: 自适应路由能有效降低扩散Transformer在医学影像分类中的计算开销，同时保持较高的预测性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Residual Kinematic Corrections for Continuous Neural Decoding via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Decoding continuous three-dimensional (3D) motor imagery (MI) using non-invasive electroencephalography (EEG)-based brain--computer interfaces (BCIs) remains challenging due to signal variability and residual decoding errors. Deep learning architectures such as convolutional neural network--long short-term memory (CNN--LSTM) models can capture spatial and temporal dynamics for continuous kinematic decoding; however, systematic residual errors persist in predicted trajectories. We propose a two-stage decoding framework that applies reinforcement learning (RL) to perform residual kinematic correction on the outputs of a CNN--LSTM decoder (CNN--LSTM--RL). The RL agent is trained offline without direct EEG input and instead operates on predicted kinematic trajectories to optimize movement accuracy relative to target trajectories. Decoding performance was quantified using Pearson correlation coefficients ($r$) and Root Mean Square Errors (RMSE) along the $x, y$, and $z$ axes. Compared to CNN--LSTM applied alone, CNN--LSTM--RL improved the mean correlation from $0.5076$ to $0.7181$ ($p = 0.0005$) in 2D and from $0.6420$ to $0.7780$ ($p = 0.0059$) in VR, with relative gains of $41.5\%$ and $21.2\%$, respectively. Correspondingly, RMSE was reduced from $0.0890$ to $0.0532$ (2D, $p < 0.0001$) and from $0.0714$ to $0.0441$ (VR, $p < 0.0001$), representing relative reductions of $40.2\%$ and $38.2\%$. These findings demonstrate that this scalable framework enhances 3D BCI MI decoding by correcting kinematic errors via offline residual RL without extra neural data, advancing neurorehabilitation, prosthetics, and virtual interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个两阶段框架CNN-LSTM-RL，利用强化学习对CNN-LSTM解码器输出的连续三维运动想象轨迹进行残差校正。实验表明该方法在2D和VR条件下将Pearson相关系数提升至0.7181和0.7780，RMSE降低约40%，且无需额外的神经数据。
Motivation: 基于非侵入式EEG的连续三维运动想象解码仍存在信号变异和系统性残差误差，现有深度学习模型无法完全消除。
Method: 将强化学习（RL）作为残差校正模块，离线训练，输入为CNN-LSTM解码器输出的预测轨迹，无需直接处理EEG信号，通过优化轨迹准确性来修正残差。
Result: CNN-LSTM-RL相比仅用CNN-LSTM，在2D和VR环境中平均相关系数分别从0.5076提升至0.7181（增益41.5%）和从0.6420提升至0.7780（增益21.2%）；RMSE分别降低40.2%和38.2%。
Conclusion: 该可扩展框架通过离线残差RL校正运动解码误差，无需额外神经数据，可推动神经康复、假肢和虚拟交互应用。

papers.title: Parse, Search, and Confirmation: Training-Free Aerial Vision-and-Dialog Navigation with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning and Structured Spatial Memory
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we tackle the Aerial Vision-and-Dialog Navigation (AVDN) task in the training-free setting for resource-efficient high-altitude UAV navigation.Naively applying MLLMs leads to unreliable navigation due to weak directional grounding and the lack of explicit spatial memory.To address these issues, we propose PSC-AVDN, a training-free framework that tightly couples a three-stage Parsing-Search-Confirmation reasoning pipeline with a Structured Spatial Memory (SSM).The parsing stage uses an LLM to convert ambiguous dialogue instructions into stable geometric directional and destination cues.A Search Chain-of-Thought (S-CoT) then performs stepwise target exploration under high-altitude observations, and a Confirmation Chain-of-Thought (C-CoT) conducts fine-grained verification around candidate regions to resolve visual ambiguity.Meanwhile, SSM integrates three complementary sources of spatial cues, including multi-scale visual observation, spatial visual memory, and structured geometric memory to provide global spatial context and long-horizon consistency.Extensive experiments on ANDH and ANDH-Full show that PSC-AVDN establishes new state-of-the-art performance in the training-free setting, matching or surpassing several finetuned methods.Code will be publicly available at: https://github.com/QY6616/PSC-AVDN
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 2026, pp. 23859-23868
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对空中视觉对话导航（AVDN）任务，在无训练（training-free）设置下提出PSC-AVDN框架。该框架通过三段式推理流程（解析-搜索-确认）与结构化空间记忆（SSM）耦合，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）和链式思维（Chain-of-Thought）进行高精度导航。实验表明，PSC-AVDN在ANDH和ANDH-Full数据集上达到无训练设置的最新最优性能，甚至超越若干微调方法。
Motivation: 现有方法在无训练设置下直接使用MLLM进行空中导航时，面临方向定位弱和缺乏显式空间记忆的问题，导致导航不可靠。
Method: 提出PSC-AVDN框架，包含三个阶段：解析阶段利用LLM将模糊对话指令转化为稳定的几何方向与目的地线索；搜索阶段使用搜索链式思维（S-CoT）逐步探索目标；确认阶段使用确认链式思维（C-CoT）在候选区域进行细粒度验证以消除视觉歧义。同时，结构化空间记忆（SSM）整合多尺度视觉观测、空间视觉记忆和结构化几何记忆三种互补空间线索，提供全局空间上下文和长期一致性。
Result: 在ANDH和ANDH-Full数据集上的大量实验表明，PSC-AVDN在无训练设置下达到最新最优性能，匹配或超越若干微调方法。
Conclusion: 本文证明了在无训练条件下，通过结构化推理和空间记忆可以显著提升空中视觉对话导航的性能，为资源受限的高空无人机导航提供了有效方案。

papers.title: AutoMatBench: An Automatic Optimization Toolkit for the Acceleration of Material Properties Prediction Benchmarking
papers.abstract_en: Material property prediction (MPP) infers key properties from chemical composition and structure, accelerating the discovery and optimization of novel materials. In the realm of MPP, MatBench is a widely accepted benchmarking tool that defines over ten significant problems and provides the paradigm of performance evaluation for AI prediction models. Even though MatBench works well in benchmarking the performances of prediction models on in-distribution (ID) tasks and datasets, it lacks the ability to reflect their performances on out-of-distribution (OOD) material data, resulting failure in new material discovery. By combining the pipelines of MatBench and the existing researches on OOD performance evaluation, this study enables a huge space of benchmarking configurations, comprehensively reflecting the performances, abilities, and disadvantages of various AI prediction models. This work reports that the discrepancy of performances at different configuration values is huge and can be illustrated with prior knowledge and novel insights, therefore consideration of causal effect of configurations on performance results is necessary. In case of the impossibility of enumerative benchmarking at every configuration, this work further proposes AutoMatBench, an automatic toolkit with Bayesian optimization. Experiments with AutoMatBench reports that, within twelve steps of optimization, the similar results with MatBench and former OOD research can be accessed while more than half of the cost are saved. Besides, this tool also yields more essential findings on MPP benchmarking, positively contributing to the cost and efficiency of new material discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AutoMatBench，一个基于贝叶斯优化的自动工具包，用于材料属性预测（MPP）的基准测试。它扩展了MatBench，使其能够评估分布外（OOD）数据上的模型性能，并在12步优化内达到与MatBench和先前OOD研究类似的结果，同时节省超过一半的成本。
Motivation: MatBench在分布外（OOD）材料数据上表现不足，限制了新材料发现。需要一种能够全面评估模型性能的自动化方法。
Method: 结合MatBench流水线和现有OOD性能评估研究，提出AutoMatBench，利用贝叶斯优化自动搜索最佳基准配置，避免穷举所有配置。
Result: 在12步优化内，AutoMatBench达到与MatBench和先前OOD研究类似的结果，同时节省超过一半的计算成本。
Conclusion: 不同配置下的性能差异显著，需考虑配置的因果效应。AutoMatBench有助于低成本高效发现新材料。

papers.title: Vinci2: Providing Proactive Assistance in Continuous Egocentric Videos
papers.abstract_en: When should an intelligent assistant speak up without being asked? Continuous egocentric video offers rich, evolving context that enables a new form of assistance: one that is proactive rather than merely reactive. Yet existing approaches either wait passively for user queries or treat every detected event as requiring a response, without considering the user's history, current activity, or whether assistance would actually be welcome. We reframe proactive assistance as a context-dependent decision problem: the agent must not only perceive what is happening, but reason over accumulated temporal context to determine when and whether to intervene. To this end, we present Vinci2, a proactive egocentric assistance system that advances the on-device assistant Vinci from reactive response toward proactivity. On the evaluation side, we present EgoServe, the first large-scale benchmark for proactive assistance in continuous egocentric video. EgoServe comprises over 3,000 service instances organized along 4 temporal memory horizons, ranging from immediate safety alerts to long-term habit coaching, across 10 service categories. On the modeling side, we propose EgoMemo, a training-free, memory-augmented agent that maintains three complementary memory representations: multi-scale temporal summaries, a semantic knowledge graph, and visual embedding archives. At each timestep, EgoMemo performs retrieval-augmented reasoning to determine whether assistance is warranted and, if so, produces contextually grounded responses. Experiments demonstrate that EgoMemo establishes strong baselines on EgoServe while remaining competitive on existing egocentric benchmarks. Our benchmark and code are publicly available at \href{https://sitonggong.github.io/EgoServe-page/}{Vinci2}.

papers.title: Toward Inclusive Avatar Design with Limb Differences Through Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: As extended reality becomes more popular for social interaction and entertainment, 3D avatars must represent the full diversity of body types. Most 3D avatar systems only support normative bodies and do not accurately depict people with limb differences, amputations, or other morphological variations. This paper reviews emerging technical approaches for inclusive 3D avatar customization for this group and current guidelines that promote respectful and accurate representation. We highlight persistent challenges, including the scarcity of diverse datasets and the limitations in animation for non-normative anatomies. This paper positions artificial intelligence as a promising path to overcoming these limitations and advancing inclusive 3D avatar generation.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Computing in Science & Engineering, Apr.-Jun. 2026, pp. 81-88, vol. 28
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了面向肢体差异人群的包容性3D头像定制技术，分析了当前支持非规范身体形态的头像生成方法及挑战，并指出了人工智能在克服数据集稀缺和非规范动画限制方面的潜力。
Motivation: 现有3D头像系统主要支持规范身体形态，无法准确表现肢体差异、截肢等形态变异，导致XR社交和娱乐场景中的代表性不足。
Method: 通过文献综述梳理了包容性头像定制的技术方法、现有指南以及人工智能的潜在解决路径，未提出具体新方法。
Result: 识别出两大挑战：多样化数据集的稀缺和非规范解剖结构的动画局限性。
Conclusion: 人工智能被认为是克服现有局限、推动包容性3D头像生成的有前景方向，但本文未提供实证验证。

papers.title: DAG-FM: A Foundation Model for Causal Discovery under Heterogeneous Causal Mechanisms
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery from observational tabular data remains fundamentally challenging, primarily due to the heterogeneity of underlying causal mechanisms and the high-dimensional combinatorial search space of Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs). In this paper, we propose \textbf{DAG-FM}, a novel foundation model architecture that amortizes causal discovery. Unlike direct matrix prediction, DAG-FM decomposes the causal discovery process into two auto-regressive stages using two specialized Transformer-based sub-modules: a leaf-node predictor and a parent-node predictor. To effectively model complex row-column interactions, we adopt a robust tabular interaction block to output feature-wise representations. Crucially, to handle diverse and unknown Functional Causal Model (FCM) assumptions in real-world scenarios, we introduce Mixture-of-Leaf-Experts (MoLE), allowing the model to dynamically route and adapt to identifiable mechanism families. Through an iterative inference algorithm, DAG-FM seamlessly extracts causal orderings and constructs valid DAGs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DAG-FM achieves state-of-the-art performance on both synthetic benchmarks and complex real-world datasets, significantly outperforming traditional classical algorithms and recent foundation models in both accuracy and scalability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DAG-FM 是一个基于 Transformer 的基础模型，通过两阶段自回归（叶节点预测和父节点预测）和混合叶专家（MoLE）模块，处理异构因果机制下的因果发现，在合成和真实数据集上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法在处理异构因果机制和高维 DAG 搜索空间时面临挑战，且难以适应多样化的功能因果模型假设。
Method: DAG-FM 将因果发现分解为两个自回归阶段，分别用 Transformer 子模块预测叶节点和父节点；引入表格交互块学习特征表示，并通过混合叶专家（MoLE）动态路由适应不同机制族。
Result: 在合成基准和复杂真实数据集上，DAG-FM 在准确性和可扩展性上显著优于传统算法和近期基础模型。
Conclusion: DAG-FM 提供了一种可扩展的因果发现基础模型，能够有效处理异构因果机制，但摘要未讨论具体局限。

papers.title: CFR-Net:Collaborative Feature Refnement Network for Medical Image Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Medical image anomaly detection remains challenging because networks pretrained on natural images often exhibit limited adaptability to medical images, where abnormal patterns appear as fine-grained local shifts, multi-scale contextual mismatches, and orientation-sensitive structural deviations. To address this, we propose the Collaborative Feature Refinement Network (CFR-Net), which combines shared teacher-student feature refinement before decoding with cross-space consistency after decoding. CFR-Net refines frozen teacher features and trainable student features using a Multi-Path Feature Refinement Module (MPFRM) with shared parameters, imposing common multi-path refinement rules on generic visual references and representations adapted to the medical domain, thereby mitigating domain discrepancy while modeling local, multi-scale, and orientation-sensitive feature characteristics. A variance-sensitive objective and dynamic ``homework set'' reorganization further support layer-adaptive consistency learning. Experiments on medical benchmarks show that CFR-Net achieves competitive anomaly classification and strong anomaly localization performance when trained on normal data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出协同特征精炼网络（CFR-Net）解决医学图像异常检测中预训练网络适应性不足的问题。CFR-Net在解码前通过共享参数的多路径特征精炼模块（MPFRM）联合优化教师和学生特征，并在解码后引入跨空间一致性约束。方差敏感目标和动态"作业集"重组支持逐层自适应学习。在医学基准上，仅使用正常数据训练即可实现有竞争力的异常分类和定位性能。
Motivation: 自然图像预训练网络对医学图像适应性有限，医学异常表现为细粒度局部偏移、多尺度上下文不匹配和方向敏感的结构偏差。
Method: 提出CFR-Net，包含共享参数的教师-学生特征精炼（MPFRM）和解码后的跨空间一致性，并引入方差敏感目标和动态重组训练策略。
Result: 在医学基准上，仅用正常数据训练即达到有竞争力的异常分类和强异常定位性能。
Conclusion: CFR-Net通过协同特征精炼和一致性学习有效缓解了域差异并建模医学异常特征，但仅在医学图像上验证。

papers.title: CDFM: Towards a General-Purpose Causal Discovery Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery, the process of recovering underlying causal structures from observational data, is a fundamental pursuit across scientific disciplines. Over the past decades, numerous algorithms have been developed to tackle this challenge through workflows tailored to the specific causal mechanisms underlying each type of dataset, demonstrating effectiveness across a wide range of applications. However, as the volume and heterogeneity of real-world data continue to grow, this dataset-specific approach inevitably leads to a fragmented, test-driven paradigm that struggles to scale to the demands of modern scientific discovery. To address this, we formulate the Causal Discovery Foundation Model (CDFM) as a unified, general-purpose framework for zero-shot structural inference. To ensure reliable generalization across unknown domains, we first investigate the theoretical boundaries of causal identifiability, revealing the indispensable role of causal prior mechanisms in this process. Building on these insights, we formulate a principled variational framework that treats unknown causal mechanisms as latent variables and mathematically decomposes the intractable marginal likelihood into distinct, tractable learning modules. The variational decomposition provides a conceptual design principle for the architecture design of CDFM, while comprehensive causal knowledge guides the large-scale synthesis of our pretraining data. By pretraining on a massive, highly diverse space of synthetic structural causal models, CDFM successfully internalizes complex statistical asymmetries. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CDFM consistently outperforms traditional algorithms, driving a paradigm shift toward a general-purpose causal discovery foundation model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出因果发现基础模型（CDFM），通过将未知因果机制视为隐变量并分解边际似然为可学习模块，在大规模合成结构因果模型上预训练，实现零样本因果结构推断。实验表明CDFM在多个基准上超越传统算法。
Motivation: 传统因果发现算法针对特定数据集定制，难以扩展至大规模异质数据；缺乏统一的通用框架。
Method: 建立理论可识别性边界，提出变分框架将因果机制作为隐变量，分解边际似然为多个可学习模块，并基于该框架设计架构与预训练数据合成策略。
Result: 在大规模合成数据上预训练后，CDFM在标准因果发现基准上持续优于传统算法，显示零样本泛化能力。
Conclusion: CDFM展示了通用因果发现基础模型的可行性，但当前仅在合成数据上验证，实际应用中的鲁棒性需进一步检验。

papers.title: SCOPE-RL: Optimizing Reasoning Paths Before and After Success
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) optimizes LLMs using sparse verifiable final-answer rewards. This sparse anchor reliably verifies whether a trajectory succeeds but provides no direct feedback on the reasoning path that produced it. Before success, prerequisite progress on hard problems receives no reward signal; after success, outcome rewards cannot distinguish well-organized correct trajectories from redundant or locally flawed ones. We introduce SCOPE-RL (Scaffolded Chain Optimization with Process Efficiency), a two-stage framework that densifies this anchor while retaining the GRPO update: Adaptive Scaffolded RL adds prefix-decomposed verifiable rewards on answer-hidden sub-question chains before success, and Quality-Aware Process RL applies correctness-gated process-shape rewards to refine correct trajectories after success. An expert-validated Step-Quality Evaluation Protocol evaluates useful-step density, error localization, and token efficiency beyond final-answer accuracy. On Qwen3-8B-Instruct trained on DAPO-Math and Big-Math, SCOPE-RL improves average accuracy by up to 11.2 pp and reduces reasoning tokens by up to 27.1% over outcome-only GRPO; the gains hold under GSPO and on Qwen3-0.6B-Instruct, indicating that reward-signal densification is complementary to policy-update-level RLVR advances. Code and data are available at https://github.com/tokencraft-lab/SCOPE-RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCOPE-RL 提出两阶段框架，通过自适应支架化强化学习和质量感知过程强化学习，在 RLVR 框架下对推理路径进行细粒度奖励密度化，提升 LLM 推理准确性和 token 效率。实验表明在 Qwen3-8B-Instruct 上平均准确率提升 11.2 个百分点，推理 token 减少 27.1%。
Motivation: 标准 RLVR 仅依赖稀疏的最终答案奖励，无法对成功前的关键步骤或成功后的冗余路径提供有效反馈，导致困难问题缺乏中间奖励信号，且无法区分高质量与低质量的成功轨迹。
Method: 提出 SCOPE-RL 两阶段框架：第一阶段 Adaptive Scaffolded RL 在答案隐藏的子问题链上添加前缀分解的可验证奖励；第二阶段 Quality-Aware Process RL 应用正确性门控的过程形状奖励优化正确轨迹。
Result: 在 Qwen3-8B-Instruct 上训练，相比仅使用结果奖励的 GRPO，平均准确率提升最多 11.2 个百分点，推理 token 减少最多 27.1%；在 Qwen3-0.6B-Instruct 及 GSPO 更新下增益保持。
Conclusion: 奖励信号密度化与策略更新层面的 RLVR 改进互补，为提升 LLM 推理性能提供了有效途径。

papers.title: Proxy Exploration and Reusable Guidance: A Modular LLM Post-Training Paradigm via Proxy-Guided Update Signals
papers.abstract_en: Post-training is essential for refining the domain-specific capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet existing reward optimization and distribution matching methods tightly couple policy exploration with distribution alignment. This coupling forces expensive exploration directly on the policy model and severely hinders the asynchronous generation, reuse, and cross-model transfer of optimization signals. In this paper, we propose Proxy-guided Update Signal Transfer (PUST), a novel post-training framework that fundamentally decouples update-signal exploration from distribution alignment. Instead of utilizing the primary model for costly exploration, PUST employs a lightweight proxy model as an efficient testbed to discover high-reward behaviors. We extract the relative improvement signal between the proxy's initial and optimized states, transferring this directional update to the primary model to guide its policy alignment. This decoupled pipeline, comprising proxy exploration, update-signal extraction, and signal transfer, significantly reduces computational overhead and enables optimization signals to be asynchronously generated, cached, and reused. Crucially, by transferring relative improvements rather than absolute policy distributions, PUST naturally supports weak-to-strong improvement and seamless cross-model transfer. Systematic evaluations on Qwen3-family models across math and code domains demonstrate that update signals extracted from substantially weaker proxies can robustly and adjustably enhance stronger primary models. Ultimately, PUST transforms post-training from a monolithic online optimization process into a highly modular, reusable, and cost-efficient paradigm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Proxy-guided Update Signal Transfer (PUST)，一种将 LLM 后训练中更新信号探索与分布对齐解耦的模块化框架。PUST 使用轻量级代理模型高效探索高奖励行为，提取代理模型初始态与优化态之间的相对改进信号，并将其转移到主模型以指导策略对齐。在 Qwen3 系列模型的数学和代码任务上，PUST 验证了弱代理的更新信号能稳健增强强主模型，将后训练从在线优化转变为可复用、低成本的范式。
Motivation: 现有后训练方法（如奖励优化、分布匹配）将策略探索与分布对齐紧密耦合，导致主模型必须直接进行昂贵的在线探索，且优化信号难以异步生成、复用和跨模型迁移。
Method: 提出 PUST 框架，包含三个模块：代理探索（proxy exploration），用轻量级代理模型作为测试床探索高奖励行为；更新信号提取，计算代理初始态与优化态之间的相对改进方向；信号转移，将该方向性更新应用到主模型进行策略对齐。

papers.title: Comparative Analysis of GAT and BERT for Human-Like Playtesting
papers.abstract_en: Accurately modeling and understanding player experience is crucial for designing engaging puzzle games. To achieve this, a common approach involves collecting diverse user data to train predictive playtesting models that mimic player behavior. However, existing data-driven methods often lack the ability to capture the full range of player strategies and require extensive feature engineering and network architecture modeling. This limitation becomes particularly evident when new game mechanics or features are introduced, which necessitate continual adjustments to the models. To addrss these challenges, we propose a more generalized representation that reduces - or even eliminates - the need for ongoing feature-engineering maintenance. Specifically, we investigate two general-purpose network architectures: (a) a transformer-based model (BERT) and (b) a graph attention model (GAT), both of which are designed to effectively capture the relational structure of Candy Crush Saga (CCS) game boards. Our experiments compare these approaches to Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) baselines, revealing better performance on challenging board configurations and underscoring the benefits of our generalizable representation.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 2025 IEEE Conference on Games (CoG), pp. 1-8
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对人类化游戏测试（playtesting）中现有数据驱动方法需要大量特征工程且难以泛化到新游戏机制的问题，提出了两种通用网络架构——基于Transformer的BERT和基于图注意力的GAT——来捕捉Candy Crush Saga游戏板的关系结构。实验表明，这两种模型在挑战性棋盘配置上优于CNN基线，并展示了通用表示的优势。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动的游戏测试方法依赖大量特征工程，且当引入新游戏机制时需要持续调整模型，缺乏泛化能力。
Method: 采用两种通用网络架构：BERT（Transformer）和GAT（图注意力），直接建模游戏板中糖果之间的关系结构，减少或消除特征工程维护。
Result: 在Candy Crush Saga挑战性棋盘配置上，BERT和GAT优于CNN基线，表明通用表示的有效性。

papers.title: HyperGS: Fast and Generalizable Gaussian Video Representation
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian Splatting has emerged as an effective representation for video, but existing methods rely on per-video optimization. This leads to slow encoding and limits generalization across videos. To amortize this optimization, we propose HyperGS, a feedforward, optimization-free approach that directly predicts Gaussian representations from any video in a single forward pass, speeding up encoding and decoding by orders of magnitude while generalizing to out-of-distribution videos at higher resolutions. In HyperGS, we design a factorized spatiotemporal Transformer to extract tokens from video, and a learnable query-based Transformer to obtain 8-parameter Gaussian representations for each video frame. We find that naively predicting Gaussians across diverse videos induces a needle-like degeneration that collapses training, and address this with a rank-based geometric regularizer whose strength adapts dynamically to stabilize optimization. HyperGS achieves encoding at $10^4$--$10^5\times$ the speed of per-video Gaussian optimization at matched reconstruction quality while generalizing zero-shot to $720p$ video, enabling higher-resolution rendering without re-encoding. HyperGS improves PSNR by +2.9--3.1 dB over the prior video encoders on K400, SSv2, and UCF101 at a smaller video representation size. By predicting explicit 2D Gaussians in a single forward pass, HyperGS combines the fast, flexible rendering of Gaussian Splatting with the speed and generalization of feedforward prediction, advancing Gaussians as a practical direction for fast and generalizable video representation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyperGS，一种前馈、无需逐视频优化的高斯视频表示方法。通过分解的时空 Transformer 和可学习查询 Transformer，直接从视频帧预测 8 参数 2D 高斯表示，并引入自适应秩基几何正则化器防止训练崩溃。该方法编码速度比逐视频优化快 10^4–10^5 倍，零样本泛化到 720p 视频，在 K400、SSv2 和 UCF101 上 PSNR 提升 +2.9–3.1 dB。
Motivation: 现有基于高斯泼溅的视频表示方法依赖每视频优化，导致编码缓慢且难以泛化到不同视频或更高分辨率。
Method: 设计分解的时空 Transformer 提取视频令牌，并用可学习查询 Transformer 为每帧预测 8 参数高斯表示；引入秩基几何正则化器，其强度自适应调整以稳定优化，防止高斯退化。
Result: 编码速度达到逐视频优化的 10^4–10^5 倍，重建质量相当；在 720p 视频上零样本泛化；在 K400、SSv2、UCF101 上以更小的表示尺寸获得 +2.9–3.1 dB 的 PSNR 提升。
Conclusion: HyperGS 将高斯泼溅的快速灵活渲染与前馈预测的速度和泛化能力结合，推进了高斯表示作为快速且可泛化的视频表示的实际应用方向。

papers.title: See like a Robot: Robot-Centric Pointmaps for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict robot actions from visual observations and language instructions. These actions are defined in the robot's own 3D coordinate frame, yet most VLAs observe the scene in the camera frame, creating a frame mismatch between where the scene is observed and where actions are defined. The mismatch is benign under a fixed viewpoint, where the policy can memorize a single observation-to-action mapping, but grows harder as large-scale datasets aggregate demonstrations across diverse camera setups and the policy must generalize this mapping across viewpoints. We address this mismatch with robot-centric pointmaps, images whose pixels store the 3D coordinates of scene points in the robot frame. Pointmaps provide robot-frame 3D geometry while preserving the dense H x W grid expected by pretrained 2D VLAs, so they integrate into existing VLAs with minimal architectural change. On RoboCasa, pointmaps improve both pi0.5 and SmolVLA and outperform representative camera-viewpoint and 3D-aware baselines. In real-robot experiments, their advantage over an RGB-only policy widens when the camera is moved to a placement unseen during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出机器人中心点图（robot-centric pointmaps），其像素存储场景点在机器人坐标系中的3D坐标，从而解决VLA模型中观察帧与动作帧之间的帧不匹配问题。点图保持密集2D网格结构，可无缝集成到现有预训练2D VLA模型中。在RoboCasa上，点图提升了pi0.5和SmolVLA的性能，并优于代表性基線；真实机器人实验中，相机移至训练未见过位置时点图的优势更明显。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型通常在相机帧中观察场景，但动作定义在机器人帧，造成帧不匹配。固定视角下可通过记忆缓解，但大规模数据集包含多种相机设置，跨视角泛化时帧不匹配成为难题。
Method: 提出机器人中心点图，其像素存储场景点在机器人坐标系中的3D坐标，提供机器人帧的3D几何信息，同时保持密集H×W网格，与预训练2D VLA模型兼容，仅需最小架构改动。
Result: 在RoboCasa上，点图改进了pi0.5和SmolVLA，并优于代表性的相机视角和3D感知基线。真实机器人实验中，当相机被移到训练未见过位置时，点图相对于纯RGB策略优势扩大。
Conclusion: 机器人中心点图有效解决了VLA中的帧不匹配问题，提升了跨视角泛化能力，且易于集成到现有模型。

papers.title: IG-GAN: A Generative Adversarial Network for Aerodynamic Data Generation Based on Intrinsic Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Existing generative models learn data distributions in flat Euclidean space. However, most data in our real world are manifolds embedded in high dimensional Euclidean space. Therefore, we propose an intrinsic-geometry-based generative adversarial network (IG-GAN) for data generation in the field of aerodynamics. The generator of the IG-GAN represents aerodynamic data as a piecewise smooth manifold constructed by Bézier surfaces, and the generator tries to learn the coefficients of each Bézier surface to further combine multiple Bézier surfaces into a smooth manifold automatically. The discriminator in the IG-GAN is a radial-basis-function based discriminator (RBF-D). Experimental results show that IG-GAN achieves lower predicted Mean Squared Errors (MSEs) than those of three baselines. Specifically, on the Burgers' equation dataset, IG-GAN reduces the predicted MSE of velocity u by 97.41% compared with state of the art SSL-Transformer. Additionally, on the ONERA M6 aircraft dataset, IG-GAN reduces the overall MSE of nine aerodynamic coefficients by 82.95% compared with SSL-Transformer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于内禀几何的生成对抗网络（IG-GAN），用于气动数据生成。生成器将气动数据表示为贝塞尔曲面构造的分段光滑流形，并自动组合多个贝塞尔曲面；判别器采用径向基函数（RBF）。实验结果表明，在Burgers方程数据集上，IG-GAN将速度u的预测均方误差（MSE）相比SSL-Transformer降低97.41%；在ONERA M6机翼数据集上，九个气动系数的总体MSE降低82.95%。
Motivation: 现有生成模型在平坦欧氏空间中学习数据分布，但真实世界中的气动数据往往是嵌入高维欧氏空间中的流形，传统方法难以捕捉其内禀几何结构。
Method: 提出IG-GAN：生成器利用贝塞尔曲面将气动数据建模为分段光滑流形，并自动学习每个贝塞尔曲面的系数以组合成整体流形；判别器基于径向基函数（RBF-D）进行判别。
Result: 在Burgers方程数据集上，IG-GAN的预测MSE相比SSL-Transformer降低97.41%；在ONERA M6机翼数据集上，九个气动系数的总体MSE降低82.95%。
Conclusion: 基于内禀几何的生成模型能更有效地生成气动数据，流形建模显著提升了数据生成的精度。

papers.title: Agentic Skill Optimization over Lie Algebroids
papers.abstract_en: Agentic systems increasingly improve themselves by editing skills: prompts, rubrics, plans, tool contracts, examples, validators, and traces. Skill edits are not independent coordinates in a vector space: they are local repairs to structured artifacts whose effects are observed only after rollout, validation, and critique. Distinct edits can have the same immediate visible effect while differing in routing context, template state, guardrail scope, or future composability. The order of edits can matter as well: repairing a schema before a normalization rule need not be equivalent to applying the same edits in the reverse order. This paper introduces a new framework for skill optimization called LASKO, for Lie Algebroid SKill Optimization. LASKO models typed, anchored Markdown skills as the base category and available edit policies as sections of a controlled Lie algebroid with anchor $ρ$. The anchor maps an edit policy to its visible Markdown effect; the kernel $\ker(ρ)$ represents latent template, routing, or implementation structure; and the algebroid bracket measures noncommuting edit composition. As shown in the paper, LASKO achieves order-of-magnitude speedups in skill optimization in our preliminary benchmark results, primarily because it substitutes inexpensive Lie-bracket screening tests that run in microseconds, before investing in expensive validations that require running large language models. On a causal extraction from natural language task, LASKO achieved a speedup of almost $15 \times$ compared to a brute-force approach that validated all edits by running them through a DeepSeek V3.1 4-bit model with 671B parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文引入LASKO框架，将智能体技能优化建模为李代数胚上的问题，通过廉价李括号筛选测试替代昂贵的LLM验证，实现了数量级的加速。
Motivation: 现有技能编辑（如提示词、规则等）不是独立向量，编辑顺序和组合影响效果，缺乏统一的优化框架。
Method: 将Markdown技能建模为基范畴，可用编辑策略作为受控李代数胚的截面，锚ρ映射到可见Markdown效果，核ker(ρ)捕获潜在结构，李括号度量非交换编辑组合。
Result: 在初步基准测试中，相比使用DeepSeek V3.1（671B参数4位模型）暴力验证所有编辑，LASKO在自然语言因果抽取任务中实现近15倍加速。
Conclusion: LASKO通过微秒级李括号筛选测试替代昂贵LLM验证，实现数量级加速。

papers.title: Enhancing Query Efficiency for d-DNNF Representations Through Preprocessing
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate preprocessing techniques aimed at improving the efficiency of accessing models of propositional formulas represented in conjunctive normal form (CNF). We focus on three fundamental tasks: uniform sampling, direct model access, and model enumeration. Our analysis reveals that most state-of-the-art preprocessors, when they do not preserve formula equivalence, are generally unsuitable for these tasks. In contrast, we demonstrate that preprocessors which preserve model counts can be effectively leveraged, provided relevant preprocessing information is maintained. To validate our approach, we perform extensive experiments on a diverse suite of benchmarks from multiple domains. The experimental results show that our preprocessing methods are both efficient and robust, yielding significant performance improvements for model access queries when CNF formulas are compiled into d-DNNF representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了针对CNF公式的预处理技术，旨在提高模型访问（均匀采样、直接访问和枚举）的效率。分析表明，大多数不保持公式等价性的预处理器不适用于这些任务；而保持模型计数的预处理器只要维护相关信息即可有效利用。实验在多个领域的基准测试上显示，所提出的预处理方法在将CNF编译为d-DNNF表示后能显著提升模型访问查询的性能。
Motivation: 现有预处理器在处理模型访问任务时往往不保持公式等价性，导致无法应用于均匀采样、直接模型访问和模型枚举等需要精确模型计数或结构信息的场景。
Method: 提出利用保持模型计数的预处理器，并维护预处理过程中的相关信息，使得后续的d-DNNF编译能够受益于预处理带来的简化。
Result: 在多样化的基准测试集上的实验表明，该方法能高效且稳健地提升模型访问查询的性能。
Conclusion: 保持模型计数的预处理结合信息维护，是提升d-DNNF上查询效率的有效途径。

papers.title: Compound Interference Recognition for LR-FHSS Satellite IoT Uplinks via Multi-Domain Instance Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Long range-frequency hopping spread spectrum (LR-FHSS) is a promising uplink physical layer for massive low Earth orbit satellite Internet of Things, where low power terminals report short packets from wide area regions with limited terrestrial infrastructure. However, satellite IoT links are exposed to external interference, and the coexistence of multiple interference components can severely degrade receiver reliability and complicate interference mitigation. Existing recognition methods either focus on single interference scenarios or treat each compound interference combination as an independent class, leading to limited generalization or poor scalability. To address this problem, this paper formulates LR-FHSS uplink compound interference recognition as a multi-instance multi-label learning problem and proposes a multi-domain instance fusion method. The proposed method fuses local instances from the time-frequency and frequency domains and aggregates their predictions for bag-level multi-label recognition. A dataset construction pipeline is developed based on the US915 LR-FHSS configuration and incorporates shadowed-Rician fading and time-varying Doppler to emulate practical satellite communication conditions. Considering the difficulty of obtaining labeled compound interference samples in practice, single-to-compound generalization and few-shot compound interference adaptation are investigated as two practical receiver deployment scenarios. Experimental results show that the proposed method improves the overall exact accuracy over the strongest baseline by 14.71 percentage points in single-to-compound generalization and by 14.81 percentage points in few-shot compound interference adaptation for $r=1$.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE Internet of Things Journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LR-FHSS卫星物联网上行链路中的复合干扰识别问题，将其建模为多实例多标签学习，提出多域实例融合方法。该方法融合时频域和频域的局部实例，聚合预测进行包级多标签识别。基于US915 LR-FHSS配置构建数据集，包含阴影莱斯衰落和时变多普勒。实验显示，在单到复合泛化场景下精确匹配准确率比最强基线提升14.71个百分点，在少样本复合干扰适应（r=1）场景下提升14.81个百分点。
Motivation: 现有复合干扰识别方法要么仅针对单干扰场景，要么将每种复合干扰组合视为独立类别，导致泛化能力差或可扩展性不足，无法有效应对卫星IoT链路中多种干扰共存的复杂情况。
Method: 将LR-FHSS上行链路复合干扰识别转化为多实例多标签学习问题，提出多域实例融合方法：从时频域和频域提取局部实例特征，融合后通过聚合器进行包级多标签预测。同时构建了基于US915配置的数据集，模拟阴影莱斯衰落和时变多普勒信道。
Result: 在单到复合泛化场景下，所提方法精确匹配准确率比最强基线提升14.71个百分点；在少样本复合干扰适应（r=1）场景下提升14.81个百分点。
Conclusion: 论文表明多域实例融合方法能有效提升LR-FHSS上行链路复合干扰识别的泛化能力和少样本适应能力，为实际卫星物联网接收机部署提供了可行方案。

papers.title: LightMem-Ego: Your AI Memory for Everyday Life
papers.abstract_en: Personal AI assistants on mobile and wearable devices continuously perceive users' daily lives through visual and audio streams. However, answering queries about past experiences requires lightweight multimodal memory that can continuously accumulate, organize, and retrieve long-term experiences, which remains challenging. To address this challenge, we present LightMem-Ego, a lightweight streaming multimodal memory system for everyday-life assistance. The system continuously captures egocentric visual and audio streams, aligns them on a shared timeline, and organizes them into a hierarchical memory consisting of current, short-term, and long-term memory. Given a user query, LightMem-Ego dynamically routes retrieval to the appropriate memory level and generates answers grounded in multimodal evidence. The demonstration can be deployed on smartphones and AI glasses, supporting object finding, conversation recall, life summarization, routine discovery, and personalized assistance. Code is available at https://github.com/zjunlp/LightMem-Ego.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LightMem-Ego，一种轻量级流式多模态记忆系统，用于在移动和可穿戴设备上为日常生活提供个人AI记忆辅助。系统持续捕获第一视角的视觉和音频流，对齐到共享时间线，并组织成当前、短期和长期层次记忆，根据用户查询动态路由检索并生成基于多模态证据的回答。该系统可部署在智能手机和AI眼镜上，支持物体查找、对话回忆、生活总结、例行发现和个性化辅助。
Motivation: 个人AI助手需要轻量级多模态记忆来持续积累、组织和检索长期经历，以回答关于过去经验的问题，但现有方法面临挑战。
Method: 利用流式多模态记忆系统，通过对齐第一视角视觉和音频流，构建当前、短期和长期层次记忆，并动态路由检索以生成基于多模态证据的回答。
Result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果，但声称系统可部署在智能手机和AI眼镜上，支持多种日常生活辅助功能。
Conclusion: LightMem-Ego 为日常生活提供了一种轻量级流式多模态记忆解决方案，强调可部署性和对多种查询类型的支持。

papers.title: HyperSafe: Inference-Time Safety Recovery for Fine-Tuned Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Safety alignment in large language models can be fragile under fine-tuning, as even benign task adaptation may increase harmful compliance. Existing defenses mainly follow two directions: they either intervene during or after fine-tuning through retraining or weight modification, which can be costly and may hurt task performance, or they use model-agnostic safety classifiers, which may miss failures specific to a given fine-tuned checkpoint. These limitations motivate a post hoc, model-specific, and non-invasive approach to safety restoration. To meet these requirements, we propose HyperSafe, a framework that restores safety behavior by generating a model-specific Safe Side Network (SSN) for each fine-tuned checkpoint. HyperSafe uses layer-wise activation fingerprints to capture how fine-tuning changes the model's inner representations. With a small set of given calibration prompts, the hypernetwork maps these fingerprints to the parameters of the \ssn{} in a single forward pass. The generated \ssn{} runs alongside the frozen fine-tuned model and performs prompt-level safety classification: harmful prompts are routed to refusal, while safe prompts are answered by the original fine-tuned model. Thus, HyperSafe requires no gradient updates, no safety data at deployment time, and no modification to the deployed model weights. We evaluate HyperSafe on two model families, Qwen2-7B and LLaMA-3-8B, across multiple safety benchmarks. HyperSafe reduces harmful response rates from 19-31% to below 1% on every held-out checkpoint, while keeping downstream task accuracy within 1% of the fine-tuned baseline on average. Code is available at https://github.com/nokronim/project-safety-remedy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出HyperSafe框架，针对微调后可能丧失安全对齐的大语言模型，在推理时通过生成模型专属的安全侧网络（SSN）进行安全恢复。SSN利用层激活指纹和超网络，无需梯度更新或修改模型权重即可对有害提示进行拒绝或安全应答。在Qwen2-7B和LLaMA-3-8B上，将有害响应率从19-31%降至1%以下，同时下游任务精度平均下降不超过1%。
Motivation: 微调大语言模型可能破坏其安全对齐，现有防御方法或代价高昂且影响性能，或缺乏模型特异性。需要一种事后、模型专属且非侵入的安全恢复方法。
Method: 提出HyperSafe，为每个微调检查点生成安全侧网络（SSN）。先提取层激活指纹，再用超网络根据少量校准提示将指纹映射为SSN参数。SSN与冻结的微调模型并行运行，进行提示级安全分类：有害提示触发拒绝，安全提示由原模型回答。无需梯度更新、部署时安全数据或修改模型权重。
Result: 在Qwen2-7B和LLaMA-3-8B上，Harmful response rates从19-31%降至1%以下，下游任务精度平均下降在1%以内。
Conclusion: HyperSafe提供了一种高效、非侵入式的安全恢复手段，无需训练或修改模型权重，适用于微调后的模型安全检查。

papers.title: Towards Efficient Convolutional Neural Network for Embedded Hardware via Multi-Dimensional Pruning
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose TECO, a multi-dimensional pruning framework to collaboratively prune the three dimensions (depth, width, and resolution) of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for better execution efficiency on embedded hardware. In TECO, we first introduce a two-stage importance evaluation framework, which efficiently and comprehensively evaluates each pruning unit according to both the local importance inside each dimension and the global importance across different dimensions. Based on the evaluation framework, we present a heuristic pruning algorithm to progressively prune the three dimensions of CNNs towards the optimal trade-off between accuracy and efficiency. Experiments on multiple benchmarks validate the advantages of TECO over existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches. The code and pre-trained models are available at https://github.com/ntuliuteam/Teco.
papers.comment: Author's accepted version. Published in Proceedings of the 60th ACM/IEEE Design Automation Conference (DAC 2023)
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 60th ACM/IEEE Design Automation Conference (DAC), pp. 1-6, 2023
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TECO，一种多维剪枝框架，联合剪枝卷积神经网络的深度、宽度和分辨率，以提升在嵌入式硬件上的执行效率。TECO 引入两阶段重要性评估框架，结合局部和全局重要性，并基于此设计启发式剪枝算法，逐步剪枝三个维度以平衡精度与效率。实验表明 TECO 优于现有最新方法。
Motivation: 现有剪枝方法通常仅关注单一维度（如深度或宽度），忽视了多维度协同剪枝对嵌入式硬件效率的潜在提升。
Method: 提出两阶段重要性评估：第一阶段评估每个维度内局部重要性，第二阶段评估跨维度全局重要性；基于评估结果设计启发式算法，逐步剪枝深度、宽度和分辨率。
Result: 在多个基准上，TECO 在保持精度的同时显著降低计算开销，优于现有最新剪枝方法。
Conclusion: 多维度协同剪枝比单一维度剪枝更有效，TECO 框架为实现嵌入式硬件上的高效 CNN 提供了实用方案。

papers.title: Climate-Invariant Conformal Prediction Intervals for Multi-Horizon Solar and Wind Forecasting
authors: Banalaxmi Brahma (1) ((1) B. R. Ambedkar National Institute of Technology
papers.abstract_en: Reliable uncertainty quantification is essential for integrating solar and wind generation into modern power systems, where operators must weigh risk rather than act on point forecasts alone. Existing probabilistic methods, however, often either lack finite-sample validity or require per-site recalibration, so a single model rarely transfers across the diverse climates of a dispersed generation fleet. This paper proposes a heteroscedastic, asymmetric, group-conditional split-conformal framework built on a bootstrap-diverse XGBoost ensemble, producing prediction intervals that adapt in width to local difficulty while retaining distribution-free coverage guarantees. A single fixed specification, with no per-site or per-horizon tuning, is evaluated across four climatologically distinct sites spanning both hemispheres, at horizons of 1 to 12 hours, for both solar irradiance and wind speed. The framework holds near-nominal coverage on both targets and reduces the Interval Score by up to 35% relative to competitive baselines, with the calibration and sharpness of its intervals shown to be properties of the method rather than of site-specific tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种异方差、非对称、分组条件共形预测框架，基于bootstrap多样化的XGBoost集成，为多时间尺度的太阳能和风能预测提供分布自由、有限样本有效的预测区间。该方法无需逐站点或逐时间尺度调参，在四个气候差异显著的地点验证，在1-12小时预测范围内，覆盖率达到近名义水平，区间分数比基线降低35%。
Motivation: 现有概率预测方法要么缺乏有限样本有效性，要么需要逐站点重新校准，难以在分散的发电机组群的不同气候条件下迁移。
Method: 提出一种异方差、非对称、分组条件分裂共形预测框架，使用bootstrap多样化的XGBoost集成，生成适应局部难度的预测区间，无需逐站点或逐时间尺度调参。
Result: 在四个气候差异显著的地点，对太阳辐照度和风速进行1-12小时预测，区间达到近名义覆盖率，区间分数比竞争基线降低35%。
Conclusion: 该方法的校准和锐度是方法本身的特性而非站点特定调参的结果。

summary_sections.method: 提出一种异方差、非对称、分组条件分裂共形预测框架，使用bootstrap多样化的XGBoost集成，生成适应局部难度的预测区间，无需逐站点或逐时间尺度调参。
summary_sections.result: 在四个气候差异显著的地点，对太阳辐照度和风速进行1-12小时预测，区间达到近名义覆盖率，区间分数比竞争基线降低35%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法的校准和锐度是方法本身的特性而非站点特定调参的结果。

papers.title: A Multimodal Dataset for Large Language Model Applications in the Energy Domain
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents the mAIEnergy dataset, an open-access, multimodal corpus developed to support Large Language Model (LLM) applications in the energy sector. The dataset integrates approximately 50,000 textual documents, 20,000 images, 25 million numerical time series records, and 2 million geospatial and relational data entries. It includes policy and regulatory texts, scientific articles and news articles, satellite and contextual imagery, electricity system measurements, weather observations, statistical indicators, and geospatial representations of energy infrastructure and related entities. All data have been harmonized into structured, ready-to-use formats, accompanied by consistent metadata and reproducible data retrieval and preparation workflows. The dataset can serve as a foundational energy knowledge base, allowing energy stakeholders to integrate additional open-source or proprietary data. The mAIEnergy dataset adheres to Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable (FAIR) principles, enhancing its applicability for AI-driven energy research, modeling, and decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:

Result: mAIEnergy数据集包含约5万篇文本、2万张图像、2500万条时间序列记录和200万条地理空间条目，覆盖能源政策、科学、新闻、卫星图像、电力测量、天气观测、统计和地理基础设施等。

papers.title: HourGlass: A probabilistic data-driven temporal downscaler for global and regional weather forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Many forecast applications require high frequency temporal resolution, yet most state-of-the-art data-driven weather forecasting systems operate at 6-hourly resolution. Although direct hourly forecasting is possible, it suffers from error accumulation and temporal inconsistency. We introduce HourGlass, a probabilistic data-driven temporal downscaling method that reconstructs the evolution between forecast states. HourGlass is trained using variants of the continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) preserving small-scale spatial variability while encouraging temporal consistency. Unlike existing deterministic temporal downscaling approaches, which tend to produce overly smooth fields, HourGlass generates realistic probabilistic forecasts. Training on forecast trajectories rather than reanalysis or analysis data also avoids the temporal inconsistencies present in datasets used by previous methods. We evaluate HourGlass in two settings: AIFS-HourGlass, applied globally to ECMWF's AIFS-Single and AIFS-ENS forecast systems, and Bris-HourGlass, applied regionally to MET Norway's high-resolution stretched-grid ensemble model, Bris. Verification against observations shows that both models retain the skill of their underlying forecasting systems while producing temporally coherent hourly forecasts with realistic small-scale variability. Case studies demonstrate physically consistent evolution during rapidly developing weather events, including extratropical cyclones and organised convection. Hourly precipitation remains challenging: HourGlass improves the spatial realism of precipitation fields but still underestimates the most intense extremes, a common limitation of data-driven weather forecasting models. These results demonstrate that HourGlass effectively bridges the gap between 6-hourly data-driven forecasts and the hourly products required for operational regional and global forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HourGlass是一种概率性数据驱动的时间降尺度方法，能从6小时间隔的预报状态重建小时级演变。使用连续排序概率评分（CRPS）变体训练，保持小尺度空间变异性和时间一致性。在全局（AIFS-HourGlass）和区域（Bris-HourGlass）设置中验证，均保留基础预报技能并产生时间一致的小时预报。降水极值仍然低估，但降水场空间真实性改善。
Motivation: 多数先进数据驱动天气预报系统以6小时间隔运行，而许多应用需要小时级分辨率。直接小时预报存在误差累积和时间不一致问题，现有确定性降尺度方法产生过于平滑的场。
Method: HourGlass使用CRPS变体训练，利用预报轨迹而非再分析数据以避免时间不一致。通过两个实现评估：全局AIFS-HourGlass（应用于ECMWF的AIFS-Single和AIFS-ENS）和区域Bris-HourGlass（应用于MET Norway的Bris拉伸网格集合模型）。
Result: 验证表明两个模型均保留基础预报技能，产生时间一致的小时预报和真实小尺度变率。案例研究显示快速发展天气事件（温带气旋、组织对流）的物理一致演变。降水场空间真实性提升，但极端降水仍低估。
Conclusion: HourGlass有效弥合了6小时间隔数据驱动预报与业务所需小时级产品之间的差距，降水极值低估是共同局限。

papers.title: Event-based Neural Decoding for Neuroprosthetic Motor Control
papers.abstract_en: A substantial number of patients experience diminished mobility due to disabilities, diseases, or accidents. Although modern prostheses, powered by deep neural networks, hold the promise of significantly enhancing the quality of life for these individuals, their widespread adoption is hindered by significant latency, energy consumption, and spatial requirements. Wired connections to external high-performance processors restrict patient mobility, while wireless connections limit the volume of information that can be transmitted to these processors. Spiking neural networks offer the potential for compressed communication and low-power inference, yet they often lag behind state-of-the-art deep learning models in various applications. In this study, we propose a high-performance neural decoding method that effectively balances task performance and efficiency. An eventbased gated recurrent unit generates a sparse communication pattern with graded spikes, surpassing classical spiking neural networks in terms of task performance. Utilising an efficient training method and sparse inference, our model presents new opportunities for on-device neural decoding.
papers.journal_ref: K. K. Nazeer, S. Arfa, M. Jobst, R. George and C. Mayr, "Event-based Neural Decoding for Neuroprosthetic Motor Control," 2025 IEEE Biomedical Circuits and Systems Conference (BioCAS), Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, 2025, pp. 334-338

TL;DR: 本文针对神经假体运动控制中的解码延迟和能耗问题，提出一种基于事件的高性能神经解码方法。该方法利用事件驱动的门控循环单元（event-based GRU）生成带有分级脉冲的稀疏通信模式，结合高效训练和稀疏推理，在任务性能上优于传统脉冲神经网络。
Motivation: 现有神经假体依赖有线连接或受限无线传输，存在延迟、能耗和空间瓶颈，限制了应用推广。
Method: 提出事件驱动的门控循环单元（event-based GRU），产生带有分级脉冲的稀疏通信模式，并采用高效训练与稀疏推理方法。
Result: 该方法在任务性能上超越传统脉冲神经网络，同时实现稀疏通信和低功耗推理。
Conclusion: 该研究为设备上低延迟、低功耗的神经解码提供了新的可能性。

papers.title: Velocity Scheduled Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching trains a neural network to regress the conditional velocity along a linear interpolant between noise and data, and the number of network evaluations~(NFE) sets the cost of sampling. The straight-line interpolant carries an implicit choice: the sample moves at constant speed throughout the trajectory. We relax this choice and introduce Velocity Scheduled Flow Matching~(VSFM), which replaces the conditional target $x_1 - x_0$ with $v(t)(x_1 - x_0)$ for any nonnegative profile $v:[0,1]\to\mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}$ satisfying $\int_0^1 v\,dt = 1$. We study six polynomial profiles drawn from motion planning. The first use of VSFM is at inference time: a pretrained linear flow-matching model can be sampled under any admissible profile by integrating its ODE on a non-uniform $τ$-schedule, with no retraining and no additional computation; on CIFAR-10 this lowers FID by up to $19.8\%$. Training from scratch under a braking profile gives a further reduction of $17.4\%$ at $4$~NFE. Both gains follow from the local truncation error of the Euler integrator on the induced grid.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Velocity Scheduled Flow Matching (VSFM)，通过引入非负速度轮廓 v(t)（满足 ∫v dt=1）替代 flow matching 中的恒定速度，允许采样轨迹速度可调。研究六种多项式速度轮廓，可在推理时对预训练模型直接应用（无需重训），或在训练时从头学习刹车轮廓。在 CIFAR-10 上，推理阶段 FID 降低最多 19.8%，从头训练在 4 NFE 下 FID 降低 17.4%。性能提升源自 Euler 积分器在非均匀时间网格上的局部截断误差减小。
Motivation: 现有 flow matching 采用线性插值隐含恒定速度假设，可能不是最优的采样轨迹。本文旨在放松这一约束，通过速度调度提升生成质量或降低采样步数。
Method: 将条件目标从 x1−x0 替换为 v(t)(x1−x0)，其中 v(t) 为任意非负可积函数且积分为 1。研究六种多项式速度轮廓（如加速、减速、制动等）。对于预训练模型，通过非均匀 τ 调度积分 ODE 实现推理时速度调度；也可从头训练特定速度轮廓的模型。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10 上，使用预训练模型推理时采用最优速度轮廓使 FID 降低 19.8%；从头训练制动轮廓模型在 4 NFE 时 FID 降低 17.4%。
Conclusion: 速度调度可显著改善 flow matching 的采样效率与质量，且无需额外训练成本即可应用于现有模型。增益源于 Euler 方法在非均匀网格上的局部截断误差变化。
