papers.title: The Ebb and Flow of Multimodal Focus: Scheduling Visual Relay Windows for Grounded VLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models increasingly succeed on multimodal reasoning benchmarks, yet their visual evidence often becomes unstable once it enters the language stack, weakening evidence-grounded reasoning. To understand this fragility, we examine the internal dynamics of VLMs through a mechanistic lens and uncover a stable three-stage redistribution of multimodal attention focus across depth: an early question-conditioned organization, a critical middle visual-dominant relay, and a late return to answer formation. We operationalize the middle phase as the Visual Relay Window (VRW), and show that its geometry varies with task demand, is causally tied to grounded generation, and distinguishes unsupported answers from stronger reasoning trajectories. Guided by this internal rhythm, we propose TRACE, a task-adaptive inference-time control framework with lightweight trained modules. It reshapes relay allocation during prefill and preserves assembled visual support after handoff during decoding. Across four open-weight VLM backbones and seven benchmarks, TRACE delivers large gains on grounding-sensitive settings, improving them by 4.33 points on average and by up to 6.6 points, while also improving reasoning-heavy tasks. These results show that explicitly controlling multimodal focus across depth offers a unified and effective mechanism for strengthening evidence-grounded multimodal reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过机械论视角考察视觉-语言模型（VLM）的内部动态，发现多模态注意力焦点在深度上存在稳定的三阶段重新分布：早期问题条件组织、中期视觉主导的传递窗口、晚期回归答案形成。将中间阶段定义为视觉传递窗口（VRW），并证明其几何形状随任务需求变化、与基于证据的生成有因果关系，并能区分无支撑答案与更强推理轨迹。据此提出TRACE，一种任务自适应的推理时控制框架，通过轻量训练模块在预填充阶段重塑传递分配，在解码阶段保持已组装的视觉支持。在四种开源VLM主干和七个基准上，TRACE在依赖基础证据的场景上平均提升4.33个点，最高提升6.6个点，同时也能改善推理密集型任务。
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型在多模态推理基准上表现日益成功，但其视觉证据一旦进入语言栈后往往变得不稳定，削弱了基于证据的推理能力。理解这一脆弱性并寻求控制机制是本文的目标。
Method: 通过机械论分析揭示VLM内部多模态注意力焦点的三阶段分布，并识别出中间阶段的视觉传递窗口（VRW）。基于此提出TRACE框架，包含轻量训练模块，在预填充阶段调整传递分配，在解码阶段保持视觉支持，实现任务自适应的推理时控制。
Result: 在四种开源VLM主干和七个基准上，TRACE在依赖基础证据的场景上平均提升4.33个点，最高提升6.6个点，同时推理密集型任务也有改善。
Conclusion: 明确控制跨深度的多模态注意力焦点为加强基于证据的多模态推理提供了一种统一且有效的机制。

summary_sections.motivation: 视觉-语言模型在多模态推理基准上表现日益成功，但其视觉证据一旦进入语言栈后往往变得不稳定，削弱了基于证据的推理能力。理解这一脆弱性并寻求控制机制是本文的目标。
summary_sections.method: 通过机械论分析揭示VLM内部多模态注意力焦点的三阶段分布，并识别出中间阶段的视觉传递窗口（VRW）。基于此提出TRACE框架，包含轻量训练模块，在预填充阶段调整传递分配，在解码阶段保持视觉支持，实现任务自适应的推理时控制。
summary_sections.result: 在四种开源VLM主干和七个基准上，TRACE在依赖基础证据的场景上平均提升4.33个点，最高提升6.6个点，同时推理密集型任务也有改善。
summary_sections.conclusion: 明确控制跨深度的多模态注意力焦点为加强基于证据的多模态推理提供了一种统一且有效的机制。

papers.title: Direct Image-to-Modern Vietnamese Translation of Han-Nom Manuscripts via Multimodal RLHF Preference Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Translating Han-Nom manuscripts into modern Vietnamese is challenging because historical pages are often degraded, the script contains rare logographic characters, and parallel supervision is limited. We propose a multimodal RLHF preference-alignment framework that conditions Vietnamese generation on manuscript images and aligned Han-Nom source text. The model combines four streams: CLIP ViT-L/14@336 for visual features, bert-base-chinese for Han-Nom representations, vinai/phobert-base for Vietnamese representations, and T5-small encoder states. Modality-specific projections and a fusion block compress the resulting 2,048-dimensional concatenation into a shared 512-dimensional representation. Starting from the same supervised fine-tuned policy, we compare PPO, DPO, and KTO under matched work-level macro-averaged evaluation. DPO achieves the best BLEU-4, ROUGE-L, BERTScore, semantic similarity, CER, WER, and token accuracy, whereas PPO obtains the highest precision, recall, and F1. KTO remains competitive through its desirable-undesirable utility objective. All preference-aligned policies improve the BLEU-4 and semantic-similarity scores available for the SFT baseline. These results indicate that multimodal preference optimization complements supervised learning by improving lexical and semantic quality in low-resource historical translation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个多模态RLHF偏好对齐框架，用于将汉喃手稿图像直接翻译为现代越南语。该框架融合CLIP ViT-L/14@336、bert-base-chinese、vinai/phobert-base和T5-small四路特征，通过投影和融合模块压缩为512维表示。实验对比PPO、DPO和KTO三种偏好对齐方法，发现DPO在BLEU-4、ROUGE-L、BERTScore等多数指标上最优，而PPO获得最高精确率、召回率和F1值，KTO通过期望-非期望效用目标保持竞争力。所有偏好对齐策略均优于有监督微调基线。
Motivation: 汉喃手稿翻译面临页面退化、稀有字符以及平行语料有限等挑战，传统监督学习难以充分提升翻译质量。
Method: 提出多模态RLHF偏好对齐框架，利用CLIP、BERT、PhoBERT和T5分别提取视觉、汉喃、越南语和序列特征，经过特定投影和融合模块压缩为共享512维表示，并基于同一有监督微调策略初始化，比较PPO、DPO和KTO三种偏好优化方法。
Result: DPO在BLEU-4、ROUGE-L、BERTScore、语义相似度、CER、WER和token准确率上取得最佳，PPO在精确率、召回率和F1上最高，KTO保持竞争力；所有偏好对齐策略均提升了BLEU-4和语义相似度。
Conclusion: 多模态偏好优化能有效补充监督学习，提升低资源历史翻译的词汇和语义质量。

papers.title: Omni-Decision: A Progressive Evidence-State Agent System for Omni-Modal QA
papers.abstract_en: Omni-modal evidence-seeking QA requires agents to answer questions whose evidence is sparsely distributed across videos, audio, images, web pages, and computation results. Existing agentic multimodal systems often leave evidence in scratchpads, tool trajectories, or free-form histories, making it difficult to track what has been grounded, what remains missing, and when the evidence is sufficient to answer. We propose Omni-Decision, a training-free evidence-state system that turns omni-modal QA into a query-scoped evidence-closure process. For each query, Omni-Decision maintains a structured evidence state containing confirmed evidence, unresolved conflicts, fact and computation dependencies, and open evidence needs. A shared state view conditions planning, evidence acquisition, validation, repair, and finalization. Heterogeneous observations from media, web, computation, and verification modules are normalized, judged, and committed through deterministic state updates. This design enables targeted evidence acquisition, preserves sparse cross-modal cues, and provides inspectable control over repair and stopping. Omni-Decision achieves 45.6% accuracy on OmniGAIA and 58.3% on WorldSense, improving over the baselines by +27.3 and +30.2 percentage points, respectively. No-state ablations and trajectory audits further support the role of explicit evidence-state control in multi-step omni-modal evidence seeking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Omni-Decision 是一种免训练的证据状态系统，将全模态 QA 建模为查询范围的证据闭合过程，通过结构化证据状态（已确认证据、未解决冲突、事实与计算依赖、开放证据需求）来驱动规划、获取、验证与修复，从而在稀疏跨模态线索场景下实现可追踪的证据控制。
Motivation: 现有智能体多模态系统将证据分散在暂存器、工具轨迹或自由形式历史中，难以跟踪已接地的证据、缺失部分以及何时证据足够回答问题，导致跨模态证据追踪困难。
Method: 提出 Omni-Decision，维护一个结构化证据状态，包含已确认证据、未解决冲突、事实与计算依赖及开放证据需求；通过确定性状态更新将来自媒体、网页、计算和验证模块的异质观察归一化、判断并提交，实现目标导向的证据获取和可检查的修复与停止控制。
Result: 在 OmniGAIA 上达到 45.6% 准确率，在 WorldSense 上达到 58.3%，分别比基线提升 +27.3 和 +30.2 个百分点。无状态消融和轨迹审计进一步证实显式证据状态控制在多步全模态证据搜索中的作用。
Conclusion: 显式证据状态控制能够有效提升全模态 QA 中稀疏证据追踪和修复能力，且方法无需训练。

papers.title: Generalizing Preference-based Reinforcement Learning: a Rationality Model for Incomparability
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we study the reinforcement learning (RL) problem from pairwise trajectory comparisons provided by a human expert. We generalize preference-based RL by formalizing a novel setting in which the expert can also label trajectory pairs as incomparable, i.e., when neither trajectory dominates the other. We introduce the learning problem and the desiderata that its solution should satisfy. Then, we propose a novel Bradley-Terry-inspired rationality model that effectively captures incomparabilities and infers a multi-dimensional reward function, and we study its properties. We provide a sample complexity analysis for learning the model parameters when a dataset is available. Finally, we evaluate our model's ability to reconstruct a reward function that aligns with the expert's comparisons in simulated environments and to recover the Pareto frontier of policies, along with a robustness analysis across varying levels of expert rationality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文推广了基于偏好的强化学习，允许专家标记轨迹对为不可比较，并提出一种基于Bradley-Terry的理性模型来捕捉不可比较性并推断多维奖励函数。提供了样本复杂度分析，并在模拟环境中验证了模型恢复奖励函数和帕累托前沿的能力，以及在不同专家理性水平下的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有偏好强化学习假设专家总能比较轨迹对，但现实中可能存在无法比较的情况（不可比较性），需要建模这一现象。
Method: 提出一种受Bradley-Terry模型启发的理性模型，通过多维奖励函数表示不可比较的偏好，并学习其参数。
Result: 在模拟环境中，模型能有效恢复与专家比较一致的奖励函数和帕累托前沿，且对专家理性水平的变化具有鲁棒性；提供了样本复杂度上界。
Conclusion: 该模型为处理不可比较偏好提供了理论基础，并展示了在实际中恢复奖励函数的可行性。

papers.title: Physics-Aware Conditional SetGAN for Spatially Consistent Multi-User TR 38.901 Channel Generation
papers.abstract_en: TR 38.901-based channel models such as Sionna are reliable, but generating many multi-user channel realizations remains expensive. This paper asks a practical question: can a trained generative model produce multi-user TR 38.901 channels faster than Sionna without losing the spatial correlations imposed by user geometry? To answer this question, we propose a physics-aware, geometry-conditioned SetGAN trained on Sionna reference data. The method separates large-scale received power from normalized small-scale fading, compresses the latter with principal component analysis, and learns the conditional channel distribution in a latent space while preserving geometry-dependent correlations. On the UMa/NLoS benchmark, the model keeps the received-power distributions close to the reference, with about 0.41 dB Wasserstein distance, and reproduces spatial-consistency profiles with mean deviations below 0.03 on median curves versus distance. In addition, it reduces elapsed generation time by a factor of 3.45 and CPU-total cost by a factor of 6.15 relative to Sionna under matched user positions in the fixed-position CPU-vs-CPU benchmark. These results show that a trained generative model can substantially accelerate TR 38.901 channel generation without breaking the spatial consistency needed to evaluate multi-user systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种物理感知的条件SetGAN，用于快速生成多用户TR 38.901信道实现，同时保持用户几何空间相关性。模型在大尺度接收功率与小尺度归一化衰落分离的基础上，通过主成分分析压缩后者，并在潜空间中学习条件信道分布。在UMa/NLoS基准测试中，接收功率分布的Wasserstein距离约为0.41 dB，空间一致性曲线中值偏差低于0.03，生成时间减少3.45倍，CPU总成本减少6.15倍。
Motivation: 基于TR 38.901的信道模型（如Sionna）可靠但生成多用户信道实现计算昂贵，现有方法难以在加速的同时保持用户几何引入的空间相关性。
Method: 提出物理感知、几何条件化的SetGAN，采用大尺度功率与小尺度衰落分离、PCA压缩、潜空间条件生成，并以Sionna参考数据训练。
Result: 在UMa/NLoS基准下，接收功率分布Wasserstein距离约0.41 dB，空间一致性中值偏差低于0.03；固定位置CPU-vs-CPU基准中生成时间减少3.45倍，CPU总成本减少6.15倍。
Conclusion: 训练后的生成模型可在保持多用户空间一致性的前提下，显著加速TR 38.901信道生成。

papers.title: Video Transformer for Remote Identity Document Hologram Detection
papers.abstract_en: Remote identity authentification using Identification Documents has been a major challenge for several years. DeepFakes advent and the development of AI-guided tools helps fraudsters creating counterfeit ID Documents. Ensuring the authenticity of ID Documents has become a real clue in the seurization of remote authentification. This need is all the more pressing given the increasing digitization of administrative and transactional processes. To ensure widespread accessibility, the system should rely solely on video captured via mobile devices. In this specific context, confirming the authenticity of ID is a real challenge as many security features needs specific device like infrared sensor for instance. Among underutilized but promising security features, holographic printings hold a special place. Difficult to counterfeit, they produce distinctive visual effects according enlightment, making them both detectable in a video captured by a smartphone camera and difficult to imitate. In this paper, we propose a Remote Identity Document Verification System (RIDVS) and an approach based on a video transformer for detecting holograms in simple videos captured by smartphones. Our system is designed for a smartphone-based capture process, followed by a server-side verification. The hologram detection method builds on a robust model previously validated in a related research domain. We demonstrate that it outperforms existing SotA methods, achieving near-perfect accuracy even when trained on medium- to small-sized datasets. In particular, we report improvements of +26.86\% in Recall and +17.93\% in accuracy over the best MIDV-Holo baseline. This study includes several experiments that evaluate the model adaptation to frugality, both for training samples and computational resources.
papers.comment: Accepted to SMC2026 conference, 6 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对远程身份认证中身份证件全息图检测问题，提出基于视频Transformer的远程身份证验证系统（RIDVS）。系统通过智能手机采集视频，在服务器端进行全息图检测，利用视频中全息图随光照变化的视觉效果进行鉴别。实验表明，该方法在MIDV-Holo数据集上相比现有最优方法召回率提升26.86%，准确率提升17.93%，且在小样本和计算资源受限下仍能保持近完美精度。
Motivation: 远程身份认证中伪造身份证件日益猖獗，而全息图作为安全特征难以伪造且可在智能手机视频中检测，但现有方法性能不足，且缺乏适用于手机视频的轻量级系统。
Method: 提出RIDVS系统，包含智能手机端视频采集和服务器端全息图检测；检测模块采用视频Transformer架构，利用视频时序信息捕捉全息图动态视觉特征。
Result: 在MIDV-Holo数据集上，召回率提升26.86%，准确率提升17.93%，超越所有基线；在小样本和低计算资源下仍保持近完美准确率。
Conclusion: 视频Transformer能有效利用全息图光照变化特征，实现高精度远程检测；系统具有轻量级和易部署潜力。

summary_sections.method: 提出RIDVS系统，包含智能手机端视频采集和服务器端全息图检测；检测模块采用视频Transformer架构，利用视频时序信息捕捉全息图动态视觉特征。
summary_sections.result: 在MIDV-Holo数据集上，召回率提升26.86%，准确率提升17.93%，超越所有基线；在小样本和低计算资源下仍保持近完美准确率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 视频Transformer能有效利用全息图光照变化特征，实现高精度远程检测；系统具有轻量级和易部署潜力。

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification for EO Regression Tasks: Building Height, Tree Canopy Height and Above-ground Biomass Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Earth Observation regression tasks such as building height, canopy height, and above-ground biomass estimation underpin critical applications in urban planning, forest monitoring, and climate policy, where both accuracy and reliability are critical. Yet most deep learning models yield only deterministic predictions, providing no indication of per-pixel reliability. These regression tasks are inherently challenging due to heterogeneous land surfaces, skewed target distributions, sensor noise, and signal saturation at high target values, making uncertainty (UC) estimation essential for reliable inference. We address this gap by modeling aleatoric uncertainty using year-long Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 MSI time series, proposing two complementary approaches: (i) Gaussian UC, which jointly predicts mean and standard deviation under a Gaussian assumption, and (ii) Quantile UC, which estimates the 10th, 50th, and 90th quantiles to capture asymmetric and heteroscedastic error distributions. Both models are evaluated on three representative EO regression tasks at 10 m spatial resolution. Results show that both approaches match or surpass deterministic benchmarks and existing global products, while delivering well-calibrated, interpretable, and operationally useful confidence estimates. Notably, both models outperform the current 10 m state-of-the-art uncertainty-aware model for canopy height estimation. Our implementation will be available at: https://github.com/RituYadav92/EO-Regression-Uncertainty-Estimation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对地球观测回归任务（建筑高度、树冠高度、地上生物量估计）中的不确定性量化问题，提出两种方法：高斯不确定性（Gaussian UC）和分位数不确定性（Quantile UC），利用Sentinel-1/2时间序列数据。实验表明两种方法在10米分辨率上匹配或超越确定性基准，并提供校准良好的置信度估计，尤其在树冠高度估计上优于现有最先进的不确定性模型。
Motivation: 地球观测回归任务需要高精度和可靠性，但现有深度学习模型仅提供确定性预测，无法给出逐像素可靠性指标。由于地表异质性、目标分布偏斜、传感器噪声和高值信号饱和，不确定性估计对可靠推断至关重要。
Method: 提出两种互补的不确定性建模方法：高斯不确定性（联合预测均值和标准差，假设高斯分布）和分位数不确定性（估计10%、50%、90%分位数，捕捉非对称和异方差误差分布），基于一年长的Sentinel-1 SAR和Sentinel-2 MSI时间序列。
Result: 两种方法在三个代表性EO回归任务（10米分辨率）上匹配或超越确定性基准和现有全球产品，并提供校准良好、可解释且实用的置信度估计。在树冠高度估计上，两者均优于目前10米空间分辨率的现有最优不确定性模型。
Conclusion: 所提不确定性量化方法能有效提升EO回归任务的可靠性，且无需修改网络结构即可集成到现有深度学习框架中。代码将开源。

papers.title: Agentic Routing: The Harness-Native Data Flywheel
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents are increasingly executed not by a single model call, but by an execution harness that manages observation, context, control, action, state, and verification. At the same time, frontier and open models are becoming structurally specialized: a model that is strong at code editing, long-context recovery, tool use, mathematical reasoning, or low-latency response may not dominate on the other axes. This makes model selection inside an agent a core systems problem rather than a per-query serving trick. Existing routing methods mostly optimize single-turn cost-quality trade-offs and therefore miss the execution state, intermediate failures, and feedback loops that make agents different from chat completion. We propose Harness-Native agentic routing, a step-level routing paradigm that selects either a single best-fit model for cost-effective execution or multiple complementary models for ensemble-style accuracy improvement, conditioned on the full harness state. The key insight is that every routing decision naturally produces a structured data record -- consisting of the query, harness state, model choice or model set, execution trace, outcome, and cost -- whose labels are supplied by the environment rather than by the router itself. These records form a harness-native data flywheel: execution traces train better routers and harness-native models, which improve cost-quality trade-offs and generate more traces under the same budget. We instantiate this idea in OpenSquilla with a four-layer routing stack, an open LightGBM cold-start ranker, and a staged router-model path that turns logged arena records into progressively stronger routing policies. The report studies singleton and multi-model routing on agentic benchmarks including DRACO and PinchBench, and argues that agentic routing is not merely cost control, but a data engine for agent-native training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于执行步骤的智能体路由范式（Harness-Native Agentic Routing），根据完整执行状态选择单模型或多个互补模型，以平衡成本与准确性。每次路由决策自动生成结构化数据记录（查询、状态、模型选择、执行轨迹、结果、成本），形成数据飞轮：执行轨迹训练更好的路由器和模型，进而提升成本-质量权衡并生成更多数据。该方法在OpenSquilla中实例化，包含四层路由栈、冷启动LightGBM排序器和分阶段路由器-模型路径，并在DRACO和PinchBench上进行了单/多模型路由研究。
Motivation: 现有路由方法主要优化单轮成本-质量权衡，忽略了智能体执行中的状态、中间失败和反馈循环；同时，模型结构日趋专业化，单一模型难以在所有维度（如代码编辑、长上下文、工具使用、数学推理、低延迟）均占优，使得智能体内模型选择成为核心系统问题。
Method: 提出Harness-Native Agentic Routing，一种步骤级路由范式：基于完整执行状态（由执行框架管理）选择单一最佳模型或互补多模型集成。每次路由决策产生的结构化数据记录（包含查询、状态、模型选择、执行轨迹、结果和成本）由环境自动标注，构成数据飞轮。在OpenSquilla中实例化为四层路由栈，包括冷启动LightGBM排序器和分阶段路由器-模型路径，利用日志竞技场记录逐步提升路由策略。
Result: 在DRACO和PinchBench等智能体基准上研究了单模型和多模型路由，表明该方法不仅优化成本，更重要的是作为智能体原生训练的数据引擎。摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 智能体路由不仅仅是成本控制，而是一种数据引擎，能够为智能体原生训练生成大量结构化数据，从而持续改进路由策略和模型性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robust Subgroup Analysis for Heterogeneous Censored Data
papers.abstract_en: Subgroup analysis is important in practice because real-world data typically come from heterogeneous populations, where meaningful patterns can differ substantially across subpopulations. Correctly identifying these subgroups can improve prediction accuracy, prevent biased or misleading conclusions, and support more effective, targeted decision-making. While most existing subgroup analysis methods are developed for complete data, in this paper we propose a novel and robust approach for censored data under heterogeneous accelerated failure time (AFT) models. Specifically, we combine inverse probability weighting, M-estimation, and concave pairwise fusion penalization to simultaneously identify subgroups and estimate covariate effects for heterogeneous censored data, without requiring prior knowledge of individual subgroup memberships. We further develop an efficient RISA-ADMM algorithm to implement the method and establish its convergence. Furthermore, we derive the theoretical properties of the proposed estimators under mild regularity conditions. Extensive simulations and an application to the German credit dataset demonstrate the robustness and effectiveness of our approach.
papers.journal_ref: Stat, 2026, Volume15, Issue 2, e70158
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对异质性删失数据下的子组分析问题，提出一种结合逆概率加权、M估计和凹成对融合惩罚的稳健方法，无需预先知道子组归属即可同时识别子组并估计协变量效应。基于加速失效时间（AFT）模型框架，开发了高效的RISA-ADMM算法并证明其收敛性，在正则条件下推导了估计量的理论性质。模拟实验和德国信用数据集应用表明方法的稳健性和有效性。
Motivation: 现实数据常来自异质性总体，不同子组中的有意义模式可能差异显著，现有子组分析方法大多针对完整数据，缺乏对删失数据的有效处理。
Method: 提出异质性AFT模型下的子组分析框架，采用逆概率加权处理删失，M估计确保稳健性，凹成对融合惩罚实现子组识别与变量选择，并设计RISA-ADMM算法进行求解。
Result: 广泛的模拟研究和德国信用数据集应用验证了方法的稳健性和有效性。
Conclusion: 该方法为异质性删失数据提供了一种无需先验子组标签的子组分析工具，兼具理论保证和实际适用性。

papers.title: StructAgent: Harness Long-horizon Digital Agents with Unified Causal Structure
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) have enabled increasingly capable digital agents for computer use. However, real-world tasks are often long-horizon and involve evolving contexts containing accumulated observations, intermediate edits, failed attempts, and partially completed executions. Existing agents typically operate over raw interaction history, making task progress difficult to interpret, verify, and recover, which ultimately limits reliable long-horizon execution. In this paper, we argue that addressing this challenge requires explicitly structuring both the agent's state and workflow around a unified causal representation of task progress. We present \textbf{StructAgent}, a state-centered framework that introduces a unified state for maintaining compact, verifiable task progress and a structured workflow that regulates progress through verifier-backed state transitions. Building on this design, StructAgent further enables explicit progress checkpointing, evidence-driven task completion, targeted failure recovery, and tool-supported execution, while ensuring that all progress updates remain grounded in verification. Extensive experiments demonstrate that StructAgent consistently improves a wide range of LLM and VLM backbones on long-horizon computer-use tasks. On OSWorld-Verified, it improves Qwen3.5-9B from 27.0\% to 46.9\% success rate and Qwen3.5-27B from 31.6\% to 62.2\%, while achieving a new open-source state of the art of 78.9\% with MiniMax-M3. Moreover, the same framework generalizes beyond desktop environments to Minecraft, demonstrating the generality of our design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出StructAgent，一种面向长时间跨度数字代理的统一因果结构框架。该框架通过显式维护紧凑、可验证的任务进度状态和基于验证的状态转换工作流，解决了现有代理在长期任务中难以解释、验证和恢复的问题。实验表明，在OSWorld-Verified基准上，该方法显著提升了多种LLM和VLM后端的成功率，例如将Qwen3.5-9B从27.0%提升至46.9%，Qwen3.5-27B从31.6%提升至62.2%，并利用MiniMax-M3达到了78.9%的新开源最优水平。此外，该框架还泛化到Minecraft环境，展示了设计的一般性。
Motivation: 现有数字代理在处理长时间跨度的真实世界任务时，通常直接操作原始交互历史，导致任务进度难以解释、验证和恢复，限制了可靠的长期执行。
Method: 提出StructAgent，一种以状态为中心的框架，包含统一状态（维护紧凑、可验证的任务进度）和结构化工作流（通过验证器支持的状态转换来调节进度），同时支持显式进度检查点、证据驱动的任务完成、定向失败恢复和工具支持执行，确保所有进度更新基于验证。
Result: 在OSWorld-Verified上，将Qwen3.5-9B成功率从27.0%提升至46.9%，Qwen3.5-27B从31.6%提升至62.2%，并用MiniMax-M3达到78.9%的新开源最优。在Minecraft环境也取得良好泛化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过围绕统一的因果任务进度表示来结构化代理状态和工作流，可以显著提升长时间跨度数字代理的可靠性和性能，且框架具有跨环境通用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diffusion MRI preprocessing affects ADC estimation and automatic PI-RADS v2.1 classification in bi-parametric prostate MRI
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) is acquired as part of bi-parametric prostate MRI, but suffers from artifacts that degrade downstream quantitative and diagnostic performance. While DWI preprocessing is standard in brain imaging, its adoption in prostate imaging remains limited and lacks standardized pipelines. This study investigated the effect of different DWI preprocessing strategies on apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) estimation and automatic Prostate Imaging Reporting and Data System (PI-RADS) classification. 268 cases were derived from the fastMRI prostate cohort by sequentially applying denoising, Gibbs-ringing correction, and diffeomorphic registration for susceptibility distortion correction. ADC maps were compared using linear least squares (LLS) and iteratively-weighted LLS (IWLLS). A 3-class DenseNet classifier was trained to predict PI-RADS scores from multi-channel MRI inputs. ADC analysis revealed statistically significant differences across preprocessing pipelines, with LLS and IWLLS producing numerically equivalent maps. Linear relationships between ADC values were preserved across most datasets (PCC ~0.99), while distortion correction realigned DWI to T2w anatomy and altered ADC values accordingly (PCC ~0.90). Classification showed the best AUROC and sensitivity for high-risk PI-RADS classes in the fully processed dataset. False-negative analysis revealed this dataset produced the least overconfident incorrect predictions on high-risk classes, which is a desirable property for clinical triage. DWI preprocessing, particularly distortion correction, enhances both ADC map quality and the predictive power of deep learning models for PI-RADS classification, supporting the need for optimized preprocessing pipelines in prostate MRI.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了扩散加权成像（DWI）预处理策略对双参数前列腺MRI中表观扩散系数（ADC）估计和自动PI-RADS v2.1分类的影响。268例来自fastMRI前列腺队列，依次应用去噪、吉布斯振铃校正和微分同胚配准进行磁敏感畸变校正，使用线性最小二乘（LLS）和迭代加权LLS（IWLLS）计算ADC图，并训练3类DenseNet分类器预测PI-RADS评分。结果显示，预处理管线间ADC存在显著差异，畸变校正重新对齐DWI与T2w解剖并改变ADC值；全处理数据集的分类AUROC和灵敏度最优，且对高风险类别的假阴性预测最不自信，有利于临床分诊。
Motivation: 前列腺DWI预处理缺乏标准化管线，尽管脑影像中预处理已广泛采用，但前列腺影像中尚未普及，且不同预处理策略对下游定量和诊断性能的影响未知。
Method: 使用fastMRI前列腺队列268例，应用三种预处理步骤（去噪、吉布斯振铃校正、微分同胚配准畸变校正），分别采用LLS和IWLLS估计ADC图，并训练多通道输入的3类DenseNet分类器进行PI-RADS评分预测。
Result: ADC分析显示预处理管线间存在统计显著差异，LLS与IWLLS数值等效；畸变校正使DWI与T2w解剖对齐，ADC值改变（PCC~0.90）。全处理数据集上高风险类别（PI-RADS 4/5）的AUROC和灵敏度最高，且假阴性预测的置信度最低。
Conclusion: DWI预处理（特别是畸变校正）可改善ADC图质量和深度学习模型对PI-RADS分类的预测能力，支持在前列腺MRI中采用优化预处理管线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Glimpse into Long-term Physical Coexistence with Intelligent Robots
papers.abstract_en: Long-term physical coexistence with intelligent robots requires more than capable robot policies. A persistent robotic assistant must support diverse user-facing interfaces, maintain long-horizon memory of people and preferences, coordinate across robot embodiments, and translate human intent into safe physical execution. We introduce PHILIA, a multi-robot agent built around a robot gateway abstraction. PHILIA retains the rich interaction and tool ecosystem of OpenClaw while exposing robot-local runtimes, onboard perception, navigation, speaker, and robot policies through a unified capability interface. This design decouples low-frequency, high-semantic agent reasoning from high-frequency, low-level robot execution, enabling plug-and-play integration of user interfaces, robot embodiments, and policy backends. As a result, the user experience becomes compositional: advances in user interfaces, robot embodiments, robot policies, navigation, or interaction algorithms can improve the overall experience without redesigning the system. We validate the architecture on Astribot S1 robots while designing the robot gateway contract to support future heterogeneous robot platforms through a shared capability interface for observation, task execution, navigation, speech playback, status monitoring, and task cancellation. We present representative use cases in which agent memory and scene understanding are grounded in robot actions. These span interactive household scenarios, ranging from simple organization to challenging long-horizon and dexterous service tasks, such as packing a backpack and lifting a garbage bag. We highlight the human-robot interaction flow, where contextual understanding of user intent and preferences, together with human-in-the-loop confirmation or adjustment during execution, is essential for effective assistance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PHILIA，一个基于机器人网关抽象的多机器人代理系统，旨在实现长期物理共存。PHILIA通过统一的能力接口解耦高层语义推理与低层机器人执行，支持多种用户界面、机器人形态和策略后端的即插即用集成。在Astribot S1机器人上验证了架构的有效性，并展示了交互式家庭场景中的长时记忆和灵巧操作能力。
Motivation: 长期物理共存需要机器人具备多样化的用户界面、长时记忆、多机器人协调以及将人类意图转化为安全执行的能力，现有系统缺乏统一的架构支持。
Method: 引入机器人网关抽象，将低频率、高语义的智能体推理与高频率、低层次的机器人执行解耦，通过通用能力接口封装机器人本地运行时、感知、导航、语音和策略。
Result: 在Astribot S1机器人上验证，展示了从简单整理到长时灵巧服务任务的代表性用例，如打包背包和提起垃圾袋。
Conclusion: 有效的辅助依赖于对用户意图和偏好的上下文理解，以及人在回路中的确认或调整，该架构支持通过组件升级实现整体体验的渐进改进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Surprisingly Simple and Effective Multi-Domain Graph Foundation Model through Graph-to-Table Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for learning transferable representations across diverse graph domains. Recent advancements in GFMs have been largely dominated by two paradigms: Graph Neural Network and Large Language Model (LLM) based methods. However, these methods often face a fundamental dilemma between training with limited data and a heavy reliance on textual attributes. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) offer a potential alternative, as node features and representations can be naturally organized in a tabular form. However, how to enable TFMs to effectively capture structural information of graphs remains largely unexplored. The key challenge is to learn a graph-to-table alignment mechanism that enables graph structural understanding for TFMs. To address this, we propose GTAlign, a surprisingly simple yet effective Graph-to-Table Alignment framework for text-free Graph Foundation Model. Specifically, we first pretrain a graph encoder that maps diverse graphs into a unified latent space to capture domain-agnostic graph representations. To further bridge the gap between graph topology and the tabular representation space, we propose community-guided continual pre-training, where pseudo-labels derived from graph community are used to construct few-shot prediction episodes. Lastly, we adapt the graph encoder for an unseen target domain and perform in-context inference. Extensive experiments on five benchmark datasets demonstrate that GTAlign significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on both node and graph classification, offering a simple, effective, and text-free GFM model. Code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GTAlign，一种通过图到表对齐（Graph-to-Table Alignment）的无文本图基础模型。该方法先预训练图编码器将多域图映射到统一潜在空间，再通过社区引导的持续预训练构建少样本预测任务，最后在目标域进行上下文推理。在五个基准数据集上，GTAlign在节点和图分类任务上显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有图基础模型面临训练数据有限或过度依赖文本属性的困境，而表格基础模型虽能自然处理节点特征，但难以捕捉图结构信息。如何让表格模型理解图拓扑结构是关键挑战。
Method: 提出GTAlign框架：1）预训练图编码器学习域无关表示；2）社区引导的持续预训练，利用图社区伪标签构建少样本预测任务；3）在未知目标域进行上下文推理。
Result: 在五个基准数据集上，GTAlign在节点和图分类任务上显著超越现有最先进基线。
Conclusion: GTAlign提供了一种简单、有效且无需文本的图基础模型方案，展示了图到表对齐的潜力。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Decomposing Runtime, Kernel, and Quantization Speedups via a Matched FP16 Intermediate: A Hardware-Conditioned Case Study on Four NVIDIA RTX A5000 GPUs
papers.abstract_en: Reported serving speedups from quantized kernels typically bundle the weight format, the kernel, and the inference runtime into one number. We present an attribution study on four NVIDIA RTX A5000 GPUs, 24 GiB each, on a single host with NVLink-bridged pairs. A matched intermediate stack that keeps the faster runtime without the quantized kernel splits the full speedup into a runtime part and a kernel and quantization part. Under matched greedy decoding the full stack reaches $2.58\times$ end to end, with the runtime change accounting for about two thirds of that gain on a logarithmic scale; across three similar model families the kernel and quantization part moves by at most 1.5%. Sharding one instance across all four cards falls well below doubling: a profiler trace attributes about 80% of the per token shortfall to coordination, and an NVLink versus PCIe control on the same hardware shows similar realized bandwidth on both links, pointing away from link bandwidth as the cause. Whether to run one sharded instance or several independent ones depends on the workload and the model, with the ranking reversing on the larger model: the smaller model splits between sharding and multiple instances by workload, while the larger model favors two paired instances on every workload. Quantization extends sustainable concurrent users roughly four times past a reproducible half precision memory cliff. Differences in sampling mode and prompt pool between the two stacks are documented as threats to validity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文在四块NVIDIA RTX A5000 GPU上分解量化推理加速的贡献，通过匹配FP16中间栈分离运行时加速与内核/量化加速，发现运行时变化贡献约三分之二的对数尺度加速，并分析分片实例的通信瓶颈及量化对并发用户数的影响。
Motivation: 现有报告将量化加速的权重格式、内核和推理运行时混合为一个单一数值，缺乏归因研究。
Method: 提出匹配的FP16中间栈（matched intermediate stack），保留更快的运行时但不使用量化内核，从而将总体加速拆分为运行时部分与内核加量化部分。
Result: 完整栈在贪婪解码下达到2.58倍端到端加速，其中运行时变化贡献约三分之二的对数尺度加速；三个相似模型族的内核加量化部分变化不超过1.5%。分片实例的每token短fall约80%来自协调开销，NVLink与PCIe带宽相近。量化将可持续并发用户数扩展约四倍。
Conclusion: 论文强调了运行时优化在加速中的主导作用，并指出分片实例的通信开销及量化对内存瓶颈的缓解效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-supervised training for high-resolution close-range multispectral remote sensing imagery
papers.abstract_en: Although self-supervised learning (SSL) offers a promising way to reduce annotation effort in close-range remote sensing, its effectiveness for high-resolution multispectral unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery remains underexplored due to limited data. This study evaluated SSL pretraining for precision agriculture using cm-scale multispectral drone imagery collected across multiple sensors, years, and regions. Transformer-based encoders were pretrained with Momentum Contrast v3 (MoCo-v3) and Masked Autoencoders on a harmonized dataset combining msuav500K with newly collected multi-year UAV imagery from agricultural fields in Finland. Pretraining used four spectral bands (Green, Red, Red-Edge, Near-Infrared) for cross-sensor compatibility. The models were evaluated on crop-weed semantic segmentation using the WeedMap dataset with 5--100% training data. The following two subsets served as downstream tasks: Task A (Germany, RedEdge-M), where all pretrained models were compared under partial and full fine-tuning, and Task B (Switzerland, Sequoia), where the best encoder from Task A was assessed. Our Swin Transformer pretrained with MoCo-v3 achieved the strongest performance on both tasks, surpassing the Swin Transformer model of Doornbos et al. pretrained on a pre-release of msuav500K. Our pretrained Swin Transformer further demonstrated cross-sensor and cross-region generalization. We additionally provide a public multi-year multispectral UAV dataset from Finland to support future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了自监督学习在高分辨率多光谱无人机遥感图像上的有效性，使用MoCo-v3和掩码自编码器预训练多种Transformer编码器，并在作物-杂草语义分割任务上测试。结果表明，Swin Transformer结合MoCo-v3预训练在两个跨传感器、跨区域的下游任务上表现最佳，超越了现有方法。
Motivation: 自监督学习在近距遥感中可减少标注成本，但其在高分辨率多光谱无人机图像上的效果因数据有限而未被充分探索。
Method: 使用MoCo-v3和掩码自编码器在自建的多传感器、多年份、多区域的芬兰无人机数据集上预训练Transformer编码器（包括Swin Transformer），输入为绿、红、红边、近红外四个光谱波段，并在WeedMap数据集上进行下游作物-杂草语义分割评估。
Result: Swin Transformer经MoCo-v3预训练后在两个任务上均取得最优结果，超越了Doornbos等人使用msuav500K预训练版本的Swin Transformer，并展示了跨传感器和跨区域的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 研究表明自监督学习可有效利用多光谱无人机图像，且跨传感器/区域数据预训练有助于提升迁移性能。公开了芬兰多年多光谱无人机数据集以支持后续研究。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: BackgroundMellow: A Multi-Modal Cohesive Framework for Narrative-Driven Rich Cinematic Soundscape Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating immersive, synchronized and cinematic audio for long-form textual narratives remains a significant challenge in multi-modal AI. While current Text-to-Audio (TTA) frameworks successfully synthesize isolated sound effects, they struggle with narrative cohesion, temporal alignment, and cinematic emotional depth. We present BackgroundMellow, a framework that treats story-to-audio generation as a precise orchestration and signal processing problem. This framework is enabled without ground-truth through a master-specialist agent architecture that decomposes text into precise and multi-layered audio cues, generates each category of sounds with suitable specialist model, and superimposes the soundscapes to create a unified and aligned audio segment. Our pipeline is built over Tango2 latent diffusion model for environmental synthesis alongside a novel Cinematic BGM Retriever mined from professional soundtracks. To automate the sound mixing process, we use an NLP based module that predicts precise audio parameters, like start time, duration, and relative loudness, based on the narrative timeline. We further empirically evaluate and show the efficacy of the proposed framework leveraging nearest-neighbor retrieval against a curated dataset of YouTube cinematic trailers to measure temporal synchronization, coverage, and spectral richness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BackgroundMellow 框架，将故事到音频的生成视为精确编排和信号处理问题，通过主专家智能体架构将文本分解为多层级音频提示，使用 Tango2 潜扩散模型合成环境音，并结合从专业配乐中挖掘的电影背景音乐检索器，以及基于 NLP 的音频参数预测模块，实现同步、连贯且富有电影感的音景生成。在 YouTube 电影预告片数据集上的最近邻检索评估表明其在时间同步、覆盖率和频谱丰富度方面的有效性。
Motivation: 现有文本到音频框架虽能合成孤立音效，但在叙事连贯性、时间对齐和电影情感深度方面存在不足，难以生成长篇文本叙事所需沉浸式同步电影音频。
Method: 提出主-专家智能体架构，将文本分解为精确的多层音频提示，由不同专家模型生成各类声音，再叠加为统一对齐的音频段；管线基于 Tango2 潜扩散模型进行环境音合成，配合电影背景音乐检索器，并使用 NLP 模块预测开始时间、持续时间和相对响度等音频参数。
Result: 在 YouTube 电影预告片数据集上通过最近邻检索评估，展示了框架在时间同步、覆盖率和频谱丰富度方面的有效性。
Conclusion: 该框架无需真实数据即可实现叙事驱动的电影音景生成，为长文本到音频生成提供了一种新的系统级解决思路。

papers.title: Beyond Sally-Anne: Evaluating Theory of Mind in LLMs using Epistemic Schelling Points
papers.abstract_en: Text-based evaluations of Theory of Mind (ToM) in Large Language Models (LLMs) often involve cognitive tests akin to the Sally-Anne task that can be gamed due to exposure to relevantly similar tasks in pre-training and do not obviously test models' functional ToM abilities in ways that generalize to naturalistic settings. To address these issues, we introduce the Epistemic Asymmetry Schelling Task (EAST), a two-player dialogue game designed to benchmark robust and generalizable ToM abilities. By requiring LLM-LLM dyads to independently converge on semantic Schelling points under varying states of epistemic transparency, we evaluate whether models can robustly apply ToM to achieve coordination. Our results reveal a significant capability gap in functional social reasoning, with only frontier models successfully navigating the varying epistemic demands of the tasks. Analysis of reasoning traces shows that coordination failures are primarily driven by epistemic tracking errors, such as conflating private knowledge with mutual knowledge. Despite high performance on traditional static benchmarks, our study shows that robust social reasoning and epistemic tracking remain a critical bottleneck, providing concrete targets for future LLM evaluation and development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Epistemic Asymmetry Schelling Task (EAST)，一种双人对话游戏，用于评估LLM在认知信息不对称下协调的能力，从而测试其心理理论（ToM）。结果显示仅前沿模型能应对任务，且协调失败主要源于认知追踪错误（如混淆私有知识与共同知识）。研究表明，尽管LLM在传统静态ToM基准上表现良好，但稳健的社交推理仍是关键瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有基于文本的心理理论评估（如Sally-Anne任务）容易因预训练数据中的类似任务而被钻空子，且无法泛化到真实场景，因此需要更鲁棒和可泛化的评估方法。
Method: 引入Epistemic Asymmetry Schelling Task (EAST)，通过让两个LLM在信息透明程度不同的条件下独立选择语义Schelling点（即协调点），评估模型能否利用心理理论实现协调。
Result: 仅有前沿模型（如GPT-4等）能成功完成EAST；失败案例中，主要原因是将私人知识误认为共同知识的认知追踪错误。
Conclusion: 尽管LLM在静态ToM基准上得分很高，但跨认知情景的稳健社交推理仍是显著瓶颈，为未来模型评估和发展提供了具体改进方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Tuning Before Low-Bit Post-Training Quantization for Stochastic Gradient Descent-optimized Models
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) compresses deep neural networks for deployment under limited memory and computational budgets. However, low-bit (i.e., 2-bit or 4-bit) PTQ often suffers from substantial performance degradation. Most existing PTQ methods operate on an unconstrained full-precision (FP) model and primarily address quantization errors through post-hoc reconstruction. We argue that low-bit PTQ accuracy is limited not only by post-quantization error minimization, but also by the quantization-error tolerance of a FP model itself. In this paper, we propose Efficient Tuning Before Quantization (ETBQ), a pre-conditioning tuning stage for Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD)-optimized models before PTQ. During tuning, the FP model is optimized under perturbations sampled from the error distributions of weight and activation quantization, guiding the model toward a loss-landscape region that is less sensitive to the subsequent PTQ. Unlike QAT, ETBQ does not train a fake-quantized deployment model, which is computationally and memory intensive. Instead, ETBQ outputs a FP model that can be used by any PTQ backend. Experiments on CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet, ImageNet, and Cityscapes provide consistent evidence that ETBQ improves low-bit PTQ across diverse tasks. Under W2A4 settings, e.g., ETBQ improves over naive PTQ by 2.14\% top-1 accuracy on Tiny-ImageNet and by 5.80\% mIoU on Cityscapes. Code is available at https://github.com/xpxpxp2001xpxpxp/ETBQ.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 10 figures, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems (TNNLS). Code available at https://github.com/xpxpxp2001xpxpxp/ETBQ
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ETBQ，一种在低比特后训练量化（PTQ）之前对SGD优化模型进行预调节微调的方法。通过从权重量化和激活量化的误差分布中采样扰动，引导全精度模型进入对后续量化不敏感的区域，从而提升低比特PTQ精度。实验表明，在W2A4设置下，ETBQ在Tiny-ImageNet上top-1准确率提升2.14%，在Cityscapes上mIoU提升5.80%。
Motivation: 低比特PTQ（2/4比特）性能下降严重，现有方法大多在无约束的全精度模型上通过后处理重构来减小量化误差，但忽略了模型本身对量化误差的容忍度。
Method: 提出ETBQ，在PTQ之前对全精度模型进行微调：从权重和激活量化误差分布中采样扰动，优化模型使其损失景观对后续量化不敏感。无需训练伪量化模型，输出全精度模型可被任意PTQ后端使用。
Result: 在CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet、ImageNet、Cityscapes上一致提升低比特PTQ性能。W2A4设定下，Tiny-ImageNet top-1提升2.14%，Cityscapes mIoU提升5.80%。
Conclusion: ETBQ通过预调节微调提高模型对低比特PTQ的容忍度，是一种轻量级且与PTQ后端无关的前置方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OpsMem: Dual-Memory Reasoning with Cross-Memory Resonance for Failure Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Failure diagnosis in modern software systems requires iterative evidence acquisition and hypothesis reasoning guided by operational experience. Existing LLM-based methods improve diagnosis through agentic reasoning or knowledge augmentation, but they often lack a mechanism to coordinate the evolving diagnostic state with operational experience during iterative diagnosis. We propose OpsMem, a dual-memory framework that maintains a short-term memory for the current diagnostic state and a long-term memory for reusable operational experience. OpsMem uses cross-memory resonance to activate state-relevant long-term memory, conditions multi-agent diagnosis on the short-term and activated long-term memories, and consolidates reusable experience from solved incidents back into long-term memory. Experiments on a real-world Huawei microservice failure diagnosis dataset show that OpsMem outperforms representative agentic-reasoning and knowledge-augmented baselines, improving Match and Relevant by up to 46.88% and 18.39% over the strongest baseline, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OpsMem，一种双记忆框架，用于现代软件系统的故障诊断。它维护短期记忆（当前诊断状态）和长期记忆（可复用的运维经验），通过跨记忆共振激活状态相关的长期记忆，并基于这两种记忆进行多智能体诊断。在华为微服务故障诊断数据集上，OpsMem在Match和Relevant指标上分别比最强基线提升46.88%和18.39%。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的故障诊断方法通过智能体推理或知识增强来改进，但缺乏在迭代诊断中协调不断演化的诊断状态与运维经验的机制。
Method: 提出双记忆框架OpsMem，包含短期记忆（当前诊断状态）和长期记忆（可复用运维经验），通过跨记忆共振激活状态相关的长期记忆，并基于短期和激活的长期记忆进行多智能体诊断，同时将可复用的经验从已解决的故障整合回长期记忆。
Result: 在真实华为微服务故障诊断数据集上，OpsMem在Match和Relevant指标上分别比最强基线提升46.88%和18.39%。
Conclusion: OpsMem通过双记忆和跨记忆共振有效协调了诊断状态与运维经验，显著提升了故障诊断性能。

papers.title: Benchmarking Edge Inference Strategies for Deep Learning Models in Industrial Machine Vision
papers.abstract_en: Edge deployment is often the preferred solution for industrial machine vision systems when low latency, data security, or limited connectivity are critical requirements. Several frameworks are available to optimise inference on edge devices; however, relatively few studies have systematically compared their inference-time performance under industrial deployment conditions. In this work, we present a comparative study of four widely used approaches for machine vision inference in industrial settings: plain PyTorch, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO, and TensorRT. The evaluation focuses on inference time, covers several CPU- and GPU-based hardware platforms, and includes both conventional convolutional neural networks and a transformer-based vision model. For the hardware platforms and models evaluated, the results show that OpenVINO achieves the lowest inference time on CPUs, while TensorRT achieves the lowest inference time on GPUs. However, TensorRT does not outperform plain PyTorch for the transformer-based model considered in this study.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, accepted at IEEE COINS 2026. Preprint version; camera-ready version to appear in the conference proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了四种边缘推理框架（plain PyTorch、ONNX Runtime、OpenVINO、TensorRT）在工业机器视觉任务中的推理时间。实验覆盖CPU和GPU硬件平台，包含传统CNN和Transformer模型。结果表明OpenVINO在CPU上最快，TensorRT在GPU上最快，但TensorRT在Transformer模型上并未优于plain PyTorch。
Motivation: 工业机器视觉对低延迟、数据安全和有限连接有严格要求，尽管有多种边缘推理框架可用，但缺乏系统性比较研究。
Method: 在工业部署条件下，对四种推理框架（PyTorch、ONNX Runtime、OpenVINO、TensorRT）进行推理时间对比，涵盖多种CPU和GPU平台，以及CNN和Transformer模型。
Result: OpenVINO在CPU上达到最低推理时间，TensorRT在GPU上最低；但TensorRT对Transformer模型未超过plain PyTorch。
Conclusion: OpenVINO和TensorRT分别适用于CPU和GPU场景，但TensorRT对Transformer模型无优势。

papers.title: Characterising AI Models for Cataloguing
papers.abstract_en: The creation of digital collections involves not only the digitisation of content, but also the creation of catalogue records for it. This often-overlooked task requires slow and costly expert manual work. In this project, we have evaluated the application of AI models to this task, comparing different implementations and models. This work includes a qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the experiments carried out, as well as recommendations on the use of AI models that go beyond the specific use case.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了多种 AI 模型在数字藏品编目（cataloguing）中的应用，包括定性和定量实验，并给出了超越具体用例的通用建议。
Motivation: 数字藏品创建中编目环节常被忽视，但需要缓慢且昂贵的专家手动工作，因此需要自动化的 AI 辅助方案。
Method: 对比不同实现和不同 AI 模型在编目任务上的表现，进行定性及定量评估。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，仅说明包含了实验评估和建议。
Conclusion: 提出了关于使用 AI 模型进行编目的推荐，可推广至更广泛的场景。

papers.title: Beyond Critical Slowing Down: Slow Modes, Extreme Tails, and Field Decoherence in Tipping Transitions
papers.abstract_en: We study early-warning signals of climate tipping in the metastable stochastic Ghil--Sellers energy balance model. Rather than relying on a single scalar indicator, we analyze the transition through three complementary lenses: reduced Ruelle--Pollicott (RP) resonances, extreme value statistics, and full-field data-adaptive harmonic modes. This distinguishes bulk relaxation, tail excursions, and spatial phase organization as interacting aspects of tipping. First, using a reduced transfer-operator construction for global mean temperature and meridional thermal contrast, we estimate reduced RP resonances and Kolmogorov modes. Near tipping, several dominant decay rates drop and their modes harmonize along a common slow direction. Consequently, Green's functions aligned with this direction acquire coherent delayed-recovery tails and enhanced low-frequency susceptibility. The warning is thus carried by a bundle of slow modes rather than a single spectral gap. Second, Extreme Value Theory reveals that the cold tail of the global mean temperature anomaly becomes less sharply bounded and more persistent near the transition. The shape and extremal indices show an asymmetric organization: cold excursions probing the escape direction become more accessible and clustered. Third, Data-Adaptive Harmonic Mode (DAHM) analysis of the full temperature field shows that near tipping, leading modes still capture the large-scale trend, but fixed-rank reconstruction degrades and the DAHM phase distribution broadens. We interpret this as multivariate phase decoherence: the field retains a coherent transition component while losing sharp latitudinal phase organization. Ultimately, metastable tipping is marked by a joint reorganization of reduced spectral response, extreme-event statistics, and full-field phase coherence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究气候系统中临界转变的早期预警信号，使用随机Ghil-Sellers能量平衡模型。通过三条互补途径分析转变：约化Rulle-Pollicott共振、极值统计和全场数据自适应谐波模式。发现临界点附近，主导衰减率下降且模态沿共同慢方向协调，冷尾变得持久且不对称，全场相分布展宽（即相退相干）。这些信号共同区别于单个标量指标。
Motivation: 传统临界慢化指标通常只关注单一标量指标，无法全面描述气候临界转变的复杂行为。本文旨在从约化谱响应、极端事件统计和全场相位组织三个互补视角揭示临界点前的多维度预警信号。
Method: 对于全球平均温度和经向热对比，构建约化转移算子估计约化Rulle-Pollicott共振；应用极值理论研究冷尾的形状参数和极值指数；对全场温度场进行数据自适应谐波模式分析。
Result: 临界点附近多个主导衰减率下降且模态沿共同慢方向协调，格林函数出现相干延迟恢复尾和低频敏感性增强；冷尾变得更持久且不对称；DAHM相分布展宽，表明全场相位退相干。
Conclusion: 临界转变由约化谱响应、极端事件统计和全场相位相干性的联合重组标记，这些信号共同构成更丰富的早期预警信息。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Inter-Stop Energy Prediction and Causal Driver Quantification for Dual-Source Trolleybuses via a Time-Aware Tabular Deep Learning Architecture
authors: China (2) School of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering and Automation
papers.abstract_en: Dual-source trolleybuses alternate between overhead catenary supply and on-board battery operation, creating energy-use patterns driven by route attributes, high-frequency trajectories, and hourly weather. Existing models struggle to represent these heterogeneous inputs and rarely explain the causal drivers of consumption. This paper proposes a time-aware tabular deep learning framework for inter-stop energy management. Periodic time encoding is integrated into a parameter-efficient batch-ensemble backbone to jointly learn static and sequential features, while Bayesian optimization with tree-structured density estimation tunes hyperparameters. To move beyond prediction, a three-layer causal explanation pipeline combines feature attribution for marginal effects, a linear non-Gaussian acyclic model for causal direction discovery, and a meta-learner for net average treatment effects. Experiments on the Zurich trolleybus dataset enriched with meteorological records achieve a MAPE of 6.52% and R of 0.982, outperforming ten statistical, tree-ensemble, and deep learning baselines. Ablation results show that periodic time encoding contributes most to the accuracy gain. Causal analysis identifies regenerative braking ratio and average speed as the strongest energy-saving factors, while coasting distance is the main driver of excess consumption. The findings offer actionable thresholds for vehicle technology, driving behavior, capacity allocation, and catenary network planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为双源无轨电车站间能耗预测与因果驱动因素量化提出一种时间感知的表格深度学习框架。该框架集成周期性时间编码到参数高效的批量集成骨干网络中，使用贝叶斯优化调整超参数，并设计三层因果解释流水线。在苏黎世无轨电车数据集上，模型MAPE达6.52%，R为0.982，优于十种基线。因果分析发现再生制动比例和平均速度是最主要的节能因素，滑行距离是能耗过高的主因。
Motivation: 现有模型难以同时表示路线属性、高频轨迹和逐时天气等异构输入，且很少解释能耗的因果驱动因素。
Method: 提出时间感知表格深度学习框架：周期性时间编码嵌入参数高效的批量集成骨干网络，联合学习静态和序列特征；使用基于树结构密度估计的贝叶斯优化调参；构建三层因果解释流水线，包括特征归因、线性非高斯无环模型发现因果方向，以及元学习器估计平均处理效应。
Result: 在苏黎世无轨电车数据集上MAPE达6.52%，R为0.982，超过十种统计、树集成和深度学习基线。消融实验表明周期性时间编码贡献最大。因果分析识别再生制动比例和平均速度为最强节能因素，滑行距离为能耗过高的主要驱动因素。
Conclusion: 论文强调所提框架在能耗预测精度和因果解释方面的有效性，并提供了车辆技术、驾驶行为、容量分配和接触网网络规划的可行阈值。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Understanding the Impact of AI Code Assistants on Security API Usage: An Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: AI code assistants are transforming software development, but their implications for software security remain a major concern, particularly in the context of security APIs. These APIs are critical for safeguarding software systems, yet their complexity often leads to incorrect use and serious vulnerabilities. Developing an evidence-based understanding of how AI assistants influence developers' use of these APIs is therefore essential for informing effective mitigation strategies. While a few user studies have examined the broader impact of AI assistants on software vulnerabilities, the use of security APIs remains unexplored from a developer-centered perspective. This study addresses this gap by presenting the first empirical investigation into how AI code assistants affect professional developers' use of security APIs. We conducted a study with 44 developers who completed security API programming tasks with and without GitHub Copilot assistance. Our findings show that, while Copilot improves functional correctness and marginally reduces certain insecure patterns, it does not significantly improve secure API usage. We also found that developers rarely raised security concerns when engaging with Copilot, and many did not recognize that their final implementations remained insecure. Finally, we offer recommendations for enhancing security awareness among developers and propose future research directions to support safer AI-assisted software development.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the 29th International Symposium on Research in Attacks, Intrusions and Defenses (RAID 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是首个针对AI代码助手（GitHub Copilot）如何影响专业开发者安全API使用的实证研究。44名开发者完成安全API编程任务，结果显示Copilot提升了功能正确性并略微减少某些不安全模式，但并未显著改善安全API使用，且开发者很少主动关注安全问题，许多人不认为自己的实现存在安全风险。
Motivation: 安全API的复杂性常导致错误使用和严重漏洞，而AI代码助手对开发者使用安全API的影响尚缺乏开发者视角的实证研究。
Method: 开展用户研究，招募44名专业开发者在有无GitHub Copilot辅助下完成安全API编程任务，对比分析代码的功能正确性和安全性。
Result: Copilot提高了功能正确性，并略微减少某些不安全模式，但未显著改善安全API使用；开发者极少主动提出安全顾虑，且未识别出最终实现中的安全缺陷。
Conclusion: 现有AI代码助手对安全API使用的改善有限，需要增强开发者的安全意识和改进工具设计，并提出了未来研究方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Neural Network Decisions to Training Cases: An Exact Account via Case-Based Decision Theory
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks increasingly guide decisions in high-stakes domains such as medical diagnosis, credit approval, and energy bidding. Audit in these settings requires case-level evidence: which training cases support an action and what outcomes they carried. Case-based decision theory (CBDT) formalizes this reasoning by aggregating outcome support from remembered cases. We show that an OLS action readout fitted on a fixed neural representation admits an exact case-based decomposition. Each action score is a weighted sum of training-case returns, with coefficients determined by empirical Gram geometry. We identify a sufficient regime for CBDT similarity semantics; outside it, the coefficients should generally be treated as signed Gram-geometric influence. The decomposition yields audit signals that trace scores to training cases, measure action coherence, and identify weak support. Across synthetic CBDT, PJM, Adult Income, and Default Credit tasks, the method recovers case-level preference structure and achieves the highest mean Top-30 consistency among compared attribution baselines, while remaining competitive on support reconstruction. The audit requires only fitting an OLS top-layer probe, without retraining the representation or accessing the original optimization trajectory; probe fidelity is measured by score reconstruction.
papers.comment: Preprint. 15 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables. Includes appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于案例决策理论（CBDT）的精确分解方法，将神经网络决策追踪到训练案例。通过在固定神经表示上拟合OLS动作读取器，每个动作得分可表示为训练案例回报的加权和，系数由经验Gram几何决定。该方法提供审计信号，可用于追溯得分来源、衡量动作一致性和识别弱支持。在合成CBDT、PJM、成人收入和默认信用任务上，该方法在Top-30一致性上达到最高均值，在支持重建上具有竞争力。
Motivation: 高风险领域（如医疗诊断、信贷审批）的神经网络决策需要案例级证据，即哪些训练案例支持某个动作及其结果。现有方法缺乏精确的案例级分解。
Method: 在固定神经表示上拟合一个OLS顶层探针，利用案例决策理论得到每个动作得分的精确可分解形式：加权和的系数由经验Gram几何决定。该方法不需要重新训练表示或访问原始优化轨迹。
Result: 在合成CBDT、PJM、成人收入和默认信用任务上，该方法在Top-30一致性上达到最高均值，支持重建性能具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种无训练、精确的案例级审计工具，适用于已训练的神经网络，但需注意系数在CBDT相似性语义外的解释局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Compile, Then Page: Executable SOP Programs and a Capability-Gated Runtime for Procedural LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise agents must follow long-horizon, conditional, safety-critical standard operating procedures (SOPs). We compile machine-readable SOP constraints into executable pseudo-code and run them with a program-guided (PG) stack machine that pages the active frame while an LLM performs semantic execution. A three-arm SOPBench study across six models separates representation from runtime: compiled text never significantly hurts and gains up to 16.0 points where official prose underperforms. Runtime guidance is capability-gated. Two strong models independently show positive seven-domain PG contrasts (58:19 and 75:31 discordant pairs), whereas weak models are harmed. A full-program cursor ablation (active frame first, complete program retained) recovers much of the strong-model refusal gain; selective visibility adds a smaller improvement. Paired probe and audit measurements track this divide to spontaneous state discipline rather than reconstruction ability. On Bank the three primary arms rise from 70.4 to 86.4 to 92.8, with 100% refusal correctness. Practical guidance: compile first; enable active-frame paging only after a model-level discipline check.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将标准操作程序(SOP)编译为可执行伪代码，并通过程序引导的栈式运行时执行，其中LLM负责语义执行，运行时通过主动帧分页和基于能力的分级门控来管理。在六个模型上的实验表明，编译文本不劣于原文，且在原文表现不佳时最高提升16.0分；能力较强的模型在七个领域中获得正面对比，而弱模型则受损。全程序游标消融实验恢复了大部分强模型的拒绝性收益，选择性可见性贡献较小。
Motivation: 企业代理需要遵循长时程、条件性、安全关键的标准操作程序(SOP)，但现有LLM在直接遵循自然语言SOP时可能出现偏差或安全隐患。
Method: 将机器可读的SOP约束编译为可执行伪代码，并设计程序引导的栈式运行时，其中LLM执行语义操作，运行时使用主动帧分页并基于模型能力进行分级门控。
Result: 在SOPBench六个模型上，编译文本从不显著有害，最高提升16.0分；强模型在七个领域中有58:19和75:31的正向对比对，弱模型则被损害。全程序游标消融恢复了大部分强模型的拒绝性增益，选择性可见性带来较小改进。在Bank任务上，三个主要分支得分从70.4升至86.4再升至92.8，拒绝正确率达100%。
Conclusion: 实际指导：优先编译SOP；仅在模型通过能力级纪律检查后才启用主动帧分页。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to control switching nonlinear systems with Koopman operator regression
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we consider the identification and control of nonlinear systems with finite action spaces. The unknown dynamics are estimated from finite samples with Koopman operator regression in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space, yielding a linear switching predictive model, the switches governed by the value of the control variable. In order to perform control in closed-loop, the learned dynamics are employed in an infinite-horizon optimal control problem with time-varying stage cost, which is solved by means of model predictive control. In a theoretical analysis, we derive learning rates for the Koopman dynamics approximation. We further quantify, under suitable assumptions, the sub-optimality of the model predictive control strategy, both in the case of exact Koopman dynamics, and in the case of learned ones. Numerical simulations on the Duffing oscillator complement our theoretical findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文考虑有限动作空间的非线性系统辨识与控制问题。利用Koopman算子回归在再生核希尔伯特空间中从有限样本估计未知动力学，获得线性切换预测模型。然后采用模型预测控制求解时变阶段成本的无限时域最优控制问题。理论分析给出了Koopman动力学近似的学习速率，并量化了MPC策略的次优性。数值模拟在Duffing振荡器上验证。
Motivation: 针对有限动作空间的非线性系统，现有方法难以有效辨识并控制切换动力学。本文旨在通过Koopman算子理论结合模型预测控制，提供可证明的近似保证。
Method: 采用Koopman算子回归在RKHS中学习线性切换模型，并基于该模型设计模型预测控制器。
Result: 理论推导了Koopman动力学逼近的学习速率，并量化了精确与学习动力学的MPC次优性界。数值模拟验证了理论结果。
Conclusion: 本文展示了Koopman算子回归与模型预测控制结合用于切换非线性系统的可行性与理论保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Longitudinal Multi-View Breast Cancer Risk Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate breast cancer risk prediction from screening mammography is critical for enabling personalized screening intervals and early detection. Recent deep learning methods have shown the value of longitudinal data and explicit temporal alignment. However, existing approaches either perform explicit alignment using a single mammographic view or model multiple views without explicit longitudinal alignment, limiting their ability to exploit the complementary spatial-temporal information used in clinical practice. To address this gap, we propose LMV-Net, a longitudinal multi-view breast cancer risk prediction model that jointly analyzes anatomically complementary CC and MLO views within an explicitly aligned longitudinal framework. We evaluate our approach on the public EMBED and CSAW-CC datasets, comparing it to state-of-the-art breast cancer risk prediction methods. Our model consistently outperforms existing approaches in overall risk prediction performance and across different breast density and cancer subgroups. Importantly, these improvements highlight the potential of longitudinal multi-view modeling to enhance risk stratification, paving the way for future work on personalized screening, earlier identification of high-risk patients, and more efficient screening resource allocation. The code is available at https://github.com/sot176/LMV-Net.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LMV-Net，一种纵向多视图乳腺癌风险预测模型，联合分析头尾位(CC)和内外斜位(MLO)两种乳腺X线视图，在显式时间对齐框架下利用时空信息。在EMBED和CSAW-CC数据集上，该模型在整体风险预测性能及不同乳腺密度和癌症亚组中均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法要么使用单一视图进行显式对齐，要么处理多视图但缺乏纵向对齐，无法充分利用临床实践中互补的时空信息。
Method: 提出LMV-Net，在显式对齐的纵向框架中联合分析解剖学上互补的CC和MLO视图，实现多视图时空特征融合。
Result: 在EMBED和CSAW-CC公共数据集上，LMV-Net在整体风险预测及不同乳腺密度和癌症亚组中一致优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 纵向多视图建模能增强风险分层，为个性化筛查、早期高风险患者识别及筛查资源分配提供潜力。

papers.title: Fail-Aware and Explainable Test Oracle Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Despite their central role in fault detection, test oracles remain challenging to construct effectively. Recent learning based methods address this challenge by automatically generating test assertions, yet even if syntactically correct, they are often ineffective in revealing bugs. Rather than generating assertions, this study explores a different approach by training a model to directly predict whether a given test prefix passes or fails. We present FOCAL, an emerging code LLM-based discriminative oracle predictor. It learns from labeled pairs of test prefixes and methods under test, employs losses that emphasize failing cases during training, and grounds its predictions in statement level behavioral evidence. Compared with the baseline method SEER, we substantially improve performance on failing cases for unseen projects and provide richer explanations. A preliminary evaluation on fault-detection benchmarks and automated test-generation artifacts shows that our approach is highly accurate within its training distribution and substantially improves failure detection on previously unseen projects where prior discriminative oracles collapse. Moreover, the highlighted statements are supported by behavioral explanation checks. These early results suggest that fail-aware discriminative oracle prediction can complement existing approaches such as fuzzing, search-based testing, and LLM-based test generation. These techniques produce test prefixes at scale but often lack fault oriented oracles. In future work, FOCAL could take generated test prefixes and attach fault-aware predicted oracles to them, turning high-volume input generation into executable tests that are more likely to expose semantic failures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FOCAL，一种基于代码LLM的判别式测试预言预测器，直接预测给定测试前缀通过或失败，并基于语句级行为证据提供解释。与基线SEER相比，在未见项目上显著提升失败案例的检测性能，并在训练分布内保持高准确率。
Motivation: 测试预言的构建困难，现有学习方法生成的断言即使语法正确也常无法有效揭示缺陷，需要一种直接预测测试结果并关注失败案例的方法。
Method: FOCAL从测试前缀和方法对的标注数据中学习，使用强调失败案例的损失函数，并基于语句级行为证据进行预测解释。
Result: 在缺陷检测基准和自动化测试生成工件上，FOCAL在训练分布内高度准确，并在未见项目上显著提升失败检测性能，而基线SEER性能崩溃。
Conclusion: 早期结果表明FOCAL可补充模糊测试、搜索测试和LLM测试生成等方法，未来可用于为生成测试前缀附加故障感知预言，将高容量输入转化为可执行测试。

papers.title: The In-Car Sign Language Corpus (ICSL): A Multi-Modal Resource for Constrained-Space Sign Language Recognition
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the challenges of using sign language within shared mobility services, such as taxis, carpools, or ride-sharing platforms. The use of sign language recognition (SLR) in real-world, confined environments, specifically vehicle interiors remains largely unexplored. To motivate research in this area, we present the In-Car Sign Language (ICSL) dataset for Brazilian Sign Language (Libras), with the long-term goal of improving public transport accessibility for the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing community. The dataset consists of: (1) high-precision laboratory motion capture (MoCap) data to establish an idealized linguistic baseline and (2) real-world multi-modal in-car recordings captured using a 2D camera and 3D Time-of-Flight sensors. The dataset provides a basis for comparative analyses between synthesized signing avatar animations and recorded real signing interpreter videos, which enable future research into robust "in-the-wild" SLR models and domain adaptation. We describe in detail the use cases, the setup, the data collection protocol, and the metadata structure of the corpus. In total, we recorded a multimodal dataset exceeding 1.5 million frames, comprising the synchronized multimodal streams described above featuring Libras users across various in-car scenarios. The corpus is provided with gloss annotation of lexical signs and non-lexical sign language elements specially designed to support the training and evaluation of deep neural networks for constrained space recognition. In-vehicle signing offers a technically significant example of a constrained, occluded, and non-frontal environment. While recognizing the diverse communication strategies already employed by the Deaf community, identifying automotive-specific limitations provides a useful stepping stone for research into enhancing in-car accessibility and passenger quality of life.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对共享出行场景中的手语识别挑战，提出了车载手语（ICSL）数据集，包含高精度运动捕捉（MoCap）数据和真实车载多模态数据（2D相机+3D ToF传感器），总帧数超过150万，用于巴西手语（Libras）的受限空间识别。数据集附带词汇和非词汇元素的注释，支持深度神经网络训练，旨在提升聋人社区的公共交通无障碍性。
Motivation: 目前手语识别在真实受限环境（如车内）中研究不足，现有方法主要针对正面、非遮挡场景，无法处理车内空间限制、遮挡和非正面视角等挑战。该数据集旨在填补这一空白，并推动域适应和鲁棒SLR模型的研究。
Method: 构建ICSL数据集，包含实验室MoCap数据作为语言基线和真实车载多模态数据（2D摄像头+3D Time-of-Flight传感器）。记录总帧数超过150万，覆盖多种车内场景。提供词汇和非词汇符号的注释（gloss annotation），用于训练和评估受限空间识别深度神经网络。
Result: 数据集超过150万帧，同步多模态流，包含Libras使用者在车内各种情景下的数据。提供了详细的使用案例、设置、采集协议和元数据结构。
Conclusion: 车辆内手语识别是受限、遮挡、非正面环境的典型例子，该数据集为提升聋人乘客无障碍性和生活质量提供了研究基础。摘要强调该资源可促进域适应和“野外”鲁棒SLR模型的发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HierCAD: Hierarchical Text-to-CAD Design via Structure Alignment and Parameter Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Recent text-to-CAD approaches have shown promising results by leveraging large language models, but they often struggle with maintaining structural consistency in complex designs and accurately grounding geometric parameters. To address these issues, we propose HierCAD, a hierarchical text-to-CAD framework that improves both structural reasoning and parameter prediction. HierCAD reformulates CAD generation as progressive reasoning by decomposing CAD construction trees into object-level procedural reasoning and part-level topology reasoning trajectories. To further improve generation fidelity, we introduce a unified Structure Alignment and Parameter Grounding (SAPG) learning strategy. Structure alignment aligns topology reasoning trajectories with their corresponding parametric CAD spans, while parameter grounding mitigates shortcut learning through structure-preserving parameter perturbations and ranking-based supervision. Experiments demonstrate that HierCAD outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods on both CAD sequence generation and reconstructed CAD model evaluation. Our code is available at https://github.com/Collab-Gen/HierCAD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HierCAD，一种层次化文本到 CAD 框架，通过将 CAD 构造树分解为对象级过程推理和部件级拓扑推理轨迹，并引入结构对齐与参数基础（SAPG）学习策略，在保持复杂设计结构一致性和几何参数准确性方面超越先前方法。
Motivation: 现有文本到 CAD 方法在复杂设计中难以维持结构一致性，且几何参数定位不准，导致生成质量受限。
Method: 将 CAD 生成建模为层次化推理：先进行对象级过程推理，再进行部件级拓扑推理；并提出 SAPG 策略，包含结构对齐（对齐拓扑轨迹与参数 CAD 片段）和参数基础（结构保持参数扰动与排序监督）以缓解捷径学习。
Result: 实验表明，在 CAD 序列生成和重建模型评估上，HierCAD 均优于先前最先进方法。
Conclusion: 层次化推理结合 SAPG 策略可有效提升文本到 CAD 的结构一致性与参数准确性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AutoVSR: Automatic Visual-to-Symbolic Reasoning for Symbolic Expression Generation from Circuit Schematic
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic expressions can effectively characterize and predict circuit behavior, but deriving them directly from circuit schematics is challenging. This process requires accurate visual-to-symbolic construction of circuit structure from images and correct multi-step symbolic derivation, both of which impose strict correctness requirements. This work proposes AutoVSR, an automated framework for visual-to-symbolic generation of circuit expressions using Vision Language Models (VLMs). By reconstructing circuit diagrams into an executable intermediate representation (Executable IR) and leveraging a symbolic solver for reasoning, AutoVSR significantly improves the accuracy of symbolic expression generation. AutoVSR introduces two key innovations: an IR construction method guided by component rule retrieval and verification-based feedback, and a symbolic solver implemented as a planning agent equipped with a symbolic tool library for reliable multi-step derivation. Compared with end-to-end VLM approaches and specialized methods on the main symbolic expression generation task, AutoVSR achieves accuracy improvements of 30.01--59.45% and 41.96--51.84%, respectively. Moreover, AutoVSR surpasses closed-source state-of-the-art VLMs in inference cost and computational efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/LongfeiLi1/AutoVSR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoVSR，一个利用视觉语言模型(VLM)从电路原理图自动生成符号表达式的框架。它通过将电路图重建为可执行中间表示(Executable IR)并结合符号求解器进行推理，显著提升了生成准确性。两个关键创新是基于组件规则检索和验证反馈的IR构建方法，以及作为规划代理配备符号工具库的符号求解器。
Motivation: 从电路原理图直接推导符号表达式需要准确的视觉到符号的结构构建和正确的多步符号推导，现有方法难以保证高准确性。
Method: AutoVSR 框架：先利用VLM和组件规则检索将电路图转换为可执行IR，再通过一个作为规划代理的符号求解器（配备符号工具库）进行可靠的多步推导，并引入基于验证的反馈机制。
Result: 在主要符号表达式生成任务上，与端到端VLM方案和专用方法相比，AutoVSR分别提升准确率30.01–59.45%和41.96–51.84%，且在推理成本和计算效率上超越闭源最先进VLM。
Conclusion: AutoVSR 通过视觉-符号分离和符号求解器的组合，有效提高了电路符号表达式生成的准确性和效率，但方法依赖电路组件的先验规则库。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Verifier-Guided Twelve-Tone Composition: A Generate-Verify-Repair Harness for Symbolic Music Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can produce superficially legal twelve-tone scores that collapse into degenerate textures. We introduce a neuro-symbolic harness that wraps a language-model proposer in a generate-verify-repair-trace loop with symbolic verification. The complete pipeline improves event-local consistency without claiming whole-piece legality. Across 40 controlled tasks and four paired models, audited delivery yield rises from 13.3% under raw generation to 48.1% with the harness, which explicitly abstains otherwise. The pass rate of a narrower collision and serialisation-consistency check rises from 33.5% to 58.3%, while degeneracy remains near 0.05, including under exploratory adversarial prompting. A blinded evaluation by five experts also shows a descriptive aggregate preference for harness candidates over raw generation in adherence, perceived legality, coherence, and overall quality.

TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型生成十二音音乐时表面合法但实际退化的问题，提出一个神经符号框架，将语言模型提议器与符号验证结合，形成生成-验证-修复-追踪循环。该框架在40个受控任务和4组模型上，将交付率从13.3%提升至48.1%，通过率从33.5%提升至58.3%，退化率保持在0.05附近，专家评估也显示对框架生成的候选作品有偏好。
Motivation: 大语言模型生成的十二音乐谱往往表面合法但实际退化，缺乏一致性和合法性，需要一种方法提升事件局部一致性而不保证整曲合法性。
Method: 提出一个神经符号框架，在语言模型提议器外套接生成-验证-修复-追踪循环，使用符号验证器检查并修复局部违规，循环迭代直到通过或放弃。
Result: 在40个受控任务和4组模型上，交付率从原始生成的13.3%提高到48.1%，通过率从33.5%提高到58.3%，退化率保持在0.05以下（包括对抗性提示）。五位专家的盲评显示，框架生成的候选作品在遵循规则、感知合法性、连贯性和整体质量上均优于原始生成。
Conclusion: 该框架能有效提升十二音作曲的局部一致性，但作者明确指出不声称能保证整首乐曲的完全合法性。

papers.title: PRISM Edit: One Vector for All Temporal Answers
papers.abstract_en: Model editing keeps large language models (LLMs) up to date without retraining, but temporal facts expose a limitation of the prevailing locate-and-edit paradigm: an update is not always a replacement. When a fact changes, the new answer should become current while the old answer may remain correct in historical time contexts. Building on this insight, we use causal tracing to show that LLMs already support this distinction via a two-stage internal computation: early MLP layers retrieve a time-agnostic subject representation, and later layers modulate it with temporal context to yield the time-correct answer. Motivated by this finding, we introduce PRISM Edit, which optimizes a single polysemous representation across temporal contexts and leverages the model's inherent modulation pathway to route it to temporally correct predictions, without any architectural modification. We evaluate on TimeConflict, a new temporal editing benchmark we introduce, and on temporally augmented CounterFact. PRISM Edit improves over the best baseline by +23.3 Temporal Consistency (TC) and +33.7 Current Relative-time Score (CRS) on average while being more than 2x faster. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/AnonymousStudy972/PRISM-Edit.
papers.comment: Chen Huang and Qi Zheng contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Long Zeng, Yuantong Xu
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时序事实（temporal facts）下的大语言模型编辑问题，发现模型内部存在两阶段计算：早期MLP层提取时间无关的主体表示，后续层根据时间上下文调节得到正确答案。基于此，提出PRISM Edit方法，通过优化一个多义词表示（polysemous representation）并利用模型固有的调制路径，无需架构修改即可在不同时间上下文中输出正确预测。在新建的TimeConflict基准和时序增强的CounterFact上，PRISM Edit平均提升+23.3时序一致性（TC）和+33.7当前相对时间分数（CRS），且推理速度提升2倍以上。
Motivation: 现有模型编辑方法（locate-and-edit）假设事实更新就是替换，但时序事实中旧答案在历史上下文中仍应正确，需要模型支持时间感知的预测。
Method: 提出PRISM Edit，通过优化一个单一的多义词表示（polysemous representation）来覆盖不同时间上下文，并利用模型内在的调制路径（modulation pathway）将该表示路由到时间正确的预测，无需修改模型架构。
Result: 在TimeConflict和时序增强的CounterFact上，相比最优基线，平均时序一致性（TC）提升+23.3，当前相对时间分数（CRS）提升+33.7，且训练/推理速度提升超过2倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调无需架构修改即可实现时序事实的模型编辑，并开源代码和数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Calibrated e-CUSUM Decoding for Quantized Reasoning Models: Why Token Log-Probability Is the Wrong Observable for Decoding Monitors
papers.abstract_en: Low-bit quantization makes small reasoning models inexpensive to deploy but can degrade their chains of thought. This motivates decoder-side monitors that intervene when generation becomes unreliable. We show that a natural candidate, the centered token log-probability increment $\log p(w_t)+H_t$, is the wrong observable for this purpose. Under the model's own sampling law it is a mean-zero martingale by construction, so it measures sampling self-consistency rather than trajectory health and is nearly silent during confident repetition, where both $\log p(w_t)$ and entropy are close to zero. We introduce a training-free decoding controller that combines (i) a degeneration-aware alarm score fusing token uncertainty with explicit verbatim repetition and (ii) a calibrated e-process-inspired sequential detector. The raw product process is Ville-valid under a conditional-mean null, while the deployed CUSUM-floored statistic is treated as an empirical change detector because the score is history-dependent and autocorrelated. On GSM8K with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B in FP16 and INT4, calibration turns a monitor that fires on 93--95% of generations into a selective detector of failing traces ($φ\approx 0.3$, precision $\approx 0.6$ against a 0.38 base rate). In this pilot, the controller reduces measured verbatim-degeneration signals and yields a positive but statistically inconclusive INT4 accuracy change from 63% to 69% (paired McNemar $p=0.18$, $n=100$), at a 28% token-budget cost. We also find that non-termination, rather than looping, is the dominant failure mode on GSM8K. The main contribution is methodological: an explanation of why centered token log-probability is inadequate for decoder monitoring and a calibrated, cautiously evaluated replacement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出中心化的token对数概率增量（log p(w_t)+H_t）作为解码器监控的观测变量存在根本缺陷：它在模型自身的采样定律下是零均值鞅，只能测量采样自洽性而非轨迹健康度，且在自信重复时几乎无声。作者提出无需训练的解码控制器，结合退化感知警报分数和基于e-process的校准顺序检测器（CUSUM-floored统计量）。在GSM8K上对DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B模型（FP16和INT4）的实验表明，校准将原本93-95%触发率的监控器转变为选择性检测故障轨迹（φ≈0.3，精确率≈0.6，基率0.38），INT4准确率从63%提高到69%（McNemar检验p=0.18），代价为28%的token预算；还发现非终止是主要失败模式。
Motivation: 低比特量化会退化小推理模型的思维链，需要解码器侧监控干预；但自然候选的centered token log-probability增量实际上是零均值鞅，只能反映采样自洽性，无法指示轨迹健康度，尤其在模型自信重复时几乎无声。
Method: 提出无需训练的解码控制器，包含两部分：（i）退化感知警报分数，融合token不确定性和显式逐字重复检测；（ii）基于e-process的校准顺序检测器，原始乘积过程在条件均值零假设下满足Ville性质，而实际部署的CUSUM-floored统计量因历史依赖和自相关被视为经验变化检测器。
Result: 在GSM8K上，DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B模型FP16和INT4下，校准将原来在93-95%生成上触发的监控器转变为选择性检测故障轨迹（φ≈0.3，精确率≈0.6，基率0.38）。INT4准确率从63%提升到69%（配对McNemar检验p=0.18，n=100），代价为28%的token预算。还发现非终止（而非循环）是主要失败模式。
Conclusion: 主要贡献是方法论：解释了为什么centered token log-probability不适合解码器监控，并提供了一个校准的、谨慎评估的替代监控控制器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Programming Language Policy as an AI Literacy Equity Problem: A 15-Nation Comparative Analysis
papers.abstract_en: The promise of AI literacy ``for all'' confronts a structural challenge embedded in how nations organise secondary computer science education. In most systems, a general-track subject -- Digital Literacy, ICT, TIC, or SNT -- bears the weight of universal AI literacy, while a specialist Informatics course serves STEM pathways separately. Yet the content and depth of the general track are shaped by governance decisions made largely with reference to the specialist one. This paper presents a comparative analysis of curricula and examination frameworks across fifteen countries, identifying two structural challenges. First, in several systems a significant portion of students completes secondary education without any formal programming exposure. Second, among those who do receive CS education, a \emph{Syntax Ceiling} emerges: Python-based instruction reaches most students, while the algorithmic depth associated with C++ remains concentrated in elite STEM tracks. Drawing on reform cases spanning centralised mandates (France, China, Japan), assessment-driven systems (Poland, Romania, South Korea), and recent universal reforms (Switzerland, Kazakhstan), we show that governance structures and high-stakes examinations are the primary drivers of both challenges -- and that specialist and general-track language choices are rarely independent, linked through shared teacher pipelines that curriculum policy seldom acknowledges. Achieving genuine AI literacy for all requires confronting not just curriculum content, but the access architectures and resource constraints that determine who receives it -- and at what depth.
papers.comment: Presented at 2nd International Workshop on AI Literacy Education For All (CEUR proceedings)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对15个国家中学计算机教育课程和考试框架进行比较分析，指出通用科目中编程教育不足以及“语法天花板”问题，并探讨治理结构和考试制度的影响。
Motivation: AI素养教育承诺“面向所有人”，但各国中学计算机教育组织方式存在结构性不平等，部分学生缺乏编程教育，且编程语言深度受限于课程轨道。
Method: 比较15个国家的课程与考试框架，分析中央集权（法国、中国、日本）、考试驱动（波兰、罗马尼亚、韩国）和近期普遍改革（瑞士、哈萨克斯坦）案例。
Result: 发现部分学生无编程教育，存在Python vs C++的语法天花板，且通用与专业课程的语言选择通过教师管道相互关联。
Conclusion: 实现真正的AI素养教育需要解决访问架构和资源限制问题，而不只是课程内容。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SLVMBench: Skill Learning from Video Memory
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Skill Learning from Video Memory (SLVMBench), the first benchmark that jointly evaluates whether video large language models (video-LLMs) can learn skills from long video memory and apply them to real-time tasks. SLVMBench presents models with 2-3 hour video streams that contain a tutorial video embedded in a stream of arbitrary irrelevant videos, resembling real-world human learning practices. Video-LLMs are asked to apply the acquired skill to answer real-time questions about an ongoing video. Unlike long-video understanding benchmarks that emphasize passive comprehension and skill-learning benchmarks that rely on short, immediate demonstrations, SLVMBench tests the full pipeline of memorizing and extracting procedural knowledge, as well as transferring it to real-time tasks. Moreover, rigorous human annotations feature sub-second-level temporal calibration, manually engineered questions eliminating common-sense guessing, and collated tutorials to ensure coverage of the required skills. Evaluations on state-of-the-art proprietary and open-source video LLMs show that video-LLMs struggle substantially with learning and applying skill knowledge from videos. Moreover, performance degrades markedly when the skill knowledge is placed within a long video memory. These results reveal a key limitation of existing video LLMs and position SLVMBench as the first benchmark for studying real-time skill acquisition and application from long-context video memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SLVMBench 是首个联合评估视频大语言模型 (video-LLMs) 能否从长视频记忆中学习技能并应用于实时任务的基准。模型需要从2-3小时包含教程的视频流中提取程序性知识，并回答关于正在播放视频的实时问题。评估显示现有视频 LLM 在此任务上表现不佳，且长视频记忆会显著降低性能。
Motivation: 现有长视频理解基准侧重于被动理解，技能学习基准依赖短时示范，缺乏对从长时间视频中记忆、提取程序性知识并迁移到实时任务的完整流程测试。
Method: 构建包含2-3小时视频流的数据集，其中嵌入教程视频，要求视频-LLM在观看后回答与当前视频相关的实时问题。问题经过人工设计以避免常识猜测，教程经整理确保覆盖所需技能。
Result: 在多个先进的开源和闭源视频-LLM上，模型在技能学习和应用方面表现困难，且当技能知识位于长视频记忆中时性能显著下降。
Conclusion: SLVMBench揭示了现有视频-LLM在实时技能获取与长上下文视频记忆方面的关键局限性，是该领域的首个基准。
Relevance: 0
