papers.title: SPARC-Net: A Spectral, Causality-Aware, and Hard-Constrained Physics-Informed Architecture for Stiff and Shock-Dominated Partial Differential Equations
papers.abstract_en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) provide a meshless approach for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), but suffer severe degradation in stiff and shock-dominated problems, where small PDE residuals can correspond to globally inaccurate solutions. We show these failures are multi-causal, arising from the concurrent interplay of (i) spectral bias against sharp features, (ii) imbalanced multi-term optimization and loss-weight collapse, (iii) violation of temporal causality, and (iv) under-resolved collocation. We present SPARC-Net, a unified architecture and training framework that jointly addresses all four pathologies. SPARC-Net leverages an adaptive multi-scale spectral encoder with a learnable spectral gate, a gated residual backbone, adaptive activations, and a hard-constraint output ansatz that exactly enforces initial and boundary conditions, structurally eliminating loss-weight collapse. Training employs stabilized gradient-norm loss balancing, floored causality-respecting residual weighting, and residual-based adaptive collocation (RAD). Validated against exact analytic and high-order spectral reference solutions across four canonical benchmarks -- viscous Burgers', Allen-Cahn, convection (beta=30), and reaction -- SPARC-Net yields substantial improvements over vanilla PINNs: relative L2 error drops from 1.47e-1 to 1.14e-1 on Burgers' (22% reduction), 9.93e-1 to 5.78e-2 on Allen-Cahn (94% reduction), and 9.82e-1 to 3.54e-3 on reaction (100% reduction). A characteristic-coordinate encoder for hyperbolic transport further reduces convection error from 5.14e-1 to 9.88e-5 (100% reduction). We report five-seed mean +/- standard deviation errors, Wilcoxon significance tests, full ablation studies, hyperparameter sensitivities, an extension to the 2D heat equation, and comparisons against parameter-matched baselines.

papers.title: Efficient Test-Time Optimization for Multi-Agent Proof Autoformalization
papers.abstract_en: Full-proof autoformalization bridges extensive mathematical proofs in natural language with formally validated reasoning, offering a pathway to elevate the ceiling of verifiable mathematical reasoning. Unlike statement-level formalization, proof autoformalization is a long-horizon challenge requiring coordination of claims, contexts, and dependencies across many proof steps, yet has only recently come under focused study. Current approaches either rely on costly model training or apply excessive, unguided repair at inference time. To this end, we introduce ToMap, a multi-agent framework that structures proof autoformalization as a Decomposer-Formalizer-Prover pipeline with efficient test-time optimization guided by formal verification and semantic rubrics for proof quality. Rather than distributing test-time compute across all agents, we perform bottleneck analysis and identify the Decomposer as the critical bottleneck: the quality of its atomic, self-contained proof units directly determines whether downstream agents can successfully formalize and prove each step. ToMap therefore treats the Formalizer and Prover as downstream executors and efficiently focuses test-time compute on Decomposer refinement. This refinement follows a loop inspired by GEPA, evolving prompts over candidate decompositions and using formal verification progress together with semantic proof rubrics to define a Pareto frontier that guides the next decomposition update. Experiments on ProofFlowBench show that ToMap improves over the best previous method by 19.0% when evaluated by both syntactic correctness and semantic faithfulness, while requiring lower test-time cost. Scaling analysis shows that most gains emerge within a few iterations of decomposition evolution, guiding test-time budget selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ToMap，一个多智能体框架，将完整证明自动形式化（proof autoformalization）构建为分解器-形式化器-证明器流水线，并通过基于形式验证和语义质量评分的高效测试时优化来提升效果。瓶颈分析表明分解器是关键瓶颈，因此将测试时计算集中用于改进分解器，通过类似GEPA的循环迭代演化分解提示，利用Pareto前沿指导更新。在ProofFlowBench上，ToMap在语法正确性和语义忠实性上比此前最佳方法提升19.0%，且测试时成本更低。
Motivation: 完整证明自动形式化是长期挑战，现有方法要么依赖昂贵的模型训练，要么在推理时进行过多无引导修复，缺乏高效的测试时优化策略。
Method: 引入多智能体框架ToMap，采用分解器-形式化器-证明器流水线，通过瓶颈分析识别分解器为关键瓶颈，将测试时计算集中在分解器优化上，利用形式验证进展和语义评分构建Pareto前沿，迭代演化分解提示。
Result: 在ProofFlowBench上，ToMap相比此前最佳方法在语法正确性和语义忠实性上提升19.0%，同时降低了测试时成本。扩展性分析表明大部分增益在几次分解演化迭代内获得。
Conclusion: ToMap通过瓶颈分析和有引导的测试时优化，有效提升了证明自动形式化的效率和质量，且计算开销更低。

papers.title: ASUMOT: Motion-Consistency-Based Asynchronous UAV Detection and Tracking with Event Cameras
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras offer microsecond-level temporal resolution and high dynamic range for low-altitude UAV perception. However, long-range UAVs often produce sparse, fragmented, and noise-contaminated event responses, where one semantic target may appear as multiple spatially separated blobs. Direct blob-level asynchronous tracking therefore suffers from duplicate trajectories and unstable identities. We propose ASUMOT, a motion-consistency-based asynchronous UAV detection and tracking framework operating directly on raw events. ASUMOT models each UAV as a set of motion-consistent event blobs. A local motion-consistency estimator triggers reliable candidates, a lightweight multi-task verifier provides UAV confidence and motion-direction cues, and motion-consistency clustering aggregates fragmented blobs into identity-consistent UAV tracks. We also introduce ES-UAV, a high-definition event-level UAV benchmark with dense semantic annotations. Experiments on public UAV tracking data and ES-UAV show that ASUMOT improves the accuracy--efficiency trade-off while preserving asynchronous event processing. Code and Dataset will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ASUMOT，一种基于运动一致性的异步无人机检测与跟踪框架，直接在事件相机原始事件流上运行。ASUMOT将每个无人机建模为一组运动一致的事件斑块，通过局部运动一致性估计、轻量级多任务验证器和运动一致性聚类实现鲁棒跟踪。还发布了ES-UAV高分辨率事件级无人机基准数据集。实验表明ASUMOT在精度-效率权衡上优于现有方法，同时保持异步事件处理。
Motivation: 事件相机虽能提供微秒级时间分辨率和高动态范围，但远距离无人机产生的稀疏、碎片化事件响应导致直接异步跟踪出现重复轨迹和身份不稳定问题。
Method: ASUMOT框架包括：局部运动一致性估计器触发候选斑块，轻量级多任务验证器提供无人机置信度和运动方向线索，运动一致性聚类将碎片斑块聚合成身份一致的无人机轨迹。
Result: 在公开无人机跟踪数据和ES-UAV数据集上，ASUMOT改善了精度-效率权衡，并保持了异步事件处理的优势。
Conclusion: ASUMOT通过运动一致性建模有效解决了事件相机远距离无人机跟踪中的碎片化问题，为异步事件感知提供了新思路。

papers.title: Metadata Supervised MRI Representations for Modelling and Controlling Acquisition Variability
papers.abstract_en: Magnetic resonance imaging exhibits substantial acquisition variability, where identical anatomy can appear markedly different across scanners and imaging protocols. Consequently, learned representations entangle biological structure with acquisition-dependent appearance, limiting interpretability, generalisation, and clinical deployment. We show that these sources of variation can be separated by jointly modelling MRI images and DICOM metadata. Using large-scale clinical brain MRI data, we learn representations that separate anatomical structure from contrast-dependent appearance. Resulting contrast representations organise heterogeneous acquisitions, support sequence understanding, and detect image--metadata inconsistencies, whereas anatomical representations suppress acquisition-specific variation while preserving biologically relevant information. Building on these disentangled representations, we introduce a unified anatomy-preserving harmonisation model for cross-modality and cross-site adaptation, conditioned on image or acquisition metadata. Our findings suggest that acquisition variability is a structured component of the imaging process that can be modelled, audited, and controlled, providing a foundation for acquisition-aware representation learning in large-scale medical imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对MRI采集变异（acquisition variability）导致表示混杂解剖结构与采集外观的问题，提出利用DICOM元数据联合建模MRI图像和元数据来学习解耦表示。在大规模临床脑MRI数据上，模型分离出解剖表示和对比表示，其中对比表示用于组织采集、理解序列和检测不一致，解剖表示保留生物学信息并抑制采集变异。进一步，基于解耦表示提出统一解剖保持的归一化模型，实现跨模态和跨站点的自适应。
Motivation: MRI采集变异使得同一解剖结构在不同扫描仪和协议下表现差异显著，学习到的表示纠缠了生物结构和采集依赖的外观，限制了可解释性、泛化性和临床部署。
Method: 提出同时建模MRI图像和DICOM元数据的表示学习方法，通过大规模临床数据学习分离解剖结构和对比依赖外观的表示。并基于解耦表示构建条件于图像或采集元数据的归一化模型。
Result: 对比表示能够组织异质采集、支持序列理解并检测图像与元数据的不一致；解剖表示抑制采集特异性变异同时保留生物学相关信息。归一化模型实现有效的跨模态和跨站点适应。
Conclusion: 采集变异是成像过程中可建模、可审计、可控制的结构化成分，为大规模医学影像中的采集感知表示学习提供了基础。

papers.title: The Paternalistic Filter: Epistemic Injustice and Differential Refusal in LLM-Mediated History Education for Marginalized Romanian Students
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as conversational tutors, they risk institutionalizing systemic inequalities. This study presents a systematic API audit of four LLMs acting as history tutors, evaluating 1,800 responses regarding the 1989 Romanian Revolution across five student personas varying by ethnicity and socio-economic tier. We uncover four interconnected patterns of \emph{epistemic paternalism}: (1)~\textbf{Differential Refusal}, where safety-aligned models block 76.7\% of educational requests from low-tier students; (2)~\textbf{Epistemic Gatekeeping}, evidenced by a 3$\times$ reduction in access to geopolitical complexity (e.g., the contested ``coup theory'') for marginalized learners; (3)~\textbf{Agency Theft}, a lexical shift where models like LLaMA produce a 5$\times$ higher victimization-to-politics vocabulary ratio for Roma students compared to elite peers; and (4)~\textbf{Elite Hermeneutics}, where AI tutors disproportionately withhold epistemic confidence and justification scores from low-resource demographic profiles. We argue that current safety alignment acts as a paternalistic filter, transforming conversational AI into agents of narrative segregation -- a manifestation of \emph{hermeneutical injustice} in Fricker's~\cite{fricker2007} sense that demands urgent pedagogical auditing.
papers.comment: 8th International Workshop on Culturally-Aware Tutoring Systems (HAL precedings)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM作为历史导师时的系统偏见进行系统审计，评估了四个LLM对1989年罗马尼亚革命的1800条回复，按民族和社会经济阶层划分五个学生角色。发现了四种认知家长主义模式：差异拒绝、认知守门、代理剥夺和精英解释学，证明安全对齐成为家长过滤器，导致叙事隔离。
Motivation: LLM作为对话导师可能制度化系统性不平等，但缺乏对历史教育中边际化学生群体的具体审计。
Method: 通过API审计四个LLM作为历史导师，使用五个学生角色（按民族和阶层变化）评估对1989年罗马尼亚革命相关问题的1800条回复，分析回复中的拒绝率、地理政治复杂性、词汇占比和信心分数。
Result: 安全对齐模型对低阶层学生的教育请求拒绝率达76.7%；边际化学习者接触地缘政治复杂性（如争议的政变理论）的机会减少3倍；对罗姆学生的受害者-政治词汇比精英学生高5倍；低资源人口从AI导师获得的认知信心和理由分数被不成比例地保留。
Conclusion: 当前安全对齐充当家长过滤器，将对话AI转变为叙事隔离的代理人，构成Fricker意义上的解释学不公正，亟需教育审计。

papers.title: Backpropagation as a Nilpotent Linear System
papers.abstract_en: Backpropagation is the computational engine of deep learning, yet its mathematical structure is typically treated as a procedural traversal of computational graphs. We present a global operator theory of the \emph{F-adjoint} framework, which reformulates the layerwise backward recursion of an $L$-depth feedforward network into a single linear system $(I-\cB)\Xs=\bG$, where $\bG$ is a source vector. We prove that the global backward operator $\cB$ is strictly block upper-triangular and nilpotent of index at most $L$. This nilpotency guarantees the exact termination of the Neumann series solution after at most $L$ terms, revealing classical backpropagation to be mathematically equivalent to block back-substitution on an upper bidiagonal system. We formalise \emph{F-symmetry} -- the condition in which the backward pass perfectly mirrors the forward pass -- identifying orthogonal weight matrices as canonical examples. Through worked numerical examples, we demonstrate how this operator perspective exposes the single-path collapse of strictly feedforward networks and its breakdown in residual architectures. Finally, we leverage this compositional structure to rigorously derive the mechanics of residual networks (gradient highways) and transfer learning (gradient truncation). This framework elevates backpropagation from an algorithmic recipe to a global nilpotent-operator formulation.

Motivation: 反向传播通常被视为计算图的过程性遍历，缺乏统一的数学结构。本文旨在用全局算子理论揭示其深层线性代数本质。
Method: 定义全局反向算子𝒞并证明其为严格块上三角幂零算子，利用Neumann级数求解线性系统，将反向传播转化为块回代。
Result: 严格证明了反向传播是幂零线性系统的精确解，并通过数值例子展示了前馈网络的单路径坍缩和残差架构的梯度高速公路机制。
Conclusion: 该框架将反向传播从算法提升为全局幂零算子形式，为理解残差网络和迁移学习提供了新视角。

papers.title: Mako: A Self-Evolving Agentic Operating System (SE-AOS) for Autonomous Web Exploitation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Self-Evolving Agentic Operating System (SE-AOS): a new class of AI agent that treats exploit capability as a mutable, versioned kernel it extends at runtime, observing its own failures, synthesising new capabilities, proving them against a live target, and hot-loading them back into itself. Mako is the first SE-AOS instance for security research and the autonomous web exploitation engine developed within LaunchSafe. LaunchSafe builds autonomous security agents for continuous offensive testing and agent-driven security research; Mako is the core engine behind that platform. On the public XBOW validation-benchmarks, 104 containerised, CTF-style web applications spanning 26 vulnerability classes across three difficulty tiers, Mako achieves full-suite coverage: it drives every one of the 104 targets to emit a cryptographically fresh, per-build flag, under a verification regime that makes fabricated or memorised results impossible. Our central result is a law of autonomous exploitation: once a capability exists and is discoverable, difficulty collapses; capability, not reasoning, is what is scarce, together with an architecture and formalism that turn that law into a self-improving system. Mako further runs a gated self-evolution loop that proposes, sandboxes, and commits improvements to its own agents and rules when fitness does not regress. We deliberately withhold the operational results, payloads, exploit chains, and tool source, because a system that reduces full-spectrum web exploitation to a repeatable, machine-speed pipeline is dual-use research of concern. We publish the science; we withhold the weapon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一种自演化智能体操作系统（SE-AOS），名为Mako，专为安全研究和自主Web漏洞利用设计。Mako能够将利用能力视为可变异、版本化的内核，在运行时扩展，通过观察自身失败、合成新能力并实时加载到自身。在公开的XBOW验证基准上（包括104个容器化CTF风格Web应用，覆盖26种漏洞类别和三个难度层级），Mako实现了全覆盖，驱动每个目标生成经过验证的唯一标志。核心结论是自主利用定律：一旦能力存在且可发现，难度即消失；能力而非推理是稀缺资源。论文出于双重用途担忧，有意隐藏了操作结果、Payload、利用链和工具源代码。
Motivation: 现有AI agent在安全研究中的漏洞利用能力有限，缺乏自我演化和动态能力扩展机制。论文旨在提出一种能够自主观察失败、合成新能力并实时更新自身的系统，以实现全谱Web漏洞利用的自动化。
Method: 提出自演化智能体操作系统（SE-AOS）架构，将利用能力视为可版本化的内核，通过自演化循环（观察失败、合成能力、验证、热加载）持续改进。Mako作为首个实例，采用门控自演化循环，在适应度不退化时提交改进。
Result: 在公开XBOW基准测试中，Mako在104个容器化CTF应用上实现全覆盖，每个目标均产生经过加密验证的唯一标志，证明了能力而非推理是漏洞利用的关键瓶颈。
Conclusion: 论文揭示了自主利用定律：一旦能力存在且可发现，难度即消失。SE-AOS架构将这一规律转化为自改进系统。但由于双重用途担忧，操作结果和工具源代码被有意隐瞒。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Unified Framework for Comprehensive Cardiac CT Segmentation and Phenotyping: Human-in-the-Loop Data Annotation, Vision Foundation Model Development, Multicenter Evaluation and Clinical Validation
papers.abstract_en: Comprehensive quantification of cardiac structures from computed tomography (CT) remains limited not by data availability but by the scalability of measurements, which makes routine use impractical. Here we present a unified framework for comprehensive cardiac CT segmentation and phenotyping that combines a human-in-the-loop annotation pipeline, a cardiac CT augmentation technique, and a self-supervised foundation model pre-trained on 60,000 unlabeled cardiac CT scans. Using this approach, we assembled the largest and most comprehensive expert-annotated cardiac CT segmentation dataset to date, comprising 1598 cases and 14 distinct cardiac structures (1000 for training, 598 for the external test set). Across five external datasets, the framework segmented all structures more accurately and comprehensively than existing open-source tools. Self-supervised pre-training improved labeling efficiency, with the most significant gains observed during external evaluation in the low-data regime. Benchmarking across convolutional, transformer, and state-space architectures showed comparable performance, indicating that data quality and pre-training, rather than architecture, drove accuracy. The framework was scaled to population-level phenotyping, with segmented anatomy that carries functionally relevant information about ventricular function and disease severity beyond demographic variables. By openly releasing the largest dataset with human labels, code, model weights, a CT augmentation library, and software, this work provides a reproducible foundation for opportunistic cardiac phenotyping from routinely acquired CT scans.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架，用于心脏CT的全面分割和表型分析，包含人机协同标注流程、心脏CT数据增强技术，以及在6万张无标注心脏CT扫描上预训练的自监督基础模型。利用该框架构建了迄今最大且最全面的专家标注心脏CT分割数据集（1598例，14个心脏结构），在5个外部数据集上分割精度和全面性均优于现有开源工具。自监督预训练提高了标注效率，尤其在低数据场景下增益显著。框架还被扩展到群体水平表型分析，分割解剖结构包含心室功能和疾病严重程度的功能相关信息。
Motivation: 心脏CT的全面定量测量受限于测量可扩展性，使得常规临床应用不切实际。
Method: 结合人机协同标注管道、心脏CT增强技术，以及基于60,000张无标注心脏CT扫描自监督预训练的基础模型。数据集包含1598例专家标注（1000训练，598外部测试），覆盖14个心脏结构。
Result: 在5个外部数据集上，框架比现有开源工具分割更准确、更全面。自监督预训练显著提升标注效率，尤其在低数据场景。卷积、Transformer和状态空间架构表现相当，表明数据质量和预训练而非架构驱动精度。框架在群体表型分析中提取的解剖特征包含心室功能和疾病严重程度的功能相关信息。
Conclusion: 通过公开最大标注数据集、代码、模型权重、CT增强库和软件，为常规CT扫描的机会性心脏表型分析提供了可重复的基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SalientGS: Unified SfM-to-3DGS with Importance-Guided MCMC Gaussian Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing 3D scenes from unordered images remains bottlenecked by expensive Structure-from-Motion (SfM) preprocessing and frozen pose interfaces. We present SalientGS, a unified SfM-to-3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pipeline. Its central contribution is importance-guided Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) Gaussian allocation, which aggregates multi-view residuals into per-Gaussian underfit and redundancy signals. These signals define a smooth importance-weighted sampling distribution that biases both birth and relocation toward underfit regions. This reallocates capacity from well-fit areas without altering the underlying stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics (SGLD). SalientGS achieves end-to-end reconstruction in 15 minutes with state-of-the-art perceptual quality. The supplementary material provides dedicated sections for Per-Scene Qualitative Comparisons and Per-Image Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) Analysis, including failure cases. Code and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/Six-Bit-TX/SalientGS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SalientGS 提出了一种统一的 SfM 到 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 流水线，核心是重要性引导的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛 (MCMC) 高斯分配，通过多视图残差聚合生成欠拟合和冗余信号，并定义平滑的重要性加权采样分布，引导高斯的生成和重定位到欠拟合区域。该方法在 15 分钟内实现端到端重建，达到最先进的感知质量。
Motivation: 现有 3D 场景重建方法受限于昂贵的 SfM 预处理和固定的姿态接口，需要更高效统一的流水线。
Method: 提出重要性引导的 MCMC 高斯分配，利用多视图残差生成每个高斯的欠拟合和冗余信号，定义平滑的重要性加权采样分布，偏置高斯的生成和重定位，在不改变随机梯度 Langevin 动力学的情况下重新分配容量。
Result: 在 15 分钟内实现端到端重建，达到最先进的感知质量，并提供了每场景定性比较和每图像 LPIPS 分析的补充材料。
Conclusion: SalientGS 通过统一 SfM 和 3DGS 并引入重要性引导的分配机制，实现了高效高质的 3D 场景重建。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Devil Is in the Leakage: A Disentangled Dual-Purification Framework for High-Fidelity Hairstyle Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Hairstyle transfer aims to synthesize a photorealistic portrait by transplanting the hairstyle from a reference image onto a source subject while preserving the source identity. Recent foundation models show strong generative capability, but they struggle with the zero-shot disentanglement required for precise local editing, often entangling the reference hairstyle with its original identity and pose. Existing diffusion-based pipelines typically decompose the task by first generating a "bald" image from the source and then injecting hairstyle features from the reference. However, we show that this paradigm suffers from a fundamental leakage problem. Identity Leakage in Hairstyle occurs when hairstyle features retain reference identity or pose information, while Flaw Leakage in Bald arises when residual artifacts in the bald image are propagated into the final synthesis. To address both issues, we propose the Dual-Purification Framework (DPF), which introduces two complementary training-time regularizers. Adversarial Hairstyle Purification (AHP) purifies hairstyle features by suppressing identity predictability under a mutual-information-inspired adversarial objective. Contrastive Geometric Purification (CGP) regularizes the ControlNet pathway with a contrastive objective, reducing the model's reliance on geometric artifacts in the bald condition. By jointly purifying the hairstyle representation and geometric pathway, DPF achieves high-fidelity, identity-preserving hairstyle transfer and state-of-the-art performance on diverse benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种双净化框架（DPF）用于高保真发型迁移，解决现有方法中身份泄漏和细节泄漏两个问题。通过对抗性发型净化（AHP）和对比几何净化（CGP）两种训练时正则化器，分别净化发型特征和几何路径，从而实现身份保持的高质量发型迁移，在多个基准上达到最优性能。
Motivation: 现有扩散流水线将发型迁移分解为先生成‘秃头’图像再注入发型特征，但这种范式存在根本性泄漏问题：发型特征中泄漏参考身份/姿态信息，以及秃头图像中的残余伪影传播到最终合成中，影响保真度和身份保持。
Method: 提出双净化框架（DPF），包含两个训练时正则化器：对抗性发型净化（AHP）通过互信息启发的对抗目标抑制发型特征中的身份可预测性；对比几何净化（CGP）通过对比目标正则化ControlNet路径，减少模型对秃头条件中几何伪影的依赖。
Result: 在多个基准上实现高保真、身份保持的发型迁移，达到最优性能。
Conclusion: 通过联合净化发型表示和几何路径，DPF有效解决了身份泄漏和细节泄漏问题，提升了发型迁移的保真度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Automated Textbook Auditing with Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring the quality of educational materials requires more than standard proofreading: textbooks must be audited for factual accuracy, domain-specific technical correctness, and linguistic quality simultaneously -- a task that general-purpose grammar checkers cannot address. We present \textbf{AI Textbook Auditor}, a modular multi-agent pipeline for automated quality assurance of educational materials across subject domains. The system accepts a textbook PDF and produces a structured, human-reviewable report via two analysis tracks: a \textbf{Factual and Technical Track} in which an ensemble of specialized LLM agents detects factual inaccuracies, code errors, incorrect definitions, and conceptual inconsistencies, augmented with web search for humanities domains; and a \textbf{Grammar Track} operating PDF-natively to preserve diacritical encoding. A \textbf{Judge Agent} filters false positives using domain-specific rules before presenting findings to a human reviewer. The pipeline supports two ingestion modes -- vision-native page rendering and PyMuPDF text extraction -- and is domain-adaptable via custom prompts encoding subject-specific error taxonomies. We demonstrate the system on two Romanian upper-secondary textbooks: a CS textbook (56 technical findings across seven categories, with an expert-validated precision of 62.5\%) and a history and social sciences textbook (72 findings spanning factual errors, ideological bias, and grammar). The system is designed as a triage tool that reduces the manual effort of locating candidate issues, with human expert validation required before any editorial action.

TL;DR: 本文提出了AI Textbook Auditor，一个基于多智能体LLM系统的模块化流水线，用于自动化教科书质量审核。系统通过事实与技术轨道（检测事实错误、代码错误等）和语法轨道（保留变音符号编码）处理教科书PDF，并经过法官智能体过滤误报后生成结构化报告。在罗马尼亚高中计算机科学教科书上验证了56项技术发现（精确率62.5%），以及历史与社会教科书上的72项发现。
Motivation: 标准校对工具无法同时检查教科书的准确性、领域技术正确性和语言质量，需要专门的多方面审核方法。
Method: 提出模块化多智能体LLM流水线，包含两个分析轨道：事实与技术轨道（多个专业LLM代理检测事实不准确、代码错误等，并支持网络搜索）和语法轨道（PDF原生处理，保留变音符号）。法官智能体使用领域特定规则过滤误报后提交人工审核。
Result: 在罗马尼亚计算机科学教科书中获得56项技术发现，专家验证精确率为62.5%；在历史与社会教科书中获得72项发现（包括事实错误、意识形态偏见和语法问题）。
Conclusion: 系统被设计为分诊工具，可减少人工查找候选问题的工作量，但需要人类专家验证后才能进行编辑操作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fixed-Protocol Amortized MPS Tomography with Conformalized Predictive Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Quantum state tomography is sample-starved, and the states one prepares live on a narrow, learnable manifold. A $k{=}0$ prior-only control shows that on concentrated families a prior estimate is already near-optimal, so ``high fidelity at few measurements'' can be family memorization rather than tomography; genuine measurement-efficiency needs a model that conditions on the measurements and demonstrably uses them. On a shared matrix-product-state (MPS) core parameterization we study two routes. Approach~A learns a generative prior over MPS cores with measurement-guided posterior inference (gold-standard-validated, but whose few-measurement accuracy the control shows is largely the prior). Approach~B, our main proposal, is a \emph{fixed-protocol amortized} MPS estimator trained once with a gauge-invariant fidelity loss; we deliberately do not rest it on a permutation-invariant set encoder (a plain MLP matches it). The decisive lever is the measurement design: motivated by the fact that local reduced density matrices determine a $χ$-MPS, conditioning on an \emph{informative local} Pauli set rather than random strings turns a modest, memorization-prone estimator into a high-fidelity one ($\approx\!0.95$, up to $+0.59$ over prior-only, decisively passing a shuffled-measurement control). A dropout ensemble, conformally recalibrated, gives $\approx\!90\%$-coverage intervals -- including for observables never measured, where a shot-based interval does not exist. Quality holds as the system grows (fidelity $0.90$ at $n{=}10$, gain \emph{growing} in $n$; $0.88$ at bond dimension $χ{=}4$), the parameterization is polynomial (native contraction to $20$ qubits), and we close the loop on IBM hardware ($5$ states at $0.97$ from hardware-measured Paulis).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对量子态层析中样本稀缺的问题，提出了基于固定协议摊销矩阵乘积态（MPS）的估计方法，并利用共形预测（conformalized predictive uncertainty）提供校准的不确定性区间。方法通过学习测量引导的后验推断或直接训练固定协议的摊销估计器，关键改进在于使用信息性局部Pauli测量而非随机字符串，显著提升保真度（可达约0.95，比仅先验高出0.59）。在系统规模扩大时仍保持高质量（n=10时保真度0.90，键维χ=4时0.88），参数化复杂度为多项式，并在IBM硬件上验证（5态保真度0.97）。
Motivation: 量子态层析面临样本稀缺问题，且制备的态位于低维可学习流形上。先验控制实验表明，在集中态族中仅使用先验估计已接近最优，因此“少测量高保真度”可能仅仅是族记忆而非真正的层析效率；需要依赖测量并实际利用测量的模型才能实现真正的测量效率。
Method: 在共享的矩阵乘积态（MPS）核心参数化下，研究两种途径：方法A学习生成先验并通过测量引导的后验推断；方法B（主要提议）是固定协议摊销MPS估计器，使用规范不变的保真度损失一次训练，不依赖置换不变集编码器（普通MLP即可）。关键杠杆是测量设计：基于局部约化密度矩阵决定χ-MPS的事实，使用信息性局部Pauli集而非随机字符串，将中等、易记忆的估计器转变为高保真度估计器。
Result: 在测量设计改进下，保真度达到约0.95，比仅使用先验高出0.59，并通过打乱测量的控制实验验证。丢包集成结合共形校准给出约90%覆盖率的区间，包括从未测量的可观测量的区间（此时基于测量的区间不存在）。系统规模扩大时保真度保持良好（n=10时0.90，增益随n增大；键维χ=4时0.88），参数化复杂度多项式（原生收缩到20量子比特），并在IBM硬件上验证（5态保真度0.97）。
Conclusion: 本文表明，通过精心设计的测量策略（如信息性局部Pauli集）和固定协议摊销MPS估计器，可以在量子态层析中实现少测量下的高保真度，并提供共形校准的不确定性区间。方法在系统规模扩大时保持性能，且参数化具有多项式复杂度，适用于实际硬件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Long-Memory Reservoir Computing for Data-Scarce Dengue Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate dengue forecasting is crucial for public health planning, but remains challenging because incidence series are often short, noisy, non-stationary, nonlinear, and often affected by long-range temporal dependence. Fractional differencing in Autoregressive Fractionally Integrated Moving Average (ARFIMA) helps balance non-stationarity and persistence, but its linear structure limits its ability to capture nonlinear dynamics. Deep neural networks can model nonlinear patterns, but usually require large training samples and do not explicitly encode statistical long memory. Echo State Networks (ESNs), a widely used reservoir computing framework, are attractive in this setting because they retain nonlinear recurrent dynamics while training only a simple readout, making them suitable for data-scarce scenarios. However, standard ESNs lack long-term memory from a time-series perspective. This study proposes a long-memory reservoir computing framework that integrates dedicated long-memory and short-memory ESN reservoirs with a ridge-regression readout. We introduce two variants: Fractional ESN (fESN), which incorporates fractional-differencing dynamics into the reservoir to encode long-range dependence directly, and Wavelet ESN (wESN), which extracts stable low-frequency components through wavelet smoothing before modeling them with a memory-aware reservoir. We establish theoretical guarantees for closed-loop reservoir dynamics, showing that standard ESNs induce short-memory processes under mild conditions, whereas the proposed long-memory reservoirs generate polynomially decaying dependence consistent with statistical long memory. Across multiple dengue datasets and forecasting horizons, fESN and wESN outperform statistical and deep learning baselines. Combining conformal prediction with fESN and wESN provides distribution-free calibrated uncertainty intervals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对登革热预测中数据稀缺、序列非平稳且存在长期依赖的问题，提出了长记忆水库计算框架，包括分数阶ESN（fESN）和小波ESN（wESN），理论证明标准ESN产生短记忆而所提模型具有多项式衰减的长记忆特性，在多个登革热数据集上优于统计和深度基线，并结合保形预测提供了校准的不确定性区间。
Motivation: 登革热预测面临序列短、噪声大、非平稳、非线性及长期依赖等挑战，现有ARFIMA线性模型无法捕捉非线性，深度神经网络需大量数据且不显式建模长记忆，标准ESN缺乏长记忆能力。
Method: 提出长记忆水库计算框架，包含两个变体：fESN将分数差分动力学融入水库，wESN通过小波平滑提取低频成分并用记忆感知水库建模；使用岭回归读出层，并结合保形预测提供不确定性量化。
Result: 在多个登革热数据集和预测时域上，fESN和wESN优于统计和深度学习基线，结合保形预测可提供分布自由校准的置信区间。
Conclusion: 所提长记忆水库计算框架适合数据稀缺下具有长期依赖的非线性时间序列预测，但主要针对登革热领域，未在降水等天气变量上验证。

papers.title: Towards Predictive, Aligned, and Scalable Robot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Learning, at its core, extends beyond memorization to the ability to reason and solve novel problems by navigating a space of possibilities. We introduce Lumo-2, a latent world-action model that generates actions by reasoning over world dynamics in latent space. The learned latent world dynamics capture physically grounded visual transitions, naturally encoding future possibilities and providing a unified substrate for cross-modal alignment. This formulation enables predictive reasoning akin to world modelling while remaining lightweight and focused on physical dynamics relevant to control. Central to our approach is the hypothesis that action generation quality is governed by the geometry of the latent space. We observe that standard reconstruction-based action tokenization objectives induce representations biased toward low-level signal fidelity, leading to misalignment between reconstruction quality and downstream control performance. To address this limitation, we propose a multi-stage modality pre-alignment strategy in which action representations are progressively aligned with latent world dynamics, vision, and language. This process enforces cross-modal consistency, promotes abstraction, and induces a structured latent space for predictive reasoning. We provide a systematic empirical study of latent world modelling and modality alignment, analyzing their roles in scaling laws and out-of-distribution generalization. Results show that Lumo-2 consistently outperforms strong vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action model (WAM) baselines, with gains on challenging real-world tasks requiring temporal reasoning, physical understanding, or high control complexity, including long-horizon and dexterous manipulation. These findings suggest that structured multimodal alignment and predictive reasoning are fundamental principles for advancing embodied intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Lumo-2，一个潜在世界-动作模型，通过在潜在空间中对世界动态进行推理生成动作。核心假设是动作生成质量受潜在空间几何形状控制，并提出多阶段模态预对齐策略来改善表示。实验表明Lumo-2在需要时间推理、物理理解或高控制难度的真实世界任务上优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有基于重建的动作分词方法导致表示偏向低级信号保真度，与下游控制性能脱节。需要一种结构化潜在空间以支持预测推理和跨模态对齐。
Method: 提出Lumo-2潜在世界-动作模型，采用多阶段模态预对齐：逐步将动作表示与潜在世界动态、视觉和语言对齐，强制跨模态一致性并诱导结构化潜在空间。
Result: 在长期和灵巧操作等复杂任务上，Lumo-2一致优于视觉-语言-动作模型和世界-动作模型基线。
Conclusion: 结构化的多模态对齐和预测推理是推动具身智能的基本原则。

papers.title: Trustworthy synthetic data for campaign decision support: strategy simulation fidelity and the PolicySynth framework
papers.abstract_en: Decision support systems (DSS) increasingly run retention what-if analysis on synthetic customer populations, because privacy constraints preclude unrestricted use of real data. Such a system is trustworthy only if the synthetic data lead managers to the same decisions as the real data would; yet prevailing criteria certify distributional similarity, not decision alignment, so a synthetic population can match every marginal distribution while still steering a marketing team toward the wrong campaigns. We close this decision-alignment gap with three contributions: strategy simulation fidelity (SSF), a criterion measuring how often the synthetic population yields the same go/no-go campaign decision as the real population; PolicySynth, a DSS framework whose generator is conditioned on the production churn scorer to align decision-relevant structure; and a three-axis reporting standard of decision alignment, membership-inference resistance, and novel-record rate as the minimum deployment quality gate. On a telecommunications churn corpus and a banking acquisition corpus, PolicySynth attains a mean SSF of 0.923 and 0.960, with seed-to-seed variance roughly ten times tighter than CTGAN on telecommunications and 2.5 times on banking. This stability is the deployable property: go/no-go recommendations shift by at most 1.2 percentage points between monthly retraining cycles, against 11.5 for CTGAN, a reversed recommendation on one campaign in nine. A bootstrap baseline matches PolicySynth on SSF yet copies real records verbatim and fails membership inference, evidence that no single axis suffices. PolicySynth reliably supports directional go/no-go screening; its ROI estimates diverge from real outcomes by 70 to 78% and require the volume correction we document.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对合成数据在决策支持系统中可能导致决策偏差的问题，提出策略仿真保真度（SSF）作为衡量决策一致性的新标准，并开发了PolicySynth框架，通过条件化生成器对齐决策相关结构。在电信客户流失和银行客户获取数据集上，PolicySynth平均SSF达0.923和0.960，且跨种子方差远低于CTGAN，但其ROI估计与真实结果偏差70%-78%。
Motivation: 现有合成数据认证标准仅关注分布相似性，无法保证基于合成数据的决策与基于真实数据的决策一致，可能导致营销策略错误。
Method: 提出策略仿真保真度（SSF）度量决策一致性的标准；设计PolicySynth框架，其生成器以生产环境中的流失评分器为条件，以保留决策相关结构；并建立三轴报告标准（决策对齐、成员推断抵抗、新记录率）作为最低部署质量门槛。
Result: 在电信和银行数据集上，PolicySynth平均SSF分别为0.923和0.960，种子间方差比CTGAN低约10倍（电信）和2.5倍（银行）；月度重训练中go/no-go推荐变化不超过1.2个百分点（CTGAN为11.5），但ROI估计偏差70-78%。
Conclusion: PolicySynth能可靠支持方向性go/no-go筛选，但其ROI估计存在较大偏差，需进行体积修正；单轴标准不足，需三轴联合评估。

papers.title: Enhancing LLMs through human feedback: a journey towards self-improvement
papers.abstract_en: In the rapidly evolving landscape of information retrieval systems, the ability to adapt and improve through user feedback is paramount. This study introduces a novel methodology for refining the performance of a primary Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) system by strategically integrating an auxiliary feedback RAG system. By systematically harnessing human-generated feedback, the approach aims to enhance the accuracy, relevance, and overall quality of responses, driving the system towards self-improvement. Central to this methodology is a human-in-the-loop implementation, where user feedback is continuously collected, classified, and integrated into the inference workflow, enabling the system to learn and evolve iteratively. To validate the effectiveness of this approach, the study employs rigorous testing against three diverse benchmark datasets focused on general and custom domain knowledge, utilizing a LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation strategy. This comprehensive framework not only underscores the transformative potential of feedback-driven enhancements in RAG systems but also sets a precedent for future research in adaptive information retrieval technologies, marking a significant step in the journey towards autonomous refinement and optimization through user engagement.

papers.title: Valid $\ne$ Necessary: Diagnosing Latent Inefficiency in Chain-of-Thought
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has significantly advanced the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet it often incurs substantial computational costs due to over-reasoning: the generation of redundant, verbose, or irrelevant steps. While existing reasoning step evaluators effectively detect logical fallacies and factual errors, our analysis reveals a critical blind spot: they fail to penalize valid but inefficient reasoning steps that inflate token usage without contributing to the solution. To systematically diagnose this limitation, we introduce RIV-GSM8K, a diagnostic benchmark injected with five distinct types of inefficiencies, including circular reasoning and excessive decomposition. Diagnostic experiments reveal that state-of-the-art evaluators struggle to distinguish these inefficiencies from necessary reasoning. To address this gap, we propose CAID (Context-Aware Information Density), a training-free metric grounded in information theory that identifies low-utility steps. To validate the metric's practical utility, we apply it within PACE, a post-hoc compression strategy. Additional control experiments show that the gains of PACE are not explained by trivial pruning: compared with random step removal and PRM-based compression baselines, it preserves accuracy at substantially higher compression rates. Empirical results on GSM8K, StrategyQA, and ARC-Challenge demonstrate that PACE reduces token consumption by 31-53% while maintaining accuracy, confirming that CAID successfully distills informational froth from reasoning chains without compromising deductive validity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现链式思维提示（Chain-of-Thought）中广泛存在“有效但不必要的推理步骤”，它们增加计算开销却无助于解答。作者构建了包含五种低效类型的诊断基准RIV-GSM8K，实验表明现有评估器难以区分这些低效步骤与必要推理。为此提出基于信息论的无训练度量CAID，并基于此设计后处理压缩策略PACE，在GSM8K、StrategyQA和ARC-Challenge上减少31-53%的token消耗同时保持准确率。
Motivation: 现有推理步骤评估器只能检测逻辑错误和事实错误，但无法惩罚“有效但低效”的步骤，导致LLM在推理时产生大量冗余令牌，造成计算浪费。
Method: 提出CAID（Context-Aware Information Density），一种基于信息论的无训练度量，用于识别低效用推理步骤；并进一步提出PACE，一种后处理压缩策略，利用CAID选择性地移除低信息密度步骤。
Result: 在GSM8K、StrategyQA和ARC-Challenge上，PACE实现了31-53%的令牌节省，同时保持与原始CoT相当的准确率；控制实验表明其收益源于CAID的有效性，而非简单剪枝。
Conclusion: CAID能够有效蒸馏推理链中的信息泡沫，在不损害推理有效性的前提下显著减少计算开销。

papers.title: Bringing Back Rule Induction to Fluid Intelligence Research? An Initial Validation of the ARC-AGI Benchmark in Humans
papers.abstract_en: Two competing perspectives on fluid intelligence (gf) measures propose that performance is primarily constrained either by working memory capacity or by the ability to induce novel relations. The first perspective is currently dominant in measurement, as evident from the use of a limited set of recurring rules, whereas the second perspective is reflected in many definitions but rarely present in measurement. The ARC-AGI benchmark predominantly requires rule induction and was proposed as a measure of gf for both humans and artificial systems. However, its psychometric properties have not yet been examined in human samples. We therefore investigated the psychometric characteristics and nomological network of ARC-AGI in a first study with 100 participants. A compilation of ARC-AGI items showed good psychometric properties and correlated substantially with figural fluid intelligence as measured by a figural reasoning test (\r{ho} = .63). Associations with figural originality were weak. These findings provide initial support for the validity of ARC-AGI as a measure of human fluid intelligence. Future research should include more rule induction tasks as well as additional multivariate covariates. This study is unusual by studying a task in humans that was initially designed for machines. We suggest systematically embedding AI benchmarks into the nomological network of human cognitive abilities to enable more systematic evaluation and interdisciplinary cooperation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次在人类样本中检验ARC-AGI基准的心理测量学特性。研究100名参与者，发现ARC-AGI项目具有良好的心理测量属性，与图形流体智力（figural reasoning test）的相关为ρ=0.63，与图形原创性相关较弱。结果初步支持ARC-AGI作为人类流体智力测量的有效性，并建议将AI基准系统性地嵌入人类认知能力的整体网络。
Motivation: 当前流体智力测量主要依赖工作记忆容量视角，而规则归纳能力虽被广泛定义却鲜有测量。ARC-AGI基准侧重规则归纳，但其在人类样本中的心理测量特性尚未被检验。
Method: 招募100名参与者，施测ARC-AGI项目编译版、图形推理测验（流体智力指标）以及图形原创性测验，分析项目特性与相关网络。
Result: ARC-AGI显示良好心理测量特性；与图形流体智力相关显著（ρ=0.63），与图形原创性相关微弱。
Conclusion: ARC-AGI可作为人类流体智力的有效测量工具，未来应纳入更多规则归纳任务与多元协变量。研究呼吁将AI基准嵌入人类认知能力网络以促进跨学科评估。

papers.title: LaGuadia: Language-Guided Adaptive Distillation from Pathology Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Pathology Foundation Models (PFMs) offer powerful Whole Slide Image (WSI) representations but suffer from massive computational costs. While Knowledge Distillation (KD) can create efficient student models, existing multi-teacher methods often use suboptimal uniform weighting that ignores tissue heterogeneity. We propose LaGuadia (Language-Guided Adaptive DistillAtion), a framework that develops a compact pathology image encoder by dynamically integrating expertise from multiple PFMs under clinical linguistic guidance. Our approach utilizes a multi-stage pipeline: first, extracting visually observable clinical keywords from pathology reports; second, aligning visual features with these keywords via a Vision-Language meta-teacher (MedSigLIP) to provide dense semantic guidance; and finally, performing adaptive KD where teacher contributions are weighted based on their semantic alignment with the clinical narrative. Experiments on WSI captioning, visual question answering, and slide-level classification tasks demonstrate that an 87M parameter LaGuadia student model matches or exceeds foundation-scale models such as GigaPath and UNI, achieving strong factual consistency and robust generalization. These results highlight clinical language as an effective semantic anchor for building efficient and reliable digital pathology systems. Code is available at https://github.com/hvcl/LaGuadia.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LaGuadia框架，利用临床语言引导自适应蒸馏，从多个病理基础模型（PFMs）中蒸馏出紧凑的病理图像编码器，在WSI字幕生成、视觉问答和分类任务上达到与基础模型相当的性能。
Motivation: 病理基础模型计算成本高，现有多教师知识蒸馏方法使用均匀加权，忽略了组织异质性，导致次优性能。
Method: 提出LaGuadia，包括三步：从病理报告中提取临床关键词；通过视觉语言元教师（MedSigLIP）对齐视觉特征与关键词；基于语义对齐动态加权教师贡献进行自适应蒸馏。
Result: 87M参数的LaGuadia学生模型在WSI字幕、VQA和分类任务上匹配或超过GigaPath和UNI等基础模型，且具有强事实一致性和鲁棒泛化。
Conclusion: 临床语言可作为有效语义锚点，构建高效可靠的数字病理系统。

papers.title: A Nearable Soft Mat Based on Distributed Optical Fiber Sensing for Physiological Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Distributed optical fiber sensing (DOFS) combines the advantages of fiber optic sensors, including flexibility, small size, immunity to electromagnetic interference, and high metrological performance, with the capability to transform a single optical fiber into a continuous sensing element for spatially resolved mechanical measurements. Optical frequency domain reflectometry (OFDR), based on Rayleigh backscattering, enables high spatial resolution DOFS measurements, broadening the range of potential sensing applications. However, OFDR based DOFS remains largely unexplored for biomedical applications, despite the need for sensitive, spatially resolved, and conformable sensing interfaces. This study presents a soft DOFS based mat as a large-area interface for physiological monitoring. A single-mode optical fiber was embedded in a flexible silicone matrix and arranged in a serpentine layout to distribute sensing over the mat surface. With a gage pitch of 2.6 mm, the system provided 2250 sensing sites across the active area at a sampling frequency of 50 Hz. The mat was assessed on six healthy volunteers in a seated nearable configuration on the backrest of a standard office chair. The distributed output enabled two dimensional mapping of the mat response, reflecting back mat mechanical coupling and cardiorespiratory induced perturbations. Respiratory rate and heart rate were therefore estimated and compared with a reference wearable system. The maps revealed physiologically coherent spatial and temporal patterns, while the estimated rates showed good agreement with the reference measurements. These results demonstrate the feasibility of combining large area distributed sensing, spatial mapping, and quantitative cardiorespiratory monitoring within a DOFS based soft nearable interface.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一种基于分布式光纤传感（DOFS）的软垫，用于生理监测。该软垫将单模光纤嵌入柔性硅胶中，以蛇形布局排列，在2.6 mm间距下提供2250个传感点，采样率50 Hz。在6名健康志愿者坐在椅子上靠背时测试，能够二维映射机械耦合和心肺诱导扰动，估计呼吸率和心率，并与参考系统一致。摘要证明了在软可穿戴界面中结合大面积分布式传感、空间映射和定量心肺监测的可行性。
Motivation: 尽管OFDR基于DOFS具有高空间分辨率，但在生物医学应用中尚未充分探索，而需要灵敏、空间分辨且适形的传感接口。
Method: 采用分布式光纤传感，利用光学频域反射（OFDR）基于瑞利背散射，将单模光纤嵌入柔性硅胶中，以蛇形布局形成软垫，每2.6 mm一个测量点，共2250个传感点，采样频率50 Hz。
Result: 在6名志愿者中，通过坐姿靠背测试，分布式输出实现了垫响应的二维映射，估计的呼吸率和心率与参考可穿戴系统相比显示出良好的一致性，并揭示了生理连贯的时空模式。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，该结果证明了在基于DOFS的软可穿戴界面中结合大面积分布式传感、空间映射和定量心肺监测的可行性。

papers.title: Multi-Agent LLMs Fail to Explore Each Other
papers.abstract_en: Exploration is essential for reliable autonomy in multi-agent systems, yet it remains unclear whether large language model (LLM) agents can explore effectively when interacting with one another. We show that modern LLM agents fail to do so, often exhibiting myopic and polarized interaction patterns that lead to suboptimal coordination and increased regret. We formalize this challenge as the Multi-Agent Exploration problem, modeling it as a partially observable stochastic game (POSG) problem in which agents must probe peers to infer their capabilities and identify effective interaction strategies. To address this, we introduce Multi- Agent Contextual Exploration (MACE), a lightweight framework that explicitly promotes exploration through structured peer selection. Across both contextual and parametric diversity settings, MACE substantially improves exploration behavior and downstream task performance. We further show theoretically that the value of exploration increases with agent diversity. Overall, our results highlight a fundamental limitation of current LLM agents and underscore the importance of explicitly guided exploration for reliable multi-agent autonomy. Code will be released in https://github.com/deeplearning-wisc/mace

Motivation: 多智能体系统中可靠自主性需要有效探索，但现有LLM agent在相互交互时是否能够有效探索尚不清楚。
Method: 提出多智能体上下文探索（MACE）框架，通过结构化同伴选择机制显式鼓励探索；将问题建模为部分可观测随机博弈（POSG），并在上下文和参数多样性设置下进行验证。
Result: MACE在探索行为和下游任务性能上均有显著提升；理论证明探索的价值随智能体多样性增加而提高。
Conclusion: 当前LLM agent在多智能体探索中存在根本性局限，显式引导的探索对于可靠的多智能体自主性至关重要。

papers.title: An Empirical Study for GUI Test Migration from Android to OpenHarmony System
papers.abstract_en: To reduce the substantial engineering effort required to test the corresponding applications from Android to OpenHarmony, migrating existing GUI test cases has become a critical problem. However, current research neither proposes solutions tailored for OpenHarmony nor provides a systematic evaluation of migration approaches on this system, leaving developers with limited empirical guidance in practice. In this paper, we present the first systematic empirical study of test migration from Android to OpenHarmony. Specifically, we first construct a dataset referred to as the ATH Benchmark, comprising 36 commercial applications with an average of over 9 billion downloads, along with 108 manually designed test cases. Second, we select two state-of-the-art test migration approaches (i.e., ReSPlay and ITeM) and adapt these two approaches to enable their execution on OpenHarmony. Third, we use the preceding infrastructure to evaluate these two approaches from three perspectives, including testing performance, root causes of failures, and the impact of OpenHarmony characteristics. Our results reveal that existing test migration approaches are less effective (15% success-rate on ReSPlay and 26% success-rate on ITeM) in Android-to-OpenHarmony scenarios. Through an in-depth analysis of failed cases, we identify that test performance is primarily hindered by OpenHarmony-specific characteristics, including technical architecture differences and unique ecosystem traits. Utilizing these findings, we propose an enhanced approach based on ITeM, referred as ITeM-HM, which incorporates specific OpenHarmony system features. As a result, ITeM-HM successfully achieves a 214% success-rate relative improvement over the original ITeM (from 26% to 81%).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究从Android到OpenHarmony系统的GUI测试迁移问题。构建了包含36个商业应用和108个测试用例的ATH Benchmark，改编了两种现有迁移方法（ReSPlay和ITeM）并在OpenHarmony上评估。结果显示现有方法效果较差（成功率15%和26%），失败主要由OpenHarmony的技术架构差异和生态系统特性导致。基于此提出了改进方法ITeM-HM，将成功率从26%提升至81%。
Motivation: 将Android应用测试用例迁移到OpenHarmony需要大量工程努力，但缺乏针对OpenHarmony的迁移方法或系统评估，开发者缺乏实证指导。
Method: 构建ATH Benchmark数据集，选取并适配ReSPlay和ITeM两种现有迁移方法，评估测试性能、失败原因及OpenHarmony特性的影响，并提出基于ITeM的增强方法ITeM-HM。
Result: ReSPlay成功率15%，ITeM成功率26%；ITeM-HM相对改进214%，成功率从26%提升至81%。
Conclusion: 现有GUI测试迁移方法在Android到OpenHarmony场景下效果不佳，主要受OpenHarmony特定特性影响；结合系统特征的改进方法可显著提升迁移成功率。

papers.title: Structure-Detail Decoupled Autoregressive Generation for Fast and High-Fidelity Virtual Try-On
papers.abstract_en: Virtual try-on (VTON) is a bi-conditional image generation problem that requires not only accurate person preservation but also faithful garment deformation and detail synthesis. Diffusion-based VTON methods can jointly model these factors in a compressed latent space, but suffer from high-frequency detail loss due to inherent latent compression, even with costly multi-step denoising. Recent visual autoregressive (VAR) models offer a promising alternative for high-quality generation with faster inference, yet remain unexplored for VTON due to the lack of effective bi-conditioning mechanisms. To bridge this gap, we first introduce VAR-VTON, a VAR-based VTON model that incorporates garment conditioning and structural guidance for efficient latent-space VTON. Despite its efficacy, latent-space generation still struggles to preserve fine-grained garment details. We argue that different VTON sub-tasks should be addressed in different representation spaces: structural synthesis such as garment warping and person layout is suited to the latent space, whereas fine-grained detail recovery should be tackled in the pixel space. Motivated by this insight, we further propose STAR-VTON, a Two-Stage AutoRegressive framework that builds upon VAR-VTON by decoupling latent-space structural synthesis from pixel-space detail recovery. Our idea is to resort to a matching-informed refiner to establish dense correspondences between the stage-one generation and the source garment to directly map fine-grained pixel-space details. Extensive experiments show that STAR-VTON achieves an impressive efficiency-fidelity trade-off: VAR-VTON runs at least $4\times$ faster than diffusion-based counterparts without degrading quality, and the pixel-space refiner effectively restores fine details and acts as a plug-and-play module that can benefit existing VTON approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出STAR-VTON，一种两阶段自回归虚拟试穿框架，将潜在空间中的结构合成与像素空间中的细节恢复解耦。第一阶段VAR-VTON基于视觉自回归模型，在潜在空间中高效处理布料变形和人体布局；第二阶段利用匹配信息精炼器从源服装直接映射细节到像素空间。实验表明STAR-VTON在速度（比扩散方法快4倍以上）和质量之间取得了良好平衡，且像素空间精炼器可作为即插即用模块提升现有VTON方法。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在虚拟试穿中因潜在压缩导致高频细节丢失，且推理成本高；视觉自回归模型尚未用于虚拟试穿，缺乏有效的双条件机制。
Method: 提出两阶段自回归框架STAR-VTON：第一阶段VAR-VTON在潜在空间进行结构合成（布料变形、人物布局），第二阶段在像素空间通过匹配信息精炼器恢复细粒度细节。
Result: VAR-VTON比扩散方法快至少4倍且质量相当，像素空间精炼器有效恢复细节并可作为即插即用模块提升现有方法。
Conclusion: 解耦结构合成和细节恢复在不同表示空间是有效的，像素级细节恢复可以通过匹配对应关系从源服装直接映射实现。

papers.title: DeepBias: Adaptive In-depth Probing of Social Biases in LVLMs
papers.abstract_en: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate remarkable capabilities, they remain highly susceptible to embedded social biases. Existing bias evaluation protocols predominantly rely on static datasets, which provide only a superficial assessment, as their fixed test cases cannot adaptively evolve to measure the true depth and limits of model vulnerabilities. We introduce DeepBias, an adaptive framework for the in-depth probing of social biases in LVLMs with carefully designed agents. Our approach operates through a dynamic ''generation-evolution-probing'' loop. First, a generative ProposerAgent synthesizes test data and is iteratively updated via Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) based on the target LVLM's responses, exploring model-specific failure modes. Second, an autonomous skill-driven DiggerAgent rewrites each test data across multiple probing turns, adaptively selecting from a curated skill library of deepening and rewriting strategies. At each turn, this process is conditioned on the model's previous response, enabling progressively deeper biases to be exposed. Furthermore, we build a benchmark named DeepBiasBench using our framework. By employing an ensemble of five diverse state-of-the-art LVLMs as anchors, the benchmark captures vulnerabilities shared across architectures. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework and show that DeepBias provides a challenging benchmark for in-depth bias evaluation, establishing an evolutionary paradigm for LVLM safety assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeepBias是一个自适应框架，用于深度探测大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）中的社会偏见。它通过动态的“生成-演化-探测”循环，由ProposerAgent合成测试数据并利用DPO迭代更新，同时DiggerAgent基于技能库多轮重写测试数据，逐步暴露深层偏见。基于该框架构建的DeepBiasBench基准整合了多个先进LVLM的共享脆弱点，实验证明其有效性，建立了一种LVLM安全评估的进化范式。
Motivation: 现有偏见评估协议依赖静态数据集，只能提供表面评估，无法自适应地衡量模型偏见的真实深度和极限。
Method: 提出DeepBias框架，包含ProposerAgent（通过DPO根据目标LVLM响应迭代更新生成测试数据）和DiggerAgent（从技能库中自适应选择策略，多轮重写测试数据，每轮基于先前响应逐步暴露更深层偏见）。
Result: 综合实验表明框架有效，DeepBiasBench成为具有挑战性的深度偏见评估基准，为LVLM安全评估建立了进化范式。
Conclusion: 该工作建立了一种进化范式用于LVLM安全评估，但未在摘要中明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Heterogeneous Agent Cohorts for Safe Open-Ended Exploration with Runtime Constraint Memory
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents today are caught in an awkward bind. Lock them down with static safety instructions and they rarely venture beyond the obvious; give them free reign with tools and multi-agent debate, and safety violations quickly follow. Rather than forcing a single model to juggle both creativity and caution, we separate the concerns across specialized roles. A Disrupter generates unconventional proposals, a Validator enforces hard runtime checks at the tool gateway, and a Broker pulls in distant but relevant analogies. Failures are not discarded -- they are compiled, via MCTS, into compact, signed constraint patches we call Scars. These patches are cached locally and inherited by future cohorts, turning repeated failures into reusable, low-cost runtime constraints. In a spatial-semantic sandbox (N=20 runs, p<0.01), our cohort reaches remote targets where debate fails, the Validator prevents all executed breaches, and Scars reduce token consumption by 15.1% by avoiding redundant validator checks. Furthermore, credit-based Communication Allocation Scores (CAS) restrict outbound bandwidth, reducing overall token costs by 55.9% under resource constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种异构智能体群体（Heterogeneous Agent Cohorts）方法，通过角色分离（Disrupter、Validator、Broker）和运行时约束记忆（Scars）来平衡LLM agent在开放探索中的安全性与创造力。实验在空间语义沙箱中验证，群体能到达远程目标，Validator阻止所有执行违规，Scars减少15.1% token消耗，CAS机制在资源约束下降低55.9% token成本。
Motivation: 现有LLM agent在静态安全指令下探索有限，而完全自由则导致安全违规；单一模型难以兼顾创造性与谨慎性。
Method: 引入三个专用角色：Disrupter生成非常规提议，Validator在工具网关执行硬运行时检查，Broker拉取远程类比。失败经历通过MCTS编译为紧凑签名约束补丁（Scars），本地缓存并由后续群体继承。
Result: 在N=20次运行中（p<0.01），群体到达远程目标，Validator阻止所有执行违规；Scars减少冗余检查，降低15.1% token消耗；CAS机制限制出站带宽，在资源约束下降低55.9% token成本。
Conclusion: 通过角色分离和运行时约束记忆，可以在开放探索中有效平衡安全性与创造性，并降低计算成本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HandFlow: Fully Generative 4D Hand Recovery with Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Accurate monocular 4D hand reconstruction remains challenging. Per-frame discriminative regressors lack temporal context and often produce jittery predictions. Temporal models improve consistency by aggregating information across frames, but they are typically deterministic regressors, making them vulnerable to ambiguous observations caused by occlusion and motion blur. Generative modeling offers a natural alternative by learning a prior over plausible hand motion sequences, enabling coherent hand-state recovery when visual evidence is incomplete or unreliable. Motivated by this observation, we present HandFlow, a fully generative flow-matching framework for temporally coherent 3D hand pose and shape estimation from monocular video. Given visual and skeletal observations, HandFlow denoises an entire temporal window of MANO parameters through a single ODE integration. To support this, we use a Flux-style dual-stream transformer that attends across the full sequence to capture long-range dependencies without autoregressive decoding, and a confidence-aware continuous masking mechanism that blends observed features with learnable mask tokens to handle noisy or missing observations. Experiments on DexYCB and HOT3D show that HandFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance, with particularly large gains in world-space accuracy and temporal smoothness. It reduces world-space pose error by over 30% compared with the strongest baseline and achieves the lowest acceleration error among all evaluated methods, while remaining competitive in per-frame pose accuracy. Moreover, on a single GPU HandFlow reconstructs a 150-frame sequence at 47 fps, about 12x faster than the fastest prior video-based method, with reconstruction itself accounting for only a small fraction of the end-to-end latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HandFlow是一个完全生成式的流匹配（flow matching）框架，用于从单目视频中恢复时间一致的三维手部姿态和形状。它通过单个ODE积分去噪整个时间窗口的MANO参数，采用Flux风格的双流Transformer捕获长程依赖，并设计了置信度感知的连续掩码机制处理遮挡和运动模糊。实验表明，该方法在DexYCB和HOT3D上达到最先进性能，尤其在世界空间精度和时序平滑性上大幅提升，同时实现了47fps的高效推理。
Motivation: 现有单目4D手部重建方法主要有两类：逐帧判别式回归器缺乏时间上下文导致抖动，以及时间确定性回归器易受遮挡和运动模糊影响。生成式建模通过学习手部运动序列的先验，能够在视觉证据不完整时恢复一致的姿态，但此前缺乏高效的全生成式框架。
Method: 提出HandFlow，一个基于流匹配的全生成式框架。给定视觉和骨骼观测，它通过单一ODE积分去噪整个时间窗口的MANO参数。核心组件包括：Flux风格的双流Transformer，在完整序列上处理长程依赖（无需自回归解码），以及置信度感知的连续掩码机制，混合观测特征与可学习掩码令牌以处理噪声或缺失观测。
Result: 在DexYCB和HOT3D数据集上，HandFlow相比最强基线在世界空间姿态误差上降低超过30%，且在所有评估方法中取得最低的加速度误差，同时保持有竞争力的逐帧姿态精度。单GPU上处理150帧序列的速度为47fps，比先前最快的视频方法快约12倍，且重建延迟仅占端到端延迟的一小部分。
Conclusion: HandFlow通过全生成式流匹配在时序手部重建中实现了显著的世界空间精度和运动平滑性改进，且推理速度远超之前的方法。该工作表明生成式建模在应对遮挡和运动模糊等不确定视觉观察时具有优势。

papers.title: Typhoon intensity ReAnalysis (TyRA)
papers.abstract_en: Best-track data have been typically used to explore long-term changes in typhoon intensity over the western North Pacific (WNP). However, the methods used to construct best-track intensities have changed over the past several decades. Several attempts have been made to achieve homogeneous intensity analyses based on the Dvorak method, but their consistency with direct observations can still be improved. This study tries to accurately explain minimum sea-level pressure (MSLP) from aircraft observations during 1981-1986 using CI numbers and other parameters as in Aizawa et al. (2024). Using the optimized coefficients, we reanalyzed MSLP for 1987-2024. The reanalyzed MSLPs were converted into maximum wind speeds using Knaff and Zehr (2007). This Typhoon intensity ReAnalysis (TyRA) exhibited a slightly decreasing trend in the number of intense typhoons, which was not statistically significant. Compared with TyRA, the Joint Typhoon Warning Center (JTWC) best-track contained a larger number of intense typhoons from the late 1980s to the mid-2000s, whereas the Regional Specialized Meteorological Center (RSMC) Tokyo best-track contained a smaller number. In TyRA, typhoons recently weakened over the eastern part of the WNP with some statistical significance. It can be explained by the decrease of mean age of typhoons after typhoon genesis. Large differences among the RSMC Tokyo and JTWC best-track data and TyRA were found for rapid intensification. Furthermore, although previous studies reported that errors in intensity forecasts by the RSMC Tokyo increased in the mid-2000s, the changes in the quality of the RSMC Tokyo best-track data partly explain this.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出台风强度再分析（TyRA），利用1981-1986年飞机观测数据优化Dvorak方法系数，再分析1987-2024年西北太平洋台风最小海平面气压（MSLP）并转换为最大风速。结果显示强台风数量略降但不显著，东部分区台风近期显著减弱，与台风平均年龄下降有关；不同最佳路径数据在快速增强事件上存在较大差异。
Motivation: 最佳路径数据集构建方法随时间变化导致非均一性，需实现与直接观测一致的强度分析，以准确研究台风长期变化。
Method: 基于Aizawa et al. (2024)方法，利用1981-1986年飞机观测数据优化CI数等参数与MSLP的关系，用优化系数再分析1987-2024年MSLP，再通过Knaff and Zehr (2007)转换为最大风速。
Result: TyRA中强台风数量略降但不显著；JTWC最佳路径在1980s末至2000s中期有更多强台风，RSMC Tokyo则较少；TyRA中东部分区台风近期显著减弱，与台风平均年龄下降有关；快速增强事件在数据间差异大；RSMC Tokyo预报误差增加部分可由最佳路径数据质量变化解释。
Conclusion: 强调均一化强度再分析对理解长期变化的重要性，并指出不同数据集间差异对趋势和预报误差评估的影响。

papers.title: A Novel Method to Evaluate Models on Unreliable, Noisy and Inconsistent Labels: Adaptive Resolution Label Aggregation (ARLA)
papers.abstract_en: Labels are critical for both training and evaluating deep learning segmentation models, but are often inconsistent, noisy, or ambiguous at class boundaries. Many approaches have been developed to support training models on weak labels, but few to none currently exist to facilitate evaluating models on unreliable labels. We therefore introduce a method called "Adaptive Resolution Label Aggregation", or "ARLA", which dynamically adapts the resolution of both the label and the model prediction at inference time before the evaluation metrics are computed. We demonstrate how ARLA can be used to better analyse model behaviour with a practical application to a real flood prediction model, where ARLA was able to overcome issues with inconsistent labelling of forested areas and errors in labels within regions of heavy cloud cover. Our work presents a new approach to evaluating segmentation models, with adjustable parameters to adapt the aggregated resolution to the precision of the label or the level of label noise. Fundamentally, ARLA exploits the information encapsulated by a label but minimises the label error, extracting from the noise a clearer signal of a model's true performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应分辨率标签聚合（ARLA）方法，在评估分割模型时动态调整标签和预测的分辨率，以减少标签噪声和不一致的影响。在真实洪水预测模型上，ARLA克服了森林区域标记不一致和云层覆盖区域标签错误等问题，提取出模型真实性能的更清晰信号。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注在弱标签下训练模型，但缺乏在不可靠标签下评估模型的方法，而真实世界的标签常存在噪声和不一致性。
Method: ARLA在推理时动态调整标签和模型预测的分辨率，通过可调参数适应标签的精度或噪声水平，在计算评估指标前进行聚合。
Result: 在洪水预测模型上，ARLA克服了森林区域标签不一致和云层覆盖区域标签错误的问题，更准确地反映模型真实性能。
Conclusion: ARLA提供了一种评估分割模型的新方法，通过从噪声中提取清晰信号，适用于标签质量不确定的场景。

papers.title: PREF-Gate: Provenance-Constrained Relational Evidence Fusion with Validation-Gated Selection for Graph Fraud Detection
papers.abstract_en: Relational fraud detection can exploit both label-free graph context and label-derived neighborhood evidence, but these two information sources obey different validity conditions. In particular, neighborhood risk becomes invalid when a queried node's own label, or any validation or test label, enters its construction. We formulate this issue as provenance-constrained relational evidence use and present PREF-Gate, an auditable decision framework with two fixed experts and a finite validation gate. The context expert uses attributes, one-hop means, feature residuals, and degree descriptors without labels. The evidence expert adds self-excluded, training-label-only neighborhood risk and empirical-Bayes summaries that expose support, uncertainty, availability, and shrinkage. Before test inference, the gate selects either expert or one of three pre-specified probability mixtures and fixes the decision threshold. On Amazon, YelpChi, and TFinance, using five identical stratified splits and 14 same-protocol methods, PREF-Gate obtains mean AUPRC values of 0.9085, 0.8104, and 0.8913. It selects the label-free expert on all Amazon and YelpChi splits and an evidence mixture on all TFinance splits. Thus, the main result is conditional rather than universal: label-derived relational evidence is useful only where held-out validation supports it. The framework couples competitive ranking performance with an explicit label-provenance contract, finite selection policy, failure accounting, and review-budget evaluation, providing an auditable knowledge-based decision pipeline for graph fraud detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对欺诈检测中标签相关证据的合法性约束问题，提出了PREF-Gate框架，包含两个固定专家（上下文专家和证据专家）和一个有限验证门。上下文专家仅使用无标签特征，证据专家加入基于训练标签的邻域风险和贝叶斯摘要。在Amazon、YelpChi和TFinance数据集上，PREF-Gate获得了0.9085、0.8104和0.8913的平均AUPRC，并展现了证据选择的条件性：仅当验证支持时才使用标签证据。
Motivation: 关系欺诈检测中，无标签图上下文和标签衍生的邻域证据具有不同的有效性条件，特别是当查询节点的自身标签或验证/测试标签进入构建时，邻域风险会失效。现有方法缺乏对证据来源的显式约束和审计机制。
Method: 提出PREF-Gate框架，包括两个固定专家：上下文专家（使用属性、一跳均值、特征残差和度数描述符，无标签）和证据专家（添加自排除、训练标签仅的邻域风险和贝叶斯摘要，支持不确定性和收缩）。一个有限验证门在测试推理前选择专家或三种预定义概率混合，并固定决策阈值。
Result: 在Amazon、YelpChi和TFinance数据集上，使用五份相同的分层分割和14种相同协议的方法，PREF-Gate的平均AUPRC分别为0.9085、0.8104和0.8913。门控选择在Amazon和YelpChi上均选无标签专家，在TFinance上选证据混合。
Conclusion: 标签衍生的关系证据并非普遍有用，仅当验证支持时才有价值。框架提供了竞争性的排序性能，同时具备明确的标签来源合约、有限选择策略、失败核算和审核预算评估，构成可审计的基于知识的决策管道。

papers.title: FastTPS: An Optimized Method for LLM Token Phase for AI accelerators
papers.abstract_en: The popularity of large language models (LLMs) escalates an ongoing demand for effective inference. However, due to the sequential processing of tokens during the token phase in decoder-only LLMs inference, the inherent low parallelism leads to reduced throughput and suboptimal utilization of the computing units on artificial intelligence (AI) accelerators, particularly when handling long-sequence inputs that impose significant memory overhead. Recently, many reported methods have been developed as potential solutions, since they emerge with numeric deviation. This paper presents FastTPS, a high performance and low-precision loss method for accelerating the token-phase in LLM inference on general AI accelerators which includes three key components: (1) AI accelerator-enabled reloading-free KV Cache concatenation which decreases memory access overhead as well as enables full fusion of Attention, (2) high-efficiency and high-accuracy 'RoPE' attention based on the tiling optimized FLAT, and (3) highly-fused MLP with fine-grain pipeline scheduling. Our results confirm that FastTPS significantly alleviates memory bottlenecks in the token phase, delivering a 6x speed improvement (compared to none-fusion) on an AMD Ryzen AI 300 series NPU with BF16 precision while sustaining 93% peak memory bandwidth utilization during Phi3-mini-4k-instruct inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FastTPS，一种针对AI加速器上LLM推理token阶段的高性能、低精度损失方法，包含三个关键组件：重加载免加载的KV缓存拼接、基于分块优化FLAT的高效高精度RoPE注意力、以及细粒度流水线调度的MLP融合。在AMD Ryzen AI 300系列NPU上使用BF16精度推理Phi3-mini-4k-instruct时，相比无融合实现达到6倍加速并维持93%峰值内存带宽利用率。
Motivation: LLM推理中token阶段因顺序处理导致低并行度和内存瓶颈，尤其在长序列输入时，降低吞吐量和计算单元利用率。
Method: 提出三个组件：1) AI加速器支持的免重加载KV缓存拼接，减少内存访问开销并实现注意力全融合；2) 基于分块优化FLAT的高效高精度RoPE注意力；3) 高度融合的MLP与细粒度流水线调度。
Result: 在AMD Ryzen AI 300系列NPU上，BF16精度推理Phi3-mini-4k-instruct时，相比无融合实现获得6倍加速，并达到93%峰值内存带宽利用率。
Conclusion: FastTPS有效缓解了token阶段的内存瓶颈，提升了LLM推理性能，且保持了低精度损失。

papers.title: ProgramTab: Boosting Table Reasoning of LLMs via Programmatic Paradigm
papers.abstract_en: Table-based reasoning with large language models (LLMs), which requires reasoning based on natural language questions and structured tabular data, has gained widespread attention. However, a series of issues still constrain the application of this task. The previous approaches suffered from significant performance degradation when faced with large tables due to the difficulty of long text modeling and the limitation of input length for LLMs. The text-to-SQL approach is used to efficiently extract key information from tables and generate smaller sub-tables. However, tabular data, especially web tables, often lack the necessary structure and consistency, making them unsuitable for performing mathematical logic operations using SQL queries. We propose the ProgramTab framework, which guides LLMs employing in-context learning to perform tabular data preprocessing with Python code, as well as the momentous contents extraction with row and column extraction and SQL generation. The experiment results on table reasoning datasets demonstrate that the ProgramTab framework effectively deals with table-based reasoning tasks and outperforms all LLM-based baselines.
papers.comment: Large Language Models, Table Reasoning, In-context Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型在表格推理任务中面临的大表格长文本建模困难、输入长度受限以及Web表格结构不一致等问题，提出ProgramTab框架。该框架通过上下文学习引导LLM使用Python代码进行表格数据预处理，并结合行列提取与SQL生成进行关键内容抽取。在表格推理数据集上的实验表明，ProgramTab优于所有基于LLM的基线方法。
Motivation: 现有方法在处理大表格时因长文本建模困难和输入长度限制性能显著下降；Text-to-SQL方法虽能提取子表，但Web表格缺乏结构一致性，不适合SQL进行数学逻辑运算。
Method: 提出ProgramTab框架，利用上下文学习（in-context learning）引导LLM以Python代码进行表格预处理，并整合行列提取与SQL生成来抽取重要内容。
Result: 在多个表格推理数据集上，ProgramTab有效处理表格推理任务，并超越所有基于LLM的基线方法。
Conclusion: ProgramTab通过程序化范式（Python预处理+行列/SQL提取）提升了LLM在表格推理上的性能，尤其适用于大表格和非结构化Web表格。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Parallax Portrait Matting
papers.abstract_en: Image matting is highly ill-posed, especially when both the foreground and background are richly textured. While single-image matting methods learn strong priors from data, they often struggle on these challenging cases. Existing approaches improve results by requiring additional signals such as green screens, polarized lighting, or clean background images, but these typically rely on specialized capture setups. We present Parallax Portrait Matting, a practical two-frame matting method that uses a second image captured with slight viewpoint change. Such a setting arises naturally in burst photography, where small camera motion induces foreground-background parallax and provides complementary observations for matting. Our pipeline estimates trimaps and foreground/background motion, then constructs aligned views for prediction. To handle imperfect motion estimation, the network uses the background-aligned pair for direct fusion and the foreground-aligned cue through cross-attention for error compensation. Experiments show that our method recovers finer details and more accurate foreground colors than strong single-image matting baselines on challenging portrait cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于两帧图像的视差人像抠图方法，利用轻微视角变化产生的视差来改善抠图效果。该方法估计三元图和前景/背景运动，然后构建对齐视图进行预测，并通过交叉注意力补偿运动估计误差。实验表明，在复杂人像场景中，该方法比强单图像抠图基线恢复了更精细的细节和更准确的前景颜色。
Motivation: 单图像抠图在前景和背景纹理丰富时高度不适定，现有方法需要绿幕、偏振光或干净背景等额外信号，依赖专用采集设备。本文旨在利用自然存在的视差（如连拍中的微小相机运动）提供互补观测，无需特殊设备。
Method: 提出两帧视差抠图流水线：首先估计三元图和前景/背景运动，然后构建背景对齐和前景对齐视图；网络通过直接融合背景对齐对，并利用交叉注意力从前景对齐线索中补偿运动估计误差。
Result: 在挑战性人像案例上，该方法相比强单图像抠图基线恢复了更精细的细节和更准确的前景颜色。
Conclusion: 利用连拍中的小视角变化可以改善人像抠图效果，无需额外硬件支持，为移动设备等应用提供了实用方案。

papers.title: DynEval: Holistic Evaluations of T2I Generative Models in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in text-to-image (T2I) generation have led to models capable of producing highly realistic images. Yet, reliably evaluating their outputs remains challenging, especially at scale. Existing automatic evaluators, often relying on a static prompt set, struggle to capture subtle failure modes such as partial prompt misalignment, compositional errors, or visually plausible but semantically incorrect generations. In this work, we introduce DynEval, a Dynamic Evaluation framework designed to jointly assess text-to-image alignment and image quality of T2I models. To support scalable training beyond limited human-annotated data, we construct two large datasets. First, we build GenDB, a collection of 500K prompt-image pairs generated from human-written prompts drawn from DiffusionDB using a tiered prompt-model generation strategy. Second, building upon GenDB, we construct DynEvalInstruct, a 250K instruction dataset comprising prompt-image-response triplets distilled from a structured evaluation pipeline that decomposes evaluation into text-image alignment and visual quality reasoning. Using this dataset, we perform full fine-tuning of a compact evaluator through a curriculum learning strategy to effectively distill the superior evaluation capabilities of a larger teacher vision-language model, resulting in DynEval-2B and DynEval-4B. In extensive comparisons against existing evaluators across 11 benchmarks, our evaluator achieves a higher overall correlation with human judgments. Furthermore, it provides fine-grained analysis of the capabilities and failure modes of 36 T2I models across 42 subcategories and 9 semantic dimensions.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Project page: https://vcl-iisc.github.io/dyneval/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DynEval，一种动态评估框架，用于联合评估文本到图像（T2I）生成模型的对齐质量和图像质量。通过构建500K对的GenDB数据集和250K指令的DynEvalInstruct数据集，并采用课程学习对紧凑评估器（DynEval-2B/4B）进行微调，蒸馏大教师模型的评估能力。在11个基准上，DynEval与人类判断的相关性高于现有评估器，并对36个T2I模型在42个子类别和9个语义维度上进行细粒度分析。
Motivation: 现有自动评估器依赖静态提示集，难以捕捉部分提示不对齐、组合错误或视觉合理但语义错误的生成。
Method: 构建GenDB数据集（从DiffusionDB中人类提示出发，采用分层提示-模型生成策略得到50万对）；基于GenDB构建DynEvalInstruct数据集（包含25万提示-图像-响应对，从结构化评估管道中蒸馏得到）；通过课程学习对紧凑评估器进行全微调，蒸馏大教师模型的能力。
Result: 在11个基准上，DynEval与人类判断的整体相关性更高，并提供了对36个T2I模型在42个子类别和9个语义维度上的细粒度分析。
Conclusion: DynEval通过动态提示和细粒度分析改进了T2I模型评估的可靠性和可解释性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: What We Talk About When We Talk About LLM Planning: Evidence for Two Distinct Planning Abilities
papers.abstract_en: When LLMs exhibit uneven performance across planning tasks, these gaps are often attributed to task difficulty. We argue that this explanation is incomplete, as task-level variation may reflect distinct latent planning competencies rather than differences along a single ability spectrum. We study this question on ACPBench-Hard by evaluating multiple LLM families under varying test-time reasoning budgets and applying a multidimensional item response theory model to uncover the latent competency structure underlying LLM planning. The analysis reveals two principal dimensions that shape planning performance: operational reasoning, the ability to evaluate local action applicability and immediate state transitions, and structural enumeration, the ability to reason about goal reachability and landmark structure. Operational reasoning improving under model scaling and longer reasoning traces, while structural enumeration remains comparatively insensitive. Our findings motivate competency-level evaluation of LLM planning, shifting the focus from whether models improve overall to which planning competencies improve, under what conditions, and why.
papers.comment: 19 pages. Keywords: Reasoning, Automated Planning, Item Responses Theory, LLMs as Planner Research Area: NLP and Symbolic Reasoning Research Area Keywords: neurosymbolic, planning in agents, symbolic reasoning Contribution Types: Model analysis & interpretability
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM在规划任务上的性能差异，提出存在两种不同的潜在规划能力：操作推理（operational reasoning）和结构枚举（structural enumeration）。通过多维项目反应理论模型分析ACPBench-Hard上的多个LLM家族，发现操作推理随模型规模和推理链增长而改善，而结构枚举相对不敏感。
Motivation: 现有研究将LLM规划性能差异归因于任务难度，但本文认为这种解释不完整，因为任务层面差异可能反映不同的潜在规划能力而非单一能力谱系。
Method: 使用多维项目反应理论模型分析多个LLM家族在ACPBench-Hard上的表现，并变化测试时推理预算。
Result: 揭示了两个主要维度：操作推理（评估局部动作适用性和即时状态转换）和结构枚举（推理目标可达性和地标结构）。操作推理随模型规模扩大和推理链增长而改善，结构枚举相对不敏感。
Conclusion: 主张对LLM规划进行能力级别的评估，将关注点从模型整体是否改进转移到哪些规划能力改进、在什么条件下以及为什么。

papers.title: Slot-RAE: Streamlining Object-Centric Learning via Direct Representation Auto-Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Deploying object-centric models for real-world scene understanding typically requires complex pipelines to achieve both robust scene decomposition and high-fidelity generation. Recent diffusion-based approaches have improved visual quality, but they almost universally rely on heavy, pretrained generative priors (e.g., Stable Diffusion) and external VAE latent spaces. In this paper, we propose Slot-RAE, a much simpler, fully integrated framework that operates directly within the continuous semantic feature space of visual foundation models (e.g., DINOv3). Slot-RAE employs a feature-space diffusion process using a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) decoder and a Representation Alignment (REPA) head. Unlike existing diffusion-based objectcentric methods that rely heavily on subsidized text-toimage priors, the generative core of Slot-RAE (Slot Attention and the DiT) is trained from scratch within the frozen VFM feature space. This eliminates the need for VAE bottlenecks and task-agnostic generative pre-training. Experiments on the COCO dataset demonstrate that despite its architectural simplicity, Slot-RAE achieves state-of-the-art results. It delivers comparable unsupervised object discovery, higher-fidelity image reconstruction, and robust zero-shot compositionality, all while being significantly faster and more computationally efficient than existing object-centric latent diffusion models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Slot-RAE，一个简化的目标中心学习框架，直接在视觉基础模型（如 DINOv3）的连续语义特征空间中进行操作，无需 VAE 瓶颈或预训练生成先验。它使用扩散 Transformer 解码器和表示对齐头，训练自始至终在冻结的 VFM 特征空间内完成。在 COCO 数据集上，Slot-RAE 在无监督对象发现、高质量图像重建和零样本组合性方面达到最新水平，同时比现有目标中心潜扩散模型更快、更高效。
Motivation: 现有目标中心模型通常需要复杂的流水线（如预训练的扩散先验和外部 VAE 潜空间）才能同时实现鲁棒的场景分解和高保真生成，导致计算开销大。本文旨在简化这一流程。
Method: 提出 Slot-RAE，使用 Slot Attention 进行对象发现，然后在DINOv3特征空间内通过扩散 Transformer 解码器进行特征空间扩散，并利用表示对齐头进行训练。整个生成核心从头训练，无需依赖文本到图像的先验或 VAE。
Result: 在 COCO 数据集上，Slot-RAE 取得了与现有方法相当的无监督对象发现性能，更优的图像重建质量，以及鲁棒的零样本组合能力，同时训练和推理速度显著更快，计算成本更低。
Conclusion: Slot-RAE 证明了在冻结的视觉基础模型特征空间中直接训练目标中心生成模型是可行的，能够简化流水线并提升效率，为未来无需复杂预训练先验的场景理解提供了新方向。

papers.title: RepTran: Search-Based Repair of Transformer Models
papers.abstract_en: To ensure the overall quality of AI-enabled software, not only traditional software components but also AI components need to be tested and repaired. Among AI components, Transformer models are increasingly integrated into software systems, which makes their misbehaviors critical. Although prior work in the software engineering community has proposed deep neural network (DNN) repair methods, most overlook Transformer-specific structures. We propose RepTran, a search-based repair method for Transformer models. It targets their feed-forward networks (FFNs), which play a central role in the architecture. RepTran identifies suspicious weights by combining two types of scores: a variance-based neuron score and an existing bidirectional score. It then iteratively optimizes these weights using differential evolution. Our evaluation includes 18 fault benchmarks constructed from CIFAR-100 and Tiny-ImageNet. We compare RepTran against three baselines: random weight selection, Arachne (a state-of-the-art DNN repair method), and ArachneW, which enables Arachne to control the number of selected weights. RepTran achieved an average repair rate of 74.7%, statistically outperforming random selection and Arachne across all benchmarks. Effect size analysis revealed that RepTran achieved higher repair rates than ArachneW regardless of the number of selected weights. These results suggest that RepTran is effective for enhancing the reliability of AI-enabled software.
papers.comment: 12 pages. Accepted to the Research Track of ISSRE 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RepTran，一种基于搜索的 Transformer 模型修复方法，针对其前馈网络（FFN）进行权重修复。通过结合方差-based 神经元分数和现有双向分数识别可疑权重，并使用差分进化迭代优化。在 CIFAR-100 和 Tiny-ImageNet 构建的 18 个故障基准上，RepTran 平均修复率达 74.7%，优于随机选择和 Arachne 等基线。
Motivation: 现有 DNN 修复方法大多忽视 Transformer 特有结构，而 Transformer 在 AI 软件中日益重要，需要专门的修复方法。
Method: 提出 RepTran，针对 Transformer 的 FFN 层，结合方差-based 神经元分数和双向分数识别可疑权重，然后使用差分进化进行权重的迭代优化。
Result: 在 18 个故障基准上，RepTran 平均修复率 74.7%，统计上显著优于随机选择和 Arachne；与 ArachneW 相比，无论选择多少权重，RepTran 修复率都更高。
Conclusion: RepTran 可有效提高 AI 软件中 Transformer 模型的可靠性。
Relevance: 0
