papers.title: Learning in Blocks: A Multi Agent Debate Assisted Personalized Adaptive Learning Framework for Language Learning
papers.abstract_en: Most digital language learning curricula rely on discrete-item quizzes that test recall rather than applied conversational proficiency. When progression is driven by quiz performance, learners can advance despite persistent gaps in using grammar and vocabulary during interaction. Recent work on LLM-based judging suggests a path toward scoring open-ended conversations, but using interaction evidence to drive progression and review requires scoring protocols that are reliable and validated. We introduce Learning in Blocks, a framework that grounds progression in demonstrated conversational competence evaluated using CEFR-aligned rubrics. The framework employs heterogeneous multi-agent debate (HeteroMAD) in two stages: a scoring stage where role-specialized agents independently evaluate Grammar, Vocabulary, and Interactive Communication, engage in debate to address conflicting judgments, and a judge synthesizes consensus scores; and a recommendation stage that identifies specific grammar skills and vocabulary topics for targeted review. Progression requires demonstrating 70% mastery, and spaced review targets identified weaknesses to counter skill decay. We benchmark four scoring and recommendation methods on CEFR A2 conversations annotated by ESL experts. HeteroMAD achieves a superior score agreement with a 0.23 degree of variation and recommendation acceptability of 90.91%. An 8-week study with 180 CEFR A2 learners demonstrates that combining rubric-aligned scoring and recommendation with spaced review and mastery-based progression produces better learning outcomes than feedback alone.

TL;DR: 本文提出“Learning in Blocks”框架，针对数字语言学习课程中基于离散测验的推进方式无法评估实际对话能力的问题。该框架使用基于CEFR标准的多智能体辩论（HeteroMAD）两阶段流程：评分阶段由角色特化智能体分别评估语法、词汇和互动交流，通过辩论达成一致评分；推荐阶段确定需要针对性复习的语法和词汇。要求掌握70%才能推进，并采用间隔复习对抗技能衰退。在CEFR A2对话上的基准测试中，HeteroMAD的评分变异度0.23，推荐可接受度90.91%。一项180名CEFR A2学习者的8周研究表明，结合标准评分和推荐、间隔复习和基于掌握度的推进，相比仅反馈产生了更好的学习效果。
Motivation: 现有数字语言学习课程依赖离散项目测验，测试的是记忆而非实际会话能力，导致学习者可能带着语法和词汇应用的漏洞前进。需要基于互动证据的可靠评分协议来驱动推进和复习。
Method: 提出HeteroMAD框架，分为两阶段：评分阶段，角色特化智能体独立评估语法、词汇和互动交流，通过辩论解决判断冲突，由法官综合共识分数；推荐阶段识别特定语法技能和词汇主题进行针对性复习。使用CEFR标准评分规则。
Result: 在CEFR A2对话上，HeteroMAD取得0.23的评分变异度和90.91%的推荐可接受度。8周研究（180名A2学习者）显示该框架相比仅反馈产生更好学习效果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将基于标准的评分和推荐与间隔复习及基于掌握度的推进相结合，能显著提升学习效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Sensing Varies with Contexts: Context Probing for Tactile Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) aims to recognize novel classes from only a few labeled samples while retaining previously learned knowledge. Although recent FSCIL methods have achieved substantial progress on visual benchmarks, they remain limited in tactile sensing, where the same material may produce markedly different observations under different acquisition contexts, such as sensing devices, contact states, scanning trajectories, and interaction conditions. In tactile FSCIL, the challenges of few-shot learning and class-incremental learning are further amplified by acquisition context: the limited support samples may not only be scarce, but also carry context-induced biases. Once the resulting biased prototypes are inserted into the classifier, they may affect the decision boundaries in subsequent sessions. To address this problem, we propose Context-Probing Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (CoP-FSCIL), a context-aware framework for tactile FSCIL. CoP-FSCIL first employs Context-Probing Intervention (CPI) to diagnose local context-sensitive variations in tactile representations. It then introduces a Probe-Conditioned Quotient Adapter (PCQA) to suppress context-sensitive components identified by the probes. Finally, Probe-Stability Prototype Calibration (PSPC) estimates support sample reliability from probe-induced embedding fluctuations and calibrates stochastic prototypes accordingly. Experiments on HapTex and LMT108 show that CoP-FSCIL consistently outperforms representative FSCIL baselines, and extended experiments on audio FSCIL further demonstrate the generality of the proposed context probing mechanism. The source code is currently being prepared and will be released soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对触觉少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中同一材料因采集上下文（如传感器、接触状态等）不同导致观测差异的问题，提出上下文探测框架CoP-FSCIL。该框架通过上下文探测干预（CPI）诊断表示中的局部上下文敏感变化，利用探测条件商适配器（PCQA）抑制这些敏感成分，并通过探测稳定性原型校准（PSPC）估计样本可靠性并校准原型。在HapTex和LMT108数据集上，CoP-FSCIL优于代表性基线，并在音频FSCIL实验中验证了泛化性。
Motivation: 触觉FSCIL中，支持样本不仅数量稀缺，还因采集上下文携带偏差，导致分类器原型有偏，影响后续会话的决策边界。现有视觉FSCIL方法未考虑触觉中上下文引起的观测差异。
Method: 提出CoP-FSCIL框架，包含三个组件：（1）Context-Probing Intervention (CPI) 诊断局部上下文敏感变化；（2）Probe-Conditioned Quotient Adapter (PCQA) 抑制上下文敏感成分；（3）Probe-Stability Prototype Calibration (PSPC) 根据探针引起的嵌入波动估计样本可靠性并校准随机原型。
Result: 在HapTex和LMT108数据集上，CoP-FSCIL一致优于代表性FSCIL基线；扩展实验在音频FSCIL上展示了上下文探测机制的泛化性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调CoP-FSCIL有效解决了触觉FSCIL中上下文引起的偏差问题，并具有跨模态泛化潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Where Experts Disagree, Models Fail: Detecting Implicit Legal Citations in French Court Decisions
papers.abstract_en: Applying computational methods to law at scale requires separating genuine legal reasoning from surface similarity. We study this through a concrete task: detecting implicit citations of the French Civil Code, where a court applies a statutory rule without naming it: a post-hoc question about the reasoning a court actually used. We release a benchmark of 1,015 passage-article pairs annotated by three legal experts. Our central finding is that their disagreement is itself informative: the third of cases the experts dispute are where models fail. Our best ensemble reaches an F1 score of 0.70 overall. Yet, two-thirds of its false positives fall on those disputed cases, a concentration that holds across all ten models we evaluate. Disagreement is a signal of intrinsic difficulty, not annotation noise. This should not block useful tools, however: reframed as top-$k$ ranking with multi-model consensus, the same signals reach 76% precision for the top-200 candidates without supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何在法国法院判决中检测隐性引用《法国民法典》条文的情况（即法院适用法律但未明确提及条文）。作者构建了一个由三位法律专家标注的1,015条文段-条文对基准，发现专家之间的分歧本身具有信息性：在专家有争议的三分之一案例中，模型表现最差。最佳集成模型达到整体F1 0.70，但其三分之二的假阳性集中在这些有争议的案例上，该现象在十个模型中一致。专家分歧是内在难度的信号，而非标注噪声。将任务重新定义为基于多模型共识的top-k排序后，无需监督即可达到前200候选76%的精度。
Motivation: 大规模法律文本计算需要区分真正的法律推理与表面相似性，而隐性法律引用检测作为具体任务，可以揭示模型在法律推理中的局限性。现有研究较少关注法律专家之间的分歧对模型性能的影响。
Method: 构建了由三位法律专家标注的基准数据集，评估多种模型（共十种）在检测隐性引用上的表现。通过分析专家分歧与模型错误的关系，提出将检测任务重构成基于多模型共识的top-k排序方法。
Result: 最佳集成模型整体F1为0.70，但三分之二的假阳性出现在专家有争议的案例上。在top-200排序中，多模型共识达到76%的精度。
Conclusion: 专家分歧是模型难以处理的内在难度信号，而非标注噪声；但通过无监督的多模型共识排序仍可达到实用精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Uncertainty-guided Compositional Alignment with Part-to-Whole Semantic Representativeness in Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable performance, their Euclidean embeddings remain limited in capturing hierarchical relationships such as part-to-whole or parent-child structures, and often face challenges in multi-object compositional scenarios. Hyperbolic VLMs mitigate this issue by better preserving hierarchical structures and modeling part-whole relations (i.e., whole scene and its part images) through entailment. However, existing approaches do not model that each part has a different level of semantic representativeness to the whole. We propose UNcertainty-guided Compositional Hyperbolic Alignment (UNCHA) for enhancing hyperbolic VLMs. UNCHA models part-to-whole semantic representativeness with hyperbolic uncertainty, by assigning lower uncertainty to more representative parts and higher uncertainty to less representative ones for the whole scene. This representativeness is then incorporated into the contrastive objective with uncertainty-guided weights. Finally, the uncertainty is further calibrated with an entailment loss regularized by entropy-based term. With the proposed losses, UNCHA learns hyperbolic embeddings with more accurate part-whole ordering, capturing the underlying compositional structure in an image and improving its understanding of complex multi-object scenes. UNCHA achieves state-of-the-art performance on zero-shot classification, retrieval, and multi-label classification benchmarks. Our code and models are available at: https://github.com/jeeit17/UNCHA.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UNCHA，一种在双曲空间中对视觉语言模型进行不确定性引导的组合对齐方法。通过为部分图像分配反映其整体语义代表性的双曲不确定性，并利用不确定性加权的对比损失和基于熵的正则化来校准，UNCHA 改善了双曲嵌入的部分-整体排序，在零样本分类、检索和多标签分类基准上取得了最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有双曲视觉语言模型虽能建模部分-整体层次结构，但未区分不同部分对整体语义的代表性差异，导致多目标组合场景理解不足。
Method: 提出 UNCHA，包含：1) 用双曲不确定性建模部分对整体的语义代表性，代表性强的部分分配低不确定性；2) 引入不确定性加权的对比损失；3) 结合基于熵正则化的蕴含损失校准不确定性。
Result: 在零样本分类、检索和多标签分类基准上达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 不确定性引导的部分-整体语义代表性建模能有效提升双曲视觉语言模型对复杂多目标场景的理解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evolutionarily Stable Stackelberg Equilibrium
papers.abstract_en: We present a new solution concept called evolutionarily stable Stackelberg equilibrium (SESS). We study the Stackelberg evolutionary game setting in which there is a single leading player and a symmetric population of followers. The leader selects an optimal mixed strategy, anticipating that the follower population plays an evolutionarily stable strategy (ESS) in the induced subgame and may satisfy additional ecological conditions. We consider both leader-optimal and leader-pessimal selection among ESSs, which arise as special cases of our framework. Prior approaches to Stackelberg evolutionary games either define the follower response via evolutionary dynamics or assume rational best-response behavior, without explicitly enforcing stability against invasion by mutations. We present algorithms for computing SESS in discrete and continuous games, and validate the latter empirically. Our model applies naturally to biological settings; for example, in cancer treatment the leader represents the physician and the followers correspond to competing cancer cell phenotypes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出进化稳定Stackelberg均衡（SESS）作为新的解概念，研究单领导者与对称追随者群体的Stackelberg进化博弈，其中追随者群体在诱导子博弈中采取进化稳定策略（ESS），并考虑生态条件。领导者选择最优混合策略，并考虑对ESS的领导者最优和领导者最差选择。算法适用于离散和连续博弈，并在癌症治疗等生物学场景中验证。
Motivation: 现有Stackelberg进化博弈方法要么通过进化动态定义追随者响应，要么假设理性最佳响应，但未明确强制执行对突变入侵的稳定性。本文填补这一空白，提出结合ESS稳定性的均衡概念。
Method: 定义SESS，要求领导者策略在追随者群体达到ESS时最优，且追随者ESS满足进化稳定性。提出离散和连续博弈的计算算法，并通过实验验证。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称算法在连续博弈中经实验验证有效。
Conclusion: SESS为生物学等场景（如癌症治疗）提供鲁棒的均衡概念，确保稳定性对抗突变入侵。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Approximate Graph Elicits Detonation Lattice
papers.abstract_en: This study presents a novel algorithm based on graph theory for the precise segmentation and measurement of detonation cells from 3D pressure traces, termed detonation lattices, addressing the limitations of manual and primitive 2D edge detection methods prevalent in the field. Using a segmentation model, the proposed training-free algorithm is designed to accurately extract cellular patterns, a longstanding challenge in detonations research. First, the efficacy of segmentation phase on two synthetic datasets is evaluated with an error of 2%. Next, 3D simulation data is used to establish performance of the graph-based workflow. The results of statistics and joint probability densities show oblong cells aligned with the wave propagation axis with 17% deviation, whereas larger dispersion in volume reflects cubic amplification of linear variability. Although the framework is robust, it remains challenging to reliably segment and quantify highly complex cellular patterns. However, the graph-based formulation generalizes across diverse cellular geometries, positioning it as a practical tool for detonation analysis and a strong foundation for future extensions in triple-point collision studies.
papers.comment: 3D Detonation; Soot Foil; Graph; Cell Classification; Cellular Detonation; Detonation Lattice; SAM Model
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图论的无训练算法，用于从3D压力迹线中精确分割和测量爆轰胞（detonation cells），称为爆轰晶格。在合成数据集上误差为2%，在3D模拟数据上验证了效果。统计显示细胞呈扁长形，沿波传播轴偏差17%，体积分散较大。该框架鲁棒但复杂图案的分割仍有挑战。
Motivation: 现有爆轰研究依赖手工和原始2D边缘检测方法，精度不足，无法有效处理3D压力迹线中爆轰胞的提取。
Method: 提出基于图论的无训练分割算法，结合分割模型，用于精确提取爆轰细胞图案。
Result: 在合成数据集上误差2%；在3D模拟数据上，细胞呈扁长形，沿传播轴偏差17%，体积分散体现出立方放大效应。
Conclusion: 该图论框架对多种胞几何具有泛化性，可作为爆轰分析实用工具，并为未来三重点碰撞研究提供基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Direct Object-Level Reconstruction via Probabilistic Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Object-level 3D reconstruction play important roles across domains such as cultural heritage digitization, industrial manufacturing, and virtual reality. However, existing Gaussian Splatting-based approaches generally rely on full-scene reconstruction, in which substantial redundant background information is introduced, leading to increased computational and storage overhead. To address this limitation, we propose an efficient single-object 3D reconstruction method based on 2D Gaussian Splatting. By directly integrating foreground-background probability cues into Gaussian primitives and dynamically pruning low-probability Gaussians during training, the proposed method fundamentally focuses on an object of interest and improves the memory and computational efficiency. Our pipeline leverages probability masks generated by YOLO and SAM to supervise probabilistic Gaussian attributes, replacing binary masks with continuous probability values to mitigate boundary ambiguity. Additionally, we propose a dual-stage filtering strategy for training's startup to suppress background Gaussians. And, during training, rendered probability masks are conversely employed to refine supervision and enhance boundary consistency across views. Experiments conducted on the MIP-360, T&T, and NVOS datasets demonstrate that our method exhibits strong self-correction capability in the presence of mask errors and achieves reconstruction quality comparable to standard 3DGS approaches, while requiring only approximately 1/10 of their Gaussian amount. These results validate the efficiency and robustness of our method for single-object reconstruction and highlight its potential for applications requiring both high fidelity and computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于概率高斯泼溅（Probabilistic Gaussian Splatting）的单物体3D重建方法，通过将前景-背景概率直接融入高斯原语并动态剪枝低概率高斯来提高计算和存储效率。利用YOLO和SAM生成的概率掩码监督概率高斯属性，并用连续概率值替代二值掩码以缓解边界模糊。在MIP-360、T&T和NVOS数据集上，该方法在仅使用约1/10高斯数量的情况下，达到了与标准3DGS相当的重建质量，并展现出对掩码误差的强自校正能力。
Motivation: 现有基于高斯泼溅的方法通常依赖全场景重建，引入大量冗余背景信息，导致计算和存储开销增加。
Method: 提出基于2D高斯泼溅的单物体3D重建方法：将前景-背景概率直接编码为高斯原语的属性，训练中动态剪枝低概率高斯；利用YOLO和SAM生成的连续概率掩码监督训练，并采用双阶段滤波策略抑制初始背景高斯；训练中反向利用渲染的概率掩码细化监督，增强跨视图边界一致性。
Result: 在MIP-360、T&T和NVOS数据集上，使用约1/10的高斯数量达到与标准3DGS相当的重建质量，对掩码误差具有强自校正能力。
Conclusion: 该方法实现了高效且鲁棒的单物体重建，适用于需要高保真度和计算效率的应用场景。

papers.title: Towards Robust Speech Deepfake Detection via Human-Inspired Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: The modern generative audio models can be used by an adversary in an unlawful manner, specifically, to impersonate other people to gain access to private information. To mitigate this issue, speech deepfake detection (SDD) methods started to evolve. Unfortunately, current SDD methods generally suffer from the lack of generalization to new audio domains and generators. More than that, they lack interpretability, especially human-like reasoning that would naturally explain the attribution of a given audio to the bona fide or spoof class and provide human-perceptible cues. In this paper, we propose HIR-SDD, a novel SDD framework that combines the strengths of Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) with the chain-of-thought reasoning derived from the novel proposed human-annotated dataset. Experimental evaluation demonstrates both the effectiveness of the proposed method and its ability to provide reasonable justifications for predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HIR-SDD 框架，结合大型音频语言模型（LALM）与人类推理链（chain-of-thought），用于语音深度伪造检测（speech deepfake detection），旨在提升泛化性和可解释性。实验表明该方法在提供合理预测依据的同时，取得了良好的检测效果。
Motivation: 现有语音深度伪造检测方法泛化性差、缺乏可解释性，无法像人类一样给出推理过程。
Method: 提出 HIR-SDD，利用大型音频语言模型与基于人类标注数据集的链式推理机制，实现可解释的语音伪造检测。
Result: 实验验证了该方法的有效性，并能提供合理的预测理由。
Conclusion: 该框架在提升检测性能的同时，首次赋予伪造检测类人推理能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bilateral Trade Under Heavy-Tailed Valuations: Minimax Regret with Infinite Variance
papers.abstract_en: We study contextual bilateral trade under full feedback when, conditionally on the context, trader valuations have bounded density but infinite variance. We first extend the self-bounding property of Bachoc et al. (ICML 2025) from bounded to real-valued valuations, showing that the expected regret of any price pi satisfies a quadratic self-bounding inequality under bounded density alone. Combining this with truncated-mean estimation, we prove that an epoch-based algorithm achieves regret O~(T^{1 - 2beta(p-1)/(betap + d(p-1))}) when the noise has finite p-th moment for p in (1,2) and the market value function is beta-Holder, and we establish a matching lower bound via Assouad's method with a fixed-support mixture construction. Our results characterize the exact minimax rate in T for this problem, interpolating between the classical nonparametric rate at p=2 and the trivial linear rate as p tends to 1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究上下文双边贸易（contextual bilateral trade）在完全反馈设置下的遗憾最小化问题，其中条件于上下文，交易者估价具有有界密度但无限方差。作者将自界性质从有界估值扩展到实值估值，并结合截尾均值估计，提出基于epoch的算法，实现了与噪声p阶矩（p∈(1,2)）和市场价值函数β-赫尔德光滑性相关的遗憾上界O~(T^{1 - 2β(p-1)/(βp + d(p-1))})，并通过Assouad方法建立了匹配的下界，刻画了该问题在T上的精确极小化最优速率，在p=2时退化为经典非参数速率，p→1时退化为线性速率。
Motivation: 现有双边贸易研究通常假设估值分布具有有界方差或指数尾，但实际中估值可能呈现重尾分布（无限方差），这导致传统遗憾界失效。需要针对重尾估值设计最优算法并刻画极小化最优速率。
Method: 首先将Bachoc等人的自界不等式从有界估值扩展到实值估值，证明在仅有界密度条件下，任何价格的期望遗憾满足二次自界不等式。然后结合截尾均值估计，设计基于epoch的算法，并利用自界不等式和截尾技术导出遗憾上界。下界通过Assouad方法结合固定支撑混合分布构造得到。
Result: 在噪声仅有p阶矩（p∈(1,2)）且市场价值函数β-赫尔德光滑时，算法实现遗憾上界O~(T^{1 - 2β(p-1)/(βp + d(p-1))})，并证明该速率是最优的，即匹配下界。该速率在p=2时对应经典非参数速率，在p→1时趋于线性速率。
Conclusion: 本文完整刻画了重尾估值下上下文双边贸易的极小化最优遗憾速率，展示了无限方差如何影响学习难度，并提供了新的分析工具（自界不等式的实值扩展）。该结果适用于估值分布仅有界密度而无任何矩假设的情景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: First-Order Softmax Weighted Switching Gradient Method for Distributed Stochastic Minimax Optimization with Stochastic Constraints
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the distributed stochastic minimax optimization problem subject to stochastic constraints. We propose a novel first-order Softmax-Weighted Switching Gradient method tailored for federated learning. Under full client participation, our algorithm achieves the standard $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(ε^{-4})$ oracle complexity to satisfy a unified bound $ε$ for both the optimality gap and feasibility tolerance. We extend our theoretical analysis to the practical partial participation regime by quantifying client sampling noise through a stochastic superiority assumption. Furthermore, by relaxing standard boundedness assumptions on the objective functions, we establish a strictly tighter lower bound for the softmax hyperparameter. We provide a unified error decomposition and establish a sharp $\mathcal{O}(\log\frac{1}δ)$ high-probability convergence guarantee. Ultimately, our framework demonstrates that a single-loop primal-only switching mechanism provides a stable alternative for optimizing worst-case client performance, effectively bypassing the hyperparameter sensitivity and convergence oscillations often encountered in traditional primal-dual or penalty-based approaches. We verify the efficacy of our algorithm via experiment on the Neyman-Pearson (NP) classification, fair classification, and federated safe reinforcement learning tasks.
papers.comment: This paper was accepted by the 42nd annual Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026)

papers.title: Autocorrelation effects in a stochastic-process model for solving two-armed bandit problems
papers.abstract_en: Decision makers exploiting photonic chaotic dynamics obtained by semiconductor lasers provide an ultrafast approach to solving multi-armed bandit problems by using a temporal optical signal as the driving source for sequential decisions. In such systems, the sampling interval of the chaotic waveform shapes the temporal correlation of the resulting time series, and experiments have reported that decision accuracy depends strongly on this autocorrelation property. However, it remains unclear whether the benefit of autocorrelation can be explained by a minimal mathematical model. Here, we analyze a stochastic-process model for solving the two-armed bandit problem based on time series, where the threshold and a two-valued Markov signal evolve jointly. Numerical results reveal an environment-dependent structure: negative (positive) autocorrelation is optimal in reward-rich (reward-poor) environments. These findings show that negative autocorrelation of the time series is advantageous when the sum of the winning probabilities is more than one, whereas positive autocorrelation is useful when the sum of the winning probabilities is less than one. Moreover, the performance is independent of autocorrelation if the sum of the winning probabilities equals one, which is mathematically clarified. This study paves the way for solving the two-armed bandit problems for reinforcement learning applications in wireless communications and robotics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于混沌激光时间序列求解双臂赌博机问题中的自相关效应，构建了一个随机过程模型，其中阈值与二值马尔可夫信号共同演化。数值实验揭示了环境依赖的最优自相关结构：在奖励丰富（获胜概率和大于1）时负自相关最优，在奖励贫乏（获胜概率和小于1）时正自相关最优。当获胜概率和等于1时，性能与自相关无关。该工作为无线通信和机器人中的强化学习应用提供了理论依据。
Motivation: 已有实验表明决策精度强烈依赖于混沌波形的自相关特性，但自相关的收益能否用最小数学模型解释仍不清楚。
Method: 分析了基于时间序列的双臂赌博机随机过程模型，其中阈值与二值马尔可夫信号联合演化，并通过数值仿真研究自相关的影响。
Result: 数值结果显示：当两臂获胜概率之和大于1时，负自相关最优；小于1时，正自相关最优；等于1时，性能与自相关无关。
Conclusion: 阐明了自相关在双臂赌博机问题中的作用机制，为无线通信和机器人等领域的强化学习应用提供了指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Model-Free Universal AI
papers.abstract_en: In general reinforcement learning, all established optimal agents, including AIXI, are model-based, explicitly maintaining and using environment models. This paper introduces Universal AI with Q-Induction (AIQI), the first model-free agent proven to be asymptotically $\varepsilon$-optimal in general RL. AIQI performs universal induction over distributional action-value functions, instead of policies or environments like previous works. Under a grain of truth condition, we prove that AIQI is strong asymptotically $\varepsilon$-optimal and asymptotically $\varepsilon$-Bayes-optimal. We also apply our novel proof techniques to show asymptotic $\varepsilon$-optimality of Self-AIXI without any ad-hoc assumptions. Our results significantly expand the diversity of known universal agents.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个在通用强化学习中被证明渐近ε最优的无模型智能体AIQI（Universal AI with Q-Induction），通过对分布状动作价值函数进行通用归纳，而非像以往工作那样对策略或环境进行归纳。在真理颗粒条件下，证明AIQI是强渐近ε最优和渐近ε贝叶斯最优，并将新证明技术应用于Self-AIXI以展示其渐近ε最优性，显著扩展了通用智能体的多样性。
Motivation: 通用强化学习中所有已建立的最优智能体（包括AIXI）都是基于模型的，需要显式维护和使用环境模型；缺乏被证明最优的无模型智能体。
Method: 引入AIQI，通过对分布状动作价值函数进行通用归纳（universal induction）实现无模型学习；在真理颗粒（grain of truth）条件下证明其渐近最优性。
Result: 证明AIQI是强渐近ε最优和渐近ε贝叶斯最优；并将证明技术应用于Self-AIXI，在其无额外假设下证明渐近ε最优性。
Conclusion: 该工作显著扩展了已知通用智能体的多样性，为无模型通用强化学习提供了理论基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A General Equilibrium Theory of Orchestrated AI Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: We establish a general equilibrium theory for systems of large language model (LLM) agents operating under centralized orchestration. The framework is a production economy in the sense of Arrow-Debreu (1954), extended to infinite-dimensional commodity spaces following Bewley (1972). Each LLM agent is modeled as a firm whose production set Y a $\subset$ H = L 2 ([0, T ], R R ) represents the feasible metric trajectories determined by its frozen model weights. The orchestrator is the consumer, choosing a routing policy over the agent DAG to maximize system welfare subject to a budget constraint evaluated at functional prices p $\in$ H A . These prices-elements of the Hilbert dual of the commodity space-assign a shadow value to each metric of each agent at each instant. We prove, via Brouwer's theorem applied to a finitedimensional approximation V K $\subset$ H, that every such economy admits at least one general equilibrium (p * , y * , $π$ * ). A functional Walras' law holds as a theorem: the value of functional excess demand is zero for all prices, as a consequence of the consumer's budget constraint-not by construction. We further establish Pareto optimality (First Welfare Theorem), decentralizability of Pareto optima (Second Welfare Theorem), and uniqueness with geometric convergence under a contraction condition (Banach). The orchestration dynamics constitute a Walrasian t{â}tonnement that converges globally under the contraction condition, unlike classical t{â}tonnement (Scarf, 1960). The framework admits a DSGE interpretation with SLO parameters as policy rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为在集中式编排下运行的大语言模型代理系统建立了一般均衡理论，将每个LLM代理视为企业，编排器视为消费者，证明了均衡存在性、福利定理及收敛性，并给出了DSGE解释。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理系统缺乏经济学理论基础，作者希望用Arrow-Debreu一般均衡框架分析集中式编排下的代理系统。
Method: 将问题建模为生产经济，代理为具有生产集（可行度量轨迹）的企业，编排器为消费者（在函数价格下选择路由策略最大化社会福利）。通过有限维逼近和Brouwer不动点定理证明均衡存在性。
Result: 证明了每个此类经济至少存在一个一般均衡，建立了函数Walras律、第一和第二福利定理，以及在收缩条件下的唯一性和几何收敛。编排动力学构成全局收敛的瓦尔拉斯试错过程。
Conclusion: 该框架可解释为DSGE模型，其中SLO参数充当政策利率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Driving Like Yourself: A Benchmark for Closed-Loop Personalized End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Human driving behavior is inherently diverse, yet most end-to-end autonomous driving (E2E-AD) systems learn a single average driving style, neglecting individual differences. Achieving personalized E2E-AD faces challenges across three levels: limited real-world datasets with individual-level annotations, a lack of quantitative metrics for evaluating personal driving styles, and the absence of algorithms that can learn stylized representations from users' trajectories. To address these gaps, we propose Person2Drive, a comprehensive personalized E2E-AD platform and benchmark. It includes an open-source, flexible data collection system that simulates realistic scenarios to generate scalable, diverse personalized driving datasets; style vector-based evaluation metrics with Maximum Mean Discrepancy and KL divergence to comprehensively quantify individual driving behaviors; and a personalized E2E-AD framework with a style reward model that efficiently adapts E2E models for safe and individualized driving. Crucially, our framework enables plug-and-play personalization by fine-tuning only the trajectory prediction head, preserving the pretrained base model and ensuring safety. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Person2Drive enables fine-grained analysis and effective personalization, while preserving driving performance and success rate even in challenging scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Person2Drive，一个针对个性化端到端自动驾驶 (E2E-AD) 的综合平台和基准。它包含开源数据采集系统、基于风格向量的评估指标以及具有风格奖励模型的个性化 E2E-AD 框架。实验表明，该方法在保持驾驶性能和安全性的同时，实现了有效的个性化。
Motivation: 现有端到端自动驾驶系统忽略个体驾驶风格差异，缺乏个性化数据集、量化指标和算法。
Method: 提出 Person2Drive 平台，包括：1) 模拟真实场景的数据采集系统；2) 基于最大均值差异和 KL 散度的风格向量评估指标；3) 带有风格奖励模型的个性化框架，仅微调轨迹预测头实现即插即用个性化。
Result: 实验证明 Person2Drive 能进行细粒度分析和有效个性化，在挑战性场景下保持驾驶性能和成功率。
Conclusion: 该平台为个性化端到端自动驾驶提供了基准，并展示了安全且有效的个性化方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Debiasing Central Fixation Confounds Reveals a Peripheral "Sweet Spot" for Human-like Scanpaths in Hard-Attention Vision
papers.abstract_en: Human eye movements in visual recognition reflect a balance between foveal sampling and peripheral context. Task-driven hard-attention models for vision are often evaluated by how well their scanpaths match human gaze. However, common scanpath metrics can be strongly confounded by dataset-specific center bias, especially on object-centric datasets. Using Gaze-CIFAR-10, we show that a trivial center-fixation baseline achieves surprisingly strong scanpath scores, approaching many learned policies. This makes standard metrics optimistic and blurs the distinction between genuine behavioral alignment and mere central tendency. We then analyze a hard-attention classifier under constrained vision by sweeping foveal patch size and peripheral context, revealing a peripheral sweet spot: only a narrow range of sensory constraints yields scanpaths that are simultaneously (i) above the center baseline after debiasing and (ii) temporally human-like in movement statistics. To address center bias, we propose GCS (Gaze Consistency Score), a center-debiased composite metric augmented with movement similarity. GCS uncovers a robust sweet spot at medium patch size with both foveal and peripheral vision, that is not obvious from raw scanpath metrics or accuracy alone, and also highlights a "shortcut regime" when the field-of-view becomes too large. We discuss implications for evaluating active perception on object-centric datasets and for designing gaze benchmarks that better separate behavioral alignment from center bias.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文揭示了视觉识别中硬注意力模型的扫描路径评估受到数据集中心偏误的严重干扰。在Gaze-CIFAR-10数据集上，一个简单的中心注视基线即可取得与许多学习策略相当的扫描路径分数。作者提出中心去偏复合指标GCS（Gaze Consistency Score），并发现只有狭窄的感觉约束范围才能产生既去偏后高于基线又具有类人时间运动统计的扫描路径。中等大小的注视补丁同时使用中央凹和周边视觉时存在稳健的“甜区”。
Motivation: 现有扫描路径度量受数据集特定中心偏误严重混淆，导致标准度量过于乐观，模糊了真实行为对齐与单纯中心趋势的区别。
Method: 提出GCS（Gaze Consistency Score），一种中心去偏复合度量，结合运动相似性；并通过扫描中央凹补丁大小和周边上下文范围，分析硬注意力分类器在约束视觉下的扫描路径。
Result: 在Gaze-CIFAR-10上，中心注视基线能达到接近许多学习策略的分数；GCS揭示中等补丁大小同时利用中央凹和周边视觉时存在稳健甜区，且当视场过大时存在“捷径”区域。
Conclusion: 讨论了对基于对象数据集评估主动感知的影响，以及设计更好分离行为对齐与中心偏误的注视基准的意义。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SynthSAEBench: Evaluating Sparse Autoencoders on Scalable Realistic Synthetic Data
papers.abstract_en: Improving Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) requires benchmarks that can precisely validate architectural innovations. Current LLM-based SAE benchmarks are too noisy to differentiate architectural improvements, while commonly used synthetic-data experiments are too small-scale, unstandardized, and unrealistic to be meaningful. We introduce SynthSAEBench, a benchmark and toolkit for evaluating SAEs against large-scale synthetic data with realistic feature characteristics including correlation, hierarchy, and superposition, while providing ground-truth features and firings. SynthSAEBench acts as a controlled lower-bound test: SAE architectures that fail when the Linear Representation Hypothesis holds by construction have little hope on real LLMs. The benchmark reproduces known LLM SAE phenomena including the disconnect between reconstruction and latent quality, poor SAE probing, and a precision-recall trade-off mediated by L0, demonstrating that SynthSAEBench findings reproduce results on LLM SAEs. We further identify a novel failure mode: Matching Pursuit SAEs exploit superposition noise to improve reconstruction without learning ground-truth features, suggesting more expressive encoding procedures can easily overfit. SynthSAEBench complements LLM benchmarks with ground-truth features and controlled ablations for diagnosing SAE failure modes, while providing a clear target for SAE architecture work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SynthSAEBench，一个用于评估稀疏自编码器（SAE）的基准和工具包，基于大规模合成数据，具有真实特征特性（相关性、层次性、叠加），并提供真实特征和触发数据。该基准作为受控下限测试：如果在线性表示假设成立时 SAE 架构失败，则对真实 LLM 几乎没有希望。该基准复现了已知的 LLM SAE 现象，并识别出新失败模式：匹配追踪 SAE 利用叠加噪声改善重建而不学习真实特征。
Motivation: 当前基于 LLM 的 SAE 基准噪声太大，无法区分架构改进；而常用的合成数据实验规模过小、不标准化、不真实，缺乏意义。
Method: 提出 SynthSAEBench，生成大规模合成数据，包含相关、层次和叠加等现实特征特性，并提供真实特征和触发数据，用于受控评估 SAE。
Result: 摘要指出该基准复现了 LLM SAE 中重建与潜在质量脱节、SAE 探测性能差、由 L0 介导的精确率-召回率权衡等现象。并发现匹配追踪 SAE 通过利用叠加噪声来改善重建，而不学习真实特征，表明更具表达力的编码过程容易过拟合。
Conclusion: SynthSAEBench 通过提供真实特征和受控消融来补充 LLM 基准，用于诊断 SAE 失败模式，并为 SAE 架构工作提供明确目标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Probabilistic Wind Power Forecasting with Tree-Based Machine Learning and Weather Ensembles
papers.abstract_en: Accurate production forecasts are essential for the integration of renewable energy sources into the power grid. This paper illustrates how to obtain probabilistic forecasts of wind power generation using gradient boosting trees and an ensemble of weather forecasts. To this end, we perform a comparative analysis across three state-of-the-art probabilistic prediction methods-conformalized quantile regression, natural gradient boosting and conditional diffusion models-all of which can be combined with tree-based machine learning. The methods are validated using four years of data for all Belgian offshore wind farms. We benchmark the models against the power curve and a calibrated wake model as well as a probabilistic method using stochastic variational Gaussian process regression. The tree-based models significantly reduce the mean absolute error in comparison to the deterministic baselines. Additionally, all three methods outperform the Gaussian process baseline in probabilistic skill, while two out of the three also improve point forecast accuracy. The conditional diffusion model attains the best performance, with improvements of 5% in mean absolute error and 12% in continuous rank probability score compared to the probabilistic baseline. Last, the results indicate an average improvement in point forecast accuracy of 17% by using an ensemble of weather forecasts instead of a single provider.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何利用梯度提升树和天气集合预报获取风电概率预测，比较了分位数回归、自然梯度提升和条件扩散三种树基概率方法，在比利时所有海上风电场四年数据上验证。条件扩散模型最优，相比概率基线降低5% MAE和12% CRPS；使用天气集合预报比单一提供商平均提升17%点预测精度。
Motivation: 准确的风电预测对可再生能源并网至关重要，传统确定性预测和简单概率方法不够精确，需要利用天气集合预报和先进的机器学习方法提升概率预测性能。
Method: 采用三种树基概率预测方法（保形分位数回归、自然梯度提升、条件扩散模型），结合树基机器学习与天气集合预报，并与功率曲线、标定尾流模型和随机变分高斯过程回归对比。
Result: 树基模型在点预测MAE上显著优于确定性基线；三种方法在概率技能上均优于高斯过程基线，其中条件扩散模型最优，MAE降低5%，CRPS降低12%；使用天气集合预报平均提升17%点预测精度。
Conclusion: 树基机器学习结合天气集合预报可有效提升风电概率预测准确性，条件扩散模型表现最佳。
Relevance: 30

summary_sections.result: 树基模型在点预测MAE上显著优于确定性基线；三种方法在概率技能上均优于高斯过程基线，其中条件扩散模型最优，MAE降低5%，CRPS降低12%；使用天气集合预报平均提升17%点预测精度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 树基机器学习结合天气集合预报可有效提升风电概率预测准确性，条件扩散模型表现最佳。

papers.title: Reliable Mislabel Detection for Video Capsule Endoscopy Data
papers.abstract_en: The classification performance of deep neural networks relies strongly on access to large, accurately annotated datasets. In medical imaging, however, obtaining such datasets is particularly challenging since annotations must be provided by specialized physicians, which severely limits the pool of annotators. Furthermore, class boundaries can often be ambiguous or difficult to define which further complicates machine learning-based classification. In this paper, we want to address this problem and introduce a framework for mislabel detection in medical datasets. This is validated on the two largest, publicly available datasets for Video Capsule Endoscopy, an important imaging procedure for examining the gastrointestinal tract based on a video stream of lowresolution images. In addition, potentially mislabeled samples identified by our pipeline were reviewed and re-annotated by three experienced gastroenterologists. Our results show that the proposed framework successfully detects incorrectly labeled data and results in an improved anomaly detection performance after cleaning the datasets compared to current baselines.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC) 2026. Code on Github: https://github.com/juliawerner/vce-noise-identification
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对医学图像数据集中的标签错误问题，本文提出一个检测错误标注的框架，并在两个公开的视频胶囊内镜（Video Capsule Endoscopy）数据集上验证。三位胃肠病专家对检测出的潜在错误样本进行了复核和重新标注，清洗后的数据集在异常检测任务上优于当前基线方法。
Motivation: 医学图像标注依赖专家医师，标注者少且类别边界模糊，导致标签噪声，影响深度学习模型性能。
Method: 提出一个通用的错误标注检测框架，通过分析模型训练过程中的信号来识别潜在错误标签，并在视频胶囊内镜数据上结合专家重标注进行验证。
Result: 框架成功检测出错误标注，经过数据集清洗后，异常检测性能相比当前基线方法有所提升。
Conclusion: 本文展示了错误标注检测在医学图像中的有效性，但验证仅针对特定成像模态（视频胶囊内镜），未来需推广到其他医学图像领域。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: JADE: Expert-Grounded Dynamic Evaluation for Open-Ended Professional Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating agentic AI on open-ended professional tasks faces a fundamental dilemma between rigor and flexibility. Static rubrics provide rigorous, reproducible assessment but fail to accommodate diverse valid response strategies, while LLM-as-a-judge approaches adapt to individual responses yet suffer from instability and bias. Human experts address this dilemma by combining domain-grounded principles with dynamic, claim-level assessment. Inspired by this process, we propose \textbf{JADE}, a two-layer evaluation framework. Layer 1 encodes expert knowledge as a predefined set of evaluation skills, providing stable evaluation criteria. Layer 2 performs report-specific, claim-level evaluation to flexibly assess diverse reasoning strategies, with evidence-dependency gating to invalidate conclusions built on refuted claims. Experiments on BizBench show that JADE improves evaluation stability and reveals critical agent failure modes missed by holistic LLM-based evaluators. We further demonstrate strong alignment with expert-authored rubrics and effective transfer to HealthBench and DR.BENCH, covering medical and 10-domain professional evaluation settings. Code and data are available at https://github.com/smiling-world/JADE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出JADE，一个两层的评估框架，用于解决开放专业任务中AI代理评估的严格性与灵活性之间的困境。第一层编码专家知识作为预定义评估技能，提供稳定标准；第二层针对报告特定的声明级别评估，通过证据依赖门控来灵活评估不同推理策略。在BizBench上的实验表明，JADE提高了评估稳定性，并揭示了整体LLM评估器遗漏的关键失败模式。此外，JADE与专家编写的评分标准高度一致，并能有效迁移到HealthBench和DR.BENCH等医疗及10领域专业评估设置。
Motivation: 现有方法（静态评分标准缺乏灵活性，LLM作为评判者不稳定且有偏见）无法同时满足开放专业任务的严格性和灵活性需求。
Method: 提出JADE两层框架：Layer 1编码专家知识为预定义评估技能集；Layer 2进行报告特定、声明级别的评估，并使用证据依赖门控来使建立在被反驳声明上的结论无效。
Result: 在BizBench上，JADE提高了评估稳定性并揭示了被整体LLM评估器遗漏的失败模式。与专家评分标准高度对齐，并有效迁移到HealthBench和DR.BENCH。
Conclusion: JADE通过结合专家知识与动态声明级评估，为开放专业任务提供了一种更稳定、灵活且可迁移的评估方法。

papers.title: SalFormer360: a transformer-based saliency estimation model for 360-degree videos
papers.abstract_en: Saliency estimation has received growing attention in recent years due to its importance in a wide range of applications. In the context of 360-degree video, it has been particularly valuable for tasks such as viewport prediction and immersive content optimization. In this paper, we propose SalFormer360, a novel saliency estimation model for 360-degree videos built on a transformer-based architecture. Our approach is based on the combination of an existing encoder architecture, SegFormer, and a custom decoder. The SegFormer model was originally developed for 2D segmentation tasks, and it has been fine-tuned to adapt it to 360-degree content. To further enhance prediction accuracy in our model, we incorporated Viewing Center Bias to reflect user attention in 360-degree environments. Extensive experiments on the three largest benchmark datasets for saliency estimation demonstrate that SalFormer360 outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods. In terms of Pearson Correlation Coefficient, our model achieves 8.4% higher performance on Sport360, 2.5% on PVS-HM, and 18.6% on VR-EyeTracking compared to previous state-of-the-art.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Broadcasting, vol. 72, no. 2, pp. 533-544, June 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了SalFormer360，一个基于Transformer的360度视频显著性估计模型。该模型结合了SegFormer编码器和自定义解码器，并引入Viewing Center Bias来提升预测精度。在三个最大的基准数据集上，SalFormer360在皮尔逊相关系数上分别比现有最优方法提高了8.4%、2.5%和18.6%。
Motivation: 显著性估计在360度视频中有重要应用（如视口预测和沉浸式内容优化），但现有方法精度不足。本文旨在提出一个更准确的模型。
Method: 基于Transformer架构，采用SegFormer编码器（原用于2D分割）并针对360度内容微调，搭配自定义解码器，并加入Viewing Center Bias以反映用户注意力。
Result: 在Sport360、PVS-HM和VR-EyeTracking三个数据集上，皮尔逊相关系数分别提升8.4%、2.5%和18.6%，超越现有最优方法。
Conclusion: 该模型在360度视频显著性估计上达到最新最优性能。

papers.title: Separation-Utility Pareto Frontier: An Information-Theoretic Characterization
papers.abstract_en: We study the Pareto frontier (optimal trade-off) between utility and separation, a fairness criterion requiring predictive independence from sensitive attributes conditional on the true outcome. Through an information-theoretic lens, we prove a characterization of the utility-separation Pareto frontier, establish its concavity, and thereby prove the increasing marginal cost of separation in terms of utility. In addition, we characterize the conditions under which this trade-off becomes strict, providing a guide for trade-off selection in practice. Based on the theoretical characterization, we develop an empirical regularizer based on conditional mutual information (CMI) between predictions and sensitive attributes given the true outcome. The CMI regularizer is compatible with any deep model trained via gradient-based optimization and serves as a scalar monitor of residual separation violations, offering tractable guarantees during training. Finally, numerical experiments support our theoretical findings: across COMPAS, UCI Adult, UCI Bank, and CelebA, the proposed method substantially reduces separation violations while matching or exceeding the utility of established baseline methods. This study thus offers a provable, stable, and flexible approach to enforcing separation in deep learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从信息论角度刻画了机器学习公平性准则separation（预测与敏感属性在给定真实结果下条件独立）与效用之间的帕累托前沿，证明了前沿的凹性及分离的边际成本递增。在此基础上提出基于条件互信息（CMI）的正则化方法，可与任意深度学习模型兼容，并在训练中提供可处理的分离违反监控。在COMPAS、UCI Adult、UCI Bank、CelebA等数据集上，该方法在保持或提升效用的同时显著减少分离违反。
Motivation: 现有公平性-效用权衡缺乏严格的理论刻画，特别是separation准则下的帕累托前沿特性未知，导致实践中难以选择权衡点。
Method: 通过信息论证明separation-效用帕累托前沿的凹性及分离边际成本递增；开发基于条件互信息（CMI）的正则化项，作为可微的惩罚项加入深度学习训练，提供训练中分离违反的标量监控。
Result: 实验表明在COMPAS、UCI Adult、UCI Bank、CelebA上，所提方法在匹配或超越基线效用的同时显著降低分离违反。
Conclusion: 该工作为深度学习施加separation公平性提供了可证明、稳定且灵活的途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking Zero-Shot Time Series Classification: From Task-specific Classifiers to In-Context Inference
papers.abstract_en: The zero-shot evaluation of time series foundation models (TSFMs) for classification typically uses a frozen encoder followed by a task-specific classifier. However, this practice violates the training-free premise of zero-shot deployment and introduces evaluation bias due to classifier-dependent training choices. To address this issue, we propose TIC-FM, an in-context learning framework that treats the labeled training set as context and predicts labels for all test instances in a single forward pass, without parameter updates. TIC-FM pairs a time series encoder and a lightweight projection adapter with a split-masked latent memory Transformer. We further provide theoretical justification that in-context inference can subsume trained classifiers and can emulate gradient-based classifier training within a single forward pass. Experiments on 128 UCR datasets show strong accuracy, with consistent gains in the extreme low-label situation, highlighting training-free transfer for time series classification.The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/fangjuntao/TIC-FM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TIC-FM，一种用于时间序列基础模型零样本分类的上下文学习框架，无需参数更新即可通过单次前向传播完成分类。在128个UCR数据集上实验显示强准确率，尤其在极低标签场景下表现一致提升。理论证明上下文推理可以涵盖训练好的分类器。
Motivation: 现有零样本时间序列分类方法使用冻结编码器加任务特定分类器，违背了零样本的无训练前提，且因分类器依赖的训练选择引入评估偏差。
Method: 提出TIC-FM，结合时间序列编码器、轻量投影适配器和分裂掩码隐记忆Transformer，将标注训练集作为上下文，单次前向传播预测所有测试实例标签，无需参数更新。
Result: 在128个UCR数据集上取得强准确率，极端低标签场景下持续提升，验证了无训练迁移的有效性。
Conclusion: 上下文推理可以涵盖训练好的分类器，并在单次前向传播中模拟基于梯度的分类器训练，为时间序列分类提供无训练迁移方案。

papers.title: Youtu-Parsing: Perception, Structuring and Recognition via High-Parallelism Decoding
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents Youtu-Parsing, an efficient and versatile document parsing model designed for high-performance content extraction. The architecture employs a native Vision Transformer (ViT) featuring a dynamic-resolution visual encoder to extract shared document features, coupled with a prompt-guided Youtu-LLM-2B language model for layout analysis and region-prompted decoding. Leveraging this decoupled and feature-reusable framework, we introduce a high-parallelism decoding strategy comprising two core components: token parallelism and query parallelism. The token parallelism strategy concurrently generates up to 64 candidate tokens per inference step, which are subsequently validated through a verification mechanism. This approach yields a 5--11x speedup over traditional autoregressive decoding and is particularly well-suited for highly structured scenarios, such as table recognition. To further exploit the advantages of region-prompted decoding, the query parallelism strategy enables simultaneous content prediction for multiple bounding boxes (up to five), providing an additional 2x acceleration while maintaining output quality equivalent to standard decoding. Youtu-Parsing encompasses a diverse range of document elements, including text, formulas, tables, charts, seals, and hierarchical structures. Furthermore, the model exhibits strong robustness when handling rare characters, multilingual text, and handwritten content. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that Youtu-Parsing achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on both the OmniDocBench and olmOCR-bench benchmarks. Overall, Youtu-Parsing demonstrates significant experimental value and practical utility for large-scale document intelligence applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Youtu-Parsing，一种基于动态分辨率ViT和Youtu-LLM-2B的高效文档解析模型，采用token并行（单步生成64个候选token）和查询并行（同时处理最多5个边界框）的高并行解码策略，实现5-11倍加速，在OmniDocBench和olmOCR-bench基准上达到SOTA。
Motivation: 现有文档解析模型解码速度慢，难以高效处理文本、公式、表格、图表、印章等多种元素，且对罕见字符、多语言和手写内容的鲁棒性不足。
Method: 采用动态分辨率视觉编码器提取共享特征，结合提示引导的Youtu-LLM-2B进行布局分析；引入token并行（一次生成64个候选token并经验证机制筛选）和查询并行（同时预测多个边界框内容）两种高并行解码策略。
Result: 在OmniDocBench和olmOCR-bench上取得SOTA性能，解码速度相比传统自回归方法提升5-11倍，查询并行额外提供2倍加速且输出质量不变。
Conclusion: Youtu-Parsing在文档智能大规模应用中具有显著实验价值和实用性，尤其适合高度结构化的场景（如表格识别）。

summary_sections.method: 采用动态分辨率视觉编码器提取共享特征，结合提示引导的Youtu-LLM-2B进行布局分析；引入token并行（一次生成64个候选token并经验证机制筛选）和查询并行（同时预测多个边界框内容）两种高并行解码策略。
summary_sections.result: 在OmniDocBench和olmOCR-bench上取得SOTA性能，解码速度相比传统自回归方法提升5-11倍，查询并行额外提供2倍加速且输出质量不变。
summary_sections.conclusion: Youtu-Parsing在文档智能大规模应用中具有显著实验价值和实用性，尤其适合高度结构化的场景（如表格识别）。

papers.title: SFO: Learning PDE Operators via Spectral Filtering
papers.abstract_en: Partial differential equations (PDEs) govern complex systems, yet neural operators often struggle to efficiently capture the long-range, nonlocal interactions inherent in their solution maps. We introduce Spectral Filtering Operator (SFO), a neural operator that parameterizes integral kernels using the Universal Spectral Basis (USB), a fixed, global orthonormal basis derived from the eigenmodes of the Hilbert matrix in spectral filtering theory. Motivated by our theoretical finding that the discrete Green's functions of shift-invariant PDE discretizations exhibit spatial Linear Dynamical System (LDS) structure, we prove that these kernels admit compact approximations in the USB. By learning only the spectral coefficients of rapidly decaying eigenvalues, SFO achieves a highly efficient representation. Across six benchmarks, including reaction-diffusion, fluid dynamics, and 3D electromagnetics, SFO achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, reducing error by up to 40% relative to strong baselines while using substantially fewer parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出谱滤波算子（Spectral Filtering Operator, SFO），一种用于偏微分方程（PDE）算子学习的神经算子。SFO 使用希尔伯特矩阵特征模态（Universal Spectral Basis, USB）参数化积分核，并基于平移不变 PDE 离散化的离散格林函数具有线性动力系统结构这一理论发现，证明核在 USB 中可紧凑表示。通过只学习快速衰减特征值的谱系数，SFO 实现高效表示。在六个基准（包括反应扩散、流体动力学和 3D 电磁学）上，SFO 达到最先进精度，相比强基线平均降低误差达 40%，同时使用更少参数。
Motivation: 现有神经算子在高效捕获 PDE 解映射中的长程非局部相互作用方面存在困难。
Method: SFO 采用固定全局正交基（USB）参数化核，该基来自谱滤波理论中希尔伯特矩阵的特征模态。利用离散格林函数的 LDS 结构证明核可紧凑表示，仅学习快速衰减特征值的谱系数。
Result: 在六个基准上，SFO 达到最先进精度，误差降低高达 40%，参数更少。
Conclusion: SFO 通过谱滤波和紧凑核表示，实现了高效准确的 PDE 算子学习，适用于多种物理系统。
Relevance: 50

papers.title: PUMA: Perception-driven Unified Foothold Prior for Mobility Augmented Quadruped Parkour
papers.abstract_en: Parkour tasks for quadrupeds have emerged as a promising benchmark for agile locomotion. While human athletes can effectively perceive environmental characteristics to select appropriate footholds for obstacle traversal, endowing legged robots with similar perceptual reasoning remains a significant challenge. Existing methods often rely on hierarchical controllers that follow pre-computed footholds, thereby constraining the robot's real-time adaptability and the exploratory potential of reinforcement learning. To overcome these challenges, we present PUMA, an end-to-end learning framework that integrates visual perception and foothold priors into a single-stage training process. This approach leverages terrain features to estimate egocentric polar foothold priors, composed of relative distance and heading, guiding the robot in active posture adaptation for parkour tasks. Extensive experiments conducted in simulation and real-world environments across various discrete complex terrains, demonstrate PUMA's exceptional agility and robustness in challenging scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PUMA，一个端到端学习框架，将视觉感知和落脚点先验知识整合到单阶段训练过程中，用于四足机器人跑酷任务。该方法利用地形特征估计以自我为中心的极坐标落脚点先验（相对距离和航向），指导机器人主动调整姿态。在仿真和真实世界多种离散复杂地形上的实验表明，PUMA在挑战性场景中表现出卓越的敏捷性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有四足机器人跑酷方法常依赖分层控制器遵循预计算落脚点，限制了机器人的实时适应性和强化学习的探索潜力。
Method: 提出PUMA框架，通过端到端训练将视觉感知和落脚点先验结合，利用地形特征估计极坐标落脚点先验（相对距离和航向），引导机器人主动姿态调整。
Result: 在仿真和真实世界多种离散复杂地形上的实验表明，PUMA在挑战性场景中表现出卓越的敏捷性和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: PUMA通过将感知和先验集成到单阶段训练，提升了四足机器人跑酷的适应性和性能，但未提及局限性。

papers.title: HyperNet-Adaptation for Diffusion-Based Test Case Generation
papers.abstract_en: The increasing deployment of deep learning systems requires systematic evaluation of their reliability in real-world scenarios. Traditional gradient-based adversarial attacks introduce small perturbations that rarely correspond to realistic failures and mainly assess robustness rather than functional behavior. Generative test generation methods offer an alternative but are often limited to simple datasets or constrained input domains. Although diffusion models enable high-fidelity image synthesis, their computational cost and limited controllability restrict their applicability to large-scale testing. We present HyNeA, a generative testing method that enables direct and efficient control over diffusion-based generation. HyNeA provides dataset-free controllability through hypernetworks, allowing targeted manipulation of the generative process without relying on architecture-specific conditioning mechanisms or dataset-driven adaptations such as fine-tuning. HyNeA employs a distinct training strategy that supports instance-level tuning to identify failure-inducing test cases without requiring datasets that explicitly contain examples of similar failures. This approach enables the targeted generation of realistic failure cases at substantially lower computational cost than search-based methods. Experimental results show that HyNeA improves controllability and test diversity compared to existing generative test generators and generalizes to domains where failure-labeled training data is unavailable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyNeA，一种基于超网络 (hypernetwork) 的扩散模型测试用例生成方法，无需数据集或微调即可实现实例级可控生成，显著降低计算成本并提高测试多样性。实验表明，该方法在控制性和多样性上优于现有生成测试方法，并能泛化到无故障标注数据的领域。
Motivation: 现有生成测试方法多依赖数据集驱动或架构特定条件机制，计算成本高且难以控制；传统对抗攻击生成不现实故障，且主要评估鲁棒性而非功能行为。
Method: HyNeA 通过超网络直接控制扩散模型的生成过程，支持实例级调优以识别引发故障的测试用例，无需显式故障样本数据集。
Result: 摘要报告 HyNeA 相比现有生成测试方法提升了可控制性和测试多样性，且计算成本显著低于搜索方法。
Conclusion: HyNeA 为扩散模型生成测试提供了高效、可控的方案，尤其适用于缺乏故障标注数据的领域。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SplatReasoner: Enhancing Embodied Reasoning and Grounding by Novel View Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning capabilities over images and videos, yet their application to embodied scene understanding often constrained by the fixed viewpoints stored in episodic RGB-D memories. These observations may fail to capture query-relevant evidence due to occlusions, object truncation, restricted fields of view, or suboptimal view composition. We present SplatReasoner, a framework that introduces novel view synthesis into the VLM reasoning process by leveraging 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). Given a user query about a 3D scene, SplatReasoner retrieves relevant observations and synthesizes query-conditioned viewpoints that reveal the visual evidence needed to answer the query and ground the referred entities in 3D. Experiments show that query-conditioned novel view synthesis improves both embodied reasoning and 3D grounding over fixed-view memory and language-embedded 3DGS baselines.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Project page: https://splatreasoner.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SplatReasoner框架，将新视角合成引入视觉语言模型推理，利用3D高斯泼溅(3DGS)根据用户查询生成查询条件化的新视角，从而获取被遮挡或截断的视觉证据，提升具身推理和3D定位能力。实验表明该方法优于固定视角记忆和语言嵌入3DGS基线。
Motivation: 现有VLM在具身场景理解中受限于固定视角的RGB-D记忆，可能因遮挡、对象截断、视场受限或视角组合不佳而无法捕获查询相关证据。
Method: 提出SplatReasoner，结合3D高斯泼溅实现查询条件化的新视角合成，检索相关观测并生成显示查询所需视觉证据的新视角。
Result: 实验证明查询条件化新视角合成在具身推理和3D定位上均优于固定视角记忆和语言嵌入3DGS基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将新视角合成整合到VLM推理中可以有效克服固定视角的局限性。

papers.title: BizFinBench.v2: Towards Reliable LLMs in Finance via Real-User Data and Offline/Online Bilingual Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are becoming increasingly significant in financial applications. Nevertheless, prevailing benchmarks are largely dependent on simulated or generic data, which leads to a significant gap between reported performance and actual efficacy in real-world scenarios. To tackle this challenge, we present BizFinBench.v2, the first integrated offline and online benchmark built upon authentic user query-response data from both Chinese and U.S. equity markets. It comprises 28,860 questions across eight offline and two online tasks. Experimental results show that GPT-5 achieves a mere 61.5% accuracy, still failing to meet the practical business requirement (84.8%). Among the evaluated commercial models, DeepSeek-R1 exhibits superior investment efficacy. Error analysis grounded in real financial practice reveals persistent limitations in existing models. By overcoming the constraints of prior benchmarks, BizFinBench.v2 provides a substantiated foundation for advancing LLM deployment in the financial sector. Our data and code are available at https://github.com/HiThink-Research/BizFinBench.v2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BizFinBench.v2 是基于真实用户查询-响应数据构建的首个集成离线和在线金融基准，涵盖中美股票市场，包含28,860个问题。实验表明GPT-5准确率仅61.5%，远低于实际业务需求（84.8%），DeepSeek-R1在商业模型中表现最优。错误分析揭示了现有模型在金融实践中的持续局限性。
Motivation: 现有金融LLM基准多依赖模拟或通用数据，导致报告性能与实际部署效果之间存在显著差距。
Method: 使用来自中美股票市场的真实用户查询-响应数据，构建包含8项离线任务和2项在线任务的28,860个问题，形成首个集成离线和在线的金融基准。
Result: GPT-5准确率为61.5%，未达到实际业务需求的84.8%；DeepSeek-R1在商业模型中投资效能最优。
Conclusion: BizFinBench.v2通过克服先前基准的局限，为推进LLM在金融领域的部署提供了有实证基础的支持。

papers.title: Do Implicit Personalization and Explicit Styles Conflict? PsPLUG: A Lightweight Plug-in for Balancing Personalization and Style in Customized LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Personalized large language models are often expected to follow explicit style instructions, yet we find that such instructions can undermine the user-specific characteristics that personalization methods aim to preserve. We call this failure mode personalization collapse: explicit style control can conflict with implicit user preferences. To address this challenge, we propose PsPLUG, a lightweight plug-in that learns a user-specific residual after accounting for the requested style. PsPLUG also allows us to tune personalization strength at inference time. Our experiments show that explicit style instructions can diminish personalization in existing methods, whereas PsPLUG better preserves user preferences while providing precise control over the balance between personalization and style adherence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现显式风格指令会削弱个性化LLM中的用户特征（称为个性化崩溃），提出PsPLUG插件，学习用户特定残差以平衡个性化和风格。实验表明PsPLUG能更好地保留用户偏好。
Motivation: 显式风格指令与隐式用户偏好冲突导致个性化崩溃（personalization collapse）。
Method: PsPLUG是一个轻量级插件，学习用户特定残差（在考虑风格要求后），并在推理时允许调整个性化强度。
Result: 实验表明现有方法中显式风格指令会削弱个性化，而PsPLUG能更好地保留用户偏好并提供精确控制。
Conclusion: PsPLUG有效平衡个性化和风格，且为轻量级插件。

papers.title: NMIRacle: Multi-modal Generative Molecular Elucidation from IR and NMR Spectra
papers.abstract_en: Molecular structure elucidation from spectroscopic data is a long-standing challenge in Chemistry, traditionally requiring expert interpretation. We introduce NMIRacle, a two-stage generative framework that builds upon recent paradigms in AI-driven spectroscopy with minimal assumptions. In the first stage, NMIRacle learns to reconstruct molecular structures from count-aware fragment representations, capturing both fragment identities and their occurrences. In the second stage, a spectral encoder maps input spectra (IR, 1H-NMR, 13C-NMR) into a latent embedding used to condition the pre-trained generator, which is fine-tuned for direct spectra-to-molecule generation. This formulation bridges fragment-level chemical modeling with spectral evidence, yielding accurate molecular predictions. Empirical results demonstrate that NMIRacle outperforms existing baselines on molecular elucidation, while maintaining robust performance across increasing levels of molecular complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NMIRacle，一个两阶段生成框架，用于从红外和核磁共振光谱数据推断分子结构。第一阶段学习从计数感知的片段表示重建分子结构，第二阶段使用光谱编码器将输入光谱映射到潜在嵌入，以调节预训练的生成器，实现光谱到分子的直接生成。实验表明NMIRacle在分子解析上优于基线。
Motivation: 从光谱数据推断分子结构是化学中长期存在的挑战，传统上需要专家解释，缺乏自动化和高精度方法。
Method: 两阶段生成框架：第一阶段训练分子结构重建模型，基于片段计数表示；第二阶段引入光谱编码器，将IR、1H-NMR、13C-NMR光谱编码为潜在嵌入，微调预训练生成器以条件生成分子。
Result: 实验表明NMIRacle在分子解析任务上优于现有基线，并在不同分子复杂度下保持稳健性能。
Conclusion: NMIRacle通过结合片段级化学建模和光谱证据，实现了准确的光谱到分子生成，为自动分子结构解析提供了有效方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Emotion Recognition in Signers
papers.abstract_en: Recognition of signers' emotions suffers from one theoretical challenge and one practical challenge, namely, the overlap between grammatical and affective facial expressions and the scarcity of data for model training. This paper addresses these two challenges in a cross-lingual setting using our eJSL dataset, a new benchmark dataset for emotion recognition in Japanese Sign Language signers, and BOBSL, a large British Sign Language dataset with subtitles. In eJSL, two signers expressed 78 distinct utterances with each of seven different emotional states, resulting in 1,092 video clips. We empirically demonstrate that 1) textual emotion recognition in spoken language mitigates data scarcity in sign language, 2) temporal segment selection has a significant impact, and 3) incorporating hand motion enhances emotion recognition in signers. Finally we establish a stronger baseline than spoken language LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对手语者情感识别中语法与情感面部表情重叠以及数据稀缺的问题，在跨语言设置下利用eJSL数据集（日语手语）和BOBSL（英国手语）提出解决方案。实验表明文本情感识别可缓解数据稀缺、时间片段选择影响显著、加入手部运动可提升识别效果，并建立了比口语大语言模型更强的基线。
Motivation: 手语者情感识别面临两个挑战：语法性表情与情感性表情的混淆，以及带标注手语数据稀缺。本文旨在跨语言场景下解决这些问题。
Method: 使用eJSL数据集（7种情感状态，78段话语，共1092个视频片段）及BOBSL数据集。通过文本情感识别迁移学习缓解数据稀缺，进行时间片段选择，并融合手部运动特征。
Result: 实验表明文本情感识别能缓解数据稀缺，时间片段选择显著影响性能，加入手部运动有效提升识别效果，最终建立的基线超越口语大语言模型。
Conclusion: 摘要强调了跨语言手语情感识别的可行性，并指出文本情感知识、时间片段选择和手部运动是关键因素。未提及明确的局限性。

papers.title: MoLingo: Motion-Language Alignment for Text-to-Human Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce MoLingo, a text-to-motion (T2M) model that generates realistic, lifelike human motion by denoising in a continuous latent space. Recent works perform latent space diffusion, either on the whole latent at once or auto-regressively over multiple latents. In this paper, we study how to make diffusion on continuous motion latents work best. We focus on two questions: (1) how to build a semantically aligned latent space so diffusion becomes more effective, and (2) how to best inject text conditioning so the motion follows the description closely. We propose a semantic-aligned motion encoder trained with frame-level text labels so that latents with similar text meaning stay close, which makes the latent space more diffusion-friendly. We also compare single-token conditioning with a multi-token cross-attention scheme and find that cross-attention gives better motion realism and text-motion alignment. With semantically aligned latents, auto-regressive generation, and cross-attention text conditioning, our model sets a new state of the art in human motion generation on standard metrics and in a user study. We will release our code and models for further research and downstream usage.
papers.comment: Accepted by CVPR 2026. Project page: https://hynann.github.io/molingo/MoLingo.html. Title type fixed, content unchanged
papers.journal_ref: Proc. IEEE/CVF Conf. Comput. Vis. Pattern Recogn. (CVPR), 2026, pp. 38387-38398
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoLingo 是一种文本到人体运动生成模型，通过在连续潜在空间中去噪生成逼真的人体运动。模型采用语义对齐的运动编码器（利用帧级文本标签训练）和多 token 交叉注意力文本条件注入，结合自回归生成，在标准指标和用户研究中达到新的最优性能。
Motivation: 现有潜在空间扩散方法在文本到人体运动生成中效果受限于潜在空间的语义对齐和文本条件注入方式，本文研究如何构建更有效的连续运动潜在空间扩散，重点解决语义对齐和文本条件注入两个问题。
Method: 提出语义对齐的运动编码器，使用帧级文本标签训练使得语义相近的潜在表示距离更近；比较了单 token 条件与多 token 交叉注意力方案，发现交叉注意力能提升运动真实感和文本-运动对齐。整体采用自回归生成和交叉注意力文本条件。
Result: 在标准人体运动生成指标和用户研究中达到新的最优性能。
Conclusion: 语义对齐的潜在空间和交叉注意力文本条件注入能够显著改善连续潜在空间扩散在文本到人体运动生成中的效果。

papers.title: An Elementary Proof of the Near Optimality of LogSumExp Smoothing
papers.abstract_en: We consider the design of smoothings of the (coordinate-wise) max function in $\mathbb{R}^d$ in the infinity norm. The LogSumExp function $f(x)=\ln(\sum^d_i\exp(x_i))$ provides a classical smoothing, differing from the max function in value by at most $\ln(d)$. We provide an elementary construction of a lower bound, establishing that every overestimating smoothing of the max function must differ by at least $\sim 0.8145\ln(d)$. Hence, LogSumExp is optimal up to small constant factors. However, we provide strictly stronger smoothings showing the entropy-based LogSumExp approach is not exactly optimal. In small dimensions, we propose exactly optimal smoothings, attaining our lower bound.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在无穷范数下对坐标wise最大值函数的平滑，LogSumExp平滑误差上界为ln(d)。通过初等下界构造，证明每个过估计平滑必须与最大值函数相差至少约0.8145 ln(d)，因此LogSumExp在常数因子内最优。但文章也给出了严格更强的平滑，并提出了小维度下的精确最优平滑。
Motivation: 评估LogSumExp平滑在最大值函数平滑中的最优性，确定其误差下界，并探索是否存在更优的平滑方法。
Method: 提供了一个初等构造的下界证明，表明任何过估计平滑的误差至少为~0.8145 ln(d)。同时给出了比LogSumExp更强的平滑，以及在小维度下达到下界的精确最优平滑。
Result: 得到误差下界~0.8145 ln(d)，证明LogSumExp在常数因子内最优，但非精确最优；小维度下存在精确最优平滑。
Conclusion: LogSumExp平滑近似最优，但熵方法并非精确最优；小维度下可以构造严格达到下界的平滑。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CUDA-L2: Surpassing cuBLAS Performance for Matrix Multiplication through Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose CUDA-L2, a system that combines large language models (LLMs) and reinforcement learning (RL) to automatically optimize Half-precision General Matrix Multiply (HGEMM) CUDA kernels. Using CUDA execution speed as the RL reward, CUDA-L2 automatically optimizes HGEMM kernels across 1,000 configurations. CUDA-L2 systematically outperforms major matmul baselines to date, from the widely-used torch.matmul to state-of-the-art Nvidia's closed-source libraries, i.e., cuBLAS, cuBLASLt. In offline mode, where kernels are executed consecutively without time intervals, CUDA-L2 yields +22.0% over torch.matmul on average; +19.2% over cuBLAS using the optimal layout configuration (normal-normal NN and transposed-normal TN); +16.8% over cuBLASLt-heuristic, which queries cuBLASLt library and selects the algorithm based on the heuristic's suggestion; and +11.4% over the most competitive cuBLASLt-AutoTuning model, which selects the fastest algorithm from up to 100 candidates from cuBLASLt's suggestions. In server mode, where kernels are executed at random intervals simulating real-time inference, the speedups further increase to +28.7%, +26.0%, +22.4%, and +15.9% for torch.matmul, cuBLAS, cuBLASLt-heuristic, and cuBLASLt-AutoTuning respectively. CUDA-L2 shows that even the most performance-critical, heavily-optimized kernels like HGEMM can be improved through LLM-guided RL automation by systematically exploring configuration spaces at scales impractical for humans. Project and code can be found at github.com/deepreinforce-ai/CUDA-L2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CUDA-L2，一个结合大语言模型（LLM）和强化学习（RL）的系统，用于自动优化半精度通用矩阵乘法（HGEMM）的CUDA内核。该系统在1000种配置下自动搜索最优内核，在离线和服务器模式下均显著超越torch.matmul、cuBLAS、cuBLASLt等基线，最高提升达28.7%。
Motivation: 现有高性能矩阵乘法库（如cuBLAS）虽经高度优化，但其配置空间巨大，人工调优难以覆盖所有场景，且自动调优方法仍存在提升空间。
Method: 使用LLM生成候选内核配置，以CUDA执行速度为RL奖励信号，通过强化学习在1000种配置中自动搜索最优HGEMM内核。
Result: 离线模式下，CUDA-L2平均提速：torch.matmul +22.0%，cuBLAS +19.2%，cuBLASLt-heuristic +16.8%，cuBLASLt-AutoTuning +11.4%；服务器模式下提速提升至+28.7%、+26.0%、+22.4%、+15.9%。
Conclusion: 即使是最性能关键、高度优化的HGEMM内核，也能通过LLM引导的RL自动化在人类难以企及的配置规模下进一步改进。

papers.title: GeoWorld: Providing Full-frame Geometry Features to Facilitate 3D Scene Generation
papers.abstract_en: Previous works that leverage video models for image-to-3D scene generation often suffer from geometric distortions and blurry content. Using video generation models to implicitly maintain geometric consistency according to a single-frame input is ineffective. In this paper, we present a two-stage method, named $\textbf{GeoWorld}$, that renovates the image-to-3D scene generation pipeline by providing full-frame geometry features. The first-stage video generation model, followed by a multi-view geometry model, produces $\textbf{full-frame}$ geometry features, which are then used as a mental draft of geometric conditions to aid the second-stage video-generation model. A geometric loss is proposed to impose real-world geometric constraints, and a geometry adaptation module is introduced to ensure the effective utilization of geometry features. Thanks to full-frame geometric modeling, the two smaller video models in our two-stage method can generate higher-fidelity 3D scenes than SOTA methods, while being even faster, e.g. 7.5$\times$ faster than Hunyuan-Voyager. Project page: https://peaes.github.io/GeoWorld.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出两阶段方法 GeoWorld，通过为图像到3D场景生成提供全帧几何特征来解决几何畸变和内容模糊问题。第一阶段视频生成模型结合多视图几何模型生成全帧几何特征，作为几何条件辅助第二阶段视频生成模型，并引入几何损失和几何适应模块。该方法在3D场景生成上比SOTA方法更快（例如比Hunyuan-Voyager快7.5倍）且生成质量更高。
Motivation: 现有基于视频模型的图像到3D场景生成方法常因单帧输入难以维持几何一致性而导致几何畸变和内容模糊。
Method: 提出两阶段流水线：第一阶段使用视频生成模型生成多视角图像，再由多视图几何模型提取全帧几何特征；第二阶段视频生成模型利用这些特征，并加入几何损失和几何适应模块以增强几何约束。
Result: 摘要报告GeoWorld生成的3D场景保真度超过SOTA方法，且推理速度更快，例如比Hunyuan-Voyager快7.5倍。
Conclusion: 全帧几何建模使得两个较小的视频模型能够生成高质量3D场景，验证了显式几何条件对视频模型的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Enhancing Adversarial Transferability through Block Stretch and Shrink
papers.abstract_en: Input transformation-based attacks improve adversarial transferability by aggregating gradients over transformed inputs. Existing analyses mainly explain their efficacy from image diversity, semantic preservation, attention variance or hypothesis space augmentation, yet overlook the critical role of model frontend responses. In this paper, we revisit transformation-based attacks from an implicit ensemble perspective: each transformation can be viewed as a pre-processing operator before the surrogate model, inducing a distinct frontend response for gradient aggregation. Based on this view, we propose FRO, a Frontend Response-Oriented input transformation method that enriches such responses through two complementary operators. The Local Scaling Operator perturbs local content sampling via block-wise stretch-and-shrink operations, while the Projection Operator modifies global spatial organization through coherent perspective deformation. Together, they produce structured transformed views to optimize transferable adversarial perturbations. Experiments on an ImageNet subset show that FRO consistently improves black-box transferability across diverse CNN and Vision Transformer models. We further analyze the effect of implicit ensemble size and evaluate different transformation-based methods under a unified ensemble scale, demonstrating the superiority of designing input transformations from the perspective of front-end response ensembles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FRO，一种前端响应导向的输入变换方法，通过局部缩放算子（块拉伸与收缩）和投影算子（透视变形）增强对抗迁移性。在 ImageNet 子集上，FRO 一致提升跨 CNN 和 Vision Transformer 模型的黑盒迁移性，并从隐式集成视角解释了输入变换的有效性。
Motivation: 现有输入变换攻击主要从图像多样性、语义保持等角度解释其有效性，忽略了模型前端响应。本文重新审视变换攻击为隐式集成，每个变换可视为代理模型前的预处理算子，从而产生不同的前端响应用于梯度聚合。
Method: 提出 FRO 方法，包含两个互补算子：局部缩放算子通过块级拉伸与收缩扰动局部内容采样；投影算子通过一致透视变形改变全局空间组织。二者共同产生结构化的变换视图以优化可迁移的对抗扰动。
Result: 在 ImageNet 子集上，FRO 一致提升了针对多种 CNN 和 Vision Transformer 模型的黑盒迁移性。进一步分析了隐式集成大小的影响，并在统一集成尺度下比较了不同变换方法，证明了从前端响应集成角度设计输入变换的优越性。
Conclusion: 从隐式集成的视角重新审视输入变换，并提出了面向前端响应的变换方法 FRO，通过丰富前端响应提升对抗迁移性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sat2RealCity: Geometry-Aware and Appearance-Controllable 3D Urban Generation from Satellite Imagery
papers.abstract_en: 3D urban generation from satellite imagery is an important task for scalable digital twins and real-world simulation environments. Existing approaches primarily rely on scene-level generation paradigms, which often require large-scale 3D city assets and struggle with controllability, geographic alignment, and realistic appearance grounding in real-world urban environments. To address these limitations, we present Sat2RealCity, a grounded urban generation framework that leverages object-level 3D generative priors for scalable city synthesis from satellite imagery. Our framework decomposes cities into geographically grounded building entities, enabling the reuse of pretrained object-level 3D generative priors while preserving real-world spatial structures. Supported by our constructed BuildVerse3D dataset, (1) we introduce an OpenStreetMap (OSM)-guided spatial grounding strategy to inject geospatial constraints into the 3D generation process; (2) we design an appearance-guided controllable generation mechanism for realistic architectural appearance and regional style consistency; and (3) we construct an MLLM-powered semantic pipeline for regional appearance understanding and semantic-aware appearance synthesis. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Sat2RealCity achieves strong geographic alignment, regional stylistic consistency, and plausible urban asset synthesis compared with existing urban generation and 3D asset generation approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出Sat2RealCity框架，从卫星图像生成地理对齐且外观可控的3D城市。通过分解为建筑实体、利用OpenStreetMap注入空间约束、设计外观引导生成机制，并引入MLLM语义管线，实现真实空间结构与外观一致性。在BuildVerse3D数据集上训练和评估，相比现有方法取得更好的地理对齐和区域风格一致性。
Motivation: 现有场景级3D城市生成方法依赖大规模城市资产，难以实现可控性、地理对齐和真实外观接地。
Method: 将城市分解为地理定位的建筑实体，重用预训练的对象级3D生成先验；采用OSM引导的空间接地策略注入地理约束；设计外观引导的生成机制实现真实外观和区域风格一致；构建MLLM驱动的语义管线用于区域外观理解和语义感知合成。
Result: 实验表明，Sat2RealCity相比现有城市生成和3D资产生成方法，在地理对齐、区域风格一致性和城市资产合成方面表现更优。
Conclusion: 通过对象级生成和语义引导，实现了从卫星图像到可控、地理对齐的3D城市生成，为数字孪生和仿真提供可行方案。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: From Hindsight to Foresight: Self-Encouraged Hindsight Distillation for Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering (KBVQA) necessitates external knowledge incorporation beyond cross-modal understanding. Existing KBVQA methods either utilize implicit knowledge in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) via in-context learning or explicit knowledge via retrieval augmented generation. However, their reasoning processes remain implicit, without explicit multi-step trajectories from MLLMs. To address this gap, we provide a Hindsight Distilled Reasoning (HinD) framework with Knowledge Encouragement Preference Optimization, aiming at self-encouraging the knowledge reasoning ability inside the MLLM. First, we construct the Hindsight Teacher by prompting the MLLM to complete the reasoning process with knowing the right answer, obtaining Hindsight-Zero training data. Then, the Foresight Student, without knowing the answer, learns the golden trajectories from Hindsight: (1) Hindsight Distillation Fine-Tuning (HDFT) to self-distill the Hindsight-Zero into a modularized Chain-of-Thought (CoT) Generator and a Knowledge Generator for sequential steps and discrete facts generation, respectively; (2) Knowledge Encouragement Preference Optimization (KEPO) to encourage the under-confident but relevant knowledge inside the MLLM and suppress the over-confident but irrelevant one. Experiments on OK-VQA and A-OKVQA validate the effectiveness of HinD, showing that HinD with 7-8B MLLM achieves superior performance without commercial model APIs or retrieved knowledge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Hindsight Distilled Reasoning (HinD)框架，通过后见之明蒸馏和知识鼓励偏好优化，增强多模态大模型在知识型视觉问答中的显式推理能力。在OK-VQA和A-OKVQA上，使用7-8B模型实现了无需商用API或检索知识的优越性能。
Motivation: 现有KBVQA方法推理过程隐式，缺乏显式多步推理轨迹；MLLM虽能利用隐式或显式知识，但难以自我激励内部知识推理能力。
Method: 构建后见之明教师（Hindsight Teacher）生成Hindsight-Zero训练数据，再通过前见学生（Foresight Student）学习：1) 后见之明蒸馏微调（HDFT）将数据蒸馏为模块化CoT生成器和知识生成器；2) 知识鼓励偏好优化（KEPO）鼓励模型对正确但低置信知识，抑制错误但高置信知识。
Result: 在OK-VQA和A-OKVQA上，7-8B MLLM的HinD方法达到先进性能，且无需商用API或检索知识。
Conclusion: 本文强调通过后见之明蒸馏和偏好优化可以激发MLLM内部的知识推理能力，为KBVQA提供可解释的显式推理路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Enabling Agents to Communicate Entirely in Latent Space
papers.abstract_en: While natural language is the de facto communication medium for LLM-based agents, it presents a fundamental constraint. The process of downsampling rich, internal latent states into discrete tokens inherently limits the depth and nuance of information that can be transmitted, thereby hindering collaborative problem-solving. Inspired by telepathy, which bypasses symbolic language in communication, we propose Interlat (Inter-agent Latent Space Communication), a paradigm that leverages the continuous last hidden states of an LLM as a representation of its thought for direct communication (termed latent communication). An additional learned compression process further compresses latent communication via latent space reasoning. Experiments demonstrate that Interlat outperforms both fine-tuned chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting and single-agent baselines, even across heterogeneous models, promoting more exploratory behavior and enabling genuine utilization of latent information. Further compression not only substantially accelerates inference by up to 24 times but also maintains competitive performance through an efficient information-preserving mechanism. We position this work as a feasibility study of entirely latent space inter-agent communication, and our results highlight its potential, offering valuable insights for future research. Our code is available at https://github.com/XiaoDu-flying/Interlat.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Interlat，一种让 LLM 智能体完全在连续潜空间进行通信的范式，将模型最后的隐藏状态作为思维表示直接传递，并学习额外的压缩过程。实验表明，Interlat 在异构模型间也优于微调链式思维提示和单智能体基线，且压缩推理可加速高达 24 倍而保持竞争力。作者将此定位为全潜空间智能体间通信的可行性研究。
Motivation: 基于自然语言的智能体通信将丰富的内部潜状态降采样为离散词元，限制了信息深度和协作求解能力。
Method: 提出 Interlat 范式，使用 LLM 最后的连续隐藏状态作为思维表示直接通信（潜通信），并通过一个额外的学习压缩过程利用潜空间推理来压缩通信。
Result: Interlat 在异构模型上也优于微调 CoT 提示和单智能体基线，并促进更具探索性的行为；进一步压缩推理速度提升达 24 倍，同时通过信息保持机制维持竞争性性能。
Conclusion: 本文作为全潜空间智能体间通信的可行性研究，展示了潜通信的潜力，为未来研究提供了见解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Controllably Efficient Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The substantial inference costs of attention in transformers motivated the development of efficient sequence mixers: namely sparse and sliding window attention, convolutions and linear attention. Although these approaches result in impressive reductions in inference costs, they often trade-off with quality, specifically in-context recall. Apriori fixing this quality-cost tradeoff at training time means being suboptimal from the get-go: some downstream applications might fundamentally require more memory for in-context recall, while other tasks may require lower latency and memory. We propose a conceptually simple meta-sequence mixer with inference-cost controllability: the Compress & Attend Transformer (CAT). CAT decodes chunks of tokens by attending to compressed chunks of the sequence so far. Both compression and decoding can use any existing sequence mixer. Decoding from the compressed sequence yields compute and memory savings, with chunk size setting the operating point on the quality-cost trade-off. Importantly, training CAT across multiple chunk sizes at once unlocks test-time control of this trade-off without any retraining, all in a single model. Instantiated with the most basic choice, dense attention as the mixer, CAT surprisingly suffices to match 10 popular and diverse efficient models (linear, hybrids, sparse) on real-world long-context recall at comparable inference costs, all from a single trained model. CAT further performs competitively on long-context understanding benchmarks while providing 1.4-3.7x higher generation throughput than a dense transformer. Code is at: https://github.com/rajesh-lab/cat-transformer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出压缩与注意力Transformer（CAT），一种可通过推理时控制质量-成本权衡的序列混合器。CAT将序列压缩为块，解码时仅需关注压缩块，使用块大小控制计算与内存节省。单模型训练多个块大小后可在测试时无需重训练切换权衡。以基础密集注意力实例化的CAT在长上下文召回任务上匹配10种高效模型，并在长上下文理解基准上具有竞争力，生成吞吐量比密集Transformer提升1.4-3.7倍。
Motivation: 现有高效序列混合器（稀疏/滑动窗口注意力、卷积、线性注意力）在减少推理成本的同时往往牺牲质量，特别是在上下文召回能力上。预先固定质量-成本权衡会导致对不同下游任务次优。需要一种可动态控制该权衡的方法。
Method: 提出Compress & Attend Transformer (CAT)，将序列分块，对每个块进行压缩（使用任意序列混合器），解码时仅关注压缩后的表示。训练时同时学习多个块大小，实现测试时无需重训练的质量-成本控制。
Result: 以密集注意力作为混合器的单个CAT模型在长上下文召回任务上匹配10种不同高效模型（线性、混合、稀疏），并在长上下文理解基准上表现竞争，同时提供比密集Transformer高1.4-3.7倍的生成吞吐量。
Conclusion: CAT通过简单的压缩-解码框架和训练时多块大小策略，实现了推理时可控的效率和性能权衡，无需重新训练即可适应不同需求。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Online conformal inference with retrospective adjustment for faster adaptation to distribution shift
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction has emerged as a powerful framework for constructing distribution-free prediction sets with guaranteed coverage assuming only the exchangeability assumption. However, this assumption is often violated in online environments where data distributions evolve over time. Several recent approaches have been proposed to address this limitation, but, typically, they slowly adapt to distribution shifts because they update predictions only in a forward manner, that is, they generate a prediction for a newly observed data point while previously computed predictions are not updated. In this paper, we propose a novel online conformal inference method with retrospective adjustment, which is designed to achieve faster adaptation to distributional shifts. Our method leverages regression approaches with efficient leave-one-out update formulas to retroactively adjust past predictions when new data arrive, thereby aligning the entire set of predictions with the most recent data distribution. Through extensive numerical studies performed on both synthetic and real-world data sets, we show that the proposed approach achieves coverage close to the nominal level while reducing predictive interval width by up to approximately 30\% compared to existing online conformal prediction methods, demonstrating improved statistical efficiency alongside faster adaptation.
papers.journal_ref: Pattern Recognition, Volume 180, Part D, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对在线环境中数据分布漂移导致共形预测（conformal prediction）覆盖保证失效的问题，提出一种带有回溯调整（retrospective adjustment）的在线共形推断方法。该方法利用高效留一法更新公式，在新数据到达时回溯调整历史预测，使整个预测集与最新数据分布对齐。合成和真实数据实验表明，该方法在保持接近名义覆盖水平的同时，将预测区间宽度较现有方法降低约30%，实现更快的适应速度和更高的统计效率。
Motivation: 现有在线共形预测方法仅在正向更新预测，对分布漂移适应缓慢，因为先前计算的预测不会被更新，导致覆盖退化。
Method: 提出一种在线共形推断方法，结合回归方法与高效的留一法更新公式，在新数据到达时回溯调整历史预测，使所有预测与最新分布对齐。
Result: 在合成和真实数据上，该方法达到接近名义水平的覆盖，并将预测区间宽度较现有在线共形预测方法降低约30%。
Conclusion: 回溯调整机制能显著加快对分布漂移的适应，同时提高统计效率。
Relevance: 0
