summary_sections.motivation: 现有在线共形预测方法仅在正向更新预测，对分布漂移适应缓慢，因为先前计算的预测不会被更新，导致覆盖退化。
summary_sections.method: 提出一种在线共形推断方法，结合回归方法与高效的留一法更新公式，在新数据到达时回溯调整历史预测，使所有预测与最新分布对齐。
summary_sections.result: 在合成和真实数据上，该方法达到接近名义水平的覆盖，并将预测区间宽度较现有在线共形预测方法降低约30%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 回溯调整机制能显著加快对分布漂移的适应，同时提高统计效率。

papers.title: Redundancy Maximization as a Principle of Associative Memory Learning in Hopfield Networks
papers.abstract_en: Associative memory, traditionally modeled by Hopfield networks, enables the retrieval of previously stored patterns from partial or noisy cues. Yet, the local computational principles which are required to enable this function remain incompletely understood. To formally characterize the local information processing in such systems, we employ a recent extension of information theory -- Partial Information Decomposition (PID). PID decomposes the contribution of different inputs to an output into unique information from each input, redundant information across inputs, and synergistic information that emerges from combining different inputs. Applying this framework to individual neurons in classical Hopfield networks we find that below the memory capacity, the information in a neuron's activity is characterized by high redundancy between the external pattern input and the internal recurrent input, while synergy and unique information are close to zero until the memory capacity is surpassed and performance drops steeply. Inspired by this observation, we use redundancy maximization at each neuron as an information-theoretic learning goal. This dramatically increases the network's memory capacity to 1.59, a more than tenfold improvement over the 0.14 capacity of classical Hopfield networks, and also outperforming recent state-of-the-art implementations of Hopfield networks. Overall, this work establishes redundancy maximization as a new design principle for associative memories and opens pathways for new associative memory models based on information-theoretic goals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用部分信息分解（Partial Information Decomposition, PID）分析经典Hopfield网络中单个神经元的信息处理，发现低于记忆容量时神经元活动主要表现为外部模式输入与内部循环输入之间的高冗余信息，而协同与独特信息接近零。受此启发，提出以每个神经元的冗余最大化为信息论学习目标，将网络记忆容量从经典Hopfield网络的0.14大幅提升至1.59，超越近期最先进的Hopfield网络实现。
Motivation: 联想记忆的局部计算原则尚不完全清楚，经典Hopfield网络在记忆容量和检索性能上存在瓶颈。
Method: 应用部分信息分解（PID）分析神经元信息成分，并基于观察到的冗余特性，将每个神经元的冗余最大化作为信息论学习目标来训练Hopfield网络。
Result: 冗余最大化将记忆容量提升至1.59，相比经典Hopfield网络（0.14）提高超过十倍，且优于近期最优的Hopfield网络变体。
Conclusion: 冗余最大化可作为联想记忆的新设计原则，为基于信息论目标的新型联想记忆模型开辟路径。

papers.title: Incomplete U-Statistics of Equireplicate Designs: Berry-Esseen Bound and Efficient Construction
papers.abstract_en: U-statistics are a fundamental class of estimators that generalize the sample mean and underpin much of nonparametric statistics. Although extensively studied in both statistics and probability, key challenges remain: their high computational cost - addressed partly through incomplete U-statistics - and their non-standard asymptotic behavior in the degenerate case, which typically requires resampling methods for hypothesis testing. This paper presents a novel perspective on U-statistics, grounded in hypergraph theory and combinatorial designs. Our approach bypasses the traditional Hoeffding decomposition, the main analytical tool in this literature but one that is highly sensitive to degeneracy. By characterizing the dependence structure of a U-statistic, we derive a Berry-Esseen bound valid for incomplete U-statistics of deterministic designs, yielding conditions under which Gaussian limiting distributions can be established even in degenerate cases and when the order diverges. We also introduce efficient algorithms to construct incomplete U-statistics based on equireplicate designs, a subclass of deterministic designs that, in certain cases, achieve minimum variance. Beyond its theoretical contributions, our framework provides a systematic way to construct permutation-free counterparts to tests based on degenerate U-statistics, as demonstrated in experiments with kernel-based tests using the Maximum Mean Discrepancy and the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文从超图理论和组合设计角度重新审视U-统计量，为不完全U-统计量推导了Berry-Esseen界，并在退化情况下和阶数发散时建立高斯极限分布。同时提出了基于等重复设计的高效算法，用于构造最小方差的不完全U-统计量，并将其应用于基于核的检验（如MMD和HSIC）以替代置换检验。
Motivation: U-统计量的高计算成本（部分通过不完全U-统计量解决）以及在退化情况下非标准渐近行为（需要重采样方法）是传统挑战。现有分析工具Hoeffding分解对退化敏感，需要新的视角和方法。
Method: 利用超图理论和组合设计刻画U-统计量的依赖结构，绕过Hoeffding分解；推导出针对确定性设计的不完全U-统计量的Berry-Esseen界；提出基于等重复设计的算法，在某些情况下达到最小方差。
Result: 在退化情况以及阶数发散时，仍能通过Berry-Esseen界建立高斯极限分布；等重复设计的不完全U-统计量在特定条件下具有最小方差；在最大均值差异（MMD）和希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则（HSIC）的核检验实验中展示了无需置换的替代方案。
Conclusion: 该框架为基于退化U-统计量的检验提供了系统性的无置换替代方法，但实验仅限于核方法，且理论结果依赖于确定性设计。

papers.title: Survival of the fittest Cox model: Pivotal variable selection for time-to-event data
papers.abstract_en: We revisit Cox's proportional hazards model to improve variable selection in survival analysis. A square-root transformation of the partial likelihood renders the selection of the regularization parameter pivotal, free of the unknown baseline hazard and censoring mechanism. The resulting criterion borrows from information criteria such as BIC and from penalized regression methods such as the lasso, taking the best of both. On simulated and real data, our method substantially improves upon state-of-the-art approaches used daily in support recovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过部分似然的平方根变换，使正则化参数的选择成为枢轴量（pivotal），独立于未知基线风险函数和删失机制。提出的方法结合了BIC等信息准则和lasso等惩罚回归方法的优点，在模拟和实际数据上显著优于当前常用的支持恢复方法。
Motivation: 生存分析中的变量选择依赖于正则化参数的选择，但现有方法受基线风险函数和删失机制的未知影响，难以实现稳健的模型选择。
Method: 对Cox比例风险模型的部分似然进行平方根变换，得到枢轴化的正则化参数选择准则，融合信息准则与惩罚回归的优势。
Result: 在模拟和实际数据上，该方法在支持恢复方面显著优于当前最先进方法。
Conclusion: 平方根变换使Cox模型的变量选择更加稳定和可靠，避免了基线风险函数和删失机制的影响。

papers.title: Improving Topic Modeling of Social Media Short Texts with Rephrasing: A Case Study of COVID-19 Related Tweets
papers.abstract_en: Social media platforms such as Twitter (now X) provide rich data for analyzing public discourse, especially during crises such as the COVID-19 pandemic. However, the brevity, informality, and noise of social media short texts often hinder the effectiveness of traditional topic modeling, producing incoherent or redundant topics that are often difficult to interpret. To address these challenges, we have developed \emph{TM-Rephrase}, a model-agnostic framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to rephrase raw tweets into more standardized and formal language prior to topic modeling. Using a dataset of 25,027 COVID-19-related Twitter posts, we investigate the effects of two rephrasing strategies, general- and colloquial-to-formal-rephrasing, on multiple topic modeling methods. Results demonstrate that \emph{TM-Rephrase} improves three metrics measuring topic modeling performance (i.e., topic coherence, topic uniqueness, and topic diversity) while reducing topic redundancy of most topic modeling algorithms, with the colloquial-to-formal strategy yielding the greatest performance gains and especially for the Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) algorithm. This study contributes to a model-agnostic approach to enhancing topic modeling in public health related social media analysis, with broad implications for improved understanding of public discourse in health crisis as well as other important domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TM-Rephrase，一个模型无关的框架，利用大型语言模型将社交媒体短文本重述为更正式的语言，以提升主题建模效果。在 25,027 条 COVID-19 相关推文上的实验表明，该方法显著提高了主题一致性、唯一性和多样性，并减少了冗余，尤其是口语到正式的重述策略对 LDA 算法提升最大。
Motivation: 社交媒体短文本的简洁、非正式和噪声特性常导致传统主题建模生成不连贯或冗余的主题，难以解释。
Method: 提出 TM-Rephrase 框架，先使用 LLM 对原始推文进行两种重述（一般重述和口语到正式重述），再应用标准主题建模算法。
Result: 在 25,027 条 COVID-19 推文上，TM-Rephrase 提升了主题一致性、唯一性和多样性三个指标，并减少了主题冗余；口语到正式策略效果最佳，尤其对 LDA 提升显著。
Conclusion: 该研究提供了一种模型无关的方法来增强公共卫生社交媒体的主题建模，对理解健康危机等领域的公众话语有广泛意义。

papers.title: Exact Dynamics of Multi-class Stochastic Gradient Descent
papers.abstract_en: We develop a framework for analyzing the learning dynamics of high-dimensional problems trained using one-pass stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with data from multiple anisotropic classes. Our main theorem provides exact expressions for quantities of interest, including the risk and the overlap with the true signal, in terms of a deterministic system of ODEs, valid in the high-dimensional limit. The theorem holds for a broad class of optimization problems and extends to settings where the number of classes grows with dimension. To illustrate its utility, we investigate in detail the effect of the data's anisotropic structure on the problems of binary logistic regression and least-squares (LS) loss. We study the LS in a linear multiclass setup and derive a learning-rate threshold that depends on the average eigenvalue of the covariance matrices. In the binary logistic regression, we study three cases: isotropic covariances, data covariance matrices with a large fraction of zero eigenvalues (denoted as the zero-one model), and covariance matrices with power-law spectra. We show that a structural phase transition occurs. In particular, for the zero-one model and the power-law model with sufficiently large power, SGD aligns more closely with values of the class mean that are projected onto the ``clean directions'' (i.e., directions of smaller variance). This is supported by analytical studies and numerical simulations, which show the exact asymptotic behavior of the loss in the high-dimensional limit. The effects of data anisotropy that we demonstrate are likely to hold beyond these examples and illustrate one application of the broader theorem that we prove.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个分析高维多类各向异性数据下使用one-pass SGD学习动力学的框架。主要定理给出了风险、与真实信号的重叠等量的精确表达式，通过一个确定性ODE系统描述，适用于高维极限下的一类优化问题。论文详细研究了二元逻辑回归和最小二乘损失，揭示了数据各向异性的结构对学习动力学的影响。
Motivation: 现有理论大多假设数据类别同质或各向同性，缺乏对多类各向异性数据下SGD学习动力学的精确刻画。
Method: 建立了一个分析框架，将高维SGD的学习动态映射到低维确定性ODE系统，并得到风险等量的精确表达式。扩展到类别数随维度增长的情形。
Result: 在最小二乘问题中推导出依赖于协方差矩阵平均特征值的学习率阈值。在二元逻辑回归中发现了结构相变：对于零-一模型和幂律谱模型，SGD更倾向于对齐投影到“干净方向”（小方差方向）的类均值。数值模拟验证了高维极限下的渐近行为。
Conclusion: 定理适用于一类广泛优化问题，展示的数据各向异性效应很可能超越所举例子。

papers.title: Unveiling the Mechanisms of Multi-Hop Reasoning in Transformers via Identity Bridge
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at multi-hop reasoning in distribution, yet fail on unseen compositions, a phenomenon known as the curse of two-hop reasoning. In this work, we argue that this phenomenon can be attributed to a missing supervision on the bridge entity. We formalize this gap by introducing identity bridge, a minimal supervision that enforces a identity mapping on bridge tokens. Under this supervision, even a one-layer transformer with uniform attention (Emb-MLP) can achieve out-of-distribution (OOD) two-hop generalization. We provide a theoretical analysis demonstrating that identity bridge induces an implicit regularization effect, leading the model to establish a direct subject-to-answer association. From an empirical perspective, the performance of standard GPT-2 models aligns closely with simple Emb--MLP models across varying levels of problem complexity. Finally, analyses of fine-tuned mainstream LLMs indicate that correct two-hop predictions consistently coincide with the establishment of a subject-to-answer relationship, extending our findings to realistic settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer在多跳推理中的机制，指出在分布外场景下失败的原因是桥接实体缺乏监督。作者提出identity bridge，在桥接token上强制恒等映射，使得即使单层Transformer（Emb-MLP）也能实现分布外两跳泛化。理论分析表明identity bridge诱导隐式正则化，实验显示GPT-2与Emb-MLP性能一致，且微调后的主流LLM中正确预测与subject-to-answer关系一致。
Motivation: 标准Transformer在分布外两跳推理上失败，现有研究归因于桥接实体监督缺失，但缺乏理论分析和简单解决方案。
Method: 提出identity bridge，即在桥接token上施加恒等映射的最小监督，并利用单层Transformer（Emb-MLP）的均匀注意力机制进行分析。
Result: 单层Emb-MLP在分布外两跳泛化上成功；GPT-2与Emb-MLP性能随问题复杂度变化一致；微调的主流LLM中正确预测与subject-to-answer关系建立完全对应。
Conclusion: identity bridge是一种简单有效的监督信号，可揭示Transformer多跳推理的内在机制，且该机制在真实规模模型中同样成立。

papers.title: Graph Optimization Foundation Model: Tokenizing Graph via A Language-Model Paradigm
papers.abstract_en: The pretrain-transfer paradigm, which underpins the success of large language models (LLMs), has demonstrated the immense power of creating foundation models that learn generalizable representations from vast datasets. However, extending this paradigm to Operations Research (OR) problems on graph structures remains challenging due to the fundamental conflict between the statistical flexibility of language and the strict combinatorial constraints of graphs. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Graph Foundation Model (GFM), the first framework capable of solving all distance-based optimization problems on graph structures. By introducing the LLM-like self-supervised pre-training paradigm on the paths generated from random walks in the graph, GFM is compelled to internalize the graph's complex topological and combinatorial rules, where the connectivity of the structure itself can be treated as the supervisory signal. Unlike existing neural methods that learn complex and task-specific solving policies, our approach leverages the pre-trained GFM as a foundational model of the graph's intrinsic structure, which in turn enables a simple generative heuristic to tackle a diverse range of optimization challenges effectively. Comprehensive experiments on networks ranging from 20 to 893 nodes demonstrate that GFM achieves competitive performance against specialized solvers across a variety of distinct optimization task classes, while maintaining significantly faster inference times. Our work establishes a new paradigm of adapting the pretrain-transfer framework to graph optimization, opening the door for applying foundation model innovations to OR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Graph Foundation Model (GFM)，首个能解决图上所有基于距离的优化问题的框架。通过类似LLM的自监督预训练范式在随机游走生成的路径上训练，使模型内化图的拓扑和组合规则。实验表明在20-893节点网络上，GFM在多种优化任务中达到与专用求解器竞争的性能，且推理更快。
Motivation: 将预训练-迁移范式扩展到图结构上的运筹学问题面临语言统计灵活性与图组合约束的根本冲突，现有神经方法需要复杂、任务特定的求解策略。
Method: 引入类似LLM的自监督预训练范式，在图上随机游走生成的路径上预训练，以结构连通性作为监督信号，使模型内化图的拓扑和组合规则。
Result: 在20-893节点网络上，GFM在多种不同优化任务类中达到与专用求解器竞争的性能，且推理时间显著更快。
Conclusion: 建立了将预训练-迁移框架适应到图优化的新范式，为基础模型创新应用于运筹学打开了大门。

papers.title: Beyond Slater's Condition in Online CMDPs with Stochastic and Adversarial Constraints
papers.abstract_en: We study \emph{online episodic Constrained Markov Decision Processes} (CMDPs) under both stochastic and adversarial constraints. We provide a novel algorithm whose guarantees greatly improve those of the state-of-the-art best-of-both-worlds algorithm introduced by Stradi et al. (2025). In the stochastic regime, \emph{i.e.}, when the constraints are sampled from fixed but unknown distributions, our method achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T})$ regret and constraint violation without relying on Slater's condition, thereby handling settings where no strictly feasible solution exists. Moreover, we provide guarantees on the stronger notion of \emph{positive} constraint violation, which does not allow to recover from large violation in the early episodes by playing strictly safe policies. In the adversarial regime, \emph{i.e.}, when the constraints may change arbitrarily between episodes, our algorithm ensures sublinear constraint violation without Slater's condition, and achieves sublinear $α$-regret with respect to the \emph{unconstrained} optimum, where $α$ is a suitably defined multiplicative approximation factor. We further validate our results through synthetic experiments, showing the practical effectiveness of our algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线情节式约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）在随机和对抗约束下的算法。在随机约束下，无需Slater条件即可达到~O(√T)遗憾和约束违反，并处理了正约束违反的更强概念；在对抗约束下，无需Slater条件实现次线性约束违反和次线性α-遗憾。实验验证了实际有效性。
Motivation: 现有在线CMDP方法大多依赖Slater条件（存在严格可行解），但许多实际场景中不存在严格可行解；此外，正约束违反概念更严格，已有方法无法保证。
Method: 提出一种新型在线算法，同时适用于随机和对抗约束，无需Slater条件，并能够控制正约束违反。
Result: 随机约束下实现~O(√T)遗憾和约束违反；对抗约束下次线性约束违反和α-遗憾。合成实验验证了算法效果。
Conclusion: 本文显著改进了现有best-of-both-worlds结果，移除了Slater条件要求，并提供了正约束违反的保证。

papers.title: KAMERA: Enhancing Aerial Surveys of Ice-associated Seals in Arctic Environments
papers.abstract_en: We introduce KAMERA: a comprehensive system for multi-camera, multi-spectral synchronization and real-time detection of seals and polar bears. Utilized in aerial surveys for ice-associated seals in the Bering, Chukchi, and Beaufort seas around Alaska, KAMERA provides up to an 80% reduction in dataset processing time over previous methods. Our rigorous calibration and hardware synchronization enable using multiple spectra for object detection. All collected data are annotated with metadata so they can be easily referenced later. All imagery and animal detections from a survey are mapped onto a world plane for accurate surveyed area estimates and quick assessment of survey results. We hope KAMERA will inspire other mapping and detection efforts in the scientific community, with all software, models, and schematics fully open-sourced.
papers.journal_ref: 2025 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision Workshops (ICCVW), 2025, pp. 2183-2192
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KAMERA 是一个多相机、多光谱同步与实时检测系统，用于北极冰海豹和北极熊的空中调查。系统通过严格的标定与硬件同步实现多光谱目标检测，所有数据附带元数据，并将检测结果映射到世界平面以估算调查面积。相比传统方法，KAMERA 可减少高达 80% 的数据集处理时间，且所有软件、模型和图纸完全开源。
Motivation: 现有北极冰海豹空中调查依赖大量人工处理图像数据，效率低下。KAMERA 旨在通过自动化多光谱同步与实时检测大幅缩短数据处理时间。
Method: KAMERA 系统集成了多相机硬件同步与标定、多光谱目标检测、元数据标注以及世界平面映射模块，实现端到端的数据采集与处理。
Result: 摘要报告称该系统相比先前方法可减少最多 80% 的数据集处理时间。
Conclusion: 作者希望 KAMERA 的全开源方案能激励其他领域的地图绘制与检测工作。

papers.title: PiCSAR: Probabilistic Confidence Selection And Ranking for Reasoning Chains
papers.abstract_en: Best-of-n sampling improves the accuracy of large language models (LLMs) and large reasoning models (LRMs) by generating multiple candidate solutions and selecting the one with the highest reward. The key challenge for reasoning tasks is designing a scoring function that can identify correct reasoning chains without access to ground-truth answers. We propose Probabilistic Confidence Selection And Ranking (PiCSAR): a simple, training-free method that scores each candidate generation using the joint log-likelihood of the reasoning and final answer. The joint log-likelihood of the reasoning and final answer naturally decomposes into reasoning confidence and answer confidence. PiCSAR achieves substantial gains across diverse benchmarks (+10.18 on MATH500, +9.81 on AIME2025), outperforming baselines with at least 2x fewer samples in 16 out of 20 comparisons. Our analysis reveals that correct reasoning chains exhibit significantly higher reasoning and answer confidence, justifying the effectiveness of PiCSAR.
papers.journal_ref: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PiCSAR，一种无需训练的方法，通过联合对数似然（joint log-likelihood）对推理链和最终答案进行评分，从而在 Best-of-n 采样中选择最佳候选。该方法在 MATH500 和 AIME2025 等推理基准上取得显著提升，且分析表明正确推理链的推理与答案置信度更高。
Motivation: Best-of-n 采样需设计评分函数以在无真实答案时识别正确推理链，现有方法在推理任务中面临挑战。
Method: PiCSAR 使用联合对数似然作为评分函数，自然分解为推理置信度和答案置信度，无需额外训练。
Result: 在 MATH500 上提升 +10.18，在 AIME2025 上提升 +9.81，且在 20 次比较中 16 次以至少 2 倍更少的样本数超越基线。
Conclusion: 论文表明正确推理链具有更高的推理和答案置信度，验证了 PiCSAR 的有效性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: InqEduAgent: Adaptive AI Learning Partners with Gaussian Process Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative partnerships play a crucial role in inquiry-oriented education. However, most learning partners are currently assigned through experience-driven heuristics or rule-based machine assistants, which often result in limited knowledge expansion and low adaptability. To address these challenges, this study introduces InqEduAgent, an LLM-empowered generative agent framework designed to simulate and select adaptive learning partners for inquiry-based learning. InqEduAgent integrates a Gaussian process-augmented matching mechanism to model the cognitive and evaluative characteristics of learners, allowing adaptive partner selection based on prior knowledge patterns. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that InqEduAgent consistently achieves superior performance across diverse learning scenarios and large language model configurations. This study advances human-AI collaborative learning by enabling intelligent pairing between human- and AI-based learning partners, and contributes to adaptive user modeling and personalized recommendation within Web-based educational environments.
papers.comment: Accepted by the 2026 8th Asia Conference on Machine Learning and Computing (ACMLC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出InqEduAgent，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的生成式智能体框架，用于模拟和选择自适应学习伙伴，以支持探究式学习。该框架通过高斯过程增强的匹配机制建模学习者的认知和评价特征，实现基于先验知识模式的自适应伙伴选择。实验表明，InqEduAgent在不同学习场景和LLM配置下均取得一致优越性能。
Motivation: 现有学习伙伴分配多依赖经验启发式或基于规则的机器助手，导致知识扩展有限且适应性低。需要更智能的自适应匹配方法以提升人机协作学习效果。
Method: 集成高斯过程增强的匹配机制，建模学习者的认知与评价特征，结合LLM生成自适应学习伙伴，实现基于先验知识模式的动态配对。
Result: 综合实验表明，InqEduAgent在多种学习场景和不同大语言模型配置下均持续取得优越性能。
Conclusion: 该研究推进了人机协作学习中的智能配对，有助于网络教育环境下的自适应用户建模与个性化推荐。

papers.title: Detecting and measuring respiratory events in horses during exercise with a microphone: deep learning vs. standard signal processing
papers.abstract_en: Monitoring respiration parameters such as respiratory rate could be beneficial to understand the impact of training on equine health and performance and ultimately improve equine welfare. In this work, we compare deep learning-based methods to an adapted signal processing method to automatically detect cyclic respiratory events and extract the dynamic respiratory rate from microphone recordings during high intensity exercise in Standardbred trotters. Our deep learning models are able to detect exhalation sounds (median F1 score of 0.94) in noisy microphone signals and show promising results on unlabelled signals at lower exercising intensity, where the exhalation sounds are less recognisable. Temporal convolutional networks were better at detecting exhalation events and estimating dynamic respiratory rates (median F1: 0.94, Mean Absolute Error (MAE) $\pm$ Confidence Intervals (CI): 1.44$\pm$1.04 bpm, Limits Of Agreements (LOA): 0.63$\pm$7.06 bpm) than long short-term memory networks (median F1: 0.90, MAE$\pm$CI: 3.11$\pm$1.58 bpm) and signal processing methods (MAE$\pm$CI: 2.36$\pm$1.11 bpm). This work is the first to automatically detect equine respiratory sounds and automatically compute dynamic respiratory rates in exercising horses. In the future, our models will be validated on lower exercising intensity sounds and different microphone placements will be evaluated in order to find the best combination for regular monitoring.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了深度学习方法与改进的信号处理方法，用于从麦克风录音中自动检测马匹在运动中的呼吸事件并提取动态呼吸率。在标准bred trotters的高强度运动数据上，时间卷积网络（TCN）表现最佳，呼气事件检测中位F1分数0.94，呼吸率估计平均绝对误差1.44 ± 1.04 bpm。这是首次自动检测马匹呼吸声音并计算动态呼吸率的工作。
Motivation: 监测呼吸参数有助于理解训练对马匹健康和性能的影响，改善马匹福利。目前缺乏自动化的方法从运动马匹的麦克风录音中检测呼吸事件。
Method: 采用深度学习模型（TCN和LSTM）以及改进的信号处理方法，从麦克风信号中检测呼气声音并计算动态呼吸率。
Result: TCN在呼气检测（中位F1 0.94）和呼吸率估计（MAE±CI: 1.44±1.04 bpm, LOA: 0.63±7.06 bpm）上优于LSTM（中位F1 0.90, MAE±CI: 3.11±1.58 bpm）和信号处理方法（MAE±CI: 2.36±1.11 bpm）。
Conclusion: 本文首次实现自动检测马匹呼吸声音并计算动态呼吸率。未来将验证模型在低强度运动数据上的表现，并评估不同麦克风位置。

summary_sections.result: TCN在呼气检测（中位F1 0.94）和呼吸率估计（MAE±CI: 1.44±1.04 bpm, LOA: 0.63±7.06 bpm）上优于LSTM（中位F1 0.90, MAE±CI: 3.11±1.58 bpm）和信号处理方法（MAE±CI: 2.36±1.11 bpm）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文首次实现自动检测马匹呼吸声音并计算动态呼吸率。未来将验证模型在低强度运动数据上的表现，并评估不同麦克风位置。

papers.title: CRINN: Contrastive Reinforcement Learning for Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
papers.abstract_en: Approximate nearest-neighbor search (ANNS) algorithms have become increasingly critical for recent AI applications, particularly in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agent-based LLM applications. In this paper, we present CRINN, a new paradigm for ANNS algorithms. CRINN treats ANNS optimization as a reinforcement learning problem where execution speed serves as the reward signal. This approach enables the automatic generation of progressively faster ANNS implementations while maintaining accuracy constraints. Our experimental evaluation demonstrates CRINN's effectiveness across six widely-used NNS benchmark datasets. When compared against state-of-the-art open-source ANNS algorithms, CRINN achieves best performance on three of them (GIST-960-Euclidean, MNIST-784-Euclidean, and GloVe-25-angular), and tied for first place on two of them (SIFT-128-Euclidean and GloVe-25-angular). The implications of CRINN's success reach well beyond ANNS optimization: It validates that LLMs augmented with reinforcement learning can function as an effective tool for automating sophisticated algorithmic optimizations that demand specialized knowledge and labor-intensive manual refinement. Code can be found at https://github.com/deepreinforce-ai/CRINN
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CRINN，一种将近似最近邻搜索 (ANNS) 优化视为强化学习问题的新范式，以执行速度作为奖励信号自动生成更快的 ANNS 实现。在六个广泛使用的 NNS 基准数据集上评估，CRINN 在三个数据集上达到最佳性能，在两个数据集上并列第一。该工作还验证了 LLM 结合强化学习可自动化需专业知识的算法优化。
Motivation: 传统 ANNS 算法依赖人工调优，耗时且需要专业知识。本文旨在通过强化学习自动优化 ANNS 实现，提升搜索速度同时保持精度。
Method: 将 ANNS 优化建模为强化学习问题，以执行速度作为奖励信号，通过 LLM 结合强化学习自动生成更快的 ANNS 实现。
Result: 在六个基准数据集上，CRINN 在 GIST-960-Euclidean、MNIST-784-Euclidean 和 GloVe-25-angular 上取得最佳性能，在 SIFT-128-Euclidean 和 GloVe-25-angular 上并列第一。
Conclusion: CRINN 的成功表明 LLM 增强强化学习可有效自动化需要专业知识和人工精调的算法优化，其影响超越 ANNS 本身。

papers.title: funOCLUST: Clustering Functional Data with Outliers
papers.abstract_en: Functional data present unique challenges for clustering due to their infinite-dimensional nature and potential sensitivity to outliers. An extension of the OCLUST algorithm to the functional setting is proposed to address these issues. The approach leverages the OCLUST framework, creating a robust method to cluster curves and trim outliers. The methodology is evaluated on both simulated and real-world functional datasets, demonstrating strong performance in clustering and outlier identification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出funOCLUST算法，将OCLUST扩展至函数型数据，用于对曲线进行鲁棒聚类并剔除异常值。在模拟和真实函数型数据集上验证了聚类与异常值识别性能。
Motivation: 函数型数据因无限维特性和对异常值的敏感性，给聚类带来独特挑战。现有方法鲁棒性不足，需要一种能同时聚类并识别异常值的算法。
Method: 基于OCLUST框架，将其拓展至函数型数据场景，通过鲁棒方法实现曲线聚类与异常值修剪。
Result: 在模拟和真实函数型数据集上，方法在聚类准确性和异常值检测方面表现良好。
Conclusion: funOCLUST是函数型数据聚类中一种有效的鲁棒方法，但未提及天气领域的应用或局限性。

papers.title: LLM-Driven Collaborative Model for Untangling Commits via Explicit and Implicit Dependency Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Atomic commits, which address a single development concern, are a best practice in software development. In practice, however, developers often produce tangled commits that mix unrelated changes, complicating code review and maintenance. Prior untangling approaches (rule-based, feature-based, or graph-based) have made progress but typically rely on shallow signals and struggle to distinguish explicit dependencies (e.g., control/data flow) from implicit ones (e.g., semantic or conceptual relationships). In this paper, we propose ColaUntangle, a new collaborative consultation framework for commit untangling that models both explicit and implicit dependencies among code changes. ColaUntangle integrates Large Language Model (LLM)-driven agents in a multi-agent architecture: one agent specializes in explicit dependencies, another in implicit ones, and a reviewer agent synthesizes their perspectives through iterative consultation. To capture structural and contextual information, we construct Explicit and Implicit Contexts, enabling agents to reason over code relationships with both symbolic and semantic depth. We evaluate ColaUntangle on two widely-used datasets (1,612 C# and 14k Java tangled commits). Experimental results show that ColaUntangle outperforms the best-performing baseline, achieving an improvement of 44% on the C# dataset and 82% on the Java dataset. These findings highlight the potential of LLM-based collaborative frameworks for advancing automated commit untangling tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ColaUntangle，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体协作框架，用于将杂乱的代码提交拆解为原子提交。该框架通过显式与隐式依赖推理，结合多智能体迭代协商，在两个大型数据集（1,612个C#和14k个Java杂提交）上分别比最佳基线提升44%和82%。
Motivation: 开发中常出现将无关修改混在一起的杂提交，现有方法依赖浅层信号难以区分显式（如控制流）与隐式（如语义）依赖，导致拆解效果不佳。
Method: 构建显式与隐式上下文，分别由两个LLM驱动的智能体处理，并通过一个审查智能体进行迭代协商融合，实现代码依赖的符号与语义推理。
Result: 在C#数据集（1,612个）和Java数据集（14k个）上，ColaUntangle分别比最佳基线提升44%和82%。
Conclusion: LLM协作框架在自动拆解杂提交任务中具有巨大潜力，实验验证了其有效性。

papers.title: Hyper-modal Imputation Diffusion Embedding with Dual-Distillation for Federated Multimodal Knowledge Graph Completion
papers.abstract_en: With the increasing multimodal knowledge privatization requirements, multimodal knowledge graphs in different institutes are usually decentralized, lacking of effective collaboration system with both stronger reasoning ability and transmission safety guarantees. In this paper, we propose the Federated Multimodal Knowledge Graph Completion (FedMKGC) task, aiming at training over federated MKGs for better predicting the missing links in clients without sharing sensitive knowledge. We propose a framework named MMFeD3-HidE for addressing multimodal uncertain unavailability and multimodal client heterogeneity challenges of FedMKGC. (1) Inside the clients, our proposed Hyper-modal Imputation Diffusion Embedding model (HidE) recovers the complete multimodal distributions from incomplete entity embeddings constrained by available modalities. (2) Among clients, our proposed Multimodal FeDerated Dual Distillation (MMFeD3) transfers knowledge mutually between clients and the server with logit and feature distillation to improve both global convergence and semantic consistency. We propose a FedMKGC benchmark for a comprehensive evaluation, consisting of a general FedMKGC backbone named MMFedE, datasets with heterogeneous multimodal information, and three groups of constructed baselines. Experiments conducted on our benchmark validate the effectiveness, semantic consistency, and convergence robustness of MMFeD3-HidE.
papers.comment: Published in IEEE Transactions on Multimedia, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出联邦多模态知识图谱补全（FedMKGC）任务，并设计MMFeD3-HidE框架，在客户端内使用超模态插补扩散嵌入（HidE）从不完整实体嵌入恢复完整多模态分布，在客户端间采用多模态联邦双重蒸馏（MMFeD3）通过logit和特征蒸馏实现知识迁移。实验在构建的基准上验证了有效性、语义一致性和收敛鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有知识图谱补全忽略多模态知识私有化需求，不同机构的多模态知识图谱分散且缺乏有效协作系统，同时面临多模态不确定不可用性和客户端异质性挑战。
Method: 提出MMFeD3-HidE框架：客户端内使用超模态插补扩散嵌入模型（HidE）从可用模态约束的不完整实体嵌入恢复完整多模态分布；客户端间采用多模态联邦双重蒸馏（MMFeD3）在客户端与服务器之间通过logit和特征蒸馏相互传递知识。
Result: 在构建的FedMKGC基准上，包括通用骨干MMFedE、异构多模态数据集和三类基线，实验验证了MMFeD3-HidE的有效性、语义一致性和收敛鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 本文首次提出联邦多模态知识图谱补全任务，所提框架能够处理多模态不确定性和异质性，增强联邦场景下的推理能力与安全性。

papers.title: Can Argus Judge Them All? Comparing VLMs Across Domains
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used in industry VLM applications such as retrieval systems, content generation platforms, and decision-support workflows, where model selection is commonly guided by benchmark rankings. These rankings are largely determined by retrieval, captioning, and reasoning downstream tasks; however, models with similar task performance often show substantially different behavior across datasets. This creates a Capability-Reliability Gap between benchmark performance and observed model stability. We present ARGUS-EVAL, a capability-reliability-oriented evaluation framework for VLMs that characterizes model behavior through Benchmark Capability P(M), Cross-Dataset Consistency CDC(M), Robustness Retention RR(M), and Efficiency E(M). We evaluate CLIP, BLIP, LXMERT, Gemma-3-4B, and Qwen-2.5VL-3B-Instruct across retrieval, captioning, and reasoning downstream tasks. The results reveal notable differences between capability-oriented and reliability-oriented rankings. Qwen-2.5VL-3BInstruct achieves the strongest overall capability (R@1 = 82.7%, BLEU-4 = 47.2%, CIDEr = 141.6, CDC = 0.91), whereas CLIP records the lowest latency (31 ms) and memory footprint (0.9 GB).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言模型在基准测试性能与实际部署稳定性之间的差异，提出ARGUS-EVAL评估框架，从能力、跨数据集一致性、鲁棒性和效率四个维度对VLM进行综合评价。在五个模型上的实验显示，不同模型在不同维度上表现各异，Qwen-2.5VL-3B-Instruct在能力指标上最优，而CLIP在效率上最优。
Motivation: 现有VLM模型在相似任务性能下，跨数据集行为差异显著，存在“能力-可靠性差距”，影响模型选择。需一种兼顾能力与可靠性的评估方法。
Method: 提出ARGUS-EVAL框架，定义四个指标：基准能力P(M)、跨数据集一致性CDC(M)、鲁棒保持RR(M)和效率E(M)，对VLM进行多维度评估。
Result: 实验结果显示，Qwen-2.5VL-3B-Instruct在检索、字幕和推理任务上取得最强能力（R@1=82.7%, BLEU-4=47.2%, CIDEr=141.6, CDC=0.91），而CLIP具有最低延迟（31 ms）和内存占用（0.9 GB）。
Conclusion: 论文强调能力导向排名与可靠性导向排名存在显著差异，需综合考虑多个维度进行模型选择。

papers.title: Efficient Q-Learning and Actor-Critic Methods for Robust Average-Reward Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study model-free methods for distributionally robust infinite-horizon average-reward Markov decision processes (MDPs). We present non-asymptotic convergence analyses of Q-learning and actor-critic algorithms for robust average-reward MDPs under contamination, total-variation distance, and Wasserstein uncertainty sets. A key ingredient of our analysis is showing that the optimal robust Bellman operator is a strict contraction with respect to a carefully designed semi-norm. This property enables a stochastic approximation update that learns the optimal robust $Q$-function with $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(ε^{-2})$ dependence on the target accuracy. We also establish robust TD convergence bounds whose constants are uniform over all stationary policies, yielding an efficient data-driven routine for robust critic estimation. Building on this, we introduce an actor-critic algorithm that learns an $ε$-optimal robust policy with $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(ε^{-2})$ dependence on the target accuracy. We provide numerical simulations to illustrate the qualitative behavior of the proposed algorithms. Our results contribute to the theoretical foundations of robust planning under model misspecification and to model-free approaches for building robust long-run policies directly from simulation data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分布鲁棒无限时域平均奖励MDP的模型无关方法，提出Q学习和actor-critic算法，并给出非渐近收敛分析。关键贡献是证明最优鲁棒Bellman算子在特定半范数下是严格收缩，从而实现ε^{-2}精度的学习。数值模拟验证了算法的定性行为。
Motivation: 现有强化学习在模型误指定下鲁棒性不足，特别是长期平均奖励设置。需要具有理论保证且数据驱动的鲁棒策略学习方法。
Method: 基于分布鲁棒优化，使用污染、全变差距离和Wasserstein不确定集。证明最优鲁棒Bellman算子是收缩映射，设计随机近似更新。actor-critic中，critic采用鲁棒TD学习，actor执行策略梯度。
Result: Q学习和actor-critic算法均达到O(ε^{-2})的目标精度依赖。鲁棒TD收敛界常数对所有平稳策略一致，支持高效鲁棒critic估计。
Conclusion: 为模型误指定下的鲁棒规划提供理论基础，并给出从模拟数据直接构建鲁棒长期策略的模型无关方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: pyMEAL: A Multi-Encoder Augmentation-Aware-Learning Toolbox for Robust Medical Image Translation
papers.abstract_en: Medical imaging plays a vital role in clinical diagnosis, yet AI-driven imaging methods remain challenged by patient variability, image artifacts, and limited robustness across acquisition conditions. Although deep learning has advanced medical image analysis, 3D image translation remains hindered by limited training data and variability arising from scanner differences, imaging protocols, and patient motion. Conventional data augmentation typically relies on a single transformation pipeline, overlooking augmentation-specific characteristics and limiting representation learning. To address these challenges, we propose Multi-Encoder Augmentation-Aware Learning (MEAL), which processes multiple augmentation variants through dedicated encoder pathways. Three feature integration strategies are investigated: encoder concatenation (MEAL-CC), fusion layer (MEAL-FL), and an adaptive controller block (MEAL-BD). By dynamically weighting augmentation-specific features before decoding, MEAL-BD preserves complementary representations and improves robustness to clinically relevant variability. We evaluate MEAL using CT-to-T1-weighted MRI translation, a clinically relevant task when MRI is unavailable, contraindicated, or delayed. Across predefined and unseen test datasets, MEAL-BD consistently outperformed competing approaches under both geometric perturbations and standard imaging conditions, achieving higher peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity index measure (SSIM). By prioritizing structural fidelity over perceptual realism, MEAL supports clinical interpretation and downstream image analysis rather than replacing diagnostic MRI, demonstrating that augmentation-aware representation learning improves the robustness and clinical applicability of medical image translation.

Motivation: 医学图像翻译面临患者变异性、伪影和采集条件差异等挑战，传统数据增强方法忽略增强特定特征，限制了表示学习。

papers.title: VIBE: Annotation-Free Video-to-Text Information Bottleneck Evaluation for TL;DR
papers.abstract_en: Many decision-making tasks, where both accuracy and efficiency matter, still require human supervision. For example, tasks like traffic officers reviewing hour-long dashcam footage or researchers screening conference videos can benefit from concise summaries that reduce cognitive load and save time. Yet current vision-language models (VLMs) often produce verbose, redundant outputs that hinder task performance. Existing video caption evaluation depends on costly human annotations and overlooks the summaries' utility in downstream tasks. We address these gaps with Video-to-text Information Bottleneck Evaluation (VIBE), an annotation-free method that scores VLM outputs using two metrics: grounding (how well the summary aligns with visual content) and utility (how informative it is for the task). VIBE selects from randomly sampled VLM outputs by ranking them according to the two scores to support effective human decision-making. Human studies on LearningPaper24, SUTD-TrafficQA, and LongVideoBench show that summaries selected by VIBE consistently improve performance-boosting task accuracy by up to 61.23% and reducing response time by 75.77% compared to naive VLM summaries or raw video.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VIBE（Video-to-text Information Bottleneck Evaluation），一种无需人工标注的视频摘要评估方法，通过 grounding（与视觉内容对齐）和 utility（对下游任务的信息量）两个指标对 VLM 生成的摘要进行评分和排序。在 LearningPaper24、SUTD-TrafficQA 和 LongVideoBench 上的人类研究表明，VIBE 选出的摘要相比原始 VLM 摘要或原始视频，能将任务准确率提升最多 61.23%，并将响应时间降低 75.77%。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 生成的摘要常冗长冗余，且视频字幕评估依赖昂贵的人工标注，忽略了摘要在下游任务中的效用。
Method: 提出 VIBE，一种基于信息瓶颈的无标注方法，通过 grounding 和 utility 两个指标对随机采样的 VLM 输出进行排序，以选出有助于人类决策的摘要。
Result: 在三个数据集上，VIBE 选出的摘要相比 naive VLM 摘要或原始视频，任务准确率提升最多 61.23%，响应时间降低 75.77%。
Conclusion: VIBE 通过 grounding 和 utility 双指标评估，能有效提升 VLM 摘要对人类决策的支持能力。

papers.title: Meta-Dependence in Conditional Independence Testing
papers.abstract_en: Conditional independence testing is a critical component of feature screening, invariant statistical models, and causal discovery. Many of these algorithms rely on the sequential application of conditional independence tests, and their stability hinges on how their outcomes interact. We study this ``meta-dependence'' between conditional independence properties using the following geometric intuition: satisfying each conditional independence property constrains the space of possible joint distributions to a manifold. The ``meta-dependence'' of multiple conditional independences in a probability distribution is informed by its position relative to these manifolds. We provide a simple-to-compute measure of this meta-dependence using moment projections, with a closed-form expression for multivariate Gaussian distributions, and consolidate our findings empirically using both synthetic and real-world data. Our measure of meta-dependence does not rely on graphical properties of the distribution and can be computed directly from summary statistics such as a covariance matrix, allowing for various applications. We demonstrate one use case of meta-dependence, using a simple redundancy metric to tune significance thresholds and improve causal discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究条件独立性测试中多个条件独立性属性之间的“元依赖性”（meta-dependence），提出基于矩投影的简单可计算度量，对多元高斯分布有闭式解，并通过合成和真实数据验证。该度量不依赖图性质，可直接从协方差矩阵等统计量计算，可应用于调整显著性阈值以改进因果发现。
Motivation: 许多算法（特征筛选、不变统计模型、因果发现）顺序应用条件独立性测试，其稳定性依赖于测试结果的相互作用。现有研究缺乏对这种元依赖性的直接度量。
Method: 利用几何直觉：每个条件独立性属性约束联合分布空间到一个流形，元依赖性由分布相对于这些流形的位置决定。提出基于矩投影的度量，对多元高斯分布给出闭式表达式。
Result: 在合成和真实数据上验证了该度量，并展示了一个应用：使用简单冗余度量调整显著性阈值以改进因果发现。
Conclusion: 该度量不依赖图性质，可直接从协方差矩阵等汇总统计量计算，具有广泛适用性。作者通过调整显著性阈值展示了在因果发现中的一个用例。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: SpurLens: Automatic Detection of Spurious Cues in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Unimodal vision models are known to rely on spurious correlations, but it remains unclear to what extent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) exhibit similar biases despite language supervision. In this paper, we investigate spurious bias in MLLMs and introduce SpurLens, a pipeline that leverages GPT-4 and open-set object detectors to automatically identify spurious visual cues without human supervision. Our findings reveal that spurious correlations cause two major failure modes in MLLMs: (1) over-reliance on spurious cues for object recognition, where removing these cues reduces accuracy, and (2) object hallucination, where spurious cues amplify the hallucination by over 10x. We validate our findings in various MLLMs and datasets. Beyond diagnosing these failures, we explore potential mitigation strategies, such as prompt ensembling and reasoning-based prompting, and conduct ablation studies to examine the root causes of spurious bias in MLLMs. By exposing the persistence of spurious correlations, our study calls for more rigorous evaluation methods and mitigation strategies to enhance the reliability of MLLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中的虚假相关性，提出SpurLens，一种利用GPT-4和开放集目标检测器自动识别虚假视觉线索的流水线。实验发现虚假相关性导致两种主要失败模式：过度依赖虚假线索进行物体识别（去除后准确率下降）和物体幻觉（虚假线索使幻觉增加超过10倍）。论文还探讨了提示集成和基于推理的提示等缓解策略。
Motivation: 单模态视觉模型已知依赖虚假相关性，但多模态大语言模型在语言监督下是否仍存在类似偏置尚不明确。本文旨在系统检测和量化MLLMs中的虚假偏置。
Method: 提出SpurLens流水线，结合GPT-4和开放集目标检测器，无需人工标注即可自动识别图像中可能引发虚假相关性的视觉线索。
Result: 虚假相关性在多种MLLMs和数据集中导致两类失败：物体识别过度依赖虚假线索，以及物体幻觉率提升超过10倍。
Conclusion: 研究表明多模态大语言模型仍然存在虚假相关性偏置，呼吁更严格的评估方法和缓解策略以提升可靠性。

papers.title: Cascaded Multi-Scale Attention for Enhanced Multi-Scale Feature Extraction and Interaction with Low-Resolution Images
papers.abstract_en: In real-world applications of image recognition tasks, such as human pose estimation, cameras often capture objects, like human bodies, at low resolutions. This scenario poses a challenge in extracting and leveraging multi-scale features, which is often essential for precise inference. To address this challenge, we propose a new attention mechanism, named cascaded multi-scale attention (CMSA), tailored for use in CNN-ViT hybrid architectures, to handle low-resolution inputs effectively. The design of CMSA enables the extraction and seamless integration of features across various scales without necessitating the downsampling of the input image or feature maps. This is achieved through a novel combination of grouped multi-head self-attention mechanisms with window-based local attention and cascaded fusion of multi-scale features over different scales. This architecture allows for the effective handling of features across different scales, enhancing the model's ability to perform tasks such as human pose estimation, head pose estimation, and more with low-resolution images. Our experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in these areas with fewer parameters, showcasing its potential for broad application in real-world scenarios where capturing high-resolution images is not feasible. Code is available at https://github.com/xyongLu/CMSA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出级联多尺度注意力（CMSA），一种用于CNN-ViT混合架构的注意力机制，旨在有效处理低分辨率图像的多尺度特征提取与融合。该方法通过分组多头自注意力、窗口局部注意力和级联融合实现，不降低输入分辨率。实验表明，在人体姿态估计、头部姿态估计等任务上，CMSA以更少参数超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现实应用中，相机常捕获低分辨率目标（如人体），这给提取和利用多尺度特征带来挑战，而多尺度特征对精确推理至关重要。
Method: 提出级联多尺度注意力（CMSA），结合分组多头自注意力与窗口局部注意力，并通过级联融合不同尺度的特征，无需对输入图像或特征图进行下采样。
Result: 在人体姿态估计和头部姿态估计等低分辨率图像任务上，CMSA以更少参数优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: CMSA能有效处理低分辨率图像的多尺度特征，适用于需高精度但高分辨率不可用的真实场景。

papers.title: Big data approach to Kazhdan-Lusztig polynomials
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the structure of Kazhdan-Lusztig polynomials of the symmetric group by leveraging computational approaches from big data, including exploratory and topological data analysis, applied to the polynomials for symmetric groups of up to 11 strands.
papers.comment: 27 pages, many figures, comments welcome, appeared in J. Exp. Math, added a remark acknowledging E. O. Hjelle for proposing an AI-generated proof of Conjecture 6.4 (via ChatGPT 5.5 Pro), added a link to the complete proof on our GitHub repository

TL;DR: 本文利用大数据方法（包括探索性数据分析和拓扑数据分析）研究对称群的Kazhdan-Lusztig多项式，具体应用于最多11根花簇的对称群。论文通过计算实验探索多项式的结构性质。

Conclusion: 大数据方法能够有效揭示Kazhdan-Lusztig多项式的代数结构，为后续理论研究提供计算证据。

papers.title: Optimal Estimation of Shared Singular Subspaces across Multiple Noisy Matrices
papers.abstract_en: Estimating singular subspaces from noisy matrices is a fundamental problem with wide-ranging applications across various fields. Driven by the challenges of data integration and multi-view analysis, this study focuses on estimating shared singular subspaces across multiple matrices within a low-rank matrix denoising framework. A common approach for this task is to perform singular value decomposition on the stacked matrix (Stack-SVD), which concatenates all the matrices. We establish that Stack-SVD achieves minimax rate-optimality when the true singular subspaces of the noisy matrices are identical, whereas a popular alternative approach based on SVD of concatenated singular vector matrices (Average-SVD) can be sub-optimal. We then tackle the more complex scenario where the true singular subspaces are only partially shared across matrices. For various cases of partial sharing, we rigorously characterize the conditions under which Stack-SVD remains effective, achieves minimax optimality, or fails to deliver consistent estimates, offering theoretical insights into its practical applicability. To address the limitations of Stack-SVD in scenarios with partial sharing, we propose novel estimators and an efficient algorithm designed to identify both shared and unshared singular vectors. We further prove that these methods attain minimax rate-optimality under partial sharing. Extensive simulations and real-world data applications demonstrate the advantages of our proposed approach.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Information Theory (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多个含噪矩阵中共享奇异子空间的最优估计问题。在低秩矩阵去噪框架下，证明当矩阵间真奇异子空间完全相同时，Stack-SVD（对矩阵堆叠后做SVD）达到极小最大最优，而Average-SVD（基于拼接奇异向量矩阵的SVD）可能次优。针对部分共享场景，提出新估计器和高效算法，证明其达到极小最大最优，并通过模拟和真实数据验证优势。
Motivation: 数据整合和多视图分析中需估计多个矩阵间的共享奇异子空间，现有Stack-SVD在子空间不完全共享时可能失效，缺乏理论保证和有效方法。
Method: 在部分共享奇异子空间的复杂情景下，提出新的估计器和高效算法以识别共享和独有的奇异向量，并证明其达到极小最大最优速率。
Result: 建立Stack-SVD在完全共享时的极小最大最优性，揭示Average-SVD的次优性；对于部分共享，给出Stack-SVD有效或失效的条件，新方法在理论和实验中均优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 本文为多矩阵共享子空间估计提供了理论最优的方法，并针对部分共享场景开发了实用的算法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Training on Irrelevant States Implies Data Augmentation: Generalization in Contextual MDPs
papers.abstract_en: In the zero-shot policy transfer (ZSPT) setting for contextual Markov decision processes (CMDP), agents train on a fixed, finite set of contexts and must generalize to new ones. Recent work has demonstrated that training on additional states, even if they are irrelevant for solving the current context, can improve generalization to unseen contexts. In this paper, we demonstrate that training on these states can indeed improve generalization, but can come at a cost of reducing the accuracy of the learned value function, which should hurt generalization. We hypothesize and demonstrate that increasing the agent's coverage by training on these additional states while also increasing the accuracy improves generalization even further. Inspired by this, we propose a simple approach Explore-Go that leverages existing pure exploration strategies in a new way: by introducing a pure exploration phase at the start of each training episode. Unlike previous approaches that apply exploration strategies for the purpose of improving generalization, our approach can be combined with both on- and off-policy algorithms. We demonstrate the effectiveness of Explore-Go when combined with several popular algorithms and show an increase in test-time performance across several generalization benchmarks, even partially observable ones. With this, we hope to provide practitioners with a simple modification that can significantly improve the generalization of their agents.

TL;DR: 本文研究上下文马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）中零样本策略迁移的泛化问题。作者证明训练额外状态（即使与当前任务无关）可以提升泛化，但可能降低值函数精度。为平衡两者，提出Explore-Go方法，在每回合开始时引入纯探索阶段，可与多种算法结合，在多个基准上提升测试性能。

Method: 提出Explore-Go方法，在每个训练回合开始时增加一个纯探索阶段，以增加智能体的状态覆盖。该方法与on-policy和off-policy算法兼容。
Result: 在多个泛化基准（包括部分可观测环境）上，Explore-Go与流行算法结合均能提升测试性能。

papers.title: Constrained Reinforcement Learning for Safe Heat Pump Control
papers.abstract_en: Constrained Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a significant research area within RL, where integrating constraints with rewards is crucial for enhancing safety and performance across diverse control tasks. In the context of heating systems in the buildings, optimizing the energy efficiency while maintaining the residents' thermal comfort can be intuitively formulated as a constrained optimization problem. However, to solve it with RL may require large amount of data. Therefore, an accurate and versatile simulator is favored. In this paper, we propose a novel building simulator I4B which provides interfaces for different usages and apply a model-free constrained RL algorithm named constrained Soft Actor-Critic with Linear Smoothed Log Barrier function (CSAC-LB) to the heating optimization problem. Benchmarking against baseline algorithms demonstrates CSAC-LB's efficiency in data exploration, constraint satisfaction and performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出名为I4B的建筑模拟器，并采用一种无模型的约束强化学习算法CSAC-LB（带线性平滑对数障碍函数的约束软演员-评论家算法）来优化热泵供暖系统，在保证居民热舒适度的同时提高能效。基准测试表明CSAC-LB在数据探索、约束满足和性能方面优于基线算法。
Motivation: 建筑供暖系统需要同时优化能效和热舒适度，这可以自然地建模为约束优化问题，但用强化学习解决需要大量数据，因此需要精确且通用的模拟器。
Method: 提出新型建筑模拟器I4B，并提供多种接口；应用无模型约束强化学习算法CSAC-LB，该算法结合了软演员-评论家与线性平滑对数障碍函数来处理安全约束。
Result: 与基线算法相比，CSAC-LB在数据探索效率、约束满足能力和整体性能上更优。
Conclusion: CSAC-LB是一种有效的建筑供暖控制方法，能够在满足热舒适约束的同时提升能效。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Paragraph-level Handwriting Imitation with Latent Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: The imitation of cursive handwriting is mainly limited to generating handwritten words or lines. Multiple synthetic outputs must be stitched together to create paragraphs or whole pages, whereby consistency and layout information are lost. To close this gap, we propose a method for imitating handwriting at the paragraph level that also works for unseen writing styles. Therefore, we introduce a modified latent diffusion model that enriches the encoder-decoder mechanism with specialized loss functions that explicitly preserve the style and content. We enhance the attention mechanism of the diffusion model with adaptive 2D positional encoding and the conditioning mechanism to work with two modalities simultaneously: a style image and the target text. This significantly improves the realism of the generated handwriting. We set a new benchmark in our comprehensive evaluation, achieving 61 % mAP and 56 % top-1 accuracy in style preservation, significantly outperforming the previous best method (37 % mAP, 30 % top-1). We are making our code publicly available for reproducibility, supporting research in this area and research into potential countermeasures: https://github.com/M4rt1nM4yr/paragraph_handwriting_imitation_ldm
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于潜在扩散模型的段落级手写模仿方法，能够对未见过的书写风格进行零样本段落生成。通过自适应2D位置编码和双模态条件机制（风格图像+目标文本），结合专用损失函数，显著提升了手写的真实感和风格保持一致性。在综合评价中，风格保持的mAP达到61%，top-1准确率56%，大幅超越先前方法（37% mAP，30% top-1）。
Motivation: 现有手写模仿主要限于单词或行级别，生成段落需拼接多个输出，导致一致性和布局信息丢失。本文旨在填补段落级手写模仿的空白，支持零样本风格迁移。
Method: 提出一个修改的潜在扩散模型，在编码器-解码器中引入专门损失函数以显式保持风格和内容。增强注意力机制为自适应2D位置编码，并改进条件机制以同时处理风格图像和目标文本两种模态。
Result: 在风格保持任务上达到61% mAP和56% top-1准确率，优于先前最佳方法的37% mAP和30% top-1。
Conclusion: 该方法实现了段落级手写模仿的显著性能提升，代码已公开以支持复现和反制措施研究。

papers.title: Estimating Dyadic Treatment Effects with Unknown Confounders
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes estimation and inference methods for assessing treatment effects with dyadic data. Under the assumption that the treatments follow an exchangeable distribution, our approach allows for the presence of any unobserved confounding factors that potentially cause endogeneity of treatment choice without requiring additional information other than the treatments and outcomes. Building on the literature of graphon estimation in network data analysis, we propose a neighbourhood kernel smoothing method for estimating dyadic average treatment effects, and derive the rate of convergence of the proposed estimator under certain regularity conditions. We also develop conformal inference methods for predicting outcomes conditional on treatment status. We apply our methods to international trade data to assess the impact of free trade agreements on bilateral trade flows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种估计dyadic数据中处理效应的方法，允许存在未知混淆因子导致处理选择内生性，仅需处理和结果数据。基于graphon估计的邻域核平滑方法估计dyadic平均处理效应，并推导收敛速度；同时开发共形推断方法预测条件结果。应用于国际贸易数据评估自由贸易协定对双边贸易流的影响。
Motivation: Dyadic数据中处理效应估计常面临未知混淆因子导致的内生性问题，现有方法通常需要额外信息或假设。本文旨在仅利用处理和结果数据即可进行有效推断。
Method: 基于网络数据分析中的graphon估计文献，提出邻域核平滑方法估计dyadic平均处理效应，并推导其收敛速度；同时开发共形推断方法用于预测给定处理状态下的结果。
Result: 推导了估计量的收敛速度，并在国际贸数据集上应用，展示了方法评估自由贸易协定对双边贸易流影响的实际效果。
Conclusion: 本文方法允许存在未知混淆因子，适用于dyadic数据，但依赖于处理分配的可交换性假设。

papers.title: Distributionally Robust Reinforcement Learning with Interactive Data Collection: Fundamental Hardness and Near-Optimal Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: The sim-to-real gap, which represents the disparity between training and testing environments, poses a significant challenge in reinforcement learning (RL). A promising approach to addressing this challenge is distributionally robust RL, often framed as a robust Markov decision process (RMDP). In this framework, the objective is to find a robust policy that achieves good performance under the worst-case scenario among all environments within a pre-specified uncertainty set centered around the training environment. Unlike previous work, which relies on a generative model or a pre-collected offline dataset enjoying good coverage of the deployment environment, we tackle robust RL via interactive data collection, where the learner interacts with the training environment only and refines the policy through trial and error. In this robust RL paradigm, two main challenges emerge: managing distributional robustness while striking a balance between exploration and exploitation during data collection. Initially, we establish that sample-efficient learning without additional assumptions is unattainable owing to the curse of support shift; i.e., the potential disjointedness of the distributional supports between the training and testing environments. To circumvent such a hardness result, we introduce the vanishing minimal value assumption to RMDPs with a total-variation (TV) distance robust set, postulating that the minimal value of the optimal robust value function is zero. We prove that such an assumption effectively eliminates support shift pathologies for RMDPs with a TV distance robust set, and present an algorithm with near-optimal sample complexity. To demonstrate the breadth of our framework, we extend our algorithm and theory to new robust set formulations and robust Markov games. To illustrate the operational relevance, we apply our algorithm to data-driven robust inventory control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究交互式数据收集下的分布鲁棒强化学习，证明由于支撑偏移（support shift）的存在，在无额外假设下无法实现样本高效学习，并引入消失最小值假设（vanishing minimal value assumption）来克服该困难，提出具有近最优样本复杂度的算法，并扩展到鲁棒马尔可夫博弈等。
Motivation: 现有的分布鲁棒RL大多依赖生成模型或覆盖良好的离线数据，而交互式数据收集场景下同时面临分布鲁棒性与探索-利用平衡的挑战，且支撑偏移导致样本效率无法保证。
Method: 首先证明在没有额外假设时样本高效学习不可能（支撑偏移诅咒），然后对TV距离鲁棒集引入消失最小值假设（即最优鲁棒值函数的最小值为0），基于此设计算法并证明近最优样本复杂度。
Result: 证明在TV距离鲁棒集下，消失最小值假设能有效消除支撑偏移问题，给出算法的近最优样本复杂度界限，并扩展到其他鲁棒集和鲁棒马尔可夫博弈。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作为交互式数据收集下的分布鲁棒RL提供了理论基础，并通过数据驱动的鲁棒库存控制展示了应用价值。

papers.title: HiQA: A Hierarchical Contextual Augmentation RAG for Multi-Documents QA
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has rapidly advanced the language model field, particularly in question-answering (QA) systems. By integrating external documents during the response generation phase, RAG significantly enhances the accuracy and reliability of language models. This method elevates the quality of responses and reduces the frequency of hallucinations, where the model generates incorrect or misleading information. However, these methods exhibit limited retrieval accuracy when faced with numerous indistinguishable documents, presenting notable challenges in their practical application. In response to these emerging challenges, we present HiQA, an advanced multi-document question-answering (MDQA) framework that integrates cascading metadata into content and a multi-route retrieval mechanism. We also release a benchmark called MasQA to evaluate and research in MDQA. Finally, HiQA demonstrates the state-of-the-art performance in multi-document environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HiQA，一种针对多文档问答（MDQA）的分层上下文增强 RAG 框架。该框架通过集成级联元数据（cascading metadata）到内容中并采用多路由检索机制，提升检索准确性。作者同时发布了用于 MDQA 评估的基准 MasQA，并在该基准上取得了最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有 RAG 方法在处理大量相似文档时检索准确率有限，影响实际应用效果。
Method: 提出 HiQA 框架，将级联元数据融入文档内容，并设计多路由检索机制以增强信息获取能力。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Execution under Dynamic Fees in a Closed-Loop DEX Simulator
papers.abstract_en: Trader-facing dynamic fees are increasingly proposed for automated market makers (AMMs), but historical data do not identify how order flow would respond: trader-facing fees do not vary, trader types are latent, and a replayed tape is not a sequential decision environment. We therefore construct a minimal closed-loop simulator in which the missing signal exists by construction: two constant-product pools repriced by an equilibrium-inspired dynamic-fee rule, fee-sensitive noise flow, and closed-form CEX--AMM arbitrage. Equilibrium is used as a closure principle, not as an object the trader learns. Against a tuned benchmark ladder of schedule, planning, lookahead, and tabular policies, a small DQN is the only evaluated valid policy whose paired improvement over tuned one-step routing excludes zero. On a reserved final block of 1{,}000 seeds with completion forced to 1.0 for every policy, it reduces implementation shortfall under every tested intra-step ordering, by $13.3\bps$ of order notional under the pre-specified agent-last ordering, and the edge is concentrated in, and learned from, dynamic-fee environments: under constant fees the paired difference is indistinguishable from zero. The result is model-conditioned counterfactual evidence about execution control in AMMs, not evidence about historical traders, equilibrium play, or deployable profit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动做市商（AMM）中交易者面临的动态费用问题，构建了一个最小封闭循环模拟器，其中包含两个恒定产品池、平衡启发动态费用规则、费用敏感噪声流以及闭式CEX-AMM套利。通过比较多种策略（包括阶梯调度、规划、前瞻和表格策略），发现小型DQN是唯一在配对改进上显著优于调优单步路由的验证有效策略。在保留的1000个种子测试块上，DQN在每个测试的步内排序下均降低了实现短缺，尤其在动态费用环境下优势显著（agent-last排序下减少13.3个基点），而恒定费用下效果不显著。
Motivation: 现有历史数据无法揭示交易者对动态费用的响应模式，因为交易者费用不变、交易者类型未知，且重放数据不是顺序决策环境。因此需要构建一个能捕捉缺失信号的闭环模拟器来研究执行策略。
Method: 构建一个最小封闭循环模拟器，包含两个恒定产品池、基于均衡启发的动态费用规则、费用敏感的噪声交易流，以及闭式的中心化交易所（CEX）与AMM套利模型。将均衡作为封闭原理而非学习目标。对比基准包括阶梯调度、规划、前瞻和表格策略，评估一个小型DQN。
Result: 在强制完成率为1.0的1000个种子保留块上，DQN在每个测试的步内排序下均减少了实现短缺。在预设的agent-last排序下，相对于最优单步路由，实现短缺降低13.3个基点（占订单名义价值）。该优势集中在动态费用环境中，而在恒定费用环境下配对差异与零无显著区别。
Conclusion: 本文提供的是模型条件下的反事实证据，证明在AMM执行控制中强化学习的有效性，但并不涉及历史交易者行为、均衡策略或可部署的盈利性。

papers.title: WSqD: A Horizon-Free Learning Rate Schedule for Large Model Training
papers.abstract_en: Standard learning rate schedules such as cosine annealing are tied to a fixed training horizon, limiting their ability to accommodate post hoc horizon extension. Warmup-stable-decay (WSD) partially addresses this issue by maintaining a long constant-rate phase before a short linear cooldown, allowing training to resume from a pre-decay checkpoint. However, its peak learning rate is still tuned based on the original training horizon and can become suboptimal when training is extended. Motivated by stochastic convex optimization, we propose WSqD (Warmup with Square-root base and linear Decay), a learning rate schedule that replaces WSD's constant stable phase with a shifted inverse-square-root base while retaining the final linear cooldown. In the stochastic convex setting, WSqD provably attains the minimax-optimal $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ last-iterate convergence rate. Importantly, its base learning rate schedule is horizon-independent, and the training horizon is needed only to determine when to begin the final cooldown. Empirically, on language-model pretraining using the SlimPajama corpus, WSqD matches or outperforms carefully tuned WSD and other baselines across multiple training horizons while reusing a single peak learning rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 WSqD（Warmup with Square-root base and linear Decay）的学习率调度策略，它用移位逆平方根衰减基替代 WSD 的恒定稳定阶段，并保留最终的线性冷却阶段。在随机凸优化中证明了最小最大最优的 O(1/√T) 末位收敛速率；在基于 SlimPajama 语料库的语言模型预训练中，WSqD 在多个训练水平线上匹配或优于精心调优的 WSD 等基线，且可复用单一峰值学习率。
Motivation: 标准学习率调度（如余弦退火）依赖固定训练水平线，难以适应事后扩展；WSD 虽通过长常数阶段缓解此问题，但其峰值学习率仍基于原水平线调优，扩展训练时可能变次优。
Method: 提出 WSqD：替换 WSD 的常数稳定阶段为移位逆平方根衰减基（shifted inverse-square-root base），保留最终线性冷却阶段；基学习率与训练水平线无关，水平线仅用于确定冷却开始时机。
Result: 在随机凸设置中证明 WSqD 达到最小最大最优的 O(1/√T) 末位收敛速率；在语言模型预训练实验（SlimPajama 语料）中，WSqD 匹配或超越调优后的 WSD 等基线，且跨不同水平线可复用单一峰值学习率。
Conclusion: WSqD 实现了与训练水平线解耦的学习率调度，使峰值学习率可跨不同水平线重用。

papers.title: Learning Anatomy-Grounded CT Vision-Language Representations with Organ-Hierarchical Report Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision-language pretraining (VLP) from paired CT images and radiology reports enables scalable representation learning, but most existing methods align either whole scans with entire reports or local image regions with text fragments. These formulations underuse a key property of radiology reports: findings are organized around anatomical structures, with abnormalities described by organs, disease concepts, locations, and severity-related attributes. We propose OKA-CT, an organ-hierarchical knowledge-augmented framework for CT-report VLP. OKA-CT first converts free-text reports into organ-conditioned knowledge using radiology report parsing and LLM-assisted semantic structuring. The extracted hierarchy is used across two learning stages. Stage~1 injects anatomy-grounded evidence into the CT visual representation through fine-grained organ-conditioned supervision, while Stage~2 uses organ-specific report evidence to guide structured report-CT contrastive learning, where hierarchy-derived semantic soft targets treat non-paired cases with shared organ-level findings as weak semantic positives rather than uniform negatives. A lightweight query-based global branch further aggregates disease-relevant volumetric evidence for whole-scan representation. On CT-RATE and RAD-ChestCT datasets, OKA-CT achieves zero-shot abnormality diagnosis AUROCs of 84.9 and 72.2, outperforming prior CT VLP baselines. Retrieval and patch-occlusion analyses further show improved report-image alignment and stronger sensitivity to disease-associated anatomical regions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OKA-CT，一种基于器官层次知识的 CT-报告视觉语言预训练框架。通过将放射学报告解析为器官条件知识，并在两阶段训练中注入解剖学监督和结构化对比学习，OKA-CT 在 CT-RATE 和 RAD-ChestCT 数据集上实现了零样本异常诊断 AUROC 分别为 84.9 和 72.2，优于先前方法。
Motivation: 现有医学视觉语言预训练方法未充分利用放射学报告的器官组织结构，仅进行全局或局部对齐，限制了表示学习的效果。
Method: OKA-CT 框架：首先利用报告解析和 LLM 辅助语义结构化将自由文本报告转化为器官层次知识；第一阶段通过细粒度器官条件监督注入解剖学证据；第二阶段利用器官特定报告证据进行结构化报告-CT 对比学习，并引入基于层次语义软标签处理非配对样本；同时使用轻量级查询全局分支聚合疾病相关体积特征。
Result: 在 CT-RATE 和 RAD-ChestCT 数据集上，零样本异常诊断 AUROC 分别达到 84.9 和 72.2，优于先前 CT VLP 基线；检索和补丁遮挡分析显示改进的报告-图像对齐和对疾病相关解剖区域的敏感性。
Conclusion: OKA-CT 通过利用器官层次报告知识提升了 CT 视觉语言表示的性能，强调了结构化解剖学监督在医学 VLP 中的有效性。

papers.title: Sticky Jump Diffusions: A Unifying View of Masked, Continuous, and Hybrid Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Sticky Jump Diffusions (SJDs), continuous-time Markov processes on $\mathbb R^d$ whose discrete anchors are token embeddings. In forward time, anchors release their mass at a hazard rate and the released mass diffuses in the continuous ambient space; time reversal couples a score-driven SDE with a sticky jump kernel whose rate and destination are fixed by flux balance with the forward law. We estimate the score and the per-anchor reverse hazards from a single denoising classifier via Denoising Hazard Matching, the hazard analogue of denoising score matching, with simulation-free cross-entropy training. SJD recovers masked diffusion, continuous diffusion, and hybrid diffusion as limits. Its reversal explains features that each family treats as given: the mask of masked diffusion carries no evidence about the source token because the unsticking kernel of every anchor collapses to the same absorbing point; the terminal projection of continuous diffusion is required due to the absence of atoms in its forward marginal, without which flux balance yields no reverse jumps; and the update rules of hybrid diffusion (commit rate, destination, and drift) all follow from flux balance rather than from separate design. Beyond these limits, the unsticking kernel becomes a design space: a cross-position blending corrupts each position toward a blend of its neighbors' clean values or embeddings, turning dependency structure such as spatial locality or a constraint graph into an inductive bias of the corruption itself, and improves over the identity-kernel hybrid on CIFAR-10, Text8, and Sudoku.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文引入粘性跳跃扩散（SJDs），一种连续时间马尔可夫过程，其离散锚点是token嵌入。前向过程中，锚点以风险率释放质量，释放的质量在连续空间扩散；时间反转将基于分数的SDE与粘性跳跃核结合。通过去噪风险匹配（Denoising Hazard Matching）从单一去噪分类器中估计分数和每个锚点的反向风险，实现免模拟的交叉熵训练。SJD统一了掩码扩散、连续扩散和混合扩散作为极限情况。
Motivation: 掩码扩散、连续扩散和混合扩散各有其设计假设，缺乏统一的理论框架。例如，掩码扩散的掩码不携带源token信息，连续扩散需要终端投影，混合扩散的更新规则（承诺率、目的地和漂移）是分别设计的。本文旨在通过粘性跳跃扩散提供一个统一视角，使这些设计选择从通量平衡中自然导出。
Method: 提出粘性跳跃扩散（SJDs），定义前向过程为锚点释放质量并扩散，反向过程通过通量平衡确定跳跃核的速率和目的地。训练使用Denoising Hazard Matching，即风险版本的去噪分数匹配，通过交叉熵损失优化。此外，引入跨位置混合的未粘附核设计空间，将依赖结构（如空间局部性）作为归纳偏置。
Result: 在CIFAR-10、Text8和Sudoku上，跨位置混合核优于恒等核的混合扩散模型。从理论上看，SJD统一了三种扩散模型，并解释了它们的固有特征（如掩码的虚无性、终端投影的必要性、混合扩散更新规则的来源）。
Conclusion: 粘性跳跃扩散提供了一个统一的框架，将掩码、连续和混合扩散视为特例，并通过通量平衡自然推导出各自的更新规则。未粘附核的设计空间允许将结构化先验（如空间局部性）直接嵌入腐蚀过程，提升了生成性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unsupervised Detection of Entry and Exit Regions from Vehicle Trajectories for Camera-Agnostic Turning Movement Counts
papers.abstract_en: Turning movement counts are essential for intersection-level traffic management, yet their collection remains predominantly manual due to the cost of per-camera region annotation. This paper presents an unsupervised pipeline that identifies entry and exit regions directly from raw vehicle trajectories extracted via object detection and multi-object tracking, requiring no manual annotation, camera calibration, or prior knowledge of intersection geometry. Unlike trajectory clustering methods that classify individual trajectories using pairwise similarity and must be re-executed on every new batch, the proposed pipeline clusters initial and terminal point locations to produce persistent spatial region polygons that classify future trajectories by point-in-polygon containment at linear cost. The pipeline comprises six sequential steps, each with configurable parameters evaluated through a systematic statistical analysis spanning 19,152 pipeline executions across 25 surveillance cameras capturing dense heterogeneous traffic in Bengaluru, India, and 10 sequences from the UA-DETRAC benchmark dataset. Both parametric and nonparametric testing frameworks identify three consistently significant parameters and yield an empirically grounded recommended configuration. Under this configuration, the pipeline achieves a median classification error of approximately 3% across all 25 cameras, including 16 held-out locations, with GEH values within accepted engineering thresholds. Compared with two trajectory clustering baselines, the proposed pipeline exhibits greater stability across camera views and lower computational cost, at the expense of higher median error. Extended evaluation demonstrates that calibration clips of at least 60 minutes and peak-traffic selection further improve region estimation quality.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无监督管道，从原始车辆轨迹中自动识别进入和退出区域，无需手动标注、相机标定或交叉口几何先验知识。管道通过聚类轨迹起点和终点生成空间区域多边形，并以线性代价对后续轨迹进行分类。在25个监控摄像头和19,152次管道执行上的系统评估表明，配置优化后中位分类误差约3%，GEH值符合工程标准。
Motivation: 转向运动计数对交叉口交通管理至关重要，但传统方法依赖每相机区域手动标注，成本高昂。现有轨迹聚类方法需每次新批次重新计算，且缺乏通用性。
Method: 提出一个六步无监督管道：从目标检测和多目标跟踪提取原始轨迹，聚类起点和终点位置以生成持久性区域多边形，通过点-多边形包含关系分类未来轨迹。通过19,152次管道执行进行统计分析，识别出三个显著参数并给出经验推荐配置。
Result: 在25个摄像头（含16个未见位置）上，中位分类误差约3%，GEH值在工程接受范围内。相比两种轨迹聚类基线，本文管道在不同相机视角下更稳定、计算成本更低，但中位误差稍高。60分钟校准视频和峰值交通选择可进一步提升区域估计质量。
Conclusion: 该无监督管道可高效生成相机无关的转向运动计数，但中位误差略高于聚类方法，适用于无需高精度、需快速部署的场景。

papers.title: Edge Physical AI Deployment of Vision Transformers on Heterogeneous Edge GPU Targeting Autonomous Vehicles
papers.abstract_en: Physical AI systems, such as autonomous vehicles and intelligent machines, require transformer-based perception models that satisfy stringent edge latency and energy constraints. However, heterogeneous edge-GPU deployment remains limited by underutilized hardware engines and accelerator-incompatible operators, causing fragmented execution and lower throughput per watt. This paper presents Heterogeneous Frame Dispatch Scheduling (H-FraDS), a hardware-aware frame scheduling methodology for transformer inference on a recent NVIDIA edge GPU. H-FraDS routes frames across the GPU and dual deep learning accelerator (DLA) cores using fixed dispatch ratios to improve utilization under latency and power constraints. To enable scheduling, incompatible transformer components are adapted for DLA execution by reshaping tensors, approximating error function (ERF) with tanh, and replacing layer normalization with bounded tanh. The adapted model maintains a 92% F1 score, with only a 2% reduction from the original. Optical flow accelerator (OFA) is further used for inference-side optical-flow estimation. To the best of the authors' knowledge, prior work has not addressed these combined issues. Using Swin Transformer for autonomous-driving perception, H-FraDS Balanced Dispatch (1:2) achieves 125.93 FPS, a 2.36x speedup over standalone adapted-DLA execution, 4.0 FPS/W, and approximately 24 ms DLA latency, satisfying 30 FPS real-time operation; the GPU-DLA-OFA case achieves a 2.02x DLA throughput speedup.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 15 figures, This work has been submitted to IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Heterogeneous Frame Dispatch Scheduling (H-FraDS) 方法，用于在异构边缘 GPU（NVIDIA 边缘 GPU）上部署视觉 Transformer（Swin Transformer）实现自动驾驶感知。通过固定调度比例将帧分配给 GPU 和双深度学习加速器（DLA）核心，并适配不兼容的算子（如用 tanh 近似 ERF 和层归一化），在保持 92% F1 分数的同时，实现 125.93 FPS 和 4.0 FPS/W 的能效，满足实时 30 FPS 要求。
Motivation: 物理 AI 系统（如自动驾驶）需要满足边缘延迟和能耗约束的 Transformer 感知模型，但现有异构边缘 GPU 部署存在硬件引擎利用不足和加速器不兼容算子的问题，导致执行碎片化及吞吐量/瓦特低下。
Method: 提出 H-FraDS 硬件感知帧调度方法，将帧以固定比例路由到 GPU 和双 DLA 核心；通过张量重塑、用 tanh 近似 ERF 和替换层归一化为有界 tanh 来适配 Transformer 组件，使其可在 DLA 上执行；并利用 OFA 进行推理端光流估计。
Result: 在 Swin Transformer 自动驾驶感知任务上，H-FraDS 均衡调度 (1:2) 实现 125.93 FPS，相比独立适配 DLA 执行加速 2.36 倍，能效 4.0 FPS/W，DLA 延迟约 24 ms，满足 30 FPS 实时要求；GPU-DLA-OFA 组合使 DLA 吞吐量加速 2.02 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法首次联合解决异构边缘 GPU 上的 Transformer 部署问题，通过硬件感知调度和算子适配实现高吞吐量和实时性，且仅降低 2% 的 F1 分数。

papers.title: Bandit PCA with Minimax Optimal Regret
papers.abstract_en: We study the bandit-feedback version of online principal component analysis (Bandit PCA): in each round $t = 1,\dots,T$, the adversary selects a $d \times d$ symmetric gain matrix $G_t$ with spectrum in $[0,1]$ and rank at most $r$; the learner simultaneously selects a unit vector $w_t \in S^{d-1}$ and receives the reward $w_t^\top G_t w_t$. The learner receives no other feedback, and aims to minimize the regret against the best unit vector in hindsight. This problem was introduced by Kotlowski and Neu (2019), who gave an algorithm with regret $O(d\sqrt{rT \log T})$ and showed the lower bound of $Ω(r\sqrt{T/\log T})$. We improve upon both of these bounds and essentially bridge the gap between them, establishing the minimax regret of order $r\sqrt{dT}$ up to polylogarithmic factors in $d$ and $T$. The upper bound is attained by a novel algorithm, which combines online mirror descent on the spectrahedron of (real) density matrices with a multiscale exploration scheme in which the eigenspaces with different spectral magnitudes are updated at different rates. For the lower bound, we construct an adaptive adversary that refines a hidden large-reward subspace based on the learner's actions, in such a way that low regret is impossible without estimating the subspace; as a result, lower-bounding the regret reduces to studying the arising subspace estimation problem. Finally, we discuss connections of Bandit PCA with adaptive-measurement quantum tomography.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线主成分分析（PCA）的赌博机反馈版本（Bandit PCA），其中学习者在每一轮选择一个单位向量，并仅观察到奖励值，目标是极小化对最佳固定向量的遗憾。作者给出了一个新颖的算法，将谱面（density matrices）上的在线镜像下降与多尺度探索策略相结合，实现了阶为 r√(dT)（忽略对数因子）的遗憾上界，并证明了与之匹配的下界 Ω(r√(T/log T))，从而几乎精确确定了极小化最优遗憾。
Motivation: Bandit PCA 是 Kotlowski 和 Neu (2019) 引入的问题，但已有的上界和下界之间存在间隙（上界 O(d√(rT log T))，下界 Ω(r√(T/log T))）。本文旨在缩小这一间隙，建立极小化最优的遗憾阶。
Method: 提出一种结合在线镜像下降（spectrahedron of density matrices）与多尺度探索的算法。多尺度探索方案允许不同谱大小的特征空间以不同速率更新。
Result: 建立了阶为 r√(dT)（对数因子内）的遗憾上界和 Ω(r√(T/log T)) 的下界，几乎精确匹配，从而确定了极小化最优遗憾阶。
Conclusion: 给出了 Bandit PCA 问题的极小化最优遗憾（忽略对数因子），并讨论了与自适应测量量子层析成像的联系。

papers.title: Fast Whole-Brain, Geometry-Aware Functional Alignment for Cross-Subject Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Decoding brain activity is useful for characterizing brain processes and understanding the functional architecture underlying cognition. However, the inter-individual variability in brain response patterns limits the development of decoders that generalize across individuals. A solution to this challenge is functional alignment: aligning functional data across individuals before training population-level decoders. The core issue is to strike the balance between aligning functional features and preserving the anatomical structure, while maintaining computational efficiency. We introduce a new functional alignment method for fMRI, SpectralOT, that embeds cortical geometry into Laplace-Beltrami eigenmodes along functional data to regularize the alignment.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 9th Conference on Cognitive Computational Neuroscience, New York, NY, USA, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对fMRI跨个体解码中的功能对齐问题，提出SpectralOT方法，利用Laplace-Beltrami特征模态将皮层几何嵌入功能数据以正则化对齐，旨在平衡功能特征保留、解剖结构保持与计算效率。
Motivation: 跨个体脑响应模式的差异限制了通用解码器的开发，现有功能对齐方法难以兼顾功能对齐精度、解剖结构保持与计算效率三者之间的平衡。
Method: 提出SpectralOT，一种基于谱嵌入的功能对齐方法，通过将皮层几何信息编码到Laplace-Beltrami特征模态中，对功能数据对齐进行正则化。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值，但方法声称在保持功能对齐和解剖结构的同时具备计算效率优势。
Conclusion: SpectralOT通过几何感知的正则化实现了功能对齐、解剖结构与计算效率的折衷。

papers.title: The Singularity Space: A Generative Diffusion Framework for Signal Representation
papers.abstract_en: Generative models often represent signals as dense grids of amplitudes, blurring sharp transients that are crucial for the correctness of physical signals. We introduce Singularity Space, a generative framework that represents signals through complex-plane singularities, rooted in the classical pole-residue representation of meromorphic functions. We learn a latent space of physically constrained, per-signal singularity configurations to solve an inverse problem from degraded or partial observations. The framework has three key properties: interpretability, in which each generated singularity configuration corresponds to a set of physical parameters; structural stability, which mitigates Gibbs artifacts at discontinuities; and resolution-free output reconstruction on arbitrary grids without retraining or interpolation. Our framework employs a transformer-based diffusion model that directly predicts samples at complex-plane singularity coordinates, subject to geometric constraints during sampling. As a controlled test case for sharp-feature recovery, we evaluate our framework on 1D Burgers shocks, where each shock is represented by 32 predicted singularities (an $8\times$ reduction versus a 1024-point grid signal). Our framework preserves signal structure ($\text{TV ratio} \approx 1$) under unseen test-time observation noise, achieves a $4.2\times$ lower reconstruction error in zero-shot sub-resolution generalization than a grid-based baseline, and recovers physical parameters to $10^{-4}$ absolute error in-distribution. These results suggest that singularity-based representations may provide a practical foundation for other transient-dominated signals such as speech and biomedical signals, with potential extension to higher-dimensional domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Singularity Space，一种基于复平面奇异点（极点-留数表示）的信号生成框架。该框架使用变压器扩散模型直接预测奇异点坐标，并受几何约束。在 1D Burgers 激波测试中，仅用 32 个奇异点表示信号（相比 1024 点网格减少 8 倍），在噪声下保持 TV 比≈1，零样本亚分辨率重建误差比网格基线低 4.2 倍，物理参数恢复绝对误差达 10^-4。
Motivation: 现有生成模型将信号表示为密集振幅网格，会模糊物理信号中的尖锐瞬态，不利于正确重建。
Method: 提出 Singularity Space 框架，将信号表示为复平面上的奇异点（极点-留数），学习每个信号的物理约束奇异点配置隐空间。使用基于变压器的扩散模型，在采样过程中施加几何约束，直接生成奇异点坐标。
Result: 在 1D Burgers 激波任务上，使用 32 个奇异点表示（网格信号 1024 点），在测试时噪声下 TV 比≈1；零样本亚分辨率泛化中重建误差比网格基线低 4.2 倍；物理参数恢复绝对误差 10^-4。
Conclusion: 基于奇异点的表示可为语音、生物医学等瞬态主导信号提供实用基础，并有潜力扩展到高维领域。

papers.title: The Spectral Structure of Latent Treatment Effects
papers.abstract_en: Identifying heterogeneous treatment effects under unobserved confounding is central in observational causal inference. In proxy models with a discrete latent confounder, prior Synthetic Potential Outcomes (SPO) [Mazaheri-Squires-Uhler '25] recover the mixture of treatment effects through recursively constructed scalar moments. We show that this sequence is one projection of a more fundamental object. Under the same population factorization assumptions, there is an exact compressed observable operator: after projecting onto the shared proxy signal subspace, the difference of two treatment-arm quotient operators is similar to the diagonal matrix of latent treatment effects. Its eigenvalues are the latent effects; its lifted left eigenvectors, after anchor normalization, recover the target-proxy feature matrix and then the latent mixture proportions. Every scalar SPO moment is a bilinear functional of a power of this operator. The resulting estimator handles overcomplete proxy systems, replaces high-order scalar inversion with finite-dimensional spectral analysis, and admits high-probability first-order perturbation bounds for treatment effects, feature rows, and simplex-projected mixture weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在潜在混杂因素存在且离散的代理模型中，证明先前SPO方法递归构造的标量矩实际上是更基本的压缩可观测算子的投影。该算子的特征值即为潜在治疗效应，左特征向量经锚点归一化可恢复目标-代理特征矩阵和混合比例。新方法支持过完备代理系统，用有限维谱分析替代高阶标量求逆，并给出治疗效应、特征行和混合权重的概率扰动界。
Motivation: 现有代理模型方法（如SPO）通过递归标量矩恢复异质性治疗效应，但高阶矩计算复杂且难以扩展到过完备代理系统。需要更本质的算子框架统一处理并提高鲁棒性。
Method: 假设离散潜在混杂因子下的代理模型满足相同的人口因子分解条件，构造两个治疗臂的商算子，其差在共享代理信号子空间上相似于潜在治疗效应的对角矩阵。通过特征分解得到效应值，利用左特征向量锚点归一化恢复特征矩阵和混合比例。
Result: 每个SPO标量矩是该算子幂的双线性泛函；新方法给出了治疗效应、特征行和单纯形投影混合权重的高概率一阶扰动界。
Conclusion: 所提出的谱方法将高维标量矩求逆转化为有限维特征分析，自然处理过完备代理系统，并具有理论上的误差保证，为因果推断中的异质性治疗效应识别提供了更紧凑的工具。
