papers.title: Infrared Organization and Critical Cognitive Field Formation in Transformer Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Large language models exhibit remarkable emergent behaviors, yet the physical mechanism governing their collective dynamics remains poorly understood. Cognitive Field Theory predicts that learning reorganizes the time-scale density of states (TDOS) through the infrared accumulation of slow relaxation modes, thereby enhancing the memory self-energy, reducing the cognitive forgetting gap, and strengthening the collective susceptibility. Using publicly available Pythia language models, we extract relaxation spectra directly from Transformer layer Jacobians throughout training, network depth, and model scale, allowing the TDOS, memory self-energy, forgetting gap, memory kernel, and infrared critical exponent to be measured quantitatively. The measurements reveal progressive infrared accumulation of slow relaxation modes, producing an approximately flat infrared TDOS with \( ρ(λ)\simλ^{-0.1} \) and scale-free memory kernels \( K(t)\sim t^{-1}. \) The memory self-energy exhibits a pronounced transient maximum during early optimization before relaxing toward a metastable near-critical regime, corresponding to the smallest cognitive forgetting gap and the largest collective susceptibility predicted by Cognitive Field Theory. These observations provide quantitative experimental evidence that Transformer dynamics are governed by infrared collective organization. The reproducibility of the same dynamical behavior across training, network depth, and model scales suggests that infrared slow-mode organization represents a universal collective principle of Transformer dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过提取Pythia语言模型的Transformer层Jacobian的松弛谱，定量测量了时间尺度态密度(TDOS)、记忆自能、遗忘间隙等，发现红外慢模式累积，TDOS近似平坦，记忆核呈无标度幂律衰减，记忆自能早期出现瞬态极大，支持认知场理论关于Transformer动力学受红外集体组织支配的预测。
Motivation: 大语言模型的涌现行为背后的物理机制尚不清晰，认知场理论预测学习会通过红外积累慢弛豫模式重新组织TDOS，但缺乏定量实验证据。
Method: 使用公开Pythia模型，从训练过程、网络深度和模型规模的Transformer层Jacobian中提取松弛谱，定量测量TDOS、记忆自能、遗忘间隙、记忆核和红外临界指数。
Result: 观测到红外慢模式渐进累积，TDOS近似平坦（ρ(λ)~λ^{-0.1}），记忆核无标度幂律衰减（K(t)~t^{-1}），记忆自能在早期优化出现瞬态极大，随后弛豫到亚稳态近临界区域，对应最小认知遗忘间隙和最大集体易感性。
Conclusion: 这些定量实验证据表明Transformer动力学受红外集体组织支配，且该行为在训练、深度和规模上可重复，暗示红外慢模式组织是Transformer动力学的普遍集体原理。

papers.title: Learning Linear Temporal Specifications from Demonstrations with Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Learning temporal logic specifications from system demonstrations is essential for tasks such as formal verification and controller synthesis, especially in safety-critical domains. Existing approaches typically assume demonstrations are correct or only affected by misclassification errors. In practice, however, system traces are often uncertain or incomplete due to sensor faults, measurement errors, or data loss. We present a framework for learning minimal Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) formulas from demonstrations with uncertainty. Our approach models uncertainty via Hamming distance to generate possible estimates around each observed trace, which are grouped with constraints requiring that at least one trace per group is consistent with the learned formula. Our problem is then reduced to an equivalent Pseudo-Boolean Optimization. We evaluate our method against state-of-the-art LTL learning approaches and show that it recovers specifications that more closely align with ground-truth formulas under uncertainty.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted by the ACC2026 (American Control Conference)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出从带有不确定性的系统演示中学习最小线性时序逻辑（LTL）公式的框架。通过汉明距离建模不确定性，将问题转化为伪布尔优化，与现有方法对比，在不确定性下恢复的规范更接近真实公式。
Motivation: 现有学习方法假设演示正确或仅受分类错误影响，但实际系统轨迹常因传感器故障、测量误差或数据丢失而存在不确定性。
Method: 利用汉明距离为每个观测轨迹生成可能的估计，并分组约束每组至少有一个轨迹与学习公式一致，将问题归约为伪布尔优化。
Result: 在不确定性条件下，该方法比现有LTL学习方法恢复的规范更接近真实公式。
Conclusion: 框架有效处理演示中的不确定性，适用于形式化验证和控制器合成等安全关键领域。

papers.title: Normative Alignment of Recommender Systems via Internal Label Shift
papers.abstract_en: We introduce NAILS (Normative Alignment of Recommender Systems via Internal Label Shift), a simple and scalable method for aligning recommendation outputs with target distributions over item-level attributes, such as categories. Recommender systems optimized solely for user engagement often fail to satisfy broader normative objectives, including fairness, diversity, and editorial values. NAILS modifies the user-conditional item distribution to induce a specified marginal distribution over attributes while preserving the preferences learned by an existing recommender system and requiring no model retraining. We formulate this problem as a form of label shift applied internally within a hierarchical classification framework. By adopting a stakeholder-centric perspective, NAILS enables recommendation outputs to be aligned with global normative objectives. Empirically, we show that NAILS consistently improves attribute-level alignment with minimal impact on user engagement, providing a practical mechanism for value-driven recommendation.
papers.comment: 6 pages. Published in the Proceedings of the Nineteenth ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys '25), Prague, Czech Republic, September 22-26, 2025. Code available at https://github.com/johanneskruse/nails
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出NAILS方法，通过内部标签偏移（label shift）调整推荐系统输出，使其满足指定项目属性（如类别）的目标分布，同时保持用户偏好。该方法无需重训练模型，且能有效改善公平性、多样性等规范目标。实验表明NAILS在最小化用户参与度影响下提升属性对齐。
Motivation: 传统推荐系统仅优化用户参与度，未能满足公平性、多样性等更广泛的规范目标。需要一种简单可扩展的方法来对齐推荐输出与目标属性分布。
Method: NAILS将推荐对齐问题建模为层次分类框架中的内部标签偏移。它修改用户条件项目分布，诱导出指定的边际属性分布，同时保留已有推荐系统学习的偏好，无需重新训练。
Result: 实验显示NAILS能持续改善属性对齐，且对用户参与度影响极小。
Conclusion: NAILS提供了一种实用的、以价值为导向的推荐对齐机制，采用利益相关者中心视角，使推荐输出与全局规范目标一致。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: DP-Splat: Bayesian Nonparametric Complexity Control for Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting represents scenes as finite mixtures of anisotropic Gaussians whose number of components $K$ is set by heuristic density control or user caps. Variational Bayes Gaussian Splatting (VBGS) recast splat fitting as conjugate variational inference, but $K$ remains fixed. We replace the finite symmetric Dirichlet over mixture weights with a truncated stick-breaking Dirichlet-process prior -- and, as a theory-backed alternative, a sparse overfitted finite Dirichlet -- so that the number of occupied components adapts to the data while every update remains a closed-form coordinate-ascent step; a natural-gradient stochastic variant makes the per-step cost independent of the number of points. We give an exact monotonicity guarantee, a rigorous truncation-error bound correcting an anti-conservative large-$α$ approximation in common use, and an honest account of what the fitted number of components estimates. Empirically: (i) the effective complexity $\hat{K}$ adapts to scene complexity and recovers the true $K$ within $\pm 1$ on well-separated synthetic data with regime-appropriate concentration; (ii) a deconfounded comparison shows the DP prior's contribution is complexity selection, not per-component efficiency -- converged DP fits exceed single-pass fixed-$K$ VBGS by +2.7 dB at matched budgets yet tie an equally converged fixed-$K$ baseline, and on 3D scenes DP-Splat matches or exceeds VBGS's held-out color prediction with 5.9-7.6x fewer components; (iii) the posterior-predictive color variance is well calibrated on model-matched synthetic data; and (iv) the ordering suggested by exact-posterior asymptotics reverses under mean-field coordinate ascent: the DP prior resists over-splitting while the sparse finite mixture saturates its truncation, a gap between variational practice and posterior asymptotics documented across three orders of magnitude in $N$.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 8 figures. Code and experiment records: https://github.com/archiedong/dp-splat
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对3D高斯泼溅中分量数固定或启发式设定的问题，提出DP-Splat，用截断stick-breaking狄利克雷过程先验或稀疏过拟合有限狄利克雷先验替代固定混合权重先验，使分量数自适应于数据。该方法保持闭式坐标上升更新，并引入自然梯度变体以降低每步成本。实验表明，DP-Splat在合成数据上恢复真实分量数，在3D场景中以5.9-7.6倍更少分量匹配或超越VBGS，同时揭示变分实践与后验渐近性之间的偏差。
Motivation: 现有3D高斯泼溅方法中分量数由启发式密度控制或用户上限设定，缺乏自适应机制；变分贝叶斯高斯泼溅（VBGS）虽引入共轭变分推断，但分量数仍固定。需要一种能自动调整复杂度的方法。
Method: 用截断stick-breaking狄利克雷过程先验（以及稀疏过拟合有限狄利克雷先验作为替代）替换混合权重上的有限对称狄利克雷先验，使有效分量数自适应于数据。推导闭式坐标上升更新步骤，并给出自然梯度随机变体以消除对点数的线性依赖。提供严格的截断误差界和单调性保证。
Result: 在合成数据上，有效复杂度K̂适应场景复杂度，恢复真实K±1；在3D场景中，DP-Splat以5.9-7.6倍更少分量匹配或超越VBGS的保留色彩预测；后验预测色彩方差在模型匹配合成数据上校准良好；发现平均场变分推断下DP先验抵抗过度分裂，而稀疏有限混合饱和截断，与精确后验渐近性相反。
Conclusion: 本文证明了DP先验在3D高斯泼溅中实现自适应复杂度选择的有效性，且收敛表现与同样收敛的固定K基线持平，但使用更少分量。同时，揭示了变分坐标上升与后验渐近性之间的系统性偏差。

papers.title: The Nuts and Bolts of Natural Language to SQL Translation: A Systematic Analysis of Model Pipeline Optimisation Approaches and their Interactions
papers.abstract_en: In the age of large language models, Natural Language to SQL (NL2SQL) translation remains an open problem with many useful applications. We explore interactions between several NL2SQL pipeline extensions to inspire development of more lightweight models. Specifically, we integrate the NatSQL intermediate representation, include a preprocessing step and a fine-tuning step based on synthetic data, and develop a novel reranker model to improve SQL selection in the final beam. We perform an ablation study supplemented by a Shapley analysis of these different components integrated with two backbone architectures, SmBoP and RASAT. We find that simply combining all of them does not lead to best results, but that their impact depends on their interactions with the baseline system, as well as each other.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统分析自然语言转SQL (NL2SQL) 流水线中多项扩展技术的交互效应，包括NatSQL中间表示、预处理、基于合成数据的微调以及新型重排序模型。基于SmBoP和RASAT两种骨干架构进行消融实验和Shapley分析，发现简单组合所有组件并非最优，各组件的影响取决于彼此及基线的交互。
Motivation: NL2SQL翻译在大型语言模型时代仍是开放问题，需要探索轻量级模型，通过分析流水线扩展的交互来指导优化。
Method: 集成NatSQL中间表示、预处理步骤、基于合成数据的微调步骤，并开发新重排序模型以改进波束搜索的SQL选择。在SmBoP和RASAT骨干上进行消融研究和Shapley分析。
Result: 简单组合所有扩展不会带来最佳结果，各组件的效果依赖于与基线系统及彼此之间的交互。
Conclusion: NL2SQL流水线优化需考虑组件间的交互，而非盲目堆砌。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文系统分析自然语言转SQL (NL2SQL) 流水线中多项扩展技术的交互效应，包括NatSQL中间表示、预处理、基于合成数据的微调以及新型重排序模型。基于SmBoP和RASAT两种骨干架构进行消融实验和Shapley分析，发现简单组合所有组件并非最优，各组件的影响取决于彼此及基线的交互。

papers.title: ZoRRO: A Zero-Weight Personalized Recommender System for Scalable News Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: We present ZoRRO (Zero-Weight Personalized Recommender System), a zero-weight, training-free framework for personalized news recommendation designed for scalable real-world deployment. ZoRRO outperforms strong neural baselines in offline ranking evaluations and achieves click-through rate performance in online A/B testing that is nearly on par with a state-of-the-art deep learning model, while operating more than 600 times faster. Our experiments reveal gaps between offline and online performance and demonstrate that models with similar click-through rate outcomes can produce markedly different recommendation distributions, thereby influencing the overall news flow. These findings position ZoRRO as a practical and efficient solution for large-scale news recommendation and highlight the importance of evaluating recommender systems using metrics beyond accuracy alone.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 49th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR '26), Melbourne, Australia, July 20-24, 2026. Code available at https://github.com/johanneskruse/zorro
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ZoRRO，一种零权重、无需训练的个性化新闻推荐框架，适用于大规模真实部署。该框架在离线排名评估中优于强神经基线，在线 A/B 测试的点击率（CTR）几乎与最先进的深度学习模型相当，但速度快 600 倍以上。实验揭示了离线与在线性能之间的差距，并指出具有相似 CTR 的模型可能产生截然不同的推荐分布，影响新闻流。
Motivation: 现有新闻推荐系统通常依赖训练参数，部署成本高且难以扩展到大规模实时场景，需要更高效的解决方案。
Method: ZoRRO 是一种零权重（zero-weight）框架，无需训练即可生成个性化推荐，通过轻量级计算实现快速推理。
Result: 离线评估中 ZoRRO 在排名指标上优于强神经基线；在线 A/B 测试中 CTR 几乎与 SOTA 深度学习模型持平，但推理速度提升超过 600 倍。
Conclusion: ZoRRO 作为实用高效的新闻推荐方案，适合大规模部署，同时强调推荐系统评估应超越单一准确性指标，关注推荐分布的影响。

papers.title: Design Choices in Splitting-Based Self-Supervised Sparse-View CT Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised data splitting has emerged as a promising paradigm for sparse-view CT reconstruction, enabling training from incomplete measurements without fully sampled ground truth. However, the influence of key design choices, including partitioning strategy, preprocessing, and inference, remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we introduce a unified framework that decomposes splitting-based reconstruction into these three components, enabling controlled comparison of existing methods and two incremental extensions: multi-partition splitting and an alternative inference strategy. Experiments on simulated LoDoPaB-CT data under independent and correlated noise, together with validation on the real-world 2DeteCT dataset, show that the optimal partitioning strategy strongly depends on the measurement noise structure. Lattice-based splitting performs favorably under independent noise, whereas angular masking is more robust under correlated noise and real measured data. Multi-partition splitting consistently improves over pure projection-wise splitting in several settings. Complementary perceptual and structural metrics, including LPIPS and HaarPSI, reveal differences between masking strategies that are less apparent from PSNR and SSIM alone. These results provide practical guidelines for designing self-supervised sparse-view CT reconstruction methods and highlight the limitations of common independence assumptions in realistic imaging environments.
papers.comment: 12 pages (main manuscript), 9 pages (supplementary material and figures)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了基于数据拆分的自监督稀疏视图CT重建中的关键设计选择，包括划分策略、预处理和推理，提出了一个统一框架进行比较。实验表明最优划分策略依赖于噪声结构，晶格划分在独立噪声下表现好，角度掩膜在相关噪声和真实数据中更鲁棒，多划分拆分能提升性能。
Motivation: 现有自监督稀疏视图CT重建方法对设计选择（如划分策略、预处理、推理）的影响缺乏系统理解，常见独立性假设在真实成像环境中可能不成立。
Method: 提出一个统一框架，将基于拆分的重建分解为划分策略、预处理和推理三个组件，并引入了两种增量扩展：多划分拆分和替代推理策略。
Result: 在模拟LoDoPaB-CT数据和真实2DeteCT数据集上，晶格划分在独立噪声下更优，角度掩膜在相关噪声和真实数据中更鲁棒；多划分拆分在多个设置中持续优于纯投影拆分；LPIPS和HaarPSI指标揭示了掩膜策略间PSNR/SSIM不易察觉的差异。
Conclusion: 研究为设计自监督稀疏视图CT重建方法提供了实用指南，并指出了常见独立性假设在真实成像环境中的局限性。

papers.title: Incremental Transformer for Surrogate-Based Inverse Design of Geopolymer Mixtures
papers.abstract_en: Small-data inverse design is challenging in engineering informatics when observations are heterogeneous, mixed-type, and constrained by physical relations among design variables. This work proposes a topology-aware surrogate framework guided by an Incremental Transformer (INCRT) for physics-constrained inverse design, applied to geopolymer mixture design. The method integrates intrinsic-dimensionality analysis, mixed-variable design-space representation, tabular surrogate prediction, INCRT-based manifold rationalisation, and constrained inverse optimisation. Using a public benchmark of fly-ash and slag-based geopolymer concrete mixtures with compressive-strength and carbon-emission targets, the high-dimensional design space proves strongly redundant, organising around fewer effective mixture regimes. Compressive strength requires nonlinear tabular surrogates, while carbon emission is largely determined by composition and well recovered by regularised linear models. INCRT thus acts not as a replacement for tabular predictors but as a rationalisation layer providing prototype regimes and a manifold-support score for inverse design. Three strategies are compared: unconstrained surrogate optimisation, physics-constrained optimisation, and topology-aware physics-constrained optimisation. Unconstrained optimisation can match target strength but may yield physically invalid or off-manifold candidates; physics-only constraints do not always ensure data support. The topology-aware strategy yields candidates balancing target compliance, carbon reduction, physical admissibility, and proximity to the learned feasible manifold. The framework aims not to replace experimental validation but to support screening of credible candidate mixtures from small, mixed, physically constrained engineering datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于增量Transformer（INCRT）的拓扑感知代理框架，用于小数据、物理约束的逆设计，应用在地质聚合物混合物设计中。方法结合本征维度分析、混合变量设计空间表示、表格代理预测、INCRT流形合理化及约束逆优化。在粉煤灰和矿渣基地质聚合物混凝土数据集上测试，结果表明高维设计空间冗余，压缩强度需非线性表格代理，碳排放可通过线性模型恢复。拓扑感知策略能生成平衡目标符合性、碳减排、物理合理性和流形接近度的候选方案。
Motivation: 小数据逆设计面临观测异质性、混合类型和物理关系约束的挑战，现有方法难以处理。
Method: 提出INCRT作为合理化层，提供原型机制和流形支持分数，结合本征维度分析、混合变量表示、表格代理预测和约束逆优化。
Result: 在公开数据集上，拓扑感知物理约束优化比无约束或仅物理约束方法更有效，生成的目标候选方案在合规性、减排和物理合理性上更优。
Conclusion: 框架旨在从小型、混合、物理约束的工程数据集中支持可信候选混合物的筛选，而非替代实验验证。

papers.title: SETA: Scaling Environments for Terminal Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly shifting toward agents that solve tasks through diverse interfaces, including web and graphical user interfaces (GUIs). Among these, the terminal command line provides a text-based, general-purpose interface, covering tasks from system operations to data science and machine learning. However, scaling terminal-agent training remains challenging, as it requires diverse and coherent task instructions, executable environments, and reliable verification, while lacking naturally grounded supervision data. In this work, we propose SETA, a scalable framework for generating verifiable terminal environments for reinforcement learning (RL). The framework consists of two pipelines sharing a unified verification mechanism: SETA-Synth converts diverse sources into standardized RL environments, and SETA-Evol further expands from existing environments with adaptive control of difficulty and diversity. Together, we construct and release SETA-Env, the largest open-source verifiable terminal RL dataset to date, containing over 4,500 environments. We evaluate our dataset by training Qwen3-8B with GRPO on SETA-Env, achieving 12% pass rate on Terminal-Bench 2.0, the best reported result for an RL-trained model at the 8B scale. We further observe gains on DeepSeek-V4-Flash under the same terminal agent harness, with pass@1 on Terminal-Bench 2.0 improving from 40% to 43% and pass@5 improving from 54% to 58%. These results demonstrate that SETA- Env provides high-quality training environments for terminal agents and serves as a valuable resource for advancing research on terminal-based agent learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SETA框架，用于生成可验证的终端环境，以支持强化学习训练终端智能体。框架包含两个流水线：SETA-Synth将多样来源转化为标准化RL环境，SETA-Evol从现有环境扩展并自适应控制难度和多样性。基于此构建了包含4500+环境的开源数据集SETA-Env，并用GRPO训练Qwen3-8B，在Terminal-Bench 2.0上达到12%的通过率，为8B规模RL训练模型的最佳结果。在DeepSeek-V4-Flash上，pass@1从40%提升至43%，pass@5从54%提升至58%。
Motivation: 终端智能体训练需要多样化、连贯的任务指令、可执行环境和可靠验证，但缺乏自然监督数据，可扩展训练环境不足。
Method: 提出SETA框架，包含SETA-Synth（将多样化来源转化为标准RL环境）和SETA-Evol（从现有环境扩展，自适应控制难度和多样性），并共享统一验证机制。
Result: 构建SETA-Env数据集（4500+环境）；用GRPO训练Qwen3-8B，Terminal-Bench 2.0通过率12%，为8B规模RL训练最佳；DeepSeek-V4-Flash上pass@1从40%到43%，pass@5从54%到58%。
Conclusion: SETA-Env提供了高质量终端智能体训练环境，是终端智能体学习研究的重要资源。

papers.title: Transferable Implicit Solvent Machine Learning Potential for Drugs and Proteins Approaching Ab Initio Accuracy
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLPs) have revolutionized atomistic modeling, offering the potential to replace traditional methods like Density Functional Theory (DFT). However, inference time of MLPs is orders of magnitude slower than that of classical force fields, hindering real-world applications for biomolecular systems that require timescales of microseconds and beyond. Implicit solvent MLPs can address this issue, but are faced with data challenges associated with coarse-grained modeling. Consequently, previous approaches relied on empirical force field data, thereby inherently limiting the MLP's accuracy. Here, we introduce the Transferable Water Implicit Network (TWIN), an implicit water MLP parametrized entirely by an Equivariant Graph Neural Network and trained solely on ab initio and experimental labels. We demonstrate TWIN's transferability across drug-like molecules, peptides, and proteins, achieving excellent results on ab initio and experimental crystallographic and NMR benchmarks, consistently outperforming previous machine-learning-based implicit solvent or coarse-grained models. Furthermore, TWIN closely matches DFT-based explicit solvent MLPs while providing a two-order-of-magnitude faster timestep evaluation, paving the way for efficient ab initio-level modeling of biomolecular systems in aqueous environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可转移的水隐式网络（TWIN），一种完全由等变图神经网络参数化、仅基于从头算和实验标签训练的隐式水MLP。TWIN在药物分子、肽和蛋白质上展现了可转移性，在从头算和实验晶体学及NMR基准上优于先前的机器学习隐式溶剂或粗粒化模型，并且与基于DFT的显式溶剂MLP精度接近，同时时间步长评估快两个数量级。

papers.title: First-Order Modal Logic in HOL: Deep and Shallow Embeddings with Automated Faithfulness (Extended Preprint)
papers.abstract_en: We extend, in Isabelle/HOL, the deep-and-shallow embedding methodology of our prior work from propositional to first-order modal logic (FML) with constant-domain Kripke semantics. Three embeddings of FML into classical higher-order logic (HOL) are provided side by side: a deep embedding, a heavyweight maximal-shallow embedding, and a lightweight minimal-shallow embedding. The minimal-shallow embedding is presented as an Isabelle/HOL locale, parametrised by an accessibility relation, a world-indexed interpretation, a universe of worlds, and a variable assignment; the locale form admits a global faithfulness theorem, stating that quantifying over all minimal-shallow interpretations recovers exactly deep validity. A central technical contribution is a mechanisation, for FML under constant-domain Kripke semantics, of the (countable) downward Löwenheim-Skolem theorem, which underpins the automation of our faithfulness proof between the deep and minimal-shallow embeddings. Deploying it inside an extension of the minimal-shallow locale resolves the surjectivity problem that arises against an uncountable domain of individuals -- where the locale's variable assignment, having countable domain V = nat, cannot be surjective onto the domain -- and thereby yields faithfulness over the full domain. Since prior work treats only the propositional fragment, we develop here the substitution machinery (free/bound-variable predicates, the fresh-variable function, capture-avoiding substitution, alphabetic renaming, the substitutability predicate, the substitution lemma, and size-based induction principles) needed for the first-order quantifiers.

TL;DR: 本文在Isabelle/HOL中将先前命题模态逻辑的深浅嵌入方法扩展至一阶模态逻辑（FML），采用常域Kripke语义。并列提供了三种FML到经典高阶逻辑的嵌入：深嵌入、重量级最大浅嵌入和轻量级最小浅嵌入。主要技术贡献是机械化证明了FML在常域Kripke语义下的可数向下Löwenheim-Skolem定理，该定理支撑了深嵌入与最小浅嵌入之间的忠实性证明自动化。
Motivation: 先前工作仅处理命题片段，缺乏一阶量词所需的替换机制和忠实性证明。本文旨在填补这一空白，为一阶模态逻辑提供可靠的嵌入方法学。
Method: 提出三种嵌入：深嵌入将FML公式翻译为HOL数据类型；最小浅嵌入作为Isabelle/HOL locale，参数化于可及关系、世界索引解释、世界域和变量赋值。利用向下Löwenheim-Skolem定理解决最小浅嵌入中变量赋值（可数域）相对于个体域（不可数）的非满射问题，从而在全体域上建立忠实性。
Result: 摘要报告成功在Isabelle/HOL中机械化了一阶模态逻辑的深浅嵌入，并证明了深嵌入与最小浅嵌入之间的忠实性。
Conclusion: 本文扩展了深浅嵌入方法学至一阶模态逻辑，为自动化推理提供基础。局限性在于仅针对常域Kripke语义。

papers.title: 3D Scene Graph Prediction: Generating Hierarchical Models from Partially Observed Environments
papers.abstract_en: Generating realistic 3D indoor scenes is an area of growing interest in computer vision and robotics. Existing methods, often motivated by applications such as interior design, generally focus on object layout generation within a single room. The generation of high-level scene structure, such as room-level layout and traversability, remains underexplored despite its importance for robotics applications. In this paper, we consider the case where a robot has explored part of an environment and needs to predict the unexplored parts to support downstream tasks such as exploration or object search. We propose a top-down framework for synthesizing hierarchical 3D scene graphs, including a room layer -- describing the floor plan and traversability -- and an object layer modeling object layouts within each room. For the room layer, we propose a novel mixed-domain graph diffusion model jointly predicting room categories, floor boundaries, and traversability between rooms. Via corruption and masking, this model supports partial constraints such as incomplete floor plans, avoiding the need for partially observed training data. For the object layer, we integrate an existing mixed discrete-continuous diffusion model for joint prediction of object categories, locations, sizes, and orientations within each room given the floor plan. We compare our method with state-of-the-art occupancy-based and LLM-based floor plan generation methods on a standard benchmark. Compared with an occupancy-based learning baseline, our method generalizes substantially better to out-of-distribution partial floor plans. We also demonstrate our integrated prediction pipeline on real-world scenes from robot-collected data, enabling prediction beyond explored areas.
papers.comment: Accepted at IROS 2026. Main paper: 8 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Includes a supplementary appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种从部分观察的室内环境生成层次化3D场景图的框架，包括房间层（楼层平面和可穿越性）和对象层（对象布局）。房间层采用混合域图扩散模型，通过损坏和掩码支持部分约束；对象层集成现有的混合离散-连续扩散模型。实验表明该方法在标准基准上优于基于占用和LLM的方法，并在机器人采集的真实场景中预测未探索区域。
Motivation: 现有3D室内场景生成方法多关注单房间内的对象布局，而高层场景结构（如房间布局和可穿越性）对机器人应用至关重要但未被充分探索。
Method: 提出自顶向下的框架：房间层使用混合域图扩散模型，通过损坏和掩码支持部分约束（如不完整楼层平面）；对象层集成现有的混合离散-连续扩散模型，根据楼层平面预测对象类别、位置、大小和方向。
Result: 在标准基准上与最新的基于占用和LLM的楼层平面生成方法相比，本文方法在分布外的部分楼层平面上泛化能力显著更好，并在机器人采集的真实数据上展示了完整的预测流程。
Conclusion: 本文证明了利用图扩散模型生成层次化3D场景图的有效性，尤其适用于机器人在未知环境中进行预测，以支持探索和对象搜索等下游任务。

papers.title: LOGOS: A Living Logic for AI Agent Teams That Evolve With Humans
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are evolving from answer engines into persistent teams that use tools, delegate work, learn from experience, and modify the artifacts that shape their future behavior. The defining question for deployment is no longer merely what agents can do, but who controls what they are allowed to become. We introduce logos, a pluggable layer for self-evolution and governance that strengthens existing multiagent frameworks rather than replacing them. logos compiles heterogeneous multimodal inputs, including documents, images, audio, tables, databases, APIs, and human instructions into versioned agent packs containing agents, tools, knowledge, tests, permissions, and policies. During operation, it transforms agent activity into portable, auditable event traces and applies fail-closed verification across frameworks and backends. Every learned prompt, memory, skill, tool, role, or workflow remains an untrusted release candidate until held-out execution evidence, human-controlled policy, and explicit authorization permit its promotion. This architecture enables "verifiable human-agent loop engineering": agents can act, ask, learn, and propose improvements, while humans can steer objectives, permissions, approvals, and irreversible actions without interrupting continuous operation. logos provides a living logic for accountable automation. Agents may evolve at machine speed, but only evidence and human authority can close the loop.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LOGOS，一个可插拔的自身演化与治理层，用于增强现有多智能体框架。LOGOS将异构多模态输入编译成版本化的智能体包，通过事件追踪和验证机制确保智能体行为可审计，并实现人类可控的智能体演化循环。
Motivation: 现有AI智能体从回答引擎进化为持续协作的团队，但缺乏对智能体演化方向和权限的控制机制，导致部署中的治理问题。
Method: LOGOS作为中间层，接收文档、图像、音频等输入，生成版本化的智能体包（含智能体、工具、知识、测试、权限和策略）。通过事件追踪和失败关闭验证确保可审计性，智能体改进需经过人类策略和授权才能生效。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验定量结果，主要描述架构设计及其在可控性和可审计性方面的优势。
Conclusion: LOGOS实现了可验证的人机循环工程，允许智能体快速演化但最终由人类证据和权威控制闭环，为负责任的自动化提供可行方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: X-GuideAR: An Augmented Reality Framework to Mitigate Radiation Exposure during Fluoroscopic Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Achieving optimal screw placement for orthopedic surgeries requires frequent alignment checks and multiple anatomical views under X-ray -- a process known as "fluoro-hunting" that increases radiation exposure to patients and surgical teams. This work introduces X-GuideAR, an augmented reality (AR) framework for identifying optimal X-ray views, aimed at reducing radiation exposure while ensuring accurate screw placement. To exemplify the benefits of X-GuideAR, we focus on S2 alar-iliac (S2AI) screw placement. Our system provides radiation-free guidance for view acquisition and drilling by generating synthetic X-ray previews that accelerate fluoro-hunting. Once the required anatomical views are identified using these previews, a real X-ray is acquired, and the preview of the drilling trajectory is augmented onto it, facilitating precise screw placement with minimal additional radiation. A preliminary study involving eight S2AI trajectories performed by an expert spine surgeon demonstrated a 62.3% reduction in the number of X-rays. Post-procedure evaluations showed that trajectories done with X-GuideAR supported an average safe screw diameter of 12.95 mm compared to 5.9 mm under the conventional workflow, suggesting improved bony containment and potential biomechanical benefit. X-GuideAR shows great potential to reduce radiation exposure and streamline S2AI screw placement, offering a promising direction toward safer and more efficient surgeries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出X-GuideAR，一个增强现实框架，旨在减少透视引导过程中的辐射暴露，通过生成合成X射线预览加速“氟化追踪”过程。初步研究表明，在S2AI螺钉放置中，该方法减少了62.3%的X射线使用，并提高了安全螺钉直径。
Motivation: 骨科手术中频繁的X射线检查（氟化追踪）增加了患者和手术团队的辐射暴露，需要一种减少辐射且不影响螺钉放置准确性的方法。
Method: X-GuideAR通过生成合成X射线预览来指导视图获取和钻孔，无需额外辐射，并在获取真实X射线后增强钻孔轨迹预览。
Result: 初步研究显示，与传统工作流程相比，X射线数量减少62.3%，平均安全螺钉直径从5.9毫米提高到12.95毫米。
Conclusion: X-GuideAR有潜力减少辐射暴露并简化S2AI螺钉放置流程，为更安全高效的手术提供了方向。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Toward Contemplative LLM: A Modular Framework for Evaluating and Enhancing LLM Alignment in Mental Health
papers.abstract_en: Contemplative traditions have long guided ethical behavior and prosocial interaction, and recent work suggests that contemplative principles (e.g., mindfulness, compassion, non-dual reasoning) may offer a promising paradigm for aligning large language models (LLMs), improving cooperation and reducing ethical violations in LLM outputs. However, as new models, evaluation metrics, and benchmarks emerge rapidly, it remains challenging to systematically assess whether and how contemplative principles enhance LLM alignment across diverse and evolving scenarios, and existing approaches are often ad hoc and fail to generalize. We present a modular, extensible evaluation framework, initially targeted at the mental health domain, that enables seamless integration of new models, metrics, and benchmarks through a reusable pipeline. The framework currently reproduces existing state-of-the-art results and supports systematic cross-evaluation by flexibly mixing and matching models, metrics, and benchmarks, enabling fair comparison and deeper insight. Its plug-and-play prompting module offers a principled pathway for incorporating ethical perspectives such as contemplative principles, allowing domain experts to define alignment criteria without requiring technical expertise. Although initially focused on mental health, the framework is domain-agnostic and extends naturally to areas such as decision-making, moral reasoning, and human-AI collaboration. By bridging computational evaluation with human-centered ethical reasoning, this work lays the groundwork for interdisciplinary research spanning cognitive science, behavioral economics, philosophy, and system design, toward robust, trustworthy, and socially beneficial human-AI ecosystems.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个模块化、可扩展的评估框架，最初针对心理健康领域，用于系统评估和改进大语言模型（LLM）的对齐，特别是通过融入沉思原则（如正念、慈悲、非二元推理）来增强伦理行为。该框架通过可复用的pipeline支持无缝集成新模型、指标和基准，并提供了一个即插即用的提示模块，允许领域专家无需技术知识即可定义对齐标准。框架复现了现有SOTA结果，支持灵活交叉评估，且领域无关，可扩展到决策、道德推理和人机协作等领域。
Motivation: 现有LLM对齐评估方法往往是临时性的，无法泛化，难以系统评估沉思原则如何在不同场景下增强LLM对齐。需要一个标准化、可扩展的框架来支持公平比较和深入洞察。
Method: 提出一个模块化评估框架，包含可复用的pipeline，支持新模型、指标和基准的集成；核心是即插即用的提示模块，用于融入伦理视角（如沉思原则），使领域专家能定义对齐标准而无需技术背景。
Result: 框架复现了现有SOTA结果，并支持通过灵活混合匹配模型、指标和基准进行系统交叉评估，实现公平比较。
Conclusion: 该框架桥接了计算评估与人类中心伦理推理，为认知科学、行为经济学、哲学和系统设计等跨学科研究奠定基础，旨在构建稳健、可信、有益的人机生态系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Singular perturbations and hierarchical learning in two-layer neural networks
papers.abstract_en: We study the population gradient flow of an infinitely wide two-layer neural network learning a misspecified single-index model in high dimension. The two layers are optimized jointly, with a perturbative parameter tuning the relative training speed between the first and second layer. This setting was considered by Berthier, Montanari and Zhou in \cite{berthier2024learning}, who conjectured a hierarchical learning scenario with explicit timescales as the second layer is trained faster than the first. In this paper, we prove that the constant and linear components of the hidden link function are indeed recovered within the predicted timescales, at sharp explicit thresholds. We then analyze the onset of learning of the quadratic component and show that the components learned at earlier stages continue to influence the dynamics in an essential way. Our proof is based on quantitative approximation results for singularly perturbed flows evolving near a manifold defined by integral constraints. At a phenomenological level, we also show that the empirical measure of the weights displays singular behaviour when reaching the quadratic component of the hidden link, with a small fraction of neurons growing significantly while the remaining ones rearrange to preserve the components already learned.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了高维空间中无穷宽两层神经网络在错误设定的单指数模型上的群体梯度流，其中两层联合优化并引入一个摄动参数来调节第一层与第二层的相对训练速度。作者证明了在学习隐藏链接函数的常数和线性分量时，存在尖锐的显式时间阈值，并分析了二次分量学习的起始阶段，揭示了早期学习分量对后续动力学的持续影响。
Motivation: Berthier, Montanari 和 Zhou 在之前的工作中猜想了一个分层学习场景及其显式时间尺度，但未得到严格证明。本文旨在从数学上确认这一猜想，并深入分析学习过程中不同分量的相互作用。
Method: 使用奇异摄动理论，对接近由积分约束定义的流形演化的摄动流进行定量逼近，从而分析两层神经网络的群体梯度流在联合训练下的动态行为。
Result: 证明了隐藏链接函数的常数和线性分量在预测的时间尺度内被恢复，并给出了尖锐的显式阈值。同时，揭示了二次分量学习开始时，权重的经验测度出现奇异行为，一小部分神经元显著增长，其余神经元重新排列以保持已学习的分量。
Conclusion: 本文严格验证了分层学习的显式时间尺度，并强调了早期学习分量在后继学习中的关键作用。该方法为分析高维神经网络的分层动态提供了数学框架。

papers.title: AU-Guided Synthetic Video Generation for Micro-Expression Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Micro-expression recognition is limited by the small scale, narrow demographic coverage, and restricted emotion labels of existing datasets. We introduce EquiME, a synthetic micro-expression dataset built from AU-guided image-to-video generation. EquiME contains 75K videos generated from 15K source face images across five target emotions, together with automatically inferred demographic metadata and video-quality measurements. We evaluate EquiME using frame-pair similarity, spatial variation, and no-reference perceptual-quality metrics, together with cross-dataset MER experiments on SAMM and CASME II. Models trained on EquiME achieve competitive cross-dataset performance on SAMM and CASME II and show comparatively low variation across the four evaluated architectures. This paper focuses on the dataset design, the structured AU-conditioning pipeline used for video generation, and the empirical evidence needed to assess EquiME as a synthetic MER resource. Project page: https://kirito-blade.github.io/me-vlm/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EquiME，一个由AU引导的图像到视频生成的合成微表情数据集，包含75K视频，用于缓解现有数据集规模小、人口覆盖窄、情绪标签少的问题。摘要报告在SAMM和CASME II上训练的模型取得了有竞争力的跨数据集性能。
Motivation: 微表情识别受限于现有数据集规模小、人口覆盖窄、情绪标签有限。
Method: 通过AU引导的图像到视频生成构建合成数据集EquiME，包含75K视频，来自15K源面部图像的五种目标情绪，并自动推断人口统计元数据和视频质量。
Result: 使用帧对相似性、空间变化和无参考感知质量指标评估EquiME，并在SAMM和CASME II上进行跨数据集MER实验。训练于EquiME的模型在SAMM和CASME II上取得有竞争力的跨数据集性能，且在四种架构上变化较低。
Conclusion: 本文聚焦于数据集设计、结构化AU条件生成流程以及评估EquiME作为合成MER资源的实证证据。

papers.title: How Do Practitioners Build SE Agents? Insights from a Mixed-Methods Study
papers.abstract_en: The rise of Software Engineering (SE) agents, i.e., LLM-based agents that can understand large codebases and carry out engineering tasks with limited human intervention, has been marked by rapid advances and adoption, but little is known about how developers build these systems in practice: existing studies mine repositories or examine deployment, but few investigate how SE agents are constructed. Through semi-structured interviews with 20 practitioners from 12 organizations and an online survey of 80 practitioners, this paper is the first to study how SE processes are changing in the development of SE agents and what challenges developers face. We find that as implementation becomes cheaper, bottlenecks shift rather than disappear: long-standing non-coding work such as requirements, coordination, review, and deployment becomes more visible, while reviewing and evaluating agent output becomes new and central. We characterize a seven-stage workflow and a shift toward evaluation-driven development, in which evaluation steers iteration and specifications become versioned artifacts read by both humans and agents. We further identify six challenges that teams face, together with the practices they adopt to address them, including unreliable evaluation signals, comprehension debt as code outpaces understanding, and behavioral changes introduced by provider-side model updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过混合方法研究（20名从业者半结构化访谈和80名从业者在线调查）首次系统探讨了软件工程（SE）代理（即基于LLM的代理）的构建实践。研究发现，随着实现成本降低，瓶颈转向长期存在的非编码工作（如需求、协调、评审、部署），而评审和评估代理输出成为新的核心任务。文章总结了七个阶段的工作流以及向评估驱动开发的转变，并识别了六项挑战及应对实践。
Motivation: 现有研究主要挖掘代码仓库或检查部署，但缺乏对开发者如何实际构建SE代理的了解。本文旨在填补这一空白，理解SE流程在SE代理开发中的变化及开发者面临的挑战。
Method: 采用混合方法研究：对来自12个组织的20名从业者进行半结构化访谈，并对80名从业者进行在线调查。
Result: 发现实现成本降低后，非编码工作（如需求、协调、评审、部署）变得更加突出，评审和评估代理输出成为新核心。总结了七个阶段的工作流和评估驱动开发模式，识别了六项挑战，包括不可靠的评估信号、理解债务以及模型更新引起的行为变化。
Conclusion: 本文首次揭示了SE代理构建的实践工作流和挑战，强调了评估驱动开发的重要性，并为未来SE代理的开发和工具支持提供了指导。

papers.title: Reliability Scaling Laws for Quantized Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Quantization is a powerful strategy to build capable and resource-efficient large language models (LLMs) by reducing the bitwidth of the parameters. While quantized LLMs achieve state-of-the-art performance on unperturbed inputs using standard predictive metrics, their performance on perturbed inputs, measured using reliability metrics, remains underexplored, despite its importance for reliable deployment. To address this gap, we first conduct a comprehensive reliability evaluation of quantized LLMs consisting of three key components: (1) Uncertainty: We assess the trustworthiness of LLMs quantized to 2, 3, 4, and 8 bits using six different quantization methods, employing established uncertainty metrics. (2) Calibration: We assess how well-calibrated the uncertainty estimates of quantized models are across model scales and bit precisions. (3) Robustness: We design character-level and word-level input perturbations to evaluate the reliability of quantized models under semantically-preserving variations in the inputs that arise in real-world applications. Second, we characterize how reliability scales with the total number of model bits. Our study reveals that while the performance scales monotonically with the total number of bits, the reliability scalings are nonlinear. A reliability peak occurs for 4-bit quantized models, indicating that quantizing moderately sized models offers the best reliability-efficiency trade-off. Additionally, our empirical findings reveal that quantization enhances the robustness of LLMs to natural input perturbations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了量化大语言模型（LLMs）在扰动输入下的可靠性，包括不确定性、校准和鲁棒性。研究发现，模型性能随总比特数单调提升，但可靠性呈非线性缩放，4比特量化模型在可靠性与效率之间达到最佳平衡。量化还增强了模型对自然输入扰动的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 量化策略虽能提升LLMs的资源效率，且标准预测指标表现优异，但模型在扰动输入下的可靠性（不确定性、校准、鲁棒性）尚未得到充分研究，这对可靠部署至关重要。
Method: 采用六种量化方法将LLMs量化为2、3、4、8比特，并对模型进行综合可靠性评估，包括使用不确定性指标、校准评估以及字符级和词级输入扰动下的鲁棒性测试，同时刻画可靠性随总比特数的缩放行为。
Result: 性能随总比特数单调提升，但可靠性缩放呈非线性；4比特量化模型在可靠性与效率间达到最佳折中；量化增强了LLMs对自然输入扰动的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 研究表明，中等大小模型的4比特量化能提供最佳的可靠性-效率权衡，量化本身可提升模型对输入扰动的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diversify Diffusion with Temperature Sampling and Variance-Corrective Time Shifting
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models faithfully reproduce their training distribution, but also inherit its imbalances and leave rare or under-represented modes hard to reach. A natural inference-time remedy is to sample from the high-temperature target $p^{(γ)}_0(x) \propto p_0(x)^γ$ for $0 < γ< 1$, which flattens dominant modes and lifts rare ones. However, naive score scaling while correctly reweighting modes also inflates the per-mode variance, breaking the reverse diffusion process and degrading sample quality. We introduce variance-corrective time shifting, a training-free fix that queries the network at a shifted timestep and scales the resulting score by $γ$, canceling the variance inflation while preserving the mode reweighting. The correction turns simple temperature sampling into a practical diversity knob for pretrained diffusion and flow-matching backbones with no retraining, and we demonstrate consistent gains at minimal cost to sample quality and condition fidelity across DiT, Stable Diffusion and Motion Diffusion models. We further show that the timing of the temperature intervention enables coarse-to-fine control: high-noise stages drive compositional diversity across modes, while low-noise stages drive local appearance variation under a fixed composition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需重新训练的推理时方法，通过温度采样和方差校正时间偏移来增加扩散模型生成样本的多样性。该方法将采样分布在温度γ下重新加权，同时通过时间偏移校正方差膨胀，在DiT、Stable Diffusion和Motion Diffusion等模型上实现了多样性提升，且对样本质量和条件保真度影响很小。
Motivation: 扩散模型忠实复现训练分布，但会继承其不平衡性，导致稀有或欠表示的模式难以生成。现有温度采样虽可平滑主导模式并提升稀有模式，但会增大方差，破坏反向扩散过程，降低样本质量。
Method: 提出方差校正时间偏移（variance-corrective time shifting），在推理时对预训练扩散或流匹配模型进行无训练干预：查询网络在偏移时间步的输出，并将所得分数缩放γ，从而消除方差膨胀同时保留模式重加权。
Result: 在DiT、Stable Diffusion和Motion Diffusion模型上，该方法在保持样本质量和条件保真度接近基线的情况下，一致提升了生成多样性。进一步发现，温度干预的时间点可实现从粗到细的控制：高噪声阶段驱动跨模式组合多样性，低噪声阶段在固定组合下驱动局部外观变化。
Conclusion: 该训练免费的校正方法将简单温度采样变为实用的多样性调节旋钮，适用于多种扩散骨干网络，且无需重新训练。

papers.title: Learning To Focus: Anatomy-Guided Attention Regularization for Medical Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Medical image classification models are ideally expected to identify diagnostically relevant regions while making predictions, yet standard classification losses rarely provide spatial supervision. Explicit supervision via anatomical shape information, such as segmentation masks of task-relevant anatomy, has been shown to guide the network toward regions relevant to the target prediction. However, obtaining such masks incurs substantial manual annotation effort and computational overhead. With the advent of segmentation foundation models that exhibit strong localization of anatomical structures across diverse imaging modalities, we leverage this capability to extract anatomical shape priors without the burden of training a dedicated segmentation model. In this paper, we propose a new framework, Locus, an anatomical attention regularization framework that leverages pretrained segmentation foundation models to guide a classifier's attention toward diagnostically meaningful anatomical structures across diverse imaging modalities. Instead of enforcing pixel-wise alignment with the foundation-model-derived mask, we introduce a regularization term that adaptively balances attention between anatomical (foreground) and background regions, penalizing the classifier when background attention dominates. We validate Locus on eight diverse medical imaging datasets spanning dermoscopy, X-ray, histopathology, and cardiac MRI, showing consistent gains in classification performance alongside improved anatomically grounded attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Locus 框架，利用预训练的分割基础模型（如 SAM）提取解剖结构先验，通过注意力正则化引导医学图像分类器关注诊断相关的解剖区域，避免对背景区域的过度关注。在皮肤镜、X 光、组织病理学和心脏 MRI 等八个数据集上验证了分类性能提升和注意力可解释性改善。
Motivation: 医学图像分类模型缺乏空间监督，难以聚焦诊断相关区域。传统依赖分割掩码的方法标注成本高，计算开销大。
Method: 提出 Locus 框架，使用预训练分割基础模型生成解剖形状先验，引入自适应注意力正则化项，在训练中平衡前景（解剖区域）和背景注意力，惩罚背景注意力过高的情况。
Result: 在八个医学影像数据集（覆盖皮肤镜、X 光、组织病理学、心脏 MRI）上，分类性能一致提升，且注意力图更符合解剖结构。
Conclusion: 利用分割基础模型提供的解剖先验可以有效改善分类模型的关注区域，降低对人工标注的依赖，具有跨模态通用性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 利用分割基础模型提供的解剖先验可以有效改善分类模型的关注区域，降低对人工标注的依赖，具有跨模态通用性。

papers.title: Predictive Divergence Masks for LLM RL
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning for large language models (LLMs) typically relies on trust-region masks to stabilize off-policy updates. The dominant PPO-style approach uses the sampled-token importance ratio for two criteria: a proximity criterion, which asks whether the policy has moved too far from the behavior policy, and a direction criterion, which asks whether the update pushes it farther away. Recent work DPPO improves the proximity criterion by replacing PPO's ratio-based test with a probability divergence between the behavior and training policies. However, its direction criterion is still inherited from PPO. A token can be masked only when the sampled-token importance ratio moves away from one. We observe that this ratio-based direction criterion is a single-sample proxy that can disagree in sign with the change of the divergence that defines the proximity criterion. We therefore propose the predictive divergence mask, which asks whether the next policy-gradient step will increase or decrease the same divergence used by the trust region. For the discrete softmax policies used in LLM RL, we derive this prediction in closed form. Because production rollout engines expose only a truncated (top-K) view of the vocabulary, we develop two lightweight top-$K$ estimators for this prediction. Detailed analysis shows the divergence-based direction is better aligned with the realized change of the divergence than the sampled ratio, and the resulting masks improve RL training across model scales and precision settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM强化学习中PPO风格信赖域掩码的不足，提出预测性散度掩码（predictive divergence mask），用散度方向准则替代PPO的比率方向准则，并推导了闭式解，开发了top-K估计器。实验表明该方法训练更稳定。
Motivation: PPO的比率方向准则只是单样本代理，可能与散度变化符号不一致，导致掩码不准确。
Method: 提出预测性散度掩码，通过闭式预测下一步策略梯度会增大还是减小相同散度，并开发top-K估计器用于实际部署。
Result: 摘要表明基于散度的方向与散度实际变化更一致，且掩码在不同模型规模和精度下改进了RL训练。
Conclusion: 预测性散度掩码改进了信赖域方向准则，提升训练效果。

papers.title: Align and Segment: Unsupervised Learning for Building Segmentation From Misaligned Labels
papers.abstract_en: Supervised learning for image segmentation typically requires spatially aligned image and label sets. When images and labels originate from different sources, the pairing may be misaligned, which can significantly deteriorate the performance of the learned models. This is especially common in remote sensing, when aerial or satellite images are co-registered with labels from another source (e.g., OpenStreetMap). In this work, we propose a novel approach for training on misaligned labels, where we simultaneously learn the label alignment. Our align and segment (AnS) approach builds on the spatial transformer module to transform the misaligned labels using an affine transformation to provide a better learning target for a canonical semantic segmentation network. We prevent shortcut learning of misaligned labels in these semantic segmentation networks through a self-supervised regularization loss and show that it is complementary to data augmentation, especially for systematically misaligned training data. A decisive characteristic of our AnS approach is that it learns without requiring any golden labels. We experimentally show on both synthetic and real-world data from different cities that our approach enables high-quality building segmentation and precise label-image alignment at the same time. Code and derived datasets are available at https://github.com/venkanna37/align-and-segment

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对遥感图像中标签与图像未对齐的问题，提出一种同时学习标签对齐和图像分割的无监督方法。方法基于空间变换网络（spatial transformer）对未对齐标签进行仿射变换，并通过自监督正则化损失防止分割网络学习到未对齐的捷径。在多个城市数据上实验表明，该方法能同时实现高质量建筑分割和精确的标签-图像对齐。
Motivation: 遥感图像分割中，标签（如OpenStreetMap）与图像可能因来源不同而存在空间未对齐，这严重降低监督学习模型性能。现有方法通常需要人工对齐标签，缺乏自动处理未对齐数据的方案。
Method: 提出Align-and-Segment（AnS）框架，包含空间变换网络（STN）用于估计仿射变换参数以对齐标签，并与语义分割网络联合训练。通过自监督正则化损失（如标签一致性损失）防止分割网络利用未对齐标签的捷径，同时可结合数据增强处理系统性未对齐。
Result: 在合成数据和真实城市数据上，该方法能同时实现高精度建筑分割和标签-图像对齐，且无需任何人工标注的对齐标签。
Conclusion: 该方法为遥感图像中标签未对齐问题提供了一种有效的无监督解决方案，但当前仅针对建筑分割和仿射变换，未来可扩展至其他对象和更复杂的几何变换。

papers.title: OmniX: Any-view and Any-time 4D Reconstruction via Feed-forward Trajectory Fields
papers.abstract_en: Previous feed-forward 4D reconstruction methods either predict per-frame static point clouds, ignoring foreground motion, or estimate point cloud trajectories while being limited to small camera motions. This restricts their ability to aggregate observations over time and reconstruct complete dynamic scenes under large viewpoint changes. To address this limitation, we propose OmniX, a feed-forward 4D reconstruction framework that predicts dense 3D point trajectories for every pixel from videos with large camera motion. OmniX decouples dynamic motion modeling from static geometry prediction and represents motion using a compact set of dynamic tokens. By leveraging the sparse and low-rank structure of 3D motion, these tokens generate trajectory fields for all pixels across all images while efficiently preserving global interactions. To facilitate training, we further build an automatic UE5-based 4D data engine and introduce a large-scale dataset containing 80K scenes and 1.28M multi-view videos with full geometric annotations. OmniX achieves state-of-the-art performance on dense 3D point trajectory prediction and 3D point tracking, while also demonstrating competitive results on video depth estimation and camera pose estimation.
papers.comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026, project page: https://omnix4d.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniX，一种前馈式 4D 重建框架，能从大相机运动的视频中为每个像素预测密集 3D 点轨迹。方法将动态运动建模与静态几何预测解耦，使用紧凑的动态 token 表示运动，构建稀疏低秩轨迹场。还构建了基于 UE5 的自动 4D 数据引擎和包含 8 万场景、128 万多视角视频的大规模数据集。在密集 3D 点轨迹预测和 3D 点跟踪上达到 SOTA，在视频深度估计和相机位姿估计上也表现出竞争力。
Motivation: 现有前馈 4D 重建方法要么预测静态点云忽略前景运动，要么局限于小相机运动，无法在大视角变化下聚合观测重建完整动态场景。
Method: 提出 OmniX，解耦动态运动建模与静态几何预测；用动态 token 紧凑表示 3D 运动的稀疏低秩结构，生成所有像素在所有图像上的轨迹场；同时构建 UE5 自动数据引擎和大规模 4D 数据集。
Result: 在密集 3D 点轨迹预测和 3D 点跟踪上达到 SOTA，在视频深度估计和相机位姿估计上也有竞争力。
Conclusion: OmniX 通过解耦运动与静态几何，利用动态 token 表示运动，实现了大相机运动下视频的密集轨迹预测，并提供了大规模数据集支持。

papers.title: Route, Communicate, and Reason: Gated Routing and Adaptive Depth for Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent ensembling multiplies active parameters and inference cost without answering three basic questions: which agents to consult, how deeply a query should traverse a hierarchy of agents, and when inter-agent communication is worth its cost. We present GRADE (Gated Routing and Adaptive Depth for Efficient Reasoning), a hierarchical multi-agent system in which four lightweight learned gates jointly govern agent selection, hierarchy depth, inter-agent communication, and branch pruning. Training uses CoGRPO (Collaborative Group-Relative Policy Optimization), a novel critic-free recipe that adapts GRPO to multi-agent hierarchies and assigns a shared advantage signal to every gate and agent that participated in a rollout. Agent models are drawn from a hot-swappable Expert Registry; per-agent calibration maps allow experts to be replaced at inference time without retraining. At $\sim$17B average active parameters, GRADE outperforms all baselines on GSM8K, MMLUPro, and GPQA, surpassing the strongest baseline by 4.8 points on MMLUPro at half the active compute. On AIME-2025, where model depth dominates, GRADE remains competitive to existing frameworks. Ablations isolate the hierarchy and masked cross-attention as the largest contributors to accuracy, and show that per-agent calibration is necessary for safe hot-swapping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GRADE（Gated Routing and Adaptive Depth for Efficient Reasoning），一种层级多智能体系统，通过四个轻量级学习门控联合控制智能体选择、层级深度、智能体间通信和分支剪枝。训练使用 CoGRPO（Collaborative Group-Relative Policy Optimization），一种无评论家的强化学习方法。在约 170 亿活跃参数下，GRADE 在 GSM8K、MMLUPro 和 GPQA 上超越所有基线，在 MMLUPro 上以一半活跃计算量超过最强基线 4.8 个点。消融实验表明层级结构和掩码交叉注意力是准确率的最大贡献者。
Motivation: 现有多智能体集成会成倍增加活跃参数和推理成本，却未解决三个基本问题：该咨询哪些智能体、查询应遍历层级多深、以及智能体间通信何时值得其成本。
Method: 提出 GRADE 系统，包含四个学习门控分别用于智能体选择、层级深度、通信和分支剪枝；训练采用 CoGRPO，将 GRPO 适配至多智能体层级，为参与 rollouts 的每个门控和智能体分配共享优势信号；智能体模型从热插拔专家注册表中抽取，并通过逐智能体校准映射实现推理时无需重训练的替换。
Result: 在约 170 亿活跃参数下，GRADE 在 GSM8K、MMLUPro 和 GPQA 上优于所有基线，在 MMLUPro 上以一半活跃计算量超过最强基线 4.8 个点；在 AIME-2025 上（模型深度起主导作用），GRADE 与现有框架保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 消融实验表明层级结构和掩码交叉注意力是准确率的最大贡献因素，逐智能体校准对于安全热插拔是必要的。

papers.title: 3D-DefectBench: A Controlled Factorial Study of Vision-Language Model Evaluation Pipelines for Fine-Grained 3D Generation Defects
papers.abstract_en: Automated evaluation is essential for scaling generative 3D systems, where exhaustive human review is costly and slow. However, the reliability of an automated judge depends on the entire evaluation pipeline, not only the underlying vision-language model (VLM), but also how assets are rendered, what visual evidence is provided, how the task is specified, and how human reference labels are constructed. We introduce 3D-DefectBench, a benchmark and framework for systematic analysis of VLM-based 3D defect detection pipelines. It complements holistic ratings and pairwise preferences with nine fine-grained binary defects spanning geometry, texture, and prompt adherence, providing actionable diagnostics for generator development and judge evaluation. Using a balanced factorial design, we vary four pipeline factors, VLM, camera protocol, visual input, and prompt schema, across 84 inference designs and approximately 3.2 million scored defect decisions, followed by staged validation on a broader set of frontier models. Model choice is the largest determinant of agreement with human labels, but the remaining factors also affect performance, interact with model selection, and can change the best configuration. Within the evaluated design space, a compact six-view RGB protocol performs comparably to denser multi-view settings and inputs augmented with depth or surface normals, making it a strong cost-effective default. Under this standardized pipeline, the best of 12 VLM judges still lag behind trained human labelers, while texture agreement drops sharply when expert-consensus labels are replaced by noisier silver labels. These findings show that automated judges should be evaluated as complete pipelines and calibrated across human reference regimes, rather than benchmarked only as standalone models. We release labels, prompts, predictions, and Croissant metadata on Hugging Face.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 3D-DefectBench，一个用于系统分析基于 VLM 的 3D 缺陷检测管道的基准和框架。它通过平衡因子设计，变化四个管道因素（VLM、相机协议、视觉输入、提示方案），在约 320 万次缺陷决策上评估了 84 种推理设计，发现模型选择是决定性的，但其他因素也显著影响性能。紧凑的六视图 RGB 协议在成本效益上表现良好，最佳 VLM 仍落后于人类标注者。
Motivation: 现有的 3D 生成系统自动化评估依赖 VLM 作为评判者，但整体评估管道的可靠性不仅取决于 VLM，还受渲染方式、视觉证据、任务规范和人工标签构建等因素影响，缺乏系统性的因子分析。
Method: 构建 3D-DefectBench，包含 9 种细粒度二元缺陷（几何、纹理、提示遵从），使用平衡因子设计，同时操纵 VLM、相机协议、视觉输入和提示方案四个因素，在 84 种推理设计下收集约 320 万次缺陷评分。
Result: 模型选择是最大的性能决定因素，但其他因素也影响表现且与模型选择存在交互。紧凑的六视图 RGB 协议与更密集的多视图设置或深度/法线增强输入性能相当。最佳 VLM 仍落后于训练的人类标注者，纹理缺陷在替换专家共识标签为噪声标签后一致性显著下降。
Conclusion: 自动评判者应作为完整管道进行评估，并在人工参考基准下进行校准，而不应仅作为独立模型进行基准测试。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Large Language Models for Token-Efficient and Semantic-Preserving Opinion Summarization
papers.abstract_en: Opinionated text - spanning product reviews, hotel feedback, and social posts - captures rich signals about user experiences, preferences, and concerns. However, the scale, redundancy, and imbalance of such corpora make it challenging to analyze opinions effectively, particularly when the goal is to generate summaries that remain faithful to the diversity of viewpoints expressed. This paper presents a framework that preserves semantics in LLM-based opinion summarization while minimizing token usage. We combine multidimensional classification (e.g., sentiment, topics) with a family of stratified sampling strategies to select compact yet representative subsets of opinions before prompting the LLM. Tailored prompts then produce balanced summaries that surface the salient aspects expressed in the opinions (e.g., strengths and weaknesses of products/hotels). Experiments on Amazon product reviews, Tripadvisor hotel reviews, and X/Twitter posts demonstrate that our method significantly reduces token usage and computational cost while consistently outperforming traditional AI-based and standard LLM summarization baselines in terms of content coverage, balance, and semantic preservation.

Conclusion: 该框架能在保持语义的同时减少token使用，适用于意见摘要任务。

papers.title: Graph Neural Networks for RFID-Based Spatial Geometry Inference in Spatial AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Indoor spatial understanding remains a fundamental challenge for intelligent systems operating in physical environments. Traditional RFID localization techniques typically estimate positions of tags using signal strength measurements but fail to capture higher-order spatial relationships between objects and infrastructure. Recent work on RFID and wireless indoor localization has increasingly emphasized robust learning under noisy propagation, while recent graph-based localization methods demonstrate the value of relational modeling over isolated samples. This paper introduces a graph-based learning framework that leverages Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to infer spatial geometry from RFID observations. Rather than predicting isolated coordinates, the proposed system models relationships between RFID readings, antennas, and physical structures within an indoor floorplan. This framing is aligned with recent graph-based indoor positioning and graph construction literature, where topology is a first-class source of information for downstream inference. The approach integrates signal strength data, floorplan semantics, and spatial constraints into a graph representation where nodes correspond to RFID observations and edges encode proximity and contextual relationships. A GNN is then trained to predict geometric patterns such as linear trajectories, rectangular bounding regions, and movement paths of objects in space.
papers.comment: 38 pages, 10 figures. Introduces a Graph Neural Network framework for RFID-based spatial geometry inference using indoor floorplan semantics and digital twin representations

papers.title: Auditing Belief-Conditioned LLM Agents in Hidden-Information Social Deduction Games
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating LLM agents in hidden-information multi-agent settings is hard: final outcomes are high-variance and rarely reveal why an agent decided as it did. We study this in a 9-player Werewolf environment where agents act under strict, code-level information isolation, and we build an auditable framework that maintains an external belief state over hidden roles, logs belief updates and belief-action deviations as structured evidence, and supports a defensive offline improvement loop that reviews bad cases before any strategy change. Across 1,080 frozen games spanning belief-disabled, active-belief, kernel-ablation, camp-restricted, consumption-policy, and high-load arms, and including a seed-paired A0/A1 comparison, the active-belief condition is associated with substantially better good-side outcomes: in the 200-seed A0/A1 comparison the good-side win rate rises from 0.205 to 0.390 (paired McNemar $χ^2 = 16.4$, $p < 0.001$), with fewer irreversible witch-poison errors. We do not, however, attribute this shift to belief content. Direct action-belief consistency is low ($\approx 0.21$), and giving belief only to the werewolves helps the good side more than giving it only to the good side, which argues against a simple holder-benefit account; we therefore report the effect as an association and treat its mechanism as unresolved. The contribution is the audit framework itself: it makes the effect measurable, exposes low direct action-belief consistency, rejects an unreliable forced-consumption intervention with evidence, and separates strategy effects from load confounds. We accordingly position external belief in high-noise hidden-information games primarily as an auditable cognitive baseline that also carries decision-relevant signal, turning opaque agent behavior into replayable evidence for safer, controlled iteration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对隐藏信息多智能体环境中评估LLM代理的困难，在9人狼人杀游戏中构建了一个可审计框架，维护外部信念状态并记录信念更新与行动偏差。在1080场冻结实验中，主动信念条件使好人方胜率从0.205显著提升至0.390，但行动-信念一致性仅约0.21，机制尚不明确。主要贡献在于提供了可审计的认知基线框架。
Motivation: 隐藏信息多智能体设置中，LLM代理的最终结果方差大且难以追溯决策原因，缺乏有效的审计手段。
Method: 在9人狼人杀环境中实施严格的代码级信息隔离，构建审计框架：维护外部信念状态，记录信念更新及信念-行动偏差，并支持基于失败案例的离线改进循环。
Result: 在200种子配对比较中，主动信念条件将好人方胜率从0.205提升至0.390（McNemar χ²=16.4, p<0.001），且减少了不可逆的女巫毒药错误；但行动-信念一致性低（约0.21），且对狼人方赋予信念比对好人方更有利，表明效应机制尚不明确。
Conclusion: 该审计框架使隐藏信息环境中的信念效应可测量，暴露了低行动-信念一致性，并排除了不稳定的强制消耗干预和负载混淆，主张将外部信念视为可审计的认知基线。

papers.title: Distributed Agent System: Fault-Tolerant Collaboration Among Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI engineering is shifting from passive text generation by large language models (LLMs) to agent-driven task execution, creating new reliability challenges for long-horizon tasks under resource constraints and environmental uncertainty. Conventional error-elimination optimization strategies fail to address cumulative error propagation. This paper proposes Distributed Agent System (DAS), a device-edge-cloud framework for fault-tolerant collaboration among heterogeneous agents. We redefine agent reliability as system-level fault tolerance rather than single-turn zero-error accuracy, and present a two-layer fault-tolerance architecture: single-agent execution reliability via fault-tolerant alignment, and cross-agent communication reliability via semi-formal language protocols. This framework provides a practical engineering pathway for reliable heterogeneous embodied agents collaboration in industrial scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分布式智能体系统 (DAS)，一种设备-边缘-云框架，用于异构具身智能体之间的容错协作。系统采用两层容错架构：单智能体执行可靠性通过容错对齐实现，跨智能体通信可靠性通过半形式化语言协议实现。摘要声称该框架为工业场景中可靠异构具身智能体协作提供了工程路径。
Motivation: 传统错误消除优化策略无法解决长时任务下的累积误差传播问题，现有方法难以保证资源约束和环境不确定性下的可靠性。
Method: 提出 DAS 框架，包含设备-边缘-云三层架构，并设计两层容错机制：单智能体容错对齐和跨智能体半形式化语言协议。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，仅描述框架设计。
Conclusion: 本文重新定义了智能体可靠性为系统级容错而非单轮零错误准确率，并提供了工业场景下的工程路径。

papers.title: Diachronic Sample Integration: Robust Tail-Risk Estimation with Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Deep generative models are increasingly used as simulators for downstream decision-making under data scarcity, but in risk-sensitive applications their usefulness depends on rare adverse scenarios rather than typical samples. Standard generative objectives prioritize bulk distributional fidelity, leaving low-probability tails vulnerable to localized optimization noise and making tail-dependent functionals unstable under finite simulation budgets. We introduce Diachronic Sample Integration (DSI), a test-time inference framework that ensembles generated samples across checkpoints from a stochastic training trajectory. DSI targets a checkpoint-mixture distribution that averages checkpoint-specific tail fluctuations rather than relying on a single brittle endpoint. We formalize this mechanism through a finite-budget bias-variance theory. Empirically, across multivariate synthetic processes and high-frequency trading data, DSI substantially reduces tail-estimation error compared to single-checkpoint baselines under fixed simulation budgets, outperforming standard diffusion and state-of-the-art tail-aware baselines without modifying the generative objective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出历时样本整合（DSI）方法，用于深度生成模型的尾部风险估计。DSI通过在训练轨迹的不同检查点之间集成生成样本，形成检查点混合分布，从而降低尾部估计误差。理论分析基于有限预算的偏差-方差分解，实验表明在多元合成过程和高频交易数据上，DSI优于单检查点基线和现有尾部感知方法。
Motivation: 深度生成模型在数据稀缺时用于下游决策，但标准生成目标侧重于整体分布保真度，导致低概率尾部易受局部优化噪声影响，尾部依赖函数在有限模拟预算下不稳定。
Method: 提出DSI，一种测试时推理框架，集成随机训练轨迹中多个检查点的生成样本，形成检查点混合分布，平均化检查点特定的尾部波动，而非依赖单个脆弱的端点。通过有限预算偏差-方差理论形式化该机制。
Result: 在多元合成过程和高频交易数据上，DSI在固定模拟预算下显著降低尾部估计误差，优于单检查点基线和最先进的尾部感知基线，且无需修改生成目标。
Conclusion: DSI通过简单集成策略有效提升尾部风险估计的稳健性，适用于风险敏感应用中的生成模型模拟。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Lower Bound on the Cumulative Constrained Violation for the OGD+Projection algorithm for Constrained Online Convex Optimization (COCO)
papers.abstract_en: The problem of constrained online convex optimization is considered, where at each round, once a learner commits to an action $x_t \in \mathcal{X} \subset \mathbb{R}^d$, a convex loss function $f_t$ and a convex constraint function $g_t$ that drives the constraint $g_t(x)\le 0$ are revealed. The objective is to simultaneously minimize the static regret and cumulative constraint violation (CCV) compared to the benchmark that knows the loss functions and constraint functions $f_t$ and $g_t$ for all $t$ ahead of time, and chooses a static optimal action that is feasible with respect to all $g_t(x)\le 0$. Currently, the best known algorithm is OGD+Projection algorithm of [Vaze and Sinha, 2025] that has simultaneous regret of $O(\sqrt{T})$ and CCV of $O(T^{1/3})$ for $d=2$ [Balasundaram et al., 2026], and simultaneous regret of $O(\sqrt{T})$ and CCV of $O(\sqrt{T})$ for any $d$ [Sarkar and Sinha, 2026]. In this paper, we show that the CCV of the OGD+Projection algorithm is $Ω(T^{\frac{d-1}{2d}})$. This is the first such lower bound result.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究约束在线凸优化问题，聚焦OGD+Projection算法的累积约束违反（CCV）下限。已有算法在二维情况下达到O(√T) regret和O(T^{1/3}) CCV，任意维度下达到O(√T) regret和O(√T) CCV，而本文证明CCV的下界为Ω(T^{(d-1)/(2d)})，这是首个该类型的下界结果。
Motivation: 现有约束在线凸优化算法的最优CCV上界已知，但缺乏对应的下界分析，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 通过构造特定的对抗性约束和损失函数序列，分析OGD+Projection算法的约束违反行为，推导其CCV的下界。
Result: 证明OGD+Projection算法的CCV下界为Ω(T^{(d-1)/(2d)})。
Conclusion: 该下界是首次得出，揭示了算法在约束违反方面的理论极限，为算法设计提供重要参考。

papers.title: Abstractiveness Metrics for Evaluating Text Summarization: A Refined Formulation with Empirical Validation
papers.abstract_en: Quantifying abstractiveness in generated summaries is essential for evaluating summarization models beyond surface-level metrics like ROUGE. We introduce Reference Abstraction (RA), Summary Abstraction (SA), and Abstraction Ratio (AR) -- a set of principled heuristic metrics that measure how much a summary diverges from extractive copying of the source text. The formulation uses the harmonic mean of document lengths modulated by a cubic non-overlap factor, yielding dimensionally consistent, bounded output with non-linear sensitivity to the extractive-abstractive boundary. Evaluation on 100 XSUM documents across four summarization models (BART-large-cnn, Pegasus-xsum, DistilBart, MT5-small) demonstrates that the metrics successfully discriminate between extractive models (SA ~ 0.12-0.26) and abstractive models (SA ~ 0.96-1.77), and that the Abstraction Ratio identifies summaries requiring manual evaluation for potential hallucination. Code and results are available at https://github.com/katweNLP/AbstractionStudy.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 8 figures, code at https://github.com/katweNLP/AbstractionStudy. Extended and revised version of: Katwe et al., IEEE OCIT 2022 (doi:10.1109/OCIT56763.2022.00022)

TL;DR: 本文提出一组衡量文本摘要抽象程度的度量：Reference Abstraction (RA), Summary Abstraction (SA) 和 Abstraction Ratio (AR)。这些度量基于文档长度的调和平均与三次非重叠因子，输出有界且对抽取-抽象边界具有非线性敏感性。在XSUM数据集上对四个摘要模型（BART-large-cnn、Pegasus-xsum、DistilBart、MT5-small）的评估显示，SA值能有效区分抽取式模型（约0.12-0.26）和抽象式模型（约0.96-1.77），且AR可识别可能需要人工评估的潜在幻觉摘要。
Motivation: 现有摘要评估指标如ROUGE主要衡量表面重叠，难以量化摘要的抽象程度，因此需要一种能明确区分抽取式与抽象式摘要的度量方法。
Method: 定义RA（参考抽象度）、SA（摘要抽象度）和AR（抽象比），采用文档长度的调和平均乘以三次非重叠因子，得到维度一致且有界的数值，对抽取-抽象边界进行非线性敏感度量。
Result: 在XSUM数据集上，抽取式模型的SA值在0.12-0.26之间，抽象式模型的SA值在0.96-1.77之间，AR指标能标识出需要人工检查的潜在幻觉摘要。
Conclusion: 所提出的抽象性度量能够有效分辨摘要的抽象程度，并为自动评估提供补充，但需要进一步验证其泛化性和对幻觉检测的精确性。

papers.title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Thinking Collapse in On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a crucial paradigm for enhancing and aligning Large Language Models (LLMs). However, in complex reasoning tasks, OPSD paradoxically degrades downstream performance. In this paper, we systematically investigate this pathology and identify a severe optimization trap we define as \textbf{Thinking Collapse} -- a sharp decline in the model's native intermediate reasoning behavior, measured by epistemic-token density (ET per 1k). Through entropy-based gradient masking and token-level target analysis, we show that this collapse is triggered by aggressive teacher gradients at high-student-entropy decision forks, where student epistemic tokens are frequently suppressed into teacher non-epistemic targets and are highly concentrated in high pointwise student-teacher divergence regions. To resolve this optimization pathology, we propose \textbf{Adaptive Dual-Perspective OPSD (AD-OPSD)}, a robust control framework that dynamically moderates the self-distillation objective. AD-OPSD selectively anchors high-suppression-risk sandboxed tokens to a reference prior derived from the frozen base model via an asymmetrical pointwise divergence gate, preserving native thinking capacity while retaining OPSD's error-correcting power. Extensive experiments across competitive mathematical benchmarks show that AD-OPSD improves over standard OPSD by up to \textbf{+4.1\%} absolute average accuracy across diverse model scales and datasets. Further analysis demonstrates that AD-OPSD mitigates thinking collapse and generalizes robustly to different post-training paradigms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了在线自我蒸馏（OPSD）在复杂推理任务中导致性能下降的病理现象，识别出“思考崩溃”（Thinking Collapse）——模型原生中间推理行为急剧下降。通过熵梯度掩蔽和token级分析，发现该问题源于高学生熵决策分支中教师梯度抑制了认知token。提出自适应双视角OPSD（AD-OPSD）框架，利用不对称点散度门控将高风险token锚定到冻结基模型的参考先验，在保留原生思考能力的同时保持纠错能力。在数学推理基准上，AD-OPSD相比标准OPSD平均提升高达4.1%的绝对准确率。
Motivation: OPSD在复杂推理任务中反而降低下游性能，存在未解释的优化病理，因此需要系统诊断并缓解该问题。
Method: 提出AD-OPSD框架，通过不对称点散度门控动态调节自蒸馏目标，选择性锚定高风险token到冻结基模型的参考先验。
Result: 在多个数学基准上，AD-OPSD相比标准OPSD平均提升高达4.1%的绝对准确率，并缓解思考崩溃，泛化到不同后训练范式。
Conclusion: AD-OPSD能有效解决思考崩溃问题，在保持OPSD纠错能力的同时维持原生思考能力。

papers.title: When does distribution shift break graph neural networks calibration?
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications where distribution shift is un-avoidable. However, how such shifts affect model calibration, defined as the agreement between predictive confidence and actual accuracy, remains poorly understood, and existing graph calibration methods typically rely on labeled validation data from the deployment distribution. In this work, I present the first closed-form theoretical characterization of GNN calibration under distribution shift. I show that calibration is governed by a single scalar quantity that explicitly depends on structural changes between the source and target graphs, as well as feature quality. This characterization precisely identifies when a model becomes over-confident, under-confident, or remains calibrated, and directly yields the optimal temperature scaling strategy. I further extend the analysis to graph convolutional networks with symmetric normalization, multi-class classification, and covariate shift, and derive a theoretical upper bound on the expected calibration error. My analysis also reveals that, under homogeneous distribution shift, a single global temperature is theoretically optimal, providing a principled explanation for why more complex node-wise recalibration methods offer no additional benefit. Building on these theoretical insights, I propose STAC, a source-free, label-free calibration method. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks demonstrate substantial calibration improvements, while evaluations on five real-world graph datasets show that reliable calibration without target labels remains challenging despite the strong predictive power of the theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次理论上刻画了分布偏移下图神经网络（GNN）校准的闭合形式，发现校准由单个标量量控制，该量依赖于源图与目标图的结构变化和特征质量。该表征精确识别了模型何时过度自信、欠自信或保持校准，并直接导出最优温度缩放策略。进一步扩展到图卷积网络（GCN）、多类分类和协变量偏移，推导了期望校准误差的理论上界。基于理论洞察，提出无源、无标签的校准方法STAC，在合成基准上显示校准显著改进，但在五个真实世界图数据集上，无目标标签的可靠校准仍具挑战。
Motivation: 分布偏移在真实应用中不可避免，但其如何影响GNN校准（预测置信度与实际准确率之间的一致性）尚不明确，且现有图校准方法通常依赖目标分布的标注验证数据。
Method: 提出首个封闭形式理论表征，将校准偏差归结为源图与目标图结构变化及特征质量的函数；据此导出最优温度缩放策略，并进一步将分析扩展到对称归一化的图卷积网络、多类分类及协变量偏移。基于理论，提出无需源域数据或目标域标签的校准方法STAC。
Result: 合成实验表明STAC显著提升校准性能；在五个真实图数据集上，尽管理论预测力强，但无目标标签下的可靠校准仍面临挑战。
Conclusion: 理论分析揭示了分布偏移下校准退化的条件，并证明同质分布偏移下单一全局温度在理论上是最优的，解释了更复杂的节点级重新校准方法为何无额外收益。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Weight-Adjusted Gradients Reveal Parameter Importance and Failure Modes in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Understanding which parameters are influential in Large Language Models (LLMs) is central to improving their efficiency, reliability, and interpretability. We introduce Weight-Adjusted Gradients (WAG), a simple yet effective approach for estimating parameter importance that explicitly captures the interaction between model weights and first-order gradient information and identifies parameters that disproportionately influence model behavior, such as those responsible for collapse phenomena in LLMs. Across a range of models and settings, we show that WAG surfaces a tiny but critical subset of parameters whose modification leads to dramatic degradation in performance, a failure mode that existing importance metrics overlook. These findings reveal a previously underexplored interplay between weights and gradients, suggesting that parameter importance cannot be fully understood through either signal alone. The surprising effectiveness of WAG points to fundamental structural properties of trained networks and motivates new open questions about the role of zeroth-order and first-order information in deep learning. We demonstrate the practical utility of WAG across multiple applications, including expert allocation in mixture-of-expert architectures, parameter-specific unlearning, mixed-precision quantization, and layer selection for knowledge editing. Our results position WAG as a unified approach for analyzing, debugging, and controlling LLMs, and opens new directions for principled model-level interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出权重调整梯度（Weight-Adjusted Gradients, WAG）方法，通过显式捕捉模型权重与一阶梯度信息的交互来估计参数重要性，并发现一组微小但关键的参数，其修改会导致性能急剧下降。实验表明WAG能揭示现有重要性指标忽略的失效模式，并在混合专家中的专家分配、参数级遗忘、混合精度量化和知识编辑等应用中展示实用性。
Motivation: 现有参数重要性估计方法通常仅基于权重或梯度单一信号，无法充分捕捉权重与梯度的交互，从而忽略了某些对模型行为有不成比例影响的关键参数。
Method: 引入权重调整梯度（WAG），通过结合权重和梯度信息计算每个参数的重要性得分，识别出导致模型崩溃等失效模式的关键参数子集。
Result: WAG能够暴露现有指标无法发现的、极小但关键的参数集，其修改会导致LLM性能急剧下降；在混合专家架构、参数级遗忘、混合精度量化和知识编辑等任务中展示了实际效用。
Conclusion: 权重与梯度之间的相互作用是理解参数重要性的关键，WAG为分析、调试和控制LLM提供了统一框架，并启发了关于零阶与一阶信息在深度学习中作用的新问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Q-Learning Lab: Teaching Reinforcement Learning Through Learner-Generated Trace Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning is usually introduced through the Bellman update, yet the equation often remains abstract to undergraduates: they watch policy arrows converge but rarely observe how each value is computed or why an action is chosen. We present Q-Learning Lab, a single-file, browser-based, bilingual (Thai/English) tool for teaching tabular Q-learning that requires no installation. Beyond the usual gridworld visualization - color-coded Q-values and policy arrows on a $5 \times 5$ world - the tool exposes a live Bellman-substitution panel showing the numeric update at every step, and logs each transition, including the full pre-action Q-row, the greedy-versus-random decision under $\varepsilon$-greedy exploration, and wall-collision events, into an exportable trace. The central contribution is a learn-export-analyze loop: learners run their own agent, export the complete trace as CSV, and analyze it themselves, producing learning curves, value heatmaps, and visitation maps, turning a passive demonstration into a source of learner-generated data for reflective inquiry. We validate the tool without human-subject data through three complementary evaluations: (i) correctness of the learned values and policy against a value-iteration ground truth on the identical MDP; (ii) hyperparameter sweeps over $α$, $γ$, and $\varepsilon$ showing that every pedagogical claim the tool makes is reproducible; and (iii) a reward-editing study that uses the ground-truth optimal policy to separate two behaviorally identical but diagnostically opposite failure modes - an exploration failure versus genuine reward misspecification - that a single edited reward can produce. We also compare the tool against existing gridworld visualizers, describe its grounding in learning-by-doing pedagogy, and include a 50-minute lesson plan. The tool and all experiment code are openly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个名为 Q-Learning Lab 的浏览器端、无需安装、双语（泰/英）的教学工具，用于教授表格型 Q 学习。该工具在 5x5 网格世界中展示实时贝尔曼更新面板、动作选择记录及轨迹导出功能，核心是一个学习-导出-分析的循环，让学生从被动观察转向主动分析学习曲线、价值热力图和访问图。作者通过价值迭代对比、超参数扫描和奖励修改研究验证了工具的正确性与教学价值，并提供了教案。
Motivation: 强化学习中的贝尔曼更新对本科生常是抽象的，现有工具只展示策略箭头收敛，但未能让学生观察到每一步的具体数值计算或动作选择原因。
Method: 开发单文件、浏览器端、无需安装的 Q-Learning Lab 工具：在 5x5 网格世界中实时展示颜色编码的 Q 值和策略箭头，并增加实时贝尔曼替换面板（显示每一步数值更新）、完整轨迹日志（含预动作 Q 行、ε-贪心决策、撞墙事件），支持导出 CSV 供学生自行分析。
Result: 通过三类评估验证工具：价值迭代对比确认学习值与最优策略正确；超参数 (α, γ, ε) 扫描再现所有教学声明；奖励修改实验利用最优策略分离探索失败与奖励错误两种诊断上相反的行为模式。
Conclusion: 该工具通过让学习者生成并分析自己的实验数据，将被动演示转化为反思性探究，有望提升强化学习的教学效果。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 通过三类评估验证工具：价值迭代对比确认学习值与最优策略正确；超参数 (α, γ, ε) 扫描再现所有教学声明；奖励修改实验利用最优策略分离探索失败与奖励错误两种诊断上相反的行为模式。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工具通过让学习者生成并分析自己的实验数据，将被动演示转化为反思性探究，有望提升强化学习的教学效果。

papers.title: h-Flow: Flexible Flow-based Image Editing via Doob's h-Transform
papers.abstract_en: Editing images with pre-trained text-to-image flow models typically requires carefully balancing target alignment with the desired prompt and source consistency with the original image. Existing approaches either rely on inversion-based pipelines or heuristic source-to-target trajectory constructions, which often depend on architecture-specific designs or are sensitive to hyperparameters. In this paper, we propose h-Flow, a training-free and theoretically grounded flow-based editing framework. Inspired by Doob's $h$-Transform, we reformulate image editing as conditional generation under multiple terminal events corresponding to source consistency and target alignment. We first extend the classical $h$-Transform from SDE-based models to the deterministic RF framework by constructing an equivalent SDE with identical marginals. Within this formulation, we design dedicated $h$-functions for source consistency and target alignment, yielding closed-form reconstruction guidance and velocity-based semantic editing signals. We further introduce a velocity orthogonal decomposition to decouple reconstruction and editing directions, enabling a controllable trade-off between the two objectives. Extensive experiments demonstrate that h-Flow achieves effective, robust, and flexible editing across diverse scenarios. The code will be released soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 h-Flow，一种无需训练、理论驱动的流模型图像编辑框架。基于 Doob 的 h-Transform，将图像编辑转化为多终端事件下的条件生成，通过扩展 h-Transform 到确定性射频框架，设计专门的 h-函数实现源一致性和目标对齐，并引入速度正交分解以解耦重建与编辑。实验表明该方法在多种场景下有效、鲁棒且灵活。
Motivation: 现有基于文本到图像流模型的编辑方法常需精心平衡目标对齐与源一致性，依赖反演或启发式轨迹构造，对架构和超参数敏感。
Method: 利用 Doob 的 h-Transform 将编辑问题形式化为条件生成，将经典 h-Transform 从 SDE 模型扩展到确定性射频框架；设计用于源一致性和目标对齐的 h-函数，得到闭式重建指导与基于速度的编辑信号；进一步提出速度正交分解以解耦重建和编辑方向，实现可控权衡。
Result: 在多样化场景下的实验表明，该方法实现了有效、鲁棒且灵活的编辑效果。
Conclusion: 该框架无需训练，具有理论依据，能灵活平衡源一致性与目标对齐；代码将开源。
Relevance: 5
