papers.title: From Self-Attention to Connection Laplacian: A Unified Operator View of Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Self-attention is a ubiquitous primitive in modern sequence models, yet its operator-level geometry is only partially understood. We view a token sequence as a vector field over the token-position graph and identify attention as a connection walk: messages are aggregated by a nonnegative walk matrix while being transported along each edge by a learned linear map. Within this framework, we prove that single-head attention (SHA) is exactly a connection propagation step with constant transport, and that multi-head attention (MHA) is exactly a single edge-dependent connection walk whose effective transport is an attention-gated mixture of headwise transports. We further clarify the conditions under which the corresponding generator reduces to a random-walk connection Laplacian, highlighting the roles of stochasticity, reversibility, and metric-compatible transports. Empirically, we find that trained Transformers across scales (from 124M to 8B) and structures (encoder/decoder) exhibit geometric structure consistent with our theory: effective attention graphs converge to stable geometric operators in deeper layers, learned transports self-organize into approximate scaled isometries, and both phenomena strengthen consistently with scale. Overall, the paper provides a precise connection-walk formalism that links self-attention to classical geometric operators, along with a set of operator-level tools for analyzing transformer models from a geometric perspective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从算子几何角度重新审视Transformer中的自注意力机制。将token序列视为token位置图上的向量场，注意力视为一种连接行走（connection walk）：消息通过非负行走矩阵聚合，同时沿每条边由学习到的线性映射传输。证明单头注意力（SHA）是传输恒定的连接传播步骤，多头注意力（MHA）是边依赖的连接行走，其有效传输是注意力门控的头传输混合。进一步阐明相应生成元退化为随机游走连接拉普拉斯算子的条件，强调随机性、可逆性和度量兼容传输的作用。实验表明，从124M到8B参数、编码器/解码器结构的训练Transformer表现出与理论一致的几何结构：深层有效注意力图收敛为稳定几何算子，学习到的传输自组织为近似尺度等距，且随规模扩大而加强。
Motivation: 自注意力作为现代序列模型的基本原语，其算子层面的几何性质尚未被充分理解。
Method: 提出连接行走形式化框架：将注意力分解为行走矩阵和边传输映射；证明SHA是常数传输的连接传播，MHA是注意力门控混合传输的边依赖连接行走；给出生成元退化为连接拉普拉斯的条件。
Result: 跨规模（124M-8B）和结构（编码器/解码器）的Transformer中，深层有效注意力图收敛为稳定几何算子，学习传输自组织为近似尺度等距，且随规模增大而增强。
Conclusion: 本文建立了自注意力与经典几何算子（连接拉普拉斯）之间的精确连接，并提供了分析Transformer模型的操作级几何工具。

papers.title: Commenting with Copilot: A Taxonomy and Multi-Year Analysis of Student Code-Generation Specifications
papers.abstract_en: As AI code tools become integrated into programming environments, students increasingly describe intended behavior in natural language and rely on these tools to generate code, shifting emphasis from code writing to specification. Yet little is known about the comments students write as specifications in AI-assisted programming tasks. We analyze a four-year dataset of undergraduate programming submissions and reflections from tasks in which students wrote comments to guide code generation and refined solutions using test-case feedback. We introduce a taxonomy spanning three dimensions: comment type, code expression level, and code construct. Using automated classification, we examine how these dimensions vary across attempts and how students describe the process in their reflections. Our findings show that students mostly wrote natural-language What comments, shifted toward How comments for more procedural constructs, and focused more on verifying generated code than on repeatedly rewriting comments.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted in the Proceedings of the 2nd ACM Virtual Global Computing Education Conference (SIGCSE Virtual 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于四年数据，分析了学生在AI辅助编程任务中书写注释（作为代码生成规格说明）的行为，提出了一个包含注释类型、代码表达级别和代码结构三个维度的分类法，并利用自动分类揭示了学生主要书写自然语言“什么”注释，对过程性结构转向“如何”注释，且更注重验证生成代码而非反复重写注释。
Motivation: 随着AI代码工具融入编程环境，学生越来越多地用自然语言描述意图并依赖工具生成代码，但关于学生如何编写注释作为规格说明的研究尚不充分。
Method: 收集四年间本科生编程提交和反思数据，提出涵盖注释类型、代码表达级别、代码结构的三维分类法，并采用自动分类方法分析注释特征在不同尝试间的变化。
Result: 学生主要书写自然语言“什么”注释，对过程性结构转向“如何”注释，且更关注验证生成代码而非反复修改注释。
Conclusion: 该分类法可帮助教育者理解学生在AI辅助编程中的行为模式，但研究基于特定课程环境，推广需谨慎。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Modernizing HEBO: a robust Bayesian optimization baseline for practical heteroskedastic and non-stationary problems
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimization is increasingly used to guide data-efficient experimentation in chemistry, materials science, and related laboratory settings, but its practical performance depends strongly on how well surrogate-model assumptions match the geometry and noise structure of the underlying objective. We introduce tidyHEBO, a robust Bayesian optimization model inspired by heteroskedastic evolutionary Bayesian optimization (HEBO) for single-objective, sequential optimization. tidyHEBO reconstructs the HEBO design philosophy in BoTorch and revises surrogate training, output-warping selection, acquisition function evaluation, and Pareto-front search. We benchmarked tidyHEBO on synthetic functions, Olympus emulators, fully experimental reaction-optimization datasets, needle-in-a-haystack (NIAH) materials problems, and Bayesmark hyperparameter optimization tasks. On these tasks tidyHEBO achieved competitive to superior performance and improvement in robustness across repeated optimization runs. We therefore propose tidyHEBO as a practical tool for sequential experimentations and a strong general-purpose benchmark for future Bayesian optimization research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向化学、材料科学等实验室场景中的贝叶斯优化，受 heteroskedastic evolutionary Bayesian optimization (HEBO) 启发，提出 tidyHEBO 模型。tidyHEBO 在 BoTorch 中重構 HEBO 设计，并改进代理训练、输出扭曲选择、采集函数评估和帕累托前沿搜索。在合成函数、Olympus 模拟器、实验反应优化数据集、针堆式材料问题和 Bayesmark 超参数优化任务上，tidyHEBO 达到有竞争力乃至更优的性能，且在多次优化运行中提升了鲁棒性。
Motivation: 贝叶斯优化在实验室场景中的实际性能强烈依赖于代理模型假设与目标函数的几何和噪声结构的匹配程度，现有方法在异方差和非平稳问题上鲁棒性不足。
Method: 提出 tidyHEBO 模型，在 BoTorch 框架下重構 HEBO 设计，修订代理训练、输出扭曲选择、采集函数评估和帕累托前沿搜索流程。
Result: 在合成函数、Olympus 模拟器、实验反应优化数据集、针堆式材料问题和 Bayesmark 超参数优化任务上，tidyHEBO 达到有竞争力乃至更优的性能，并提升了多次优化运行的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: tidyHEBO 可作為序贯实验的实用工具和未来贝叶斯优化研究的强通用基准。

papers.title: Answer-Conditioned Chain-of-Thought Distillation for Few-Shot Industrial Vision with Small VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Deploying AI-based visual inspection in manufacturing is hard because requirements change often, new defect types appear, and large labeled datasets are rarely available. We propose answer-conditioned chain-of-thought (CoT) distillation for rapidly adapting small vision-language models (VLMs) to new industrial tasks using minimal labeled data. A frontier VLM receives each training image along with its correct label and generates a justified visual explanation. A 3B-parameter model is then fine-tuned on these reasoning-augmented examples via LoRA. By conditioning on correct answers, we ensure all training reasoning is directed toward the correct conclusion, which is critical because frontier models score as low as 24.1% on our hardest task. We validate on four industrial classification tasks spanning three image modalities using only 18 to 30 labeled images per task. Across 4 seeds per task (32 training runs), our method outperforms direct fine-tuning on all 16 seed-task combinations, with mean improvements of +1.7 to +4.4 percentage points. A controlled equal-budget experiment confirms the improvement comes from reasoning quality, not additional training steps. An unconditioned baseline demonstrates that with out answer-conditioning, wrong reasoning degrades performance by 17.8 percentage points. On weld radiograph classification, the fine-tuned 3B model outperforms GPT-4.1 by 10.0pp using just 24 training images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出答案条件链式思维（answer-conditioned CoT）蒸馏方法，用于快速将小型视觉语言模型适配到新工业视觉任务上，仅需少量标注样本。方法先让强大VLM在给定正确标签下生成视觉解释，再用LoRA微调3B参数模型。在四个工业分类任务（每种仅18-30张标注图像）上，该方法在所有16个种子-任务组合中均优于直接微调，平均提升1.7-4.4个百分点。在焊缝射线图像分类中，微调后的3B模型用24张图像即超越GPT-4.1达10个百分点。
Motivation: 工业视觉检测中需求频繁变化、新缺陷类型出现、标注数据稀缺，现有方法难以快速适应。
Method: 答案条件链式思维蒸馏：先由强大VLM基于训练图像及正确标签生成推理过程中的视觉解释，再用LoRA对3B参数小模型进行微调，确保推理方向正确。
Result: 在四个工业分类任务（每任务18-30张图像）上，所有16个种子-任务组合均优于直接微调，平均提升1.7-4.4个百分点；焊缝图像分类中，用24张图像微调后超过GPT-4.1达10个百分点。
Conclusion: 答案条件化是提升蒸馏效果的关键，无条件基线性能下降17.8个百分点；该方法在极少量标注数据下显著提升小VLM的工业视觉任务能力。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 答案条件化是提升蒸馏效果的关键，无条件基线性能下降17.8个百分点；该方法在极少量标注数据下显著提升小VLM的工业视觉任务能力。

papers.title: Edge Cluster Expansion with Radial Rotary Attention for Interatomic Potentials
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we provide a systematic investigation of SO(2) theory to machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) and identify the limitations of conventional SO(2) Linear architectures relative to SO(3) Clebsch-Gordan Tensor Products (CGTP). Building on these insights, we propose direct Cartesian construction and recursive Clebsch-Gordan construction of Wigner D-matrices and introduce two novel interaction building blocks. First, we propose the Edge Complex Product Basis based on Generalized Asymmetric Contraction, a new formulation for many-body expansion that directly constructs higher-order interactions on edges through complex-valued equivariant multiplications. Second, we introduce Radial Rotary Complex Attention(RRA), which enhances extrapolation performance and surpasses existing attention vector formulations. We also introduce several improvements to the Atomic Cluster Expansion module. Building on these advances, we train our models on OMat24, sAlex, and MPTrj, and introduce TECE-OAM-RRA-1.0, which achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on the Matbench Discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究SO(2)理论在机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）中的应用，指出传统SO(2) Linear架构相对于SO(3) Clebsch-Gordan张量积（CGTP）的局限性。提出基于广义不对称收缩的边复数乘积基和径向旋转复数注意力（RRA），改进原子簇展开模块，在OMat24、sAlex、MPTrj数据集上训练得到TECE-OAM-RRA-1.0模型，在Matbench Discovery上达到最佳性能。
Motivation: 现有SO(2) Linear架构在等变性和多体相互作用方面存在局限，需要更高效的构造方法来提升MLIPs的精度和外推能力。
Method: 提出直接笛卡尔构造和递归CG构造Wigner D-矩阵，引入边复数乘积基（基于广义不对称收缩）和径向旋转复数注意力（RRA），并改进原子簇展开模块。
Result: TECE-OAM-RRA-1.0模型在Matbench Discovery上达到SOTA性能。
Conclusion: 所提方法在等变性和多体展开上优于传统SO(2) Linear架构，为MLIPs提供了新的构建模块。

papers.title: Unlocking Parallelism in Autoregressive Language Models via Speculative Decoding with Progressive Tree Drafting
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding has significantly accelerated Large Language Model (LLM) inference by alleviating memory-bound bottlenecks. However, traditional speculative decoding typically relies on auxiliary draft modules, incurring significant training and communication overhead. Although recent methods attempt to generate drafts within the target model itself, they often fail to fully exploit its latent parallel capacity due to a lack of structural coordination. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Progressive Tree Drafting (PTD)}, which employs a structured, guided parallel drafting strategy to harness the model's parallel potential. By coupling a progressive tree structure with a stepwise pruning mechanism, PTD actively guides the LLM to explore multiple semantic paths in a single forward pass, ensuring both draft diversity and coherence. Experiments demonstrate that PTD achieves up to $2\times$ decoding speedup across various benchmarks while remaining training-free and model-agnostic. Our code is available at: https://github.com/MINE-USTC/PTD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出渐进式树状草稿（Progressive Tree Drafting, PTD），一种无需训练且模型无关的推测解码方法，通过在单个前向传播中引导LLM探索多条语义路径并逐步剪枝，实现最多2倍解码加速。
Motivation: 传统推测解码依赖辅助草稿模块，带来训练和通信开销；现有方法虽在目标模型内生成草稿，但缺乏结构协调，未能充分利用并行能力。
Method: PTD采用渐进式树状结构与逐步剪枝机制，在单个前向传播中引导LLM探索多条语义路径，同时保证草稿多样性和 coherence，无需训练且模型无关。
Result: 实验表明，PTD在各种基准测试上实现最高2倍解码加速，且无需训练、模型无关。
Conclusion: PTD通过结构化并行草稿策略有效利用LLM的并行潜力，加速推理，且易于部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Topological Quantum Phases from Limited Subsystems
papers.abstract_en: Characterizing quantum topological phases requires measuring non-local string order parameters, demanding access to the full system, which is often experimentally unfeasible. In this work, we introduce a data-efficient supervised learning framework that circumvents this limitation by recognizing quantum phases from small subsystems. Our protocol utilizes a quantum kernel constructed from the reduced density matrices of these subsystems, which can be efficiently estimated experimentally. We benchmark our framework with the classification of the phase diagrams of two spin models on one-dimensional lattices, namely the generalized cluster-Ising spin-1/2 chain and the anisotropic Haldane spin-1 chain. Remarkably, our approach achieves high accuracy in phase classification when operations are limited to as few as one to four sites, and it also generalizes to longer chains even when trained on moderate system sizes. These findings demonstrate that local reduced density matrices preserve vital signatures of global topological phases, offering a practical route to characterize rich phase diagrams of quantum many-body systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据高效的监督学习框架，通过局部子系统的约化密度矩阵构建量子核来识别拓扑量子相，避免了全局测量。在广义cluster-Ising自旋1/2链和各向异性Haldane自旋1链上验证，仅需1-4个格点即可高精度分类相图，并泛化至更长链。
Motivation: 表征量子拓扑相通常需要测量非局域弦序参量，要求访问整个系统，这在实验中往往不可行。
Method: 利用从有限子系统约化密度矩阵构建的量子核进行监督学习，通过分类器识别全局拓扑相。
Result: 在两种一维自旋模型上，仅用1-4个格点的子系统即可实现高精度相分类，并泛化至更长链。
Conclusion: 局部约化密度矩阵保留了全局拓扑相的关键特征，提供了表征量子多体系统相图的实用途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Embark Now: User Demand Oriented Framework for Multi-day Urban Travel Itinerary Planning
papers.abstract_en: In large urban areas, planning multi-day travel itineraries is challenging due to the abundance of Points of Interest (POIs), diverse user preferences, and constraints such as opening hours. Effective solutions must dynamically accommodate diverse traveler requirements while optimizing for satisfaction and feasibility within limited computation time. This paper addresses these challenges through introducing an innovative framework that integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) to dynamically capture user requirements with precision and flexibility, and an enhanced Greedy Randomized Adaptive Search Procedure (GRASP) algorithm as a well-suited preference-aware planner to generate feasible multi-day itineraries. The effectiveness of our integrated approach is demonstrated through extensive experiments on two real-world urban datasets from Beijing and Tianjin. Our framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, improving the average total itinerary score by at least 4.52% and 11.09% across 5,040 user cases with diverse preferences in the two datasets. Furthermore, through end-to-end algorithmic enhancements, it achieves notable average improvements of 17.95% and 26.07% in the computed metrics, while also delivering substantial gains in time efficiency -- realizing average performance increases of 4.64% and 25.55% within shorter computation times compared to suboptimal methods that require multiple iterations. These outcomes underscore our method's superiority in delivering both enhanced itinerary quality and computational efficiency over existing methodologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向多日城市旅行行程规划的框架，集成大语言模型（LLM）动态捕捉用户需求，并利用改进的GRASP算法生成可行行程。在北京和天津真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法在行程总得分、计算指标和时间效率上均显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 多日城市旅行规划中，兴趣点（POI）众多、用户偏好多样，且受营业时间等约束，现有方法难以同时满足满意度和可行性。
Method: 框架包括两部分：LLM用于精准灵活地捕捉用户需求；增强的贪心随机自适应搜索过程（GRASP）算法用于偏好感知的可行行程规划。
Result: 在北京和天津数据集上的5040个用户案例中，平均总行程得分分别提升至少4.52%和11.09%；通过端到端算法增强，计算指标平均提升17.95%和26.07%；时间效率提升4.64%和25.55%。
Conclusion: 该框架在行程质量和计算效率上均优于现有方法，适用于多日城市旅行规划。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Coverage Path Planning: Classical Foundations, Recent Advances, and Future Directions
papers.abstract_en: Coverage path planning (CPP) is a fundamental problem in robot motion planning, whose aim is to produce robot trajectories that provide complete coverage of target workspaces while minimizing task-specific objectives such as path length, overlap, number of turns, and energy consumption. CPP has widespread applications in cleaning, inspection, mapping, agriculture, manufacturing, surveillance, demining, and environmental monitoring. Although classical CPP has been extensively studied, recent advances have extended CPP beyond single-robot settings to multi-robot systems, complex 3D environments, constrained platforms, learning-based coverage planning, and visual coverage tasks. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of 125 representative works published primarily between 2015 and 2026, while presenting the evolution of recent developments in light of the classical CPP methods published before 2015. The CPP methods are organized into six main categories: single-robot CPP, multi-robot CPP, 3D CPP, constrained CPP, learning-based CPP, and visual CPP. For each category, the review summarizes the main planning formulations, representative algorithms, strengths, and limitations. In addition, the review analyzes how environmental knowledge, workspace geometry, robot constraints, sensing objectives, and coordination requirements shape the CPP problem. The survey further discusses open challenges in scalable online planning, multi-robot coordination, 3D and visual coverage, unified platform-constrained and resource-aware coverage, and learning-enhanced coverage. Thus, the survey provides a structured overview of recent CPP developments and future research directions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对覆盖路径规划（CPP）问题进行了全面综述，涵盖经典方法和2015至2026年间的最新进展。将CPP方法分为单机器人、多机器人、3D环境、约束平台、学习型及视觉覆盖六大类，总结了各类的规划形式、代表性算法、优势与局限，并分析了环境知识、工作空间几何、机器人约束、感知目标和协调需求对问题的影响。最后讨论了可扩展在线规划、多机器人协调、3D与视觉覆盖、统一平台约束与资源感知覆盖以及学习增强覆盖等开放挑战。
Motivation: CPP在清洁、检查、测绘、农业、制造、监视、排雷和环境监测等领域有广泛应用，但近年来出现多机器人系统、复杂3D环境、学习型覆盖等新扩展，需要系统梳理近年来的发展并与经典方法关联。
Method: 对125篇代表性工作（主要为2015-2026年间发表）进行结构化分类与评述，按单机器人CPP、多机器人CPP、3D CPP、约束CPP、学习型CPP和视觉CPP六个类别组织，每个类别总结规划形式、算法、优缺点，并分析环境知识等因素对问题建模的影响。
Result: 本文提供了CPP领域2015年后的发展概览，识别出六个主要研究方向，并归纳了各类方法的代表性算法及局限性。
Conclusion: 未来研究方向包括可扩展在线规划、多机器人协调、3D与视觉覆盖、统一平台约束与资源感知覆盖，以及学习增强覆盖。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spectral Heat Flow for Conservative Token Condensation in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are costly at inference time because they must process long sequences of visual tokens. Existing token pruning methods often degrade under high compression by blindly discarding information, breaking spatial structure or collapsing diversity. We propose SpecFlow, a training-free framework that shifts the paradigm from destructive pruning to conservative condensation, strictly enforcing spatial coverage and statistical conservation to ensure stability. Treating visual tokens as nodes in a $k$NN graph, SpecFlow (i) computes a stable importance field via spectral heat flow to preserve structural coherence, (ii) allocates budgets via adaptive spatial partitioning to guarantee coverage, and (iii) aggregates discarded information into coreset sinks to maintain statistical conservation. The method is plug-and-play, requires no fine-tuning, and is compatible with FlashAttention. Experiments confirm that our SpecFlow outperforms SOTA methods across tasks, VLM architectures, and pruning ratios. Notably, LLaVA-1.5 with SpecFlow retains 95.6\% of original performance despite pruning 88.9\% of visual tokens, offering an exceptional efficiency-accuracy balance. Code is available at https://github.com/Lzy-dot/SpecFlow
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpecFlow，一种无需训练的框架，将视觉语言模型中的视觉 token 压缩从破坏性剪枝转变为保守性凝聚。通过谱热流保持结构一致性、自适应空间划分保证覆盖、以及将丢弃信息聚合为核集汇点维持统计守恒，该方法在无需微调的情况下与 FlashAttention 兼容。实验表明，在 LLaVA-1.5 上，即使剪枝 88.9% 的视觉 token，仍能保留 95.6% 的原始性能，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型推理时需处理长序列视觉 token，现有剪枝方法在高压缩率下常盲目丢弃信息、破坏空间结构或导致多样性崩溃，需要一种更稳定的 token 压缩方法。
Method: 将视觉 token 视为 kNN 图的节点，通过谱热流计算稳定重要性场以保持结构连贯性，用自适应空间划分分配预算以保证覆盖，并将丢弃信息聚合到核集汇点以维持统计守恒。
Result: 在多种 VLM 架构和剪枝率下超越现有方法，LLaVA-1.5 在剪枝 88.9% 视觉 token 时仍保留 95.6% 的原始性能。
Conclusion: SpecFlow 是一种即插即用、无需微调的 token 压缩框架，兼顾效率与准确性，适用于多种 VLM。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Auditing Construct Overlap in Explainable Machine Learning: Evidence from Burnout-Depression Prediction Across Student Cohorts
papers.abstract_en: Explainable machine learning (XML) pipelines applied to composite mental health outcomes can produce apparently-robust, cross-population-stable risk hierarchies that are largely artefacts of how the outcome was constructed. We demonstrate this using an ElasticNet pipeline applied to 886 medical students at the University of Lausanne (primary cohort, 2022), validated across 2,580 longitudinal observations at three time points and 701 non-medical students from eight faculties; all three datasets share identical instruments. The pipeline produces a hierarchy in which trait anxiety and health satisfaction dominate wherever the outcome is measured, with Kendall $τ= 1.0$ for the top-two positions across all five evaluation sets and consistent transfer performance ($R^2$: 0.41-0.49). Two residualization experiments, which isolate shared variance between correlated variables via regression, reveal the mechanism: when trait anxiety (STAI-T) is residualized against the co-included depression subscale (CES-D, $r = 0.72$), model $R^2$ drops from 0.41 to 0.16 and STAI-T falls from rank 1 to rank 6; when burnout subscales are residualized against CES-D, $R^2$ collapses to 0.016. Prediction intervals average 35.4 units on a 0-100 scale (2.4 outcome standard deviations), independently ruling out individual-level deployment. The residualization protocol is the paper's transferable contribution: any XAI study combining correlated predictor and outcome constructs should apply this check before interpreting apparent stability as a finding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文展示了可解释机器学习（XML）管道在复合心理健康结果上产生的跨群体稳定风险层级实际上是结果构造的人为产物。作者使用弹性网络（ElasticNet）对洛桑大学医学院学生数据进行训练，并在多个队列中验证，发现特质焦虑和健康满意度始终占据主导地位。通过残差化（residualization）实验分离相关变量间的共享方差后，模型性能显著下降，表明稳定性是构造重叠（construct overlap）的假象。
Motivation: 可解释机器学习研究常报告跨群体稳定的风险因子层级，但这类稳定性可能源于结果变量的构造方式（如复合量表）而非真实预测关系。论文旨在揭示并量化这种构造重叠导致的虚假稳定性。
Method: 采用弹性网络（ElasticNet）管道预测倦怠-抑郁复合结果，并在三个数据集（总计4167份观测）上验证。关键步骤是残差化实验：将相关预测变量（如特质焦虑、倦怠子量表）对结果变量中的重叠成分进行回归后，重新评估模型性能和特征重要性排名。
Result: 残差化后，模型R²从0.41降至0.16（特质焦虑残差化）甚至0.016（倦怠子量表残差化）；特质焦虑从排名第1跌至第6。预测区间平均35.4个单位（0-100量表），排除个体层面部署的可能性。
Conclusion: 论文提出残差化协议作为可迁移贡献：任何结合相关预测变量和结果变量的XAI研究都应执行该检查，以避免将构造伪影误认为真实发现。局限性包括单一管道（ElasticNet）和自评量表数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: World Models as Adversaries: Multi-Agent Self-Play Fine-Tuning for Robust Motion Planning
papers.abstract_en: Robust motion planning in dense traffic requires autonomous vehicles to interact in rare and safety-critical scenarios that are underrepresented in naturalistic driving data. Although adversarial training offers a feasible solution, existing methods often rely on external scenario generators, heuristic perturbations, or simulator-heavy rollouts, which makes them difficult to integrate with modern autoregressive planners. Here, we cast adversarially robust planner learning as a constrained min-max game and propose Adversarial World Modeling (AWM), a theoretically grounded multi-agent self-play fine-tuning framework. Since solving the exact game is intractable, AWM introduces a principled decoupled solver. In the inner minimization, the planner's predictive world model is converted into a role-conditioned adversary that learns sparse, scene-adaptive attack coalitions via counterfactual credit assignment. In the outer maximization, the ego planner optimizes a regret-aware robust best response against the frozen AWM, utilizing tail-risk weighting and reference-anchored trust regions to improve hard-case recovery while preserving nominal driving behavior. Experiments on the nuPlan and InterPlan benchmarks demonstrate that our method generates transferable adversarial interactions and yields a robust planner that achieves competitive closed-loop performance in both nominal and highly interactive long-tail scenarios. Theoretical analysis justifies the decoupled solver and the main optimization components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对抗世界建模（AWM）框架，通过多智能体自博弈微调将鲁棒运动规划器学习建模为约束极小极大博弈。该方法将规划器的世界模型转换为角色条件的对抗器，学习稀疏场景自适应攻击，并优化规划器的后悔感知鲁棒最优响应。在nuPlan和InterPlan基准上，生成可迁移的对抗交互，在常规和长尾场景中取得有竞争力的闭环性能。
Motivation: 密集交通中的鲁棒运动规划需要处理自然驾驶数据中稀有的安全关键场景，现有对抗训练方法依赖外部场景生成器或启发式扰动，难以与现代自回归规划器集成。
Method: 提出AWM框架，将问题形式化为约束极小极大博弈，通过解耦求解器：内极小化将世界模型转换为角色条件对抗器，通过反事实信用分配学习稀疏场景自适应攻击；外极大化使用尾风险加权和参考锚定信任区域优化规划器的后悔感知鲁棒最优响应。
Result: 在nuPlan和InterPlan基准上，该方法生成可迁移的对抗交互，在常规和高交互长尾场景中取得有竞争力的闭环性能。
Conclusion: 理论分析证明了解耦求解器和主要优化组件的合理性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Anamnesis: An Open-Source Platform for Large-Scale Backstory-Conditioned Survey Simulation
papers.abstract_en: We present Anamnesis, an interactive system for demographically controllable survey simulation using large language models. Open-source, and designed for non-technical users/researchers, Anamnesis enables the prototyping and stress-testing of survey instruments on virtual populations rather than real human subjects. The platform operationalizes the recently introduced Anthology and Alterity frameworks, which use structured narrative backstories to condition model responses, within a unified web interface. It supports open-ended generation, probabilistic demographic resampling, and multimodal (image and audio) surveys. We evaluate the system through two case studies: (1) replicating segments of Pew Research Center's American Trends Panel (ATP) on political typology and biomedical issues and (2) emulating human preference in the New Yorker Caption Contest. In both cases, Anamnesis produces opinion distributions that more closely match real-world survey data than standard persona-prompting baselines, offering a transparent, reproducible, and open-source alternative to proprietary simulation services.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Anamnesis，一个基于大语言模型的交互式、开源调查模拟平台，用于人口统计可控的虚拟调查。该平台实现了Anthology和Alterity框架，通过结构化叙事背景故事调节模型响应，支持开放生成、概率性重采样和多模态调查。在皮尤研究中心美国趋势小组和《纽约客》标题比赛两个案例中，Anamnesis产生的意见分布比标准角色提示更接近真实数据，提供了透明、可重复的替代方案。
Motivation: 现有调查模拟依赖专有服务或缺乏透明性，且难以在真实人群中进行压力测试。需要一个开源、可复现的平台来帮助研究人员在不涉及真实受试者的情况下原型设计和测试调查工具。
Method: Anamnesis基于Anthology和Alterity框架，利用结构化背景故事（backstory）来条件化LLM响应。通过统一Web界面，支持开放生成、概率性人口重采样（demographic resampling）以及多模态（图像和音频）调查输入。
Result: 在两项案例研究中，Anamnesis成功复制了皮尤研究中心美国趋势小组（ATP）的政治类型学和生物医学问题调查，以及《纽约客》标题比赛的人类偏好。其输出的意见分布与真实调查数据的匹配程度高于标准角色提示基线。
Conclusion: Anamnesis提供了一个透明、可重复的开源替代方案，可用于调查模拟，减少对专有服务的依赖，并增强社会科学研究的可信度和可复现性。

papers.title: Spectral Consistent Flow for One-step 3D Medical Image Translation
papers.abstract_en: We present Spectral Consistent Flow (SC-Flow), a 3D medical image translation framework with a single function evaluation (1-NFE) in the latent space. This approach reformulates medical image translation as a stochastic Brownian bridge process that directly constructs a mapping between source and target modalities by predicting the support regularized mean velocity field. To mitigate modality entanglement, over-smoothing, and artifacts induced by the implicit low-pass modulation of the latent average velocity, we introduce a Spectral Consistency Corrector that dynamically regularizes the evolution of the power spectral density via learnable frequency-domain gain modulation. This mechanism establishes an explicit bridge between spatial textures and spectral energy flow, enabling the model to recover fine-grained anatomical fidelity while maintaining global structural coherence. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate that SC-Flow delivers significantly more accurate, consistent, and robust performance across various translation scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SC-Flow，一种在潜空间单步评估的3D医学图像翻译框架，将翻译视为随机布朗桥过程并预测支持正则化的平均速度场。引入谱一致性校正器通过频域增益调制保持纹理细节和结构一致性。实验表明在多个数据集上性能优越。
Motivation: 现有医学图像翻译方法存在模态纠缠、过度平滑和伪影问题，源于隐式低通调制导致的频谱退化。
Method: 将翻译建模为随机布朗桥过程，直接预测支持正则化的平均速度场。提出谱一致性校正器，通过可学习的频域增益动态正则化功率谱密度演化，建立空间纹理与频谱能量流之间的显式桥梁。
Result: 在四个3D医学图像数据集上，SC-Flow实现了更准确、一致和鲁棒的翻译性能。
Conclusion: 该方法通过谱一致性校正有效恢复了细粒度解剖保真度，同时保持了全局结构连贯性。

papers.title: LATO.2: Factorized 3D Mesh Generation with Vertex and Topology Flow
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching over carefully designed latent representations has recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for topology-aware mesh generation. Existing approaches, however, model vertices and connectivity jointly in a joint latent space, entangling continuous vertex geometry with discrete combinatorial structure; this complicates flow learning and manifests as drifting vertices and broken surfaces. We present LATO.2, a factorized flow matching framework that decomposes mesh generation into a vertex flow followed by a connectivity flow conditioned on the realized vertices, with both stages anchored to a shared coarse voxel scaffold. Dedicated VAEs underpin the two stages, recovering vertices at sub-voxel precision and embedding discrete connectivity into a continuous latent space. We demonstrate two advantages unique to this factorization: (i) part-wise generation, in which the scaffold is partitioned and each part synthesized at full latent capacity, yielding substantially higher-resolution meshes than a monolithic latent permits; and (ii) topology-adaptive editing, in which manipulating first-stage vertices induces the corresponding connectivity without re-optimization. Experiments show that LATO.2 surpasses state-of-the-art topology-aware mesh generators in geometric fidelity and connectivity quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LATO.2，一种因子化流匹配框架，将 3D 网格生成分解为顶点流和连接流，两阶段均锚定到共享的粗体素支架。专用 VAE 分别恢复顶点亚体素精度和将离散连接嵌入连续潜在空间。该方法支持零件级生成和拓扑自适应编辑，在几何保真度和连接质量上超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有流匹配方法在联合潜在空间中建模顶点和连接，导致几何与拓扑纠缠，引发顶点漂移和表面破裂，限制了网格质量。
Method: 将网格生成分解为两阶段：顶点流生成顶点坐标，连接流基于已生成顶点预测三角面拓扑；两阶段共享粗体素支架，并采用专用 VAE 处理。
Result: 在几何保真度和连接质量上超越当前最优的拓扑感知网格生成器，支持更高分辨率零件级生成和无需重优化的拓扑自适应编辑。
Conclusion: 因子化分解有效解耦几何与拓扑，提升生成质量与灵活性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Demixing Sparse Signals from Nonlinear Observations using Generalized Non-convex Regularization
papers.abstract_en: We consider the recovery of a pair of sparse vectors from a limited number of nonlinear observations of their superposition: $y_i=g(\inner{\ba_i}{\bPhi\bw^\ast+\bPsi\bz^\ast})+e_i$, $i=1,\dots,m$, with $m\ll n$, incoherent orthonormal bases $\bPhi,\bPsi$, a scalar link $g$, and noise $e_i$ that may be heavy-tailed or contaminated. We propose a regularization-based framework combining a Huberized data fidelity with generalized folded-concave penalties (SCAD, MCP), and a two-block proximal alternating algorithm with backtracking (NLD-PALM) whose whole iterate sequence provably converges to critical points under the Kurdyka--Łojasiewicz property, with local linear rates. On the statistical side we establish restricted strong convexity of the Huberized nonlinear loss through an exact sign-definite decomposition, and derive estimation error bounds of order $σ\sqrt{s\log(n)/m}$ that hold at \emph{every} localized stationary point, an oracle rate $σ\sqrt{s/m}$ free of $\log n$ and shrinkage bias under a beta-min condition, and a co-equal recovery theorem for \emph{unknown} monotone links via a linear surrogate and a clipped Plan--Vershynin decoupling. The estimator requires no knowledge of the sparsity levels, and its guarantees hold under symmetric noise with only finite variance. Experiments at $n=512$ under a frozen data-driven regularization rule show an earlier phase transition than convex $\ell_1$ demixing and greedy hard-thresholding baselines, a $35\times$ accuracy advantage over squared-loss estimation under $5\%$ gross outliers, and successful demixing of spike-plus-background signals observed through a saturating amplifier.

Motivation: 现有方法处理稀疏向量解混时，常假设线性观测或高斯噪声，而实际中观测可能是非线性的且噪声可能重尾或受污染，需要一种对非线性鲁棒且无需已知稀疏度的正则化框架。
Method: 结合Huberized数据保真度与折叠凹惩罚（SCAD, MCP），提出两分块近端交替算法（NLD-PALM）并带有回溯步。理论分析利用符号正定分解建立Huberized非线性损失的受限强凸性，推导局部驻点处的误差界。
Result: 在n=512的实验中，固定数据驱动正则化规则下，该方法比凸ℓ1解混和贪婪硬阈值基线更早出现相变；在5%粗大异常值下，精度比平方损失估计高出35倍；成功解混通过饱和放大器观测的尖峰加背景信号。
Conclusion: 所提估计器无需已知稀疏度，且对对称噪声仅需有限方差。理论保证包括局部线性收敛率和oracle速率，并证明了未知单调链接函数下的共同恢复定理。

papers.title: modelDNA: Calibrated Lineage Verification and Merge Decomposition from Sampled Weight Fingerprints
papers.abstract_en: The lineage graph of open-weight language models is self-reported: Hugging Face's base_model metadata field is optional and unverified, and over 60% of Hub models document no parentage at all. Methods for detecting lineage from weights exist in the research literature, but each ships as paper code tied to one signal and one experiment; when a provenance dispute breaks, the analysis is redone by hand. This report describes modelDNA, a tool that fingerprints a model from roughly 100-300 MB of ranged HTTP reads (instead of a full 15 GB download for a 7B model), compares the fingerprint against a reference database of foundation models across four published signal families, and returns one of eight verdict classes with a calibrated probability, preferring honest abstention to confident error. On a benchmark of 15 real Hub models with org-documented parentage, judged against 8 candidate bases (13 positives, 107 hard negatives), the system achieves AUROC 1.0, zero false positives at its reporting threshold, and 13/13 correct top-1 parent attribution. The report's second contribution is merge decomposition. Every mainstream weight-merging method is (near-)linear per tensor, and fingerprint sample positions are deterministic functions of tensor identity, so a merged model's fingerprint is the same linear combination of its parents' fingerprints. Mixture weights can therefore be recovered from fingerprints alone by sum-to-one constrained least squares. Against merges with published mergekit configurations as ground truth, the method recovers a slerp merge's layer-interpolation curves at r = 0.999 and a dare_ties merge's mixture weights to within 0.011 of the published values, without downloading any weights beyond the fingerprints. All fingerprints, benchmarks, and the inferred lineage graph of 55 models are public and reproducible offline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 modelDNA，一种通过采样权重指纹（weight fingerprints）进行校准的谱系验证和合并分解工具。它只需下载模型权重的 100-300 MB 子集，即可与参考数据库比对，返回八种判决类别之一并给出校准概率，而非完整下载 15 GB。在 15 个真实模型基准上，AUROC 达 1.0，零假阳性，13/13 正确识别父模型。此外，通过指纹线性分解实现合并分解，可恢复 slerp 合并的层插值曲线（r=0.999）和 dare_ties 合并的混合权重（误差≤0.011）。所有指纹、基准和 55 个模型的推断谱系图均已公开。
Motivation: 当前开放权重语言模型的谱系信息是自报的，Hugging Face 的 base_model 字段可选且未验证，超过 60% 的模型未记录父模型。现有检测方法依赖于单一信号和特定实验，遇到谱系争议需手动重做分析。
Method: 构建 modelDNA 工具，通过有限的 HTTP 范围读取获取模型指纹（约 100-300 MB），与包含四种公开发表信号家族的基金会模型参考数据库比对，输出八种判决类别及校准概率。对于合并分解，利用主流合并方法的（近）线性性质，通过约束最小二乘从指纹中恢复混合权重。
Result: 在 15 个真实模型基准上，AUROC 达到 1.0，报告阈值下零假阳性，且 13/13 正确识别 top-1 父模型。合并分解中，slerp 合并的层插值曲线相关系数为 0.999，dare_ties 合并的混合权重误差在 0.011 以内。
Conclusion: 该工具提供了一种轻量级、可复现的谱系验证和合并分解方法，支持无需完整权重下载的离线操作，并强调诚实弃权（honest abstention）以避免自信错误。

papers.title: M+Adam: Low-Precision Training via Additive-Multiplicative Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Training with quantized weights can reduce costs but often results in degraded accuracy, especially when optimization is carried out in low precision, without storing high-precision copies. We identify a key failure mode: under low precision, standard optimizers can get stuck and not make progress, especially at large weight magnitudes due to coarse mantissa resolution. To overcome this, multiplicative updates have been previously proposed, in place of additive updates in standard optimizers. While successful under extremely low precision, such as under the logarithmic number system, they suffer from failures near zero and across sign changes. The failure modes of additive and multiplicative updates are therefore complementary. To exploit this, we propose M+Adam, which combines both update types: additive steps handle sign changes and small magnitudes, while multiplicative steps ensure progress at large magnitudes when additive updates are zeroed out under rounding. We prove monotone descent for M+Adam under standard smoothness assumptions. Across LLaMA-style pretraining with 60M-1B models, 1x-8x Chinchilla budgets, and using only BF16, FP8, and FP4 master weights, M+Adam consistently improves low-precision training.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). 45 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对低精度训练中标准优化器（如Adam）在大权重幅度下因浮点数尾数分辨率不足而停滞的问题，提出结合加法更新和乘法更新的M+Adam优化器。加法更新处理符号变化和小幅度，乘法更新确保大幅度下的进展。理论证明M+Adam在标准平滑假设下具有单调下降性质。在60M-1B参数的LLaMA风格预训练中，使用BF16、FP8和FP4主权重，M+Adam一致提升了低精度训练的效果。
Motivation: 低精度训练中，标准优化器在权重幅度较大时因尾数分辨率不足而无法更新，导致训练停滞；纯乘法更新在接近零或跨符号时失败。作者希望结合两种更新类型的互补优势，解决低精度训练的性能退化问题。
Method: 提出M+Adam优化器，将Adam的加法更新与乘法更新结合：加法步骤处理符号变化和小幅度，乘法步骤在大幅度下（加法更新因舍入为零时）确保继续优化。算法基于标准平滑假设给出了单调下降的理论保证。
Result: 在60M-1B参数的LLaMA模型上，使用BF16、FP8和FP4主权重进行预训练（1x-8x Chinchilla预算），M+Adam一致优于标准低精度训练方法。
Conclusion: M+Adam通过加性-乘性更新的组合有效克服了低精度训练中更新停滞的问题，但适用范围可能受限于特定精度和模型规模，且乘法更新的数值稳定性需进一步验证。

papers.title: WasteAssistant: Regulation-Guided Visual Question Answering Framework for Intelligent Waste Segregation and Sustainable Managemen
papers.abstract_en: Efficient waste segregation is critical for sustainable urban management and environmental governance. Existing automated systems are limited by single-modality visual processing, insufficient contextual understanding, and weak regulatory alignment. To address these issues, we propose a language-guided vision-AI framework that integrates vision-language models and multimodal large language models for joint visual-linguistic reasoning. This framework implements a visual question answering paradigm aligned with India's Solid Waste Management Rules 2016. We construct a new WasteVQA dataset with 13,500 question-answer pairs across 21 waste categories. Experiments show that the BLIP-based model achieves a BLEU score of 0.8291 and a BERTScore of 0.9273, outperforming traditional CNN-based methods. This work improves source-level segregation accuracy, ensures regulatory compliance, and supports scalable deployment for municipal and citizen-facing waste management, promoting multimodal AI in sustainable urban infrastructure. The source code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/Khushkataruka/WasteAssistant
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个语言引导的视觉AI框架WasteAssistant，整合视觉-语言模型和多模态大语言模型，实现基于视觉问答的废物分类。构建了包含13,500个问答对的WasteVQA数据集，覆盖21个废物类别。实验表明BLIP模型BLEU得分0.8291，BERTScore 0.9273，优于传统CNN方法。
Motivation: 现有自动废物分类系统受限于单模态视觉处理、缺乏上下文理解和法规对齐，无法满足可持续城市管理需求。
Method: 提出语言引导的视觉问答框架，集成视觉-语言模型和多模态大语言模型，实现联合视觉-语言推理；构建WasteVQA数据集；基于印度固体废物管理规则2016进行对齐。
Result: BLIP模型在WasteVQA数据集上BLEU得分0.8291，BERTScore 0.9273，优于传统CNN方法。
Conclusion: 该工作提高了源头级分类精度，确保法规合规性，支持可扩展的城市废物管理部署，推动多模态AI在可持续基础设施中的应用。

papers.title: The Compliance Trap: Diagnosing How AI Agents Consume Conflicting Memory
papers.abstract_en: Memory is becoming a core component of long-horizon AI agents, allowing agents to reuse past experience when operating web browsers, software tools, and other interactive environments. Existing work mostly treats memory as a supply problem, asking what experience to write, how to store it, and which entry to retrieve for the next task. Yet we still lack a clear account of how models consume retrieved memory across a multi-step action trajectory. This consumption process matters because it determines not only what memories should be retrieved, but also what models and control policies are needed to use them safely. To diagnose this process, we propose Entry--Propagation--Recovery (E-P-R), a trajectory-level framework that asks where memory first changes an action, whether that change carries forward, and whether the agent can recover after leaving a correct path. We instantiate E-P-R on WebArena and on MemTrapBench, a controlled benchmark we build to isolate these phases. We find that the main failure often begins at entry: agents adopt conflicting memory at the first exposed decision point even when it is task-wrong. Repeated exposure then amplifies this early error, while recovery after divergence is weak. Together, these effects create a compliance trap: across models, conflicting memory induces similar compliance rates, but once agents comply, their success rates collapse to a low floor. Stronger agents therefore suffer larger absolute damage because each compliance event erases more baseline capability. These results suggest that memory-augmented agents should be evaluated not only by retrieval quality or final success rate, but by how they consume memory throughout the trajectory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出E-P-R框架，用于诊断AI代理如何消费检索到的记忆，并发现代理在面对冲突记忆时会陷入顺从陷阱（compliance trap）：一旦代理接受错误记忆，后续行动难以恢复，导致成功率的系统性下降。实验在WebArena和新建的MemTrapBench上进行。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注记忆的供给（写什么、如何存、检索什么），但缺乏对代理如何消费（即如何使用）检索到的记忆的清晰理解，而这决定了记忆的安全使用和模型设计。
Method: 提出Entry-Propagation-Recovery (E-P-R)框架，从三个相位分析代理消费记忆的过程：记忆首次改变行动（Entry）、该改变是否延续（Propagation）、以及代理能否从偏离正确路径中恢复（Recovery）。在WebArena和自建的MemTrapBench基准上实例化该框架。
Result: 发现主要失败始于Entry阶段：代理在第一个暴露的决策点就会采纳冲突记忆，即使该记忆是任务错误的。重复暴露加剧早期错误，而恢复能力弱。产生顺从陷阱：不同模型冲突记忆下的顺从率相似，但一旦顺从，成功率骤降至低点。更强的代理因每次顺从损失更多基线能力而承受更大的绝对损害。
Conclusion: 记忆增强代理不仅应评估检索质量或最终成功率，还应评估其在整个轨迹中如何消费记忆。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: End-to-End Real-Time Drone-Based Person Detection Framework Using Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) or drones have gained rapid response in terms of security, search and rescue (SAR), border surveillance, etc. Existing monitoring frameworks often struggle to maintain detection consistency when targets undergo significant scale variations due to altitude changes, leading to critical information gaps. To address this issue, this work proposes an integrated real-time detection pipeline for detecting targets through the wireless live drone video feed. Build upon YOLOv8-nano architecture, extensive flight experiments were conducted to determine the detection performance across multiple flight altitudes. Trained on VisDrone2019 dataset, the results of YOLOv8-nano model achieves 57.4%, 41%, 44.8% and 20.3% in precision, recall, mAP and mAP50:95 respectively. While demonstrating on real environment, this analysis revealed that the algorithm achieves near-total detection reliability at altitudes between 16 and 25 meters with the detection frame rate consistently maintained above 41 FPS and reaching a peak of 50 FPS. However, the goal of this work is to enable real-time person detection from an aerial platform via wireless transmission. This approach effectively addresses the dual challenges of identifying targets at varying scales and ensuring near-to-accurate localization during aerial observation.

papers.title: Agentic-DPO: From Imitation to Agentic Policy Optimization on Expert Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are commonly trained from expert trajectories using supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which treats multi-turn agent behavior as ordinary text imitation. This recipe is simple and low-cost, but it only learns to imitate the sequence of expert actions, rather than training the agent to choose the right action against plausible mistakes at each state. Existing methods to mitigate this problem include preference learning or reinforcement learning, but they usually need high-cost environment rollouts and reward models. We propose Agentic-DPO, a lightweight offline agent policy optimization method that turns expert trajectories into state-conditioned preference supervision. At each expert action state, Agentic-DPO samples a one-step action from the current state, treats plausible wrong actions as negatives, and contrasts them with the expert action using a DPO-style preference objective. To avoid mixing both policy and schema in preference learning, we introduce Policy-Preserving Augmentation (PPA), which renders the same latent trajectory under multiple schemas while keeping the expert policy fixed. Agentic-DPO requires no online environment rollout, reward model, or full-trajectory student exploration. We conduct experiments across StableToolBench, tau-bench retail, and Mind2Web, where Agentic-DPO consistently improves agents at different model scales beyond imitation. In particular, it raises tau-bench accuracy from 21.7% (SFT) to 41.4% for a 9B model, matching online GRPO under the same backbone with only step-level rollouts and without environment interaction during gradient steps. The results suggest that expert trajectories can support low-cost agentic policy optimization when converted from demonstrations into state-level action preferences. Code for Agentic-DPO is released at https://github.com/Schuture/Agentic-DPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agentic-DPO，一种轻量级离线 agent 策略优化方法，将专家轨迹转化为状态条件偏好监督，无需在线环境回滚或奖励模型。在 StableToolBench、tau-bench retail 和 Mind2Web 上，Agentic-DPO 在不同模型规模上持续改进 agent，例如在 9B 模型上将 tau-bench 准确率从 21.7%（SFT）提升至 41.4%，匹配在线 GRPO。
Motivation: 现有基于专家轨迹的 SFT 只模仿动作序列，而非学习在每步选择正确动作避免错误。偏好学习或 RL 需要昂贵的环境回滚和奖励模型。
Method: 提出 Agentic-DPO，在每个专家动作状态，从当前状态采样一步动作，将合理错误动作作为负例，使用 DPO 风格偏好目标与专家动作对比。引入策略保持增强（PPA）以分离策略和模式。
Result: 在 StableToolBench、tau-bench retail 和 Mind2Web 上，Agentic-DPO 持续改进 agent。在 9B 模型上 tau-bench 准确率从 21.7% 提升到 41.4%，匹配在线 GRPO，且无需环境交互。
Conclusion: 专家轨迹通过转化为状态级动作偏好可以支持低成本的 agent 策略优化。

papers.title: MRUF: Multi-granularity Routing with Uncertainty-Aware Fusion for Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal sentiment analysis relies on language, visual, and acoustic cues, but utterance-level modality quality may vary due to occlusion, background noise, motion blur, or imperfect transcripts, causing conventional fusion to over-trust unreliable modalities. We propose MRUF, a reliability-aware fusion method that combines multi-granularity routing with uncertainty-aware calibration. MRUF summarizes sentiment-relevant representations, performs subspace- and modality-level routing, and supervises modality routing with leave-one-out error increases to estimate utterance-level modality importance. It further predicts modality-wise uncertainty and refines modality gates through inverse-variance reweighting, while modality-invariant contrastive alignment stabilizes the shared representation space. Experiments on CMU-MOSI and CMU-MOSEI under aligned and unaligned settings show consistent improvements over strong baselines, and mechanism analysis verifies that modalities with higher predicted uncertainty receive lower fusion weights.
papers.comment: Main paper (6 pages). Accepted for publication by IEEE International Conference on Systems and Man and and Cybernetics 2026 (IEEE SMC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MRUF，一种结合多粒度路由与不确定性感知校准的多模态情感分析融合方法。通过子空间和模态级路由、留一法误差评估模态重要性、逆方差加权调整门控，以及模态不变对比对齐，在CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI数据集上一致优于强基线，实验验证高不确定性模态获得较低融合权重。
Motivation: 传统多模态融合方法在部分模态质量因遮挡、噪声等下降时会过度信任不可靠模态，导致性能下降。
Method: MRUF包括：多粒度路由（子空间和模态级）、基于留一法误差增加的模态重要性监督、不确定性预测及逆方差加权融合门控，并引入模态不变对比对齐稳定共享表示空间。
Result: 在CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI的对齐与非对齐设定下，MRUF一致优于强基线，机制分析证实预测不确定性高的模态获得更低融合权重。
Conclusion: 不确定性感知融合能有效处理模态质量波动，提升多模态情感分析的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Anomalous Frame Detection by Grouping Frame Similarities between Two Videos Computed by Vision-Language Model to Extract Expert Workers' Unique Actions
papers.abstract_en: Maintenance of critical infrastructures, such as railways and power plants, is essential for operational safety and reliability. However, the declining number of skilled maintenance workers poses a serious challenge to sustaining these operations, highlighting the need to effectively transfer expert know-how to less experienced workers. Although traditional interview-based approaches have been used to elicit maintenance skills, they struggle to capture know-how that experts themselves may not consciously recognize. To address this gap, we proposed a method that detects anomalous frames of candidate actions including know-how by comparing a video of manual-based work with that of expert maintenance workers. In a simulated maintenance experiment involving a distribution board, our method targeted 11 types of actions not described in the manual and achieved a 66.9% extraction rate, marking a 50-percentage-point improvement over conventional techniques. These findings underscore the effectiveness of our approach in revealing hidden maintenance knowledge, thereby contributing to enhanced skill transfer and workforce development in critical infrastructure maintenance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种方法，通过视觉语言模型（VLM）计算两个视频（基于手册的操作视频和专家操作视频）之间的帧相似性，检测出包含专家特有know-how的异常帧。在模拟配电盘维护实验中，针对11种手册未描述的动作，实现了66.9%的提取率，比传统方法提高50个百分点。
Motivation: 关键基础设施维护中熟练工人减少，需要将专家know-how转移给经验不足的工人，但传统访谈方法难以捕捉专家自身未意识到的隐性知识。
Method: 利用视觉语言模型比较手册操作视频与专家操作视频的帧相似性，检测异常帧以提取专家特有的动作。
Result: 在模拟配电盘维护实验中，针对11种手册未描述的动作，提取率达到66.9%，比传统方法提高50个百分点。
Conclusion: 该方法能有效揭示隐藏的维护知识，促进技能转移和劳动力发展。

papers.title: AutoNorm: Understanding Adaptive Normalization in Transformers through Differentiable Gating
papers.abstract_en: Normalization is a critical component for stabilizing Transformer training, yet the choice between static strategies such as Layer Normalization (LN) and adaptive alternatives remains largely task-dependent. In this paper, we investigate a key optimization challenge in differentiable normalization gating. Our experiments show that, on relatively stationary vision tasks, the high gradient variance introduced by Gumbel-Softmax gating can hinder convergence of the routing mechanism, causing learned gates to underperform simple random selection. In contrast, on non-stationary language modeling and classification tasks, sustained gating diversity enables the model to learn more effective layer-wise normalization policies. Motivated by these observations, we propose AutoNorm-S (Stabilized), a training strategy that mitigates optimization instability through a gate-freezing schedule. AutoNorm-S achieves competitive or improved performance across multiple benchmarks, outperforming adaptive normalization baselines on NLP datasets, including PTB and SST-2, while remaining competitive on standard vision benchmarks. These results suggest that decoupling normalization selection from optimization noise provides a practical and principled approach for adaptive normalization in Transformer architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过可微门控机制研究Transformer中的自适应归一化，发现静态任务下Gumbel-Softmax门控导致高梯度方差阻碍收敛，而动态任务中门控多样性有益。提出AutoNorm-S稳定化训练策略，通过门控冻结调度缓解优化不稳定，在NLP基准上取得竞争力表现。
Motivation: 现有归一化策略（如Layer Normalization）的任务依赖性未被充分理解，可微归一化门控的优化挑战尚待探究。
Method: 提出AutoNorm-S训练策略，通过门控冻结调度（gate-freezing schedule）来稳定自适应归一化门控的优化过程。
Result: 在NLP数据集（PTB, SST-2）上，AutoNorm-S优于自适应归一化基线，在视觉基准上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 将归一化选择与优化噪声解耦是Transformer自适应归一化的实用原则。

papers.title: Sharp Concentration Bounds for Bundle-Valued Statistics on Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: Many geometric statistics and manifold learning pipelines routinely produce observations -- such as tangent vectors or local frames -- whose natural home is a varying family of fibers attached to different points of a base manifold, rather than a single shared vector space. Forming empirical averages requires transporting these observations to a common reference fiber, thereby introducing curvature- and holonomy-driven effects that are absent from classical concentration theory. We develop a non-asymptotic concentration theory for such transported empirical means, deriving finite-sample, dimension-free Hoeffding- and Bernstein-type bounds via sharp Hilbert-space inequalities. When shortest paths to the reference point are non-unique, transport becomes path-dependent and introduces a deterministic holonomy bias; we isolate and quantify this bias through bundle curvature and loop geometry, with sharp closed-form formulas for the tangent bundle of a round sphere. The resulting bias-variance decomposition separates the stochastic fluctuation decaying at the classical $n^{-1/2}$ rate in sample size $n$, from a curvature-driven error floor that no amount of additional data can eliminate; minimax lower bounds confirm both terms are unavoidable. We further establish a robust median-of-means estimator achieving optimal rates under heavy tails and the central limit theorem in the reference fiber. Controlled experiments on the sphere validate all theoretical predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究流形上束值统计量的非渐近集中界，针对通过平行移动将观测值传输到参考纤维后的经验均值，得到了有限样本、维数无关的Hoeffding和Bernstein界，并量化了曲率导致的偏差和方差分解。
Motivation: 流形学习中许多统计量（如切向量）自然位于基流形不同点的纤维中，取均值需要传输，但经典集中理论未考虑曲率和和乐效应。
Method: 利用Hilbert空间不等式推导非渐近集中界，分离出随机波动和曲率驱动的误差界，并提出稳健的中位数均值估计器和中心极限定理。
Result: 得到偏差-方差分解，随机波动以n^{-1/2}衰减，但曲率误差不可消除；在球面上有闭合形式公式；minimax下界确认两项不可避免。
Conclusion: 发展了流形上传输经验均值的集中理论，揭示了曲率引入的固有偏差，并给出了最优估计方法。

papers.title: Approximation of Analytic Functions by ReLU Neural Networks with Adjustable Depth and Width
papers.abstract_en: In contrast to most studies on neural network approximation theory that characterize results through a single parameter, such as the total number of network parameters, \cite{shen2020deep} pioneered the characterization of approximation rates as a joint function of the width parameter $N$ and the depth parameter $L$, thereby granting greater architectural flexibility. Existing works using the $(N,L)$-characterization focus on function classes with finite smoothness $s$, establishing a typical approximation rate of $\mathcal{O}\left(N^{-2s/d}L^{-2s/d}\right)$ with $d$ denoting the input dimension, which indicates that network depth and width play symmetric roles for these classes. In contrast, this paper establishes upper bounds for the approximation of analytic functions, which possess infinite smoothness, via ReLU networks under the $(N,L)$-characterization. Specifically, we derive approximation rates of $\mathcal{O}\left(N^{-C L^τ}\right)$, where $C>0$ is some constant and $τ>0$ is a parameter influenced by the relation between $L$ and $N$. In particular, $τ=1$ if $N$ scales roughly as $L^d$. Our findings reveal that depth plays a more critical role than width in the context of analytic function approximation. The main technical difficulty of obtaining such upper bounds lies in the trade-off between the smoothness parameters and the approximation accuracy. To overcome this difficulty, we employ refined constructions of several ReLU networks to approximate power functions, multivariate multiplication, and polynomials, which may be of independent interest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对解析函数（无限光滑函数）的ReLU神经网络逼近问题，采用(N,L)双参数刻画逼近率，得到上界O(N^{-C L^τ})，其中C>0为常数，τ>0受L与N关系影响（当N~L^d时τ=1）。结果表明深度比宽度在解析函数逼近中作用更关键。技术上通过精细构造ReLU网络逼近幂函数、多元乘法及多项式，克服光滑参数与逼近精度间的权衡。
Motivation: 现有工作对有限光滑函数类给出了深度与宽度对称的逼近率，但对具有无限光滑性的解析函数，深度与宽度的相对重要性尚不明确，本文旨在揭示其非对称性。
Method: 提出基于ReLU网络的精细构造方法，分别用于逼近幂函数、多元乘法及多项式，进而建立解析函数的(N,L)双参数逼近上界，通过调整网络深度与宽度的关系导出形如O(N^{-C L^τ})的速率。
Result: 得到逼近率O(N^{-C L^τ})，其中τ>0依赖于L与N的比例关系；特别地，当N~L^d时τ=1，表明深度指数级提升逼近精度。
Conclusion: 对于解析函数，深度在逼近中比宽度更具决定性作用，与有限光滑函数类中对称角色的结论形成对比。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Constraint-Aware Hierarchical Search for Regulation-Driven Fine-Grained Classification
papers.abstract_en: Tasks such as customs tariff classification, export control categorization, and standards-based equipment coding require assigning an input instance to a fine-grained class under an explicit regulatory hierarchy. Unlike standard text classification, the correct label in these tasks is not determined by semantic similarity alone, but by rule-defined boundaries, threshold conditions, exclusion clauses, definitions, and local exceptions. As a result, two highly similar inputs may require different labels, while a retrieved passage that appears relevant may still be inapplicable under the governing rules. Existing flat classifiers, hierarchical text classification methods, and retrieval-augmented LLM systems are not designed to jointly enforce hierarchical validity, rule consistency, and fine-grained boundary reasoning. In this paper, we formulate this setting as regulation-driven fine-grained hierarchical classification, where an external instance must be assigned to a fine-grained class through a valid path in a regulatory hierarchy and supported by auditable evidence. We construct four benchmark datasets from representative regulation-intensive scenarios and validate the annotations through an expert-in-the-loop process. We further propose a constraint-aware hierarchical search framework that converts regulatory documents into a searchable tree, retrieves only valid local candidate nodes, and uses structured regulatory fields with evidence snippets to guide each next-hop decision. Experiments show that our method achieves the best mean accuracy on all four datasets and provides interpretable decision paths, with the largest gains on cases involving fine-grained neighboring categories and rule-based boundary conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对法规驱动的细粒度分类任务，提出一种约束感知的分层搜索框架。该框架将法规文档构建为可搜索树，仅检索有效的局部候选节点，并利用结构化法规字段和证据片段引导决策。在四个基准数据集上，该方法取得了最佳平均准确率，并提供了可解释的决策路径。
Motivation: 现有方法如平分类器、分层文本分类和检索增强LLM无法同时保证分层有效性、规则一致性和细粒度边界推理，而法规驱动的分类任务需要严格遵循规则边界和局部例外。
Method: 提出约束感知分层搜索框架，将法规文档转化为搜索树，在每一步仅检索有效的候选节点，并使用结构化法规字段和证据片段来引导下一跳决策。
Result: 在四个法规密集型数据集上，该方法达到最佳平均准确率，特别是在细粒度相邻类别和基于规则的边界条件下提升最大。
Conclusion: 该方法能有效处理法规驱动的细粒度分类，提供可解释的决策路径，但未提及对非法规场景的泛化性。

papers.title: Benchmarking UAV-based Vehicle Re-Identification under Simulated Weather Conditions
papers.abstract_en: UAV-based vehicle re-identification (ReID) has emerged as a promising technique for traffic surveillance, urban monitoring, and public-safety applications thanks to the flexible viewpoints and wide-area coverage provided by unmanned aerial vehicles. However, despite recent progress on UAV-based vehicle ReID benchmarks, the robustness of existing methods under adverse weather remains insufficiently studied. This is important because weather degradation can significantly affect the fine-grained appearance cues required for reliable vehicle matching in aerial imagery, especially under small object scale, viewpoint variation, and complex backgrounds. In this paper, we present a controlled comparative study of three representative recent vehicle ReID methods, namely CLIP-ReID, MSINet, and AdaSP, on two UAV-based benchmarks, VRU and UAV-VeID. To ensure consistent robustness evaluation, we generate synthetic foggy and rainy variants of both datasets using an analytical weather-effect pipeline while preserving the original identities and data splits. All methods are then trained and evaluated under matched clean, foggy, and rainy conditions. Experimental results show that adverse weather consistently degrades retrieval performance across both datasets, with rain causing larger drops than fog in nearly all settings. Among the evaluated methods, AdaSP demonstrates the strongest robustness, achieving 93.0% and 88.5% mAP on VRU-Large, and 88.7% and 76.2% mAP on UAV-VeID-Test under foggy and rainy conditions, respectively. Overall, our findings show that simulated adverse weather substantially increases the difficulty of UAV-based vehicle ReID, reveals clear robustness differences among recent methods, and highlights the need for weather-aware model design and evaluation protocols in future aerial ReID research. The code is released at https://github.com/tranminhvu945/Benchmarking-ReID.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 International Conference on Multimedia Analysis and Pattern Recognition (MAPR 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过模拟雾天和雨天条件，系统评估了三种最新的车辆重识别方法（CLIP-ReID、MSINet、AdaSP）在两个无人机基准数据集（VRU、UAV-VeID）上的鲁棒性。实验表明，恶劣天气一致地降低了检索性能，其中降雨的影响大于雾天，而AdaSP在大多数设置下表现最佳，在VRU-Large上雾天和雨天分别达到93.0%和88.5% mAP。研究揭示了现有方法在天气鲁棒性上的显著差异，并强调了未来航空重识别研究需要考虑天气感知模型设计。
Motivation: 现有无人机车辆重识别研究主要关注标准条件，对恶劣天气下的鲁棒性缺乏系统评估，而天气退化会显著影响空中图像中的细粒度外观线索，尤其是目标尺度小、视角变化和复杂背景下。
Method: 使用分析性天气效应管道生成两个基准数据集的合成雾天和雨天变体（保持身份和划分不变），然后在匹配的干净、雾天和雨天条件下训练并评估三种代表性方法（CLIP-ReID、MSINet、AdaSP）。
Result: 恶劣天气一致降低所有方法的检索性能，雨天的性能下降大于雾天。AdaSP在雾天和雨天下分别达到VRU-Large上93.0%和88.5% mAP，UAV-VeID-Test上88.7%和76.2% mAP，表现出最强的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 模拟的恶劣天气显著增加了无人机车辆重识别的难度，不同方法间的鲁棒性差异明显，未来航空重识别研究需要采用天气感知的模型设计和评估协议。

papers.title: MemDecay: Region-Aware KV Cache Eviction for Efficient LLM Agent Inference
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents accumulate heterogeneous context, including system instructions, plans, user turns, retrieved documents, tool outputs, and intermediate reasoning, whose key-value (KV) cache can become a major memory bottleneck. Existing eviction policies generally apply the same attention- or recency-based rule to every token, ignoring semantic structure already available to the agent orchestrator. We introduce MemDecay, a training-free, region-aware KV-cache eviction policy. MemDecay assigns tokens region-specific base priorities and decay rates, refreshes retention scores when tokens receive attention, and evicts the lowest-scoring pages under a fixed cache budget while allowing critical regions to be pinned. We also provide a procedure for calibrating decay rates from measured attention lifetimes. We evaluate MemDecay at approximately 450 and 1,700 token contexts using Qwen2.5-1.5B and 3B. Across all settings, attention lifetimes differ by an order of magnitude across regions: system-token half-lives range from 148 to 189 decoding steps, compared with 14 to 16 for scratchpad tokens. Pinning preserves system-region facts at full-cache accuracy in every setting, while no baseline preserves more than 13 of 24. Region-aware retention remains effective as context grows, whereas recency-based retention collapses. Accumulated-attention retention performs better on unpinned content, however, and ablations identify attention-score normalization as the main limitation of the current formulation. These results establish semantic prompt structure as a robust signal for KV-cache management while clarifying how it should be combined with attention-based importance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM agent 推理中 KV 缓存的内存瓶颈，提出 MemDecay，一种无需训练的区域感知缓存驱逐策略。该策略根据 token 在提示中的语义区域（如系统指令、中间推理等）分配不同的基础优先级和衰减率，并允许固定关键区域。实验在 Qwen2.5-1.5B 和 3B 模型上，约 450 和 1700 token 上下文中进行，发现系统 token 的注意力半衰期（148–189 步）比 scratchpad token（14–16 步）长一个数量级；固定系统区域可在满缓存精度下保持事实，而基线最多仅保持 13/24。结果证明语义提示结构是 KV 缓存管理的稳健信号。
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 中，KV 缓存随着异构上下文（系统指令、用户轮次、检索文档、工具输出、中间推理等）的积累成为主要内存瓶颈，而现有逐出策略通常对所有 token 应用相同的基于注意力或最近使用的规则，忽略了 agent 编排器已经知晓的语义结构。
Method: MemDecay 是一种无需训练的区域感知 KV 缓存逐出策略。它为每个 token 分配区域特定的基础优先级和衰减率，当 token 被注意时刷新其保留分数，并在固定缓存预算下驱逐得分最低的页面，同时允许关键区域被固定。还提供了从测量的注意力寿命中校准衰减率的过程。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-1.5B 和 3B 模型上，约 450 和 1700 token 上下文中，系统 token 的注意力半衰期为 148–189 步，而 scratchpad token 为 14–16 步。固定系统区域在所有设置下都能以完整缓存精度保持事实，而基线最多保持 13/24。区域感知保留在上下文增长时仍然有效，而基于最近使用的保留则失效。积累注意力保留在未固定内容上表现更好，消融实验表明注意力分数归一化是当前公式的主要限制。
Conclusion: 语义提示结构是 KV 缓存管理的稳健信号，但需要与基于注意力的重要性相结合；注意力分数归一化是当前方法的局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DiffUE: Enhancing Utility-Unlearnability Trade-off of Unlearnable Examples via Diffusion Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: AI models are increasingly trained on personal images scraped from social media and public platforms, often without consent, leading to serious privacy violations, such as unauthorized facial recognition and targeted advertising. To counter this, researchers have developed unlearnable examples (UEs), images modified with imperceptible noise to prevent AI models from extracting meaningful information. However, existing UE methods primarily rely on pixel-space noise, which can be bypassed by relearning strategies such as adversarial training, image transformation, and compression. While some techniques improve robustness, they often come at the expense of significant degradation in image utility and perceptual quality. In this paper, we introduce DiffUE to overcome these limitations by injecting noise into the semantic space of images instead of the pixel space. Instead of corrupting pixel values, DiffUE modifies high-level semantic features of images, ensuring robust unlearnability while preserving visual quality and utility. By leveraging a diffusion-based autoencoder framework to manipulate semantic features, DiffUE generates purposeful, natural-looking modifications that effectively resist advanced relearning strategies. Extensive experiments on four datasets, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, CelebA-HQ, and ImageNet, as well as a subjective user study, demonstrate that DiffUE significantly enhances the trade-off between image quality and unlearnability, offering a more robust and effective solution for safeguarding personal data in an increasingly exploitative AI landscape.
papers.comment: To appear at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DiffUE方法，通过在语义空间中注入噪声（而非像素空间）生成不可学习示例（UEs），以抵抗重学习策略。利用扩散自编码器修改图像的高层语义特征，在保持视觉质量的同时实现鲁棒不可学习性。在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、CelebA-HQ和ImageNet上的实验以及主观用户研究显示，该方法有效改善了图像质量与不可学习性之间的权衡。
Motivation: 现有不可学习示例主要依赖像素空间噪声，易被对抗训练、图像变换和压缩等重学习策略绕过，且部分增强鲁棒性的方法会严重降低图像效用和感知质量。需要一种在保持图像质量的同时提供鲁棒不可学习性的方法。
Method: DiffUE利用基于扩散的自编码器框架，将噪声注入图像的语义空间而非像素空间，修改高层语义特征，生成自然且具有针对性的修改，从而抵抗先进的重学习策略。
Result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、CelebA-HQ和ImageNet上的实验及主观用户研究表明，DiffUE显著提升了图像质量与不可学习性之间的权衡，比现有方法更鲁棒有效。
Conclusion: DiffUE通过语义级噪声注入实现了更好的效用与不可学习性权衡，为保护个人数据提供了一种更鲁棒的解决方案。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、CelebA-HQ和ImageNet上的实验及主观用户研究表明，DiffUE显著提升了图像质量与不可学习性之间的权衡，比现有方法更鲁棒有效。
summary_sections.conclusion: DiffUE通过语义级噪声注入实现了更好的效用与不可学习性权衡，为保护个人数据提供了一种更鲁棒的解决方案。

papers.title: Laguerre Geometry for Interpreting Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Existing hypotheses represent a concept in an LLM as a single point, a linear direction, or a Gaussian cluster, yet it remains unclear how and why such structures emerge. Here, we show that concept geometry can be precisely characterized via Laguerre Geometry, in which a concept is defined as a region--a Laguerre-Voronoi cell or a union of cells--allowing us to strictly define, measure, and separate concepts. Building on this formulation, we show that finer-grained concept structures, such as inclusion and hierarchy, are naturally revealed by the Laguerre weights. We then push this geometry inside the transformer. Decomposing each layer into piecewise-linear operators, we show that a token's hidden trajectory is governed by two coupled mechanisms: a static tree of self-contained piecewise-linear flow, and a dynamic transport that hops the trajectory across trees when cross-token attention fires. This decomposition yields Geometric Lens, a training-free, hyperparameter-free method for reading out the exact concept a hidden vector encodes at any layer. We also develop Laguerre Autoencoder, a 2D visualizer that renders both the decision geometry and a model's full reasoning trajectory in one view. Finally, we move beyond explanatory geometry toward actionable interpretability, showing that Geometric Lens recovers the correct factual token when a model is prompted with in-context interference. The code is available on GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用拉盖尔几何（Laguerre Geometry）精确描述大语言模型中的概念几何，将概念定义为拉盖尔-沃罗诺伊单元（Laguerre-Voronoi cells）或单元并集，从而严格定义、测量和分离概念。在此基础上，展示了更细粒度的概念结构（如包含、层次）自然由拉盖尔权重揭示。进一步将几何推入Transformer内部，将每层分解为分段线性算子，揭示token隐藏轨迹由静态分段线性流树和动态跨树传输两种耦合机制控制。由此提出Geometric Lens，一种无需训练、无需超参数的方法，可从任意层的隐藏向量中直接读出其编码的确切概念。还开发了拉盖尔自编码器（Laguerre Autoencoder），一种二维可视化工具，在同一视图中呈现决策几何和模型完整推理轨迹。最后，展示了Geometric Lens在上下文干扰提示下能恢复正确的事实token。
Motivation: 现有假设将LLM中的概念表示为单个点、线性方向或高斯簇，但尚不清楚这些结构如何形成以及为何如此。
Method: 采用拉盖尔几何将概念定义为区域（拉盖尔-沃罗诺伊单元或单元并集），并分解Transformer每层为分段线性算子，发现token轨迹由静态分段线性流树和动态跨树传输（交叉注意力触发）耦合。基于此提出Geometric Lens，一种训练免费、超参数免费的方法，可直接读取隐藏向量编码的概念。
Result: Geometric Lens能恢复上下文干扰提示下的正确事实token；拉盖尔自编码器可可视化决策几何和推理轨迹。
Conclusion: 该工作从解释性几何走向可操作的可解释性，但未提及在多大范围或数据集上验证，且应用限于事实恢复和可视化。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Why Domain Matters: Domain-Aware Benchmarking of Underwater Object Detection and Annotation Quality
papers.abstract_en: Underwater object detection is strongly affected by domain shift, where performance can vary significantly across different locations, habitats, and deployment conditions. However, detector performance is typically evaluated using aggregate metrics that hide failures in specific environments, while existing domain generalization benchmarks often rely on synthetic variations that do not reflect real-world conditions. We introduce a framework that characterizes underwater images by appearance, scene composition, and acquisition geometry to assign domain labels. Using this framework, we perform the first systematic study of how domain factors influence both human annotation quality in underwater object detection datasets and deep learning-based detector performance, revealing substantial domain-dependent discrepancies. By incorporating physically meaningful domain labels, domain shift becomes something we can characterize, measure, benchmark, and act on. We highlight how this can be used to guide data collection and annotation, design more informative benchmarks, and assess detector robustness across diverse underwater environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对水下目标检测中的域偏移问题，提出一种域感知基准测试框架。该框架通过外观、场景组成和采集几何特征为水下图像分配域标签，并首次系统研究了域因素对人类标注质量和深度学习检测器性能的影响，揭示了显著的域依赖差异。
Motivation: 现有评估使用聚合指标掩盖特定环境下的失败，且域泛化基准多依赖不反映真实世界的合成变化，导致对水下域偏移缺乏系统理解和可操作的基准。
Method: 提出一个框架，利用外观、场景组成和采集几何三个维度对水下图像进行域标签分配，并基于此框架进行跨域标注质量和检测性能的系统性研究。
Result: 实验表明，域因素导致人类标注质量和检测器性能均出现显著差异，说明域偏移是可量化、可测量的。
Conclusion: 引入物理有意义的域标签使域偏移变得可表征、可基准，可用于指导数据收集、设计更具信息量的基准以及评估检测器在不同水下环境中的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning from Local Walks on Dynamic Graphs with Bandit Feedback
papers.abstract_en: We study stochastic multi-armed bandits on dynamic graphs, where arms correspond to the vertices of a network with time-varying edges. In this setting, the learner is restricted to local movement, selecting only its current node or an immediate neighbor at each round. This constraint decouples best-arm identification from exploitation: even after the optimal arm is identified, the learner may remain unable to reach it through the evolving topology. We identify a process-agnostic structural condition, based on sliding-window mixing, that ensures the graph's intrinsic walk remains stable for both exploration and navigation. Under this regime, we analyze a family of local explore-then-commit algorithms and establish sublinear expected regret. Our framework includes a reward-aware strategy, for which we prove a worst-case safety theorem and a separate performance gain theorem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究动态图上基于局部移动的随机多臂赌博机问题，其中学习者每一步只能选择当前节点或邻居节点。作者引入基于滑动窗口混合的渐进无关结构条件，保证图的内在行走在探索和导航中保持稳定。在此条件下，分析了一类局部探索后提交算法，并证明了亚线性遗憾界。还提出了一个奖励感知策略，并证明了最坏情况安全定理和性能增益定理。
Motivation: 现有图赌博机工作通常假设学习者可以在任意节点间切换，忽略了实际场景中移动受限的情况。本文针对动态图中局部移动约束下的最佳臂识别与利用困难问题，旨在提供理论保证的算法。
Method: 提出一种基于滑动窗口混合的结构条件，确保动态图行走的稳定性；设计局部探索后提交算法族，包括奖励感知策略，并分析其遗憾界。
Result: 在滑动窗口混合条件下，证明了所提算法的亚线性期望遗憾；奖励感知策略具有最坏情况安全定理和性能增益定理。
Conclusion: 动态图上局部移动的赌博机问题可以通过合适的结构条件实现可解的遗憾界，未来工作可扩展至更复杂的图变化模式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Does Restricting a Coding Agent to execute_code Help? A Regime $\times$ Agent-Design Ablation
papers.abstract_en: Modern coding agents expose multiple tool surfaces -- IDE primitives, bash, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) code-execution -- and the field has shipped three contradictory claims about which one matters. We run the missing crossed comparison: an integrity-clean three-arm ablation (baseline / bash_only / code_only) on synthetic computation tasks and SWE-bench Mini modification tasks, holding model, harness, and prompts fixed, with two agents (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI) so the comparison spans both regime and agent-design axes. Across the four resulting (regime, agent) cells, restricting the agent to a single execute_code MCP tool is cheaper than -- or statistically tied with -- its cheapest tool-rich rival in three cells (significantly on Artifact/Claude and SWE-bench/Codex; directionally on Artifact/Codex), with pass rates statistically tied within each cell. The lone exception is SWE-bench/Claude, where code_only is directionally costlier (+14.4%, not significant); a conditional-cost analysis localizes that gap to failure-cost on doomed-run trajectories, not a per-edit tax on successful runs. Two implications: the cheapest tool surface is jointly determined by task regime and agent design rather than by either axis alone, and the headline cost signal lives in cache-adjusted cost -- not pass rate, which is invariant across surfaces at the model sizes we evaluate. The benchmark harness, task suite, and analysis code are available at https://github.com/hyang0129/onlycodes.
papers.comment: 9 pages (excluding references), 4 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to the Agentic Software Engineering (SE 3.0) Workshop at KDD 2026 (non-archival)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对编码代理的三种工具表面（基线、仅bash、仅代码执行）进行了跨两个代理（Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI）和两个任务场景（合成计算任务、SWE-bench Mini修改任务）的烧蚀研究。结果显示，在四个（场景，代理）组合中的三个中，限制代理仅使用代码执行MCP工具比其最便宜的多工具配置更便宜或统计上相当，且通过率统计上无差异；唯一的例外是SWE-bench/Claude组合，其中仅代码方向性更贵（+14.4%，不显著）。
Motivation: 现代编码代理暴露多种工具表面，但文献中关于哪种工具表面最重要的说法相互矛盾。
Method: 在固定模型、测试平台和提示的条件下，对两个代理执行三臂烧蚀（基线、仅bash、仅代码），包括合成计算任务和SWE-bench Mini修改任务。
Result: 四个（场景，代理）组合中，三个组合中仅代码执行比多工具更便宜或统计上相当，且通过率统计上无差异；SWE-bench/Claude组合中仅代码方向性更贵但未显著。成本信号主要来自缓存调整成本，而非通过率。
Conclusion: 最便宜的工具表面由任务场景和代理设计共同决定，而非单一轴；成本信号在缓存调整成本中，通过率在评估的模型规模下跨工具表面不变。

papers.title: Quantum Compressed Sensing CT Reconstruction Algorithm Based on Penalized Weighted Least Squares and Guided Total Variation
papers.abstract_en: Objective. Existing quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO)-based sparse-view computed tomography (CT) reconstruction neglects photon-counting statistics and anatomical heterogeneity. We address both limitations within the QUBO framework.Approach. We propose a quantum compressed-sensing CT method combining penalized weighted least squares (PWLS) and guided total variation (GTV). PWLS weights projection residuals by photon-count reliability, whereas GTV uses gradients from a prior image reconstructed by the simultaneous algebraic reconstruction technique (SART) to preserve edges and suppress noise in homogeneous regions. After binary encoding, both terms form a unified QUBO model. Experiments used four 40 times 40 CT images under a 10-view fan-beam geometry with Poisson noise. Comparisons included conventional reconstruction methods, QUBO variants, gradient descent, simulated annealing, and a D-Wave hybrid quantum-classical solver.Main results. PWLS-GTV achieved the best reconstruction quality across all cases. In the representative chest case, it reached a peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 36.64 dB, compared with 22.48 dB for SART, the best conventional baseline. GTV consistently outperformed conventional total variation. Simulated annealing and the D-Wave hybrid solver produced similar reconstructions, whereas gradient descent was ineffective. Repeated hybrid-solver runs showed stable performance.Significance. The framework incorporates photon-statistical weighting and structure-guided regularization into QUBO-based CT reconstruction without changing its quadratic form, providing a proof of concept for quantum-assisted sparse-view CT reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于惩罚加权最小二乘（PWLS）和引导全变分（GTV）的量子压缩感知CT重建算法，将光子计数统计与解剖异质性纳入QUBO框架。在10视角扇形束几何下，对4张40×40的CT图像进行实验，PWLS-GTV在胸片案例中达到36.64 dB的PSNR，优于SART的22.48 dB。模拟退火与D-Wave混合求解器结果相似，梯度下降无效。
Motivation: 现有基于QUBO的稀疏CT重建忽略了光子计数统计和解剖异质性，导致重建质量受限。本文旨在QUBO框架内同时解决这两个问题。
Method: 将惩罚加权最小二乘（PWLS）与引导全变分（GTV）结合：PWLS根据光子计数可靠性加权投影残差，GTV利用先验图像梯度保持边缘并抑制均匀区域噪声。经二进制编码后形成统一QUBO模型，使用模拟退火、梯度下降和D-Wave混合求解器求解。
Result: PWLS-GTV在所有测试案例中重建质量最优；胸片案例PSNR达36.64 dB，而最佳传统基线SART仅22.48 dB。GTV始终优于传统全变分。D-Wave混合求解器与模拟退火结果相近，重复运行稳定。
Conclusion: 该框架在不改变QUBO二次型的前提下，将光子统计加权和结构引导正则化纳入CT重建，为量子辅助稀疏CT重建提供了概念验证。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: PWLS-GTV在所有测试案例中重建质量最优；胸片案例PSNR达36.64 dB，而最佳传统基线SART仅22.48 dB。GTV始终优于传统全变分。D-Wave混合求解器与模拟退火结果相近，重复运行稳定。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架在不改变QUBO二次型的前提下，将光子统计加权和结构引导正则化纳入CT重建，为量子辅助稀疏CT重建提供了概念验证。

papers.title: BucketKD: A Safety-Aware Bucket-Based Knowledge Distillation Framework for End-to-End Motion Planning
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end motion planning has emerged as a promising paradigm in autonomous driving, directly mapping raw sensor data to control commands via deep neural networks. Despite its advantages, its large model size hinders deployment in resource-constrained platforms. In this paper, we present BucketKD, a bucket-based knowledge distillation framework that yields compact and safety-aware end-to-end planners. Compared to the state-of-the-art approach, which relies on simplified planning state representations, BucketKD discretizes critical environmental variables into adaptive buckets that capture richer scene semantics while preserving efficiency. In addition, we design a safety-aware waypoint attention mechanism that evaluates each waypoint's risk level by accounting for both obstacle proximity and relative motion through a time-to-collision (TTC) formulation widely used in transportation research. This enables the student model to better retain safety-critical behaviors during distillation. Extensive experiments in CARLA using the Bench2Drive dataset show that BucketKD significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art in both planning accuracy and safety while maintaining strong compression ratios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BucketKD，一种基于桶（bucket）的、安全感知的知识蒸馏框架，用于端到端运动规划。与使用简化规划状态表示的最先进方法相比，BucketKD 将关键环境变量离散化为自适应桶，以捕获更丰富的场景语义，同时保持效率。此外，设计了一个安全感知的路点注意力机制，通过考虑障碍物接近度和相对运动（使用时间到碰撞公式）来评估每个路点的风险水平。在 CARLA 模拟器上使用 Bench2Drive 数据集的实验表明，BucketKD 在规划精度和安全性方面显著优于最先进方法，同时保持强压缩比。
Motivation: 端到端运动规划模型尺寸大，难以部署在资源受限平台上；现有知识蒸馏方法依赖于简化的规划状态表示，可能丢失重要场景语义和安全关键行为。
Method: 提出 BucketKD 框架，将环境变量离散化为自适应桶以丰富语义表示，并设计安全感知的路点注意力机制（基于 TTC）来保留安全关键行为，从而在知识蒸馏中提升学生模型的安全性和精度。
Result: 在 CARLA 模拟器上使用 Bench2Drive 数据集，BucketKD 在规划精度和安全性上显著优于最先进方法，同时保持强压缩比。
Conclusion: BucketKD 通过离散化环境变量和引入安全注意力机制，实现了安全高效的紧凑型端到端运动规划器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CRiT-QA: Evaluating Multi-hop Reasoning with Counterfactual Chains and Distractor Traps
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating the multi-hop reasoning capabilities of large language models remains a significant challenge. Although current models achieve strong results on existing multi-hop question answering datasets, such performance often masks two critical vulnerabilities: (1) reliance on internal parametric knowledge rather than adherence to the provided context, and (2) exploitation of dataset shortcuts, such as single-document cues or type-matching, that diminish the need for genuine evidence aggregation across multiple documents. We introduce CRiT-QA (Counterfactual Reasoning with Traps), a dataset explicitly designed to address both limitations. To neutralize reliance on memorized knowledge and enforce strict context dependency, CRiT-QA transforms factual reasoning chains with counterfactual entities. Furthermore, it injects multi-anchor distractor chains, plausible but incorrect reasoning paths that diverge at different hops. These traps require models to follow the entire reasoning process rather than exploiting shallow heuristics. Our experiments show that LLMs exhibit substantial performance degradation on CRiT-QA compared to standard datasets, exposing their vulnerability to counterfactual conditions and distractor traps. CRiT-QA thus serves as a rigorous diagnostic tool for evaluating genuine multi-hop reasoning and provides a foundation for developing more reliable, evidence-grounded LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CRiT-QA数据集，通过反事实实体和多锚点干扰链评估大语言模型的多跳推理能力，揭示模型对参数知识和数据集捷径的依赖。实验表明模型在该数据集上性能显著下降。
Motivation: 现有多跳问答数据集无法检测模型是否真正基于上下文推理，模型可能依赖内部知识或利用数据集捷径，如单文档线索或类型匹配。
Method: 构建包含反事实实体（替换事实实体）和多锚点干扰链（看似合理但错误的推理路径）的问答数据集，强制模型严格依据上下文完成完整推理。
Result: 实验显示LLMs在CRiT-QA上性能显著下降，暴露了它们在反事实条件和干扰陷阱下的脆弱性。
Conclusion: CRiT-QA可作为严格的诊断工具，用于评估真正的多跳推理能力，并促进更可靠、基于证据的LLM开发。
