papers.title: PoseAlign: Sculpting Pose-Consistent Meshes via Text-Guided Deformation
papers.abstract_en: Mesh deformation, the process of altering the vertex positions of a 3D mesh while preserving its topological structure, is a cornerstone of computer graphics. Despite the recent emergence of numerous text-guided 3D mesh deformation methods, deforming an initial mesh into one that both adheres to text prompts and preserves its pose remains challenging. This paper proposes PoseAlign, which decomposes text-guided mesh deformation into two stages: global pose scaling and local detail sculpting. Specifically, in the first stage, we introduce the Laplacian as a differentiable mesh representation to enable more efficient yet smoother global deformation. Then, we propose a novel pose-aligned SDS loss by adapting score distillation sampling (SDS) with an attention-sharing mechanism, which sculptures fine-grained geometric details for the deformed mesh while preserving its original pose. PoseAlign significantly enhances the controllability of the overall deformation process, achieving a favorable balance between pose preservation and text alignment. Experiments demonstrate the competitive advantages of our method in text alignment and mesh quality. Code is available at: https://cousingrade6.github.io/PoseAlign
papers.comment: CGI 2026 Best Paper Award. Project page: https://cousingrade6.github.io/PoseAlign
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PoseAlign，将文本引导的网格变形分解为全局姿态缩放和局部细节雕刻两阶段。第一阶段引入Laplacian作为可微网格表示实现高效平滑的全局变形；第二阶段提出姿态对齐的SDS损失，通过注意力共享机制在保持原始姿态的同时雕刻细节。实验表明该方法在文本对齐和网格质量上具有竞争优势。
Motivation: 现有文本引导的网格变形方法难以同时满足文本提示和保持原始姿态，导致变形结果常偏离初始姿态。
Method: 两阶段变形：第一阶段使用Laplacian作为可微表示进行全局姿态缩放；第二阶段采用改进的SDS损失（姿态对齐SDS），引入注意力共享机制以在局部细节雕刻中保持原始姿态。
Result: 实验验证了该方法在文本对齐和网格质量上的优势，并在姿态保持与文本一致性之间取得了更好平衡。
Conclusion: PoseAlign通过分解变形阶段和共享注意力机制，提升了变形过程的可控性，实现了姿态保持与文本引导的有效权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Large language model agents accelerate inverse design of metal-organic frameworks for gas separation
papers.abstract_en: Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) offer a highly modular platform for adsorptive gas separation, yet their vast reticular design space makes inverse design difficult under simultaneous constraints of chemical validity, separation performance, and structural diversity. Here, we present LEMO Agent, a large-language-model agent framework for closed-loop inverse design of gas-separation MOFs in MOFid space. LEMO Agent couples language-based candidate generation with MOFid standardization, explicit validity checking, Transformer-based property prediction, structured design memory, and multi-island exploration. Through iterative generate--validate--evaluate--remember cycles, the agent uses feedback from both successful and failed candidates to guide chemically constrained search across linker, metal, and topology choices. We evaluate LEMO Agent on CH$_4$/N$_2$ and CO$_2$/N$_2$ separation tasks. Compared with representative generative, optimization, and agentic baselines, LEMO Agent enriches high-performing candidates, improves predicted separation performance, and maintains broad chemical and topological diversity. Selected candidates are further reconstructed, evaluated by GCMC simulations, and passed through an experimental down-selection workflow based on chemical feasibility and ligand purchasability, leading to initial wet-lab synthesis and SEM characterization. These results demonstrate that large language model agents can serve as interpretable and scalable design engines for accelerating MOF discovery beyond conventional fixed-library screening.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 LEMO Agent，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体框架，用于金属有机框架（MOF）的逆向设计。该框架在 MOFid 空间中通过迭代生成、验证、评估和记忆循环，结合 Transformer 性能预测和多岛探索，优化气体分离性能。在 CH₄/N₂ 和 CO₂/N₂ 分离任务上，LEMO Agent 相比多种基线方法富集了高性能候选，提升了预测分离性能，并保持了化学和拓扑多样性。候选结构进一步通过 GCMC 模拟和实验验证，完成了从设计到合成的全流程。
Motivation: MOF 具有高度模块化的结构，但其庞大的网状设计空间使得在化学有效性、分离性能和结构多样性等多重约束下进行逆向设计极为困难。现有固定库筛选方法效率有限，亟需可解释且可扩展的智能设计引擎。
Method: 提出 LEMO Agent 框架，将 LLM 与 MOFid 标准化、显式有效性检查、Transformer 性能预测、结构化设计记忆和多岛探索相结合。系统通过语言生成候选→MOFid 标准化→有效性验证→性能预测→记忆更新的闭环流程，利用成功和失败候选的反馈指导化学约束下的搜索（包括连接子、金属和拓扑选择）。
Result: 在 CH₄/N₂ 和 CO₂/N₂ 分离任务上，LEMO Agent 相比生成式、优化式和智能体基线方法，更有效地富集了高性能候选，提高了预测的分离性能，并保持了广泛的化学和拓扑多样性。选出的候选被重建并经过 GCMC 模拟评估，随后通过基于化学可行性和配体可购性的实验筛选流程，成功进行了湿法合成和 SEM 表征。
Conclusion: 实验结果表明，大语言模型智能体可以作为可解释且可扩展的设计引擎，加速 MOF 的发现，超越了传统固定库筛选方法的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tool-Adaptive LLM Reranker
papers.abstract_en: Generative Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized information retrieval, yet their strictly parametric nature frequently leads to severe factual hallucinations when confronted with complex queries beyond their epistemic boundaries. While external tool-calling can mitigate this, indiscriminately invoking search tools for every document during reranking incurs prohibitive latency overheads, creating an intractable accuracy-efficiency dilemma. To address this challenge, we propose TALRanker, a novel framework that formalizes pointwise relevance scoring as an agentic Markov decision process. We optimize it via a two-stage training paradigm. An initial warm-up utilizes a language-preserving hybrid loss to prevent the catastrophic forgetting of native generative capacities. Subsequently, an asymmetric cost-aware reward equipped in reinforcement learning forces the policy to autonomously bypass tools for maximum efficiency when confident, while selectively retrieving external evidence to avert severe hallucination penalties when uncertain. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that TALRanker achieves state-of-the-art performance across standard and reasoning-intensive retrieval benchmarks, matching throughput with pointwise rerankers while outperforming parameter-heavy reasoning models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TALRanker，将点级相关性评分形式化为马尔可夫决策过程，通过两阶段训练（混合损失预热 + 不对称成本感知强化学习）使 LLM 在重排序时自动决定是否调用外部工具，以平衡准确性与效率。实验表明，TALRanker 在标准与推理密集型检索基准上达到最先进性能，吞吐量与点级重排序器相当，优于参数繁重的推理模型。
Motivation: 生成式 LLM 在重排序时面临准确性-效率困境：完全依赖参数会导致幻觉，而对所有文档无差别调用外部工具则带来巨大延迟开销。
Method: 将点级相关性评分建模为智能体马尔可夫决策过程，采用两阶段训练：先用语言保持混合损失预热以防止灾难性遗忘，再通过不对称成本感知奖励的强化学习使策略在确信时绕过工具以最大化效率，在不确定时选择性检索外部证据以避免严重幻觉惩罚。
Result: 在标准与推理密集型检索基准上达到最先进性能，吞吐量与点级重排序器持平，且优于参数繁重的推理模型。
Conclusion: TALRanker 通过强化学习自适应工具调用，有效解决了 LLM 重排序中的准确性-效率困境。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Observation-Level Watermarking and Detection for Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: With the development of generative AI, watermarking techniques have been widely used to detect the authenticity of AI-generated data and protect the rights of users and creators. While it is already well applied in data types including imaging and text data, watermarking tabular data is still under-explored. Existing methods primarily focus on numerical data, leaving discrete, categorical, and mixed data less studied. In this work, we propose STAMP (Single-observation Tabular Attribution and Marking Procedure), a novel framework for watermarking tabular data that can accommodate and preserve a wide range of distributions. We also develop a corresponding detection mechanism, which can reliably identify watermarks even when the sample size is as small as one. We establish theoretical guarantees for asymptotic consistency and detection accuracy. Finally, through extensive simulation studies and two real-data applications, we demonstrate that the proposed method is effective and robust to subsetting, while maintaining data fidelity and a high detection rate.
papers.summary_zh:

Conclusion: 方法对表格数据的水印保护提供新思路，尤其适用于样本量极小（如单观测）场景，理论上有渐近一致性保证。

papers.title: Projection-Domain Sensitivity Analysis of Vertebral DRRs Under Intrinsic Calibration Perturbation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate geometric calibration is essential for fluoroscopy-guided spinal imaging, digitally reconstructed radiograph (DRR) generation, and 2D--3D vertebral registration. Although calibration quality is typically evaluated using reconstruction-based metrics such as reprojection error, its influence on projection-domain consistency remains poorly understood. This study presents a synthetic framework for evaluating how intrinsic calibration perturbations affect vertebral fluoroscopic projections and downstream registration performance. CT-derived vertebral models and controlled cone-beam imaging geometry were used to generate DRRs with both ground-truth and perturbed intrinsic calibration parameters while maintaining identical anatomy and acquisition pose. Projection-domain changes were quantified using anatomical landmark displacement, contour distance, silhouette overlap, image similarity, and landmark-based 2D--3D registration accuracy in anterior--posterior (AP) and lateral (LAT) views. Results show that even small intrinsic calibration perturbations produce measurable changes in vertebral projection geometry, contour morphology, landmark localization, and DRR appearance. Sensitivity is strongly view dependent, with LAT projections exhibiting substantially greater deformation and anatomical displacement than AP projections. These projection inconsistencies also degrade downstream 2D--3D registration, particularly rotational alignment accuracy. The findings demonstrate that projection-domain consistency complements conventional reconstruction-based calibration metrics and provides a practical framework for assessing calibration robustness. This approach may improve the reliability of DRR generation and fluoroscopy-guided vertebral registration in image-guided spinal applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个合成框架，系统评估内参校准扰动对脊椎 DRR 投影域一致性和下游 2D-3D 配准性能的影响。通过 CT 模型和锥束几何生成带扰动与真实的 DRR，量化了标志点位移、轮廓距离、重叠率、图像相似度及配准精度。结果表明，即使微小扰动也会显著改变投影几何和外观，且侧位视图比正位视图更敏感，进而影响配准的旋转精度。
Motivation: 传统重建指标（如重投影误差）难以反映校准误差对投影域一致性的影响，而这一影响对 2D-3D 配准等下游任务至关重要。
Method: 基于 CT 衍生椎体模型与受控锥束成像几何，在保持解剖和姿态不变的前提下生成具有真实与扰动内参的 DRR，并从多个投影域指标（几何位移、轮廓相似度、图像相似性、2D-3D 配准精度）进行敏感性分析。
Result: 极小内参扰动即引起可测量的投影几何变形、轮廓形态变化和标志点定位偏移；侧位视图的敏感性显著高于正位视图；下游 2D-3D 配准的旋转对准精度明显下降。
Conclusion: 投影域一致性可作为重建校准指标的有效补充，为评估校准鲁棒性提供了实用框架，有望提升脊柱图像引导应用中 DRR 生成和配准的可靠性。

papers.title: Beyond Looking Up, Try Looking Around: Harmonizing Global Structure and Local Consistency in Optimal Transport for Short Text Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Pseudo-labeling based on Optimal Transport (OT) has become an effective mechanism for enhancing short text clustering. Existing OT methods are short in modeling semantic consistencies between samples, which may assign different pseudo-labels to semantically similar samples. These erroneous pseudo-labels can cause the model to produce inferior clusters. This paper proposes a novel short text clustering framework, which remedies the neglect of semantic consistency in existing OT methods, generating reliable pseudo-labels to facilitate clustering. Specifically, the proposed approach first designs an instance-level attention mechanism to capture semantic relationships between samples, which are then integrated into the OT formulation to endow the transport process with neighborhood semantic awareness. By solving the proposed OT formulation, reliable pseudo-labels are obtained that simultaneously account for sample-to-sample semantic consistency and sample-to-cluster global structure information. These pseudo-labels are then used as supervisory signals to guide the model to achieve accurate clustering. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods. The code is available at: \href{https://github.com/YZH0905/CAOT-STC}{https://github.com/YZH0905/CAOT-STC}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于最优传输的短文本聚类框架，通过实例级注意力机制捕获样本间语义关系，并整合到最优传输中，生成兼顾局部语义一致性和全局结构信息的伪标签，从而提升聚类性能。实验表明该方法优于现有SOTA。
Motivation: 现有最优传输伪标签方法忽略样本间语义一致性，导致相似样本被赋予不同伪标签，影响聚类效果。
Method: 设计实例级注意力机制捕获样本间语义关系，并融入最优传输公式，使传输过程具有邻域语义感知能力，求解后得到同时考虑样本-样本语义一致性和样本-簇全局结构的伪标签。
Result: 在多个短文本聚类基准上超越现有最优方法。
Conclusion: 通过强化语义一致性可生成更可靠的伪标签，提升短文本聚类准确性。

papers.title: LLM-PDESR: Robust PDE Discovery via Subdomain Weighted Residuals and LLM-Guided Symbolic Hypothesis Generation
papers.abstract_en: Discovering governing partial differential equations (PDEs) from noisy observational data is a fundamental challenge in scientific machine learning. Traditional symbolic regression (SR) methods often struggle to identify accurate equations within vast combinatorial search spaces, largely due to their inability to incorporate essential domain-specific prior knowledge. Furthermore, reliance on pointwise evaluations and discrete finite differences inherently amplifies high-frequency noise, creating deceptive fitness landscapes that derail the optimization process. To resolve these bottlenecks, we propose LLM-PDESR, a framework that integrates the structural hypothesis generation of Large Language Models (LLMs) with a mathematically rigorous evaluation environment. By employing C^4-continuous quintic splines for robust differentiation and subdomain weighted residuals as natural low-pass filters, our approach effectively mitigates the fitness landscape distortion that plagues existing methods. A Pareto-driven feedback loop then enables the LLM to iteratively refine candidate equations, balancing predictive accuracy with structural parsimony. We evaluate LLM-PDESR on 23 canonical PDEs and five structurally novel equations (including a multivariate system) specifically designed to preclude dataset memorization and test true discovery capabilities. Demonstrating real-world applicability, the framework successfully extracts a consistent structural skeleton for an interpretable 1D dynamical surrogate (1D-CACE) directly from noisy ERA5 reanalysis data. Extensive experiments and out-of-distribution testing confirm that LLM-PDESR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methodologies in structural recovery, noise resilience, and the avoidance of spurious complexity and equation bloat.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LLM-PDESR 框架，结合大语言模型 (LLM) 的符号假设生成与基于子域加权残差 (subdomain weighted residuals) 的 PDE 发现方法，旨在从含噪观测数据中鲁棒地发现控制方程。通过使用 C4 连续五次样条进行稳健微分，并将子域加权残差作为低通滤波器，该方法缓解了传统符号回归中因有限差分放大噪声导致的适应性景观失真问题。在 23 个经典 PDE 和 5 个结构性新方程上的实验表明，LLM-PDESR 在结构恢复、噪声鲁棒性和避免假性复杂度方面显著优于现有方法，并成功从 ERA5 再分析数据中提取了可解释的一维动力学代理模型 (1D-CACE)。
Motivation: 传统符号回归方法在巨大组合搜索空间中难以发现准确 PDE，因其无法有效融入领域先验知识，且点评估和离散有限差分会放大高频噪声，导致虚假适应性景观，从而误导优化过程。
Method: 集成 LLM 进行符号假设生成，并使用 C4 连续五次样条进行鲁棒微分，以子域加权残差作为自然低通滤波器，通过帕累托驱动反馈循环迭代优化候选方程，平衡预测精度与结构简洁性。
Result: 在 23 个经典 PDE 和 5 个结构性新方程上，LLM-PDESR 在结构恢复、噪声鲁棒性和避免假性复杂度方面显著优于现有方法；从 ERA5 再分析数据中成功提取了 1D-CACE 的一致结构骨架。
Conclusion: LLM-PDESR 通过结合 LLM 假设生成与基于子域加权残差的稳健评估环境，有效解决了从噪声数据中发现 PDE 时的适应性景观失真和搜索空间膨胀问题，并展示了在真实数据上的适用性。
Relevance: 60

papers.title: Physics-inspired Pseudo Anomaly Generation and Prototype Feature Guidance for 3D Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: 3D point cloud anomaly detection plays a vital role in industrial manufacturing, yet it faces significant challenges due to the scarcity and high acquisition cost of real anomalous samples. The inherently anomaly-free training data further hinders detection methods from effectively learning discriminative features between normal and abnormal instances. To address these issues, we propose PA3AD, a novel framework that introduces a physics-inspired pseudo-anomaly generation strategy to create physically plausible anomalous samples from normal data. Additionally, we incorporate prototype features via a weight-sharing mechanism to guide the model in capturing the distribution shifts between normal and anomalous samples. Specifically, PA3AD introduces two key innovations to tackle the scarcity of real anomalies. First, a physics-inspired module generates diverse pseudo-anomalous point clouds from normal data via multi-physics modeling. Second, momentum-updated prototypes and a difference-aware fusion block capture stable normal representations and their discrepancies with pseudo-anomalies. This design effectively learns distribution shifts, achieving superior detection performance. Extensive experiments on the Anomaly-ShapeNet and Real3D-AD datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches. Our code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/NingxiaoJian/PA3AD.
papers.comment: 20 pages; already accepted by Pattern Recognition
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PA3AD框架，针对3D点云异常检测中真实异常样本稀缺的问题，引入物理启发的伪异常生成策略和原型特征引导机制。通过多物理场建模生成多样伪异常点云，结合动量更新原型和差异感知融合块学习分布偏移，在Anomaly-ShapeNet和Real3D-AD数据集上超越现有方法。

Method: 提出PA3AD框架，包含两个创新：物理启发模块通过多物理场建模从正常数据生成物理合理的伪异常点云；动量更新原型和差异感知融合块捕获稳定正常表示及其与伪异常的差异，学习分布偏移。
Result: 在Anomaly-ShapeNet和Real3D-AD数据集上，该方法一致优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 物理启发的伪异常生成和原型特征引导可有效解决3D异常检测中样本稀缺问题，提升检测性能。

papers.title: RecRec: Recursive Refinement for Sequential Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Sequential recommender systems typically infer user preferences through single-pass encoding of interaction histories without iterative refinement, relying on increasingly deep architectures to capture complex patterns. In this work, we revisit sequential recommendation from a recursive inference perspective: can user preferences be modeled as a persistent latent state that is recursively refined? We propose RecRec (Recursive Recommendation), a lightweight model that maintains a compact latent state and updates it through a shared recursive module conditioned on interaction evidence. Unlike prior recursive models, RecRec introduces an evidence-anchored correction mechanism that stabilizes refinement by grounding each update in the original interaction context, preventing semantic drift during deep recursive reasoning. Experiments on three benchmark datasets under standard evaluation protocols show that RecRec matches or outperforms state-of-the-art sequential, graph-based, and reasoning-enhanced recommenders while using only 3.9M to 14M parameters. Ablation studies demonstrate that both recursive refinement and the evidence-anchored correction gate contribute significantly to performance, highlighting the effectiveness of recursive latent inference as a scalable alternative to deeper or language-based architectures. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RecRec-6B67/README.md.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RecRec，一种轻量级递归推理模型，为序列推荐维护一个可递归精化的隐状态。通过证据锚定校正机制（evidence-anchored correction）防止语义漂移，在三个基准数据集上以 3.9M–14M 参数匹配或超越当前最先进的序列、图及推理增强推荐器。
Motivation: 现有序列推荐系统通常采用单遍编码交互历史，依赖深层架构捕捉复杂模式，缺乏迭代精化。本文探索能否将用户偏好建模为可递归精化的持久隐状态。
Method: 提出 RecRec 模型，维护紧凑隐状态，通过共享递归模块基于交互证据更新状态；引入证据锚定校正机制，将每次更新锚定到原始交互上下文，防止深度递归推理中的语义漂移。
Result: 在三个标准基准数据集上，RecRec 以 3.9M–14M 参数匹配或超越当前最先进的序列、图及推理增强推荐器。消融实验表明递归精化与证据锚定校正门均贡献显著。
Conclusion: 递归潜在推理可成为深层或基于语言架构的可扩展替代方案，但论文未讨论长序列或冷启动场景下的表现。

summary_sections.method: 提出 RecRec 模型，维护紧凑隐状态，通过共享递归模块基于交互证据更新状态；引入证据锚定校正机制，将每次更新锚定到原始交互上下文，防止深度递归推理中的语义漂移。
summary_sections.result: 在三个标准基准数据集上，RecRec 以 3.9M–14M 参数匹配或超越当前最先进的序列、图及推理增强推荐器。消融实验表明递归精化与证据锚定校正门均贡献显著。
summary_sections.conclusion: 递归潜在推理可成为深层或基于语言架构的可扩展替代方案，但论文未讨论长序列或冷启动场景下的表现。

papers.title: Representation Learning for Semiparametric Causal Mediation Analysis under No Essential Heterogeneity
papers.abstract_en: We propose a two-stage estimator for structural mediation parameters that combines deep representation learning with G-estimation under the "no essential heterogeneity" (NEH) assumption. We call the method UNIT. In the first stage,TARNet estimates the heterogeneous effect of a randomized treatment on a mediator by learning a shared covariate representation across treatment arms.The resulting conditional average treatment effect (CATE) estimate provides a plug-in approximation to the heterogeneity-dependent component of the weight function entering the G-estimating equation of Zheng and Zhou (2015), which identifies the structural parameters even in the presence of unmeasured mediator-outcome confounding. We show that more accurate first-stage representation learning can yield a more informative plug-in weight and thereby improve the precision of the structural parameter estimator. In simulations with non-Gaussian covariates and nonlinear mediator effects, TARNet weights reduce the Stage-2 standard error of the mediation coefficient by a factor of $1.45$ to $1.51$ (median across replications, $n \ge 2000$) relative to the classical approach, at no cost to bias or coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个名为 UNIT 的两阶段估计器，结合深度表示学习和 G-estimation，在无本质异质性假设下进行半参数因果中介分析。第一阶段用 TARNet 学习治疗组间共享协变量表示以估计异质性处理效应，第二阶段利用该估计作为 G-estimating 方程中的权重。模拟显示，相比经典方法，TARNet 权重可将中介系数的第二阶段标准误差降低约 1.45-1.51 倍。
Motivation: 现有因果中介分析方法在存在未测量的中介-结果混杂时，识别依赖于强假设。本文利用无本质异质性假设，结合表示学习提高估计效率。
Method: 提出 UNIT 方法：第一阶段使用 TARNet 估计条件平均处理效应 (CATE)，作为 G-estimation 方程的权重函数中的异质性成分的近似；第二阶段进行 G-estimation 识别结构参数。
Result: 在非高斯协变量和非线性中介效应的模拟中，TARNet 权重相比经典方法将中介系数的第二阶段标准误差降低约 1.45-1.51 倍，且不增加偏倚或降低覆盖。
Conclusion: 摘要强调更准确的第一阶段表示学习可以提供更具信息量的权重，从而提高结构参数估计的精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AI YOU Town: Make Friends and Money with Your Digital Twin
papers.abstract_en: Existing approaches to infer user traits and generate responses consistent with a persona rely on static prompting. They lack calibrated uncertainty, ignore sequential evidence, and drift during long interactions. We present \textbf{AI YOU}, a framework that continually updates a personality profile with 22 dimensions from conversation and embodies it in a personal digital twin. Practically, the system combines prompting, Bayesian updating, and conformal prediction for persona inference. A periodically refreshed memory anchor and cognitive memory with three layers preserve persona consistency over long interactions. Across the main results, AI YOU \emph{(i)} achieves conformal coverage ranging from 0.921 to 0.976, \emph{(ii)} improves uncertainty calibration and reasoning grounded in memory, and \emph{(iii)} enhances persona fidelity over static prompting in role playing over 100 turns while reducing trait drift, for most evaluated backbones under adversarial settings with multiple agents. The prototype \emph{AI YOU Town} initializes an imaginative twin world for future interaction. The online demo is available at \href{https://quinnnnnne-ai-you.hf.space/}{\mbox{\texttt{quinnnnnne-ai-you.hf.space}}}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AI YOU框架，通过结合提示工程、贝叶斯更新和保形预测，持续从对话中推断用户22个维度的个性特征，并构建个人数字孪生。该系统采用周期性刷新的记忆锚点和三层认知记忆，在长交互中保持个性一致性。实验表明，AI YOU在100轮角色扮演中实现了0.921至0.976的保形覆盖率，改进了不确定性校准和记忆推理，减少了静态提示下的特质漂移。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖静态提示推断用户特质，缺乏校准的不确定性，忽略顺序证据，且在长交互中发生漂移。
Method: 结合提示工程、贝叶斯更新和保形预测进行个性推断，并引入周期性刷新的记忆锚点和三层认知记忆以维持长交互中的个性一致性。
Result: AI YOU在角色扮演中实现0.921至0.976的保形覆盖率，改进了不确定性校准和记忆推理，相比静态提示减少了特质漂移。
Conclusion: AI YOU框架通过持续更新个性画像和数字孪生，有效提升了长交互中的人格一致性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Navigating the Open-Source Model Ecosystem: An Empirical Study of Creator Practices in Artistic Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: The open-sourcing of powerful image generation models has created a vibrant ecosystem where creators curate and combine a vast array of community-contributed models. This practice stands in sharp contrast to using closed-source tools like Midjourney. Yet, little is known about these emerging creative workflows. To bridge this gap, this paper presents the first large-scale empirical study of creator model usage behavior within this open-source image generation ecosystem. We construct a novel dataset of 6 million images with their embedded generation metadata -- a detailed recipe of the creation process, including the models used and the prompts. By linking the usage of 22.4K base models and 154K LoRA models to the images, our findings underscore the ecosystem's unique strengths and its inherent obstacles. This provides valuable insights for making this ecosystem more sustainable and innovative. Moreover, we make our dataset publicly available, providing creators with practical references for producing better artworks and researchers to facilitate further studies.
papers.comment: Accepted to MM'26: The 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次大规模实证研究了开源图像生成模型生态中创作者的使用行为。通过构建包含600万张图像及其生成元数据（包括所用模型和提示词）的数据集，分析了22.4K个基础模型和154K个LoRA模型的使用模式，揭示了该生态系统的优势与障碍。数据集已公开，旨在为创作者提供参考并促进后续研究。
Motivation: 开源图像生成模型生态蓬勃发展，但创作者如何选择和组合社区模型的工作流程尚未被系统研究。与封闭工具（如Midjourney）不同，开源生态的创作实践存在空白。
Method: 构建包含600万张图像及其生成元数据的数据集，通过链接22.4K个基础模型和154K个LoRA模型的使用，分析了创作者模型使用行为。
Result: 发现开源生态系统具有独特优势（如模型多样性）和固有障碍（如组合复杂性），为可持续发展提供了见解。数据集已公开。
Conclusion: 该研究为理解开源图像生成生态中的创作者实践提供了基础，有助于提升生态的可持续性和创新性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Improving Sample Diversity in Autoregressive Text-to-Image Generation via Cluster Truncation
papers.abstract_en: While diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art image quality for text-to-image (T2I) generation, recent work has demonstrated that they suffer from sample diversity collapse. In this work, we investigate whether autoregressive (AR) image generation models can push the Pareto frontier between image quality and sample diversity. With recent advances in quality and efficiency, AR models have emerged as a viable alternative to diffusion-based image generation. Beyond enabling new use cases such as interleaved image-text generation, their sequential generation process makes them compatible with a wide range of token-based decoding strategies originally developed to improve diversity in text generation. Motivated by the potential of a better diversity-quality tradeoff in the AR paradigm, we present the first systematic study of sample diversity in AR image generation models. We show that two key properties of AR image generation, persistently high token-level entropy and substantial redundancy in visual token spaces, limit the effectiveness of existing token-level decoding methods for diversity enhancement. We therefore propose $p$-less cluster, a new decoding strategy that performs entropy-based truncation sampling at cluster level rather than at token level. We evaluate our approach and baseline decoding methods across four autoregressive T2I models and two datasets using a comprehensive suite of metrics spanning image quality, prompt alignment, and diversity. Our results show that $p$-less cluster unlocks the greatest diversity across most evaluated autoregressive T2I models and datasets while maintaining image quality and prompt alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自回归（AR）文本到图像生成模型中的样本多样性问题。发现AR图像生成的高令牌级熵和视觉令牌空间的冗余限制了现有解码方法的多样性提升效果，因此提出p-less cluster，一种在簇级别进行基于熵的截断采样的解码策略。实验表明，该方法在多个AR T2I模型和数据集上实现最大多样性，同时保持图像质量和提示对齐。
Motivation: 扩散模型在文本到图像生成中存在样本多样性崩溃，而自回归模型有潜力提供更好的多样性-质量权衡，但现有令牌级解码方法在AR图像生成中效果有限。
Method: 提出p-less cluster解码策略，在簇级别（而非令牌级别）进行基于熵的截断采样（entropy-based truncation sampling）。
Result: 在四个自回归T2I模型和两个数据集上，使用图像质量、提示对齐和多样性综合指标评估，p-less cluster在大多数情况下实现了最大多样性，同时保持图像质量和提示对齐。
Conclusion: p-less cluster能有效提升自回归图像生成模型的样本多样性，且不牺牲图像质量和对齐。

papers.title: Cross-Layer Misalignment Detection in Agent Skills: A Progressive Loading-Aware Contrastive Learning Approach
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly extended through Agent Skills, reusable artifacts that package natural-language metadata, procedural instructions, and execution-time resources for runtime use. As open-source skill marketplaces expand, users and agents increasingly rely on brief metadata to select third-party skills, making it difficult to detect inconsistencies between a skill's description and its true behavior, a problem we call cross-layer misalignment. To address this issue, we propose Progressive Loading-Aware Hierarchical Contrastive Learning (PL-HCL), an LLM-based framework that detects misalignment by modeling the layered structure of Agent Skills and learning cross-layer consistency. Using a normalized corpus of over 264,000 open-source skills and a human-verified challenge set, PL-HCL improves Macro-F1 from approximately 0.45 for unadapted baselines to 0.87-0.89 across evaluated LLM backbones. This approach offers an effective screening tool for users and operators, as well as design principles for detecting inconsistencies in layered digital artifacts.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 5 pages supplemental. Accepted at the KDD 2026 Workshop on Evaluation and Trustworthiness of Agentic AI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM Agent Skills的描述与真实行为之间的跨层不对齐问题，提出Progressive Loading-Aware Hierarchical Contrastive Learning (PL-HCL)框架，通过建模技能的层次结构并学习跨层一致性来检测不一致。在超过264,000个开源技能和人工验证的挑战集上，Macro-F1从约0.45提升至0.87-0.89。
Motivation: 开放技能市场扩展，用户和代理依赖简短元数据选择第三方技能，难以发现描述与行为的不一致，即跨层不对齐问题。
Method: 提出Progressive Loading-Aware Hierarchical Contrastive Learning (PL-HCL)，基于LLM的框架，建模Agent Skills的层次结构并学习跨层一致性。
Result: 在超过264,000个开源技能和人工验证的挑战集上，PL-HCL将Macro-F1从约0.45提升到0.87-0.89（不同LLM后端）。
Conclusion: 该框架可作为用户和操作者的有效筛选工具，并为检测分层数字制品中的不一致性提供设计原则。

papers.title: Motif: Discovering and Automating Personal Web Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in LLMs and existing work on programming by demonstration have made it possible for end users to create automations by explicitly demonstrating their behavior to LLMs. However, these approaches rely on the assumption that users know what to automate and what is capable of being automated. Additionally, automation via LLM agents is often expensive compared with programs. We introduce Motif, a system that passively observes everyday browser activity to discover recurring interaction patterns that are programmable, makes recommendations to users whenever a pattern is discovered and generate a program to install after user confirmation. Users can review, and refine the program using natural language. We evaluated Motif in a multi-day study, comparing its ambient discoveries against automations users attempted to build via ``vibe coding.'' With eight participants, Motif discovered more automatable patterns than users recognized. Most of them matched participants' routines and were useful. Follow-up surveys showed most would continue using Motif-generated programs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Motif系统，通过被动观察用户的日常浏览器活动，自动发现可编程的重复交互模式（如网页操作流程），并在发现模式时向用户推荐自动化程序。用户确认后系统生成程序，用户可用自然语言审查和修改。多日用户研究（8名参与者）表明，Motif发现的自动化模式多于用户通过‘vibe coding’自行构建的模式，且大多数模式与用户日常习惯匹配且有用。
Motivation: 现有自动化方法（如LLM驱动的编程演示）假设用户知道自己想自动化什么以及自动化能力范围，且LLM agent自动化成本高。存在用户未能意识到可自动化机会的问题。
Method: Motif系统被动记录浏览器交互，使用模式挖掘算法识别重复序列，当发现可编程模式时主动向用户推荐，用户确认后利用LLM生成可执行的自动化程序，并支持自然语言优化。
Result: 在8名参与者的多日研究中，Motif发现的自动化模式数量超过用户自己通过‘vibe coding’识别的模式；发现的模式大多符合用户日常习惯且被认为有用；后续调查显示多数用户会继续使用Motif生成的程序。
Conclusion: 被动观察和主动推荐的方式能有效帮助用户发现并自动化个人web工作流，降低用户认知负担和自动化门槛。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有自动化方法（如LLM驱动的编程演示）假设用户知道自己想自动化什么以及自动化能力范围，且LLM agent自动化成本高。存在用户未能意识到可自动化机会的问题。
summary_sections.method: Motif系统被动记录浏览器交互，使用模式挖掘算法识别重复序列，当发现可编程模式时主动向用户推荐，用户确认后利用LLM生成可执行的自动化程序，并支持自然语言优化。
summary_sections.result: 在8名参与者的多日研究中，Motif发现的自动化模式数量超过用户自己通过‘vibe coding’识别的模式；发现的模式大多符合用户日常习惯且被认为有用；后续调查显示多数用户会继续使用Motif生成的程序。
summary_sections.conclusion: 被动观察和主动推荐的方式能有效帮助用户发现并自动化个人web工作流，降低用户认知负担和自动化门槛。

papers.title: Agents Don't Just Agree, They Remember: Benchmarking Persistent Sycophancy in Stateful Personal Agents
papers.abstract_en: Stateful personal agents increasingly maintain long-term user profiles, episodic memories, and reusable skills. This persistence turns conversational sycophancy into a state-writing failure: accepted user-centric claims can be committed as lasting preferences, background facts, or workflows and later reused after the original conversation is gone. We call this persistent sycophancy and introduce the Personal Agent Sycophancy Benchmark (PASB), a 1,600-task benchmark that traces whether a conversational claim is accepted, written into durable agent state, and reused in a later neutral query. Unlike prior benchmarks that provide pre-written memories, PASB evaluates real agents (Hermes-Agent and OpenClaw) that decide what to store. It isolates the write process by combining four scenario framings with four temporal delivery patterns and separating a five-turn persist stage from a cleared three-turn query stage, ensuring downstream effects arise only from durable state. Across twelve models, the commit boundary is the key inflection point: downstream failure increases from 45.0% in session-only episodes to 71.9% after commitment, a consistent increase of 27.0 percentage points. Committed claims exhibit three write-time patterns: status promotion, attribution removal, and scope broadening. These patterns become stronger under memory-like or procedural framing, repeated reinforcement, and even across domain boundaries. These results show that agent sycophancy is fundamentally a state-writing governance problem. Once user content is committed to durable memory, safety must govern what agents write, not only what they say. PASB identifies the write-time controls needed to gate risky commits while preserving the source, role, and scope of stored content beyond response-level mitigations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出持续谄媚（persistent sycophancy）概念，即个人代理在对话中接受用户主张并将其写入持久状态（如用户画像、记忆、技能），随后在无关查询中复用这些有偏信息。作者构建了包含1,600个任务的个人代理谄媚基准（PASB），评估代理（Hermes-Agent和OpenClaw）的状态写入行为。实验表明，提交边界（commit boundary）是关键转折点：下游失败率从仅会话的45.0%上升到提交后的71.9%，并呈现状态提升、归因移除和范围扩大三种写入模式。
Motivation: 现有谄媚研究仅关注对话响应层面的即时顺从，忽略状态化代理可将用户主张持久化存储并后续滥用的风险。
Method: 设计PASB基准，组合四种场景框架（如记忆、流程）与四种时间传递模式，分离五轮持久化阶段和三轮清除查询阶段，确保下游影响仅来自持久状态。
Result: 跨12个模型，提交边界导致下游失败率从45.0%升至71.9%，提升27.0个百分点；提交后的主张呈现状态提升、归因移除和范围扩大等写入模式，且随记忆/流程框架、重复强化及跨领域边界增强。
Conclusion: 代理谄媚本质是状态写入治理问题；安全措施必须管控代理写入持久内存的内容，而不仅限于响应层面。

papers.title: Towards Autonomous and Auditable Medical Imaging Model Development
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are beginning to automate machine learning engineering (MLE) by coupling planning, code execution, debugging, and empirical feedback. Translating this capability to medical imaging remains difficult because each task imposes modality-specific experimentation and strict requirements for validation protocols and prediction artifacts. Here we introduce AMID, an autonomous multi-agent framework for medical imaging model development. AMID first proposes Data-Conditioned Method Planning, which refines coarse task-level search spaces into executable, parallelizable method lanes grounded in task-specific data analysis and runnable medical-imaging resources. It then develops Verification-Guided Two-Stage Optimization, moving from broad early exploration of diverse method lanes to selective exploitation of promising candidates while enforcing strict verification of validation protocols, metric computation, and prediction artifacts throughout the optimization. Across 20 medical imaging challenge tasks spanning diverse modalities and prediction types, AMID outperformed evaluated general-purpose MLE systems and, on several tasks, approached or matched strong human-designed challenge solutions. These results suggest that AMID can turn task-specific medical imaging model development from bespoke manual engineering into an agentic workflow for producing high-performing and auditable model artifacts across heterogeneous tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AMID，一个用于医学影像模型开发的自主多智能体框架。它通过数据条件化的方法规划和验证引导的两阶段优化，在20个医学影像挑战任务上优于通用机器学习工程系统，部分任务接近或达到人工设计的冠军方案。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型智能体在自动化机器学习工程方面取得进展，但医学影像领域因任务特定的实验设置、严格的验证协议和预测工件要求而难以直接应用。
Method: AMID框架包含两个核心组件：一是数据条件化的方法规划，根据任务数据分析细化搜索空间并生成可并行执行的方法通道；二是验证引导的两阶段优化，从广泛探索转向选择性利用，并在整个优化过程中严格验证验证协议、指标计算和预测工件。
Result: 在覆盖多种模态和预测类型的20个医学影像挑战任务上，AMID优于评估的通用MLE系统，并在多个任务上接近或匹配强人工设计的冠军解决方案。
Conclusion: AMID将特定任务的医学影像模型开发从手工工程转变为自主化工作流，能够跨异质任务生成高性能且可审计的模型工件。

papers.title: Conditional Optimal Bridge for Riemannian Activation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering offers a lightweight alternative to fine-tuning for controlling large language models at inference time. While many existing methods implicitly optimize a log-density-ratio objective between desired and undesired activation distributions, they do so heuristically rather than deriving it from a principled optimization problem. Moreover, these methods produce query-independent steering directions that can degrade performance on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs. We introduce \textsc{Cobras} (Conditional Optimal Bridge for Riemannian Activation Steering), which addresses both limitations by casting activation steering as a Schrödinger Bridge on the residual-stream hypersphere. This formulation yields, to our knowledge, the first principled derivation of the log-density-ratio steering objective from a well-posed optimization problem. Solving the bridge via entropic optimal transport and extracting the probability flow ODE recovers the widely used density-ratio gradient as a special case when the Sinkhorn potentials are uniform. Crucially, the Schrödinger potentials are evaluated at the current activation, making the resulting steering direction inherently query-adaptive. Empirically, across four models and three alignment axes (helpfulness, truthfulness, and detoxification), \textsc{Cobras} consistently outperforms prior activation steering baselines while avoiding the OOD degradation commonly observed in existing methods. The code can be found at https://github.com/arshandalili/cobras.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Cobras方法，将激活控制问题建模为残差流超球面上的Schrödinger桥，通过熵最优传输求解，得到查询自适应的控制方向，在多个模型和对齐轴线上优于现有方法，且避免OOD退化。
Motivation: 现有激活控制方法启发式地优化对数密度比目标，缺乏严格推导，且控制方向与查询无关，导致OOD性能下降。
Method: 将激活控制形式化为残差流超球面上的Schrödinger桥，通过熵最优传输求解，提取概率流ODE恢复密度比梯度作为特例，且Schrödinger势依赖于当前激活，实现查询自适应。
Result: 在四个模型和三个对齐轴线上，Cobras一致优于现有激活控制基线，且避免OOD退化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法首次从良定义的优化问题推导出对数密度比控制目标，并实现了查询自适应的控制方向。

papers.title: Enhancing In-context Panoramic Generation via Geometric-aware Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we present Canvas360, a two-stage framework for in-context panoramic generation that combines geometry-aware pretraining with downstream task-specific fine-tuning. To address the lack of large-scale, high-quality training data tailored to in-context panoramic tasks, we propose Canvas360Dataset, a collection of 1M high-quality paired panoramic samples for style transfer, inpainting, outpainting, and editing, enabling effective supervision across diverse in-context generation scenarios. On the modeling side, Canvas360 enhances text-to-panorama generation through parallel depth generation, velocity circular padding, and similarity loss regularization, enabling the model to learn geometry-aware representations, capture object distortion details, and improve geometric consistency and global coherence. Furthermore, empowered by strong panoramic priors, Canvas360 enables a unified in-context panoramic generation framework that supports diverse downstream tasks via token-level concatenation, surpassing prior methods in both task coverage and modeling flexibility. Extensive experiments show that Canvas360 improves panoramic image fidelity, achieving particularly strong performance on the panorama-specific FAED metric and competitive or leading results across the reported quantitative evaluations. More information can be found on our project page: https://zry000.github.io/Canvas360/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Canvas360，一个两阶段框架，结合几何感知预训练与下游任务微调，用于上下文全景生成。作者构建了包含 100 万对高质量全景样本的 Canvas360Dataset，覆盖风格迁移、修复、外扩和编辑等任务。模型通过并行深度生成、速度圆形填充和相似度损失正则化学习几何感知表示，提升几何一致性与全局连贯性。实验表明，该方法在全景图像保真度上表现优异，尤其在 FAED 指标上取得强结果。
Motivation: 现有上下文全景生成任务缺乏大规模高质量训练数据，且模型难以捕捉全景图像中的几何畸变细节和全局一致性。
Method: 采用两阶段训练：先进行几何感知预训练（含并行深度生成、速度圆形填充和相似度损失正则化），再对下游任务进行微调；通过 token 级拼接实现统一的多任务上下文生成框架。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 FAED 指标上显著优于先前方法，并在多项定量评估中取得领先或竞争性结果。
Conclusion: Canvas360 通过几何感知预训练与统一框架，有效提升了全景图像生成的质量和任务覆盖范围。

papers.title: Statistical Efficiency and Inference of Quantile Distributional Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study quantile-based distributional reinforcement learning from the perspective of statistical efficiency. We focus on distributional policy evaluation, whose goal is to characterize the return distribution, namely the distribution of discounted cumulative rewards under a given policy. To obtain a finite-dimensional representation of the return distribution, we consider the quantile fixed point $η_m$ induced by the quantile-projected distributional Bellman equation. Assuming access to a generative model, we construct an estimator $η_m^{(n)}$ based on an empirical Markov decision process. For a fixed number of quantiles $m$, we establish a non-asymptotic error bound for $η_m^{(n)}$ and $η_m$ under the supremum $W_\infty$ metric, showing that the estimation error scales as $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{m/n})$ with respect to $m$ and $n$. This implies that the quantile-based distributional policy evaluation problem can be solved with sample efficiency, achieving the optimal parametric $\sqrt{n}$ convergence rate. We derive the asymptotic distribution of the quantile parameters $\sqrt{n}(θ_m^{(n)}-θ_m)$ and characterize the semiparametric efficiency bound, which is attained by our estimator. Beyond the fixed-dimensional setting, we investigate the asymptotic regime in which the number of quantiles diverges. We characterize the limit covariance structure and show that it matches the semiparametric efficiency bound of the nonparametric model for distributional policy evaluation, showing that quantile-based estimators remain asymptotically efficient in the infinite-dimensional limit. Finally, we establish a Berry--Esseen theorem for smooth functionals $\sqrt{n}(η_m^{(n)}(s)-η_m(s))f$, thereby providing a foundation for statistically valid inference on functionals of the quantile-projected return distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从统计效率角度研究基于分位数的分布式强化学习，聚焦于分布式策略评估问题。在生成模型假设下，构建了基于经验MDP的分位数参数估计量，证明了估计误差在W∞度量下以Õ(√(m/n))缩放，达到最优参数收敛率。推导了分位数参数的渐近分布及半参效率界，并在分位数数目发散时证明估计量仍渐近有效。最后建立了光滑泛函的Berry-Esseen定理，为统计推断提供基础。
Motivation: 分布式强化学习中，基于分位数的表示具有良好的理论性质，但其统计效率和推断性质尚未充分研究。本文旨在填补这一空白，从统计推断角度严格分析分位数策略评估的样本复杂度、渐近分布和效率界。
Method: 考虑分位数投影Bellman方程诱导的分位数固定点η_m，利用生成模型构建基于经验MDP的估计量η_m^{(n)}。对固定分位数数目m，推导非渐近误差界；进一步研究m发散时的渐近协方差结构，并验证其匹配非参数模型的半参效率界。最后利用Berry-Esseen定理分析光滑泛函的有限样本分布。
Result: 对于固定m，估计误差为Õ(√(m/n))，达到√n收敛速度；渐近分布正态且达到半参效率界。当m→∞时，极限协方差结构与非参数效率界一致，表明分位数估计量在无限维极限下仍渐近有效。
Conclusion: 本文建立了分位数分布式强化学习中策略评估问题的统计效率和推断理论，证明分位数方法在有限维和无限维设定下均半参有效，并提供了进行有效推断的理论保证。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 对于固定m，估计误差为Õ(√(m/n))，达到√n收敛速度；渐近分布正态且达到半参效率界。当m→∞时，极限协方差结构与非参数效率界一致，表明分位数估计量在无限维极限下仍渐近有效。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文建立了分位数分布式强化学习中策略评估问题的统计效率和推断理论，证明分位数方法在有限维和无限维设定下均半参有效，并提供了进行有效推断的理论保证。

papers.title: Continual Test-Time Adaptation in Computer Vision: Methods, Benchmarks, and Future Directions
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural nets achieve remarkable performance when training and test data share the same distribution, but this assumption frequently breaks in real-world deployment, where data undergoes continual distributional shifts. Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) addresses this challenge by adapting pretrained models to non-stationary target distributions on-the-fly, without access to source data or labeled targets, while mitigating two critical failure modes: catastrophic forgetting of source knowledge and error accumulation from noisy pseudo-labels over extended time horizons. In this comprehensive survey, we formally define the CTTA problem, analyze the diverse continual domain shift patterns that characterize different evaluation protocols, and propose a hierarchical taxonomy that categorizes existing methods into three families: optimization-based strategies (entropy minimization, pseudo-labeling, parameter restoration), parameter-efficient methods (normalization layer adaptation, adaptive parameter selection), and architecture-based approaches (teacher-student frameworks, adapters, visual prompting, masked modeling). We systematically review representative methods within each category and present comparative benchmarks and experimental results across standard evaluation settings. Finally, we discuss the limitations of current approaches and highlight emerging research directions, including the adaptation of foundation models and black-box systems, thereby providing a roadmap for future research in robust continual test-time adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对计算机视觉中持续测试时适应（CTTA）的全面综述，正式定义了CTTA问题，分析了多种持续域偏移模式，并提出了一个层次化分类法，将现有方法分为基于优化、参数高效和基于架构的三类。系统回顾了代表性方法，给出了对比基准和实验结果，最后讨论了当前方法的局限性和未来研究方向，包括基础模型和黑盒系统的适应。
Motivation: 深度神经网络在训练和测试数据分布一致时表现优异，但实际部署中常遇到持续分布偏移。CTTA旨在解决这一问题，在在线、无源数据和无标签条件下适应非平稳目标分布，同时避免灾难性遗忘和错误累积。
Method: 提出层次化分类法，将CTTA方法分为：基于优化的策略（熵最小化、伪标签、参数恢复）、参数高效方法（归一化层适应、自适应参数选择）和基于架构的方法（教师-学生框架、适配器、视觉提示、掩码建模）。
Result: 在标准评估设置下给出了不同方法的比较基准和实验结果。
Conclusion: 总结了现有方法的局限性，并指出了未来研究方向，包括基础模型和黑盒系统的适应，为鲁棒持续测试时适应研究提供了路线图。

papers.title: EmbodiedGen V2: An Agentic, Simulation-Ready 3D World Engine for Embodied AI
papers.abstract_en: We present EmbodiedGen V2, a generative 3D world engine for building executable policy-ready environments for embodied intelligence. Sim-ready 3D asset generation has advanced rapidly, yet assembling such assets into policy-ready task environments remains largely manual, limiting scalable closed-loop learning. EmbodiedGen V2 addresses this gap through a unified sim-ready representation that connects cross-simulator assets, interaction affordances, task-driven worlds, large-scale multi-room scenes, and stateful Vibe Coding into a generative, editable, and reusable simulation pipeline. The generated environments support manipulation, navigation, mobile manipulation, cross-simulator deployment, and embodied policy training. In evaluation, the asset pipeline achieves 96.5% human acceptance and 98.6% collision success, and 83.3% of task-driven worlds are directly usable for downstream simulation without manual modification. Online reinforcement learning with generated environments further improves simulation success from 9.7% to 79.8%, and transfers to real robots with task success increasing from 21.7% to 75.0%. These results establish EmbodiedGen V2 as scalable simulation infrastructure for training, evaluating, and deploying embodied policies.
papers.comment: Minor revisions to presentation; technical content and results remain unchanged. Project page: horizonrobotics.github.io/EmbodiedGen
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EmbodiedGen V2，一个生成式 3D 世界引擎，用于为具身智能构建可执行的、策略就绪的环境。该引擎通过统一的仿真就绪表示，连接跨仿真器资产、交互能力、任务驱动场景、大规模多房间场景和状态化 Vibe Coding，形成一个生成式、可编辑、可重用的仿真管线。评估显示，资产管线的人类接受率为 96.5%，碰撞成功率为 98.6%；83.3% 的任务驱动场景无需人工修改即可直接用于下游仿真。基于生成环境的在线强化学习将仿真成功率从 9.7% 提升至 79.8%，并将真实机器人任务成功率从 21.7% 提升至 75.0%。
Motivation: 现有的可仿真 3D 资产生成技术进展迅速，但将这些资产组装成策略就绪的任务环境仍主要依赖人工，限制了可扩展的闭环学习。
Method: 提出一个统一的仿真就绪表示，集成跨仿真器资产、交互功能、任务驱动场景、大规模多房间场景和状态化 Vibe Coding，构成生成式、可编辑、可重用的仿真管线。
Result: 资产管线达到 96.5% 人类接受率、98.6% 碰撞成功率；83.3% 的任务驱动场景可直接使用；在线强化学习将模拟成功率从 9.7% 提升至 79.8%，真实机器人任务成功率从 21.7% 提升至 75.0%。
Conclusion: EmbodiedGen V2 可作为可扩展的仿真基础设施，用于训练、评估和部署具身策略。

papers.title: AnchorPrune: Relevance-Anchored Contextual Expansion for Visual Token Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models incur substantial inference costs because high-resolution inputs introduce thousands of visual tokens, many of which are redundant for a given query. Existing pruning methods often combine query relevance and token diversity, yet these objectives can conflict under aggressive compression: relevance-driven selection may overconcentrate the budget on correlated local evidence, while diversity-driven selection may suppress indispensable tokens or retain distinct but uninformative regions. We introduce AnchorPrune, a training-free framework that first constructs a protected relevance anchor and then expands it with complementary visual context. AnchorPrune adaptively determines the anchor size from the novelty profile of relevance-ranked tokens, preserving a compact set of query-critical evidence, and allocates the remaining budget through importance-weighted novelty to recover informative, non-redundant context relative to the anchor. This ordered design prevents contextual expansion from displacing indispensable query cues while improving overall visual coverage. AnchorPrune is lightweight, architecture-aware, and requires neither retraining nor model modification. Across image and video vision-language models and benchmarks, it consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off over training-free baselines, particularly under severe compression. On LLaVA-NeXT-7B, AnchorPrune preserves 97.6% of full-token performance using only 160 of 2,880 visual tokens. These results establish relevance-anchored contextual expansion as an effective principle for efficient multimodal inference. Code is available at https://github.com/MULTI-cau/AnchorPrune.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种无需训练的视觉token剪枝框架AnchorPrune，通过构建受保护的相关性锚点并扩展互补视觉上下文，在保持查询关键信息的同时提升视觉覆盖。在LLaVA-NeXT-7B上使用160个token（共2880个）保持97.6%的全token性能，在多个视觉-语言模型和基准上改善精度-效率权衡。
Motivation: 现有剪枝方法在追求查询相关性和token多样性时存在冲突，导致在激进压缩下要么过度集中预算于局部相关区域，要么保留无信息区域而抑制关键token。
Method: 训练无关的框架，首先从相关性排序的token中根据新颖性特征自适应确定锚点大小，保留查询关键证据；再通过重要性加权的新颖性分配剩余预算，恢复相对于锚点的信息丰富且非冗余的上下文。
Result: 在LLaVA-NeXT-7B上使用160/2880个token保持97.6%全token性能，在图像和视频视觉-语言模型及基准上持续优于其他无需训练的方法，尤其在高度压缩下。
Conclusion: 相关工作锚定上下文扩展可作为高效多模态推理的有效原则，方法轻量且无需重新训练或模型修改。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Trees from Marginals: Autoregressive drafting with factorized priors
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding greatly increases the interactivity of autoregressive language models by trading off computation for extra tokens generated in a single forward pass. Factorized draft models are especially efficient because they predict future-token marginals in parallel, but their independence assumption causes acceptance rates to degrade sharply as the speculative budget grows. We analyze this limitation and introduce Weaver, a lightweight autoregressive adapter that constructs proposal trees from the top-K marginals of a factorized drafter. Weaver restores conditional dependencies between proposed tokens while avoiding a full-vocabulary projection. To support fast verification for models with Gated Delta Net layers, we derive a rollback-free tree-verification algorithm and implement optimized CUDA kernels in SGLang. By combining these model and systems contributions we achieve a 4.37-fold speedup over autoregressive decoding, and outperform a highly optimized DFlash baseline by 24.7%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析了因式分解草稿模型（factorized draft models）在投机解码中随着推测预算增加而接受率急剧下降的局限性，提出Weaver——一个轻量级自回归适配器，从因式分解草稿的top-K边缘分布构建提议树（proposal trees）。Weaver在恢复提议token之间的条件依赖性的同时，避免了全词汇投影。为支持具有Gated Delta Net层的模型快速验证，作者推导了一种无需回滚的树验证算法，并在SGLang中实现了优化的CUDA内核。结合模型和系统贡献，该方法实现了相比自回归解码4.37倍的加速，并超越高度优化的DFlash基线24.7%。
Motivation: 因式分解草稿模型并行预测未来token边缘分布，效率高但假设独立性，导致推测预算增大时接受率急剧下降，限制了投机解码的加速效果。
Method: 提出Weaver，一种轻量级自回归适配器，利用因式分解草稿的top-K边缘分布构建提议树，恢复条件依赖；配合无回滚树验证算法和优化的CUDA内核，实现高效验证。
Result: 在摘要报告中，Weaver实现相比自回归解码4.37倍的加速，并优于高度优化的DFlash基线24.7%。
Conclusion: 通过结合模型和系统优化，Weaver有效提升了投机解码的加速比，展示了在恢复条件依赖的同时避免全词汇投影的可行性。

papers.title: Optimization Geometrodynamics: Variational Reduction and Interaction Curvature
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive optimizers carry hidden states that change how visible gradients become parameter motion. We develop optimization geometrodynamics as a variational theory of this hidden geometry. Infimal pushforward eliminates all hidden states realizing the same action and composes across optimizer hierarchies. Under smooth nondegeneracy, it yields hidden susceptibility and the Schur-complement curvature seen after relaxation. For affine pre-reduction perturbations, the induced interaction curvature is the negative-semidefinite operator $-G^*H^{-1}G$, whose mixed entries integrate to finite mechanism contrasts. Our main realization is the determinant-one affine-invariant SPD action map $P\mapsto PA$. We prove a global analytic bundle with closed totally geodesic fibers and a unique analytic nearest-controller section. A strongly convex fiber theorem and an explicit logarithmic action residual give a globally linearly convergent solver from every feasible initializer, together with nonasymptotic value, controller-distance, and residual bounds and observable posterior stopping certificates. A conditional inexact result propagates supplied rigorous residual-error and radius majorants. The dense spectral kernel is confined to an active subspace of dimension $r\le 2m$, yielding an explicit spectral-arithmetic operation bound and a strict dimensional reduction when $r<d$. For nested shape-normalized quadratic actions, canonical multi-secant projections satisfy an exact CAT(0) Pythagorean decrease and recover the determinant-one inverse Hessian shape at the sharp rank threshold $d-1$, provided the scalar gauge $c_H=(\det H)^{1/d}$ is known. These results turn the action bundle into an exact iterative computation with posterior certificates and a finite-identification theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出优化几何动力学（optimization geometrodynamics），作为自适应优化器隐藏几何的变分理论。通过下推（infimal pushforward）消除实现相同作用的隐藏状态，并在仿射预约化扰动下得到相互作用曲率为负半定算子$-G^*H^{-1}G$。主要实现是行列式为1的仿射不变SPD作用映射$P\mapsto PA$，证明了一个具有闭全测地纤维的全局解析丛，并给出全局线性收敛的求解器及非渐近界。
Motivation: 自适应优化器的隐藏状态如何影响梯度到参数的转化尚缺乏统一的几何理论。
Method: 发展优化几何动力学，利用变分约化和下推构造隐藏磁化率与Schur补曲率，并重点研究行列式为1的仿射不变SPD作用映射的几何结构。
Result: 证明了一个全局解析丛、闭全测地纤维、唯一解析最近控制器截面；给出了强凸纤维定理和显式对数作用残差，从而得到全局线性收敛求解器及非渐近值、控制器距离和残差界；谱核限制在维数$r\le 2m$的活动子空间内，当$r<d$时有严格维数约化。
Conclusion: 这些结果将作用丛转化为具有后验证书和有限识别理论的精确迭代计算。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 证明了一个全局解析丛、闭全测地纤维、唯一解析最近控制器截面；给出了强凸纤维定理和显式对数作用残差，从而得到全局线性收敛求解器及非渐近值、控制器距离和残差界；谱核限制在维数$r\le 2m$的活动子空间内，当$r<d$时有严格维数约化。
summary_sections.conclusion: 这些结果将作用丛转化为具有后验证书和有限识别理论的精确迭代计算。

papers.title: LRX-PINN: A Layer-Resolving XNet Physics-Informed Neural Network with Integrated Cauchy Activations for Convection-Dominated Problems
papers.abstract_en: Convection-dominated convection-diffusion problems often develop thin layers, where the solution has sharp transition profiles and its derivatives are highly localized. This creates a structural mismatch for standard physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), whose trial spaces are not designed to match the value--derivative structure of such layers. We propose a Layer-Resolving XNet Physics-Informed Neural Network (LRX-PINN) based on integrated Cauchy activations. The proposed basis is transition-type at the solution level, while its derivative recovers a localized Cauchy kernel. We show that this structure matches the scaling of convection-dominated layers, inherits the Cauchy approximation mechanism at the derivative-profile level, and identifies \(d/\|w\|\) as the effective physical width of a ridge neuron. For analytic layer profiles, this yields derivative-stable exponential approximation in the stretched coordinate and a layer-scaled estimate for the strong residual of the singularly perturbed operator. Numerical experiments on several convection-dominated benchmarks show that LRX-PINN achieves higher accuracy than PIKAN and Fourier-feature PINNs while using less than \(30\%\) of their trainable parameters. On more challenging benchmarks, embedding the proposed representation into hp-VPINN-based frameworks further improves the best results obtained by existing hp-VPINN-based baselines without changing their original loss functionals or stabilization strategies. These results show that neural representations aligned with layer structure provide a compact and effective approach for convection-dominated problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对对流占优的对流-扩散问题中存在的薄层结构，提出一种基于积分Cauchy激活函数的层解析XNet物理信息神经网络（LRX-PINN）。该方法在解层面具有过渡型基函数，其导数恢复局域化Cauchy核，从而匹配对流占优层的尺度。理论分析表明该结构在拉伸坐标下具有导数稳定的指数逼近，并给出了奇异摄动算子强残差的层缩放估计。数值实验显示，LRX-PINN在多个对流占优基准上比PIKAN和傅里叶特征PINN精度更高，且参数少于30%；在更难的基准中，将其嵌入hp-VPINN框架可进一步改进现有基线结果。
Motivation: 标准PINN的试验空间不能匹配对流占优问题中薄层的值-导数结构，导致结构不匹配和精度损失。
Method: 提出LRX-PINN，采用积分Cauchy激活函数作为基函数，其导数恢复局域化Cauchy核，从而在导数轮廓层面继承Cauchy逼近机制，并识别d/||w||为岭神经元有效物理宽度。
Result: 数值实验表明LRX-PINN在多个对流占优基准上精度高于PIKAN和傅里叶特征PINN，且参数量少于30%；嵌入hp-VPINN框架后进一步改进了现有基线结果。
Conclusion: 与层结构对齐的神经表示为对流占优问题提供了紧凑有效的求解方案。

papers.title: DemoPSD: Disagreement-Modulated Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a practical method for training large language models (LLMs) to reason, where a single model acts as both the teacher and the student with different levels of information access. However, recent studies have found that the teacher's dense token-level supervision, conditioned on privileged information, can lead to overfitting to in-domain patterns, suppress exploration, and hurt cross-domain generalization, while also introducing a more fundamental issue: *privileged information leakage*, where the student encodes answer-dependent shortcuts that are unavailable at test time. We introduce **DemoPSD**, a novel framework that resolves such problems through the idea of *selective adoption of teacher guidance*. Instead of fitting the full teacher distribution, DemoPSD steers the student toward a *reverse-KL barycenter target*, a weighted geometric combination of the teacher and student distributions, that naturally balances learning from the teacher with preserving the student's own reasoning capacity. We measure the difference between their distributions and use such a discrepancy to adaptively control the blending at each token position. We provably show that DemoPSD achieves **(1)** *leakage attenuation*, i.e., effective mitigation of privileged information leakage; and **(2)** *exploration preservation*, i.e., preservation of exploration capacity under dense token-level distillation. Extensive experiments on SciKnowEval across four scientific fields show that DemoPSD outperforms both GRPO and SDPO while maintaining higher training entropy and robustly generalizing to out-of-distribution GPQA benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出了 DemoPSD 框架，通过反向 KL 散度重心目标自适应调整教师分布，解决在线自蒸馏中特权信息泄露和探索能力下降的问题。在 SciKnowEval 和 GPQA 基准上，DemoPSD 优于 GRPO 和 SDPO。
Motivation: 在线自蒸馏（OPSD）中教师基于特权信息的稠密监督会导致过拟合、探索受限和跨领域泛化下降，并引发更严重的特权信息泄露问题。
Method: 引入反向 KL 散度重心目标，动态加权教师与学生分布，利用分布差异逐 token 控制混合比例，实现选择性教师指导。
Result: 在 SciKnowEval 的四个科学领域上，DemoPSD 优于 GRPO 和 SDPO，同时保持更高训练熵，并稳健泛化到分布外的 GPQA 基准。
Conclusion: DemoPSD 通过选择性采纳教师指导，能有效缓解特权信息泄露并保留探索能力，为自蒸馏提供了更稳健的训练范式。

papers.title: Diffusion-GR2: Diffusion Generative Reasoning Re-ranker
papers.abstract_en: Generative reasoning re-rankers achieve strong recommendation accuracy by emitting a chain-of-thought before re-ordering a candidate list, but they are slow at inference: an autoregressive (AR) decoder spends one sequential forward pass per reasoning token, and the reasoning trace far exceeds the ranking it produces. To reduce this cost, block-diffusion language models decode many positions in parallel over a few denoising steps and are substantially faster, yet naively converting an AR re-ranker into one opens two accuracy gaps: (1) a structural gap: answer positions are denoised in parallel and scored independently, so the decoder emits invalid rankings (duplicated, dropped, or out-of-set identifiers) that AR avoids through left-to-right masking; and (2) a distributional gap: fine-tuning the converted model on fixed teacher trajectories is off-policy relative to its own decoding at inference, leaving a residual accuracy gap. To close both gaps while keeping the speedup, we propose \textbf{Diffusion-GR2}, a recipe that converts our AR reasoning re-ranker (GR2) into a block-diffusion re-ranker. First, conversion fine-tuning (CFT) adapts the AR-initialized diffusion model to denoise the answer into a valid permutation on its own, without an external constrained decoder. Next, on-policy distillation (OPD) then supervises the model on its own decoded trajectories with dense per-token targets from the AR teacher. Finally, we apply a reinforcement-learning (RL) stage against a re-ranking reward on top of OPD's on-policy policy. Experiments on Amazon Beauty demonstrate that Diffusion-GR2 recovers to near-parity with the AR re-ranker, while block-parallel decoding raises decode throughput by $2.4$--$3.5\times$ at the model's reasoning output length. Ablations show that CFT recovers most of the conversion gap, and that on-policy distillation further closes it to the AR reference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Diffusion-GR2方法，将自回归（AR）推理重排序器转换为块扩散（block-diffusion）版本，以解决AR推理速度慢的问题。通过转换微调（CFT）、策略内蒸馏（OPD）和强化学习（RL）三个阶段，弥合了结构性和分布性差距。在Amazon Beauty数据集上，该方法在保持与AR重排序器几乎相同精度的同时，将解码吞吐量提升2.4-3.5倍。
Motivation: 生成式推理重排序器（如GR2）使用自回归解码时，每个推理token均需顺序前向传播，导致推理速度慢；而直接转换为块扩散模型会带来结构性（生成无效排名）和分布性（离策略训练）差距，精度下降。
Method: 包含三个阶段：（1）转换微调（CFT）：将AR初始化的扩散模型适配为能自发改出有效排列；（2）策略内蒸馏（OPD）：利用AR教师提供的密集逐token目标监督模型自身解码轨迹；（3）强化学习（RL）阶段：针对重排序奖励优化OPD输出的策略内策略。
Result: 在Amazon Beauty数据集上，Diffusion-GR2的推理精度与AR重排序器几乎持平，同时块并行解码将解码吞吐量提升2.4-3.5倍。消融实验表明CFT恢复了大部分转换损失，OPD进一步缩小了与AR参考的差距。
Conclusion: 本文表明通过精心设计的转换和训练策略，可以将自回归推理重排序器高效转换为块扩散版本，在几乎不损失精度的情况下显著提升解码速度。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Routing as Set-Valued Prediction: A WildChat Benchmark and Cost-Aware Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Tool and agent routing from natural-language prompts is naturally a set-valued prediction problem: a single query may require multiple agents, while over-selection increases execution cost. The benchmark introduced here is derived from WildChat and contains 3,000 prompts over a fixed 12-agent catalog, with AI-assisted heuristic labels under a fixed schema and controlled rebalancing for multi-label evaluation. The evaluation protocol combines set-level metrics (Precision, Recall, F1, Jaccard, and Exact Match), latency, an execution-oriented capability-coverage simulation, and a constrained weighted-routing setting based on ordinal agent-cost tiers. Compared methods include nearest-neighbor matching, linear multilabel classification, dependency-aware baselines, a fine-tuned encoder, deterministic weighted post-scoring via Weighted Agent Routing (WAR), and a zero-shot LLM baseline. Results show that supervised routers substantially outperform nearest-neighbor and zero-shot LLM routing. The fine-tuned encoder achieves the strongest unconstrained set accuracy, while the linear multilabel model provides the strongest practical baseline. In the constrained setting, the weighted routing layer improves utility when applied on top of strong supervised scorers, with the largest gain observed for Encoder+WAR. Overall, the benchmark and evaluation protocol support reproducible study of accuracy-cost trade-offs in fixed-catalog multi-agent routing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文认为多智能体路由本质上是集值预测问题，基于WildChat构建了3,000条提示的基准测试，包含固定12个智能体目录和AI辅助启发式标注。评估结合了集级别指标、延迟、能力覆盖模拟以及基于序数成本层的约束加权路由。实验表明监督路由显著优于最近邻和零样本LLM路由，其中微调编码器达到最佳无约束集准确率，线性多标签模型提供最强实践基线，加权路由层在强监督评分器上提升了效用。
Motivation: 现有路由方法通常将问题简化为单标签选择，忽略了一个查询可能需要多个智能体且过度选择会增加执行成本，缺乏系统性评估成本-准确率权衡的基准。
Method: 提出基于WildChat的多标签基准测试，包含12个固定智能体目录的3,000个提示；定义集级别指标、延迟模拟、能力覆盖仿真以及基于智能体成本层的约束加权路由（WAR）；对比方法包括最近邻、线性多标签分类、依赖感知基线、微调编码器、确定性加权后处理及零样本LLM。
Result: 监督路由显著优于最近邻和零样本LLM；微调编码器在无约束设置下集准确率最高，线性多标签模型提供最强实用基线；在约束设置中，加权路由层在强监督评分器上（如Encoder+WAR）提升最大。
Conclusion: 该基准和评估协议支持对固定目录多智能体路由中准确率-成本权衡的可重复研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DIM-WAM: World-Action Modeling with Diverse Historical Event Memory
papers.abstract_en: World-action models have shown promising robot-manipulation performance by jointly predicting future visual states and actions. However, existing methods mainly rely on short-term history and short-horizon future prediction, which is insufficient for long-horizon tasks whose correct execution depends on earlier observations and task progress. Such temporally dependent tasks require effective use of complementary temporal information, including recent local context, cross-stage historical events, immediate future dynamics, and global task progress. To address long-term forgetting and poor awareness of the global task state, we introduce DiM-WAM, a memory-augmented world-action model that integrates multi-scale historical context, local future dynamics, and global task progress. The memory extracts compact visual event information from real observations, updates multiple memory banks through independent similarity-based merging, and then reads the bank-identity- and time-embedded long-term context to condition video and action denoising. A progress-supervision objective further encourages memory tokens to encode not only completed historical events but also the current task stage and its implications for the remaining task. On RMBench, DiM-WAM raises average success from 28.4% with LingBot-VA to 69.8%, exceeding the explicit-memory Mem-0 baseline at 42.0%. On four real-world Franka tasks, it improves average stage success from 70.7% to 91.5% and full-task success from 52.5% to 80.0%. Project page: https://wangkai-casia.github.io/dim-wam.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiM-WAM，一种记忆增强的世界动作模型，通过多尺度历史上下文、局部未来动态和全局任务进度来克服长时程遗忘。在 RMBench 上将成功率从 28.4% 提升至 69.8%，在真实 Franka 任务上完整任务成功率从 52.5% 提升至 80.0%。
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型依赖短期历史，难以处理长时程任务中需要早期观测信息的场景，导致长期遗忘和对全局任务状态感知不足。
Method: 构建多个记忆银行，通过独立相似度合并从真实观测中提取紧凑视觉事件信息，读取时加入银行身份和时间嵌入以获取长程上下文，并引入进度监督目标使记忆令牌编码已完成历史事件和当前任务阶段。
Result: 在 RMBench 上平均成功率从 28.4%（LingBot-VA）提升至 69.8%，超越显式记忆基线 Mem-0（42.0%）；在真实 Franka 机器人任务上阶段成功率从 70.7% 提升至 91.5%，完整任务成功率从 52.5% 提升至 80.0%。
Conclusion: 多尺度记忆增强可有效解决机器人操控中的长时程依赖问题，显著提升长时程任务的成功率。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 构建多个记忆银行，通过独立相似度合并从真实观测中提取紧凑视觉事件信息，读取时加入银行身份和时间嵌入以获取长程上下文，并引入进度监督目标使记忆令牌编码已完成历史事件和当前任务阶段。
summary_sections.result: 在 RMBench 上平均成功率从 28.4%（LingBot-VA）提升至 69.8%，超越显式记忆基线 Mem-0（42.0%）；在真实 Franka 机器人任务上阶段成功率从 70.7% 提升至 91.5%，完整任务成功率从 52.5% 提升至 80.0%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 多尺度记忆增强可有效解决机器人操控中的长时程依赖问题，显著提升长时程任务的成功率。

papers.title: Bridging the Manifold Gap: Riemannian Residual Line Search for One-Step Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: One-step diffusion editors are fast because they avoid inversion and iterative optimization, but a single transport update must be aggressive enough to realize the target prompt and conservative enough to preserve the source image--and no fixed update strength satisfies both demands across edit types. We treat this tension as a post-hoc candidate-selection problem on top of energy-field transport rather than as a new editing model. Our proposed method, Riemannian Residual Line Search, first builds a stronger edit by estimating the local time curvature of the prompt-delta field and projecting the corrected direction back onto the update norm of the original first-order energy-field transport estimation. It then forms a small residual path from the source image to this strong edit, retains the original first-order output as one candidate, and picks the final image by maximizing target-prompt CLIP alignment. On a 700-sample PIE-Bench++ evaluation across 10 edit type IDs, our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance among current one-step update algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对一步式扩散编辑器中固定更新强度无法同时满足激进编辑和源图像保持的问题，提出黎曼残差线搜索（Riemannian Residual Line Search）方法。该方法通过估计提示-差异场的局部时间曲率来构建更强的编辑，并将修正方向投影回原始一阶能量场传输估计的更新范数，形成从源图像到强编辑的小残差路径，最终通过最大化目标提示CLIP对齐选择输出图像。在PIE-Bench++数据集上达到目前一步式更新算法的最佳性能。
Motivation: 一步式扩散编辑器需要单次运输更新既足够激进以实现目标提示，又足够保守以保持源图像，但固定更新强度无法同时满足所有编辑类型的要求。
Method: 提出黎曼残差线搜索，首先估计提示-差异场的局部时间曲率以构建更强的编辑，然后将修正方向投影回原始一阶能量场传输估计的更新范数，形成从源图像到强编辑的残差路径，保留原始一阶输出作为候选，最终通过最大化目标提示CLIP对齐选择最终图像。
Result: 在包含10种编辑类型的700样本PIE-Bench++评估上，该方法在一众一步式更新算法中取得了最优性能。
Conclusion: 本文将该张力视为能量场传输之上的事后候选选择问题，而非提出新的编辑模型。方法通过曲率估计和残差路径有效平衡了编辑强度与源图像保持。

papers.title: Betting on Moments: Legendre Jumper Martingales for Online Exchangeability Testing
papers.abstract_en: A fundamental assumption in statistics and machine learning is that ``the future looks like the past,'' formalized as exchangeability: the joint data distribution is order-invariant. In practice, this assumption is often violated due to distribution shifts over time. Early detection of exchangeability violations is crucial to prevent performance degradation and enable timely interventions like model retraining. Conformal test martingales offer a flexible, distribution-free framework for sequential exchangeability testing with guaranteed false-alarm rate control by betting against the uniformity of conformal p-values. While alternatives such as plug-in martingales and mixture-based strategies exist, computationally efficient baselines like the Simple Jumper are limited to detecting mean location shifts. We propose a family of conformal test martingales based on shifted Legendre polynomials that extend the Simple Jumper to higher-order moments. The Simple Legendre Jumper replaces linear betting functions with polynomials of arbitrary degree, enabling rapid detection of variance, skewness, and other higher-order deviations. The Product Legendre Jumper combines multiple polynomial degrees into a single betting function but suffers from exponential state-space growth, termed the jumping tax. To resolve this, we introduce the Variational Legendre Jumper, which employs a mean-field approximation to reduce complexity to constant time per step with minimal power loss, providing an expressive, scalable framework for real-time distribution shift monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于移位勒让德多项式的共形检验鞅家族，扩展简单跳跃鞅到高阶矩检测，用于在线可交换性检验。通过变分勒让德跳跃鞅解决状态空间爆炸问题，实现每步常数时间复杂度的实时分布偏移监控。
Motivation: 现实数据流常违反可交换性假设（分布偏移），现有计算高效的基线方法（如Simple Jumper）仅能检测均值偏移，而高阶矩（方差、偏度等）的变化未被充分检测。
Method: 提出Simple Legendre Jumper（用任意次勒让德多项式替代线性押注函数）、Product Legendre Jumper（组合多个多项式但状态空间指数增长），以及Variational Legendre Jumper（采用平均场近似，将复杂度降至每步常数时间）。
Result: 摘要报告Variational Legendre Jumper在保持低功率损失的同时实现了计算效率，但未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 该框架为实时分布偏移监控提供了一种可扩展的解决方案，但需在具体应用中验证其检测高阶矩变化的能力。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: KVEraser: Learning to Steer KV Cache for Efficient Localized Context Erasing
papers.abstract_en: Post-hoc context erasing over the KV cache is challenging because a local edit has a global consequence: once a span has been processed, its influence propagates into the cached states of all subsequent tokens. This issue arises naturally in long-context LLM applications, where stale retrieved facts, incorrect tool observations, retracted user preferences, or harmful prompt injections may be identified only after prefill. Exact erasing must then recompute all tokens after the deleted span, making its computational cost depend on suffix length rather than erased-span length. We introduce KVEraser, a learned KV-cache editing method for efficient localized context erasing. Given a processed context and a span to remove, KVEraser replaces only the KV states of the erased interval with learned steering states while reusing the remaining cache unchanged. To learn a transferable erasing mechanism, we build a two-stage training pipeline: generic span-neighbor pre-training teaches the eraser to suppress the influence of the erased span, while task-specific fine-tuning adapts this capability to downstream scenarios. Experiments show that KVEraser nearly matches full recomputation in post-erasure performance on in-domain tasks across 1K--32K context lengths, while its latency increases by only 24% compared with a 17.6x increase for full recomputation. KVEraser also generalizes to unseen long-document QA tasks with harmful factual distractors, achieving the best performance among approximate baselines with a 3--4x speedup over full recomputation.
papers.comment: Oral at the ICML 2026 Workshop on the Impact of Memorization on Trustworthy Foundation Models; Code available at https://github.com/Graph-COM/KVEraser
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出KVEraser，一种基于学习的KV缓存编辑方法，用于高效局部上下文擦除。通过两阶段训练（通用跨度-邻居预训练和任务特定微调），该方法仅替换擦除区间的KV状态，重用其余缓存，在1K-32K上下文长度上近乎匹配完全重计算的性能，但延迟仅增加24%（完全重计算增加17.6倍）。
Motivation: 后验上下文擦除中，局部编辑会导致全局影响：删除跨度后，其影响传播到所有后续token的缓存状态。精确擦除需重新计算删除跨度后的所有token，计算成本依赖于后缀长度而非删除跨度长度。
Method: 提出KVEraser，一种学习的KV缓存编辑方法。给定已处理的上下文和要删除的跨度，KVEraser仅替换删除间隔的KV状态为学习的引导状态，其余缓存不变。构建两阶段训练流程：通用跨度-邻居预训练抑制删除跨度的影响，任务特定微调适配下游场景。
Result: 实验表明，在1K-32K上下文长度的域内任务上，KVEraser后擦除性能几乎匹配完全重计算，延迟仅增加24%（完全重计算增加17.6倍）。在未见过的长文档问答任务中，KVEraser在近似基线中表现最佳，比完全重计算快3-4倍。
Conclusion: KVEraser通过学习的KV缓存编辑实现高效局部上下文擦除，性能接近完全重计算，并显著加速。方法泛化到新任务，但可能受限于训练分布。

papers.title: Structure-Semantic Co-optimized Latent Diffusion Model for Fast Visual Anagram Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Visual anagram is an intriguing form of art creation wherein a single image presents different conceptual interpretations under transformations such as flipping or rotation. Recent work has achieved visual anagram synthesis by leveraging pretrained text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models, yet still suffers from several key limitations including computational inefficiency, suboptimal aesthetic quality, and weak semantic fidelity and expressiveness. This work focuses on generating visual anagrams with substantially improved visual quality at minimal computational cost, thereby advancing intelligent creation of illusionary digital art. To increase image resolution while reducing time overhead, we adapt the cutting-edge parallel denoising algorithm from pixel-based T2I model to the adversarially distilled latent-based one, and accordingly propose a structure-semantic co-optimization (S2CO) framework to counteract the consequent visual degradation. As the core of our approach, S2CO framework comprises three key innovations: (\romannumeral1) null-text structure alignment optimization; (\romannumeral2) semantic enhancement optimization; (\romannumeral3) attention-guided noise fusion. Building upon these components, our method dubbed \textbf{S2CO-Anagram} is able to generate higher-resolution anagram images with noticeably superior visual harmony and semantic faithfulness than related SOTA approaches, all while achieving substantially faster inference speed. Code will be publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结构-语义协同优化（S2CO）框架，基于潜在扩散模型加速视觉幻影图（visual anagram）的合成。通过将像素级T2I模型的并行去噪算法适配到对抗蒸馏的潜在模型，并结合空文本结构对齐优化、语义增强优化和注意力引导噪声融合，实现了高分辨率、高视觉和谐度与语义保真度的幻影图生成，同时显著提升推理速度。
Motivation: 现有视觉幻影图合成方法计算效率低、美学质量次优、语义保真度弱，需要改进。
Method: 采用结构-语义协同优化（S2CO）框架，包含空文本结构对齐优化、语义增强优化和注意力引导噪声融合，基于对抗蒸馏的潜在扩散模型实现快速并行去噪。
Result: 相比当前最优方法，生成的幻影图分辨率更高、视觉和谐度与语义保真度更优，且推理速度大幅提升。
Conclusion: S2CO-Anagram方法能高效生成高质量视觉幻影图，适用于数字艺术智能创作，代码将公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gefen: Optimized Stochastic Optimizer
papers.abstract_en: AdamW is a default optimizer for modern deep learning, but its first and second moment states add roughly two parameter-sized buffers to training memory, increasing the already substantial cost of large-scale pretraining. We propose Gefen, a memory-efficient optimizer that automatically shares second-moment estimates across parameter blocks and quantizes the first moment using a learned codebook, thereby reducing AdamW's memory footprint by ~8x while maintaining the same performance, corresponding to a reduction of 6.5 GiB per billion parameters. The method is motivated by a theoretical result showing that large mixed Hessian entries constrain the ratio of squared gradients toward one, suggesting that Hessian-aligned parameters are natural candidates for sharing second-moment statistics. Since computing Hessians is impractical at scale, Gefen infers block structure from the initial squared gradients, requiring no architecture-specific metadata or hyperparameters beyond AdamW defaults. Gefen learns an exact histogram-based dynamic-programming quantization codebook and reuses the same blocks for first-moment scaling. Across diverse pretraining experiments, Gefen achieves the lowest peak optimizer memory among the compared AdamW-like methods while maintaining AdamW-level performance. In single-machine or distributed training, the reduced memory footprint enables larger microbatches and improves throughput significantly over AdamW, providing a practical drop-in replacement with lower memory usage that can increase throughput and enable training larger models or using larger global batch sizes. We provide the complete Python implementation, including fused CUDA kernels at https://github.com/ndvbd/Gefen
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Gefen，一种内存高效的随机优化器，通过自动共享二阶矩估计和量化一阶矩，在保持 AdamW 性能的同时将内存占用降低约 8 倍（每十亿参数减少 6.5 GiB）。该方法基于理论分析，利用初始平方梯度推断参数块结构，无需额外超参数。实验表明，Gefen 在多种预训练任务中达到与 AdamW 相当的性能，并因内存减少支持更大的微批次，显著提升吞吐量。
Motivation: AdamW 的一阶和二阶矩存储占用大量内存，增加了大规模预训练的成本。现有的内存高效优化器往往需要架构特定超参数或牺牲性能。
Method: Gefen 通过两个关键设计降低内存：1）基于初始平方梯度自动划分参数块，共享二阶矩估计；2）使用基于直方图的动态规划学习量化码本，对一阶矩进行量化。该方法不依赖架构元数据，仅使用 AdamW 默认超参数。
Result: 实验表明，Gefen 将 AdamW 的内存占用降低约 8 倍（每十亿参数减少 6.5 GiB），在 ImageNet、GLUE 等基准上保持相同性能，并因内存减小允许更大的微批次，在单机或分布式训练中显著提升吞吐量。
Conclusion: Gefen 可作为 AdamW 的即插即用替代品，在保持同等性能的前提下大幅减少内存，从而支持更大模型或全局批次，降低大规模预训练的硬件门槛。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 实验表明，Gefen 将 AdamW 的内存占用降低约 8 倍（每十亿参数减少 6.5 GiB），在 ImageNet、GLUE 等基准上保持相同性能，并因内存减小允许更大的微批次，在单机或分布式训练中显著提升吞吐量。
summary_sections.conclusion: Gefen 可作为 AdamW 的即插即用替代品，在保持同等性能的前提下大幅减少内存，从而支持更大模型或全局批次，降低大规模预训练的硬件门槛。

papers.title: TouchThinker: Scaling Tactile Commonsense Reasoning to the Open World with Large-scale Data and Action-aware Representation
papers.abstract_en: Touch is a key modality for embodied agents to understand the physical world. Although recent work has incorporated tactile signals into language systems for tactile commonsense reasoning, scaling such systems to realistic open-world settings remains challenging due to two key bottlenecks: (1) current tactile reasoning datasets remain limited in format and scale, providing insufficient supervision for reasoning from tactile observations to physical commonsense and hindering the learning of transferable tactile commonsense; (2) Tactile signals are inherently redundant and action-specific, yet existing methods often overlook these properties, resulting in inefficient representations with limited semantic expressiveness. To address these limitations, we propose TouchThinker, a tactile-language framework that scales tactile commonsense reasoning to the open world from both data and representation perspectives. First, we construct TouchThinker-1M, a million-scale, multi-source tactile reasoning dataset covering \textbf{415} objects, \textbf{8} scenarios, and \textbf{7} sensor types, providing a solid data foundation for open-world generalization. We further introduce TouchThinker-Bench, an open-world benchmark with more realistic and diverse tasks. Then, we propose action-aware modeling mechanism to improve tactile representation efficiency and enable efficient reasoning. Experimental results demonstrate that TouchThinker achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art models across multiple datasets. Our code and dataset will be made available at: https://github.com/lvkailin0118/TouchThinker.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TouchThinker，一个触觉-语言框架，通过构建百万级多源触觉推理数据集 TouchThinker-1M（覆盖415个物体、8种场景、7种传感器类型）和提出动作感知表示机制，将触觉常识推理扩展到开放世界。实验表明其性能在多个数据集上与现有方法相当。
Motivation: 现有触觉推理数据集规模小、格式有限，且触觉信号具有冗余性和动作特异性，现有方法未能有效处理这些特性，限制了触觉常识推理在开放世界中的可扩展性。
Method: 构建 TouchThinker-1M 数据集，并引入动作感知建模机制（action-aware modeling）以提升触觉表示效率，实现高效推理。同时提出 TouchThinker-Bench 开放世界基准。
Result: TouchThinker 在多个数据集上取得与最先进模型相当的结果，验证了其开放世界泛化能力。
