papers.title: When Does Delegation Beat Majority? A Delegation-Based Aggregator for Multi-Sample LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Majority voting is the default unsupervised aggregator for multi-sample LLM inference, but it discards two signals: within-group answer entropy and between-group reasoning geometry. We aggregate by delegation instead (Propagational Proxy Voting, PPV): each group of samples keeps weight on its own answer in proportion to its entropy-based confidence (When) and routes the rest to peers by reasoning-embedding similarity (Whom); the stationary distribution of the resulting delegation matrix picks the consensus answer. This requires neither gold labels nor training. On MMLU-Pro with 128 samples per question, delegation beats majority by +1.5 pp overall and +2.24 pp on non-trivial questions (McNemar p ~ 1.0e-14, n = 8,099), overturning wrong majorities whose answer cluster is geometrically incoherent while the correct minority is tight. We then characterize exactly when delegation overturns majority: a two-option model gives a closed-form flip condition on each option's confidence and the weight it routes to the other, with a do-no-harm corollary for near-unanimous questions. The condition calls the realized winner on 96.5% of non-trivial questions, and its predicted mass gap tracks the realized gap at r = 0.97. We did not find any other unsupervised ensemble methods that close the oracle gap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于委托的聚合方法Propagational Proxy Voting (PPV)，用于多样本LLM推理。PPV利用每组样本的熵作为置信度权重，并将剩余权重按推理嵌入相似性路由给其他组，最终通过委托矩阵的稳态分布确定共识答案。在MMLU-Pro数据集上，每问题128样本时，PPV相比多数投票整体提升1.5个百分点，非平凡问题提升2.24个百分点，并给出闭式翻转条件。
Motivation: 多数投票作为多样本LLM推理的默认无监督聚合器，忽略了组内答案熵和组间推理几何信号，导致次优性能。
Method: PPV方法：每组样本保留与其熵成比例的权重，并将剩余权重按推理嵌入相似性分配给其他组；构建委托矩阵，其稳态分布对应共识答案。无需标签或训练。
Result: 在MMLU-Pro上（每问题128样本），PPV整体超越多数投票1.5个百分点，非平凡问题上超越2.24个百分点（McNemar p~1.0e-14）。两选项模型的闭式翻转条件在96.5%的非平凡问题上正确预测获胜者，预测的质量差距与真实差距相关性r=0.97。
Conclusion: 论文刻画了委托何时超越多数投票的精确条件，并证明无其他无监督集成方法能缩小与oracle的差距。

papers.title: The Cross-Architecture Substrate: A Domain-Transcendent, Calibration-Surviving Geometric Invariant of Modern Vision Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Different vision neural networks -- trained to classify, contrast, reconstruct, or match images to text -- should have correspondingly different internal representations. We report that they do not. After training, the top sixteen principal directions of variation inside thirteen modern vision encoders converge to the same sixteen-dimensional geometric object. We call this the cross-architecture substrate and study it with PCA, centred kernel alignment (CKA), and Pang 2026 calibration. The substrate transports across four visual domains (natural photographs, medical CT, satellite, microscopy) at median Procrustes-CKA 0.679, and across eight domains (adding sketches, depth, thermal infrared, astronomy) at 0.604, every pair >0.40. It survives Pang calibration globally (7.4x disc-vs-MAE separation, n=13,394) and locally (4.82-5.30, p<10^{-44}). It is not pixel statistics (0.263), not Gabor features (0.31), not a random projection (0.041), and emerges in the first 10% of training while accuracy keeps climbing. We deliver four applications: a label-free transferability filter beating LogME (3x faster, +0.15 Kendall-tau); a four-way domain detector (99.6% accuracy); a frozen low-shot probe (16 dims beat 768-dim DINOv2 by 3.78pp at N=50 labels per class); and a teacher-free distillation auxiliary matching trained-teacher KD on 33 pairs (7.56pp peak gain at 10% label fraction). The substrate does not cross modalities, does not help cross-paradigm distillation, and does not predict transfer quality (rho=0.08 against transfer accuracy).
papers.comment: 14 pages, 2 figures. 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文发现，经过训练的不同视觉神经网络（分类、对比、重建、图文匹配）的内部表示，其前16个主成分方向收敛到相同的16维几何不变量，称为跨架构基底。该基底在多个视觉领域（自然图像、医学CT、卫星、显微等）间传输，并经受住校准测试。它出现在训练早期，并提供标签无关的迁移性能过滤、域检测、低样本探测等应用，但无法跨模态或跨范式蒸馏。
Motivation: 视觉神经网络因其训练目标不同（分类、对比等）应具有不同的内部表示，但论文报告它们在主成分方向上惊人地收敛到同一几何对象，挑战了现有认知。
Method: 使用PCA、中心核对齐（CKA）和Pang 2026校准，在13个现代视觉编码器上研究前16个主成分方向，并验证其跨域传输性及对校准的鲁棒性。
Result: 跨四个视觉域的中位数Procrustes-CKA为0.679，跨八个域为0.604；全局校准下区分度7.4倍，局部4.82-5.30；基底在训练前10%出现而准确率继续上升。应用上，标签无关过滤比LogME快3倍且Kendall-tau提升0.15，四路域检测准确率99.6%，16维低样本探测超越768维DINOv2 3.78个百分点，无教师蒸馏辅助获得7.56个百分点的峰值增益。
Conclusion: 论文强调基底的存在及其应用潜力，但指出它不跨模态、不帮助跨范式蒸馏，也不预测迁移质量（rho=0.08）。

papers.title: Online KL-Regularized Reinforcement Learning with Function Approximation under Misspecification
papers.abstract_en: We study KL-regularized contextual bandits and episodic reinforcement learning (RL) under general function approximation with model misspecification. Existing guarantees rely on realizability and therefore do not extend to misspecified models, where classical regret bounds may fail. This work introduces KL misspecification formulations for contextual bandits and episodic RL and analyzes regression-based algorithms with Gibbs policy updates. High-probability KL-regret guarantees with explicit misspecification terms are established, recovering the standard realizable KL-regularized setting as a special case.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在模型误设定下，基于函数近似的KL正则化上下文赌博机和情节强化学习问题。提出了KL误设定形式化定义，并分析了基于回归的Gibbs策略更新算法，给出了含显式误设定项的高概率KL遗憾界，标准可实现的KL正则化情形作为特例被恢复。
Motivation: 现有KL正则化强化学习保证建立在可实现性假设上，无法推广到模型误设定的实际场景，经典遗憾界在此情况下失效。
Method: 针对上下文赌博机和情节强化学习分别引入KL误设定形式化定义，设计基于回归的算法并结合Gibbs策略更新，推导高概率KL遗憾界，其中包含显式的误设定项。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称所获遗憾界在误设定下仍有效，且可实现情形可作为特例恢复。
Conclusion: 本研究理论上将KL正则化强化学习扩展到模型误设定场景，为实际应用中放松可实现性假设提供了理论依据。

papers.title: Student Capacity Moderates Knowledge Distillation Effectiveness: A Systematic Study Across ResNet Teacher-Student Pairs on CIFAR-10
papers.abstract_en: We investigate how teacher-student capacity relationships modulate knowledge distillation (KD) effectiveness in ResNet-based image classification on CIFAR-10. Across four teacher-student pairs (R50->R18, R34->R18, R50->R34, and R101->R34) we compare Logit-KD and Feature-KD under a strict evaluation protocol: hyperparameters and checkpoints are selected on a held-out validation split, selected configurations are re-run with five seeds, and the test set is used exclusively for final reporting. Beyond accuracy, we measure distillation fidelity directly via teacher-student agreement and KL divergence. We report four findings. First, the student-capacity pattern survives the corrected protocol at reduced magnitude: the only statistically significant gains occur for R34 students under Feature-KD (+0.19 and +0.21 pp, p<0.05), in two pairs whose teachers differ two-fold in parameters but not in accuracy, localizing the moderating variable on the student side, while no KD gain for R18 students is distinguishable from zero. Second, Feature-KD matches or outperforms Logit-KD in all four pairs, and its students land closer to the teacher's output distribution (KL at T=1) than Logit-KD students despite never observing teacher logits. Third, top-1 teacher-student agreement is flat across all pairs, decoupling fidelity from accuracy gains. Fourth, architecture dominates KD: correcting the ResNet stem for 32x32 inputs is worth +5.5 to +7.2 pp, more than 25x the largest KD gain. We also retract an attribution made in v1: a controlled re-run shows the reported gradient-clipping bug had no measurable effect, and v1's larger gains are explained by test-set selection. Code and results: github.com/umutonuryasar/kd-capacity-gap (tag v2.0).
papers.comment: v2: replaces test-set hyperparameter selection with a held-out validation protocol; 5-seed final runs; adds a fourth teacher-student pair (R101->R34), fidelity metrics, and a measured stem ablation; retracts v1's attribution of Feature-KD underperformance to a gradient-clipping bug. Code: github.com/umutonuryasar/kd-capacity-gap
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了在CIFAR-10上使用ResNet教师-学生对进行知识蒸馏时，教师与学生容量关系对蒸馏效果的影响。通过四个教师-学生对（R50->R18, R34->R18, R50->R34, R101->R34）比较Logit-KD和Feature-KD，采用严格的评估协议。主要发现包括：学生容量模式在修正协议下依然存在但幅度减小，Feature-KD在R34学生上取得统计显著的增益，而R18学生无显著提升；Feature-KD在输出分布上更接近教师；架构主导蒸馏效果，修正ResNet主干带来的提升远大于蒸馏增益。
Motivation: 现有知识蒸馏研究常忽略教师-学生容量差异对蒸馏效果的调节作用，且评估协议不严格控制验证集选择，可能引入偏差。
Method: 采用严格的评估协议：在分离的验证集上选择超参数和检查点，用五个种子重新运行选定配置，测试集仅用于最终报告。除了准确率，还通过教师-学生一致性和KL散度直接测量蒸馏保真度。
Result: 仅Feature-KD在R34学生上取得统计显著的准确率提升（+0.19和+0.21个百分点，p<0.05），而R18学生无增益；Feature-KD在所有对中匹配或优于Logit-KD，且学生输出分布更接近教师；教师-学生一致性在所有对中持平；架构修正带来+5.5到+7.2个百分点提升，远大于最大蒸馏增益。
Conclusion: 学生容量是调节知识蒸馏效果的关键变量，但增益有限且仅发生于中等容量学生；架构改进比蒸馏方法更有效；蒸馏保真度与准确率增益脱钩。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 仅Feature-KD在R34学生上取得统计显著的准确率提升（+0.19和+0.21个百分点，p<0.05），而R18学生无增益；Feature-KD在所有对中匹配或优于Logit-KD，且学生输出分布更接近教师；教师-学生一致性在所有对中持平；架构修正带来+5.5到+7.2个百分点提升，远大于最大蒸馏增益。
summary_sections.conclusion: 学生容量是调节知识蒸馏效果的关键变量，但增益有限且仅发生于中等容量学生；架构改进比蒸馏方法更有效；蒸馏保真度与准确率增益脱钩。

papers.title: Incantation: Natural Language as the Action Interface for Multi-Entity Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: Modern interactive video world models have achieved impressive visual fidelity, yet lack fine-grained multi-entity control and cross-entity, cross-world generalization. We trace this gap to the action interface: standard control protocols (e.g. animation IDs, device inputs, scene-level captions) bind action semantics to specific entities or engines at design time. We propose natural language as the interface to unlock expressiveness that no prior interface can achieve, and we present Incantation, the first interactive video world model with per-latent-frame (0.25 s) natural-language conditioning that supports simultaneous multi-entity control and concept-level cross-entity transfer beyond any fixed rendering pipeline. We pair a pretrained bidirectional video backbone with frame-local text cross-attention, and enable real-time long-horizon streaming through ODE-initialized Self-Forcing distillation with a RoPE-decoupled sliding KV-cache. We surpass the Action-Index baseline on cross-entity transfer (89% vs. 43%) and out-of-vocabulary prompts (90% vs. 0%), and our 2-step student sustains 19.7 FPS at 480p with stable FVD over 2-hour rollouts. We further apply the same architecture and training recipe to The King of Fighters, changing only the per-entity action vocabulary slots. We have released a preview subset of the Incantation dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/zhush/incantation-elden-ring-scenes, containing manually collected Elden Ring player-boss combat clips with structured action-oriented metadata. Larger-scale Elden Ring and KOF data will be released with the full project.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Incantation，首个使用每潜在帧（0.25秒）自然语言条件化的交互式视频世界模型，支持多实体同时控制和跨实体概念转移。通过预训练双向视频骨干网络与帧级文本交叉注意力，以及 ODE 初始化的 Self-Forcing 蒸馏和 RoPE 解耦滑动 KV 缓存实现实时长时序流。在跨实体转移和词汇外提示上超越 Action-Index 基线，2 步学生模型在 480p 下达到 19.7 FPS，且 2 小时滚动 FVD 稳定。
Motivation: 现代交互式视频世界模型缺乏细粒度多实体控制和跨实体、跨世界泛化。作者将问题归因于动作接口：标准控制协议将动作语义绑定到特定实体或引擎。
Method: 提出自然语言作为动作接口，并设计 Incantation 模型。采用预训练双向视频骨干网络，结合帧级文本交叉注意力。通过 ODE 初始化的 Self-Forcing 蒸馏和 RoPE 解耦滑动 KV 缓存实现实时长时序流。
Result: 在跨实体转移任务上达到 89%（Action-Index 基线 43%），词汇外提示 90%（基线 0%）。2 步学生模型在 480p 下达到 19.7 FPS，2 小时滚动 FVD 稳定。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法可应用于其他游戏（如拳皇），仅需更改每实体动作词汇槽。即将发布大规模数据。

papers.title: Selective Safety Steering via Value-Filtered Decoding
papers.abstract_en: While large language models (LLMs) are trained to align with human values, their generations may still violate safety constraints. A growing line of work addresses this problem by modifying the model's sampling policy at decoding time using a safety reward. However, existing decoding-time steering methods often intervene unnecessarily, modifying generations that would have been safe under the base model. Such unnecessary interventions are undesirable, as they can distort key properties of the base model such as helpfulness, fluency, style, and coherence. We propose a new test-time steering method designed to reduce such unnecessary interventions while improving the safety of unsafe responses. Our approach filters tokens using a value-based safety criterion and provides an explicit bound on the probability of false interventions. A single threshold hyperparameter controls this bound, allowing practitioners to trade off higher rates of unnecessary intervention for better output safety. Across multiple datasets and experiments, we show that our value-filtered decoding method outperforms existing baselines, achieving better trade-offs between safety, helpfulness, and similarity to the base model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对现有解码时安全干预方法过度修改本已安全生成的问题，提出一种基于值过滤的解码方法（value-filtered decoding），通过值安全标准过滤token，并给出误干预的概率上界。实验表明，该方法在安全、有用性和与基础模型相似性之间实现了更优的权衡。
Motivation: 现有解码时安全干预方法常不必要地修改了本已安全的生成内容，损害了基础模型的有用性、流畅性和风格等关键属性。
Method: 提出基于值的安全标准过滤token，并通过一个阈值超参数控制误干预的概率上界，允许实践者在安全性和不必要干预之间进行权衡。
Result: 在多个数据集上，该方法优于现有基线，实现了安全性、有用性和与基础模型相似性之间更好的权衡。
Conclusion: 该方法通过显式的概率界和单阈值控制，减少了不必要的安全干预，为解码时安全引导提供了更精细的控制。

papers.title: TriP: A Triangle Puzzle Approach to Robust Translation Averaging
papers.abstract_en: Translation averaging aims to recover camera locations from pairwise relative translation directions and is a fundamental component of global Structure-from-Motion pipelines. The problem is challenging because direction measurements contain no distance information, making the estimation problem highly ill-conditioned and highly sensitive to corrupted observations. In this paper, we propose TriP, a triangle-based framework for robust translation averaging. TriP first infers local relative edge scales from triangle geometry, and then synchronizes the scales of overlapping triangles in the logarithmic domain to recover globally consistent edge lengths and camera locations. By leveraging higher-order consistency across triangles, the proposed method is robust to adversarial, cycle-consistent, and other structured corruptions. In addition, TriP avoids the collapse issue without requiring any extra anti-collapse constraints, since log-scale synchronization excludes the degenerate zero-scale solution by construction. These structural advantages enable a particularly strong theory for exact location recovery. On the practical side, TriP is fully parallelizable, computationally efficient, and naturally scalable to graphs with millions of cameras. Moreover, it outperforms all previous translation averaging methods by a large margin on both synthetic and real datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于三角形的鲁棒翻译平均框架TriP，用于从成对相对平移方向恢复相机位置。该方法通过三角几何推断局部相对边尺度，然后在对数域同步重叠三角形的尺度，以恢复全局一致的边长度和相机位置。TriP具有理论上的精确恢复保证，避免了塌陷问题，且完全可并行化，适用于大规模图。实验表明，在合成和真实数据集上，TriP大幅优于所有先前方法。
Motivation: 翻译平均问题中方向测量缺乏距离信息，导致估计高度病态且对异常值敏感，现有方法难以同时处理鲁棒性和效率。
Method: TriP框架包括两步：首先从三角形几何推断局部相对边尺度；然后在对数域同步重叠三角形的尺度，通过避免零尺度解自然解决塌陷问题，无需额外约束。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，TriP在所有基准方法中表现最佳，大幅超越先前方法，且具有理论上的精确恢复保证和高效并行性。
Conclusion: TriP通过高阶一致性鲁棒对抗各种结构化污染，完全并行，可扩展到百万相机图，为全局SfM提供有效的翻译平均解决方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Eulerian Motion Guidance: Robust Image Animation via Bidirectional Geometric Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in image animation have utilized diffusion models to breathe life into static images. However, existing controllable frameworks typically rely on Lagrangian motion guidance, where optical flow is estimated relative to the initial frame. This paper revisits the same optical-flow primitive through a more local supervision design: we use adjacent-frame Eulerian motion fields to guide generation, where the motion signal always describes a short temporal hop. This shift enables parallelized training and provides bounded-error supervision throughout the generation process. To mitigate the drift artifacts common in adjacent frame generation, we introduce a Bidirectional Geometric Consistency mechanism, which computes a forward-backward cycle check to mathematically identify and mask occluded regions, preventing the model from learning incorrect warping objectives. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach accelerates training, preserves temporal coherence, and reduces dynamic artifacts compared to reference-based baselines. The code, model, and data have been made available at https://nguyentthong.github.io/eulerian/
papers.comment: Accepted by ACM MM 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/nguyentthong/eulerian_motion_guidance
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于欧拉运动引导的图像动画方法，使用相邻帧运动场指导生成，并通过双向几何一致性机制减轻漂移伪影。实验表明该方法加速训练、保持时间一致性并减少动态伪影。
Motivation: 现有可控图像动画框架通常依赖拉格朗日运动引导（基于初始帧的光流），存在误差累积和训练效率低的问题。
Method: 采用相邻帧欧拉运动场作为监督信号，实现并行化训练和有界误差监督；引入双向几何一致性机制，通过前向后向循环检查识别和遮挡被遮挡区域，防止学习错误变形目标。
Result: 实验表明该方法相比基于参考帧的基线方法加速训练、保持时间一致性并减少动态伪影。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法通过欧拉运动引导和双向几何一致性有效解决了图像动画中的漂移问题，并开源了代码和数据。

papers.title: Assert, don't describe: Linguistic features that shift LLM reasoning about animal welfare
papers.abstract_en: Animal-welfare advocates produce a lot of writing, and increasingly that writing trains the language models that millions of people then ask about animal welfare. Using vocabulary-matched stance-contrast probes on a held-out animal-welfare benchmark, we measure how each of ten linguistic features changes Llama-3.2-1B's preference for pro-animal-welfare reasoning when used as fine-tuning data. Eight of the ten features produce statistically significant shifts. Seven move the model toward stronger pro-animal-welfare reasoning: assertive certainty, explicit moral vocabulary, emotion words, evaluative claims, narrative structure, depicted harm severity, and immediate temporal framing. Two move it the other way: hedged language and concrete sensory description both dilute the pro-animal-welfare stance. First-person perspective has no statistically significant effect. The practical recommendation for anyone writing animal-welfare text that may end up in LLM training corpora: assert a position rather than describe a scene neutrally. The features that shift the model are the ones that make the writer's position explicit; the features that dilute it hold animal-welfare content but withhold stance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了十种语言学特征在作为微调数据时如何改变LLM对动物福利推理的立场。通过词汇匹配的立场对比探针，在保留的动物福利基准上测量了Llama-3.2-1B的偏好变化，发现八个特征有显著影响：七个增强支持动物福利的推理，两个稀释立场。建议写作时明确断言立场而非中性描述。
Motivation: 现有LLM训练数据中包含大量动物福利文本，但不同语言学特征对模型立场的影响未知，需要系统衡量以指导写作。
Method: 使用词汇匹配的立场对比探针，在保留的动物福利基准上，测量十种语言学特征作为微调数据时对Llama-3.2-1B偏好变化的影响。
Result: 八个特征有显著影响：七个增强支持动物福利推理（如assertive certainty、explicit moral vocabulary等），两个稀释立场（hedged language、concrete sensory description），第一人称无显著效果。
Conclusion: 建议写作者明确断言立场而非中性描述，因为影响模型的特征是那些明确表达作者立场的特征。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Helpfulness Hurts: Domain-Dependent Degradation of Mid-Trained Compassion Values Under Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Standard post-training pipelines apply supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) to make language models helpful, but these processes may inadvertently degrade values instilled during pre-training. We investigate whether the domain of post-training data differentially affects the retention of animal compassion values in a Llama 3.1 8B model mid-trained on compassion-oriented synthetic data, using both SFT (helpfulness via Dolly-15k vs. coding via Magicoder-110K) and GRPO (helpfulness via RLHFlow vs. coding via Magicoder), evaluated on the ANIMA 2.2 benchmark and MORU benchmark (Moral Reasoning Under Uncertainty). Helpfulness training significantly degrades animal compassion relative to coding training on ANIMA (SFT: 35.7% vs. 65.2%; GRPO: 18.7% vs. 32.0%), replicating across two independent helpfulness datasets and two training paradigms. On English MORU items, helpfulness training degrades general moral reasoning by 25.5 percentage points (46.4% vs. 71.9%), a striking gap that rivals the compassion effect in magnitude. However, this effect does not transfer cross-lingually: on the multilingual MORU benchmark, the domain effect disappears (SFT: 52.3% vs. 51.2%). In contrast, the animal compassion effect transfers consistently across languages, with Magicoder's ANIMA percentage-point gain over the base model 4.5 times larger on non-English items than English items. This divergence suggests that values instilled through mid-training are encoded more deeply and cross-lingually than reasoning improvements from domain-specific post-training. These results suggest that, for labs building on value-laden mid-training, coding-domain post-training may better preserve mid-trained values than helpfulness post-training without harming general reasoning capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究标准后训练流程（SFT和RL）是否会无意中降低预训练期间灌输的同情心价值观。实验使用Llama 3.1 8B模型，对比有用性训练和编码训练，发现有用性训练显著降低动物同情心评分，对英语道德推理也有影响，但跨语言转移效果不同。
Motivation: 后训练虽然旨在提升模型的有用性，但可能无意中削弱预训练阶段灌输的价值观，需要研究不同领域后训练数据对价值保留的影响。
Method: 对Llama 3.1 8B模型进行同情心导向的中期训练，然后分别使用SFT（Dolly-15k用于有用性 vs Magicoder-110K用于编码）和GRPO（RLHFlow用于有用性 vs Magicoder用于编码）进行后训练，在ANIMA 2.2和MORU基准上评估。
Result: 有用性后训练相比编码后训练，在ANIMA上动物同情心显著降低（SFT: 35.7% vs 65.2%; GRPO: 18.7% vs 32.0%）。在英语MORU上，有用性训练降低一般道德推理25.5个百分点（46.4% vs 71.9%），但跨语言效果消失。而动物同情心效果跨语言一致转移。
Conclusion: 对于建立在价值导向中期训练基础上的实验室，编码领域后训练可能比有用性后训练更好地保留中期训练的价值观，同时不损害一般推理能力。

papers.title: Small edits, large models: How Wikipedia advocacy shapes LLM values
papers.abstract_en: Can a small group of volunteers shape how AI systems discuss animal welfare, just by editing Wikipedia? We show that they can. Wikipedia appears in nearly every major language model training dataset and is weighted more heavily than web-crawled text. The Pro-Animal Wikipedians (PAW), a group of advocates who add sourced animal welfare content to relevant articles, have made 125 edits across 115 pages. Using gradient-based data attribution (Bergson; MAGIC), we traced how these edits influence language model behavior. TrackStar retrieval attribution on Llama 3.1 8B found that PAW-edited sections made up 68 percent of the highest-attributed documents for animal welfare queries (p < 0.0001) but only 52 percent for unrelated queries about the same companies (p = 0.53): the model links PAW content specifically to animal welfare topics, not to the entities in general. MAGIC counterfactual influence estimation on Llama-3.2-1B, run across five random training-order seeds, gave the same picture even more sharply: in every seed, the top-10 most influential documents on animal welfare queries were all PAW edits (10 of 10, 5 of 5 seeds), while on general queries the same top-10 sat at chance (4 to 6 of 10). Mean PAW influence exceeded mean control influence on animal welfare queries with p < 0.0001 in every seed, an effect 6 to 30 times larger than on general queries. Leave-subset-out validation gave Spearman rho = 1.00 for all 10 runs. When we fine-tuned separate models on PAW content versus control content, each model performed better specifically on the type of text it was trained on: the PAW-trained model cut perplexity on animal welfare text from 12.4 to 8.4, while the control-trained model cut perplexity on control text from 16.1 to 11.4. A small, coordinated Wikipedia editing campaign therefore measurably shapes how language models handle the topics those edits address.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一小群维基百科编辑者（PAW）对大型语言模型（LLM）价值观的影响，通过梯度数据归因和反事实估计等方法，证明仅125次编辑即可使模型在动物福利相关查询中显著偏向PAW内容，而在不相关查询上无显著影响。
Motivation: 探讨小规模、有组织的维基百科编辑活动是否能够系统性地影响LLM对特定话题（如动物福利）的输出价值观，挑战了模型训练数据中立性的假设。
Method: 使用Bergson梯度数据归因和MAGIC反事实影响估计，结合TrackStar检索归因，在Llama 3.1 8B和Llama-3.2-1B模型上分析PAW编辑的文本对模型输出的影响，并进行了留子集验证和微调实验。
Result: PAW编辑的文档在动物福利查询中占最高归因文档的68%（p<0.0001），而不相关查询中仅52%（p=0.53）；MAGIC显示5个随机种子中，动物福利查询的前10个最影响文档全部来自PAW编辑，而控制查询接近随机；PAW微调模型在动物福利文本上的困惑度从12.4降至8.4，控制模型在控制文本上从16.1降至11.4。
Conclusion: 少数志愿者的维基百科协调编辑可以显著塑造LLM对相关话题的处理方式，强调了训练数据中隐含的社会价值观对模型行为的影响。

papers.title: Graph Construction and Matching for Imperative Programs using Neural and Structural Methods
papers.abstract_en: Reusing verification artefacts requires identifying structural and semantic similarities across programs and their specifications. In this paper, we focus on graph construction as a foundational step toward this goal. We present a pipeline that converts imperative programs and their annotations into typed, attributed graphs. Our experiments cover datasets including C with ACSL, Java with JML, and Dafny programs. The pipeline integrates abstract syntax tree parsing with semantic embeddings derived from models such as SentenceTransformer and CodeBERT. This enables the generation of graph representations that capture both structural relationships and semantic context. Our results show that consistent graph representations can be constructed across different languages and annotation styles. This work provides a practical basis for future steps in semantic enrichment and approximate graph matching for scalable verification artefact reuse.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个将命令式程序及其注解转换为带类型、带属性的图表示的管线，集成抽象语法树解析和语义嵌入（如SentenceTransformer、CodeBERT），在C（ACSL）、Java（JML）和Dafny程序数据集上验证了表示一致性。为验证工件重用的语义增强和近似图匹配奠定基础。
Motivation: 验证工件重用需要识别程序及其规约之间的结构和语义相似性，但现有方法缺少统一的图表示方式。
Method: 构建了一个从源码到带类型属性图的转换管线，结合抽象语法树解析和基于Transformer的语义嵌入（SentenceTransformer、CodeBERT），生成融合结构关系与语义上下文的图表示。
Result: 实验表明，该管线能在不同语言（C、Java、Dafny）和注解风格上生成一致的图表示。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了未来在语义增强和近似图匹配方面实现可扩展验证工件重用的实用基础。

papers.title: Ideological Bias in LLMs' Economic Causal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Do large language models (LLMs) exhibit systematic ideological bias when reasoning about economic causal effects? As LLMs are increasingly used in policy analysis and economic reporting, where directionally correct causal judgments are essential, this question has direct practical stakes. We present a systematic evaluation by extending the EconCausal benchmark with ideology-contested cases - instances where intervention-oriented (pro-government) and market-oriented (pro-market) perspectives predict divergent causal signs. From 10,490 causal triplets (treatment-outcome pairs with empirically verified effect directions) derived from top-tier economics and finance journals, we identify 1,056 ideology-contested instances and evaluate 20 state-of-the-art LLMs on their ability to predict empirically supported causal directions. We find that ideology-contested items are consistently harder than non-contested ones, and that across 18 of 20 models, accuracy is systematically higher when the empirically verified causal sign aligns with intervention-oriented expectations than with market-oriented ones. Moreover, when models err, their incorrect predictions disproportionately lean intervention-oriented, and this directional skew is not eliminated by one-shot in-context prompting. These results highlight that LLMs are not only less accurate on ideologically contested economic questions, but systematically less reliable in one ideological direction than the other, underscoring the need for direction-aware evaluation in high-stakes economic and policy settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了大语言模型（LLMs）在经济因果推理中是否存在意识形态偏见。通过扩展EconCausal基准，引入意识形态争议案例（即干预导向与市场导向预测不同因果符号的实例），从顶级经济金融期刊中提取10,490个因果三元组，识别出1,056个争议实例，并测试了20个最新LLM。结果显示，争议项目难度更高，且18/20的模型在实证支持的因果方向与干预导向一致时准确率更高，错误预测也偏向干预导向。
Motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地用于政策分析和经济报告，方向正确的因果判断至关重要，但模型是否表现出系统性意识形态偏见尚未被充分研究。
Method: 扩展EconCausal基准，加入意识形态争议案例；从顶级期刊提取10,490个因果三元组并识别1,056个争议实例；评估20个LLM在预测实证支持的因果方向上的表现。
Result: 争议项目准确率显著低于非争议项目；18/20模型在因果方向与干预导向一致时准确率更高；错误预测偏向干预导向，且单次上下文提示无法消除该偏差。
Conclusion: LLM在意识形态争议的经济问题上不仅准确性更低，且在特定方向上系统性更不可靠，强调了在高风险经济和政策环境中需要方向感知的评估。

papers.title: VecHeart: Holistic Four-Chamber Cardiac Anatomy Modeling via Hybrid VecSets
papers.abstract_en: Accurate cardiac anatomy modeling requires the model to be able to handle intricate interrelations among structures. In this paper, we propose VecHeart, a unified framework for holistic reconstruction and generation of four-chamber cardiac structures. To overcome the limitations of current feed-forward implicit methods, specifically their restriction to single-object modeling and their neglect of inter-part correlations, we introduce Hybrid Part Transformer, which leverages part-specific learnable queries and interleaved attention to capture complex inter-chamber dependencies. Furthermore, we propose Anatomical Completion Masking and Modality Alignment strategies, enabling the model to infer complete four-chamber structures from partial, sparse, or noisy observations, even when certain anatomical parts are entirely missing. VecHeart also seamlessly extends to 3D+t dynamic mesh sequence generation, demonstrating exceptional versatility. Experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, maintaining high-fidelity reconstruction across diverse challenging scenarios. Code is available at https://github.com/Scalsol/VecHeart.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VecHeart，一个用于四腔心脏结构整体重建与生成的统一框架。通过引入混合部分 Transformer (Hybrid Part Transformer)，利用部分特定的可学习查询和交错注意力来捕捉腔室间的复杂依赖关系，并设计了解剖补全掩码和模态对齐策略，使模型能从部分、稀疏或噪声观测中推断完整结构。实验表明，该方法在多种挑战性场景下达到了高保真重建的最优性能。
Motivation: 现有前馈隐式方法局限于单目标建模，忽略部件间相关性，难以处理心脏四腔间的复杂相互关系。
Method: 提出混合部分 Transformer，结合部分特定可学习查询与交错注意力以捕捉腔室间依赖；引入解剖补全掩码和模态对齐策略，支持从不完整观测中推断完整结构；框架可扩展至3D+t动态网格序列生成。
Result: 在多种挑战性场景下达到最优性能，保持高保真重建。
Conclusion: VecHeart 为四腔心脏解剖的整体建模提供了统一框架，并展示了从稀疏/噪声观测中补全结构的能力，但摘要未提及具体数值和局限性。

papers.title: Agentic Forecasting using Sequential Bayesian Updating of Linguistic Beliefs
papers.abstract_en: We present the Bayesian Linguistic Forecaster (BLF), an agentic system for binary forecasting that achieves state-of-the-art performance on the ForecastBench benchmark. The system is built on three ideas. (1) Linguistic belief state: a semi-structured representation combining numerical probability estimates with natural-language evidence summaries, updated by the LLM at each step of an iterative tool-use loop. This contrasts with the common approach of appending all retrieved evidence to an ever-growing, unstructured context. (2) Hierarchical multi-trial aggregation: running $K$ independent trials and combining them using logit-space averaging shrinkage with a data-dependent prior. (3) Hierarchical calibration: Platt scaling with a hierarchical prior, which avoids over-shrinking extreme predictions for sources with skewed base rates. On 400 questions from the ForecastBench leaderboard, BLF outperforms all the top public methods, including Cassi, GPT-5, Grok~4.20, and Foresight-32B. Careful ablation studies, using mixed effects analysis to control for question variability (which accounts for 62\% of the variance in performance), reveals that all 3 components contribute to the overall gains, but some components matter more than others, depending on the base LLM, and the setting (e.g.\ with or without a crowd prior). All our experiments are based on a robust back-testing framework which we develop, which has a leakage rate below 1.5\%, and may be of independent interest.
papers.comment: v4 adds 2 new appendices: app J evaluates a "generative" Bayesian alternative to BLF (which does worse than the "discriminative" approached used by BLF), and app K sketches how to do value of information computation to decide when to stop searching (although this idea has not been tried). v4 also adds a few more recent references

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出贝叶斯语言预测器（BLF），一种用于二元预测的智能体系统，在ForecastBench基准上达到当前最优性能。系统结合三个核心思想：语言信念状态（半结构化表示，迭代更新）、分层多试验聚合（logit空间平均收缩）、以及分层校准（带分层先验的Platt缩放）。在400个问题上优于所有公开方法，包括Cassi、GPT-5等。消融实验表明三个组件均有贡献，但影响大小取决于基础LLM和设置。
Motivation: 现有预测系统通常将检索到的证据追加到不断增长的无结构上下文中，导致效率低下且缺乏结构化信念更新。
Method: 提出贝叶斯语言预测器（BLF），包含：1）语言信念状态：结合数值概率估计与自然语言证据摘要的半结构化表示，由LLM在迭代工具使用循环中更新；2）分层多试验聚合：运行K个独立试验，使用带数据相关先验的logit空间平均收缩进行组合；3）分层校准：使用分层先验的Platt缩放，避免对基率偏斜源的极端预测过度收缩。
Result: 在ForecastBench的400个问题上，BLF优于所有顶级公开方法，包括Cassi、GPT-5、Grok 4.20和Foresight-32B。消融实验（使用混合效应分析控制问题变异性，该变异性占性能方差的62%）显示所有三个组件均有贡献，但贡献大小取决于基础LLM和设置（如是否使用群体先验）。
Conclusion: BLF为二元预测提供了一种有效的智能体框架，通过结构化信念更新和多层次聚合提升性能。实验基于稳健的回测框架（泄漏率低于1.5%），该框架本身可能具有独立价值。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出贝叶斯语言预测器（BLF），一种用于二元预测的智能体系统，在ForecastBench基准上达到当前最优性能。系统结合三个核心思想：语言信念状态（半结构化表示，迭代更新）、分层多试验聚合（logit空间平均收缩）、以及分层校准（带分层先验的Platt缩放）。在400个问题上优于所有公开方法，包括Cassi、GPT-5等。消融实验表明三个组件均有贡献，但影响大小取决于基础LLM和设置。

papers.title: AeroRAG: Structured Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented LLM for Fine-Grained Aerial Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent progress in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), reliable visual question answering in aerial scenes remains challenging. In such scenes, task-critical evidence is often carried by small objects, explicit quantities, coarse locations, and inter-object relations, whereas conventional dense visual-token representations are not well aligned with these structured semantics. To address this interface mismatch, we propose AeroRAG, a scene-graph-guided multimodal retrieval-augmented generation framework for visual question answering. The framework first converts an input image into structured visual knowledge, including object categories, quantities, spatial locations, and semantic relations, and then retrieves query-relevant semantic chunks to construct compact prompts for a text-based large language model. Rather than relying on direct reasoning over dense visual tokens, our method introduces a more explicit intermediate interface between perception and language reasoning. Experiments on the AUG aerial dataset and the general-domain VG-150 benchmark show consistent improvements over six strong MLLM baselines, with the largest gains observed in dense aerial scenes and relation-sensitive reasoning. We further evaluate the framework on VQAv2 to verify that the proposed interface remains compatible with standard visual reasoning settings. These results suggest that structured retrieval is a practical design direction for deployment-oriented and grounded visual reasoning systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对航空场景中多模态大模型在视觉问答时难以处理小物体、数量、位置和关系等结构化语义的问题，提出AeroRAG框架，将图像转换为场景图形式的结构化知识（类别、数量、空间位置、关系），检索查询相关语义块构建紧凑提示给文本LLM，从而避免直接对密集视觉token推理。在AUG航空数据集和VG-150通用基准上，该方法在六个强MLLM基线上取得一致提升，尤其在密集航空场景和关系敏感推理中增益最大，并在VQAv2上验证了兼容性。
Motivation: 现有MLLM在航空场景中依赖密集视觉token表示，与小物体、显式数量、粗略位置和物体间关系等结构化语义不匹配，导致推理不可靠。
Method: 提出AeroRAG：先利用场景图检测将输入图像转换为结构化视觉知识（类别、数量、空间位置、语义关系），再根据问题检索相关语义块，构建紧凑文本提示输入给文本大语言模型。
Result: 在AUG航空数据集和VG-150基准上，AeroRAG在所有六个MLLM基线上表现更优，密集航空场景和关系敏感推理的提升最大；在VQAv2上验证了该接口与标准视觉推理的兼容性。
Conclusion: 结构化检索为面向部署和接地视觉推理系统提供了可行的设计方向，通过显式的中间接口弥合感知与语言推理的鸿沟。

papers.title: BARD: Bridging AutoRegressive and Diffusion Vision-Language Models Via Highly Efficient Progressive Block Merging and Stage-Wise Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive vision-language models (VLMs) deliver strong multimodal capability, but their token-by-token decoding imposes a fundamental inference bottleneck. Diffusion VLMs offer a more parallel decoding paradigm, yet directly converting a pretrained autoregressive VLM into a large-block diffusion VLM (dVLM) often leads to substantial quality degradation. In this work, we present BARD, a simple and effective bridging framework that converts a pretrained autoregressive VLM into a same-architecture, decoding-efficient dVLM. Our approach combines progressive supervised block merging, which gradually enlarges the decoding block size, with stage-wise intra-dVLM distillation from a fixed small-block diffusion anchor to recover performance lost at larger blocks. We further incorporate a mixed noise scheduler to improve robustness and token revision during denoising, and memory-friendly training to enable efficient training on long multimodal sequences. A key empirical finding is that direct autoregressive-to-diffusion distillation is poorly aligned and can even hurt performance, whereas distillation within the diffusion regime is consistently effective. Experimental results show that, with $\leq$ 4.4M data, BARD-VL transfers strong multimodal capability from Qwen3-VL to a large-block dVLM. Remarkably, BARD-VL establishes a new SOTA among comparable-scale open dVLMs on our evaluation suite at both 4B and 8B scales. At the same time, BARD-VL achieves up to 3$\times$ decoding throughput speedup compared to the source model. Code is available at https://github.com/fudan-generative-vision/Bard-VL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BARD 框架，通过渐进式块合并和阶段式蒸馏，将预训练的自回归视觉语言模型（VLM）转换为相同架构但解码更高效的扩散 VLM（dVLM）。使用不超过 4.4M 数据，在 4B 和 8B 规模上达到开放 dVLM 的 SOTA，解码吞吐量提升最高 3 倍。关键发现是自回归到扩散的直接蒸馏效果差，而扩散内蒸馏持续有效。
Motivation: 自回归 VLM 逐 token 解码导致推理瓶颈，扩散 VLM 可并行解码，但直接将自回归 VLM 转换为大块扩散 VLM 会导致严重的质量下降。
Method: 结合渐进式有监督块合并（逐步增大解码块大小）和阶段式扩散内蒸馏（从小块扩散锚点恢复大块丢失的性能），并引入混合噪声调度器增强鲁棒性和 token 修正，以及内存友好训练以支持长多模态序列。
Result: 在 4B 和 8B 规模上，BARD-VL 在开放 dVLM 评估套件中达到新 SOTA，且与源模型相比解码吞吐量加速最高 3 倍。
Conclusion: 本文证明扩散内蒸馏是转换自回归 VLM 为高效 dVLM 的有效途径，所提框架能保持强多模态能力并显著提升解码效率。

papers.title: Rare Event Analysis via Stochastic Optimal Control
papers.abstract_en: Rare events such as conformational changes in biomolecules, phase transitions, and chemical reactions are central to the behavior of many physical systems, yet they are extremely difficult to study computationally because unbiased simulations seldom produce them. Transition Path Theory (TPT) provides a rigorous statistical framework for analyzing such events: it characterizes the ensemble of reactive trajectories between two designated metastable states (reactant and product), and its central object--the committor function, which gives the probability that the system will next reach the product rather than the reactant--encodes all essential kinetic and thermodynamic information. We introduce a framework that casts committor estimation as a stochastic optimal control (SOC) problem. In this formulation the committor defines a feedback control--proportional to the gradient of its logarithm--that actively steers trajectories toward the reactive region, thereby enabling efficient sampling of reactive paths. To solve the resulting hitting-time control problem we develop two complementary objectives: a direct backpropagation loss and a principled off-policy Value Matching loss, for which we establish first-order optimality guarantees. We further address metastability, which can trap controlled trajectories in intermediate basins, by introducing an alternative sampling process that preserves the reactive current while lowering effective energy barriers. On benchmark systems, the framework yields markedly more accurate committor estimates, reaction rates, and equilibrium constants than existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将稀有事件分析中的committor函数估计转化为随机最优控制（SOC）问题，通过反馈控制主动引导轨迹进入反应区域，从而高效采样反应路径。开发了直接反向传播损失和离策略值匹配损失两种目标，并针对亚稳态问题引入替代采样过程。在基准系统上，该方法比现有方法获得更准确的committor估计、反应速率和平衡常数。
Motivation: 稀有事件（如生物分子构象变化、相变、化学反应）在物理系统中至关重要，但无偏模拟极少产生这些事件，导致计算研究困难。现有方法（如过渡路径理论）依赖于committor函数，但准确估计committor具有挑战性。
Method: 将committor估计建模为随机最优控制问题，其中committor定义反馈控制（proportional to gradient of its logarithm），主动引导轨迹。提出两种互补目标：直接反向传播损失和离策略值匹配损失（带有最优性保证）。针对亚稳态陷阱，引入替代采样过程以降低有效能垒并保持反应流。
Result: 在基准系统上，该方法比现有方法得到更准确的committor估计、反应速率和平衡常数。
Conclusion: 该框架为稀有事件分析提供了有效的新途径，通过控制理论视角解决committor估计和反应路径采样问题。

papers.title: Pickalo: Leveraging 6D Pose Estimation for Low-Cost Industrial Bin Picking
papers.abstract_en: Bin picking in real industrial environments remains challenging due to severe clutter, occlusions, and the high cost of traditional 3D sensing setups. We present Pickalo, a modular 6D pose-based bin-picking pipeline built entirely on low-cost hardware. A wrist-mounted RGB-D camera actively explores the scene from multiple viewpoints, while raw stereo streams are processed with BridgeDepth to obtain refined depth maps suitable for accurate collision reasoning. Object instances are segmented with a Mask-RCNN model trained purely on photorealistic synthetic data and localized using the zero-shot SAM-6D pose estimator. A pose buffer module fuses multi-view observations over time, handling object symmetries and significantly reducing pose noise. Offline, we generate and curate large sets of antipodal grasp candidates per object; online, a utility-based ranking and fast collision checking are queried for the grasp planning. Deployed on a UR5e with a parallel-jaw gripper and an Intel RealSense D435i, Pickalo achieves up to 600 mean picks per hour with 96-99% grasp success and robust performance over 30-minute runs on densely filled euroboxes. Ablation studies demonstrate the benefits of enhanced depth estimation and of the pose buffer for long-term stability and throughput in realistic industrial conditions. Videos are available at https://mesh-iit.github.io/project-jl2-camozzi/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Pickalo 是一个基于低成本硬件的模块化 6D 姿态估计箱体抓取流水线，通过腕装 RGB-D 相机多视角主动探索、BridgeDepth 深度增强、Mask-RCNN 合成数据训练分割、SAM-6D 零样本姿态估计以及姿态缓冲区融合多视角信息，实现高成功率抓取。在 UR5e 机械臂和 RealSense D435i 上，平均每小时抓取 600 次，抓取成功率 96-99%，并在密集填充的欧元箱上稳定运行 30 分钟。
Motivation: 工业箱体抓取面临严重遮挡和杂乱，传统 3D 传感方案成本高昂，需要一种低成本的解决方案。
Method: 使用腕装 RGB-D 相机多视角扫描，以 BridgeDepth 增强深度图；Mask-RCNN 在合成数据上训练用于实例分割；SAM-6D 进行零样本 6D 姿态估计；设计姿态缓冲区融合多视角观测并处理对称性；离线生成抓取候选，在线通过效用排序和快速碰撞检查选择抓取。
Result: 在密集填充的欧元箱上，平均每小时抓取 600 次，抓取成功率 96-99%，30 分钟持续运行稳定。消融实验表明深度增强和姿态缓冲区对长期稳定性和吞吐量有益。
Conclusion: Pickalo 证明了仅使用低成本硬件和合成训练数据即可实现工业级箱体抓取性能，为低成本自动化提供了可行方案。

papers.title: ACES: Who Tests the Tests? Leave-One-Out AUC Consistency for Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Selecting LLM-generated code candidates using LLM-generated tests is challenging because the tests themselves may be incorrect. Existing methods either treat all tests equally or rely on ad-hoc heuristics to filter unreliable tests. Yet determining test correctness requires knowing which codes are correct, creating a \emph{circular dependency}. Our key insight is that we need not determine test correctness at all: \emph{test votes should rank, not merely count}. What matters is not how many codes pass a test, but whether the test can \emph{distinguish} correct from incorrect code. We break the circular dependency via leave-one-out evaluation: hold out one test, rank codes by their aggregate scores on all remaining tests, and measure whether the held-out test's pass/fail pattern agrees with this ranking. We formalize this agreement as the leave-one-out AUC~(LOO-AUC) and prove that the expected LOO-AUC is proportional to each test's ability to separate correct code from incorrect code. Building on this, we propose \textbf{ACES}~(\textbf{A}UC \textbf{C}onsist\textbf{E}ncy \textbf{S}coring) with two complementary variants: ACES-C provides closed-form weights that provably approximate the oracle in expectation under a mild assumption on average test quality; ACES-O drops this assumption and iteratively optimizes a differentiable LOO-AUC objective. Both operate solely on the binary pass matrix with negligible overhead, and achieve state-of-the-art Pass@$k$ on multiple code generation benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ACES方法，通过留一法AUC一致性评估LLM生成的测试用例质量，避免判断测试正确性的循环依赖。方法仅依赖代码-测试二元通过矩阵，计算开销低，在多个代码生成基准上取得最优Pass@k。
Motivation: 现有方法平等对待所有测试或依赖启发式过滤，但判断测试正确性需知道代码正确性，形成循环依赖。作者认为测试投票应排名而非计数，需衡量测试区分正确与错误代码的能力。
Method: 提出ACES，基于留一法：留出一个测试，用其余测试的聚合分数对代码排序，测量留出测试通过模式与排序的一致性（LOO-AUC）。证明期望LOO-AUC正比于测试区分能力。两个变体：ACES-C给出闭式权重近似oracle；ACES-O迭代优化可微LOO-AUC目标。
Result: 在多个代码生成基准上达到最先进的Pass@k结果。

papers.title: MG$^2$-RAG: Multi-Granularity Graph for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mitigates hallucinations in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), yet existing systems struggle with complex cross-modal reasoning. Flat vector retrieval often ignores structural dependencies, while current graph-based methods rely on costly ``translation-to-text'' pipelines that discard fine-grained visual information. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{MG$^2$-RAG}, a lightweight \textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{G}ranularity \textbf{G}raph \textbf{RAG} framework that jointly improves graph construction, modality fusion, and cross-modal retrieval. MG$^2$-RAG constructs a hierarchical multimodal knowledge graph by combining lightweight textual parsing with entity-driven visual grounding, enabling textual entities and visual regions to be fused into unified multimodal nodes that preserve atomic evidence. Building on this representation, we introduce a multi-granularity graph retrieval mechanism that aggregates dense similarities and propagates relevance across the graph to support structured multi-hop reasoning. Extensive experiments across four representative multimodal tasks (i.e., retrieval, knowledge-based VQA, reasoning, and classification) demonstrate that MG$^2$-RAG consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing graph construction overhead with an average 43.3$\times$ speedup and 23.9$\times$ cost reduction compared with advanced graph-based frameworks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MG$^2$-RAG，一个轻量级的多粒度图检索增强生成框架，通过构建层次化多模态知识图谱结合文本解析与实体驱动的视觉定位，并引入多粒度图检索机制，在四个多模态任务上取得最优性能，同时将图构建速度提升平均43.3倍、成本降低23.9倍。

Method: 构建层次化多模态知识图谱，融合文本实体与视觉区域为统一多模态节点；提出多粒度图检索机制，聚合稠密相似度并在图上传播相关性以支持结构化多跳推理。
Result: 在检索、知识型VQA、推理和分类四个多模态任务上达到最优性能，相比先进图方法，图构建速度提升43.3倍，成本降低23.9倍。
Conclusion: MG$^2$-RAG通过轻量级多粒度图设计有效提升跨模态检索与推理效率，大幅降低图构建开销。

papers.title: Critical Damping as a Momentum Schedule: Multi-Seed Validation, a Hybrid Recipe, and an Exhaustive Negative Result on Surgical Layer Selection
papers.abstract_en: The critical damping condition of the damped harmonic oscillator model of SGD with momentum (Qian, 1999) yields a momentum schedule with no tuned hyperparameters: mu(t) = 1 - 2*sqrt(alpha(t)). Across five seeds on ResNet-18/CIFAR-10 (200-epoch cosine schedule) it reaches 90% test accuracy 2.34x faster than constant mu=0.9 (range 1.71-2.86x, 5/5 seeds, one-sided paired t-test p=4e-4), at the cost of a real final-accuracy deficit of 0.46 pp (5/5 seeds, p=0.009). A short-schedule control rules out a schedule-length artifact: compressed baselines either pay 0.5-0.9 pp of accuracy or stay slower to 90% at equal accuracy. A hybrid recipe -- critical-damping momentum until 90%, then constant mu=0.9 -- removes the deficit and keeps the speedup: 95.45 +/- 0.05% final accuracy at 2.4x faster progress to 90% (n=5). The speedup generalizes across architectures (VGG-16 without skip connections: 1.72x, n=3); on CIFAR-100 early gains persist (2-4x to mid-training thresholds) but the accuracy cost grows (-1.7 pp), compressing the accuracy-matched gain to 1.14x. We also report an exhaustive negative result on surgical layer selection. Version 2 of this paper claimed that gradient attribution on misclassified images selects which layers to retrain; running the identical correction protocol on all 35 combinations of 3-of-7 layer groups ranks the selected triple 11th of 35 (exact p=0.31) -- no better than random. What survives is weaker but real: combinations containing the top-ranked layer outperform the rest (+6.2 vs -1.4 mean net error reduction), and the bottom of the gradient-norm ranking reliably predicts the most harmful interventions (down to -20 net errors). Gradient attribution on errors is a harm-avoidance signal, not a selector of repair targets. We release the full 35-combination landscape as a baseline for layer-selection claims.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 3 figures. v3: multi-seed validation (n=5), VGG-16 and CIFAR-100 generalization, short-schedule control, spectral grounding; layer-selection claim replaced by an exhaustive 35-combination negative result; all schedule results reproducible from raw data at https://github.com/anthroos/research
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首先验证了SGD动量中临界阻尼条件导出的动量调度 mu(t)=1-2*sqrt(alpha(t)) 在多个种子和架构上的效果：在ResNet-18/CIFAR-10上，该调度达到90%测试准确率的速度比恒定动量快2.34倍，但最终准确率低0.46个百分点。混合方案（达到90%后用恒定动量）消除了准确率差距并保持加速。此外，本文报告了一个关于外科层选择（surgical layer selection）的穷举负结果：之前声称基于梯度归因选择层的方法在35种3-of-7子集组合中排名第11，不优于随机；但梯度归因可作为避免有害干预的信号。
Motivation: 需要为SGD动量设计无需超参数的调度，并验证其有效性；同时，先前关于梯度归因指导层选择的声称缺乏严格验证。
Method: 利用临界阻尼条件推导动量调度 mu(t)=1-2*sqrt(alpha(t))，在多种子、多架构上验证；对层选择，穷举所有35种3/7组合，测试梯度归因选择的子集。
Result: 临界阻尼调度在ResNet-18上达到90%准确率速度提升2.34倍（5/5种子），混合方案达到95.45%最终准确率且速度提升2.4倍（5种子）。在VGG-16上加速1.72倍，CIFAR-100上加速但准确率下降。层选择方面，归因选择的子集排名11/35（p=0.31），不优于随机；但归因可识别最有害干预（误差减少-20）。
Conclusion: 临界阻尼动量调度是一种无需超参数的有效方案，混合方案可兼顾速度与精度。层选择声称被否证，但梯度归因可用于避免有害层干预。本文提供了可复现的基线。

papers.title: SHARP: Spectrum-aware Highly-dynamic Adaptation for Resolution Promotion in Remote Sensing Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image generation powered by Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) has made remarkable strides, yet remote sensing (RS) synthesis lags behind due to two barriers: the absence of a domain-specialized DiT prior and the prohibitive cost of training at the large resolutions that RS applications demand. Training-free resolution promotion via Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) rescaling offers a practical remedy, but every existing method applies a static positional scaling rule throughout the denoising process. This uniform compression is particularly harmful for RS imagery, whose substantially denser medium- and high-frequency energy encodes the fine structures critical for aerial-scene realism, such as vehicles, building contours, and road markings. Addressing both challenges requires a domain-specialized generative prior coupled with a denoising-aware positional adaptation strategy. To this end, we fine-tune FLUX on over 100,000 curated RS images to build a strong domain prior (RS-FLUX), and propose Spectrum-aware Highly-dynamic Adaptation for Resolution Promotion (SHARP), a training-free method that introduces a rational fractional time schedule k_rs(t) into RoPE. SHARP applies strong positional promotion during the early layout-formation stage and progressively relaxes it during detail recovery, aligning extrapolation strength with the frequency-progressive nature of diffusion denoising. Its resolution-agnostic formulation further enables robust multi-scale generation from a single set of hyperparameters. Extensive experiments across six square and rectangular resolutions show that SHARP consistently outperforms all training-free baselines on CLIP Score, Aesthetic Score, and HPSv2, with widening margins at more aggressive extrapolation factors and negligible computational overhead. Code and weights are available at https://github.com/bxuanz/SHARP.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对遥感图像合成中扩散Transformer（DiT）缺乏领域先验和高分辨率训练成本过高的问题，提出频谱感知高动态自适应分辨率提升方法（SHARP）。通过在FLUX模型上微调100,000张遥感图像构建领域先验（RS-FLUX），并引入动态旋转位置编码（RoPE）缩放策略，在去噪过程中自适应调整位置插值强度，从而无需训练即可提升分辨率。实验表明，在多个方形和矩形分辨率下，SHARP在CLIP Score、Aesthetic Score和HPSv2上均优于所有无训练基线，且计算开销可忽略。
Motivation: 遥感图像合成面临两个主要障碍：缺乏领域专用的DiT先验，以及高分辨率训练成本过高。现有无训练分辨率提升方法采用静态位置缩放，对遥感图像中密集的中高频细节（如车辆、建筑轮廓）造成严重破坏。
Method: 微调FLUX模型于100,000张遥感图像获得领域先验RS-FLUX；提出SHARP，通过引入理性分段时间调度k_rs(t)到RoPE中，在去噪早期布局形成阶段施加强位置提升，在细节恢复阶段逐步放松，对齐插值强度与扩散去噪的频率渐进特性。
Result: 在六种方形和矩形分辨率下，SHARP在所有无训练基线上持续提高CLIP Score、Aesthetic Score和HPSv2，且外推因子越大优势越明显，计算开销可忽略。
Conclusion: SHARP通过动态RoPE缩放策略有效提升遥感图像生成分辨率，且无需训练，代码和权重已开源。

papers.title: Back to Point: Exploring Point-Language Models for Zero-Shot 3D Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot (ZS) 3D anomaly detection is crucial for reliable industrial inspection, as it enables detecting and localizing defects without requiring any target-category training data. Existing approaches render 3D point clouds into 2D images and leverage pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for anomaly detection. However, such strategies inevitably discard geometric details and exhibit limited sensitivity to local anomalies. In this paper, we revisit intrinsic 3D representations and explore the potential of pre-trained Point-Language Models (PLMs) for ZS 3D anomaly detection. We propose BTP (Back To Point), a novel framework that effectively aligns 3D point cloud and textual embeddings. Specifically, BTP aligns multi-granularity patch features with textual representations for localized anomaly detection, while incorporating geometric descriptors to enhance sensitivity to structural anomalies. Furthermore, we introduce a joint representation learning strategy that leverages auxiliary point cloud data to improve robustness and enrich anomaly semantics. Extensive experiments on Real3D-AD and Anomaly-ShapeNet demonstrate that BTP achieves superior performance in ZS 3D anomaly detection. Code will be available at \href{https://github.com/wistful-8029/BTP-3DAD}{https://github.com/wistful-8029/BTP-3DAD}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BTP框架，利用预训练的点-语言模型（PLMs）进行零样本3D异常检测，通过多粒度点云特征与文本对齐以及几何描述子增强结构异常敏感性，在Real3D-AD和Anomaly-ShapeNet上取得优异性能。

Method: 提出BTP框架，对齐多粒度点云块特征与文本表示，并引入几何描述子增强结构异常检测，同时采用联合表示学习策略利用辅助点云数据提升鲁棒性。
Result: 在Real3D-AD和Anomaly-ShapeNet数据集上，BTP在零样本3D异常检测任务中达到领先性能。
Conclusion: 预训练的点-语言模型在零样本3D异常检测中具有潜力，几何描述子和多粒度对齐是关键。

papers.title: EvoGuard: An Extensible Agentic RL-based Framework for Practical and Evolving AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: The rapid proliferation of AI-Generated Images (AIGIs) poses severe misinformation risks, making AIGI detection critical yet challenging. Traditional detection paradigms mainly rely on low-level features, whereas recent research increasingly focuses on leveraging the general understanding ability of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to achieve better generalization, yet it still suffers from limited extensibility and expensive data annotations. Instead of building yet another detector, we recast AIGI detection as learned, reasoning-based evidence synthesis over a pool of heterogeneous off-the-shelf detectors, realized through EvoGuard, a novel agentic framework. A capability-aware selection mechanism profiles each detector and gathers complementary evidence per sample; a dynamic orchestration mechanism then reasons over heterogeneous outputs across multiple rounds, cross-validating conflicting or low-confidence signals before concluding. This design exploits the complementary strengths among heterogeneous detectors, transcending the limits of any single model. Furthermore, optimized by a GRPO-based Agentic Reinforcement Learning algorithm using only low-cost binary labels, it eliminates the reliance on fine-grained annotations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that this learned reasoning paradigm outperforms single-detector and static ensembling, achieving SOTA accuracy while mitigating the bias between positive and negative samples. More importantly, it allows the plug-and-play integration of new detectors to boost overall performance in a train-free manner, offering a highly practical, long-term solution to ever-evolving AIGI threats. Source code will be publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EvoGuard，一个基于强化学习的智能体框架，将AI生成图像（AIGI）检测重新定义为基于推理的证据合成。框架利用能力感知选择机制从异构检测器池中收集互补证据，并通过动态编排机制在多轮推理中交叉验证低置信度信号。使用GRPO-based Agentic RL算法优化，仅需低成本二元标签。实验表明该方法优于单检测器和静态集成，达到SOTA准确率，且允许即插即用集成新检测器。
Motivation: 现有AIGI检测方法依赖低级特征或昂贵标注，可扩展性差，难以应对不断演变的AIGI威胁。
Method: 提出EvoGuard框架，包含能力感知选择机制（profile每个检测器并收集每样本互补证据）和动态编排机制（多轮推理交叉验证异构输出）。采用GRPO-based Agentic RL算法，仅用低成本二元标签优化。
Result: 实验表明，该学习推理范式在多个基准上超越单检测器和静态集成，达到SOTA准确率，同时缓解正负样本偏差。支持训练-free的即插即用集成新检测器。
Conclusion: EvoGuard提供了一种实用、长期可扩展的AIGI检测方案，通过智能体强化学习实现高效推理和灵活扩展。

papers.title: ECoLAD: Selecting Anomaly Detectors for Automotive Deployment via Compute-Reduction Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Automotive anomaly detectors are often selected from accuracy only benchmarks on workstation class hardware, whereas in-vehicle monitoring requires predictable scoring latency under limited CPU parallelism. This mismatch can make methods that appear competitive offline infeasible for deployment. We present ECoLAD (Efficiency Compute Ladder for Anomaly Detection), a deployment-oriented evaluation protocol for automotive time-series anomaly detection (TSAD). ECoLAD defines a monotone compute reduction ladder with explicit CPU thread caps, mechanical integer only hyperparameter scaling, inference/full run timing separation, and auditable run logs. Applied to proprietary in-vehicle telemetry and two public benchmarks, it shows that accuracy stability and deployment feasibility can diverge: some deep detectors retain AUC-PR while losing feasible throughput, whereas lightweight classical detectors sustain high scoring rates with positive lift above the random baseline, providing a practical screening procedure for detector selection under deployment relevant constraints.
papers.comment: Accepted to appear in the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC 2026) Industry Track, Naples, Italy, September 15-18, 2026. 4 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ECoLAD协议，用于在车载部署约束下评估时间序列异常检测器（TSAD）的计算效率与准确性。协议包含单调计算缩减阶梯、CPU线程上限、整数超参数缩放、推理计时分离和可审计日志。在私有车载遥测和两个公开基准上，发现深度检测器精度稳定但吞吐量不足，轻量级经典检测器维持高评分率且高于随机基线，为部署约束下的检测器选择提供实用筛选流程。
Motivation: 现有异常检测器仅基于工作站级硬件的准确率基准进行选择，忽略了车载监控所需的有限CPU并行下的可预测评分延迟，导致离线表现良好的方法难以实际部署。
Method: 提出ECoLAD评估协议，包含单调计算缩减阶梯（设定CPU线程上限）、纯整数超参数缩放、推理与全运行时间分离、以及可审计运行日志，针对汽车时间序列异常检测。
Result: 在私有车载遥测和两个公开基准上，发现深度检测器保持AUC-PR但吞吐量不可接受；轻量级经典检测器维持高评分率且正增益优于随机基线，表明准确率稳定性与部署可行性可能背离。
Conclusion: ECoLAD协议为车载部署约束下的异常检测器筛选提供了实用流程，强调在评估中必须同时考虑计算效率与准确性。

papers.title: MUGEN: Evaluating and Improving Multi-audio Understanding of Large Audio-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: While multi-audio understanding is critical for large audio-language models (LALMs), it remains underexplored. We introduce MUGEN, a comprehensive benchmark evaluating this capability across speech, general audio, and music. Our experiments reveal consistent weaknesses in multi-audio settings, and performance degrades sharply as the number of concurrent audio inputs increases, identifying input scaling as a fundamental bottleneck. We further investigate training-free strategies and observe that Audio-Permutational Self-Consistency, which diversifies the order of audio candidates, helps models form more robust aggregated predictions, yielding up to 6.28% accuracy gains. Combining this permutation strategy with Chain-of-Thought further improves performance to 6.74%. These results expose blind spots in current LALMs and provide a foundation for evaluating complex auditory comprehension.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MUGEN 基准，用于评估大型音频语言模型（LALM）在多音频场景下的理解能力，涵盖语音、通用音频和音乐。实验发现模型在多音频设置中存在一致弱点，且随着并发音频输入数量增加，性能急剧下降，表明输入缩放是根本瓶颈。进一步研究训练无关策略，发现音频排列自一致性（Audio-Permutational Self-Consistency）通过多样化音频候选顺序可带来最高 6.28% 的准确率提升，结合思维链（Chain-of-Thought）则提升至 6.74%。
Motivation: 多音频理解对大型音频语言模型至关重要，但当前研究尚不充分，缺乏系统性评估。
Method: 构建 MUGEN 基准，评估多音频理解能力；探索训练无关策略，如音频排列自一致性（改变音频候选顺序）和思维链提示。
Result: 模型在多音频设置中表现不佳，性能随输入音频数量增加而下降；音频排列自一致性带来最高 6.28% 准确率提升，结合思维链进一步达到 6.74%。
Conclusion: 该工作揭示了当前大型音频语言模型在多音频理解上的盲点，并为评估复杂听觉理解提供了基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Local Message-Passing for Discrete Graph Generation
papers.abstract_en: Discrete graph generation has emerged as a powerful paradigm for modeling graph-structured data, yet state of the art models often rely on Graph Transformers or higher order architectures. We revisit this design assumption by introducing GenGNN, a modular message passing backbone for graph generation. GenGNN enables powerful generation by persisting edge fields through latent refinement of coupled node edge graph states, all without requiring global attention. Diffusion models integrating GenGNN achieve over 90 percent validity on standard benchmark datasets, performing within margins of Graph Transformer backbones and achieving up to 2x or even 5x faster inference. Systematic ablations isolate how GenGNN is resilient to oversmoothing during generative denoising, indicating each GenGNN component is necessary for downstream generation quality. Finally, representation-space analysis suggests GenGNN learns functionally similar representations to more theoretically-expressive architectures; even at deeper layers. As such, GenGNN uplifts local message-passing to challenge prevailing assumptions that performant discrete graph generation requires global attention or higher-order representations. Source Code Available Here
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GenGNN，一种基于局部消息传递的离散图生成模型，无需全局注意力或高阶架构。通过潜在细化耦合节点-边图状态，GenGNN 在标准基准上达到超过 90% 的有效性，与 Graph Transformer 相当，推理速度提升 2-5 倍。消融实验表明其对过度平滑具有鲁棒性，且深层表示与理论表达能力更强的架构相似。
Motivation: 当前离散图生成模型多依赖 Graph Transformer 或高阶架构，作者质疑这一设计假设，希望验证局部消息传递是否足以胜任。
Method: GenGNN 采用模块化消息传递骨干，通过潜在细化耦合节点和边的图状态来持久化边场，无需全局注意力。
Result: 在标准基准数据集上，集成 GenGNN 的扩散模型实现超过 90% 的有效性，性能接近 Graph Transformer 骨干，推理速度提升 2 倍甚至 5 倍。
Conclusion: 局部消息传递足以支持高性能离散图生成，挑战了全局注意力或高阶表示是必要条件的普遍看法。

papers.title: Can we Trust Unreliable Voxels? Exploring 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction under Label Noise
papers.abstract_en: 3D semantic occupancy prediction is a cornerstone of robotic perception, yet real-world voxel annotations are inherently corrupted by structural artifacts and dynamic trailing effects. This raises a critical but underexplored question: can autonomous systems safely rely on such unreliable occupancy supervision? To systematically investigate this issue, we establish OccNL, the first benchmark dedicated to 3D occupancy under occupancy-asymmetric and dynamic trailing noise. Our analysis reveals a fundamental domain gap: state-of-the-art 2D label noise learning strategies collapse catastrophically in sparse 3D voxel spaces, exposing a critical vulnerability in existing paradigms. To address this challenge, we propose DPR-Occ, a principled label-noise-robust framework that constructs reliable supervision through dual-source partial label reasoning. By synergizing temporal model memory with representation-level structural affinity, DPR-Occ dynamically expands and prunes candidate label sets to preserve true semantics while suppressing noise propagation. Extensive experiments on SemanticKITTI demonstrate that DPR-Occ prevents geometric and semantic collapse under extreme corruption. Notably, even at 90% label noise, our method achieves significant performance gains (up to 2.57% mIoU and 13.91% IoU) over existing label noise learning baselines adapted to the 3D occupancy prediction task. By bridging label noise learning and 3D perception, OccNL and DPR-Occ provide a reliable foundation for safety-critical robotic perception in dynamic environments. The benchmark and source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/mylwx/OccNL.
papers.comment: Accepted to IROS 2026. The benchmark and source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/mylwx/OccNL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统性研究3D语义占用预测中的标签噪声问题，建立专用基准OccNL，发现现有2D标签噪声学习策略在稀疏3D体素空间中完全失效。提出DPR-Occ框架，通过双源部分标签推理（时间模型记忆与表示级结构亲和性协同）构建可靠监督，在SemanticKITTI上即使在90%标签噪声下仍能获得显著性能提升（mIoU提升2.57%，IoU提升13.91%）。
Motivation: 真实世界中的体素标注不可避免地包含结构伪影和动态拖尾效应带来的噪声，但现有研究缺乏对这种不可靠占用监督的鲁棒性探索，尤其是在3D稀疏场景下。
Method: 提出DPR-Occ框架，结合时间模型记忆和表示级结构亲和性，动态地扩展和剪枝候选标签集，在保留真实语义的同时抑制噪声传播，实现鲁棒的标签噪声学习。
Result: 在SemanticKITTI基准上，即使标签噪声比例高达90%，DPR-Occ相比现有标签噪声学习方法（适配至3D占用预测任务）实现了显著的性能增益：mIoU提升2.57%，IoU提升13.91%。
Conclusion: 该工作填补了标签噪声学习与3D感知之间的空白，为动态环境中安全关键的机器人感知提供了可靠基础。

papers.title: SO3UFormer: Learning Intrinsic Spherical Features for Rotation-Robust Panoramic Dense Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Panoramic dense-prediction models, spanning semantic segmentation and depth estimation, are typically trained under a strict gravity-aligned assumption. Real-world captures, however, routinely violate it: handheld devices jitter and aerial platforms change attitude, so the camera is rarely upright. Under such 3D reorientation, standard spherical Transformers overfit global latitude cues and collapse. We introduce SO3UFormer, an architecture that learns intrinsic spherical features largely decoupled from the underlying coordinate frame, through three geometric components: (1) removing absolute latitude encoding, which breaks the dependence on the gravity axis; (2) quadrature-consistent spherical attention, which corrects for non-uniform sampling density; and (3) a gauge-aware relative positional bias built from local tangent-plane angles rather than global axes. A logit-space \emph{SO(3)}-consistency regularizer, used only during training, further suppresses residual discretization effects. To benchmark robustness, we introduce Pose35, a variant of Stanford2D3D perturbed by random rotations within $\pm 35^\circ$, and evaluate under a full, arbitrary \emph{SO(3)} stress test. There, the baseline SphereUFormer collapses from 67.53 \emph{mIoU} on Pose35 to 25.26 under the full \emph{SO(3)} test, whereas SO3UFormer reaches 72.03 on Pose35 and retains 70.67 under the same test. Similarly, on a second real-world dataset (Matterport3D) for segmentation and on panoramic depth estimation, SO3UFormer remains essentially rotation-invariant while the gravity-anchored baseline again loses most of its accuracy. Code and models are available at https://github.com/zhuqinfeng1999/SO3UFormer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SO3UFormer，一种能学习内在球面特征、对相机旋转鲁棒的全景密集预测架构。通过去除绝对纬度编码、正交一致球面注意力和规范感知相对位置偏置，结合训练阶段的SO(3)一致性正则化，在语义分割和深度估计任务上显著提升旋转鲁棒性。在Pose35和完整SO(3)测试下，SO3UFormer的mIoU远高于基线SphereUFormer。
Motivation: 现有全景密集预测模型假设重力对齐，实际中相机常发生旋转，导致标准球面Transformer过拟合全局纬度线索而失效。
Method: 提出三个几何组件：去除绝对纬度编码、正交一致球面注意力（校正非均匀采样密度）、基于局部切平面角度的规范感知相对位置偏置，并添加logit空间的SO(3)一致性正则化（仅训练时使用）。
Result: 在Pose35数据集上SO3UFormer达到72.03 mIoU，完整SO(3)测试下保持70.67，而基线SphereUFormer从67.53降至25.26。在Matterport3D分割和全景深度估计上也保持近似旋转不变。
Conclusion: SO3UFormer通过将特征与坐标框架解耦，实现了对任意旋转的鲁棒性，而重力锚定基线在旋转下精度大幅下降。

papers.title: Tokenization vs. Augmentation: A Systematic Study of Writer Variance in IMU-Based Online Handwriting Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Inertial measurement unit-based online handwriting recognition enables the recognition of input signals collected across different writing surfaces but remains challenged by uneven character distributions and inter-writer variability. In this work, we systematically investigate two strategies to address these issues: subword tokenization and concatenation-based data augmentation. Our experiments on the OnHW-Words500 dataset reveal a clear dichotomy between handling inter-writer and intra-writer variance. On the writer-independent split, structural abstraction via Bigram tokenization significantly improves generalization to unseen writing styles, reducing the word error rate (WER) from 15.40% to 12.99%. In contrast, on the writer-dependent split, tokenization degrades performance due to vocabulary distribution shifts between the training and validation sets. Instead, our proposed concatenation-based data augmentation acts as a powerful regularizer, reducing the character error rate by 34.5% and the WER by 25.4%. Further analysis shows that short, low-level tokens benefit model performance and that the performance gains from concatenation-based data augmentation surpass those achieved by proportionally extended training. These findings reveal a clear variance-dependent effect: subword tokenization primarily mitigates inter-writer stylistic variability, whereas concatenation-based data augmentation effectively compensates for intra-writer distributional sparsity.
papers.comment: Accepted to the ICDAR 2026 Workshop on Machine Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了基于惯性测量单元（IMU）的在线手写识别中，子词分词（subword tokenization）和拼接式数据增强（concatenation-based data augmentation）两种策略对书写者间与书写者内变异的影响。在OnHW-Words500数据集上的实验表明，Bigram分词在书写者无关（writer-independent）场景下将词错误率（WER）从15.40%降至12.99%，而拼接式数据增强在书写者相关（writer-dependent）场景下将字符错误率降低34.5%、WER降低25.4%。
Motivation: IMU在线手写识别面临字符分布不均和书写者间变异（inter-writer variability）的挑战，现有方法对此缺乏系统对比研究。
Method: 对比研究子词分词（Bigram等）与基于拼接的数据增强（concatenation-based augmentation）两种策略，并在书写者无关与书写者相关两种数据划分下评估。
Result: 书写者无关场景：Bigram分词将WER从15.40%降至12.99%；书写者相关场景：拼接式数据增强将CER降低34.5%、WER降低25.4%，且增益超过等比例延长训练。
Conclusion: 子词分词主要缓解书写者间风格变异，而拼接式数据增强有效补偿书写者内分布稀疏性，存在明显的方差依赖效应。

papers.title: Precedence-Constrained Decision Trees and Coverings
papers.abstract_en: This work considers a number of optimization problems and reductive relations between them. The two main problems we are interested in are the Optimal Decision Tree and Set Cover. We study these two fundamental tasks under precedence constraints, that is, if a test (or set) $X$ is a predecessor of $Y$, then in any feasible decision tree $X$ needs to be an ancestor of $Y$ (or respectively, if $Y$ is added to set cover, then so must be $X$). For the Optimal Decision Tree we consider two optimization criteria: worst case identification time (height of the tree) or the average identification time. Similarly, for the Set Cover we study two cost measures: the size of the cover or the average cover time. Our approach is to develop a number of algorithmic reductions, where an approximation algorithm for one problem provides an approximation for another via a black-box usage of a procedure for the former. En route we introduce other optimization problems either to complete the `reduction landscape' or because they hold the essence of combinatorial structure of our problems. The latter is brought by a problem of finding a Maximum Density Precedence-Closed Subfamily, where the density is defined as the ratio of the number of items the family covers to its size. We provide $\mathcal{O}^*(\sqrt{m})$-approximation polynomial-time algorithms for all aforementioned problems. The picture is complemented by a number of hardness reductions that provide $\mathcal{O}(m^{1/12-ε})$-inapproximability results for the decision tree and covering problems. Besides giving a complete set of results for general precedence constraints, we also provide polylogarithmic approximation guarantees for two most typically studied and applicable graph types, outforests and inforests. By providing corresponding hardness results, we show most of these results to be tight.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在前序约束下的最优决策树和集合覆盖问题，其中测试或集合必须遵循前序关系。针对最坏情况时间（树高）和平均时间两种优化准则，以及覆盖大小和平均覆盖时间两种成本度量，作者设计了一系列算法归约，得到所有问题的 O*(√m) 近似多项式时间算法，并证明了 O(m^{1/12-ε}) 不可近似性。对于出森林和入森林两种特殊图结构，还给出了多对数近似保证。
Motivation: 实际决策或覆盖问题中测试或元素常存在前序依赖，传统最优决策树和集合覆盖模型无法处理这种约束，需要研究带前序约束的版本。
Method: 通过引入最大密度前序闭子族等新问题，建立一系列算法归约，将不同优化问题之间通过黑盒过程连接，从而利用一个问题的近似算法得到另一个的近似算法。
Result: 对所有考虑的问题（最优决策树和集合覆盖的两个变种）给出 O*(√m) 近似多项式时间算法，并证明 O(m^{1/12-ε}) 不可近似性；对出森林和入森林给出多对数近似保证且证明紧性。
Conclusion: 前序约束下的决策树和覆盖问题在一般图上具有近似下界，但在森林类图上可得到更好的近似；归约方法可揭示问题间的结构联系。

papers.title: Turbo Connection: Reasoning as Information Flow from Higher to Lower Layers
papers.abstract_en: Complex problems, whether in math, logic, or planning, are solved by humans through a sequence of steps where the result of one step informs the next. In this work, we adopt the perspective that the reasoning power of Transformers is fundamentally limited by a fixed maximum number of steps along any latent path of computation. To address this, we introduce Turbo Connection (TurboConn), a novel architecture that overcomes the fixed-depth constraint by routing multiple residual connections from the higher-layer hidden states of each token $t$ to the lower layers of token $t+1$. Fine-tuning pre-trained LLMs with our method not only yields accuracy gains of 0.9% to over 10% on benchmarks like GSM8K, Parity, and multi-step arithmetic, but also demonstrates that the density of these backward connections is critical; our dense interaction significantly outperforms "sparse" alternatives that only pass a single hidden state or vector. Notably, TurboConn can be integrated into pre-trained LLMs to overcome task-specific plateaus: while a fine-tuned Qwen-3-1.7B achieves only 53.78% on Parity, adding our architectural modification enables the model to reach 100% accuracy, all without the necessity to retrain the full model from scratch or sophisticated curriculum learning. Our results provide strong empirical evidence that the depth of the computational path is a key factor in reasoning ability, also offering a new mechanism to enhance LLMs without significantly affecting generation latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Turbo Connection (TurboConn) 架构，通过将token t的高层隐藏状态通过残差连接路由到token t+1的低层，突破Transformer固定深度限制，使推理路径变长。在GSM8K、Parity和多步算术等基准上，微调预训练LLM带来0.9%到超过10%的准确率提升，尤其Parity任务上Qwen-3-1.7B从53.78%提升至100%。密集的后向连接比稀疏连接更有效，且无需重新训练整个模型或复杂的课程学习。
Motivation: Transformer的推理能力受限于计算路径的最大步数（即层数），复杂问题需要多步推理，但标准架构无法动态增加深度。
Method: TurboConn：在预训练LLM中引入多条残差连接，将当前token的高层隐藏状态跨时间步传递到下一个token的低层，形成信息流，从而扩展有效计算路径长度。
Result: 微调后模型在GSM8K、Parity、多步算术等任务上准确率提升0.9%-10%+；Parity任务上Qwen-3-1.7B从53.78%达到100%准确率；密集连接显著优于仅传递单个隐状态或向量的稀疏方案。
Conclusion: 计算路径深度是推理能力的关键因素；TurboConn提供了一种不显著增加生成延迟且无需从头训练的新机制，可增强LLM的推理能力。

papers.title: OpenEarthAgent: A Unified Framework for Tool-Augmented Geospatial Agents
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in multimodal reasoning has enabled agents that interpret imagery, connect it with language, and execute structured analytical tasks. Extending these capabilities to remote sensing remains challenging, as models must reason over spatial scale, geographic structures, and multispectral indices while maintaining coherent multi-step logic. To address this gap, we introduce \textit{OpenEarthAgent}, a unified framework for tool-augmented geospatial reasoning trained on satellite imagery, natural-language queries, and structured reasoning traces. Beyond serving as a benchmark, OpenEarthAgent establishes a cohesive agentic architecture built around a unified executable tool registry and trajectory-based policy learning. The framework standardizes heterogeneous visual, spectral, GIS, and georeferenced raster operations under a consistent callable schema, enabling modular orchestration and deterministic execution. Training is performed via supervised fine-tuning on structured reasoning trajectories with deterministic replay validation to ensure executability and spatial correctness. The accompanying corpus comprises 14,538 training and 1,169 evaluation instances with over 107K reasoning steps, spanning urban, environmental, disaster, and infrastructure domains and incorporating GIS operations alongside index analyses such as NDVI, NBR, and NDBI. Grounded in explicit reasoning traces, the learned agent demonstrates structured reasoning, stable spatial understanding, and interpretable tool-driven behaviour across diverse EO scenarios. We report consistent improvements over a strong baseline and competitive performance against recent open and closed-source models. Our code, data and trained models are publicly available: https://github.com/mbzuai-oryx/OpenEarthAgent
papers.comment: Accepted at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OpenEarthAgent是一个用于地理空间推理的统一工具增强智能体框架，基于卫星图像、自然语言查询和结构化推理轨迹进行训练。该框架通过统一的可执行工具注册表和轨迹策略学习，标准化了视觉、光谱、GIS等操作，并在包含14,538个训练实例和超过10万推理步骤的数据集上进行了监督微调。实验结果表明，该智能体在多种地球观测任务中表现出结构化推理和稳定的空间理解能力，优于强基线并达到与最新开源/闭源模型竞争的性能。
Motivation: 现有智能体在遥感领域面临挑战，需要推理空间尺度、地理结构和多光谱指数，同时保持连贯的多步逻辑。
Method: 提出OpenEarthAgent框架，包含统一的可执行工具注册表和基于轨迹的策略学习，通过监督微调和确定性重放验证进行训练。
Result: 在包含多种地球观测任务的基准上，该方法在强基线上取得一致改进，且性能与最新的开源和闭源模型竞争。
Conclusion: 该框架实现了结构化、可解释的地理空间推理，代码、数据和模型均已公开。

papers.title: Understanding Persuasive Interactions between Generative Social Agents and Humans: The Knowledge-based Persuasion Model (KPM)
papers.abstract_en: Generative social agents (GSAs) use artificial intelligence to autonomously communicate with human users in a natural and adaptive manner. Currently, there is a lack of theorizing regarding interactions with GSAs, and likewise, few guidelines exist for studying how they influence user attitudes and behaviors. Consequently, we propose the Knowledge-based Persuasion Model (KPM) as a novel theoretical framework. According to the KPM, a GSA's self-, user-, and context-knowledge drives its persuasive behavior, which in turn shapes attitudes and behaviors of a responding human user. Building on existing research, the model offers a structured approach to studying interactions with GSAs, supporting the development of agents that motivate rather than manipulate human users. Accordingly, the KPM encourages the integration of responsible GSAs that adhere to social norms and ethical standards with the goal of increasing user wellbeing. A preliminary evaluation study, as well as implications of the KPM for research and application domains such as healthcare and education are discussed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出知识说服模型（KPM），用于理解生成式社交代理（GSAs）与人类的说服性互动。模型认为GSA的自我知识、用户知识和上下文知识驱动其说服行为，进而影响人类用户的态度和行为。初步评估研究支持该框架，并讨论其在医疗保健和教育等领域的应用。
Motivation: 目前缺乏关于生成式社交代理与人类互动的理论和研究指南，特别是如何影响用户态度和行为。
Method: 提出知识说服模型（KPM），整合GSA的自我知识、用户知识和上下文知识作为说服行为的前因，并连接用户态度和行为变化。
Result: 通过初步评估研究验证了模型，但具体结果未在摘要中详述。
Conclusion: KPM为研究GSA互动提供结构化方法，支持开发遵循社会规范和伦理标准的负责任代理，以提升用户福祉。

papers.title: BRIDGE: Bridging Reasoning In Distillation Gap Elimination via Structure-Aware Masking
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has significantly improved LLMs' mathematical problem-solving capabilities, but distilling such capabilities into smaller models remains challenging due to the capacity mismatch between verbose teachers and compact students. Directly copying teachers' lengthy reasoning chains causes capacity overload, resulting in truncated outputs or repetitive failure. Existing remedies each sacrifice a critical property of CoT: implicit reasoning methods (e.g., compressing reasoning into hidden states) trade away interpretability and verifiability, while heuristic compression strategies (e.g., random step pruning) destroy logical integrity. To address this, we propose BRIDGE, a curriculum framework that first establishes structural understanding via masked reconstruction, then uses GRPO-based reinforcement learning to guide students in self-discovering the optimal balance between accuracy and brevity, and finally internalizes complex reasoning through teacher-guided rewriting on failure cases. On GSM8K, BRIDGE enables Qwen2.5-3B to achieve 11.29% accuracy improvement and 27.4% token reduction over the original model, outperforming instruction-tuned variants and distillation baselines. Zero-shot transfer experiments on SVAMP and MATH-500 further confirm the generalization of internalized reasoning. Our code and model checkpoints are publicly available at https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/SDM2026_BRIDGE and https://huggingface.co/bowen0815/BRIDGE.

papers.title: Disentangling Intrinsic Importance from Emergent Structure in Multi-Expert Orchestration
papers.abstract_en: Multi-expert systems, where multiple Large Language Models (LLMs) collaborate to solve complex tasks, are increasingly adopted for high-performance reasoning and generation. However, the orchestration policies governing expert interaction and sequencing remain largely opaque. We introduce INFORM, an interpretability analysis that treats orchestration as an explicit, analyzable computation, enabling the decoupling of expert interaction structure, execution order, and functional attribution. We use INFORM to evaluate an orchestrator on GSM8K, HumanEval, and MMLU using a homogeneous consortium of ten instruction-tuned experts drawn from LLaMA-3.1 8B, Qwen3 8B, and DeepSeek-R1 8B, with controlled decoding-temperature variation, and a secondary heterogeneous consortium spanning 1B-7B parameter models. Across tasks, routing dominance is a poor proxy for functional necessity. We reveal a divergence between relational importance, captured by routing mass and interaction topology, and intrinsic importance, measured via gradient sensitivity: frequently selected experts often act as interaction hubs with limited influence, while sparsely routed experts can be structurally critical. Orchestration behaviors emerge asynchronously, with expert centralization preceding stable routing confidence and expert ordering remaining non-deterministic. Targeted ablations show that masking intrinsically important experts induces disproportionate collapse in interaction structure compared to masking frequent peers, confirming that INFORM exposes functional and structural dependencies beyond accuracy metrics alone. Our code is available at https://github.com/parmanu-lcs2/inform.
papers.comment: Accepted by Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出INFORM框架，将多专家LLM编排系统视为可分析的计算过程，通过解耦交互结构、执行顺序和功能归因，揭示了路由主导性与功能必要性之间的差异。在GSM8K、HumanEval、MMLU等基准上使用同质和异质专家组合的实验表明，频繁被选中的专家往往只是交互中心而影响力有限，稀疏路由的专家可能结构关键。
Motivation: 现有LLM多专家系统的编排策略（如路由）缺乏可解释性，难以理解专家交互和功能归因，需要一种方法解耦专家的重要性和涌现结构。
Method: 定义两种重要性：关系重要性（基于路由质量和交互拓扑）和内在重要性（基于梯度敏感性）。通过分析路由矩阵、交互图拓扑和梯度信息，剥离专家执行顺序和功能贡献。
Result: 路由主导性不能反映功能必要性；频繁路由的专家常作为交互枢纽但影响有限，而稀疏路由的专家可能具有关键结构作用。编排行为异步涌现，专家中心化先于稳定的路由置信度，且专家排序非确定性。消融实验显示屏蔽内在重要性高的专家会导致交互结构不成比例地崩塌。
Conclusion: INFORM揭示了多专家系统中被准确率掩盖的功能和结构依赖，表明仅关注准确率会忽略关键的结构性角色。
