papers.title: SALT-GNN: Handling Dense Neighborhoods in Anti-Money Laundering Graphs via Statistics-Aware Attention
papers.abstract_en: Money laundering threatens financial stability and exposes institutions to penalties, motivating automated detection. Because laundering schemes often emerge through relational patterns, graph neural networks (GNNs) are increasingly used for anti-money laundering (AML). Yet AML GNNs are typically evaluated with aggregate metrics such as overall F1 score, which hide an operational issue: high-activity recipient accounts concentrate many incoming transactions, making suspicious signals harder to isolate and costlier to investigate. We introduce a recipient-degree stratified evaluation that reports standard AML metrics across recipient-context density. Across three datasets (HI-Small, HI-Medium, and AMLSim-32k-5%), it reveals consistent degradation in dense recipient contexts, which we trace to three GNN characteristics: two known limitations that AML amplifies, i.e., (1) multiset non-discriminability and (2) cardinality blindness, and (3) an attention-specific effect: in dense neighborhoods, normalized attention attenuates weak but pattern-relevant multi-hop signals. Guided by this diagnosis, we propose SALT-GNN, a lightweight statistics-aware architecture that fuses degree-aware statistical aggregation with attention at each message-passing layer, so distributional and cardinality information shapes the node states used by subsequent attention steps. Ablations support fusion placement as a key factor in dense-context performance. On HI-Small and HI-Medium, SALT-GNN uses up to 77% fewer parameters than task-specific graph-transformer baselines while improving dense-context F1 score by 3-6 points; on AMLSim-32k-5%, it improves highest-degree F1 score by 16-20 points. The gains hold for both Transformer- and GAT-style attention, indicating that the benefit comes from where statistical and attentional evidence is fused rather than from a specific attention operator.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 7 figures. Code available upon publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于统计感知注意力的轻量级图神经网络架构 SALT-GNN，用于反洗钱（AML）场景中的密集邻居处理。通过接收方度分层评估发现，现有 GNN 在高活跃度账户的密集交易背景下性能显著下降，原因是多集不可区分性、基数盲目性以及归一化注意力对弱多跳信号的抑制。SALT-GNN 在每个消息传递层融合度感知统计聚合与注意力机制，在三个 AML 数据集上以更少参数提升了密集上下文 F1 分数。
Motivation: 现有反洗钱 GNN 评估常使用整体 F1 等聚合指标，掩盖了高活跃度接收账户密集交易场景下的性能退化问题，导致可疑信号难以隔离且调查成本高昂。
Method: 引入接收方度分层评估方法，诊断出密集邻居中 GNN 的三个缺陷；提出 SALT-GNN，一种轻量级统计感知架构，在每个消息传递层将度感知统计聚合与注意力融合，使分布和基数信息影响后续注意力步骤的节点状态。
Result: 在 HI-Small 和 HI-Medium 数据集上，SALT-GNN 使用比任务特定图 Transformer 基线少 77% 的参数，密集上下文 F1 提升 3-6 点；在 AMLSim-32k-5% 上，最高度 F1 提升 16-20 点。增益在 Transformer 和 GAT 风格注意力下均成立。
Conclusion: 统计证据与注意力证据的融合位置是密集上下文性能的关键因素，而非特定注意力算子。

papers.title: TextGaze: Prompting Gaze Target Estimation with Textual Scene Cues
papers.abstract_en: Gaze target estimation aims to infer the position of a person's gaze within a scene. Within mainstream design logic, multi-branch methods require extra supervision and annotations, while streamlined designs prioritize low-level visual saliency over true gaze intent. The former leads to a high annotation burden and hinders domain transfer, whereas the latter causes misalignment between predicted attention and actual gaze targets. To address this issue, we propose TextGaze, a unified cross-modal architecture that leverages a Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) as scalable semantic guidance to balance the two design paradigms. The model extracts visual features from a frozen encoder and utilizes an LVLM to obtain gaze-aligned textual cues. We design a transformer-based fusion module with hierarchical text supervision to preserve task semantics. Lightweight decoding heads enable the joint prediction of gaze heatmaps and in-/out-of-frame status. We evaluate our method on four mainstream datasets, and the results show competitive performance across key metrics with robust cross-dataset generalisation without extra fine-tuning. Overall, we provide a streamlined alternative to traditional designs and highlight the potential of LVLMs as accessible auxiliary guidance for gaze estimation.
papers.comment: Accepted by IJCAI 2026. All contents are available at: https://github.com/idremo/TextGaze-IJCAI2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出TextGaze，一种统一跨模态架构，利用大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）作为可扩展的语义指导，平衡多分支方法和简化设计的缺陷。模型从冻结编码器提取视觉特征，通过LVLM获得凝视对齐的文本线索，设计基于transformer的融合模块与层次文本监督，联合预测凝视热图和帧内/外状态。在四个主流数据集上取得竞争性能，并展现跨数据集的鲁棒泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有凝视目标估计方法中，多分支方法需要额外监督和标注，增加标注负担并阻碍领域迁移；简化设计则优先考虑低层视觉显著而忽略真实凝视意图，导致预测注意力与实际目标错位。
Method: 提出TextGaze，一种使用LVLM作为语义指导的跨模态架构。从冻结视觉编码器提取特征，利用LVLM生成凝视对齐文本线索，通过transformer融合模块和层次文本监督保留任务语义，轻量级解码头联合预测热图和帧状态。
Result: 在四个主流数据集上，该方法在关键指标上取得竞争性能，并展现出鲁棒的跨数据集泛化能力，无需额外微调。
Conclusion: 提供了一种简化的替代方案，突出了LVLM作为凝视估计中可访问的辅助指导的潜力，平衡了多分支与简化设计的优劣。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Energy-guided Recursive Model
papers.abstract_en: Recursive reasoning models address structured problems by repeatedly updating latent states of small neural networks. However, their test-time scaling lacks a principled inference mechanism: increasing depth or stochastic breadth generates more trajectories without a clear criterion for selection, and existing methods predominantly rely on additional q-heads or heuristic voting. Here, we develop the Energy-guided Recursive Model (ERM), which introduces an intrinsic selection principle based on explicit Hopfield energies. ERM leverages Hopfield-type memories of valid local or global structures to define the selector over candidate trajectories. The resulting energy seamlessly integrates with energy-based techniques such as parallel tempering to enhance sampling efficiency and ranking. With $D=64$ recurrent steps and $K=128$ candidates, ERM reaches optimal solutions on Sudoku ($98.97\%$), Pencil Puzzle Bench (PPBench, $88.04\%$) and Maze ($99.30\%$), improving upon recent Probabilistic Tiny Recursive Model and Equilibrium Reasoners. These results suggest that incorporating explicit energy functions into recursive reasoning offers a principled path toward more effective inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Energy-guided Recursive Model (ERM)，引入基于Hopfield能量的内在选择机制，用于递归推理中的候选轨迹选择。在Sudoku、Pencil Puzzle Bench和Maze等结构化问题上取得高准确率，优于先前方法。
Motivation: 现有递归推理模型在测试时缺乏原则性的选择机制，增加深度或随机广度产生大量轨迹而无明确筛选标准，依赖额外的q头或启发式投票。
Method: 提出ERM，利用Hopfield型记忆定义选择器，通过并行退火等能量基技术增强采样效率和排序。
Result: 在D=64递归步、K=128候选下，Sudoku达98.97%，PPBench达88.04%，Maze达99.30%，优于近期概率小递归模型和平衡推理器。
Conclusion: 将显式能量函数融入递归推理为更有效的推理提供了原则性路径。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: GAE: Graph-Augmented Evolution for Scientific Discovery via Reinforcement Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Evolutionary program search guided by Large Language Models (LLMs) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for automated scientific discovery. However, current approaches are fundamentally constrained by three bottlenecks: structurally blind parent selection, sparse whole-program evaluation rewards, and static mutation operators that fail to adapt during search. We present GAE (Graph-Augmented Evolution), a framework that resolves these limitations through a tightly coupled, three-pillar architecture. First, a relational graph neural network (GNN) parses programs into typed computation graphs, producing structure-aware embeddings. Second, an RL-optimized meta-controller leverages these embeddings to replace blind evolutionary sampling with a directed policy, dynamically selecting optimal parents and mutation directions based on reward history. Third, an online GRPO fine-tuning loop continuously updates the LLM mutation operator at test-time using group-normalized evaluation rewards, directly aligning the model's generation distribution with high-fitness structural edits. We evaluate GAE on a challenging scientific discovery task: symbolic regression for complex nonlinear oscillator systems. By transforming stochastic search into a directed, self-improving trajectory, GAE efficiently discovers closed-form physical equations, consistently matching or outperforming static LLM-driven baselines and achieving state-of-the-art out-of-distribution performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GAE 框架，用于 LLM 引导的进化程序搜索。该框架通过图神经网络解析程序为类型化计算图，RL 元控制器指导父代选择和变异方向，以及在线 GRPO 微调 LLM 变异算子，解决现有方法的结构盲选择、稀疏奖励和静态变异问题。在符号回归任务（复杂非线性振荡器系统）上，GAE 高效发现闭合形式物理方程，达到最先进分布外性能。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 引导的进化程序搜索受限于三个瓶颈：结构盲的父代选择、稀疏的全程序评估奖励、以及无法适应搜索过程的静态变异算子。
Method: GAE 采用三支柱架构：① 关系 GNN 将程序解析为类型化计算图，产生结构感知嵌入；② RL 优化的元控制器基于这些嵌入动态选择最优父代和变异方向；③ 在线 GRPO 微调循环使用分组归一化评估奖励持续更新 LLM 变异算子的生成分布。
Result: 在符号回归任务（复杂非线性振荡器系统）上，GAE 高效发现闭合形式物理方程，与静态 LLM 驱动基线相比一致匹配或超越，并实现最先进的分布外性能。
Conclusion: 通过将随机搜索转化为定向、自我改进的轨迹，GAE 在科学发现任务中有效且性能优越。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ML in a Box: Analyzing Containerization Practices in Open Source ML Projects
papers.abstract_en: Containerization has become increasingly essential in the machine learning (ML) domain, providing reproducibility, portability, and environment consistency. While prior studies have analyzed Dockerfile structures and best practices, none have examined ML projects in depth to reveal how the iterative nature of ML workflows influences container footprint, build performance, and caching behavior. We present the first large scale empirical study of 1,993 ML related Dockerfiles, combining quantitative analysis of container roles in ML projects and build dynamics with a qualitative investigation of refactoring practices. Results show that containers serve distinct roles across training, inference, and infrastructure. Containers are typically large, averaging 10.27 GB in size, and require long build times of about 8.84 minutes. We find that 44.4% of commits trigger rebuilds, primarily due to context file changes (96.4%), with experimentation being the main motive behind those commits that initiate rebuilds. Despite partial cache reuse, 71% of rebuild work is wasted on redundant computation. From stable projects, we identify 7 recurring ML-specific Dockerfile refactoring patterns that improve build efficiency and reduce container footprint.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of MSR '26: 23rd International Conference on Mining Software Repositories, April 13-14, 2026, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. ACM, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对1993个开源机器学习项目中的Dockerfile进行大规模实证研究，分析容器在训练、推理和基础设施中的不同角色，以及构建性能和缓存行为。发现容器平均大小10.27 GB，构建时间约8.84分钟，44.4%的提交触发重建，其中96.4%由上下文文件变化引起，71%的重建工作浪费于冗余计算。还识别出7种ML特定的Dockerfile重构模式。
Motivation: 现有研究虽然分析了Dockerfile结构和最佳实践，但未深入分析ML工作流的迭代特性如何影响容器体积、构建性能和缓存行为。
Method: 采用定量分析结合定性研究的方法，对1993个ML相关的Dockerfile进行大规模实证研究，分析容器角色、构建动态和重构实践。
Result: 容器平均大小为10.27 GB，平均构建时间8.84分钟；44.4%的提交触发重建，其中96.4%由上下文文件变化引起；71%的重建工作冗余；识别出7种ML特定的Dockerfile重构模式。
Conclusion: 研究表明ML容器的体积和构建时间较大，大量重建工作冗余，但可通过特定重构模式改进效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Large-Scale Dataset of MCP Implementations on GitHub
papers.abstract_en: The rapid emergence of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) has introduced a new standard for connecting large language models to external tools and services. Despite its rapid adoption in open-source development, systematic understanding of how MCP is implemented, structured, and maintained remains limited. This study presents the first large-scale, evidence-based dataset of real-world MCP implementation collected directly from GitHub. Using a hybrid pipeline that integrates the GitHub REST and GraphQL APIs with custom Python verification scripts, 3,238 candidate repositories were discovered, filtered, and validated through multi-stage evidence checks. Each verified project was classified by operational role (e.g., client, server, gateway) and exported in a reproducible JSONL schema. A manual review of a representative subset confirmed an overall precision of 83% at a 95% confidence level, and additionally revealed a set of repositories functioning primarily as educational samples, tutorials, or demonstration templates. A targeted exclusion rule was then applied to remove these non-operational repositories, resulting in a final dataset of 2,297 validated MCP projects. The analysis shows that Python and TypeScript dominate MCP development, with hybrid architectures emerging as the most common design pattern. By emphasizing transparent verification strategies, structured evidence tagging, and reproducible data organization, this work establishes a foundational benchmark for studying real-world MCP ecosystems and supports future research on integration, connectivity, and compatibility across the broader developer community.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of MSR '26: 23rd International Conference on Mining Software Repositories, April 13-14, 2026, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. ACM, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了首个基于GitHub的大规模MCP（Model Context Protocol）实现数据集。通过混合管道从3238个候选仓库中筛选出2297个经过验证的MCP项目，按客户、服务器、网关等操作角色分类，并分析显示Python和TypeScript主导开发，混合架构是最常见的设计模式。手动审查子集确认整体精度为83%（95%置信水平）。
Motivation: 尽管MCP在开源社区中被快速采用，但对其实施方式、项目结构和维护状况缺乏系统性的理解，需要大规模、基于证据的真实世界数据集来支撑后续研究。
Method: 构建了一个融合GitHub REST API、GraphQL API和自定义Python验证脚本的混合管道，对3238个候选仓库进行多阶段证据检查、过滤和验证。每个验证后的项目按操作角色分类，并以可复现的JSONL Schema导出。通过手动审查代表性子集评估精度，并制定排除规则移除教育、教程或演示仓库。
Result: 最终获得2297个经过验证的MCP项目，手动审查显示整体精度为83%（95%置信水平）。分析表明Python和TypeScript是主导语言，混合架构是最常见的设计模式。
Conclusion: 该数据集为研究真实世界MCP生态系统建立了可复现的基准，强调了透明的验证策略和结构化的证据标签，有助于未来在集成、连通性和兼容性方面的研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WeaveEarth: Structured Evidence Construction and Reasoning for Training-Free UHR Remote Sensing Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Ultra-High-Resolution (UHR) remote sensing image understanding requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to capture both the global scene layout and sparse yet task-critical local details under limited computational budgets. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms. One is passive perception, which relies on resolution expansion or token compression and may therefore discard fine-grained details. The other is active perception, which depends on multi-round zooming and search, but suffers from high latency, contextual fragmentation, and error accumulation. We argue that a more effective path toward UHR understanding lies not in accessing more, but in organizing better. To this end, we propose WeaveEarth, a training-free framework that reformulates UHR understanding as a problem of structured evidence construction and reasoning under global context constraints. Specifically, WeaveEarth first employs Global-Aware Evidence Construction to select a compact, low-redundancy, and spatially complementary Minimal Support Evidence Set. It then introduces Structured Evidence Reasoning, which weaves local evidence, spatial metadata, and relative topology into a unified reasoning interface, thereby enhancing the VLM's ability to perform global-local joint reasoning. Extensive experiments show that WeaveEarth consistently outperforms strong baselines and existing UHR methods across multiple UHR remote sensing benchmarks and multiple frozen VLM backbones. Code is available at https://github.com/XianZhi-Ma/WeaveEarth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WeaveEarth，一种无需训练的框架，通过结构化证据构建和推理提升超高分辨率遥感图像理解。方法包括全局感知证据选择（选择最小支持证据集）和结构化证据推理（整合局部证据、空间元数据和相对拓扑）。实验表明，在多个超高分辨率遥感基准和不同视觉语言模型上，该方法一致优于强基线和现有UHR方法。
Motivation: 现有UHR遥感理解方法要么依赖分辨率扩展或令牌压缩而丢失细节，要么依赖多轮缩放搜索导致高延迟和错误累积。作者认为关键在于组织信息而非获取更多信息。
Method: 提出WeaveEarth，包含两步：全局感知证据构建（选择紧凑、低冗余、空间互补的最小支持证据集）和结构化证据推理（将局部证据、空间元数据和相对拓扑编织为统一推理接口，增强全局-局部联合推理）。
Result: 在多个UHR遥感基准和多种冻结VLM骨干上，该方法一致优于强基线和现有UHR方法。
Conclusion: 该框架无需训练，通过结构化组织证据提升VLMs对UHR图像的理解。代码已公开。
Relevance: 30

summary_sections.result: 在多个UHR遥感基准和多种冻结VLM骨干上，该方法一致优于强基线和现有UHR方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架无需训练，通过结构化组织证据提升VLMs对UHR图像的理解。代码已公开。

papers.title: When Data Imbalance Helps: Robust Generalization Through Shortcut Saturation
papers.abstract_en: We study robust generalization under spurious correlations: tasks where a shortcut feature is correlated with the true label in training but anti-correlated in an adversarial held-out split. Varying the spurious ratio $r$ (the fraction of training examples where shortcut = true label) and model capacity, we find a counterintuitive result: data imbalance promotes generalization in sufficiently capable models. On a synthetic task where the true label is sum parity of an integer sequence and the shortcut is the parity of the maximum-valued element, a 2-layer, 2-head transformer generalized (reached $100\%$ adversarial accuracy) in 0% of seeds at $r{=}0.50$ but 77% of seeds at $r{=}0.90$. The effect is absent in 1-layer models, where imbalance instead traps the model on the shortcut. Through mechanistic analysis -- gradient conflict dynamics, circuit evolution, and QK/OV circuit ablations -- we characterize a mechanistic pathway consistent with imbalance promoting generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究虚假相关性下的鲁棒泛化，发现当训练数据中捷径特征与标签高度相关（如r=0.90）时，足够容量的模型（2层2头Transformer）反而能更好地泛化到对抗性测试集（77%种子达到100%准确率），而平衡数据（r=0.50）则完全失败。通过梯度冲突动力学、电路演化和消融实验，作者揭示了一条由数据不平衡促进泛化的机制路径。
Motivation: 传统观点认为数据不平衡会加剧对虚假相关性的依赖，但本文通过实验挑战这一直觉，旨在理解何时以及为何数据不平衡可能有利于鲁棒泛化。
Method: 使用合成任务（整数序列的和奇偶性为真实标签，最大值元素的奇偶性为捷径特征），控制虚假比率r和模型层数，训练不同容量Transformer，并通过梯度冲突分析、电路演化和QK/OV电路消融进行机制研究。
Result: 在2层2头Transformer中，r=0.90时77%种子达到100%对抗准确率，r=0.50时0%种子成功；1层模型在r=0.90时反而被捷径困住。
Conclusion: 数据不平衡在足够能力的模型中可以通过促使模型学习更鲁棒的特征来促进泛化，其机制与梯度冲突和电路演化相关。

papers.title: Cost of Reasoning in non-English Languages: A Case Study on Japanese
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning Language Models (RLMs) achieve their strongest performance when they reason in English, the language for which reasoning-oriented training data is most abundant. However, reasoning trace is a clue for model interpretability and safety, and useful in practice for both the model users and for model developers. Thus, it is desirable to be able to develop a model that reasons in a language of the user's choice, while still maintaining strong reasoning performance. To this end, we study the feasibility of training a model that reasons in Japanese. We develop a Japanese-reasoning variant of Qwen-3-Swallow-8B, which is a Japanese LLM continually pretrained from Qwen-3-8B, with GRPO and evaluate it across coding, math, and science benchmarks. The study shows that reasoning-language control is feasible by training a Japanese continually pretrained model with GRPO. However, its performance is at best on par with strong English-reasoning baselines on several benchmarks. We also evaluate the trained model on Japanese cultural benchmarks and observe that the model's performance is worse than the baseline models, suggesting that the reasoning in Japanese does not immediately improve performance on culturally relevant tasks for free.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究训练日语推理语言模型的可行性，基于Qwen-3-Swallow-8B（日语持续预训练模型）使用GRPO训练日语推理变体，在编码、数学和科学基准上评估。摘要表明推理语言控制可行，但性能最多与强英语推理基线持平，且在日语文化基准上表现更差。
Motivation: 推理语言模型在英语上表现最强，但用户可能希望用其他语言推理以增强可解释性和安全性，而训练非英语推理模型可能带来性能代价。
Method: 使用GRPO训练Qwen-3-Swallow-8B的日语推理变体，该模型是从Qwen-3-8B持续预训练的日语LLM。
Result: 在编码、数学和科学基准上，日语推理模型性能最多与强英语推理基线持平，且在日语文化基准上表现更差。
Conclusion: 推理语言控制是可行的，但非英语推理不能免费提高文化相关任务性能，且存在性能代价。

papers.title: Dynamic Agent Skills: A Lifecycle Survey and Taxonomy of Evolving Skill Libraries
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly store reusable procedures outside the model. These reusable procedures are often called \emph{skills}: they may be code functions, natural-language instructions, SKILL.md packages, workflow graphs, or learned adapters that a future agent can retrieve and invoke. This taxonomy-driven survey asks how such skill libraries change over time. Across a $124$-paper $2023$--$2026$ audit set, we synthesize dynamic skill systems as \emph{lifecycle-managed, verified, evolving artifact stores}: agents collect evidence from interaction, propose skill updates, verify and admit candidates, organize them for retrieval and composition, repair or prune stale entries, and govern sharing through provenance and rollback. We organize the literature around three survey tools. First, a $\text{six}$-sense taxonomy distinguishes the structurally different artifacts called ``skills'' in current papers. Second, an $\text{eight}$-stage lifecycle architecture identifies the recurring design decisions behind evidence acquisition, proposal, verification/admission, storage, retrieval/composition, maintenance, distillation/portability, and governance. Third, a lightweight skill-record schema and $\text{ten}$-operator vocabulary provide common terms for comparing library updates without elevating them into a separate method contribution. Using this structure, we synthesize evidence-graded patterns with explicit caveats: admission and repair are repeatedly important, verifier quality materially affects skill-aware RL, flat retrieval can degrade as libraries grow, and current benchmarks still under-report library trajectories, usage--utility gaps, and safety surfaces. We close with concrete reporting standards and open problems for evaluating dynamic skills as changing libraries rather than static prompt or tool collections.
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对大语言模型智能体中动态技能库（skill library）的综述与分类研究。通过分析2023-2026年间124篇论文，作者提出一个六维度分类法区分不同形式的“技能”，以及一个八阶段生命周期架构涵盖证据获取、提议、验证、存储、检索、维护、蒸馏和治理等环节。文章还定义了技能记录模式与十种操作词汇，用于比较库的更新策略。最后总结了评估动态技能库的标准和开放问题。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型智能体倾向于将可重用的流程（技能）存储在模型之外，但这些技能库如何随时间演化尚未被系统梳理。需要统一的分类法和生命周期模型来理解不同研究中的设计选择。
Method: 基于124篇论文的系统性综合，提出六维度技能分类法、八阶段生命周期架构，以及轻量级技能记录模式与十种操作词汇，用于归纳和比较技能库的更新机制。
Result: 摘要识别出几个关键模式：准入和修复反复出现、验证器质量显著影响技能感知强化学习、扁平检索随库增长而退化、现有基准低估库轨迹与使用-效用差距及安全性。
Conclusion: 本文强调动态技能应被视为不断变化的库而非静态提示或工具集合，并提出具体的报告标准和开放问题以推动该领域的评估。

papers.title: Minionese: Comprehensive Benchmark and Mechanistic Study of Multilingual LLM Safety
papers.abstract_en: Safety alignment in large language models remains brittle across languages: prompts reliably refused in English can elicit harmful compliance in non-English and low-resource settings. We introduce \textsc{Minionese}, a multilingual jailbreak benchmark spanning 18 languages, 4 resource tiers, and 4 perturbation types (standard translation, code-switching, transliteration, and translationese), paired with a geometric mechanistic analysis of refusal failure across language tiers. We show that each attack type produces a distinct vulnerability profile: transliteration vulnerability is mediated by script identity, code-switching maintains effectiveness through the lowest-resource tier, and a sharp safety regime transition between Tiers 2 and 3 is consistent across all models. Mechanistically, low-resource jailbreaks succeed by routing harmful content through a geometrically misaligned subspace that projects insufficiently onto the refusal directions, leaving the refusal mechanism intact but untriggered. These findings show that English-only safety evaluations are insufficient; they require accounting for script family, perturbation type, and per-language alignment coverage. The benchmark and analysis code is at https://github.com/Brentkong/Minionese-Comprehensive-Benchmark-and-Mechanistic-Study-of-Multilingual-LLM-Safety.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个多语言LLM安全基准Minionese，涵盖18种语言、4个资源层级和4种扰动类型（标准翻译、代码切换、音译和翻译体），并通过几何机制分析揭示低资源语言的越狱攻击通过将有害内容路由到几何上不对齐的子空间来绕过拒绝机制。结论是仅英语安全评估不足，需考虑脚本家族、扰动类型和每语言对齐覆盖。
Motivation: 现有LLM安全对齐在不同语言间存在脆性，英语中拒绝的提示在非英语和低资源语言中可能导致有害合规，缺乏全面的多语言基准和机制理解。
Method: 构建Minionese基准，包含18种语言、4个资源层级、4种扰动类型，并采用几何机制分析拒绝失败的原因。
Result: 每种攻击类型产生不同的脆弱性特征：音译脆弱性由脚本身份调节，代码切换在最低资源层级保持有效性，层级2和3之间的安全体制转变在所有模型中一致。机制上，低资源越狱通过将有害内容路由到几何上不对齐的子空间成功，该子空间在拒绝方向上的投影不足。
Conclusion: 仅英语安全评估不足，需纳入脚本家族、扰动类型和每语言对齐覆盖。基准和分析代码已公开。

papers.title: Looped State-Space Language Models with Adaptive Exit-State Selection
papers.abstract_en: Recent work on looped language models suggests that many reasoning problems benefit from greater computational depth rather than from additional independent parameters. Existing studies, however, focus almost exclusively on Transformer backbones, leaving open whether this principle also applies to state-space language models. We investigate Looped Mamba and Looped Hybrid Mamba-Transformer architectures, which repeatedly apply a shared Mamba (or hybrid) block to introduce explicit finite-depth recurrent computation. On two controlled reasoning tasks-Mano (modular-arithmetic manipulation) and p-hop induction-Looped Mamba consistently outperforms parameter-matched non-looped baselines and, in several settings, matches or exceeds non-looped models of equal effective depth. We then extend the study to language model pre-training under matched iso-parameter and iso-FLOPs protocols, which jointly disentangle the effects of parameter sharing and effective depth: looped models remain competitive on downstream benchmarks with substantially fewer distinct parameters, although deeper non-looped models retain an advantage in validation perplexity under strict iso-FLOPs comparisons. Finally, we adapt Ouro's two-stage exit gate to Looped Mamba for threshold-controlled selection among recurrent-step outputs. Since all recurrent steps are still executed, the selected exit step represents prediction depth rather than reduced wall-clock computation. At the scales studied, adaptive exit-state selection improves downstream performance at intermediate depths, while actual inference-time savings require additional state-handling mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究循环状态空间语言模型（Looped SSM），提出 Looped Mamba 和 Looped Hybrid Mamba-Transformer 架构，通过重复共享块引入有限深度循环计算。实验表明在数学推理和语言模型预训练中，循环模型在参数共享条件下性能具有竞争力，并探索自适应退出状态选择以优化预测深度。
Motivation: 现有循环语言模型研究几乎只关注 Transformer 骨干，未验证状态空间模型（SSM）是否也能从额外计算深度中受益。
Method: 提出 Looped Mamba 和 Looped Hybrid Mamba-Transformer 架构，重复应用共享的 Mamba（或混合）块进行显式有限深度循环计算，并引入两阶段退出门进行自适应退出状态选择。
Result: 在两个推理任务（模运算归纳和 p-hop 归纳）中，Looped Mamba 始终优于参数匹配的非循环基线，且在等参数量或等计算量协议下的语言模型预训练中，循环模型用更少独特参数达到竞争性下游性能；自适应退出选择在中间深度改善性能。
Conclusion: 循环状态空间模型在推理和预训练中具有竞争力，但实际推理时间节省需要额外的状态处理机制；自适应退出选择虽提升性能，但并未减少执行步骤。

papers.title: Adaptive Model Compression (AMC): Saliency-Driven Resource Allocation for Ultra-Low-Power Transformer Inference
papers.abstract_en: Deploying large-scale transformer models on resource-constrained edge devices remains a challenge due to the high energy and memory overhead inherent in static inference, which processes simple and complex tokens with uniform intensity. To address this, we propose Adaptive Model Compression (AMC), a saliency-driven framework that dynamically allocates hardware resources based on token importance. By implementing a multi-tier architecture, our system identifies critical high-saliency information for full-precision processing while aggressively reducing the rank and bit-width of less significant data. Experimental results demonstrate that AMC achieves a 59.2% reduction in system energy and a 2.24x increase in throughput on 45nm CMOS hardware. This approach effectively extends the battery life of mobile devices by utilizing high-definition compute only where necessary, maintaining robust performance with a marginal 3.6% accuracy trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大规模Transformer模型在资源受限边缘设备上的部署问题，提出自适应模型压缩（AMC）框架，根据token重要性动态分配硬件资源。AMC采用多层级架构，对高显著性信息使用全精度计算，对低显著性信息进行低秩和低位宽处理。在45nm CMOS硬件上，系统能耗降低59.2%，吞吐量提升2.24倍，仅以3.6%的精度损失为代价。
Motivation: 静态推理对所有token使用统一计算强度，导致简单和复杂token的能耗和内存开销一致，不适合边缘设备。需要根据token重要性动态分配资源以降低能耗。
Method: 提出显著性驱动（saliency-driven）的资源分配框架AMC，通过多层级架构识别关键高显著性信息进行全精度处理，对不重要数据降低秩和位宽。
Result: 在45nm CMOS硬件上，AMC实现系统能耗降低59.2%，吞吐量提升2.24倍，精度仅下降3.6%。
Conclusion: AMC通过仅在必要时使用高精度计算，有效延长移动设备电池寿命，保持鲁棒性能，但存在轻微的精度权衡。摘要未具体说明局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DynaFilter: Cloud-driven Dynamic Filtering for Satellite Edge Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Modern satellite edge systems, including those performing remote sensing tasks such object detection and tracking, are characterized by severely limited bandwidth and intermittent connections, making continuous data transmission to the cloud impractical. Existing edge-cloud systems, however, either require heavy pre-processing before analysis, for instance, full decompression of imagery data, or transmit all compressed data regardless of relevance. To address these challenges, we design DynaFilter, a dynamic filtering technique that enables satellite edge devices to perform selective region-of-interest (RoI) inference directly in the compressed-domain, without full decompression. Our key insight is that low-level compression syntax, specifically DC coefficients/AC energy in JPEG images and motion vectors in video streams, exhibits strong correlations with high-level semantic queries. By establishing a precise mapping between cloud query semantics and multimodal compressed-domain features, DynaFilter enables the edge to identify and transmit only relevant data associated to RoIs. Extensive evaluations show that DynaFilter reduces the total volume of pixel data for decoding and subsequent inference by 1.6x-7.1x for images, and achieves 92.0% bandwidth savings for video streams compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Furthermore, it decreases energy consumption by 43.1-88.6% on target devices and achieves a 1.6x-3.0x speedup in inference latency.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 23 figures, accepted by ACM MobiCom 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DynaFilter，一种云驱动的动态过滤技术，使卫星边缘设备能在压缩域直接进行感兴趣区域 (RoI) 推理，无需完全解压。通过建立云查询语义与压缩域特征（JPEG 的 DC 系数/AC 能量、视频流的运动向量）的映射，边缘设备仅传输与 RoI 相关的数据。实验表明，DynaFilter 将图像解码和推理所需像素数据量减少 1.6-7.1 倍，视频流节省 92.0% 带宽，能耗降低 43.1-88.6%，推理延迟加速 1.6-3.0 倍。
Motivation: 卫星边缘系统带宽有限、连接间歇，现有方案要么需要完全解压后再分析，要么传输所有压缩数据，效率低下。
Method: 利用压缩域低级语法（JPEG 的 DC 系数/AC 能量、视频流的运动向量）与高层语义查询的相关性，建立映射关系，动态过滤并仅传输 RoI 相关数据。
Result: 图像数据量减少 1.6-7.1 倍，视频流带宽节省 92.0%，能耗降低 43.1-88.6%，推理延迟加速 1.6-3.0 倍。
Conclusion: DynaFilter 通过压缩域动态过滤显著降低卫星边缘系统的数据传输和计算开销，适用于资源受限的遥感和视频分析场景。

papers.title: LFD: Enabling Real-World Lensless Face Recognition with a Large-Scale Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Face recognition is a ubiquitously used computer vision task that has a wide range of applications ranging from everyday smartphone biometrics to high-stakes security systems. Most face recognition systems rely on traditional cameras, which often suffer from limitations such as bulky form factors, high costs, and limited privacy protection. To address these limitations, lensless cameras have emerged as an alternative. Lensless cameras use thin optical encoders, enabling smaller size, lower cost, and greater design flexibility. These cameras are typically paired with reconstruction algorithms that convert raw captures into recognizable images. However, reconstructed images often contain artifacts, and the reconstruction methods struggle to generalize well to real-world conditions. Furthermore, existing face datasets do not account for the artifacts present in lensless images. To address this issue, we introduce the Lensless Face Dataset (LFD). LFD comprises 21,080 lensless raw measurements, reconstructions, and standard images of faces captured under diverse lighting, angle, and distance. Our key contributions are: (1) Real-world lensless face data: LFD focuses on capturing a diverse face dataset with varying levels of artifacts introduced under different environments; (2) In-the-wild captures: 4,976 images are captured in outdoor settings with varying intensities of natural light and different background patterns; (3) Multiple lensless devices: LFD includes face images collected from three different types of lensless cameras, each with a unique optical encoder. We use this hardware diversity to demonstrate generalization across different lensless cameras. Through comprehensive evaluations and analysis, we show that LFD effectively captures shared features and artifacts across different lensless imaging devices, making it a valuable dataset for advancing lensless face recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无透镜相机在人脸识别中重建图像存在伪影且难泛化的问题，构建了Lensless Face Dataset (LFD)，包含21,080张无透镜原始测量、重建图像和标准图像，覆盖多种光照、角度和距离，并包含室外场景和三种不同无透镜相机设备。实验表明该数据集能有效捕捉不同设备间的共享特征和伪影，推动无透镜人脸识别发展。
Motivation: 现有无透镜相机的人脸识别受限于重建伪影和在真实场景中泛化能力差，而现有数据集未考虑无透镜图像伪影，亟需专门数据集。
Method: 收集21,080张人脸数据，包括无透镜原始测量、重建图像和标准图像，涵盖不同环境、室外场景（4,976张）和三种不同无透镜相机设备。
Result: 通过综合评估和分析，表明LFD能有效捕捉不同无透镜成像设备间的共享特征和伪影，为无透镜人脸识别提供有价值的基准。
Conclusion: LFD数据集填补了无透镜人脸识别领域真实世界数据的空白，支持多设备泛化研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EMBRACE: A Multi-task Framework for Comprehensive Quality Assessment in Cleavage-stage Embryo
papers.abstract_en: Cleavage-stage embryo assessment in in vitro fertilization requires the integrated interpretation of cytoplasmic fragmentation, developmental stage, and blastomere symmetry. However, conventional visual assessment is affected by observer variability, particularly when fragmented regions are small, irregular, or low contrast. This study presents EMBRACE, a multi-task deep learning framework for jointly performing cytoplasmic-fragmentation segmentation, t2/t4 developmental-stage classification, and blastomere-symmetry grading from static cleavage-stage embryo microscopy images. EMBRACE combines a shared ResNet-50 backbone, a concatenation-based multi-scale feature-fusion (C-MSFF) module, a U-Net-style segmentation decoder, and two task-specific classification heads. After predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria, 9,137 annotated embryo images were divided into 7,309 training, 914 validation, and 914 held-out test images. On the held-out test set, EMBRACE achieved a Dice coefficient of 0.781 and an intersection over union of 0.677 for fragmentation segmentation. Developmental-stage classification achieved an accuracy of 0.995, macro-F1 of 0.994, and AUC of 1.000. Blastomere-symmetry grading achieved a balanced accuracy of 0.901, macro-F1 of 0.907, and quadratic weighted kappa of 0.859. These findings support the feasibility of combining spatially inspectable fragmentation localization with embryo-level morphology assessment in a single framework. External and prospective validation is required before clinical deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EMBRACE是一个多任务深度学习框架，用于从囊胚期胚胎显微镜图像中同时进行细胞质碎片分割、发育阶段分类和卵裂球对称性分级。在9137张标注图像上，框架在碎片分割上达到Dice系数0.781、IoU 0.677；阶段分类准确率0.995、宏F1 0.994、AUC 1.000；对称性分级平衡准确率0.901、宏F1 0.907、二次加权kappa 0.859。结果表明将可空间检查的碎片定位与胚胎形态评估结合在一个框架中是可行的，但需要外部和前瞻性验证才能临床部署。
Motivation: 传统囊胚期胚胎视觉评估受观察者变异影响，尤其是当碎片区域小、不规则或低对比度时，需要一种集成解释细胞质碎片、发育阶段和卵裂球对称性的自动化方法。
Method: 提出EMBRACE多任务框架，包含共享ResNet-50骨干、基于拼接的多尺度特征融合模块（C-MSFF）、U-Net风格分割解码器以及两个任务特定的分类头，联合执行碎片分割、t2/t4阶段分类和对称性分级。
Result: 在914张保留测试集上，碎片分割Dice系数0.781、IoU 0.677；阶段分类准确率0.995、宏F1 0.994、AUC 1.000；对称性分级平衡准确率0.901、宏F1 0.907、二次加权kappa 0.859。
Conclusion: 该框架支持将空间可解释的碎片定位与胚胎级形态评估结合，但临床部署前仍需外部和前瞻性验证。

papers.title: Efficiently Adapting Spoken Language Models for the Singaporean Context
papers.abstract_en: Spoken language models (SLMs) unify speech perception and reasoning, but adapting them to sensitive domains is underexplored, especially when the original training data is inaccessible and the use case demands multilingual, spoken-query interaction. We adapt an open-source SLM to the Singaporean Home Team context across five speech tasks in Singapore's four official languages, combining LoRA fine-tuning, a surrogate text-QA dataset that guards against catastrophic forgetting, and a multi-task objective that adapts the CoBa reweighting scheme to speech. We also build HTD-multilingual-QA, a 504,853 sample multilingual QA dataset in text and spoken form. The resulting HT-Moonstone (5B) matches or outperforms SLMs up to 7x its size on most tasks, attains the best accent and gender recognition among all models evaluated, and loses under 2\% of its original speech QA ability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对口语语言模型在敏感领域的适应问题，提出结合LoRA微调、代理文本QA数据集和自适应多任务目标的方案，并构建了HTD-multilingual-QA多语言口语数据集。适应后的HT-Moonstone (5B)模型在多项口语任务上匹配或超越更大规模模型，且在口音和性别识别上达到最佳，原始语音QA能力损失小于2%。
Motivation: 口语语言模型在敏感领域的适应研究不足，尤其是当原始训练数据不可访问且需要多语言口语交互时。
Method: 采用LoRA微调一个开源SLM，使用代理文本QA数据集防止灾难遗忘，并引入改编自CoBa的多任务目标重加权方案以适配语音任务。同时构建了包含504,853样本的多语言口语QA数据集。
Result: HT-Moonstone (5B)在大多数任务上匹配或超越7倍大小的SLM，在所有评估模型中取得最佳的口音和性别识别性能，且原始语音QA能力损失低于2%。
Conclusion: 本文方法能高效地将SLM适应到特定领域，在保持原有能力的同时提升多语言口语任务性能。

papers.title: CVKD-UDA: Cross-View Knowledge Distillation for 3D Unsupervised Domain Adaptive Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: 3D unsupervised domain adaptive (UDA) segmentation mitigates the high cost of manual annotations of the new domain data. Self-training has emerged as the dominant approach in this area, where its success heavily depends on a well-initialized warm-up model to generate reliable pseudo labels. However, existing methods often depend on source supervision or output-level adversarial alignment to obtain the warm-up model, which suffer from limited generalization and training instability due to the large domain gap between domains. Constructing domain-similar representations is an effective way to bridge this gap. In this work, we propose CVKD-UDA, which revisits voxel size as a core design factor to construct domain-similar representations and leverages cross-view complementary cues to balance transferability and discriminability of the warm-up model. First, we generate two complementary views by varying voxel sizes and introduce a cross-view knowledge distillation (CVKD) to enhance generalization and target perception of the model. Second, to balance transferability and discriminability, we design a lightweight Decouple-Adapter and an auxiliary imitation classifier to decouple cross-view knowledge transfer. Extensive experiments on two benchmarks demonstrate that CVKD-UDA effectively improves the performance of self-training methods and provides a new perspective for 3D UDA segmentation. Our code will be available at GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CVKD-UDA方法，通过改变体素大小生成互补视图，并利用跨视图知识蒸馏（CVKD）提升3D无监督领域自适应分割模型的泛化能力和目标感知能力。设计轻量级Decouple-Adapter和辅助模仿分类器来平衡迁移性和判别性。在多个基准上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有3D UDA分割方法依赖源域监督或输出级对抗对齐来获得初始模型，但面临域间隙导致的泛化有限和训练不稳定问题。构建域相似表示是缩小间隙的有效途径。
Method: 提出CVKD-UDA，首先通过变化体素大小生成两个互补视图，引入跨视图知识蒸馏（CVKD）增强模型泛化和目标感知；其次设计Decouple-Adapter和辅助模仿分类器来解耦跨视图知识迁移，平衡迁移性和判别性。
Result: 在两个3D UDA分割基准上的实验表明，CVKD-UDA有效提升了自训练方法的性能，为3D UDA分割提供了新视角。
Conclusion: 该方法通过体素大小设计构建域相似表示，并利用跨视图互补线索改善初始模型质量，从而提升自训练方法的效果。

summary_sections.method: 提出CVKD-UDA，首先通过变化体素大小生成两个互补视图，引入跨视图知识蒸馏（CVKD）增强模型泛化和目标感知；其次设计Decouple-Adapter和辅助模仿分类器来解耦跨视图知识迁移，平衡迁移性和判别性。
summary_sections.result: 在两个3D UDA分割基准上的实验表明，CVKD-UDA有效提升了自训练方法的性能，为3D UDA分割提供了新视角。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法通过体素大小设计构建域相似表示，并利用跨视图互补线索改善初始模型质量，从而提升自训练方法的效果。

papers.title: Label-Free Target-Domain Adaptation for Unconstrained Event-Image Feature Matching via Dual-Stage Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Building pixel-level correspondence between event and image data is a fundamental task for multi-sensor systems. However, existing cross-modal matching methods are largely restricted by their reliance on either matching labels or strictly aligned hardware, which limits them to unlabeled and unconstrained real-world scenarios where neither matching ground truth nor prior sensor relationships are available. To address this, we propose a novel two-stage training paradigm. First, we leverage large-scale data to perform label-agnostic distillation pretraining, upgrading optimization objectives with distribution-based and contrastive losses to learn highly generalizable representations. Second, to tackle unlabeled and unconstrained downstream data, we introduce an epipolar-guided self-distillation framework. By utilizing consistency verification to isolate robust matches and incorporating geometric confidence derived from an external epipolar prior, our model can effectively self-evolve directly on target domains without any supervision. Furthermore, we introduce a rigorous cross-modal evaluation benchmark based on TUM-VIE, featuring physically separated cameras with distinct intrinsic parameters and resolutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance on both MVSEC and TUM-VIE pose estimation tasks. The source code and benchmark will be made publicly available at https://github.com/ZhonghuaYi/nexus2-official.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACM MM 2026. The source code and benchmark will be made publicly available at https://github.com/ZhonghuaYi/nexus2-official
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对事件相机与可见光图像间无需标签和预先标定的跨模态特征匹配问题，提出两阶段训练范式。第一阶段利用大规模数据进行标签无关的蒸馏预训练，结合分布损失和对比损失学习通用表征；第二阶段引入极线引导的自蒸馏框架，通过一致性校验和几何置信度实现目标域无监督自适应。在MVSEC和TUM-VIE位姿估计任务上达到最先进性能，并发布了公开基准。
Motivation: 现有跨模态匹配方法依赖标注数据或严格对齐的传感器硬件，无法在无标签、无约束的真实场景中应用。本文旨在解决这一限制。
Method: 提出两阶段训练：(1) 标签无关蒸馏预训练，使用分布损失和对比损失优化；(2) 极线引导自蒸馏，利用一致性校验和外部极线先验（external epipolar prior）的几何置信度进行无监督域自适应。
Result: 在MVSEC和TUM-VIE位姿估计任务上达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 所提方法无需任何标注或先验传感器关系即可在目标域上自我进化，适用于无标签且硬件未对齐的现实场景。

papers.title: MAG: A Web-Agent Benchmark and Harness for Multimodal Action and Guide Generation
papers.abstract_en: Digital Adoption Platforms (DAPs) are embedded overlays widely used on web systems to guide users through operations inside a page, helping them get started with unfamiliar interfaces quickly. Completing a real task, however, rarely means clicking a few buttons on a single page: it takes a sequence of actions that unfolds across changing page states. Prior studies have also treated automated web agent actions and guide text generation as two separate problems, and most of them feed models textual page representations such as the DOM or accessibility trees rather than the rendered screens that humans actually operate on. In this work we introduce MAG, the first benchmark that unifies task execution and guide writing into a single Multimodal Action and Guide task, with two grounding schemes over screenshots: Set-of-Mark element selection and raw pixel coordinates. We further build a complete harness for this compound task, covering annotation with LLM assistance and human verification, training, evaluation in live environments, and joint metrics for actions and guides. With this harness we evaluate frontier API models and open multimodal models, and report detailed analyses. Finally, we design a GRPO training method augmented with expert trajectories, which nearly doubles the success rate of a supervised 9B agent (from 6.9% to 13.2%) and improves guide quality at the same time. Even the strongest model completes fewer than 40% of the tasks, leaving ample room for future research.
papers.comment: 8 pages main text, 21 pages total including appendices; 11 figures, 7 tables, 2 algorithms. Benchmark, harness, and model checkpoints to be released
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAG，首个统一任务执行与引导编写的多模态 Web Agent 基准。该基准基于截图提供两种 grounding 方案（Set-of-Mark 元素选择和原始像素坐标），并构建了完整的训练、评估框架。实验表明，GRPO 训练方法将 9B 规模 agent 的成功率从 6.9% 提升至 13.2%，同时改善了引导质量；最强模型完成率仍低于 40%，表明该任务仍有大量改进空间。
Motivation: 现有数字采用平台（DAP）仅处理单页点击，真实任务需要跨页面动作序列；以往研究将 web agent 动作和引导文本生成视为两个独立问题，且大多使用 DOM 或可访问性树等文本页面表示，而非人类操作的渲染屏幕。
Method: 提出 MAG 基准，将任务执行与引导编写统一为多模态动作与引导生成任务，提供两种截图上的 grounding 方式（Set-of-Mark 元素选择和原始像素坐标）。构建完整框架，包括 LLM 辅助标注、人工验证、在线环境训练与评估，以及动作与引导的联合指标。并设计了结合专家轨迹的 GRPO 训练方法。
Result: 评估了多种前沿 API 模型和开源多模态模型。GRPO 方法使 9B agent 的成功率从 6.9% 提升至 13.2%，同时提高了引导质量。即使是最强模型，任务完成率也低于 40%。
Conclusion: MAG 基准统一了多模态动作与引导生成，验证了 GRPO 训练的有效性，但当前最优模型性能仍有限，为未来研究提供了空间。

papers.title: TabLoRA: Parameter-Efficient Low-Rank Ensemble Learning for Large-Scale Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Tabular learning is still dominated by gradient-boosted decision trees (GBDTs), while recent deep learning approaches have become increasingly competitive. However, applying deep tabular models to large-scale datasets remains challenging, as large sample sizes, high feature dimensionality, or many target classes can introduce substantial computational cost. We propose TabLoRA, a parameter-efficient trainable neural ensemble for large-scale tabular learning. Instead of using fully independent ensemble backbones, TabLoRA shares a common backbone across predictors and introduces predictor-specific low-rank adaptations, enabling ensemble-style prediction without full parameter duplication. Across benchmarks, TabLoRA achieves a favorable balance between predictive performance and practical efficiency compared with GBDT methods and recent deep learning baselines under the same resource constraints. Memory analysis and ablation studies further show that the proposed design improves the feasibility of neural ensemble learning while preserving much of the benefit of full ensembles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TabLoRA 提出一种参数高效的神经集成方法用于大规模表格学习，通过共享骨干网络和预测器特定的低秩适应（low-rank adaptation）替代完全独立的集成骨干，在保持集成性能的同时大幅降低参数开销。实验表明，在相同资源约束下，TabLoRA 在预测性能与计算效率之间取得比 GBDT 和近期深度基线更好的平衡，内存分析和消融研究进一步验证了其设计有效性。
Motivation: 梯度提升决策树（GBDT）在表格学习上仍占主导，而深度学习方法在大型数据集上因样本量大、特征维度高或目标类别多导致计算成本过高，限制了神经集成的应用。
Method: 提出 TabLoRA，共享一个公共骨干网络，为每个预测器引入独立的低秩适应矩阵（low-rank adaptation），从而实现类似集成的预测而无需完全复制参数。
Result: 在多个基准上，与 GBDT 和近期深度方法相比，TabLoRA 在相同资源约束下实现了预测性能与实用效率的更好平衡；内存分析和消融实验表明该设计提升了神经集成学习的可行性，同时保留了完整集成的大部分收益。
Conclusion: TabLoRA 表明参数共享加低秩适应是一种有效的表格学习集成策略，能以较低代价获得集成优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Distance-Preserving Embeddings in Inhomogeneous Random Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Graph machine learning provides powerful tools for understanding complex networks and learning meaningful node representations. A central challenge, however, is designing embeddings with minimal distortion of both local and global functionals, such as shortest path lengths. Prior distortion guarantees for distance-preserving embeddings are worst-case in nature, producing overly pessimistic bounds that fail to capture the structure of typical large-scale networks. To address this, we analyze shortest-path approximation via landmark-based embeddings on inhomogeneous random graphs, a general model with type-dependent edge probabilities. By retaining shortest paths to a small set of reference nodes called landmarks, landmark-based methods effectively function as virtual graph spanners, where structural heterogeneity and controlled neighborhood expansion modeled via multi-type branching processes enable significantly tighter dimension-distortion trade-offs than classical worst-case bounds. We extend these guarantees to global, component-wide averages and unify the analysis across finite-type and continuous latent spaces through a novel metric sandwiching framework, establishing universal distortion bounds for general $L^2$ kernel models, including heavy-tailed and power-law networks. Finally, we introduce a GNN-augmented variant that replaces rigid, computationally expensive exact shortest-path queries with flexible, structure-aware neural surrogates. By leveraging the inherent alignment between graph neural message-passing and the dynamic programming principles of shortest-path algorithms, our approach demonstrates that models trained on small-scale random graphs learn to extract universal distance-preserving features, achieving robust generalization to large-scale, real-world networks that match or exceed the fidelity of classical, exact landmark-based embeddings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在非齐次随机图中利用地标嵌入进行最短路径距离保持，通过多类型分支过程分析结构异质性，获得比经典最坏情况界更紧的维度-失真权衡。进一步将保证扩展到全局分量平均，并引入基于GNN的变体，用结构感知的神经代理替代精确最短路径查询，在真实大规模网络上达到与经典方法相当的保真度。
Motivation: 经典最坏情况下的距离保持嵌入失真界过于悲观，无法刻画典型大规模网络的真实结构，因此需要针对更现实的随机图模型（如非齐次随机图）进行更紧的分析。
Method: 利用地标嵌入（保留到少量参考节点的最短路径）作为虚拟图骨架，通过多类型分支过程分析邻域扩展；提出度量夹逼框架统一有限类型和连续潜空间的分析；最后引入GNN增强变体，利用消息传递与动态规划的对应关系训练神经代理。
Result: 在非齐次随机图上获得比经典最坏情况界更紧的维度-失真权衡；在包含重尾和幂律网络的L2核模型上建立通用失真界；GNN变体在真实大规模网络上匹配或超越经典地标嵌入的保真度。
Conclusion: 本文证明了基于地标的嵌入方法在随机图模型下可实现更优的距离保持保证，且GNN代理能够学习到通用的距离保持特征，从中小规模随机图泛化到大规模真实网络。

papers.title: FlashBEV: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact BEV Transformation with IO-Awareness
papers.abstract_en: Bird's-eye-view (BEV) perception is a core component of camera-based 3D understanding in autonomous driving, where view transformation (VT) maps multi-camera image features into a unified BEV representation. Sampling-based view transformation (Sampling-VT) is attractive because it supports dense and continuous BEV aggregation for high-resolution and long-range perception. Its deployment bottleneck, however, is systems-level: standard tensorized implementations of Sampling-VT -- which we refer to as Tensorized Sampling-VT -- explicitly materialize large height-dependent intermediate tensors, causing memory and latency costs that scale poorly with vertical resolution and the number of cameras. We revisit Tensorized Sampling-VT from an operator-execution perspective and show that it follows a gather-reduction pattern: each BEV query independently accumulates contributions across cameras and height bins, enabling thread-local accumulation with on-the-fly recomputation that eliminates the need to materialize height- and camera-dependent intermediates. Based on this insight, we propose FlashBEV, a fully fused and IO-aware execution strategy mathematically equivalent to Tensorized Sampling-VT (same operator output) while substantially reducing global memory traffic and kernel-launch overhead. Experiments show that FlashBEV achieves more than an order of magnitude lower peak GPU memory and significant inference-latency speedups, with memory effectively independent of the number of height bins, reducing the operator's peak memory to O(BCXY) (output only). This unlocks higher BEV range/resolution and vertical discretization within fixed deployment budgets on memory-constrained devices. Our contribution is an execution redesign -- same math, different execution -- that removes a key scalability barrier for deployment-ready Sampling-VT. Code available at https://github.com/yokosyun/FlashBEV
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对相机视角转换到鸟瞰图（BEV）中采样方法的内存和延迟瓶颈，本文提出FlashBEV，一种完全融合且IO感知的执行策略。它通过重新设计算子执行方式（从显式实例化高度相关中间张量改为线程本地累加和即时重算），在数学等价的前提下显著降低GPU峰值内存和推理延迟。实验表明峰值内存降低一个数量级以上，且内存与高度离散数量无关。
Motivation: 基于采样的视角转换（Sampling-VT）在部署时受限于内存和延迟，因为标准张量化实现会显式创建大的高度相关中间张量，导致内存和延迟随垂直分辨率和相机数量线性增长，成为可扩展性的系统级瓶颈。
Method: 重新审视Tensorized Sampling-VT的算子执行模式，发现其遵循gather-reduction模式：每个BEV查询独立累加跨相机和高度bin的贡献。基于此提出FlashBEV，采用完全融合的IO感知执行策略，通过线程本地累加和即时重算避免实例化高度和相机依赖的中间结果，数学上等价于原始算子。
Result: 实验显示FlashBEV相比标准实现，GPU峰值内存降低一个数量级以上，推理延迟显著加速，且内存占用量与高度bin数量无关，仅与输出大小O(BCXY)有关。
Conclusion: 本文贡献在于执行层面的重新设计（相同数学，不同执行），移除了部署级采样视角转换的关键可扩展性障碍，使得在固定内存预算下可以实现更高的BEV范围/分辨率和垂直离散化。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 针对相机视角转换到鸟瞰图（BEV）中采样方法的内存和延迟瓶颈，本文提出FlashBEV，一种完全融合且IO感知的执行策略。它通过重新设计算子执行方式（从显式实例化高度相关中间张量改为线程本地累加和即时重算），在数学等价的前提下显著降低GPU峰值内存和推理延迟。实验表明峰值内存降低一个数量级以上，且内存与高度离散数量无关。
summary_sections.motivation: 基于采样的视角转换（Sampling-VT）在部署时受限于内存和延迟，因为标准张量化实现会显式创建大的高度相关中间张量，导致内存和延迟随垂直分辨率和相机数量线性增长，成为可扩展性的系统级瓶颈。
summary_sections.method: 重新审视Tensorized Sampling-VT的算子执行模式，发现其遵循gather-reduction模式：每个BEV查询独立累加跨相机和高度bin的贡献。基于此提出FlashBEV，采用完全融合的IO感知执行策略，通过线程本地累加和即时重算避免实例化高度和相机依赖的中间结果，数学上等价于原始算子。
summary_sections.result: 实验显示FlashBEV相比标准实现，GPU峰值内存降低一个数量级以上，推理延迟显著加速，且内存占用量与高度bin数量无关，仅与输出大小O(BCXY)有关。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文贡献在于执行层面的重新设计（相同数学，不同执行），移除了部署级采样视角转换的关键可扩展性障碍，使得在固定内存预算下可以实现更高的BEV范围/分辨率和垂直离散化。

papers.title: From ambiguous utterances to governed reuse classes: canonicalization, quotient invariance, and conditional decidability
papers.abstract_en: Semantic caching defines answer reuse on embedding similarity: two utterances share a stored answer when a similarity score clears a threshold, with no notion of authorization, versioning, or of what makes two demands the same. This note changes the object on which reuse is defined: in a governed domain, reuse should operate on a mathematically characterized quotient of resolved conversational demands, not on a similarity heuristic. Three independently defined relations on resolved utterances -- reading identity, resolution identity, and reuse identity -- form a refinement chain, strict under realized nondegeneracy conditions checkable on deployment logs; the pipeline's outputs are invariant along the chain, and reuse identity is exactly the kernel of the resolution map into the governed answer partition, so the reuse quotient is the utterance-side object that partition induces, not a relabeling of it. Reuse identity licenses the governed query key and its certified answer space; reuse of a particular answer requires resolution identity or an applicability certificate. The supporting layer is stated at exactly the strength proved: exact-denotation normal forms; join aggregation as a design operator, with closure-stable cells characterizing no-escape; total computability of the full pipeline relative to an untrusted proposal layer; policy admissibility for arbitrary proposers -- and provably not factual grounding or intent fidelity; and elicitation terminating after finitely many informative replies, sound under target consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语义缓存中基于嵌入相似度的答案重用缺乏形式化授权和版本控制的问题，提出在管理域中重用应操作于已解析会话需求的数学商结构。定义了阅读恒等、解析恒等和重用恒等三种关系，证明它们构成精炼链，且重用恒等是解析映射到管理答案划分的核。支持层包括精确指称范式、连接聚合、闭包稳定单元等性质，整体可计算性相对于不可信提议层成立，策略可接受性适用于任意提议者。
Motivation: 现有语义缓存基于嵌入相似度阈值定义答案重用，缺乏授权、版本控制和判别请求相同性的形式化基础。本文旨在为管理域中的答案重用提供严格的数学框架，使重用操作基于推导恒等而非相似性启发。
Method: 引入三种独立定义的关系（阅读恒等、解析恒等、重用恒等），形成精炼链并在非退化条件下严格。将重用恒等定义为解析映射的核，从而重用商结构由管理答案划分唯一诱导。构建支持层包含精确指称范式、连接聚合操作、闭包稳定单元，并证明整体可计算性相对于不可信提议层、策略可接受性等性质。
Result: 摘要报告理论结果：管道输出沿精炼链不变；重用恒等授权管理查询键及其认证答案空间；重用特定答案需解析恒等或适用性证书；整体可计算性相对于提议层成立；策略可接受性适用于任意提议者。
Conclusion: 本文强调重用应基于数学商结构而非相似性，为管理域中的答案重用提供了形式化框架和条件可判定性。局限性包括未涉及事实基础或意图保真度。

papers.title: Error Aware Distribution Prediction for Lightweight Implicit Neural Representations
papers.abstract_en: Implicit neural representations (INRs) offer compact encoding of volumes, but as lossy approximators, inevitably have prediction errors. We consider INRs that can simultaneously encode relative error scales by predicting distributions using tools from uncertainty estimation. Typically, uncertainty estimation relies on computationally expensive approaches or on predefined parametric assumptions about the predictive distribution (e.g., Gaussian). In this study, we propose a lightweight method that reformulates regression-based INR training as a classification task by discretizing continuous targets into bins, enabling flexible distribution modeling to capture complex multimodal behaviors. We analyze the trade-off between regression and classification for INR training and demonstrate that the classification setting tends to achieve high reconstruction quality and competitive error awareness through uncertainty estimation, compared to regression-based approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级方法，将隐式神经表示（INR）中的回归训练转化为分类任务，通过将连续目标离散化为bins来预测分布，从而同时编码预测误差尺度。实验表明，分类设置相比回归方法在重建质量和误差感知方面具有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有INR作为有损逼近器必然有预测误差，而传统不确定性估计方法计算成本高或依赖预设参数假设（如高斯分布）。
Method: 将回归训练转化为分类任务：将连续目标值离散化为多个bins，通过预测bins概率分布实现灵活的分布建模，捕捉复杂多模态行为。
Result: 分类设置下的INR训练在重建质量和通过不确定性估计实现的误差感知方面优于或竞争于回归方法。
Conclusion: 分类范式为轻量级误差感知INR提供了一种有效替代方案。

papers.title: Conservation Laws for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: While autoregressive models optimize the exact data likelihood via the chain rule, diffusion models are typically trained with denoising objectives. We develop conservation laws based on generalized extrinsic information transfer (GEXIT) functions for a broad class of memoryless noise processes, showing that the data--model cross-entropy (CE) can be characterized exactly as an integral of local information-theoretic derivatives along the noise path. This yields a unified characterization of the likelihood for discrete and continuous diffusion, with the Gaussian case reducing to the well-known mutual information--minimum mean-square error (I-MMSE) relationship. An immediate implication is a locality property: one can compute the information-theoretic derivatives using only the marginal posteriors along the noise path. As a result, training reduces to learning the marginal posteriors by minimizing the negative log-likelihood. While the conservation law implies that the entropy does not depend on the noise path, finite-capacity denoisers approximate the posteriors with varying accuracy across noise types, leading to differences in performance. We validate these predictions on synthetic Markov sources and standard benchmarks, including text8 and CIFAR-10.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发展了一类基于广义外信息传递（GEXIT）函数的守恒律，适用于无记忆噪声过程，精确刻画了数据-模型交叉熵与噪声路径上信息论导数的积分关系，统一了离散和连续扩散模型的似然表征，揭示了训练等价于学习边际后验以最小化负对数似然。在合成Markov源、text8和CIFAR-10上验证了噪声类型对有限容量去噪器性能的影响。
Motivation: 扩散模型通常使用去噪目标训练，但缺乏如同自回归模型那样对似然的精确优化理论；本文旨在建立扩散模型中似然与信息论量之间的精确守恒关系，为训练和评估提供理论基础。
Method: 基于广义外信息传递（GEXIT）函数，对一类无记忆噪声过程推导守恒律，证明数据-模型交叉熵可表示为噪声路径上信息论局部导数的积分；对于高斯噪声，该关系退化为I-MMSE关系。
Result: 守恒律表明熵与噪声路径无关，但有限容量去噪器在不同噪声类型下逼近后验的精度不同，导致性能差异。在合成Markov源、text8和CIFAR-10上验证了理论预测。
Conclusion: 该工作为扩散模型提供了统一的似然表征，揭示了训练的本质是学习边际后验，并指出噪声路径选择对有限容量模型性能的影响。

papers.title: AgentAbstain: Do LLM Agents Know When Not to Act?
papers.abstract_en: Agent systems based on large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for autonomous tasks, yet existing evaluations mostly focus on task success rather than whether agents know when to abstain. This gap poses real risks: under ambiguity, conflicting constraints, or tool failures, agents may execute unintended and irreversible actions. To close this gap, we present the first systematic evaluation framework for agentic abstention: the calibrated ability of tool-using LLM agents to recognize when not to act. At its core, AgentAbstain is a paired-task benchmark built on an agent-native taxonomy of 8 abstention scenarios across pre-execution reasoning and runtime discovery. It contains 263 paired tasks across 42 executable sandbox environments, where each pair consists of a should-act task and a should-abstain variant produced through a controlled perturbation to the instruction, tool, or environment state. To scale this paired design and resist data contamination, we propose AbstainGen, a fully automated pipeline that synthesizes sandbox environments and generates paired tasks end-to-end, validated by deterministic replay and semantic LLM judges; fresh task instances can be regenerated on demand, and three independent annotators rate 94-98% of sampled tasks as well-designed. Across 17 frontier LLMs in 4 agent harnesses, the best agent (Gemini 3.1 Pro) achieves only 59.5% paired accuracy (correct on both the act and abstain sides of each paired task). More importantly, abstention capability is largely independent of general task-solving capability, indicating that scaling task-solving alone will not close this gap. We further identify failure modes such as post-hoc abstention, in which agents execute irreversible actions before recognizing abstention triggers. Our code and dataset are open-sourced at agentabstain.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentAbstain，首个系统评估 LLM 智能体弃权（abstention）能力的框架和基准。该基准包含 8 种弃权场景、263 对任务，并提出 AbstainGen 自动生成配对任务。实验表明，最佳智能体（Gemini 3.1 Pro）仅达到 59.5% 的配对准确率，且弃权能力与任务求解能力几乎无关。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体评估主要关注任务成功，忽略了智能体在不明确、冲突约束或工具故障时是否知道应弃权，这可能导致不可逆的误操作。
Method: 构建 AgentAbstain 基准，基于 8 种弃权场景分类，包含 263 对任务（should-act 和 should-abstain），通过控制指令、工具或环境状态的扰动生成配对。同时提出 AbstainGen 自动化流水线，合成沙箱环境并生成配对任务，通过确定性回放和语义 LLM 判断验证。
Result: 在 4 种智能体框架上的 17 个前沿 LLM 中，最佳模型（Gemini 3.1 Pro）仅达 59.5% 配对准确率；弃权能力与通用任务解决能力基本独立；识别出事后弃权（post-hoc abstention）等失败模式。
Conclusion: 当前 LLM 智能体的弃权能力有限，且不能随任务求解能力的提升而自动改善，需要专门设计。

papers.title: Quantum Circuit Vision: Cost-Aware Evaluation of Visual AI Agents for Quantum Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Can AI agents visually comprehend quantum circuit diagrams and generate verified executable code--and at what cost? We present Quantum Circuit Vision, a cost-aware evaluation framework for multimodal AI agents on quantum circuit visual understanding. We construct a 132-circuit benchmark spanning 13 categories ($1$--$10$ qubits) with executable Amazon Braket code and unitary-fidelity verification. Evaluating three frontier Claude-family models at different capability-cost tiers with $n=5$ repeated trials, we find that the mid-tier model (Sonnet 4.6, $1.30\times$ credits) offers the most favorable balance on the cost-accuracy frontier: 91% pass rate on the core subset at 18% of the per-call cost of the strongest model (Opus 4.6), whose accuracy advantage is not statistically significant (paired $t$: $p=0.083$). Logistic regression confirms that circuit depth--not qubit count--is the primary predictor of failure ($p<0.001$). Chain-of-thought prompting shows no statistically significant effect (all $p>0.18$, $n=5$), suggesting that visual pattern recognition outweighs explicit reasoning strategy for structurally coupled diagrams. We propose a cascade routing strategy (cheap $\rightarrow$ expensive models) that achieves 84% accuracy at 38% of single-model cost, demonstrating that model routing dominates prompt engineering as a cost lever. We release QCV-Dataset (132 circuits, 5 modalities, 1,931 files) on Hugging Face Hub as an open evaluation infrastructure with structured metadata for discoverability, interoperability, and responsible AI documentation, and all evaluation code, cost logs, and verification scripts on GitHub for full reproducibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Quantum Circuit Vision，一个成本感知的评估框架，用于测试多模态 AI agent 对量子电路图的理解并生成可执行代码。构建了包含 132 个电路（1-10 量子比特）的基准，评估三个 Claude 模型，发现中档模型 Sonnet 4.6 在成本-准确率前沿上最佳：核心子集通过率 91%，成本仅为最强模型的 18%。电路深度是失败的主要预测因子，链式思维提示无显著效果。级联路由策略（廉价→昂贵模型）以 38% 的单模型成本达到 84% 准确率。作者发布了数据集和代码。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对多模态 AI agent 在量子电路视觉理解上的成本-准确率权衡的系统评估，尤其是不同能力-成本层级的模型对比。
Method: 构建 132 电路基准（13 类，1-10 量子比特），包含 Amazon Braket 可执行代码和幺正保真度验证。评估三个 Claude 模型（Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5），进行 5 次重复试验，使用 logistic 回归分析失败预测因子，并测试链式思维提示效果。提出级联路由策略。
Result: Sonnet 4.6 在核心子集上通过率 91%，成本为 Opus 4.6 的 18%，且准确率差异不显著（p=0.083）。电路深度是失败的主要预测因子（p<0.001），链式思维无显著效果。级联路由策略达到 84% 准确率，成本为单模型的 38%。

papers.title: Reason Less, Verify More: Deterministic Gates Recover a Silent Policy-Violation Failure Mode in Tool-Using LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using LLM agents can violate the very policies they are deployed to enforce while appearing to complete the task successfully. In policy-permissive environments, a tool may execute any well-formed call even when the corresponding state transition is forbidden by domain policy. The result is a silent wrong state (a booking cancelled, a passenger count changed, a claim acted on without verification) that neither the tool nor the agent's self-report exposes. We study this failure mode in the $τ^2$-bench airline domain. On a budget agent, 78% of observed failures are silent wrong-state failures with no tool error, and the aggregate failure rate is reproducible across disjoint seeds, not sampling noise. We then evaluate a lightweight intervention: deterministic, read-only pre-execution gates that inspect the proposed call and current state before allowing a write. A four-gate suite raises full-benchmark success from 29.6% to 42.0% on gpt-4o-mini (+12.4pp; paired task-level bootstrap P=0.0012), and the lift reproduces on a disjoint 15-seed set (+12.3pp; P=0.0008). The effect is concentrated where the gates fire: on the 26/50 firing tasks, success rises by +19.2pp, while movement on the 24 non-firing tasks does not exclude zero. Two negative controls (a self-enforcing retail domain and BFCL) bound the mechanism: gates help when tools are policy-permissive and add little where tools already self-enforce. As suggestive evidence, not a central claim, the same failure mode persists at the frontier: gpt-5.2 at default reasoning still attempts policy-violating writes, and the same suite improves success from 61.2% to 71.6% (+10.4pp; P=0.020; n=5, no replication). The contribution is a bounded evaluation and reliability result: deterministic gates do not guarantee task success, but they can deterministically prevent a known class of silent policy-violating writes at the action boundary.

TL;DR: 本文研究工具使用LLM agent在策略许可环境中产生无声错误（silent wrong-state failure）的问题，即agent看似成功完成任务，实则执行了违反领域策略的操作，且工具和agent自身报告均未暴露错误。在τ^2-bench航空领域基准中，78%的失败属于此类无声错误。作者提出一种轻量级干预：确定性只读预执行门（pre-execution gates），在执行写入前检查调用和状态。四个门的组合将完整基准成功率从29.6%提升至42.0%（+12.4pp，p=0.0012），效果集中在门触发的任务上。负对照实验（零售领域和BFCL）表明门仅在工具策略许可时有效。即使在gpt-5.2等边界模型上，相同失败模式仍存在，门也可提升成功率。

Method: 提出确定性、只读的预执行门（pre-execution gates），在工具执行写入操作前，检查当前状态和调用是否违反领域策略。门是确定性的，不依赖模型推理。
Result: 在τ^2-bench航空领域，四个门的组合将标为gpt-4o-mini的完整基准成功率从29.6%提升至42.0%（+12.4pp，p=0.0012），并在独立种子集上复现（+12.3pp，p=0.0008）。效果集中在门触发任务（成功率+19.2pp），而未触发任务变化不显著。在gpt-5.2上成功率从61.2%提升至71.6%（+10.4pp，p=0.020）。
Conclusion: 确定性门虽不能保证任务完全成功，但可确定性防止一类已知的无声策略违反写入操作。该方法在工具本身不强制执行策略的环境中有效，在工具自执行环境中增益有限。

papers.title: Causal Optimizer Interaction Calculus: Hidden Geometric Relaxation and Identifiable Interventions
papers.abstract_en: Optimizer experiments observe responses to algorithmic configurations without uniquely revealing hidden mechanisms. We develop a causal optimizer interaction calculus that separates pathwise realization, Mobius decomposition, and experimental identification. Under a fixed innovation coupling, every finite-horizon innovation-driven optimizer admits a behaviorally minimal pathwise realization. For any finite effect support and intervention design, an incidence operator gives the complete observational gauge, exact identifiability, sharp quotient stability, held-out predictions, and exact noiseless configuration complexity. Smooth hidden relaxation generates interactions through inverse hidden-state stiffness. Building on this structural law, we prove an observable-readout transfer theorem: arbitrary smooth update or trace readouts inherit an explicit five-term interaction through first and second hidden responses. Unlike the reduced optimal value, a general readout has no universal interaction sign. Its Boolean effects remain exact integrals of continuous interaction curvature and can therefore be identified by factorial interventions. We also derive Gaussian quotient minimax risk, exact confidence sets and tests, misspecification decomposition, certified downstream decisions, and optimal replication. A controlled real-data experiment on a 65-dimensional strongly convex logistic model validates the complete reduced-value chain. Boolean effects and independently integrated curvature agree within 4.21e-11, while nine held-out continuous intensities agree within 8.88e-13. Gaussian campaigns attain the predicted coverage and power, and 4,500 real-minibatch observations reject an order-two interaction model. Neural trace audits provide complementary evidence that the declared response classes remain informative in nonconvex training.
papers.comment: 34 pages. Complete proofs, controlled real-data experiments, and reproducibility details are included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种因果优化器交互演算，将路径实现、Möbius分解和实验识别分离，用于分析优化器配置对输出的因果效应。在固定创新耦合下，每个有限时域创新驱动优化器存在行为最小路径实现。通过incidence算子获得完整观测规范、精确可辨识性、尖锐商稳定性、保留预测和精确无噪声配置复杂度。平滑隐藏松弛通过逆隐藏状态刚度产生交互。可观测读出转移定理表明任意平滑更新或迹读出通过第一和第二隐藏响应继承显式五项交互。65维强凸逻辑模型实验验证了布尔效应与连续交互曲率积分的一致性（误差4.21e-11），保留预测误差8.88e-13，高斯推断达到预测覆盖率和功效。
Motivation: 优化器实验观测到对算法配置的响应，但无法唯一揭示隐藏机制，需要一种因果形式化方法来实现路径实现、交互分解和实验识别的分离。
Method: 发展因果优化器交互演算，基于路径实现、Möbius分解和incidence算子构建识别框架，并证明可观测读出转移定理，推导高斯商极小极大风险、精确置信集与检验、误设定分解等。
Result: 理论给出精确可辨识性、商稳定性、保留预测等性质；65维逻辑回归实验显示布尔效应与独立积分曲率在4.21e-11内一致，九个保留连续强度在8.88e-13内一致，4500个真实小批量观测拒绝二阶交互模型。
Conclusion: 该框架为优化器交互提供了结构化定律和识别方法，但未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Eigenbasis-Independent Learnable Spectral Positional Encodings for Directed Graphs via Hermitian Block Krylov Subspaces
papers.abstract_en: Spectral positional encodings (PEs) for \emph{directed} graphs face two obstacles: magnetic Laplacians require an $O(n^3)$ Hermitian eigendecomposition per potential, and their complex eigenvectors are defined only up to unitary gauge, which prior work handles with basis-invariant architectures. We propose learnable spectral PEs of the form $h_θ(A_q)\,R$, where $A_q$ is a normalized magnetic operator, $h_θ$ a learnable scalar spectral response, and $R$ a block of random probes. Because the PE is a \emph{matrix function} of the operator, it is gauge-invariant by construction. We compute it in a Hermitian block Krylov subspace from sparse matrix--vector products only, prove that $k = O(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ block steps suffice uniformly over heat--resolvent response families, and give a covering-number argument for why low-dimensional structured families generalize where free per-eigenvalue weights overfit. On a directed SBM whose symmetrization is uninformative by construction, direction-blind PEs stay at chance while magnetic Krylov PEs converge to the exact-eigendecomposition oracle as the depth grows. The same probes yield gauge-invariant pairwise features with $1/\sqrt{s}$ Monte-Carlo error, and the undirected $q{=}0$ case improves heterophilous benchmarks over no-PE and polynomial baselines.
papers.comment: 8 pages main, theorem and type fixed
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对有向图的谱位置编码（PE）方法，通过 Hermitian 块 Krylov 子空间计算磁拉普拉斯算子的矩阵函数，实现特征基无关（eigenbasis-independent）且规范不变（gauge-invariant）的编码。理论证明 O(log(1/ε)) 步块迭代即可达到均匀逼近，并在有向随机块模型（SBM）上验证了方向感知能力。
Motivation: 有向图的谱位置编码面临两大障碍：磁拉普拉斯算子需要 O(n³) 的 Hermitian 特征分解，且复特征向量受规范自由度影响，现有方法依赖基不变架构。
Method: 提出可学习谱 PE 形式为 h_θ(A_q)R，其中 A_q 是归一化磁算子，h_θ 是可学习标量谱响应，R 是随机探针块。通过 Hermitian 块 Krylov 子空间仅用稀疏矩阵-向量乘积计算，避免显式特征分解。
Result: 理论证明 k = O(log(1/ε)) 步块 Krylov 迭代即可均匀逼近热-预解响应族；在方向性 SBM 上，方向盲 PE 性能如同随机，而磁 Krylov PE 随深度增长收敛到精确特征分解 oracle；无向情况（q=0）改善异配图基准。
Conclusion: 所提方法通过矩阵函数构造实现固有规范不变性，避免了特征分解和基选择问题，并给出了低维结构族泛化的覆盖数论证。

papers.title: When do prophets profit in prediction markets?
papers.abstract_en: Prediction markets aggregate dispersed beliefs into prices that act as probabilistic forecasts of uncertain events. Classical theory establishes a clean equivalence between forecasting accuracy and trading profit, but only for the specific automated market maker (AMM) design. However, the largest exchanges today are based on central limit order books in which informed forecasters routinely lose money while uninformed strategies can profit on simple heuristics. We resolve this discrepancy by establishing a formal equivalence between predictive accuracy and profitability. For any strictly proper scoring rule $S$, we exhibit a "proper" betting strategy that depends only on the forecaster's prediction $\mathbf{p}$ and the market price $\mathbf{q}$, and earns positive expected profit whenever $\mathbf{p}$ outperforms $\mathbf{q}$ under $S$ and the market has sufficient liquidity. Moreover, this proper betting is essentially the only strategy with such robust profitability guarantee. The proof rests on a decomposition of expected profit that strictly generalizes the classical AMM guarantee and also explains how strategies can profit without an accuracy edge. Empirically, across thousands of forecasts by AI models, proper betting is the only strategy that reliably converts accuracy into profit, and we further identify systematic forecasting personas and show how the optimal proper strategy varies across them. A month-long live deployment on Kalshi achieves $+80.33\%$ return on investment with a Sharpe ratio of $3.35$.

papers.title: x-Prediction Is All You Need:Training-Free Accelerated Generation via Endpoint Decodability
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow matching models generate high-quality samples, but their ODE samplers often need tens to hundreds of neural function evaluations (NFEs). This remains a practical challenge for released checkpoints, since many accelerators require additional design choices and training cost through retraining, distillation, or trajectory redesign. We investigate a different route based on $x$-prediction. During sampling, standard affine probability paths already expose $x_0$ information: an intermediate state and its path velocity determine a principled estimate of the clean sample. We formalize this property as \textbf{endpoint decodability} and show that the decoder is the minimum-MSE estimator $\mathbb{E}[x_0\mid x_t]$ under the usual $\ell_2$ objective. This yields \textbf{Truncated Jump Sampling} (TJS): stop the ODE at an early-exit time $t^*$ and return the decoded $x_0$. TJS requires no retraining, distillation, or architecture change. Across SDXL, SD3.5M, Z-Image-Turbo, and three class-conditional benchmarks, it reduces NFEs by 20--70\% with near-matched quality. The analysis also shows why endpoint prediction can work without straightening the trajectory, providing inference acceleration without trajectory redesign.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出截断跳跃采样（TJS），一种无需重新训练或蒸馏的扩散模型加速生成方法。通过利用x-预测的端点可解码性，在早期退出时间t*停止ODE并返回解码的x₀，从而减少20-70%的NFE，同时保持近似的生成质量。该方法在SDXL、SD3.5M、Z-Image-Turbo和三个类别条件基准上得到验证。
Motivation: 扩散和流匹配模型的ODE采样器需要数十到数百次神经函数评估，现有加速方法需要重新训练、蒸馏或重新设计轨迹，成本高昂。本文旨在无需这些改动的情况下实现加速。
Method: 形式化端点可解码性，即标准仿射概率路径中中间状态x_t与路径速度可提供干净样本x₀的最小均方误差估计。提出截断跳跃采样：在早期退出时间t*停止ODE，直接返回解码的x₀。
Result: 在SDXL、SD3.5M、Z-Image-Turbo和三个类别条件基准上，TJS减少20-70%的NFE，且生成质量与未加速版本接近。
Conclusion: 端点预测无需拉直轨迹即可实现推理加速，为训练免费的扩散模型加速提供了新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MoP-JEPA: Hard-Assigned Predictor Mixtures for Stochastic JEPA World Models
papers.abstract_en: JEPA world models commonly predict the next latent state with one regressor. Under stochastic transitions, squared and cosine regression return the conditional mean and its normalized direction, respectively: a single compromise that may match no valid successor. MoP-JEPA instead uses $K$ hard-assigned heads and a context-only router to produce a finite candidate set in one pass. On held-out OGBench transitions, graph search with single-output predictors succeeds on $0.02$--$0.09$ of queries, whereas MoP-JEPA reaches $0.85$. To distinguish useful successors from indiscriminate coverage, we also measure verified-route success (\emph{realroute}), which checks after graph construction whether the proposal contains a path of real transitions. MoP-JEPA leads this same-protocol metric on all three mazes; an MDN attains high raw coverage but predicts many nonexistent edges.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoP-JEPA 提出使用 K 个硬分配预测头和一个上下文路由器的混合方法，替代单一回归器来预测随机 JEPA 世界模型中的下一个潜在状态。在 OGBench 转换上，该方法将单输出预测器的成功率从 0.02–0.09 提升至 0.85，并在迷宫评估中引入 realroute 指标以区分真实路径与无效覆盖，显著优于 MDN。
Motivation: 现有 JEPA 世界模型用单一回归器预测下一状态，在随机转换下平方或余弦回归只能得到条件均值或其方向，可能无法匹配任何真实后继状态。
Method: 采用 K 个硬分配预测头，每个头通过一个上下文路由器的输出被硬性选择，一次性生成有限候选集；同时提出 verified-route success (realroute) 指标，在构图后检查预测是否包含真实过渡路径。
Result: 在 OGBench 转换上，单输出预测器成功率 0.02–0.09，MoP-JEPA 达到 0.85；在三个迷宫中 realroute 指标领先；MDN 原始覆盖率高但预测许多不存在边。
Conclusion: MoP-JEPA 通过硬分配预测器混合和 realroute 指标，有效提升随机世界模型的多模态预测质量，并能区分有用覆盖与无差别覆盖。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometric Causal Models
papers.abstract_en: Scientists often seek to draw causal inferences from structured data that is not independently and identically distributed, such as spatial data, network data, or molecular data. We develop geometric causal models (GCMs), a framework for causal inference from dependent data that exploits underlying symmetries of the data generating process. For example, in spatial data, we consider processes that are symmetric under translations, or in graph data, symmetric under permutations of the nodes. We show how symmetries, formalized with group theory, can enable causal identification and estimation. We deploy ergodic theory for amenable groups to establish identification, and combine geometric deep learning with scalable Bayesian inference for estimation. We recover i.i.d. causal models and do-calculus when the data is a sequence and the symmetry is permutation equivariance, and find novel types of causal models when we use alternate structures and symmetries. As an example, we construct a causal model that satisfies the symmetries of DNA. This GCM enables new estimators for the effects of genetic variation, combining deep functional genomics models to describe outcomes and DNA language models to describe propensities. We illustrate on semisynthetic data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出几何因果模型（GCMs），利用数据生成过程中的对称性（如空间平移对称、图节点置换对称）进行因果推断。通过群论形式化对称性，结合可解群的遍历理论实现因果识别，并融合几何深度学习和可扩展贝叶斯推断进行估计。示例展示了满足DNA对称性的因果模型，用于遗传变异效应估计。
Motivation: 传统因果推断方法假设数据独立同分布，但实际科学数据（如空间、网络、分子数据）往往存在依赖结构，亟需利用数据对称性进行因果推断。
Method: 将数据对称性形式化为群论，利用可解群的遍历理论进行因果识别，并采用几何深度学习与可扩展贝叶斯推断相结合的方法进行因果估计。
Result: 当数据为序列且对称性为置换等变时，恢复i.i.d.因果模型和do-calculus；使用其他结构和对称性时发现新型因果模型。在DNA对称性示例中，结合深度功能基因组学模型和DNA语言模型，实现了对遗传变异效应的新估计。
Conclusion: 几何因果模型能够利用数据对称性实现依赖数据下的因果识别和估计，拓展了因果推断的适用范围，但摘要未提及在降水预报等气象领域的应用。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Directional Curvature from Armijo Backtracking: A Low-Cost Sharpness Probe and a Calibration-Free Learning-Rate Safeguard for Adam
papers.abstract_en: The local sharpness of the loss, the top Hessian eigenvalue $λ_1$, determines the largest stable gradient step, but measuring it normally requires Lanczos or Hessian-vector iterations. We observe that a single Armijo backtracking line search already carries this information at the cost of a few forward passes: the accepted step $α$ brackets the \emph{directional} curvature $q = g^\top H g/\|g\|^2$ within the multiplicative band set by the backtracking factor. Across CIFAR-10, Fashion-MNIST and Imagenette, $\logα$ tracks $\logλ_1$ at Pearson $-0.91$ to $-0.95$, giving a low-cost online Edge-of-Stability reading. Used once at initialisation, this measurement yields a learning-rate cap (a safeguard, not a faster optimiser) that makes Adam robust to a too-large initial learning rate across more than three orders of magnitude ($10^{-3}$ to $3.0$), at about one percent overhead, and it is a no-op when the chosen rate is already safe. One probe is enough: periodic in-training probing adds no robust benefit. The raw-gradient probe exposes the mechanism but needs a safety factor calibrated to the architecture by a one-minute divergence sweep. Probing along Adam's own update direction removes this calibration: a single fixed safety factor $κ= 2$ avoids divergence on all nine architectures we test and across the full learning-rate grids of all four benchmarks, and the recipe transfers to AdamW unchanged.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用Armijo回溯线搜索中的步长α作为低成本的损失尖锐度探针，用于估计方向曲率（gᵀHg/‖g‖²），并以此作为Adam学习率的保护机制。实验表明，logα与top Hessian特征值的对数logλ₁在多个数据集上呈高度负相关（Pearson -0.91 ~ -0.95）；单次初始化探测即可使Adam对跨三个数量级的初始学习率鲁棒，且仅增加约1%开销。沿Adam更新方向探测可消除架构相关的校准需求，固定安全因子κ=2即可避免所有测试架构的发散。
Motivation: 测量损失函数的局部尖锐度（Hessian最大特征值）通常需要昂贵的Lanczos或Hessian-vector迭代，而Adam优化器对初始学习率敏感，容易因过大的学习率导致发散。
Method: 从Armijo回溯线搜索中提取接受的步长α，利用其与方向曲率q = gᵀHg/‖g‖²的关系（α在回溯因子决定的乘法带内），得到低成本的曲率估计；基于此设计一个学习率上限保护（safeguard），在Adam初始化时进行一次探测，将学习率限制在安全范围内。
Result: 在CIFAR-10、Fashion-MNIST和Imagenette上，logα与logλ₁的Pearson相关系数达到-0.91至-0.95；该方法使Adam在初始学习率从10⁻³到3.0的范围内均不发散，开销约为1%；沿Adam更新方向探测时，固定安全因子κ=2可适用于所有九种测试架构和四个基准的全部学习率网格。
Conclusion: 单次初始化探测足以提供鲁棒的学习率保护，无需训练中重复探测；沿Adam更新方向探测的版本无需针对架构校准安全因子，可直接迁移到AdamW。
Relevance: 0
