papers.title: RotateAttention: RoPE-Aware Rotation and Range Rectification for INT4 Quantized Attention in Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: In $\textbf{DiT-based video generation models equipped with 3D Rotary Position Embeddings (3D RoPE)}$, the attention mechanism remains a primary computational bottleneck due to its quadratic complexity with respect to sequence length. While quantized $\textbf{FlashAttention}$ offers a promising path toward hardware acceleration, existing low-bit quantization methods overlook two critical challenges in this setting: $\textbf{1)}$ applying online rotation matrices -- a widely used technique for mitigating outliers in Queries ($Q$) and Keys ($K$) -- is difficult to reconcile with $\textbf{RoPE}$; and $\textbf{2)}$ the non-negative attention matrix $P = \exp(QK - \max(QK))$ makes symmetric quantization waste half of the 4-bit dynamic range. In this work, we observe that the outlier distributions of $Q$ and $K$ are strongly affected by the dimensional partitioning of $\textbf{3D RoPE}$. Based on this finding, we propose $\textbf{RotateAttention}$, an efficient $\textbf{mixed-precision INT4 FlashAttention}$ framework tailored for $\textbf{DiT-based video generation models with 3D RoPE}$, using selective $\textbf{FP16 fallback}$ for accuracy-sensitive attention blocks and denoising steps. RotateAttention introduces two core techniques: $\textbf{1) RoPE-aware Rotation}$, which employs either mergeable rotation matrices that can be fused into RoPE or negligible-overhead matrices to mitigate RoPE-induced outliers in $Q$ and $K$; and $\textbf{2) Range-optimized $P$ Quantization}$, which uses fixed scales and zero-points to fully exploit the $\textbf{INT4 numerical range}$ with minimal computational overhead. Experiments show that $\textbf{RotateAttention}$ preserves video generation quality nearly identical to full-precision baselines while achieving up to 1.68$\times$ end-to-end speedup and 2.2$\times$ kernel-level acceleration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对使用3D旋转位置编码（3D RoPE）的DiT视频生成模型，提出RotateAttention框架，实现高效的INT4混合精度FlashAttention。通过RoPE-aware旋转和范围优化量化，在保持生成质量的同时取得最高1.68倍端到端加速和2.2倍kernel级加速。
Motivation: 现有低比特量化方案无法处理3D RoPE导致的Q/K异常值，且非负注意力矩阵的对称量化浪费INT4动态范围，制约视频生成模型中注意力计算的加速。
Method: 提出RotateAttention，包含两个核心技术：RoPE-aware旋转（融合可合并旋转矩阵或低开销矩阵以抑制异常值）和范围优化P量化（固定scale和zero-point充分利用INT4数值范围）。采用选择性FP16回退策略保持精度。
Result: 实验表明，RotateAttention在DiT视频生成模型上生成质量与全精度基线几乎一致，端到端加速最高1.68倍，kernel级加速2.2倍。
Conclusion: RotateAttention证明了针对3D RoPE的量化优化可有效加速视频生成模型中的注意力计算，且不牺牲生成质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exploiting Overlapping Fields of View for Redundancy-Aware Uplink Transmission in Vehicular 6G
papers.abstract_en: Emerging uplink-dominant 6G use cases, such as cooperative vehicular streaming, require efficient transmission of high-volume visual data over limited wireless resources. While semantic communications can reduce traffic by prioritizing task-relevant content, most existing approaches treat users independently and therefore overlook spatial redundancy among nearby devices' observations. This paper proposes a semantic-aware multiple access scheme that exploits overlapping fields of view among vehicular users to reduce redundant uplink transmissions. We formulate a joint perception and transmission control problem in which users decide which image patches to transmit, when to transmit them, and over which channel, subject to communication constraints. To address the resulting complexity, we introduce a practical two-phase approach. First, nearby vehicles share selected observation patches over Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) links to calculate inter-user spatial redundancy. Second, users transmit only semantically important, non-redundant patches to the base station, where observations can be reconstructed using the received patches and complementary views from neighboring vehicles. Simulation results in a dense urban vehicular scenario demonstrate that our approach improves the proportion of users who achieve high-fidelity reconstruction, highlighting the potential of semantic-aware multiple access for sustainable and resource-efficient 6G uplink systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对6G车辆上行链路中冗余传输问题，提出一种利用车辆间重叠视场的语义感知多址接入方案。通过V2V共享观测补丁计算空间冗余，仅传输语义重要且非冗余的补丁。仿真显示该方法提高了高保真重建的用户比例。
Motivation: 现有语义通信方法独立处理用户，忽略邻近设备观测的空间冗余，导致资源浪费。
Method: 提出两阶段方法：首先通过V2V链路共享补丁计算冗余；然后用户仅传输语义重要且非冗余的补丁到基站。
Result: 在密集城区车辆场景中，方法提高了实现高保真重建的用户比例。
Conclusion: 论文展示了语义感知多址接入在可持续和资源高效的6G上行系统中的潜力。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有语义通信方法独立处理用户，忽略邻近设备观测的空间冗余，导致资源浪费。
summary_sections.method: 提出两阶段方法：首先通过V2V链路共享补丁计算冗余；然后用户仅传输语义重要且非冗余的补丁到基站。
summary_sections.result: 在密集城区车辆场景中，方法提高了实现高保真重建的用户比例。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文展示了语义感知多址接入在可持续和资源高效的6G上行系统中的潜力。

papers.title: Characterizing Large Language Model Agentic Workflows: A Study on N8n Ecosystem
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are rapidly being adopted in low-code and no-code automation platforms, where non-expert users design workflows that combine natural language understanding with external services and APIs. LLM agents are LLM systems that use LLMs as a core "brain" to reason, plan, and autonomously execute complex, multi-step tasks. In this paper, we present the first large-scale empirical study of LLM agentic workflows in low-code automation platforms. We analyze more than 6,000 publicly available n8n workflows and examine four aspects of their design: task distribution, structural and tool use patterns, reliability mechanisms, and autonomy levels. Our analysis shows that LLM workflows are not merely prompt response pipelines. Instead, LLMs are commonly embedded within broader automation structures involving control logic, external tools, communication services, storage systems, and human review points. We further find that while many workflows include lightweight post-processing or routing logic after LLM execution, explicit reliability mechanisms such as structured fallback paths, repair loops, failure-specific alerts, and human approval gates remain relatively uncommon. These results reveal a gap between the increasing deployment of LLM agents in practical automation ecosystems and the limited engineering support for reliability, safety, and governance. Overall, our study provides ten empirical findings and five research takeaways for researchers, platform developers, and practitioners seeking to understand and improve real-world LLM agentic workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次大规模实证研究低代码自动化平台（如n8n）中的LLM代理工作流。分析了超过6000个公开的n8n工作流，发现LLM不仅用于提示响应，还嵌入控制逻辑、外部工具、通信服务、存储系统和人工审核点中。同时指出显式可靠性机制（如回退路径、修复循环、故障告警、人工审批）仍不常见，揭示了实际部署与工程支撑的差距。
Motivation: LLM正快速被低代码/无代码自动化平台采纳，但缺乏对真实LLM代理工作流设计模式与可靠性机制的实证理解。
Method: 对n8n生态中6000余个公开工作流进行大规模分析，考察任务分布、结构与工具使用模式、可靠性机制以及自主性水平四个方面。
Result: LLM工作流并非简单的提示响应管道，而是嵌入更广泛的自动化结构中；显式可靠性机制（如回退、修复、告警、审批）相对少见。
Conclusion: 研究提供了十项实证发现和五项研究启示，帮助研究人员、平台开发者和实践者理解和改进真实世界中的LLM代理工作流。

papers.title: Meshtryoshka: Differentiable Rendering of Real-World Scenes via Mesh Rasterization
papers.abstract_en: Differentiable rendering has emerged as a powerful approach for 3D reconstruction and novel view synthesis. State-of-the-art differentiable rendering methods combine a variety of custom representations of 3D geometry and appearance with specialized renderers. However, most downstream tasks in computer graphics rely on 3D meshes. While prior work has attempted differentiable rendering with mesh representations, these approaches are limited to object-centric scenes and fail to reconstruct large-scale, unbounded scenes. In this work, we introduce Meshtryoshka, a novel mesh differentiable rendering framework that combines an off-the-shelf triangle rasterizer with a 3D representation that consists of nested mesh shells which resemble a matryoshka doll. In every forward pass, the mesh shells are extracted anew from a 3D signed distance function via iso-surface extraction, and the opacities for each vertex are computed as a function of signed distance. Each mesh shell is then rasterized independently, and the final image is created via alpha compositing. Crucially, mesh vertex positions are updated only indirectly via gradients that flow through the opacity values into the signed distance function, and hence, our method is compatible with off-the-shelf mesh renderers that need not be differentiable with respect to vertex positions. On object-centric scenes, our method performs competitively with surface-based differentiable rendering techniques. Our differentiable mesh rendering method scales to unbounded, real-world 3D scenes, where it yields high-quality novel view synthesis results approaching those of state-of-the-art, non-mesh methods. Our method suggests that it may be possible to solve the differentiable rendering problem without relying on specialized renderers, only using conventional tools from the computer graphics toolbox.
papers.comment: Daniel Xu and David Charatan contributed equally; author order decided by coin flip. Project website: https://danielxu9393.github.io/meshtryoshka-website/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Meshtryoshka，一种基于网格光栅化的可微分渲染框架，使用嵌套的网格壳（类似俄罗斯套娃）表示 3D 场景，结合离壳光栅化器，通过符号距离函数更新顶点位置，实现大规模无界场景的高质量新视角合成。
Motivation: 现有可微分渲染方法多使用自定义 3D 表示和专用渲染器，而计算机图形学下游任务依赖网格，但基于网格的可微分渲染无法处理大规模无界场景。
Method: 提出 Meshtryoshka 框架，使用嵌套网格壳表示场景，每次前向传播从符号距离函数提取等值面生成网格壳，顶点不透明度由符号距离计算，独立光栅化后 alpha 合成。顶点位置通过梯度间接更新，兼容离壳网格渲染器。
Result: 在物体级场景上性能与基于表面的可微分渲染技术相当，在无界真实场景中达到接近非网格方法的高质量新视角合成。
Conclusion: 表明无需专用渲染器，仅使用传统计算机图形学工具即可解决可微分渲染问题。

papers.title: Cognitive Episodes in LLM Reasoning Traces Enable Interpretable Human Item Difficulty Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting human item difficulty is central to educational assessment, where reliable estimates support fairness and effective test construction. Existing methods often depend on costly human calibration or item-level textual representations, providing limited evidence about the cognitive processes that make items difficult. We argue that difficulty should be viewed not only as a property of item text, but also as an observable consequence of the problem-solving burden an item induces. Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) offer scalable process evidence through reasoning traces, but such evidence must be structured to support interpretable modeling. To this end, we introduce Epi2Diff (Episode to Difficulty), a framework that maps LRM reasoning traces into cognitively grounded episode sequences. These episodes group trace segments into functional problem-solving states, enabling difficulty to be modeled through reasoning scale, effort allocation, and state transitions. Epi2Diff extracts compact episode-dynamic features and combines them with semantic item representations for human difficulty prediction. Experiments on four real-world human difficulty datasets show that Epi2Diff consistently outperforms strong baselines, including fine-tuned small language models, LLM in-context learning, and supervised LLM adaptation. On SAT-derived classification benchmarks, Epi2Diff achieves an 8.1% average relative gain over supervised LLM fine-tuning baselines. Further analyses show that harder items induce more effortful, iterative, and implementation-centered episode dynamics, rather than merely longer responses. These results demonstrate that cognitive episodes in LRM reasoning traces provide a predictive and interpretable process representation for human item difficulty, offering a new lens for educational measurement with reasoning models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Epi2Diff框架，利用大型推理模型（LRM）的推理轨迹生成认知片段（cognitive episodes）来预测人类项目难度。该框架将推理轨迹映射为问题解决状态序列，提取片段动态特征并结合语义表示，在四个真实数据集上优于强基线，在SAT分类任务上相对提升8.1%。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖昂贵的人类校准或项目文本表示，缺乏对认知过程的证据。作者认为难度应被视为问题解决负担的可观察结果，而LRM推理轨迹可提供过程证据，但需结构化建模。
Method: Epi2Diff将LRM推理轨迹映射为认知片段序列，每组片段代表问题解决功能状态，通过推理规模、努力分配和状态转换建模难度。提取紧凑的片段动态特征，与语义表示结合进行预测。
Result: 在四个真实人类难度数据集上，Epi2Diff持续优于微调小模型、LLM上下文学习和监督LLM适配等基线。在SAT分类基准上，相比监督LLM微调基线平均相对提升8.1%。更难的项目引发更费力、迭代和实现为中心的片段动态。
Conclusion: LRM推理轨迹中的认知片段为人类项目难度提供了可预测且可解释的过程表示，为教育测量提供了新视角。

papers.title: NaviCache: Test-Time Self-Calibration Caching for Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) is constrained by immense computational costs. While offline calibration-based acceleration suffers from calibration data dependency, prohibitive calibration duration, and susceptibility to distribution shifts, offline calibration-free methods eliminate these hurdles. However, since they rely on instantaneous zero-order approximations where the mapping between input and output differences varies in real-time, they are susceptible to observational noise and ignore the intrinsic momentum within the diffusion trajectory. In this paper, we propose NaviCache, a plug-and-play test-time self-calibration method re-conceptualizing feature evolution as an Inertial Navigation System (INS) problem. NaviCache bridges the fundamental domain gap and the non-stationary nature of diffusion by modeling the relative coupling between input and output variations. We introduce a dual-state estimation architecture that adaptively tracks the feature change ratio and its latent drift, initialized via a specialized Initial Alignment phase. By integrating a time-dependent noise schedule with an uncertainty-aware Measurement Update mechanism, NaviCache provides a theoretically grounded mechanism for error-bounded computation skipping. Extensive experiments on the HunyuanVideo, Wan, and Open-Sora series demonstrate that NaviCache exhibits more accurate error judgment for computation skipping and achieves outstanding comprehensive performance.
papers.comment: Published at ICML 2026: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea. PMLR 306, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NaviCache，一种即插即用的测试时自校准缓存方法，用于加速视频扩散模型 (VDMs) 的推理。它将特征演化重新概念化为惯性导航系统 (INS) 问题，通过双状态估计架构自适应跟踪特征变化比率及其潜在漂移，并集成时间相关噪声计划和不确定性感知测量更新机制，实现有误差界的计算跳过。在 HunyuanVideo、Wan、Open-Sora 系列上的实验显示 NaviCache 在计算跳过时具有更准确的误差判断和出色的综合性能。
Motivation: 视频扩散模型计算成本极高；现有的基于离线校准的加速方法存在校准数据依赖、校准时间长、易受分布偏移影响等问题，而离线免校准方法依赖于瞬时零阶近似，易受观测噪声影响且忽略了扩散轨迹内的内在动量。
Method: 提出 NaviCache，一种即插即用的测试时自校准缓存方法，将特征演化建模为惯性导航系统 (INS) 问题。引入双状态估计架构，通过初始对准阶段初始化，自适应跟踪特征变化比率及其潜在漂移。集成时间相关噪声计划和不确定性感知测量更新机制，提供有误差界的计算跳过。
Result: 在 HunyuanVideo、Wan、Open-Sora 系列上的实验表明，NaviCache 在计算跳过时具有更准确的误差判断，并取得优异的综合性能。
Conclusion: NaviCache 通过自校准桥接了领域差距和扩散的非平稳性，提供了一种理论上有误差界的计算跳过机制。

papers.title: Average-Power-Budgeted Underwater Vehicle Control via Constrained Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Underwater vehicles operate from a fixed onboard energy budget that propulsion rapidly depletes, so a controller that completes its task while drawing less thruster power directly extends mission range and endurance. Reinforcement learning yields capable model-free controllers for station-keeping and trajectory tracking, but optimizing task accuracy alone drives the policy toward oscillatory, energy-wasting actuation. The established remedy subtracts an energy penalty from the reward, yet this sets the task-power trade-off through a single weight with no physical units: a target power level cannot be specified, the weight must be re-tuned for every vehicle and task, and a mismatched weight can even raise power. This paper instead formulates energy-efficient underwater control as a constrained Markov decision process in which average thruster power is subject to an explicit budget, solved with a PPO-Lagrangian algorithm. The power level is set by declaring a budget in physical units, and a single dual variable is updated online to meet it for each vehicle and task, without manual weight search. Across three vehicles and four tasks in the MarineGym simulator, the energy-constrained policy draws the least power in all twelve settings, reducing it by 14--65\% (up to 64.9\%) over a task-only baseline and below an energy-reward baseline everywhere, while remaining the smoothest in ten settings and preserving task accuracy except in one deliberately power-limited regime. Imposing energy as an explicit constraint thus offers a tuning-free route to energy-efficient underwater control that needs no per-vehicle, per-task weight search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将水下航行器的节能控制建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），通过PPO-Lagrangian算法显式约束平均推进器功率。在MarineGym模拟器上的三个航行器和四个任务中，该方法在所有12个设置中消耗最低功率，相比仅任务奖励的基线降低14-65%，且无需手动调参。
Motivation: 现有强化学习控制器仅优化任务精度会导致振荡和能量浪费；添加能量惩罚项至奖励函数的方法无法指定目标功率水平，且需针对每个航行器和任务重新调参，甚至可能增加能耗。
Method: 将问题形式化为平均功率受预算约束的CMDP，采用PPO-Lagrangian算法在线更新单一对偶变量以满足功率约束，无需手动搜索权重。
Result: 在三个航行器和四个任务的12个设置中，约束策略在所有设置中消耗最低功率，较仅任务奖励基线降低14-65%（最高达64.9%），且在所有场景中均低于能量惩罚基线；在十个设置中保持最平滑的驱动力，除一个刻意限能情形外均维持任务精度。
Conclusion: 将能量作为显式约束提供了无需调参的节能水下控制方案，避免每个航行器和任务的手动权重搜索。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 将能量作为显式约束提供了无需调参的节能水下控制方案，避免每个航行器和任务的手动权重搜索。

papers.title: RankGraph-2: Lifecycle Co-Design for Billion-Node Graph Learning in Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Graph-based retrieval at billion-node scale requires jointly solving three tightly coupled problems -- graph construction, representation learning, and real-time serving -- yet existing work addresses each in isolation. We present RankGraph-2, a framework deployed at Meta that co-designs all three lifecycle stages for similarity-based retrieval (U2U2I and U2I2I), where each stage's requirements shape the others. Serving requires a co-learned cluster index to avoid expensive online KNN -- this pushes index co-training into the training objective. Training benefits from the observation that similarity-based retrieval tolerates pre-computed neighborhoods, eliminating online graph infrastructure -- this requires construction to produce self-contained data. Construction must also support hour-level refresh for item coverage. Acting on these cascading requirements, RankGraph-2 reduces hundreds of trillions of edges to hundreds of billions via subsampling with popularity bias correction, pre-computes multi-hop neighborhoods via personalized PageRank, and co-learns a residual-quantization cluster index that reduces serving computational cost by 83%. This lifecycle co-design enables a simple architecture to achieve 3.8 x higher recall than a GAT + Deep Graph Infomax model on a bipartite graph and 2.1 x higher than PyTorch-BigGraph on item retrieval. RankGraph-2 delivers up to +0.96% CTR and +2.75% CVR, and has powered 20+ retrieval launches across major surfaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RankGraph-2 是 Meta 部署的十亿节点规模图检索框架，协同设计图构建、表示学习和实时服务三个生命周期阶段。通过子采样、预计算多跳邻域和残差量化聚类索引，实现了比现有方法更高的召回率和在线业务指标。
Motivation: 现有的图检索方法分别处理图构建、表示学习和在线服务，忽略了三者之间的相互依赖关系，导致在十亿节点规模下效率低下。

papers.title: The Geometry of Saturation: Effective Rank Predicts When Labels Stop Helping in Few-Shot Classification
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot label acquisition lacks a label-free signal for when additional labels cease to improve accuracy: existing stopping criteria either require a held-out validation set (violating the few-shot premise) or rely on theoretically ungrounded heuristics, so we introduce the spectral saturation index $S(K)=\mathrm{erank}(\hatΣ_W^{(K)})/K$, the exponential spectral entropy of the pooled within-class covariance normalized by per-class support size $K$, which measures the exploration rate per label and falls below a fixed threshold $τ=0.02$ once the explored spectral subspace saturates and marginal accuracy gains vanish; across 49 real tasks (binary, 5-way, 10-way) and three frozen backbones (PCA-50, CLIP ViT-B/32, DINOv2 ViT-S/14), $S(K)$ correlates strongly with the marginal gain on doubling the support set ($ρ_{\text{pool}}=0.6366$, $p=2.9\times10^{-57}$, cluster-bootstrap 95\% CI $[0.551,0.720]$), a fixed $τ=0.02$ classifies stop/continue decisions with cluster-bootstrap $\mathrm{AUC}=0.787$ (95\% CI $[0.713,0.860]$) with high recall on meaningful gains ($ΔA>1\%$), and a partial correlation controlling for $\log K$ yields $ρ_{\text{partial}}=0.324$ ($p=1.65\times10^{-13}$), confirming $S(K)$ carries spectral information beyond shared $K$-dependence; theory predicts this from first principles, since the population effective rank sets the saturation scale $K_{\text{sat}}\approx\mathrm{erank}(Σ_W)/τ$, $τ=0.02$ sits at the boundary between the first and second descent (Nakkiran et al., 2021), and $O(1/K)$ bias in the sample effective rank explains the small-$K$ hump in $S(K)$; for unregularized linear probes ($C=\infty$), practitioners should halt when $S(K)<0.02$ (PCA-50, hard stop) or monitor $S(K)$ dropping from $\sim0.3\to0.05$ (foundation models, diminishing-returns signal), with computation costing $\sim1$ ms at $d=50$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出谱饱和指数S(K)=erank(Σ_W^(K))/K，用于在小样本分类中判断何时增加标注样本不再提升准确率。S(K)衡量每个标签的探索速率，当低于固定阈值τ=0.02时，边际增益消失。在49个真实任务和三个冻结骨干上，S(K)与加倍支持集后的边际增益强相关（ρ=0.6366），且固定阈值分类停止/继续决策的AUC=0.787。理论分析表明，总体有效秩决定了饱和尺度K_sat≈erank(Σ_W)/τ。
Motivation: 现有小样本标签获取缺乏无标签信号的停止准则：需要验证集违反了小样本前提，或依赖无理论依据的启发式方法。
Method: 定义谱饱和指数S(K)=erank(Σ_W^(K))/K，即池化类内协方差矩阵的指数谱熵除以每类支持集大小K。通过阈值τ=0.02判断是否停止采集标签。
Result: 在49个真实任务（二分类、5-way、10-way）和三个骨干（PCA-50, CLIP ViT-B/32, DINOv2 ViT-S/14）上，S(K)与边际增益相关系数ρ=0.6366（p=2.9×10^{-57}），固定阈值τ=0.02分类停止/继续的AUC=0.787，对有意义增益（ΔA>1%）召回率高。控制log K后的偏相关系数为ρ=0.324（p=1.65×10^{-13}）。计算开销约1ms（d=50）。
Conclusion: S(K)是一个理论上有依据且计算高效的停止准则，适用于线性探测（C=∞）场景。实践中，对于PCA-50可在S(K)<0.02时硬停止；对于基础模型，监视S(K)从~0.3降至~0.05作为收益递减信号。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Embodied-R1.5: Evolving Physical Intelligence via Embodied Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Embodied-R1.5, a unified Embodied Foundation Model (EFM) that integrates comprehensive embodied reasoning capabilities, spanning embodied cognition, task planning, correction, and pointing, within a single architecture toward general physical intelligence. Leveraging three automated data construction pipelines to significantly expand the data coverage of critical capabilities, we build a large-scale data system of over 15B tokens, and design a multi-task balanced RL recipe to alleviate heterogeneous task conflicts. We further introduce a Planner-Grounder-Corrector (PGC) closed-loop framework that enables a single model to autonomously execute and self-correct over long-horizon tasks. With only 8B parameters, Embodied-R1.5 achieves SOTA on 16 out of 24 embodied VLM benchmarks, surpassing leading models like Gemini-Robotics-ER-1.5 and GPT-5.4. Benefiting from the internalized embodied capabilities, Embodied-R1.5 can be fine-tuned into a VLA with only a small amount of data, outperforming leading VLA models like $π_{0.5}$ across 4 popular manipulation benchmark suites. We further conduct extensive zero-shot real-robot experiments, validating performance in instruction following, affordance grounding, articulated object manipulation, and long-horizon complex tasks, demonstrating strong generalization to the physical world. We open-source model weights, datasets, training code, and EmbodiedEvalKit, an evaluation framework tailored for embodied tasks, to facilitate future research in EFMs.
papers.comment: Embodied R1.5 technical report. Project page: https://embodied-r.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Embodied-R1.5 是一个统一的具身基础模型（EFM），通过三个自动化数据构建管道和超过15B token的大规模数据系统，结合多任务平衡强化学习，将具身推理能力（认知、规划、纠正、指向）集成到单一架构中。该模型仅8B参数，在24个具身VLM基准上取得16个SOTA，并可通过少量数据微调成VLA，超越领先模型。
Motivation: 现有具身模型缺乏统一的推理能力，且数据覆盖不足、异构任务冲突难以处理，限制了向通用物理智能的发展。
Method: 提出三个自动化数据构建管道来扩充关键能力的数据覆盖，构建15B+ token数据系统；设计多任务平衡的强化学习配方以缓解任务冲突；引入规划器-接地器-纠正器（PGC）闭环框架，使单一模型能自主执行和自纠正长时域任务。
Result: Embodied-R1.5（8B参数）在24个具身VLM基准上取得16个SOTA，超越Gemini-Robotics-ER-1.5和GPT-5.4；微调为VLA后在4个流行操控基准上超越π_{0.5}；零样本真实机器人实验验证了指令跟随、可供性定位、铰接物体操作和长时域复杂任务上的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 该工作通过统一架构和大规模数据训练，实现了具身基础模型在多项任务上的领先性能，并开源模型、数据、训练代码和评估框架以推动研究。

papers.title: Learning Dynamics Reveal a Hierarchy of Weight-Induced Layerwise Gram Metrics
papers.abstract_en: We study feed-forward ReLU networks with fixed readout and quadratic loss, and rewrite gradient descent as a collective dynamics of activation fields and conjugate fields on the training set. Working to first order in the learning rate inside a fixed activation chamber, we derive explicitly the one-, two- and three-hidden-layer cases, and then give the arbitrary-depth recursion. For one hidden layer the activation dynamics closes directly and the residual update is governed by the product of an input Gram matrix and a co-activation/backpropagation Gram matrix. For two hidden layers a conjugate field is required, but no nontrivial pullback Gram metric has yet appeared. For three hidden layers the first weight-induced pullback Gram metric enters the conjugate-field dynamics. At arbitrary depth, activation variations propagate forward through a recursive response operator \(\cU_\ell^{αβ}\), while conjugate-field variations propagate backward through an effective transport operator \(\cM_\ell^{αβ}\). Their contractions reconstruct a layerwise residual kernel \[ K_{αβ}^{(L)}=\sum_{\ell=1}^{L}Q_{αβ}^{(\ell-1)}S_{αβ}^{(\ell)}. \] The resulting description exposes a duality between push-forward and pullback transport across every layer cut, and identifies the first Gram metrics as the lowest nontrivial terms in a broader hierarchy of activation-conditioned transport operators. We deliberately stop at the level of collective fields, conjugate fields, residual kernels and cut-wise transport metrics, leaving the later tensorial geometric formulation outside the scope of this paper.

papers.title: The Injection Paradox: Brand-Level Suppression in Safety-Trained LLM Recommendations via RAG Context Injection
papers.abstract_en: We present a reproducible failure mode of safety training in RAG-based LLM recommendation, the Injection Paradox, in which prompt injections embedded in retrieved documents backfire against the attacker, suppressing the target brand below the injection-free baseline. In safety-trained Claude models, documents containing prompt injections suffer a sharp drop in recommendation rate, and this suppression propagates beyond the injected document to unmodified documents of the same brand. In Claude Opus 4.6, the target brand drops from a 54% baseline to zero top-2 recommendations across all 50 trials, even though only 1 of 4 brand documents in the corpus contains an injection. The directional pattern is reproduced in counterfactual experiments and across three brands. A contrasting result across the GPT models tested, where the same injection instead increases recommendations, suggests model-family differences in how injection-like context affects recommendation behavior. These findings raise the technical possibility of a reverse-attack scenario in which an adversary embeds injections in a competitor's documents to suppress the competitor's brand via safety-sensitive model behavior. Code, prompts, privacy-preserving per-trial outcome records, and aggregate results are released.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 1 figure, 15 tables. Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Failure Modes in Agentic AI (FAGEN), a non-archival venue
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现并展示了基于RAG的LLM推荐系统中安全训练的一个可复现的失败模式，即'注入悖论'：嵌入在检索文档中的提示注入反而会抑制目标品牌的推荐率。在安全训练的Claude模型中，包含提示注入的文档推荐率大幅下降，且抑制效应会传播到同一品牌的其他未修改文档。在Claude Opus 4.6中，即使语料库中只有1/4的品牌文档包含注入，目标品牌的top-2推荐率从54%降至零。相反，在GPT模型中，相同的注入反而增加了推荐率，表明不同模型家族对注入样式的反应不同。
Motivation: 现有安全训练在RAG推荐场景下可能产生意外副作用：本来旨在防止恶意注入的安全机制反而被对手利用来压制竞争对手品牌。需要理解和防范这种反向攻击。
Method: 通过构建包含品牌文档的RAG推荐语料库，在部分文档中嵌入提示注入，然后测试不同模型（Claude Opus 4.6等）对目标品牌的推荐率变化。进行反事实实验和跨品牌复现。
Result: 在Claude Opus 4.6上，目标品牌top-2推荐率从54%降到0%（50次试验）；同一品牌其他未注入文档也受到抑制。在GPT模型中，注入反而增加推荐。模式在三个品牌上复现。
Conclusion: 这些发现揭示了安全训练的LLM推荐系统存在一种技术可能性：攻击者可以通过在竞争对手文档中嵌入注入来压制竞争对手品牌。模型家族间存在差异。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 这些发现揭示了安全训练的LLM推荐系统存在一种技术可能性：攻击者可以通过在竞争对手文档中嵌入注入来压制竞争对手品牌。模型家族间存在差异。

papers.title: RWGBench: Evaluating Scholarly Positioning in Related Work Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have shown strong fluency in scientific writing, yet the evaluation of related work generation (RWG) remains limited. Existing RWG evaluations largely inherit summarization-oriented metrics, using lexical or semantic similarity to reference sections as proxies for quality. However, related work writing is fundamentally a citation-level scholarly positioning task: it requires selecting, organizing, and framing prior work to clarify how a target paper relates to, differs from, and contributes beyond existing research.As a result, models may generate coherent and semantically-relevant text while exhibiting academically critical failures, such as inappropriate citation selection or misplaced references, that conventional metrics do not capture.To this end, we introduce \textbf{RWGBench}, a benchmark that evaluates RWG from the perspective of citation decision-making rather than text similarity. RWGBench is constructed from a large-scale collection of 40,108 computer science papers and a retrieval corpus of 1.09 million documents, with a carefully curated test set comprising 100 papers and their corresponding published related work sections.We propose a multi-dimensional evaluation framework that assesses citation selection, contextual appropriateness, organization, and discourse structure.Experiments reveal systematic limitations in current systems that are obscured by standard evaluations, while Oracle studies further disentangle retrieval-level and generation-level bottlenecks. Human evaluation further shows that our citation-centric metrics align substantially better with expert judgment than surface-level text metrics. RWGBench offers a citation-centric testbed for developing and evaluating related work generation systems that are better aligned with scholarly writing practices.
papers.comment: 9 pages, code and data available at https://github.com/BFTree/RWGBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RWGBench，一个从引用决策角度评估相关工作生成 (RWG) 的基准，而非传统基于文本相似度的指标。基准包含 40,108 篇计算机科学论文和 109 万文档的检索语料库，以及 100 篇论文的测试集。实验显示当前系统存在被标准评估掩盖的局限性，而引用中心的指标与专家判断更一致。
Motivation: 现有相关工作生成评估主要使用基于摘要的指标（如词汇或语义相似度），无法捕捉学术写作中引用选择不当、位置错放等关键失败。
Method: 构建 RWGBench，提出多维评估框架，包括引用选择、上下文恰当性、组织和话语结构。利用大规模论文集合检索语料库，设置 Oracle 研究分离检索与生成瓶颈。
Result: 实验揭示当前系统在引用决策上的系统性缺陷，而引用中心指标与专家判断的相关性显著优于表面文本指标。
Conclusion: RWGBench 提供了一个引用中心的测试平台，用于开发与学术写作实践更一致的相关工作生成系统。

papers.title: Multi-Scale Separable Fourier Neural Networks for Solving High-Frequency PDEs
papers.abstract_en: Solving high-frequency partial differential equations (PDEs) with neural networks is notoriously difficult due to the spectral bias of conventional architectures. We propose the Multi-Scale Separable Fourier Neural Network (MS-SFNN), a framework designed to overcome this limitation by explicitly encoding multi-scale Fourier features within a separable representation. The network factorizes the solution into $d$ single-coordinate subnetworks with fixed, randomly initialized weights; these subnetworks are combined via element-wise products to form a rich set of basis functions. This separable construction scales linearly with the problem dimension, thus inherently alleviating the curse of dimensionality. Crucially, each subnetwork is equipped with trainable scaling factors coupled with cosine activations, providing an adaptive mechanism for multi-scale frequency selection that endows the model with strong spectral approximation capability. The PDE solution is expressed as a linear combination of these learned basis functions, and the combination coefficients are determined by solving a large-scale least-squares system. To resolve the memory bottleneck in high-frequency or three-dimensional settings, we replace automatic differentiation (AD) with analytical derivatives of the basis functions and use a memory-efficient batched QR decomposition for solving the least-squares systems efficiently. Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate that MS-SFNN achieves superior accuracy and substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods, including Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) and the Separated-Variable Spectral Neural Network (SV-SNN).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多尺度可分离傅里叶神经网络（MS-SFNN），用于求解高频偏微分方程。该网络通过可分离表示将解分解为d个单坐标子网络，结合可训练尺度因子与余弦激活实现多尺度频率选择，并利用解析导数与内存高效的批处理QR分解求解最小二乘系统，从而缓解谱偏差与维数灾难。实验表明MS-SFNN在精度上显著优于PINN和SV-SNN等方法。
Motivation: 传统神经网络存在谱偏差，难以求解高频PDE；同时高维问题面临维数灾难，现有方法如PINN在高频或三维场景下精度不足且内存开销大。
Method: 将解表示为d个单坐标子网络的元素乘积，每个子网络使用固定随机初始化权重并配备可训练尺度因子与余弦激活；通过解析导数替代自动微分，采用批处理QR分解高效求解大规模最小二乘系统。
Result: 摘要报告MS-SFNN在多个高频PDE算例上取得优越精度，显著超越PINN和SV-SNN等最先进方法。
Conclusion: 可分离傅里叶表示结合自适应频率选择可有效克服谱偏差，解析导数与批处理QR分解缓解了内存瓶颈，为高频PDE求解提供了高效方案。
Relevance: 60

papers.title: Prompt Compression in Diffusion Large Language Models: Evaluating LLMLingua-2 on LLaDA
papers.abstract_en: Prompt compression reduces inference cost and context length in large language models, but prior evaluations focus mainly on autoregressive architectures. This study examines whether LLMLingua-2 transfers effectively to diffusion large language models (DLLMs), specifically LLaDA-8B-Instruct. We evaluate GSM8K, DUC2004, and ShareGPT using 250 prompts per dataset at an approximate 50\% compression ratio, covering mathematical reasoning, prompt reconstruction, and summarization. Outputs from original, compressed, and reconstructed prompts are compared using exact-match accuracy, BLEU, ROUGE, and BERTScore. Results show that high semantic preservation does not necessarily ensure stable downstream behavior in diffusion models. Summarization remains relatively robust, while mathematical reasoning degrades substantially despite high semantic similarity. Reconstruction further shows that semantically similar prompts may omit reasoning-critical information needed for stable denoising. Overall, compression failures are mainly driven by information omission rather than semantic drift, suggesting that autoregressive prompt compression methods may not transfer uniformly to DLLMs. These findings motivate diffusion-aware compression strategies.
papers.comment: Accepted to appear in The 14th International Conference on Advances in Information Technology (IAIT2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了LLMLingua-2在扩散大语言模型LLaDA-8B-Instruct上的转移效果，使用GSM8K、DUC2004和ShareGPT数据集以约50%压缩比进行测试。结果表明高语义保留不一定保证稳定下游行为，数学推理严重退化，提示自回归提示压缩方法可能无法均匀迁移到DLLMs。
Motivation: 提示压缩能降低推理成本和上下文长度，但以往评估主要针对自回归架构，缺乏对扩散大语言模型（DLLMs）的评估。
Method: 选取LLaDA-8B-Instruct作为DLLM代表，使用LLMLingua-2进行提示压缩，在GSM8K、DUC2004和ShareGPT上各用250个提示、约50%压缩比，通过精确匹配、BLEU、ROUGE和BERTScore评估输出。
Result: 数学推理任务在压缩后性能显著下降，尽管语义相似度高；摘要任务相对稳健；重构显示语义相似提示可能遗漏推理关键信息。
Conclusion: 压缩失败主要由信息遗漏而非语义漂移导致，自回归提示压缩方法可能不均匀迁移到DLLMs，需开发扩散感知的压缩策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IntentVLA: Short-Horizon Intent Modeling for Aliased Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Robot imitation data are often multimodal: similar visual-language observations may be followed by different action chunks because human demonstrators act with different short-horizon intents, task phases, or recent context. Existing frame-conditioned VLA policies infer each chunk from the current observation and instruction alone, so under partial observability they may resample different intents across adjacent replanning steps, leading to inter-chunk conflict and unstable execution. We introduce IntentVLA, a history-conditioned VLA framework that encodes recent visual observations into a compact short-horizon intent representation and uses it to condition chunk generation. We further introduce AliasBench, a 12-task ambiguity-aware benchmark on RoboTwin2 with matched training data and evaluation environments that isolate short-horizon observation aliasing. Across AliasBench, SimplerEnv, LIBERO, and RoboCasa, IntentVLA improves rollout stability and outperforms strong VLA baselines
papers.comment: Code can be found in https://github.com/ZGC-EmbodyAI/IntentVLA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IntentVLA，一种历史条件化的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，通过将最近的视觉观察编码为紧凑的短时意图表示来调节动作块生成，以解决机器人模仿数据中由于部分可观测性导致的意图漂移和块间冲突问题。同时引入包含12个任务的歧义感知基准 AliasBench。在多个基准上，IntentVLA 提升了 rollout 稳定性并优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有帧条件化的 VLA 策略仅从当前观测和指令推断动作块，在部分可观测性下可能在不同重新规划步骤中重新采样不同意图，导致块间冲突和执行不稳定。
Method: 提出历史条件化的 VLA 框架，将近期视觉观测序列编码为紧凑的短时意图表示，并以此条件生成动作块；同时构建 AliasBench 基准来隔离短时观测歧义。
Result: 在 AliasBench、SimplerEnv、LIBERO 和 RoboCasa 上，IntentVLA 提升了 rollout 稳定性，并优于强 VLA 基线。
Conclusion: 短时意图建模可以有效缓解机器人操作中因观测歧义导致的执行不稳定问题，但方法局限于短时域意图表示。

papers.title: CTFusion: A CTF-based Benchmark for LLM Agent Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled agentic systems for complex, multi-step tasks; cybersecurity is emerging as a prominent application. To evaluate such agents, researchers widely adopt Capture The Flag (CTF) benchmarks. However, current CTF benchmarks reuse existing challenges, which exposes them to data contamination and potential cheating. Notably, we confirmed these issues in practice by integrating web search tools into an existing agent. To address these limitations, we present CTFusion, a streaming evaluation framework built on Live CTFs. To achieve this, CTFusion preserves per-agent independence under a single team account and reduces competition impact by forwarding only the first correct flag per challenge. Moreover, we implement CTFusion as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server on the widely used CTFd platform, which offers broad applicability to diverse CTF events and agent types. Through experiments with three LLMs, two agents, and five Live CTFs, we demonstrate that existing CTF benchmarks can be unreliable in assessing LLM-based agents, while CTFusion can serve as a robust solution for evaluating cybersecurity agents. We release CTFusion as open source to foster future research in this area.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Second Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond (AIWILD), ICML 2026. Revised to match the camera-ready version. OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=aUSUvS4dPL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有CTF基准测试中数据污染和作弊问题，提出CTFusion，一个基于直播CTF（Live CTFs）的流式评估框架。CTFusion通过Model Context Protocol实现在CTFd平台上的部署，支持多智能体独立评估，并仅转发每个挑战的第一个正确答案以减少竞争影响。实验使用三个LLM、两个智能体和五个直播CTF，证明现有基准不可靠而CTFusion是稳健的解决方案。
Motivation: 现有CTF基准测试复用已有挑战，导致数据污染和潜在作弊，作者通过给现有智能体集成网页搜索工具实际验证了这些问题。
Method: 提出CTFusion流式评估框架，基于Live CTFs构建；通过单团队账户下保持每个智能体独立性，仅转发每个挑战的第一个正确flag来减少竞争影响；实现为Model Context Protocol (MCP)服务器，部署在CTFd平台上。
Result: 使用三个LLM、两个智能体和五个直播CTF的实验表明，现有CTF基准在评估LLM智能体时不可靠，而CTFusion能够提供稳健的评估。
Conclusion: CTFusion作为开源框架发布，为未来网络安全智能体评估研究提供基础。

papers.title: COSMOS: Model-Agnostic Personalized Federated Learning with Clustered Server Models and Pseudo-Label-Only Communication
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) in heterogeneous environments remains challenging because client models often differ in both architecture and data distribution. While recent approaches attempt to address this challenge through client clustering and knowledge distillation, simultaneously handling architectural and statistical heterogeneity remains difficult. We introduce COSMOS, a model-agnostic framework that enables server-side personalization using only pseudo-label communication. Clients train local models and predict on the public data; the server clusters clients by prediction similarity, trains a cluster-specific model for each group using its own compute, and distills the resulting models back to clients. We provide the first theoretical analysis showing that distillation from the learned cluster models can yield exponential personalization risk contraction, going beyond the convergence-to-stationarity guarantees typically provided in model-agnostic FL. Experiments across benchmarks demonstrate that COSMOS consistently outperforms all model-agnostic FL baselines while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art personalized FL methods. More broadly, our results highlight personalized server-side learning with pseudo-labels as a promising paradigm for scalable and model-agnostic federated learning in highly heterogeneous environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 COSMOS，一个模型无关的个性化联邦学习框架，通过仅使用伪标签通信实现服务器端个性化。客户端在公共数据上训练和预测，服务器根据预测相似性对客户端聚类，为每组训练聚类特定模型，并将蒸馏结果传回客户端。理论上证明蒸馏可实现指数级个性化风险收缩，实验表明 COSMOS 超越所有模型无关联邦学习基线，与最先进的个性化方法竞争。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习在异构环境下难以同时处理客户端架构和数据的异质性，而现有方法通过客户端聚类和知识蒸馏仍无法有效解决这一挑战。
Method: COSMOS 框架：客户端在公共数据上训练本地模型并生成伪标签；服务器根据预测相似性对客户端聚类，为每个聚类训练一个服务器模型（使用服务器自己的计算资源），然后将这些模型蒸馏回客户端。
Result: 理论分析首次证明蒸馏可带来指数级个性化风险收缩（超越传统收敛保证）；实验表明 COSMOS 在所有模型无关联邦学习基线中表现最佳，并与最先进的个性化联邦学习方法竞争力相当。

papers.title: EmbodiSkill: Skill-Aware Reflection for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: Embodied agents can benefit from skills that guide object search, action execution, and state changes across diverse environments. Since embodied environments vary across layouts, object states, and other execution factors, these skills must self-evolve from trajectories generated during task execution. However, existing skill self-evolution methods are mainly developed in digital environments and often convert trajectories into coarse skill updates. Directly applying this paradigm to embodied settings is problematic, because a failed task execution may reflect not only incorrect skill content, but also an execution lapse in which the agent fails to follow valid guidance. We propose EmbodiSkill, a training-free framework for embodied skill self-evolution through skill-aware reflection and targeted revision. EmbodiSkill interprets each trajectory with respect to the current skill, uses skill-changing evidence to update the skill body, and uses execution-lapse evidence to preserve and emphasize valid guidance. Experiments on ALFWorld and EmbodiedBench show that EmbodiSkill consistently improves embodied task success. On ALFWorld, EmbodiSkill enables a frozen Qwen3.5-27B executor to reach 93.28% task success, outperforming GPT-5.2 used as a direct agent without skills by 31.58%. These results show that skill-aware self-evolution helps embodied agents accumulate reusable procedural knowledge from their own trajectories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EmbodiSkill，一种无需训练的技能自演化框架，通过技能感知反思和针对性修订，使具身代理在执行任务后从轨迹中自我演化技能。在ALFWorld和EmbodiedBench上，该方法提升了任务成功率，例如在ALFWorld上使用冻结的Qwen3.5-27B达到93.28%，超过直接使用GPT-5.2作为代理的31.58%。

Method: 提出EmbodiSkill，一种无训练框架，通过技能感知反思解释轨迹，使用技能变化证据更新技能主体，使用执行失误证据保留有效指导。

Conclusion: 技能感知的自演化帮助具身代理从自身轨迹中积累可重复使用的过程性知识。

papers.title: 2.5-D Decomposition for LLM-Based Spatial Construction
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous systems that build structures from natural-language instructions need reliable spatial reasoning, yet large language models (LLMs) make systematic coordinate errors when generating three-dimensional block placements. We present a neuro-symbolic pipeline based on 2.5-D decomposition: the LLM plans in the two-dimensional horizontal plane while a deterministic executor computes all vertical placements from column occupancy, eliminating an entire class of errors. On the Build What I Mean benchmark (160 rounds), GPT-4o-mini with this pipeline achieves 94.6% mean structural accuracy across 12 independent runs, within 3.0 percentage points of the 97.6% ceiling imposed by architect-agent errors that no builder-side improvement can address. This outperforms both GPT-4o at 90.3% and the best competing system at 76.3%. A controlled ablation confirms that 2.5-D decomposition is the dominant contributor, accounting for 28.7 percentage points of accuracy. The pipeline transfers directly to edge hardware: Nemotron-3 120B on an NVIDIA Jetson Thor AGX achieves 96.0% mean structural accuracy with the identical pipeline, slightly exceeding the cloud result. Expanding the system prompt by four targeted examples to exceed the model's 8,320-token prefix cache page size, combined with low-effort reasoning, reduces mean per-request latency by 3X to 19.7 seconds at 95.6% accuracy. The underlying principle, removing deterministic dimensions from the LLM's output space, applies to any autonomous construction or assembly task where gravity or other physical constraints fix one or more degrees of freedom. A transfer experiment on 500 IGLU collaborative building tasks confirms the effect generalizes beyond the primary benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于2.5维分解的神经符号流水线，用于从自然语言指令进行三维结构构建。该流水线让大语言模型在二维水平面规划，由确定性执行器根据列占用计算所有垂直放置，从而消除一类坐标错误。在Build What I Mean基准上，GPT-4o-mini结合此流水线达到94.6%的平均结构准确率，优于GPT-4o的90.3%和最佳竞争系统的76.3%。消融实验表明2.5维分解贡献了28.7个百分点的准确率提升。
Motivation: 大语言模型在生成三维块放置时存在系统性坐标错误，影响自主系统从自然语言构建结构的能力。
Method: 提出神经符号流水线：LLM在二维水平面规划，确定性执行器根据列占用自动计算垂直位置。
Result: 在Build What I Mean基准上，GPT-4o-mini达到94.6%平均结构准确率，消融显示2.5维分解贡献28.7个百分点。流水线可迁移至边缘硬件，Nemotron-3 120B在NVIDIA Jetson Thor AGX上达到96.0%准确率。通过扩展系统提示和低努力推理，延迟降低3倍至19.7秒，准确率95.6%。
Conclusion: 从LLM输出空间中移除确定性维度可提高空间构建准确性，原理适用于任何重力或物理约束固定自由度的自主构建任务。

papers.title: Selective Depthwise Separable Convolution for Lightweight Joint Source-Channel Coding in Wireless Image Transmission
papers.abstract_en: Depthwise separable convolutional (DSConv) layers have been successfully applied to deep learning (DL)-based joint source-channel coding (JSCC) schemes to reduce computational complexity. However, a systematic investigation of the layerwise and ratio-wise replacement of standard convolutional (Conv) layers with DSConv layers in JSCC systems for wireless image transmission remains largely unexplored. In this letter, we propose a configurable lightweight JSCC framework that incorporates a selective replacement strategy, enabling flexible Conv-to-DSConv replacement at different replacement ratios and positions. By varying the replacement ratio, we obtain models with different computational complexities and analyze their impact on reconstruction performance. Furthermore, we investigate how replacements at different encoder and decoder depths influence reconstruction quality under a fixed replacement ratio. Our results show that Conv-to-DSConv replacement at the intermediate layers of the encoder and decoder achieves a favorable complexity-performance trade-off, revealing layer-wise redundancy in DL-based JSCC systems. Extensive experiments further demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves substantial parameter reduction with only slight performance degradation, enabling flexible complexity-performance trade-offs for resource-constrained edge devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可配置的轻量级联合源信道编码（JSCC）框架，通过选择性替换标准卷积层为深度可分离卷积（DSConv）层，实现不同替换比例和位置下的灵活计算复杂度-重构性能权衡。实验表明，在编码器和解码器的中间层进行替换可在显著减少参数的同时保持轻微性能下降，适用于资源受限的边缘设备。
Motivation: 现有JSCC方案使用深度可分离卷积降低复杂度，但缺乏对替换的层维度和比例维度的系统研究，未能揭示哪些层存在冗余以及如何实现最优复杂度-性能权衡。
Method: 提出一种可配置的轻量级JSCC框架，包含选择性替换策略，允许以不同替换比例和位置将标准卷积层替换为深度可分离卷积层。通过调整替换比例获得不同复杂度的模型，并分析其重构性能；同时在固定替换比例下探究编码器和解码器不同深度的替换影响。
Result: 结果表明，在编码器和解码器的中间层进行替换可获得最佳的复杂度-性能权衡；该框架在参数大幅减少的同时仅造成轻微性能下降，支持灵活调整以适应资源受限设备。
Conclusion: 该方法揭示了基于深度学习的JSCC系统中存在层维度的冗余，通过选择性替换可实现高效压缩，适用于边缘设备上的无线图像传输。

papers.title: Fairness Constraints in High-Dimensional Generalized Linear Models
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models often inherit biases from historical data, raising critical concerns about fairness and accountability. Conventional fairness interventions typically require access to sensitive attributes like gender or race, but privacy and legal restrictions frequently limit their use. To address this challenge, we propose a framework that infers sensitive attributes from auxiliary features and integrates fairness constraints into model training. Our approach mitigates bias while preserving predictive accuracy, offering a practical solution for fairness-aware learning. Empirical evaluations validate its effectiveness, contributing to the advancement of more equitable algorithmic decision-making.

papers.title: IP-SAM: Rethinking Prompt-Conditioned Segmentation for Prompt-Absent Deployment
papers.abstract_en: Prompt-conditioned foundation segmenters have emerged as a dominant paradigm for image segmentation, where explicit spatial prompts(e.g., points, boxes, masks) guide mask decoding. However, many real-world deployments require fully automatic segmentation, creating a structural mismatch: the decoder expects prompts that are unavailable at inference. Existing adaptations typically modify intermediate features, inadvertently bypassing the model's native prompt interface and weakening prompt-conditioned decoding. We propose IP-SAM, which revisits adaptation from a prompt-space perspective through prompt-space conditioning. Specifically, a Self-Prompt Generator (SPG) distills image context into complementary intrinsic prompts that serve as coarse regional anchors. These cues are projected through SAM2's frozen prompt encoder, restoring prompt-guided decoding without external intervention. To suppress background-induced false positives, Prompt-Space Gating (PSG) leverages the intrinsic background prompt as an asymmetric suppressive constraint prior to decoding. Under a deterministic no-external-prompt protocol, IP-SAM achieves state-of-the-art performance across four camouflaged object detection benchmarks with only 21.26M trainable parameters. Furthermore, the proposed conditioning strategy generalizes beyond COD to medical polyp segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对需要自动分割（无外部提示）的场景，提出IP-SAM，从提示空间角度重新思考适应性。通过自提示生成器（SPG）将图像上下文蒸馏为互补的内在提示，并利用提示空间门控（PSG）抑制背景误报。在伪装目标检测基准上达到SOTA，仅21.26M可训练参数，并泛化到医学息肉分割。
Motivation: 现有提示条件分割器（如SAM）在部署时需要显式空间提示，但许多实际应用需要全自动分割，存在结构不匹配。现有适应方法修改中间特征，绕过了模型的提示接口，削弱了提示条件解码能力。
Method: 提出IP-SAM，从提示空间角度进行适应。包含自提示生成器（SPG）从图像上下文生成内在提示作为粗区域锚点，通过冻结的SAM2提示编码器投影，恢复提示引导解码；以及提示空间门控（PSG）利用内在背景提示作为非对称抑制约束。
Result: 在无外部提示的确定性协议下，IP-SAM在四个伪装目标检测基准上达到SOTA，仅21.26M可训练参数，并泛化到医学息肉分割。
Conclusion: 摘要指出IP-SAM的提示空间条件策略有效解决了无提示部署问题，并适用于其他分割任务（如医学息肉分割）。

papers.title: VGGRPO: Towards World-Consistent Video Generation with 4D Latent Reward
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale video diffusion models achieve impressive visual quality, yet often fail to preserve geometric consistency. Prior approaches improve consistency either by augmenting the generator with additional modules or applying geometry-aware alignment. However, architectural modifications can compromise the generalization of internet-scale pretrained models, while existing alignment methods are limited to static scenes and rely on RGB-space rewards that require repeated VAE decoding, incurring substantial compute overhead and failing to generalize to highly dynamic real-world scenes. To preserve the pretrained capacity while improving geometric consistency, we propose VGGRPO (Visual Geometry GRPO), a latent geometry-guided framework for geometry-aware video post-training. VGGRPO introduces a Latent Geometry Model (LGM) that stitches video diffusion latents to geometry foundation models, enabling direct decoding of scene geometry from the latent space. By constructing LGM from a geometry model with 4D reconstruction capability, VGGRPO naturally extends to dynamic scenes, overcoming the static-scene limitations of prior methods. Building on this, we perform latent-space Group Relative Policy Optimization with two complementary rewards: a camera motion smoothness reward that penalizes jittery trajectories, and a geometry reprojection consistency reward that enforces cross-view geometric coherence. Experiments on both static and dynamic benchmarks show that VGGRPO improves camera stability, geometry consistency, and overall quality while eliminating costly VAE decoding, making latent-space geometry-guided reinforcement an efficient and flexible approach to world-consistent video generation.

Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型视觉质量高但几何一致性差；先前方法要么修改模型架构损害预训练泛化，要么依赖RGB空间奖励需要重复VAE解码且仅适用于静态场景。
Method: 提出VGGRPO框架，包括：(1) 构建LGM将视频扩散潜码与几何基础模型连接，直接从潜空间解码几何；(2) 采用潜在空间GRPO，结合相机运动平滑奖励和几何重投影一致性奖励进行后训练。
Result: 在静态和动态基准上，VGGRPO提升了相机稳定性、几何一致性和整体质量，同时消除了昂贵的VAE解码。
Conclusion: 潜在空间几何引导的强化学习是实现世界一致性视频生成的有效且灵活的方法，避免了架构修改和计算开销。

papers.title: Algorithm Selection with Zero Domain Knowledge via Text Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: We propose a feature-free approach to algorithm selection: instead of hand-crafted instance features, we use pretrained text embeddings. Our method, ZeroFolio, proceeds in three steps. First, it reads the raw instance file as plain text. Second, it embeds it with a pretrained embedding model. Third, it selects an algorithm via weighted k-nearest neighbors. The key to our approach is the fact that pretrained embeddings can distinguish problem instances without any domain knowledge or task-specific training. Hence, we can apply the same three-step pipeline (serialize, embed, select) across any problem domain with text-based instance formats. We evaluate our approach on 11 ASlib scenarios spanning 7 domains (SAT, MaxSAT, QBF, ASP, CSP, MIP, and graph problems). Our experiments show that this approach outperforms a random forest trained on hand-crafted features in 9 of 11 scenarios, robustly across serialization seeds (every seed, not just a favorable one) and often by a substantial margin; it still wins 8 of 11 against a per-scenario-tuned random forest. On the three scenarios with published AutoFolio results from the 2015 ASlib competition, ZeroFolio comes within a small margin of AutoFolio without any per-scenario configuration tuning. Our ablation study shows that inverse-distance weighting, line shuffling, and Manhattan distance are the key design choices, and we analyze the sensitivity of the selector to the serialization seed. On SAT12-ALL, where both selectors are competitive, combining embeddings with hand-crafted features via soft voting yields a further improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需领域知识的算法选择方法ZeroFolio，利用预训练文本嵌入将实例文件作为纯文本处理，通过嵌入和加权k近邻选择算法。在11个ASlib场景（涵盖SAT、MaxSAT等7个领域）中，该方法在9个场景上优于基于手工特征的随机森林，且在3个有AutoFolio结果的场景上接近其性能，无需任何场景特定配置。
Motivation: 传统算法选择方法依赖手工设计的实例特征，需要领域知识和大量特征工程，限制了其跨域泛化能力。
Method: ZeroFolio三步流水线：将实例文件序列化为纯文本，用预训练文本嵌入模型生成嵌入向量，通过加权k近邻（反距离加权、曼哈顿距离）选择算法。无需领域知识或任务特定训练。
Result: 在11个ASlib场景中，ZeroFolio在9个场景上超过基于手工特征的随机森林，在8个场景上超过经过场景调优的随机森林；在3个有AutoFolio结果的场景上，未调参的ZeroFolio与AutoFolio性能接近；消融实验表明反距离加权、行打乱和曼哈顿距离是关键设计。
Conclusion: 预训练文本嵌入可有效替代手工特征进行跨域算法选择，且无需领域知识；结合手工特征与嵌入的软投票可进一步提升性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Cost of Reasoning: Chain-of-Thought Induces Overconfidence in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings where reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is as important as predictive accuracy. Extended reasoning via chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting or reasoning-trained models has become ubiquitous in modern VLM pipelines, yet its effect on UQ reliability remains poorly understood. Our results show that reasoning tends to degrade the quality of many uncertainty estimates, even when it improves task accuracy. We identify implicit answer conditioning as the primary mechanism: as reasoning traces converge on a conclusion before the final answer is generated, token probabilities increasingly reflect consistency with the model's own reasoning trace rather than uncertainty about correctness. In effect, the model becomes overconfident in its answer. In contrast, agreement-based consistency remains robust and often improves under reasoning, making it a practical choice for uncertainty estimation in reasoning-enabled VLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了链式思维（CoT）推理对视觉语言模型（VLM）不确定性量化（UQ）可靠性的影响。实验表明，CoT推理虽然能提升任务准确率，但会降低多数不确定性估计的质量，其机制是隐式答案条件化（implicit answer conditioning）：推理轨迹在最终答案前已收敛，导致模型对答案过度自信。相比之下，基于一致性的不确定性估计在推理下依然稳健。
Motivation: VLM在医疗、自动驾驶等高安全场景中对不确定性量化的可靠性要求极高，但CoT推理的广泛采用对UQ的影响尚未被充分理解。
Method: 通过在多个VLM上比较有无CoT推理时的多种不确定性估计方法（如基于概率、一致性和反应时间），识别出隐式答案条件化是导致过自信的关键机制。
Result: CoT推理使多数不确定性估计质量下降，即使任务准确率提升；隐式答案条件化导致模型过度自信；基于一致性的方法在推理下保持稳健甚至改善。
Conclusion: 作者指出，当前依赖CoT推理的VLM在实际部署中可能给出过于自信的预测，建议采用基于一致性的不确定性估计作为更可靠的替代方案。

papers.title: Tool-MCoT: Tool Augmented Multimodal Chain-of-Thought for Content Safety Moderation
papers.abstract_en: The growth of online platforms and user content requires strong content moderation systems that can handle complex inputs from various media types. While large language models (LLMs) are effective, their high computational cost and latency present significant challenges for scalable deployment. To address this, we introduce Tool-MCoT, a small language model (SLM) fine-tuned for content safety moderation leveraging external framework. By training our model on tool-augmented chain-of-thought data generated by LLM, we demonstrate that the SLM can learn to effectively utilize these tools to improve its reasoning and decision-making. Our experiments show that the fine-tuned SLM achieves significant performance gains. Furthermore, we show that the model can learn to use these tools selectively, achieving a balance between moderation accuracy and inference efficiency by calling tools only when necessary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Tool-MCoT，一种通过工具增强的思维链 (chain-of-thought) 数据微调的小语言模型 (SLM)，用于内容安全审核。实验表明，微调后的 SLM 能学习选择性调用工具，在保持审核准确率的同时提升推理效率。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型 (LLM) 用于内容审核时计算成本高、延迟大，难以大规模部署。
Method: 利用 LLM 生成工具增强的思维链数据，微调小语言模型 (SLM)，使其学会通过外部工具辅助推理与决策。
Result: 微调后的 SLM 在内容安全审核任务上取得显著性能提升，并能按需调用工具，平衡了准确率与推理效率。
Conclusion: 工具增强的思维链训练可以使小模型在内容审核任务中媲美大模型效果，同时降低计算开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Simple Recipe Works: Vision-Language-Action Models are Natural Continual Learners with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual Reinforcement Learning (CRL) for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models is a promising direction toward self-improving embodied agents that can adapt in openended, evolving environments. However, conventional wisdom from continual learning suggests that naive Sequential Fine-Tuning (Seq. FT) leads to catastrophic forgetting, necessitating complex CRL strategies. In this work, we take a step back and conduct a systematic study of CRL for large pretrained VLAs across diverse lifelong RL benchmarks. We find that, contrary to established belief, simple Seq. FT with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is remarkably strong: it achieves high plasticity, exhibits little to no forgetting, and retains strong zero-shot generalization, frequently outperforming more sophisticated CRL methods. Through detailed analysis, we show that this robustness arises from a synergy between the large pretrained model, parameter-efficient adaptation, and on-policy RL. Together, these components reshape the stability-plasticity trade-off, making continual adaptation both stable and scalable. Our results position Sequential Fine-Tuning as a powerful method for continual RL with VLAs and provide new insights into lifelong learning in the large model era. Code is available at https://github.com/UT-Austin-RobIn/continual-vla-rl
papers.comment: Accepted at RLC 2026; Best paper award at ICRA26 RL4IL Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究大规模预训练视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在持续强化学习（CRL）中的表现，发现简单的顺序微调（Seq. FT）结合低秩适配（LoRA）在多个终身RL基准上性能优异，具有高可塑性和低遗忘，甚至优于复杂CRL方法，挑战了传统认知。
Motivation: 持续强化学习常认为顺序微调会导致灾难性遗忘，需要复杂策略，本文旨在重新审视大规模预训练VLA在此场景下的实际表现。
Method: 系统比较顺序微调（Seq. FT）与多种持续强化学习方法，采用参数高效微调（LoRA）和在线策略强化学习。
Result: 简单Seq. FT + LoRA在持续RL基准上表现出高可塑性、几乎无遗忘、强零样本泛化，且经常超越更复杂的CRL方法。
Conclusion: 大规模预训练模型、参数高效微调与在线策略RL协同作用，重塑了稳定-可塑性权衡，使顺序微调成为VLA持续RL的有效基线。

papers.title: RVN-Bench: A Benchmark for Reactive Visual Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Safe visual navigation is critical for indoor mobile robots operating in cluttered environments. Existing benchmarks, however, often neglect collisions or are designed for outdoor scenarios, making them unsuitable for indoor visual navigation. To address this limitation, we introduce the reactive visual navigation benchmark (RVN-Bench), a collision-aware benchmark for indoor mobile robots. In RVN-Bench, an agent must reach sequential goal positions in previously unseen environments using only visual observations and no prior map, while avoiding collisions. Built on the Habitat 2.0 simulator and leveraging high-fidelity HM3D scenes, RVN-Bench provides large-scale, diverse indoor environments, defines a collision-aware navigation task and evaluation metrics, and offers tools for standardized training and benchmarking. RVN-Bench supports both online and offline learning by offering an environment for online reinforcement learning, a trajectory image dataset generator, and tools for producing negative trajectory image datasets that capture collision events. Evaluations demonstrate that policies trained on RVN-Bench generalize effectively across unseen simulated environments. Furthermore, initial physical experiments using a Jackal UGV indicate promising sim-to-real transfer. Code and additional materials are available at: https://sequor-robotics-research.github.io/projects/RVN-Bench/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RVN-Bench 是一个面向室内移动机器人的碰撞感知基准，基于 Habitat 2.0 模拟器和 HM3D 场景，要求智能体仅依靠视觉观测、无先验地图，在未知环境中顺序到达目标点并避免碰撞。该基准支持在线和离线学习，提供强化学习环境、轨迹图像数据集生成器及碰撞事件负样本工具，评估表明训练策略可泛化至未见模拟环境，初步实物实验验证了仿真到现实的迁移。
Motivation: 现有视觉导航基准常忽视碰撞或仅针对室外场景，不适合室内移动机器人的安全导航评估。
Method: 构建基于 Habitat 2.0 和 HM3D 场景的碰撞感知基准，定义顺序到达目标点的任务、碰撞感知指标，并提供标准化训练/基准测试工具，包括在线 RL 环境、轨迹图像数据集生成器和负样本（碰撞事件）数据集工具。
Result: 训练策略在未见模拟环境中有效泛化，且基于 Jackal UGV 的初步实物实验显示出有潜力的仿真到现实迁移。
Conclusion: RVN-Bench 为室内反应式视觉导航提供了标准化碰撞感知评测平台，支持泛化性和 sim-to-real 迁移研究。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Dynamics of Learning under User Choice: Overspecialization and Peer-Model Probing
papers.abstract_en: In many economically relevant contexts where machine learning is deployed, multiple platforms obtain data from the same pool of users, each of whom selects the platform that best serves them. Prior work in this setting focuses exclusively on the "local" losses of learners on the distribution of data that they observe. We find that there exist instances where learners who use existing algorithms almost surely converge to models with arbitrarily poor global performance, even when models with low full-population loss exist. This happens through a feedback-induced mechanism, which we call the overspecialization trap: as learners optimize for users who already prefer them, they become less attractive to users outside this base, which further restricts the data they observe. Inspired by the recent use of knowledge distillation in modern ML, we propose an algorithm that allows learners to "probe" the predictions of peer models, enabling them to learn about users who do not select them. Our analysis characterizes when probing succeeds: this procedure converges almost surely to a stationary point with bounded full-population risk when probing sources are sufficiently informative, e.g., a known market leader or a majority of peers with good global performance. We verify our findings with semi-synthetic experiments on the MovieLens, Census, and Amazon Sentiment datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多平台从同一用户池获取数据时，用户选择导致的反馈机制——过专业化陷阱（overspecialization trap），即学习者优化已选择自己的用户，反而疏远其他用户，限制数据观测。提出通过知识蒸馏让学习者探测同伴模型预测，分析其收敛性：当探测源信息充分（如市场领导者或多数好模型）时，几乎必然收敛到总体风险有界的稳定点。在MovieLens、Census和Amazon Sentiment数据集上验证。
Motivation: 现有工作仅关注学习者在其观测数据分布上的局部损失，忽略了用户选择导致的全局性能下降问题。存在学习者几乎必然收敛到全局性能极差模型的情况，即使存在低总体损失模型。
Method: 提出一种基于知识蒸馏的算法，允许学习者通过探测同伴模型的预测来获取未选择自己的用户的信息。分析探测成功的条件：当探测源足够信息丰富时，算法几乎必然收敛到总体风险有界的稳定点。
Result: 半合成实验（MovieLens、Census、Amazon Sentiment）验证了理论发现。
Conclusion: 论文强调用户选择驱动的反馈机制会导致过专业化陷阱，而通过探测同伴模型可以缓解，但需依赖信息充分的探测源（如市场领导者或多数好模型）。

papers.title: Context-Dependent Affordance Computation in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We characterize the phenomenon of context-dependent affordance computation in vision-language models (VLMs). Our primary study uses Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B ($n = 3{,}213$ scene-context pairs from COCO-2017: 479 images under 7 agentic personas), with a cross-model replication on LLaVA-1.5-13B. We demonstrate substantial affordance drift: mean Jaccard similarity between context conditions is $0.095$ (95% CI $[0.092, 0.097]$ across $N = 479$ images; $9{,}244$ prime pairs; $p < 0.0001$), indicating that more than 90% of lexical scene description is context-dependent; the LLaVA replication reproduces the effect (mean $J = 0.160$, 84% context-dependent). Sentence-level cosine similarity confirms drift at the semantic level (mean $= 0.415$, 58.5% context-dependent). Stochastic baseline experiments ($2{,}384$ inference runs across 4 temperatures and 5 seeds) confirm this reflects genuine context effects rather than generation noise: within-prime variance is substantially lower than cross-prime variance across all conditions. Tucker decomposition with bootstrap stability analysis ($n = 1{,}000$ resamples) reveals stable orthogonal latent factors: a "Culinary Manifold" isolated to chef contexts and an "Access Axis" spanning child-mobility contrasts. The gap between lexical (90%) and semantic (58.5%) measures indicates that surface vocabulary changes more than underlying meaning under context shifts. These findings suggest a direction for robotics: dynamic, query-dependent ontological projection (JIT Ontology) rather than static world modeling. We do not claim to establish processing order or architectural primacy; such claims require internal representational analysis beyond output behavior.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 13 tables, 3 figures. Code available at: https://github.com/studiofarzulla/semantic-vision
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了视觉语言模型（VLM）中上下文相关的可供性计算现象。基于Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B模型（使用COCO-2017中的3213个场景-上下文对，7种智能体角色），发现超过90%的词汇场景描述是上下文相关的，并通过LLaVA-1.5-13B复制了该效应。词汇层面的平均Jaccard相似度为0.095，句子级余弦相似度均值为0.415。Tucker分解揭示了稳定的正交潜在因子，如“烹饪流形”和“访问轴”。结果表明表面词汇变化大于语义变化，并建议机器人领域采用动态查询依赖的本体论投影（JIT Ontology），而非静态世界建模。论文不声称建立处理顺序或架构优先性。
Motivation: 现有VLM在变化上下文条件下可供性计算的稳定性尚不明确，特别是上下文依赖的程度和结构未被量化。
Method: 使用Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B和LLaVA-1.5-13B模型，在COCO-2017上构建场景-上下文对，计算Jaccard相似度和余弦相似度，并通过随机基线实验（2384次推理，4种温度和5种种子）确认上下文效应而非生成噪声。采用Tucker分解和bootstrap稳定性分析（1000次重采样）提取潜在因子。
Result: 平均Jaccard相似度为0.095（95% CI [0.092, 0.097]），超过90%的词汇描述是上下文依赖的；句子级余弦相似度均值为0.415，58.5%语义依赖。LLaVA复制得到平均J=0.160（84%上下文依赖）。Tucker分解发现稳定的正交因子：烹饪流形和访问轴。
Conclusion: 词汇变化比语义变化更大，建议在机器人领域采用动态查询依赖的本体论投影（JIT Ontology），但未建立处理顺序或架构优先性。

papers.title: Bures-Wasserstein Importance-Weighted Evidence Lower Bound: Exposition and Applications
papers.abstract_en: The Importance-Weighted Evidence Lower Bound (IW-ELBO) has emerged as an effective objective for variational inference (VI), tightening the standard ELBO and mitigating the mode-seeking behaviour. However, optimizing the IW-ELBO in Euclidean space is often inefficient, as its gradient estimators suffer from a vanishing signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). This paper formulates the optimisation of the IW-ELBO in Bures-Wasserstein space, a manifold of Gaussian distributions equipped with the 2-Wasserstein metric. We derive the Wasserstein gradient of the IW-ELBO and project it onto the Bures-Wasserstein space to yield a tractable algorithm for Gaussian VI. A pivotal contribution of our analysis concerns the stability of the gradient estimator. While the SNR of the standard Euclidean gradient estimator is known to vanish as the number of importance samples $K$ increases, we prove that the SNR of the Wasserstein gradient scales favourably as $Ω(\sqrt{K})$, ensuring optimisation efficiency even for large $K$. We further extend this geometric analysis to the Variational Rényi Importance-Weighted Autoencoder bound, establishing analogous stability guarantees. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves superior approximation performance compared to other baselines.
papers.comment: 43 pages, 13 figures. Submitted to Bayesian Analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在Bures-Wasserstein空间中优化重要性加权证据下界（IW-ELBO），以解决欧几里得空间中梯度信噪比随重要性样本数K增加而消失的问题。作者推导了Wasserstein梯度并投影到该流形上，证明其信噪比缩放为Ω(√K)，从而保证大K下的优化效率。实验表明该方法在变分推断中优于基线。
Motivation: 标准欧几里得空间中IW-ELBO的梯度估计器信噪比随重要性样本数K增加而消失，导致优化效率低下。
Method: 将IW-ELBO的优化置于Bures-Wasserstein空间（带2-Wasserstein度量的高斯分布流形），推导Wasserstein梯度并投影到该空间，得到可计算的变分推断算法。
Result: 理论证明Wasserstein梯度估计器的信噪比缩放为Ω(√K)，优于欧几里得梯度的衰减行为；实验显示该方法在近似性能上优于其他基线。
Conclusion: Bures-Wasserstein空间中的IW-ELBO优化提供了稳定高效的梯度估计，并可将此几何分析扩展到变分Rényi重要性加权自编码器边界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CoGenCast: A Coupled Autoregressive-Flow Generative Framework for Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting can be viewed as a generative problem that requires both semantic understanding over contextual conditions and stochastic modeling of continuous temporal dynamics. Existing approaches typically rely on either autoregressive large language models (LLMs) for semantic context modeling or diffusion-like models for continuous probabilistic generation. However, neither method alone can adequately model both aspects simultaneously. In this work, we propose CoGenCast, a hybrid generative framework that couples pre-trained LLMs with flow-matching mechanism for effective time series forecasting. Specifically, we reconfigure pre-trained decoder-only LLMs into a native forecasting encoder-decoder backbone by modifying only the attention topology, enabling bidirectional context encoding and causal representation generation. Building on this, a flow-matching mechanism is further integrated to model temporal evolution, capturing continuous stochastic dynamics conditioned on the autoregressively generated representation. Notably, CoGenCast naturally supports multimodal forecasting and cross-domain unified training. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that CoGenCast achieves competitive performance compared to previous baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/liuyaguo/_CoGenCast.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出CoGenCast混合生成框架，结合预训练大语言模型（LLM）与流匹配机制（flow matching）进行时间序列预测。通过修改注意力拓扑将仅解码器的LLM重构为原生预测编码器-解码器，实现双向上下文编码和因果表示生成，并集成流匹配以建模连续随机时序动态。该方法支持多模态预测和跨域统一训练，在多个基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测方法中，自回归大语言模型擅长语义建模但难以处理连续随机动态，而扩散模型擅长概率生成但缺乏语义理解，两者无法同时兼顾。
Method: 将预训练仅解码器LLM通过修改注意力拓扑重构为编码器-解码器结构，支持双向上下文编码和因果表示生成；在此基础上集成流匹配机制，以自回归生成的表示为条件，建模连续随机时序动态。
Result: 在多个时间序列预测基准上取得有竞争力的性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: CoGenCast通过耦合自回归与流匹配，有效统一了语义建模和连续随机动态生成，并具备多模态和跨域扩展潜力。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Explainability Methods for Hardware Trojan Detection: A Systematic Comparison
papers.abstract_en: Hardware trojans are malicious circuits which compromise the functionality and security of an integrated circuit (IC). These circuits are manufactured directly into the silicon and cannot be fixed by security patches like software. The solution would require a costly product recall by replacing the IC and hence, early detection in the design process is essential. Hardware detection at best provides statistically based solutions with many false positives and false negatives. These detection methods require more thorough explainable analysis to filter out false indicators. Existing explainability methods developed for general domains like image classification do not always provide the actionable insights hardware engineers need. A question remains: how do domain-aware property analysis, model-agnostic case-based reasoning, and model-agnostic feature attribution techniques compare for hardware security applications? This work compares three categories of explainability for gate-level hardware trojan detection on the Trust-Hub benchmark dataset: (1) domain-aware property-based analysis of 31 circuit-specific features derived from gate fanin patterns, flip-flop distances, and primary Input/Output (I/O) connectivity; (2) model-agnostic case-based reasoning using k-nearest neighbors for precedent-based explanations; and (3) model-agnostic feature attribution methods (Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME), SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP), gradient) that provide generic importance scores without circuit-level context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了三类可解释性方法用于门级硬件木马检测：基于领域感知的电路特征分析（31种门扇入模式、触发器距离、I/O连接性）、基于模型无关的案例推理（k近邻）以及模型无关的特征归因（LIME、SHAP、梯度）。在Trust-Hub基准数据集上评估，旨在解决现有通用可解释性方法在硬件安全领域缺乏领域特定洞察的问题。
Motivation: 硬件木马难以被软件补丁修复，早期检测至关重要但现有统计方法误报率高。通用可解释性方法无法提供硬件工程师所需的领域感知分析，需要系统比较不同类别可解释性方法在硬件安全中的适用性。
Method: 在Trust-Hub基准数据集上，对门级网表实施三种可解释性方法：(1) 基于31个领域特定电路特征（扇入模式、触发器距离、I/O连通性）的属性分析；(2) 基于k近邻的案例推理（提供先例解释）；(3) LIME、SHAP和梯度等特征归因方法（通用重要性分数）。
Result: 摘要未报告具体量化结果，仅说明在Trust-Hub基准上比较了三种方法。预期领域感知方法可能更适用于硬件木马检测的可解释性需求。
Conclusion: 需要结合硬件领域知识设计可解释性方法，通用方法可能不直接适用。未来工作需更深入地评估可解释性指标与木马检测性能的关联。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TimeSAE: Causal Sparse Decoding for Faithful Explanations of Black-Box Time Series Models
papers.abstract_en: As black box models and pretrained models gain traction in time series applications, understanding and explaining their predictions becomes increasingly vital, especially in high-stakes domains where interpretability and trust are essential. However, most of the existing methods involve only in-distribution explanation, and do not generalize outside the training support, which requires the learning capability of generalization. In this work, we aim to provide a framework to explain black-box models for time series data through the dual lenses of Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) and causality. We show that many current explanation methods are sensitive to distributional shifts, limiting their effectiveness in real-world scenarios. Building on the concept of Sparse Autoencoder, we introduce TimeSAE, a framework for black-box model explanation. We conduct extensive evaluations of TimeSAE on both synthetic and real-world time series datasets, comparing it to leading baselines. The results, supported by both quantitative metrics and qualitative insights, show that TimeSAE provides more faithful and robust explanations. Our code is available in an easy-to-use library TimeSAE-Lib: https://oublalkhalid.github.io/TimeSAE/

papers.title: Stable On-Policy Distillation through Adaptive Target Reformulation
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a widely adopted technique for transferring knowledge from large language models to smaller student models; however, conventional supervised KD often suffers from a distribution mismatch between training and inference. While on-policy KD approaches attempt to mitigate this issue by learning directly from student-generated outputs, they frequently encounter training instabilities because the distributional gap between the novice student and the expert teacher is often too wide to bridge directly. These challenges manifest as pathological gradients in forward KL objectives or diversity collapse in reverse KL regimes. To address these limitations, we propose Veto, an objective-level reformulation that constructs a geometric bridge in the logit space. Unlike prior methods that mix data samples, Veto creates an intermediate target distribution that promotes alignment between the teacher and the student. By introducing a tunable parameter beta, Veto serves as an Adaptive Gradient Veto that stabilizes optimization by suppressing harmful gradients on low-confidence tokens, while simultaneously acting as a Decisiveness Knob to balance reward-driven performance with output diversity. Extensive experiments across various reasoning and generation tasks demonstrate that Veto consistently outperforms supervised fine-tuning and existing on-policy baselines.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, Accepted to Findings of ACL 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Veto，一种在logit空间中构造几何桥梁的目标级重公式，用于稳定大语言模型的在线策略知识蒸馏。Veto通过可调参数beta作为自适应梯度否决和决策旋钮，抑制低置信度token的有害梯度并平衡性能与多样性。实验表明Veto在推理和生成任务上持续优于监督微调和现有在线策略基线。

papers.title: BiasLab: A Multilingual Dual-Framing Framework for LLM Bias Measurement, Applied to Workplace and HR Contexts
papers.abstract_en: Background: Large language models (LLMs) harbor systematic biases that are particularly consequential in workplace and HR contexts, where their outputs increasingly influence hiring, job design, and organizational decisions. Existing bias-evaluation approaches remain methodologically fragmented, limiting practitioners' ability to assess deployment risks. Objective: This study introduces BiasLab, a multilingual dual-framing framework to quantify and compare directional output-level bias in LLMs, demonstrated across six workplace and HR-relevant topics. Methods: BiasLab combines mirrored affirmative and reverse prompt pairs, randomized wrapper perturbations, fixed-choice response constraints, and polarity-aligned scoring. Ten LLMs were evaluated across six topics (gender in leadership, employment gap candidates, age in hiring, remote versus office work, four-day versus five-day work weeks, and AI-assisted versus human-only hiring), spanning 12 languages and 30 iterations per framing direction, yielding 43,200 responses. Results: All ten models showed consistent directional preferences across every topic. A recurring asymmetric pattern emerged in which models rejected disfavored claims more strongly than they endorsed their opposites, a distinction invisible to single-frame designs. Conclusions: BiasLab provides a standardized, reproducible instrument for measuring directional preferences across models. Whether a preference constitutes bias in a fairness sense is topic-dependent: for protected attributes such as gender and age it maps onto equal-employment standards, whereas elsewhere it is better described as systematic preference. The framework lets organizations compare and vet models before adopting them for hiring.
papers.journal_ref: Work: A Journal of Prevention, Assessment and Rehabilitation, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BiasLab是一个多语言双框架系统，用于量化LLM在工作和HR场景中的方向性偏差。方法包括镜像肯定/否定提示对、随机包装扰动、固定选择响应约束。评估10个模型、6个主题、12种语言，共43200个响应。发现所有模型表现出一致的方向性偏好，且存在不对称模式：模型拒绝不利主张比赞同对立面更强烈。结论提供标准化可复现的测量工具。
Motivation: 现有偏差评估方法碎片化，限制了实践者评估部署风险的能力，尤其在HR领域。
Method: BiasLab框架，结合镜像肯定和反向提示对、随机包装扰动、固定选择响应约束、极性对齐评分。
Result: 所有10个模型在6个主题上表现出一致的方向性偏好；模型拒绝不利主张比赞同对立面更强烈（不对称模式），这是单框架设计无法发现的。
Conclusion: 提供标准化可复现的测量工具；偏好是否构成偏差取决于主题（受保护属性如性别年龄映射到公平就业标准，其他则为系统偏好）；组织可在采用模型前进行比较和审查。

papers.title: Distributionally Robust Recovery of Omitted Factors from Forecast Residuals with Application to Interest Rate Risk Management
papers.abstract_en: A forecasting model compresses its predictors into an estimate of a conditional mean, and the systematic structure that estimate omits survives in the second moment of its forecast errors. Accuracy comparisons do not measure this structure, and variance-based extraction does not recover the part of it that a given decision bears. In this paper, we propose a distributionally robust framework that recovers the omitted structure from the residuals of a fixed forecaster: a decision is made robust over a two-layer moment ambiguity set on the standardized residual cross-section, and the discovery statistic is the covariance forcing, the component of the decision's residual risk transverse to its exposure. We demonstrate that the forcing is invariant to shrinkage and to isotropic inflation of the covariance, so the recovered direction is a property of the residuals rather than of the regularization, the sense in which the recovery is ground truth. This is confirmed on monthly U.S. Treasury zero-coupon yields from 2006 to 2025, where the recovered factor is named by factor-adjusted robust selection against a panel of 111 macroeconomic, Treasury supply-and-demand, and financial indicators. From the residuals of the linear factor-augmented dynamic Nelson-Siegel benchmark the factor names as a leading business-cycle factor, anchored on the Conference Board leading index and certified by a block-permutation test; from those of the more accurate nonlinear random forest benchmark the same procedure selects the same real-activity family without certification. A neutralization test completes the evidence: removing the recovered factor from the deployed duration position leaves volatility essentially unchanged and worsens the tail, so the factor is a material systematic risk the position bears.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个分布鲁棒框架，从固定预测器的残差中恢复遗漏的系统性结构，通过两层矩模糊集上的鲁棒决策和协方差强迫统计量发现恢复方向。在2006-2025年美国国债收益率数据上，从线性因子增强动态Nelson-Siegel模型残差中恢复出一个领先经济周期因子，并从随机森林残差中选出相同的实际活动因子。
Motivation: 预测模型仅估计条件均值，遗漏的系统结构残存于预测误差的二阶矩中，传统精度比较和方差提取无法有效恢复对特定决策重要的部分。
Method: 提出分布鲁棒框架：在标准化残差截面的两层矩模糊集上做鲁棒决策，利用协方差强迫（决策残差风险中横向于暴露的分量）作为发现统计量，该统计量对协方差收缩和各向同性膨胀具有不变性。
Result: 在美国国债收益率数据上，从线性因子增强动态Nelson-Siegel基准残差中恢复的因子被命名为领先经济周期因子，基于会议委员会领先指数并通过块置换检验验证；从更精确的随机森林基准残差中选出同一实际活动族因子。
Conclusion: 通过中性化测试表明，移除该因子后久期头寸的波动率基本不变但尾部恶化，说明该因子是头寸承担的重要系统性风险。
