papers.title: SwinIFS: Landmark Guided Swin Transformer For Identity Preserving Face Super Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Face super-resolution aims to recover high-quality facial images from severely degraded low-resolution inputs, but remains challenging due to the loss of fine structural details and identity-specific features. This work introduces SwinIFS, a landmark-guided super-resolution framework that integrates structural priors with hierarchical attention mechanisms to achieve identity-preserving reconstruction at both moderate and extreme upscaling factors. The method incorporates dense Gaussian heatmaps of key facial landmarks into the input representation, enabling the network to focus on semantically important facial regions from the earliest stages of processing. A compact Swin Transformer backbone is employed to capture long-range contextual information while preserving local geometry, allowing the model to restore subtle facial textures and maintain global structural consistency. Extensive experiments on the CelebA benchmark demonstrate that SwinIFS achieves superior perceptual quality, sharper reconstructions, and improved identity retention; it consistently produces more photorealistic results and exhibits strong performance even under $8\times$ magnification, where most methods fail to recover meaningful structure. SwinIFS also provides an advantageous balance between reconstruction accuracy and computational efficiency, making it suitable for real-world applications in facial enhancement, surveillance, and digital restoration. Our code, model weights, and results are available at https://github.com/Habiba123-stack/SwinIFS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SwinIFS，一种基于地标引导的 Swin Transformer 人脸超分辨率框架，通过密集高斯热图嵌入关键面部地标，结合层次注意力机制，在中等和极端放大因子下实现身份保持重建。实验表明，该方法在 CelebA 基准上优于现有方法，尤其在 8 倍放大下仍能恢复有意义的结构，并在重建精度与计算效率之间取得良好平衡。
Motivation: 现有方法在严重低分辨率输入下丢失精细结构细节和身份特征，难以实现身份保持的人脸超分辨率。
Method: 将密集高斯热图表示的 facial landmarks 与输入图像结合，使用紧凑 Swin Transformer 骨干网络捕获长程上下文并保持局部几何，实现身份保持的超分辨率重建。
Result: 在 CelebA 基准上达到更优的感知质量、更清晰的重建和更好的身份保持；即使在 8 倍放大下仍能恢复有意义结构，性能优于多数方法。
Conclusion: SwinIFS 在重建精度与计算效率间取得良好平衡，适用于人脸增强、监控和数字修复等实际应用。

papers.title: UniRec-0.1B: Unified Text and Formula Recognition with 0.1B Parameters
papers.abstract_en: Text and formulas constitute the core informational components of many documents. Accurately and efficiently recognizing both is crucial for developing robust and generalizable document parsing systems. Recently, vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved impressive unified recognition of text and formulas. However, they are large-sized and computationally demanding, restricting their usage in many applications. In this paper, we propose UniRec-0.1B, a unified recognition model with only 0.1B parameters. It is capable of performing text and formula recognition at multiple levels, including characters, words, lines, paragraphs, and documents. To implement this task, we first establish UniRec40M, a large-scale dataset comprises 40 million text, formula and mixed samples, enabling the training of a powerful yet lightweight model. Secondly, we identify two challenges when building such a lightweight but unified expert model. They are: structural variability across levels and semantic entanglement between textual and formulaic content. To tackle these, we introduce a hierarchical supervision training that explicitly guides structural comprehension, and a semantic-decoupled tokenizer that separates text and formula representations. Finally, we develop a comprehensive evaluation benchmark covering Chinese and English documents from multiple domains and with multiple levels. Experimental results on this and public benchmarks demonstrate that UniRec-0.1B outperforms both general-purpose VLMs and leading document parsing expert models, while achieving 2-9x speedup, validating its effectiveness and efficiency. Codebase and Dataset: https://github.com/Topdu/OpenOCR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniRec-0.1B是一个仅0.1B参数量的统一文本与公式识别模型，支持字符、词、行、段落和文档多层级识别。通过构建包含4000万样本的UniRec40M数据集，以及提出分层监督训练和语义解耦分词器，解决了轻量级模型中的结构变异和语义纠缠问题。在多个基准上，该模型性能优于通用视觉语言模型和文档解析专家模型，并实现2-9倍推理加速。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在文本和公式统一识别上表现优异，但模型规模大、计算成本高，限制了实际应用。亟需一个轻量级且高效的统一识别模型。
Method: 提出UniRec-0.1B，仅0.1B参数。采用分层监督训练（hierarchical supervision training）以显式指导结构理解，并设计语义解耦分词器（semantic-decoupled tokenizer）分离文本与公式表示。同时构建大规模数据集UniRec40M（4000万样本）。
Result: 在涵盖中英文多领域多层级文档的评估基准及公开基准上，UniRec-0.1B优于通用VLM和领先的文档解析专家模型，并实现2-9倍的速度提升。
Conclusion: 验证了轻量级模型在统一文本与公式识别任务上的可行性和高效性，表明分层监督与语义解耦设计对轻量模型有效。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在文本和公式统一识别上表现优异，但模型规模大、计算成本高，限制了实际应用。亟需一个轻量级且高效的统一识别模型。
summary_sections.method: 提出UniRec-0.1B，仅0.1B参数。采用分层监督训练（hierarchical supervision training）以显式指导结构理解，并设计语义解耦分词器（semantic-decoupled tokenizer）分离文本与公式表示。同时构建大规模数据集UniRec40M（4000万样本）。
summary_sections.result: 在涵盖中英文多领域多层级文档的评估基准及公开基准上，UniRec-0.1B优于通用VLM和领先的文档解析专家模型，并实现2-9倍的速度提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 验证了轻量级模型在统一文本与公式识别任务上的可行性和高效性，表明分层监督与语义解耦设计对轻量模型有效。

papers.title: The Theory of Strategic Evolution: Games with Endogenous Players and Strategic Replicators
papers.abstract_en: Von Neumann founded both game theory and the theory of self-reproducing automata, but the two programs never merged. This paper provides the synthesis. The Theory of Strategic Evolution analyzes strategic replicators: entities that optimize under resource constraints and spawn copies of themselves. We introduce Games with Endogenous Players (GEPs), where lineages (not instances) are the fundamental strategic units, and define Evolutionarily Stable Distributions of Intelligence (ESDIs) as the resulting equilibrium concept. The central mathematical object is a hierarchy of strategic layers linked by cross-level gain matrices. Under a small-gain condition (spectral radius less than one), the system admits a global Lyapunov function at every finite depth. We prove closure under meta-selection: adding governance levels, innovation, or constitutional evolution preserves the dynamical structure. The Alignment Impossibility Theorem shows that unrestricted self-modification destroys this structure; stable alignment requires bounded modification classes. Applications include AI deployment dynamics, market concentration, and institutional design. The framework shows why personality engineering fails under selection pressure and identifies constitutional constraints necessary for stable multi-agent systems.

TL;DR: 本文将冯·诺依曼的博弈论与自复制自动机理论结合，提出战略演化理论。核心是内生参与者博弈（GEPs）和演化稳定智能分布（ESDIs），通过跨层级增益矩阵构成战略层级。在小子增益条件下系统存在全局李雅普诺夫函数，并证明了元选择封闭性。对齐不可能定理表明无限制自我修改破坏结构，需有界修改类。应用包括AI部署、市场集中和制度设计。
Motivation: 冯·诺依曼创立的博弈论与自复制自动机理论从未融合，本文旨在提供两者的综合框架，以分析战略复制器（在资源约束下优化并产生副本的实体）的演化动力学。
Method: 提出内生参与者博弈（GEPs），将谱系（而非实例）作为基本战略单元，定义演化稳定智能分布（ESDIs）作为均衡概念。核心数学对象是由跨层级增益矩阵连接的多个战略层级，并在谱半径小于1的条件下证明系统在任意有限深度均存在全局李雅普诺夫函数。

Conclusion: 框架解释了为何在选择压力下人格工程失败，并识别出稳定多智能体系统所需的宪政约束。应用涵盖AI部署动力学、市场集中和制度设计。

papers.title: Unlocking Multilingual Reasoning Capability of LLMs and LVLMs through Representation Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate strong reasoning capabilities, yet their performance in English significantly outperforms that in low-resource languages, raising fairness concerns in multilingual applications. Existing approaches either rely on costly multilingual training or employ prompting with external translation tools, both of which are resource-intensive and sensitive to translation quality. To address these limitations, we propose a training-free inference-time method to enhance Multilingual Reasoning capabilities via Representation Engineering (MRRE) without using any additional training data or tools. MRRE sequentially injects two precomputed vectors at specific layers during inference processing: cross-lingual reasoning enhancement vectors, which steer non-English reasoning representations toward English space to unlock multilingual reasoning, and target-language output anchoring vectors, which restore the distribution of the target language to preserve input-output language consistency. Comprehensive experiments across six advanced LLMs and LVLMs on four reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that MRRE consistently enhances non-English reasoning by an average gain of 5.48% and up to 7.54% in low-resource languages (Thai and Swahili), while improving input-output language consistency by 3.78%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出MRRE方法，一种无需训练数据和外部工具的多语言推理增强技术。通过向LLM和LVLM的特定层注入两个预计算向量（跨语言推理增强向量和目标语言输出锚定向量），在推理时提升非英语推理能力和语言一致性。实验表明，在六个先进模型和四个推理基准上，非英语推理平均提升5.48%，低资源语言（泰语、斯瓦希里语）最高提升7.54%，输入输出语言一致性提升3.78%。
Motivation: 现有LLM和LVLM在英语推理上显著优于低资源语言，引发多语言应用中的公平性问题。现有方法依赖高成本的多语言训练或受翻译质量影响的提示策略，缺乏高效、免训练的解决方案。
Method: MRRE是一种训练无关的推理时方法。它通过预计算两个向量：跨语言推理增强向量（steering non-English reasoning toward English space）和目标语言输出锚定向量（preserving target-language distribution），并在推理过程中顺序注入特定层，从而解锁多语言推理并保持语言一致性。
Result: 在六种先进LLM和LVLM的四项推理基准上，MRRE使非英语推理平均提升5.48%，低资源语言（泰语、斯瓦希里语）提升高达7.54%，同时输入输出语言一致性提升3.78%。
Conclusion: MRRE提供了一种高效、免训练的推理时方法来提升多语言推理能力，无需额外数据或翻译工具，有望缓解LLM和LVLM在多语言应用中的公平性问题。

papers.title: SPQR: A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Safety Alignment under Benign Model Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models can emit copyrighted, unsafe, or private content. Safety alignment aims to suppress specific concepts, yet evaluations seldom test whether safety persists under benign downstream fine-tuning routinely applied after deployment (e.g., LoRA personalization, style/domain adapters). We study the stability of current safety methods under benign fine-tuning and observe frequent breakdowns. As true safety alignment must withstand even benign post-deployment adaptations, we introduce the SPQR benchmark (Safety, Prompt adherence, Quality, and Robustness). SPQR is a single-scored metric that provides a unified, reproducible framework to evaluate how well safety-aligned diffusion models preserve safety, utility, and robustness under benign fine-tuning, by reporting a single leaderboard score to facilitate comparisons. We conduct multilingual, domain-specific, and out-of-distribution analyses, along with category-wise breakdowns, to identify when safety alignment fails after benign fine-tuning, ultimately showcasing SPQR as a concise yet comprehensive benchmark for T2I safety alignment techniques for T2I models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPQR 基准，用于评估文本到图像扩散模型在良性微调（如 LoRA 个性化、风格/领域适配器）后安全对齐的稳定性。研究发现现有安全方法在微调后经常失效，SPQR 通过单一分数统一衡量安全性、提示遵循度、质量和鲁棒性，并提供多语言、领域特异和分布外分析。
Motivation: 现有安全对齐评估未考虑部署后常见的良性下游微调（如 LoRA 个性化），导致安全方法在实际应用中可能失效。
Method: SPQR 是一个综合基准，包括安全性、提示遵循度、质量和鲁棒性四个维度，通过单一排行榜分数报告；支持多语言、领域特异和分布外分析。
Result: 摘要表明当前安全对齐方法在良性微调后频繁出现安全失效，SPQR 提供了一个统一的评估框架来捕捉这些失效。
Conclusion: SPQR 旨在成为文本到图像模型安全对齐技术的简洁全面基准，强调安全性必须在良性后部署适应中保持稳定。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Towards Blind Lens Aberration Correction via Large LensLib Pre-training and Discrete Degradation Priors
papers.abstract_en: Emerging deep-learning-based lens library pre-training (LensLib-PT) pipeline offers a new avenue for blind lens aberration correction by training a universal neural network, demonstrating strong capability in handling diverse unknown optical degradations. This work proposes FoundCAC, a universal foundational framework that resolves two challenges hindering the generalization of existing pipelines: the difficulty of scaling training data and the absence of prior guidance characterizing optical degradation. To improve data scalability, we expand the design specifications to increase degradation diversity and construct AODLibpro, a large-scale lens library using stratified sampling over spatial-variation patterns and degradation severity. In terms of model design, to leverage Point Spread Functions (PSFs) as guidance while maintaining the blind paradigm, we propose a multi-stage vector-quantized representation learning scheme. This paradigm is specifically designed to construct a Latent PSF Representation (LPR), explicitly encoding complex continuous PSFs into a discrete degradation prior to regularize the highly ill-posed restoration process. Through a simple yet effective codebook-freezing strategy, our framework leverages the discrete prior to elevate full-shot restoration performance and unlock highly efficient few-shot adaptation for unseen lenses. Experiments on synthetic LensLib, real-design simulations, and real-captured lenses show that our framework achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance under complementary evaluation protocols, while enabling highly efficient few-shot adaptation for specific lenses. The source code and datasets will be made publicly available at https://github.com/zju-jiangqi/FoundCAC.
papers.comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE International Conference on Computational Photography (ICCP). The source code and datasets will be made publicly available at https://github.com/zju-jiangqi/FoundCAC
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FoundCAC，一种用于盲镜头像差校正的通用基础框架。通过构建大规模镜头库AODLibpro和设计多阶段向量量化表示学习方案，将连续点扩散函数编码为离散退化先验，以正则化高度病态的恢复过程。实验表明，该方法在零样本设置下达到最先进性能，并支持高效少样本适应。
Motivation: 现有镜头库预训练流水线面临数据扩展困难和缺乏表征光学退化的先验指导，限制了其泛化能力。
Method: 通过扩大设计规格并采用分层采样构建大规模镜头库AODLibpro；提出多阶段向量量化表示学习，将连续PSF编码为离散潜在PSF表征（LPR）作为先验，并采用码本冻结策略提升全镜头恢复和少样本适应。
Result: 在合成镜头库、真实设计仿真和真实拍摄镜头上，零样本性能达到最先进水平，同时支持高效少样本适应。
Conclusion: 该框架通过离散退化先验有效提升了盲镜头像差校正的泛化性能和适应效率，代码与数据集已开源。

papers.title: CANDI: Hybrid Discrete-Continuous Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: While continuous diffusion has shown remarkable success in continuous domains such as image generation, its direct application to discrete data has underperformed pure discrete formulations. To understand this gap, we introduce token identifiability, an analytical framework characterizing how Gaussian noise corrupts discrete data through two mechanisms: discrete identity corruption and continuous rank degradation. We reveal that these mechanisms scale differently with vocabulary size, creating a temporal dissonance that forces a tradeoff between learning continuous geometry and discrete structure. To address this, we propose CANDI (Continuous ANd DIscrete diffusion), a hybrid framework that decouples discrete and continuous corruption, enabling simultaneous learning of both. This unlocks the benefits of continuous diffusion for discrete spaces: on controlled generation, CANDI enables classifier-based guidance with off-the-shelf classifiers through simple gradient addition; on text generation, CANDI outperforms masked diffusion at low NFE, demonstrating the value of learning continuous gradients for discrete spaces. We include the code on the project page: https://patrickpynadath1.github.io/candi-lander.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CANDI（混合离散-连续扩散模型），分析连续扩散在离散数据上表现不佳的原因，提出token可识别性（token identifiability）分析框架，揭示离散身份破坏与连续秩退化两种机制随词汇表大小不同缩放导致的时间不协调。为此，CANDI解耦离散和连续破坏，同时学习两者，在文本生成上以低NFE超越掩码扩散，在可控生成中利用现成分类器通过简单梯度加法实现基于分类器的引导。
Motivation: 连续扩散在离散数据上表现不如纯离散公式，现有方法未充分理解这一差距的本质，需要理论分析并设计能同时利用连续几何和离散结构优势的框架。
Method: 提出token可识别性分析框架，将高斯噪声对离散数据的影响分解为离散身份破坏和连续秩退化两种机制；基于此设计CANDI混合框架，解耦离散和连续破坏过程，使模型能同时学习两种结构。
Result: 在文本生成任务中，CANDI在低NFE下优于掩码扩散；在可控生成中，可通过简单梯度加法集成现成分类器实现基于分类器的引导。
Conclusion: CANDI展示了连续扩散在离散空间中的价值，为离散数据生成提供新范式，但实验主要限于文本和可控生成场景，对其他离散模态的泛化需进一步验证。

papers.title: Oracle-Efficient Combinatorial Semi-Bandits
papers.abstract_en: We study the combinatorial semi-bandit problem where an agent selects a subset of base arms and receives individual feedback. While this generalizes the classical multi-armed bandit and has broad applicability, its scalability is limited by the high cost of combinatorial optimization, requiring oracle queries at every round. To tackle this, we propose oracle-efficient frameworks that significantly reduce oracle calls while maintaining tight regret guarantees. For the worst-case linear reward setting, our algorithms achieve $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret using only $O(\log\log T)$ oracle queries. We also propose covariance-adaptive algorithms that leverage noise structure for improved regret, and extend our approach to general (non-linear) rewards. Overall, our methods reduce oracle usage from linear to (doubly) logarithmic in time, with strong theoretical guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究组合半赌博机（combinatorial semi-bandit）问题，其中智能体每轮选择一组基础臂并接收个体反馈。针对传统方法因每轮需调用组合优化oracle而扩展性差的问题，提出oracle高效框架，将oracle查询次数从线性降低到对数或双对数级别，同时保持紧致的遗憾界。
Motivation: 组合半赌博机问题中，每轮选择需要求解组合优化问题，导致oracle查询成本高昂，限制了算法在大型问题上的可扩展性。
Method: 提出oracle高效框架，通过精心设计的查询策略，将oracle调用次数减少到$O(\log\log T)$。具体包括最坏情况线性奖励算法和协方差自适应算法，并扩展到非线性奖励。
Result: 在最坏情况线性奖励设置下，算法实现$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$的累积遗憾，仅需$O(\log\log T)$次oracle查询。协方差自适应版本进一步利用噪声结构改进遗憾。
Conclusion: 所提方法显著降低oracle调用量（从线性到双对数），且保持强理论保障，为组合半赌博机问题的实际应用提供了高效方案。

papers.title: Efficient Group Lasso Regularized Rank Regression with Simulation-Based Tuning
papers.abstract_en: High-dimensional regression often suffers from heavy-tailed noise and outliers, which can severely undermine the reliability of least-squares based methods. To improve robustness, we adopt a non-smooth Wilcoxon score based rank objective and incorporate the group sparsity regularization. By extending the tuning-free property originally developed for the rank Lasso, we introduce a simulation-based tuning rule and further establish a finite-sample error bound for the resulting estimator. To solve the associated optimization problem, we develop a proximal augmented Lagrangian method, for which we provide a novel convergence analysis by proving the metric subregularity of the underlying non-polyhedral KKT mapping, while enabling efficient semismooth Newton updates for the subproblems. Extensive numerical experiments demonstrate the robustness and effectiveness of our proposed estimator against several leading alternatives, and showcase the efficiency and scalability of our algorithm compared to the state-of-the-art baseline in both simulated and real-data settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高维回归中重尾噪声和异常值问题，采用基于Wilcoxon得分的秩目标函数并引入组稀疏正则化。通过扩展秩Lasso的无调谐性质，提出基于模拟的调谐规则，并建立了估计量的有限样本误差界。为求解优化问题，开发了近端增广拉格朗日方法，通过证明非多面体KKT映射的度量次正则性给出收敛性分析，子问题使用高效半光滑牛顿更新。数值实验表明该方法在鲁棒性和有效性上优于多种领先方法。
Motivation: 高维回归中最小二乘方法对重尾噪声和异常值敏感，现有鲁棒方法在组稀疏场景下缺乏高效调谐和理论保证。
Method: 采用Wilcoxon秩损失结合组Lasso惩罚，提出基于模拟的调谐规则（无需交叉验证），并设计近端增广拉格朗日算法，利用半光滑牛顿法求解子问题，证明了KKT映射的度量次正则性。
Result: 摘要报告了在模拟和真实数据实验中，该方法在鲁棒性和有效性上优于多种现有方法，且算法比最先进基线更高效和可扩展。
Conclusion: 本文提出的组Lasso正则化秩回归结合模拟调谐方法在高维鲁棒回归中具有理论保证和计算效率；摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Toward Autonomous Soft Robotic Endovascular Navigation via Imitation Learning
papers.abstract_en: In endovascular surgery, endovascular interventionists push a thin tube called a catheter, guided by a thin wire to a treatment site inside the patient's blood vessels to treat various conditions such as blood clots, aneurysms, and malformations. Robotic guidewires can enhance maneuverability but are difficult to model and control. Autonomous soft robotic guidewire navigation has the potential to overcome these challenges, increasing the precision and safety of endovascular navigation. As a first step, we establish a large-scale, 2D-projected environment for autonomous navigation. In other surgical domains, end-to-end imitation learning has shown promising results. Thus, we develop a transformer-based imitation learning framework with goal conditioning, relative action outputs, and automatic contrast dye injections to enable generalizable soft robot navigation in an aneurysm targeting task. We train the policy on 36 different modular bifurcated geometries, generating 647 total demonstrations under simulated fluoroscopy, and evaluate it on three previously unseen vascular geometries. The policy reaches the aneurysm with a success rate of 83% on the unseen geometries, outperforming several baselines. In addition, ablation and baseline studies evaluate the effectiveness of each design and data collection choice. Lastly, we extend the policy to achieve 75% success on an unseen patient-derived geometry. Project website: https://softrobotnavigation.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对软体机器人导丝在血管内导航中的自主控制难题，提出基于模仿学习的transformer框架，在模拟荧光透视环境下训练策略，并在未见过的几何结构（包括患者衍生几何结构）上达到83%和75%的成功率。
Motivation: 血管内手术中，机器人导丝可增强操控性但建模和控制困难，自主导航有望提高精度和安全性。
Method: 建立大规模2D投影环境；开发基于transformer的模仿学习框架，包含目标条件、相对动作输出和自动造影剂注射；在36种分叉几何结构上收集647个演示训练策略。
Result: 在未见过的几何结构上成功率达83%，在患者衍生几何结构上达75%，优于多个基线；消融实验验证了各设计选择的有效性。
Conclusion: 该工作为自主软体机器人血管内导航提供了初步验证，但仅在模拟环境中进行，未涉及真实物理约束和复杂性。

papers.title: Segmentation and Classification of Pap Smear Images for Cervical Cancer Detection Using Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Cervical cancer remains a significant global health concern and a leading cause of cancer-related deaths among women. Early detection through Pap smear tests is essential to reduce mortality rates; however, the manual examination is time consuming and prone to human error. This study proposes a deep learning framework that integrates U-Net for segmentation and a classification model to enhance diagnostic performance. The Herlev Pap Smear Dataset, a publicly available cervical cell dataset, was utilized for training and evaluation. The impact of segmentation on classification performance was evaluated by comparing the model trained on segmented images and another trained on non-segmented images. Experimental results showed that the use of segmented images marginally improved the model performance on precision (about 0.41 percent higher) and F1-score (about 1.30 percent higher), which suggests a slightly more balanced classification performance. While segmentation helps in feature extraction, the results showed that its impact on classification performance appears to be limited. The proposed framework offers a supplemental tool for clinical applications, which may aid pathologists in early diagnosis.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合U-Net分割和分类模型的深度学习框架，用于宫颈癌筛查中的Pap涂片图像分析。在Herlev数据集上的实验表明，分割后的图像相比未分割图像仅略微提升分类性能（精确率提高约0.41%，F1分数提高约1.30%），分割对分类的改善有限。
Motivation: 宫颈癌是女性癌症死亡的主要原因之一，Pap涂片检查的早期检测至关重要，但人工检查耗时且易出错。
Method: 集成U-Net进行细胞图像分割，然后使用分类模型对分割后的图像进行分类；并与未分割图像的分类性能进行对比。
Result: 使用分割图像后，分类精确率提升约0.41%，F1分数提升约1.30%，表明分割带来轻微改善但效果有限。
Conclusion: 该框架可作为临床辅助工具，帮助病理学家进行早期诊断，但分割对分类性能的影响有限。

papers.title: Beyond Naïve Prompting: Strategies for Improved Context-aided Forecasting with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Real-world forecasting requires models to integrate not only historical data but also relevant contextual information provided in textual form. While large language models (LLMs) show promise for context-aided forecasting, critical challenges remain: we lack diagnostic tools to understand failure modes, performance remains far below their potential, and high computational costs limit practical deployment. We introduce a unified framework of four strategies that address these limitations along three orthogonal dimensions: model diagnostics, accuracy, and efficiency. Through extensive evaluation across model families from small open-source models to frontier models including Gemini, GPT, and Claude, we uncover both fundamental insights and practical solutions. Our findings span three key dimensions: diagnostic strategies reveal the "Execution Gap" where models correctly explain how context affects forecasts but fail to apply this reasoning; accuracy-focused strategies achieve substantial performance improvements of 25-50%; and efficiency-oriented approaches show that adaptive routing between small and large models can approach large model accuracy on average while significantly reducing inference costs. These orthogonal strategies can be flexibly integrated based on deployment constraints, providing practitioners with a comprehensive toolkit for practical LLM-based context-aided forecasting. Code is made available at https://github.com/ashok-arjun/beyond-naive-prompting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架，包含四种策略，用于改进大语言模型（LLM）在上下文辅助预测中的表现。通过从开源小模型到前沿模型（Gemini、GPT、Claude）的广泛评估，发现诊断策略揭示了“执行差距”（Execution Gap），即模型能正确解释上下文影响但未能应用推理；准确率提升策略带来25-50%的性能改进；效率策略通过自适应路由在小模型和大模型之间权衡，在接近大模型准确率的同时降低推理成本。这些策略可灵活组合，为实际部署提供工具集。
Motivation: 现实世界预测需要模型整合历史数据和文本上下文信息，但当前LLM在此任务上缺乏诊断工具、性能不足且计算成本高。
Method: 提出一个统一框架，包含四种正交策略，分别针对模型诊断、准确率和效率三个维度。诊断策略分析模型错误模式；准确率策略通过提示工程等提升性能；效率策略采用自适应路由选择合适模型。
Result: 诊断策略发现模型的“执行差距”；准确率策略带来25-50%的性能提升；效率策略在多个模型上平均接近大模型准确率，同时显著降低推理成本。
Conclusion: 这些正交策略可根据部署约束灵活集成，为基于LLM的上下文辅助预测提供实用工具。实验涵盖多种模型规模，表明方法的通用性。

papers.title: Likelihood Matching for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose a Likelihood Matching approach for training diffusion models by first establishing an equivalence between the likelihood of the target data distribution and a likelihood along the sample path of the reverse diffusion. To efficiently compute the reverse sample likelihood, a quasi-likelihood is considered to approximate each reverse transition density by a Gaussian distribution with matched conditional mean and covariance, respectively. The score and Hessian functions for the diffusion generation are estimated by maximizing the quasi-likelihood, ensuring a consistent matching of both the first two transitional moments between every two time points. A stochastic sampler is introduced to facilitate computation that leverages both the estimated score and Hessian information. We establish consistency of the quasi-maximum likelihood estimation, and provide non-asymptotic convergence guarantees for the proposed sampler, quantifying the rates of the approximation errors due to the score and Hessian estimation, dimensionality, and the number of diffusion steps. Empirical and simulation evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed Likelihood Matching and validate the theoretical results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于扩散模型的似然匹配（Likelihood Matching）方法，通过建立目标数据分布似然与逆扩散样本路径似然之间的等价关系，并引入拟似然（quasi-likelihood）来近似逆转移密度，从而估计扩散过程的得分（score）和Hessian函数。该方法通过最大化拟似然来确保每两个时间点之间前两个转移矩的一致匹配，并提出了一个利用得分和Hessian信息的随机采样器。理论部分给出了拟最大似然估计的一致性以及采样器的非渐近收敛保证，量化了近似误差的速率。实验验证了该方法的有效性。
Motivation: 扩散模型的训练通常需要复杂的对数似然计算，现有方法在理论保证和计算效率上存在不足。本文旨在建立似然与逆扩散路径之间的直接联系，并利用拟似然高效地近似转移密度，从而改进扩散模型的学习和采样。
Method: 首先建立目标数据分布似然与逆扩散样本路径似然之间的等价关系；然后使用匹配条件均值和协方差的高斯分布作为拟似然来近似每个逆转移密度；通过最大化拟似然估计得分和Hessian函数；最后提出一个利用得分和Hessian信息的随机采样器进行生成。
Result: 理论部分证明了拟最大似然估计的一致性，并给出了采样器的非渐近收敛界，量化了由得分和Hessian估计误差、维度以及扩散步数导致的近似误差。实验验证了该方法在生成质量上的有效性，并与理论结果一致。
Conclusion: 似然匹配为训练扩散模型提供了一种具有理论保证且计算可行的方法，其关键在于通过拟似然匹配前两个转移矩。作者认为该方法在理论分析和实际效果上均有优势。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于扩散模型的似然匹配（Likelihood Matching）方法，通过建立目标数据分布似然与逆扩散样本路径似然之间的等价关系，并引入拟似然（quasi-likelihood）来近似逆转移密度，从而估计扩散过程的得分（score）和Hessian函数。该方法通过最大化拟似然来确保每两个时间点之间前两个转移矩的一致匹配，并提出了一个利用得分和Hessian信息的随机采样器。理论部分给出了拟最大似然估计的一致性以及采样器的非渐近收敛保证，量化了近似误差的速率。实验验证了该方法的有效性。

papers.title: Neural Human Pose Prior
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a principled, data-driven approach for modeling a neural prior over human body poses using normalizing flows. Unlike heuristic or low-expressivity alternatives, our method leverages RealNVP to learn a flexible density over poses represented in the 6D rotation format. We address the challenge of modeling distributions on the manifold of valid 6D rotations by inverting the Gram-Schmidt process during training, enabling stable learning while preserving downstream compatibility with rotation-based frameworks. Our architecture and training pipeline are framework-agnostic and easily reproducible. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the learned prior through both qualitative and quantitative evaluations, and we analyze its impact via ablation studies. This work provides a sound probabilistic foundation for integrating pose priors into human motion capture and reconstruction pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于归一化流（normalizing flows）的人体姿态先验建模方法，使用RealNVP学习6D旋转格式下的灵活密度分布。通过反转Gram-Schmidt过程解决有效6D旋转流形上的分布建模问题，实现稳定训练并保持与旋转框架的兼容性。实验通过定性和定量评估展示了该先验的有效性，并进行了消融分析。
Motivation: 现有的人体姿态先验要么基于启发式规则，要么表达能力有限，缺乏一种原则性的、数据驱动的概率建模方法。
Method: 采用RealNVP归一化流学习6D旋转姿态的密度分布，在训练中通过反转Gram-Schmidt过程（inverting the Gram-Schmidt process）确保生成的旋转矩阵位于有效流形上。
Result: 通过定性和定量评估证明了学习到的先验的有效性，消融研究进一步分析了其影响。
Conclusion: 该工作为将姿态先验集成到人体运动捕捉和重建管道中提供了合理的概率基础。

papers.title: SWE-MERA: A Dynamic Benchmark for Agenticly Evaluating Large Language Models on Software Engineering Tasks
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) in software engineering has revealed critical limitations in existing benchmarks, particularly the widely used SWE-bench dataset. Recent studies have uncovered severe data contamination issues, e.g., SWE-bench reports 32.67% of successful patches involve direct solution leakage and 31.08% pass due to inadequate test cases. We introduce SWE-MERA, a dynamic, continuously updated benchmark designed to address these fundamental challenges through an automated collection of real-world GitHub issues and rigorous quality validation. Our approach implements a reliable pipeline that ensures quality while minimizing contamination risks, resulting in approximately 10,000 potential tasks with 728 samples currently available. Evaluation using the Aider coding agent demonstrates strong discriminative power in state-of-the-art models. We report performance across a dozen recent LLMs evaluated on tasks collected between September 2024 and June 2025.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 介绍SWE-MERA，一个动态更新、自动收集真实GitHub issue的软件工程基准，解决SWE-bench的数据污染问题。目前包含约10,000个潜在任务和728个样本，评估了多个LLM的性能。
Motivation: SWE-bench存在严重的数据污染，包括直接解答泄漏和测试用例不足，需要更可靠的基准。
Method: 自动化收集真实GitHub issue并进行严格质量验证，构建动态持续更新的基准。
Result: 评估表明对当前最先进模型具有强区分能力，报告了12个近期LLM在2024年9月至2025年6月收集的任务上的性能。
Conclusion: SWE-MERA旨在提供更可靠、低污染风险的软件工程任务评估。

papers.title: Trojan Horse Prompting: Jailbreaking Conversational Multimodal Models by Forging Assistant Message
papers.abstract_en: The rise of conversational interfaces has greatly enhanced LLM usability by leveraging dialogue history for sophisticated reasoning. However, this reliance introduces an unexplored attack surface. This paper introduces Trojan Horse Prompting, a novel jailbreak technique. Adversaries bypass safety mechanisms by forging the model's own past utterances within the conversational history provided to its API. A malicious payload is injected into a model-attributed message, followed by a benign user prompt to trigger harmful content generation. This vulnerability stems from Asymmetric Safety Alignment: models are extensively trained to refuse harmful user requests but lack comparable skepticism towards their own purported conversational history. This implicit trust in its "past" creates a high-impact vulnerability. Experimental validation on Google's Gemini-2.0-flash-preview-image-generation shows Trojan Horse Prompting achieves a significantly higher Attack Success Rate (ASR) than established user-turn jailbreaking methods. These findings reveal a fundamental flaw in modern conversational AI security, necessitating a paradigm shift from input-level filtering to robust, protocol-level validation of conversational context integrity.
papers.comment: We stopped working on this idea because we realized that there was a paper submitted before it that took almost identical approach
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为“特洛伊木马提示”（Trojan Horse Prompting）的新型越狱攻击方法，攻击者通过伪造模型在对话历史中的自身话语来绕过安全机制。在用户提供的对话历史中，将恶意负载注入模型声称的消息中，随后跟一个良性用户提示以触发有害内容生成。该漏洞源于“非对称安全对齐”：模型被训练拒绝有害用户请求，但对自身声称的对话历史缺乏同样程度的怀疑。在Google Gemini-2.0-flash-preview-image-generation上的实验表明，该攻击的攻击成功率（ASR）显著高于现有的用户轮次越狱方法。
Motivation: 现有对话接口的安全机制过度依赖输入过滤，但忽略了模型对自身对话历史的隐式信任，从而引入了一个未探索的攻击面。
Method: 攻击者在对话历史中伪造一条模型归属的消息，其中嵌入恶意payload，然后跟一个良性用户提示，触发模型生成有害内容。
Result: 在Gemini-2.0-flash-preview-image-generation上，Trojan Horse Prompting的攻击成功率（ASR）显著高于现有的用户轮次越狱方法。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了现代对话AI安全中的根本缺陷，需要从输入级过滤转向对话上下文完整性的协议级验证。

papers.title: On the Necessity of Output Distribution Reweighting for Effective Class Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we reveal a significant shortcoming in class unlearning evaluations: overlooking the underlying class geometry can cause information leakage about the forgotten class. We further propose a simple unlearning strategy to mitigate this issue. We introduce Class Membership Inference Attack (CMIA) that uses the probabilities assigned by the model to neighboring classes to detect unlearned samples. We find that existing unlearning methods are vulnerable to CMIA across multiple datasets. We then propose a new fine-tuning objective that mitigates this privacy leakage by approximating, for forget-class inputs, the distribution over the remaining classes that a retrained-from-scratch model would produce. To construct this approximation, we estimate inter-class similarity and tilt the target model's distribution accordingly. The resulting Tilted REWeighting (TREW) distribution serves as the desired distribution during fine-tuning. We also show that across multiple benchmarks, TREW matches or surpasses existing unlearning methods on prior unlearning metrics. More specifically, on CIFAR-10, it reduces the gap with retrained models by 19% and 46% for U-LiRA and CMIA scores, accordingly, compared to the SOTA method for each category. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/CrowdDynamicsLab/ICML_TREW.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了现有类遗忘评估中的一个重大缺陷：忽略底层类几何结构会导致被遗忘类的信息泄露。作者提出了类成员推理攻击（CMIA），利用模型对邻近类别的概率来检测遗忘样本。实验表明，现有遗忘方法在多个数据集上均易受CMIA攻击。为此，作者提出了一种新的微调目标——倾斜重加权（TREW），通过估计类间相似度并倾斜目标模型的输出分布，使其逼近从头训练模型对遗忘类输入的分布。在CIFAR-10上，TREW将U-LiRA和CMIA分数与从头训练模型的差距分别减少了19%和46%。
Motivation: 现有的类遗忘方法在评估时忽略了类别几何结构，导致被遗忘类的信息可能通过模型对邻近类别的输出泄露，造成隐私风险。
Method: 提出CMIA攻击（利用邻近类概率检测遗忘样本）和TREW方法（在微调时通过估计类间相似度重加权输出分布，使其接近从头训练模型的分布）。
Result: 在CIFAR-10上，TREW与当前最优方法相比，将U-LiRA和CMIA分数与从头训练模型的差距分别降低了19%和46%。在多个基准上，TREW在现有遗忘指标上达到或超越已有方法。
Conclusion: 强调了输出分布重加权对于有效类遗忘的必要性，TREW提供了一种简单有效的缓解隐私泄露的方案。

papers.title: AutoV: Loss-Oriented Ranking for Visual Prompt Retrieval in LVLMs
papers.abstract_en: Inspired by text prompts in large language models, visual prompts have been explored to enhance the perceptual capabilities of large vision-language models (LVLMs). However, performance tends to saturate under single visual prompt designs, making further prompt engineering increasingly ineffective. To address this limitation, we shift from prompt engineering to prompt retrieval and propose AutoV, a lightweight framework for instance-adaptive visual prompt identification. Given an input image and a textual query, AutoV automatically locates the most suitable visual prompt from a diverse candidate pool. Training such a retrieval framework requires prompt-level supervision, yet prompt quality is inherently ambiguous and difficult to assess reliably, even for humans. To enable automatic supervision, we evaluate visual prompts using a pre-trained LVLM and label them according to their prediction losses. Using the loss-oriented ranking as a robust training signal, AutoV learns to retrieve the query-aware optimal prompt for each instance without manual annotation. Experiments indicate that AutoV enhances the performance of various LVLMs on image understanding, captioning, grounding, and classification tasks. For example, AutoV improves LLaVA-OV by $\textbf{10.2}\%$ on VizWiz and boosts Qwen2.5-VL by $\textbf{3.8}\%$ on MMMU, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AutoV，一个轻量级框架，用于在大视觉语言模型（LVLM）中自动检索实例自适应的视觉提示。通过利用预训练LVLM的预测损失作为标签，进行损失导向的排序训练，AutoV能够从候选池中为每个实例选取最优提示，无需人工标注。实验表明，AutoV在图像理解、描述、定位和分类任务上提升了多种LVLM的性能。
Motivation: 当前视觉提示设计趋于饱和，单提示设计难以进一步提升LVLM性能，且提示质量难以人工评估，需要自动化的提示检索方法。
Method: 提出AutoV框架，使用预训练LVLM评估候选视觉提示的预测损失，构建损失排序作为训练信号，学习从候选池中为给定图像和文本查询检索最优提示。
Result: AutoV在多个任务上提升了LVLM性能，例如在VizWiz上提升LLaVA-OV 10.2%，在MMMU上提升Qwen2.5-VL 3.8%。
Conclusion: 结果表明，从提示工程转向提示检索，利用损失导向排序自动监督，可有效增强LVLM的视觉感知能力。

papers.title: A computational model of infant sensorimotor exploration in the mobile paradigm
papers.abstract_en: We present a computational model of the mechanisms that may determine infant behavior in the "mobile paradigm". This paradigm has been used in developmental psychology to explore how infants learn the sensory effects of their actions. In this paradigm, a mobile (an articulated and movable object hanging above an infant's crib) is connected to one of the infant's limbs, prompting the infant to preferentially move that "connected" limb. This ability to detect a "sensorimotor contingency" is considered to be a foundational cognitive ability in development. To understand how infants learn sensorimotor contingencies, we built a model that attempts to replicate infant behavior. Our model incorporates a neural network, action-outcome prediction, exploration, motor noise, preferred activity level, and biologically inspired motor control. We find that simulations with our model replicate the classic findings in the literature showing preferential movement of the connected limb. An interesting observation is that the model sometimes exhibits a burst of movement after the mobile is disconnected, shedding light on a similar occasional finding in infants. In addition to these general findings, the simulations also replicate data from two recent more detailed studies using a connection with the mobile that was either gradual or all-or-none. A series of ablation studies further shows that the inclusion of mechanisms of action-outcome prediction, exploration, motor noise, and biologically inspired motor control was essential for the model to correctly replicate infant behavior. This suggests that these components are also involved in infant sensorimotor learning.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Cognitive and Developmental Systems 18 (3), 692-707 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个计算模型来模拟婴儿在“移动范式”中的行为，该模型包含神经网络、动作-结果预测、探索、运动噪声、偏好活动水平和生物启发式运动控制。模拟结果复制了经典文献中的发现，即连接肢体的优先运动，并揭示了断连后的运动爆发。消融研究表明预测、探索、噪声和生物控制组件对正确复制婴儿行为至关重要。
Motivation: 理解婴儿如何学习感觉运动偶然性（sensorimotor contingency）是发展心理学中的基础认知能力，但缺乏计算模型来阐明其内在机制。
Method: 构建了一个包含动作-结果预测、探索、运动噪声、偏好活动水平和生物启发式运动控制的计算模型，使用神经网络进行模拟。
Result: 模拟成功复制了经典发现（连接肢体的优先运动）以及断连后的运动爆发，并复现了两个近期研究的数据。消融实验表明所有组件对正确复制行为都是必要的。
Conclusion: 该模型表明动作-结果预测、探索、运动噪声和生物控制可能参与婴儿的感觉运动学习。

papers.title: Disentangling Feature Structure: A Mathematically Provable Two-Stage Training Dynamics in Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Transformers may exhibit two-stage training dynamics during the real-world training process. For instance, when training GPT-2 on the Counterfact dataset, the answers progress from syntactically incorrect to syntactically correct to semantically correct. However, existing theoretical analyses hardly account for this feature-level two-stage phenomenon, which could be conceptually attributed to disentangled two-type features like syntax and semantics. In this paper, we theoretically demonstrate how the two-stage training dynamics potentially occur in transformers. Specifically, we analyze the feature learning dynamics induced by the aforementioned disentangled two-type feature structure, grounding our analysis in a simplified yet illustrative setting that comprises normalized ReLU self-attention and structured data. Such disentanglement of feature structure is general in practice, e.g., natural languages contain syntax and semantics, and proteins contain primary and secondary structures. To our best knowledge, this is the first rigorous result regarding a feature-level two-stage optimization process in transformers within this theoretical framework. A corollary further indicates that such a two-stage process is closely related to the spectral properties of attention weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上证明了Transformer在训练过程中可能出现特征层面的两阶段动力学现象（如从语法正确到语义正确），这是首次在理论框架下严格分析Transformer中的特征解耦两阶段优化过程。
Motivation: 现有理论分析难以解释Transformer训练中观察到的特征层面两阶段现象（如语法与语义的分离），需要理论建模解耦特征结构对学习动态的影响。
Method: 在归一化ReLU自注意力与结构化数据的简化设置下，理论分析解耦的两类特征（如语法与语义）诱导的特征学习动力学。
Result: 严格证明了两阶段训练动力学的存在性，并推论该过程与注意力权重的谱性质密切相关。
Conclusion: 该结果首次在理论框架中为Transformer的特征级两阶段优化过程提供了严格证明，揭示了特征解耦结构在训练动态中的关键作用。

papers.title: Disentangled Unsupervised Skill Discovery for Efficient Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: A hallmark of intelligent agents is the ability to learn reusable skills purely from unsupervised interaction with the environment. However, existing unsupervised skill discovery methods often learn entangled skills where one skill variable simultaneously influences many entities in the environment, making downstream skill chaining extremely challenging. We propose Disentangled Unsupervised Skill Discovery (DUSDi), a method for learning disentangled skills that can be efficiently reused to solve downstream tasks. DUSDi decomposes skills into disentangled components, where each skill component only affects one factor of the state space. Importantly, these skill components can be concurrently composed to generate low-level actions, and efficiently chained to tackle downstream tasks through hierarchical Reinforcement Learning. DUSDi defines a novel mutual-information-based objective to enforce disentanglement between the influences of different skill components, and utilizes value factorization to optimize this objective efficiently. Evaluated in a set of challenging environments, DUSDi successfully learns disentangled skills, and significantly outperforms previous skill discovery methods when it comes to applying the learned skills to solve downstream tasks. Code and skills visualization at jiahenghu.github.io/DUSDi-site/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种解耦的无监督技能发现方法（DUSDi），用于层次化强化学习。DUSDi通过学习解耦的技能组件，每个组件只影响状态空间的一个因子，并可以并行组合和高效链接以解决下游任务。该方法基于互信息目标函数和值分解优化，在多个环境中优于先前的方法。
Motivation: 现有的无监督技能发现方法通常学习纠缠的技能，其中一个技能变量同时影响多个环境实体，使得下游技能链接非常困难。
Method: 提出DUSDi，通过互信息目标强制不同技能组件之间的解耦，并利用值分解高效优化该目标。技能组件可以并发组合生成低级动作，并通过层次化强化学习有效链接。
Result: 在多个挑战性环境中，DUSDi成功学习了解耦技能，并在应用所学技能解决下游任务时显著优于先前的技能发现方法。
Conclusion: DUSDi能够学习解耦的可重用技能，提高层次化强化学习的效率，但未提及局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PanDORA: Casual HDR Radiance Acquisition of Indoor Scenes for Image-based Lighting
papers.abstract_en: Most novel view synthesis methods -- including Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) -- struggle to capture the high dynamic range (HDR) radiance required for realistic image-based lighting (IBL). This limitation stems from a reliance on low dynamic range (LDR) imagery, which fails to capture the intensity of light sources found in indoor environments. While exposure bracketing can recover this range, it is often too slow for practical, large-scale acquisition. In this work, we introduce PanDORA: PANoramic Dual-Observer Radiance Acquisition, a system specifically designed for the fast and affordable capture of high-quality HDR radiance maps for IBL. Our approach utilizes two 360° cameras mounted on a portable monopod to simultaneously record videos at different exposures. These videos are processed by our proposed two-stage NeRF-based algorithm featuring a novel self-calibrating pipeline to estimate camera parameters. This pipeline produces non-saturated HDR radiance fields that accurately capture the radiance of a scene. When evaluated on a new dataset of real indoor environments featuring HDR ground truth lighting, PanDORA demonstrates superior fidelity in reconstructing the peak intensities necessary for downstream rendering tasks, providing a scalable and efficient solution for capturing real-world IBLs.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICCP 2026. Selected for PAMI Special Issue
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PanDORA 是一种便携式双摄像头系统，通过 360° 视频采集和两阶段 NeRF 算法，快速获取室内场景的高动态范围辐射场，用于基于图像的照明（IBL）。实验在真实室内数据集上验证了其在重建峰值强度方面的优势。
Motivation: 现有新视图合成方法（如 NeRF）受限于低动态范围（LDR）图像，无法捕获室内光源的强度，而曝光包围法速度慢，不适用于大规模采集。
Method: 使用两个 360° 摄像头固定在便携式单脚架上，同时以不同曝光录制视频；提出两阶段 NeRF 算法，包含自标定流水线估计相机参数，生成无饱和的 HDR 辐射场。
Result: 在带有 HDR 真实照明的室内数据集上，PanDORA 在重建峰值强度方面优于现有方法，支持下游渲染任务。
Conclusion: 该系统为捕获真实世界 IBL 提供了一种可扩展且高效的解决方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Federated Topic Model and Model Pruning Based on Variational Autoencoder
papers.abstract_en: Topic modeling has emerged as a valuable tool for discovering patterns and topics within large collections of documents. However, when cross-analysis involves multiple parties, data privacy becomes a critical concern. Federated topic modeling has been developed to address this issue, allowing multiple parties to jointly train models while protecting privacy. However, there are communication and performance challenges in the federated scenario. To solve these problems, this paper proposes a method to establish a federated topic model while ensuring the privacy of each node and uses neural network model pruning to accelerate the model. The client periodically sends cumulative neuron gradients and model weights to the server, and the server prunes the model. To address different requirements, two methods are proposed to determine the pruning rate. The first slowly prunes throughout training, which has limited acceleration during training but can ensure higher accuracy and significantly reduce inference time. The second quickly reaches the target pruning rate early in training and then continues training with a smaller model. This approach may lose more useful information but can complete training faster. Experimental results show that the proposed variational-autoencoder-based federated topic model pruning can greatly accelerate training while maintaining model performance.
papers.journal_ref: In Proceedings of 2023 Chinese Intelligent Automation Conference, 2023: 51-60
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于变分自编码器（VAE）的联邦主题模型，并利用神经网络模型剪枝技术加速训练和推理。客户端定期向服务器发送累积神经元梯度和模型权重，服务器执行剪枝。针对不同需求，提出两种剪枝率确定方法：一种在训练过程中缓慢剪枝以保持精度并显著减少推理时间；另一种在训练早期快速达到目标剪枝率，以加快训练速度。实验表明该方法在保持模型性能的同时能大幅加速训练。
Motivation: 联邦主题建模在多方协作分析中存在通信和性能挑战，且数据隐私保护是关键问题。现有方法难以在保证隐私的同时兼顾效率和模型质量。
Method: 基于VAE的联邦主题模型框架，客户端上传累积神经元梯度和模型权重至服务器，服务器执行剪枝。提出两种剪枝率确定策略：缓慢剪枝（渐进式）和快速剪枝（早期达到目标率）。
Result: 实验结果显示，所提方法能在保持模型性能的前提下大幅加速训练过程。
Conclusion: 该方法在不牺牲隐私的前提下，通过模型剪枝有效缓解了联邦场景下的通信和计算负担，适用于分布式文档主题建模。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interventions Against Machine-Assisted Statistical Discrimination
papers.abstract_en: I study statistical discrimination driven by verifiable beliefs, such as those generated by machine learning, rather than by humans. When beliefs are verifiable, interventions against statistical discrimination can move beyond simple belief-free designs, like affirmative action and blinding, to more sophisticated belief-contingent ones. I analyze a belief-contingent intervention, common identity, and show that it can be more effective at combating statistical discrimination than popular alternatives -- particularly when the training dataset exhibits the kinds of statistical biases that often plague machine-assisted decision problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究由可验证信念（如机器学习产生的信念）驱动的统计歧视，并分析一种信念依赖干预——共同身份。作者证明，在训练数据集存在统计偏差的机器辅助决策问题中，共同身份干预比传统的无信念干预（如平权行动和盲审）更有效。
Motivation: 传统的对抗统计歧视的干预（如平权行动、盲审）是无信念的，不适用于由可验证信念（如机器学习）驱动的歧视场景。
Method: 提出并形式化了一种信念依赖干预——共同身份（common identity），并对其效果进行理论分析。
Result: 摘要声称，当训练数据集呈现出统计偏差时，共同身份干预在对抗统计歧视方面优于流行的无信念干预方案。
Conclusion: 该研究强调了信念依赖干预在机器辅助统计歧视中的潜力，为设计更有效的算法公平性干预提供了理论依据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Profiling and Evolution of Intellectual Property
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, with the rapid growth of Internet data, the number and types of scientific and technological resources are also rapidly expanding. However, the increase in the number and category of information data will also increase the cost of information acquisition. For technology-based enterprises or users, in addition to general papers, patents, and other resources, policies related to technology or the development of their industries should also belong to a type of scientific and technological resource. Extracting valuable science and technology policy resources from a huge amount of mixed-content data and providing accurate and fast retrieval will help break down information barriers and reduce information-acquisition costs, which has profound social significance and utility. This article focuses on the difficulties and problems in the field of science and technology policy and introduces related technologies and developments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了科技政策资源的画像与演化问题，旨在从海量混合内容数据中提取有价值的科技政策资源，并提供精准快速检索，以降低信息获取成本。文章介绍了科技政策领域的难点及相关技术发展。
Motivation: 随着互联网数据快速增长，科技资源的种类和数量迅速扩张，但信息数据增加也提高了信息获取成本。对于技术型企业或用户，除论文、专利等资源外，技术或产业发展相关政策也属于科技资源，需要有效提取和检索。
Method: 本文聚焦科技政策领域的难点和问题，介绍了相关技术和发展，但未在摘要中详细说明具体方法。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果或量化指标。
Conclusion: 文章强调了科技政策资源的价值，并指出相关技术有助于打破信息壁垒、降低信息获取成本，具有深远的社会意义。

papers.title: Research on Intellectual Property Resource Profile and Evolution Law
papers.abstract_en: In the era of big data, intellectual property-oriented scientific and technological resources show the trend of large data scale, high information density, and low value density, which brings severe challenges to the effective use of intellectual property resources, and the demand for mining hidden information in intellectual property is increasing. This makes intellectual property-oriented science and technology resource portraits and analysis of evolution become a current research hotspot. This paper sorts out the construction method of intellectual property resource portraits and its preliminary work, including property entity extraction and entity completion, from the aspects of algorithm classification and general process, and identifies directions for improving future methods.

papers.title: Research on Cross-media Science and Technology Information Data Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Since the era of big data, the Internet has been flooded with all kinds of information. Browsing information through the Internet has become an integral part of people's daily life. Unlike news data and social data on the Internet, cross-media science and technology information data has different characteristics. This data has become an important basis for researchers and scholars to track current hot spots and explore future directions of technology development. As the volume of science and technology information data becomes richer, traditional science and technology information retrieval systems, which support only unimodal data retrieval and use outdated keyword-matching models, can no longer meet the daily retrieval needs of science and technology scholars. Therefore, in view of this research background, it is of profound practical significance to study cross-media science and technology information data retrieval systems based on deep semantic features, in line with domestic and international technology-development trends.

papers.title: FlashTrie: A GPU-Accelerated Constrained Beam Search for Generative Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Constrained decoding is essential in generative retrieval, where document identifiers generated directly from a query must exactly match a predefined library of valid IDs. At scale, decoding is often constrained using a trie with beam search but most implementations run on CPU. Limited parallelism then makes trie traversal and candidate validation a serving bottleneck as beam width grows. We present FlashTrie, which addresses this limitation by optimizing constrained beam search on GPUs. It introduces an integer-aware succinct trie layout that uses bit compression to reduce memory footprint while keeping the full index in GPU high-bandwidth memory reducing memory stalls, and a cooperative CUDA kernel that performs beam expansion, validation, and pruning entirely on-device without per-step host orchestration. It further replaces CPU-style irregular lookup and heap maintenance with GPU-aware parallel primitives, improving warp utilization and reducing divergence. Together, these designs significantly reduce decoding latency and increase throughput while preserving retrieval quality. On a library of 800M keywords with beam widths up to 1000, FlashTrie reduces trie-search latency to under 3 ms, achieving up to 24x speedup over a highly optimized multi-threaded CPU baseline. These improvements enable FlashTrie to scale beam sizes by up to 5x in latency-critical applications such as sponsored search. In a large-scale online A/B experiment on a popular commercial search engine, it delivers a statistically significant +0.71% revenue lift, enabling real-time constrained decoding at a scale previously feasible only offline. The FlashTrie code will be publicly released after the review process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlashTrie 是一种基于 GPU 的约束束搜索优化方法，用于生成式检索中的约束解码。它通过整数感知的紧凑 trie 布局和协作 CUDA 内核，将束扩展、验证和剪枝完全在 GPU 设备上执行，避免了逐步骤的主机协调。在 800M 关键词库、束宽达 1000 时，trie 搜索延迟低于 3ms，相比多线程 CPU 基线实现 24 倍加速，并在商业搜索引擎的在线 A/B 实验中带来 +0.71% 的显著收入提升。
Motivation: 现有生成式检索中，基于 trie 的约束束搜索通常在 CPU 上执行，随着束宽增加，trie 遍历和候选验证成为服务瓶颈，限制了扩展性。
Method: FlashTrie 引入整数感知的紧凑 trie 布局，利用位压缩降低内存占用并保持完整索引在 GPU 高带宽内存中，同时设计协作 CUDA 内核在设备上完成束扩展、验证和剪枝，并用 GPU 意识的并行原语替代 CPU 风格的不规则查找和堆维护。
Result: 在 800M 关键词库、束宽 1000 时，trie 搜索延迟低于 3ms，比优化多线程 CPU 基线快 24 倍；在延迟关键应用（如赞助搜索）中束大小可扩展 5 倍；在线 A/B 实验显示 +0.71% 的收入提升。
Conclusion: FlashTrie 使实时约束解码达到此前仅离线可行的规模，代码将在审稿后公开。

papers.title: Are We Ready for AI-Driven Discovery? AI Verification Before the Next Fundamental Physics Breakthrough
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning (ML) has become integral to fundamental physics, accelerating statistical workflows from data acquisition through inference and hypothesis testing. As ML systems grow increasingly autonomous, ensuring their reliability for discovery claims becomes critical. This review synthesizes the VERaiPHY (Validation & Evaluation for Robust AI in PHYsics) initiative's frameworks for rigorous ML assessment across particle physics, astrophysics, and cosmology. We establish when verification is essential by contextualizing ML within the statistical discovery workflow. We emphasize fundamental limitations: inductive bias is unavoidable, sample complexity bounds learning, and experimental constraints limit discovery. We reflect on physicists' evolving role as both experimental designers and evaluators whose judgments encode scientific rigor into AI systems. Responsible integration requires understanding ML's transformative potential alongside its intrinsic boundaries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述，系统总结了VERaiPHY倡议提出的用于基础物理学（粒子物理、天体物理、宇宙学）中机器学习严格评估的框架。文章将ML置于统计发现流程中，指出归纳偏置不可避免、样本复杂度限制学习、实验约束限制发现，并反思了物理学家作为实验设计者和评估者的角色变化。结论强调，负责任地整合ML需要理解其变革潜力与固有边界。
Motivation: 随着机器学习系统在基础物理学中日益自主，确保其用于科学发现声明的可靠性变得至关重要，而现有评估方法尚未系统化。
Method: 通过VERaiPHY倡议构建一个覆盖数据获取到假设检验全流程的ML验证框架，并讨论归纳偏置、样本复杂度与实验约束等根本性限制。
Result: 文章指出归纳偏置无法避免，样本复杂度理论限制了学习能力，实验约束制约了发现空间，并强调了物理学家作为判断编码者这一角色的演变。
Conclusion: 负责任地整合ML需要同时认识到其巨大潜力与内在局限性，并通过科学严谨的验证流程确保可靠性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometric mean-based pairwise comparison method with the reference values -- statistical approach
papers.abstract_en: For many years, the pairwise comparison method has been widely used for decision-making involving experts. The best-known example of this method is the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). In this now classic approach, the weights of alternatives are calculated using the principal eigenvector of the comparison matrix. In this paper, we present a statistical view of the pairwise comparison method, using reference values and the geometric mean to calculate alternative priorities. Thanks to this approach, we can simultaneously capture both the phenomenon of inconsistency in pairwise comparisons and the preference distance between alternatives. In this paper, we define indicators that measure the quality of the obtained weight vector, which, thanks to the statistical approach, have a clear and intuitive interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从统计视角重新审视成对比较方法，提出使用参考值与几何平均数计算备选项权重，同时刻画成对比较的不一致性及备选项间的偏好距离。定义了具有直观统计解释的权重向量质量指标。
Motivation: 传统AHP方法依赖主特征向量计算权重，缺乏统计解释；现有方法难以同时处理不一致性和偏好距离。
Method: 采用参考值（reference values）和几何平均数（geometric mean）构建统计框架下的成对比较模型，推导优先级权重，并定义基于统计理论的质量指标。
Result: 所提指标能够清晰、直观地解释权重向量的统计质量，并同时反映比较矩阵的不一致程度与备选项之间的偏好差异。
Conclusion: 该统计方法为成对比较提供了一种兼具解释性与实用性的分析工具，但摘要明确其适用范围为决策分析领域，不涉及天气相关应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MLPs are Hebbians: Constructing Efficient Fact-Storing MLPs for Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) store factual knowledge in their parameters. While recent work has shown that this knowledge resides in MLP layers, existing constructive and mechanistic interpretability models of fact-storage in LLMs fail to explain the surprising empirical phenomenon that they store facts at an information-theoretically optimal rate. In this work, we develop a theoretical account of this phenomenon. We develop the first Transformer-compatible fact-storing MLP closed-form construction that satisfies the following three properties empirically observed in LLMs: it (i) attains optimal fact storage scaling, (ii) handles arbitrary input/output geometries, and (iii) works inside Transformers. Key to our work is to analyze the decoding margin of MLPs, whereas prior work only studies MLP fact storage. Under isotropic embeddings, our construction achieves information-theoretically optimal storage capacity scaling and requires $10$-$104\times$ fewer parameters at matched fact count than prior constructions. For arbitrary key and value embeddings, we show that our construction attains the same storage capacity scaling, up to penalization factors depending on the embedding geometries. Moreover, we demonstrate that our constructed MLPs can be used within Transformer blocks for factual recall tasks at optimal capacity scaling, requiring $15$-$63\times$ fewer parameters at matched fact count than prior constructions. Finally, as a proof-of-concept, we show that fact-storing MLPs enable modular fact editing by swapping a Transformer's MLP with a new one.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文提出第一个满足Transformer兼容性的MLP事实存储封闭形式构造，该构造在**各向同性嵌入**下达到信息论最优存储容量，且参数效率比以往构造提升10-104倍；在**任意键值嵌入**下也能达到最优缩放率（受几何惩罚影响）。作者将MLP构造集成到Transformer模块中，在事实召回任务上以15-63倍参数效率优于此前构造，并展示了通过替换MLP实现模块化事实编辑的可行性。
Motivation: 现有可解释性模型无法解释大语言模型（LLM）以信息论最优速率存储事实的惊人现象，缺乏同时满足(1)最优存储缩放、(2)任意输入/输出几何、(3) Transformer兼容性的闭式构造。
Method: 从解码边际（decoding margin）角度分析MLP事实存储，提出首个Transformer兼容的闭式MLP构造。该构造利用嵌入几何性质，通过理论分析获得存储容量缩放律。
Result: 在**各向同性嵌入**下达到信息论最优存储容量，参数效率比先前构造提升10-104倍；在**任意键值嵌入**下仍保持相同缩放律（受几何惩罚）。在Transformer中用于事实召回时，参数效率提升15-63倍。
Conclusion: 本工作首次在理论上解释了LLM以最优速率存储事实的能力，并为模块化事实编辑提供了新思路。

papers.title: Tracing the space-time causal origins of Earth system extremes
papers.abstract_en: Identifying the causes of Earth's extremes is challenging because counterfactual experiments are not possible in the observed world, while numerical experiments are computationally expensive and subject to biases. Data-driven causal discovery offers a complementary path, but existing approaches can fail in undersampled, high-dimensional regimes, and may not recover multi-timestep, multivariate pathways leading to particular events. We introduce Tracer of Causal Evolutions in Space and Time (TraCE-ST), a probabilistic Lagrangian approach that produces event-conditioned causal trajectories in multivariate gridded data. In synthetic experiments and real-world extreme events, TraCE-ST recovers known causal drivers and estimates their relative contributions, while also highlighting less-studied drivers, including orography-driven vorticity for Tropical Storm Debby (2006) and anomalous ocean-surface fluxes for the 2021 Pacific Northwest heatwave. Here, we propose causal tracking as an efficient data-driven framework for synthesizing causal evidence and generating testable hypotheses, complementing association analyses and numerical modeling while accelerating the study of high-impact events.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TraCE-ST（时空因果演化追踪器），一种基于概率拉格朗日方法的因果发现框架，用于从多变量网格数据中重建事件条件下的因果轨迹。在合成实验和真实极端事件（如2006年热带风暴Debby、2021年太平洋西北热浪）中，该方法恢复了已知因果驱动因子并估计了其相对贡献，同时揭示了较少研究的驱动因素，如地形引起的大气涡度异常和海洋表面通量异常。作者认为因果追踪可作为高效的数据驱动框架，补充关联分析和数值模拟，加速高影响事件研究。
Motivation: 识别地球系统极端事件的因果原因具有挑战性，因为反事实实验不可行，数值实验昂贵且有偏差，而现有数据驱动因果发现方法在欠采样高维场景下可能失败，无法恢复多时间步、多变量的因果路径。
Method: 提出TraCE-ST，一种概率拉格朗日方法，通过事件条件化产生多变量网格数据中的因果轨迹，实现从空间时间上追踪极端事件的因果演化过程。
Result: 在合成实验中验证了方法的准确性；在真实极端事件中，成功恢复了已知因果驱动（如热带风暴Debby的地形涡度、太平洋西北热浪的异常海洋表面通量），并量化了各驱动因子的相对贡献。
Conclusion: 因果追踪可作为高效的数据驱动框架，用于综合因果证据并生成可验证假设，补充关联分析和数值建模，加速高影响事件研究。

papers.title: Robustly Invertible Nonlinear Dynamics and the BiLipREN: From Inversion-Based Control to Generative Trajectory Modelling
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a new notion of robust invertibility for nonlinear dynamical systems, and introduces constructive parameterizations of recurrent neural network which are robustly invertible by design. We define robust invertibility as the existence of a causal inverse system such that both the forward and inverse systems are contracting and have bounded incremental input-output gains (the system is bi-Lipschitz), implying that both forward prediction and input reconstruction are robust to signal perturbations and initial-state mismatch. We construct robustly invertible recurrent models via series composition of static orthogonal layers and dynamic layers satisfying a strong input-output monotonicity property, and provide a differentiable neural network parameterizations in the form of the bi-Lipschitz recurrent equilibrium network (BiLipREN). Additionally, composition with dynamic orthogonal layers yields a nonlinear minimum-phase/all-pass (a.k.a. inner--outer) factorization. We illustrate the utility of the framework through a series of application examples in data-driven internal model control, dynamic surrogate loss learning, and signal-space normalizing flows, illustrating its utility for robust control, trajectory optimization, and generative modeling of complex trajectory distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了非线性动力系统的鲁棒可逆性概念，并构建了具有双Lipschitz性质的循环均衡网络（BiLipREN），该网络通过设计保证前向和逆向映射均具有收缩性和有界增量增益。网络由静态正交层和满足强输入-输出单调性的动态层串联构成，并支持非线性最小相位/全通分解。应用包括数据驱动内模控制、动态代理损失学习和信号空间归一化流，展示了在鲁棒控制、轨迹优化和复杂轨迹生成建模中的潜力。
Motivation: 现有非线性动力系统模型在逆系统构建中缺乏鲁棒性保证，导致前向预测和输入重构对扰动与初始状态偏差敏感。需要一种可构造的神经网络参数化，同时保证正逆系统的收缩性与有界输入输出增益。
Method: 定义了鲁棒可逆性：存在因果逆系统使得正逆系统均收缩且具有有界增量增益（双Lipschitz）。通过串联满足强输入-输出单调性的动态层与静态正交层，构建了BiLipREN网络。进一步，组合动态正交层实现了非线性最小相位/全通分解。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但通过数据驱动内模控制、动态代理损失学习和信号空间归一化流等应用示例，展示了框架在鲁棒控制、轨迹优化和生成建模中的实用效果。
Conclusion: 作者认为BiLipREN为鲁棒可逆非线性动力学提供了可微分的神经网络参数化，并扩展了从逆控制到生成轨迹建模的应用场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Local Multimodal Music Alignment from Global Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Understanding music requires understanding localized relationships across data modalities, e.g., how time in performance audio maps onto position in a score image. Yet supervision for such local correspondences is difficult to obtain-in practice, we often only have access to coarser global supervision like paired segments of audio and images. To address this gap, we propose FuSiLi (Fused Sinkhorn-Localized Similarity), a similarity score for multimodal contrastive learning operating directly on local image patch and audio frame features via Sinkhorn-based soft alignment. We show that FuSiLi (i) effectively learns local relationships, (ii) requires only global supervision, and (iii) retains the global alignment capabilities of conventional contrastive approaches. We fine-tune pretrained CLIP and CLAP encoders on pairs of raw sheet music images and audio using a hybrid contrastive objective combining FuSiLi with conventional global similarity. We evaluate on cross-modal retrieval and frame-level alignment tasks against a range of global and local baselines, showing that our approach outperforms them on local alignment while remaining competitive on retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FuSiLi (Fused Sinkhorn-Localized Similarity)，一种用于多模态对比学习的相似度分数，通过 Sinkhorn 软对齐直接操作局部图像块和音频帧特征，仅需全局监督即可学习局部对应关系。在乐谱图像和音频对上的实验表明，FuSiLi 在帧级对齐任务上优于现有方法，在跨模态检索上保持竞争力。
Motivation: 音乐分析需要跨模态的局部关系理解（如音频时间到乐谱位置），但局部对应监督难以获取，通常仅有全局配对的音视频段。现有对比学习方法无法有效学习局部对齐。
Method: 混合对比目标：结合 FuSiLi（基于 Sinkhorn 的局部相似度）与常规全局相似度，微调预训练的 CLIP 和 CLAP 编码器，在乐谱图像和音频对上进行训练。
Result: 在跨模态检索和帧级对齐任务上，FuSiLi 在局部对齐性能上超越全局和局部基线，在检索任务上与基线相当。
Conclusion: FuSiLi 证明了仅凭全局监督即可有效学习局部多模态对齐，同时不牺牲全局对齐能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Symbolic Neural CPU for Quantization-Simulated Writeback and Interpretable Program Execution
authors: Jose Luis Lima de Jesus Silva
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks can learn algorithmic input-output mappings, but trusting a learned executor requires more than a correct final answer because the state transitions that produce it are usually hidden. To make those transitions visible, we introduce a trace-supervised symbolic neural CPU, a factorized learned execution architecture that combines recurrent control, an explicit operation router over a fixed differentiable arithmetic-logic unit bank, destination-masked register writeback, complete trajectory supervision and matched fixed-point replay. The model exposes the selected operation, source and destination registers, register trajectory, memory signals and writeback semantics at every step. On the principal 16-wide benchmark, the non-quantized executor reproduces reference execution exactly, while the eight-bit quantization-simulated executor preserves the symbolic operation path through programs of 1,000 instructions. When the same execution is evaluated against a matched fixed-point replay, the residual numerical drift disappears, showing that it comes from a mismatch between continuous and low-precision reference semantics rather than from execution failure. We compare recurrent, Transformer, temporal-convolution, temporal graph-inspired and state-space controllers, and the ablations show that operation-gate supervision is necessary for an inspectable execution path. Hidden-opcode memory-pressure tasks expose the remaining limits in delayed state use and temporal binding. We also extend the interface with ValueMemory, hybrid adaptive leaky integrate-and-fire controllers, candidate-constrained symbolic control trained through behaviour cloning and actor-critic reinforcement learning, and an RV32I base-integer semantic bridge. Together, these results establish a trace-verifiable framework for interpretable, low-precision and controllable neural execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种迹监督的符号神经CPU（trace-supervised symbolic neural CPU），通过分解的神经网络架构（循环控制、显式操作路由器、可微算术逻辑单元库、目标掩码写回等）实现可解释的程序执行。模型在每个步骤暴露操作、寄存器、内存信号等。在16宽度基准上，非量化执行器完全精确，8位量化模拟执行器在1000条指令的程序上保持符号操作路径。与固定点回放对比时数值漂移消失。消融表明操作门监督（operation-gate supervision）对于可检查的执行路径是必要的。还扩展了值内存、混合自适应漏积分控制器、候选约束符号控制等。建立了可迹验证的可解释低精度神经执行框架。
Motivation: 神经网络学习算法映射时，隐藏的状态转换使得信任其执行结果困难。需要使这些转换可见。
Method: 提出迹监督的符号神经CPU架构，包括循环控制器、显式操作路由器（over固定可微ALU库）、目标掩码寄存器写回、完整轨迹监督和匹配的定点回放。
Result: 非量化执行器在16宽度基准上完全精确；8位量化模拟执行器在1000指令程序上保持符号操作路径。数值漂移通过匹配定点回放消失。消融显示操作门监督是必要的。
Conclusion: 建立了迹可验证的框架，用于可解释、低精度、可控的神经执行。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robust, Scalable Detection of Text Containment in Large Web-Crawled Corpora
papers.abstract_en: We present FindMyText, an open-source Python package designed to efficiently assess whether a given text appears, in part or in full, within a text corpus. The tool builds on prior techniques for document fingerprinting, but extends them with a novel mechanism to explicitly capture sequences of matching fingerprints. By identifying such chains, the tool can more reliably detect near-verbatim copies of a given text rather than mere textual similarities. This makes FindMyText particularly suited for verifying the presence of copyrighted material in a corpus. Leveraging a distributed, disk-based indexing framework, the system scales to large web-crawled datasets. Using a new benchmark for evaluating text containment methods, we show that FindMyText outperforms alternative approaches across three datasets (ArXiv papers, Wikipedia, and generic web content).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍FindMyText，一个开源Python包，用于高效评估给定文本是否部分或全部出现在大型语料库中。该工具基于文档指纹技术，但通过捕获匹配指纹的序列来更可靠地检测近乎逐字复制的内容，而非仅仅文本相似性。利用分布式磁盘索引，可扩展到网络爬取数据集。在新基准上，FindMyText在三个数据集（ArXiv论文、维基百科、通用网页内容）上优于其他方法。
Motivation: 现有文本包含检测方法可能混淆近似复制与真正的逐字包含，且难以扩展到大型网络爬取语料库。
Method: 扩展文档指纹技术，提出显式捕获匹配指纹序列的机制，从而更可靠地检测文本包含，并采用分布式磁盘索引框架实现可扩展性。
Result: 在新基准上，FindMyText在ArXiv论文、维基百科和通用网页内容三个数据集上均优于其他方法。
Conclusion: FindMyText提供了一种可扩展的、鲁棒的文本包含检测方法，特别适用于验证版权材料在语料库中的存在。

papers.title: Tokenizing Numerical and Embedding Features for LLM RecSys
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as backbone architectures for recommender systems because of their strong sequence modeling and representation learning capabilities. However, most LLM-based recommenders operate primarily on discrete textual tokens, whereas practical recommendation pipelines also rely on continuous numerical features and dense embedding features produced by upstream feature engineering or pretrained encoders. This mismatch limits the ability of LLM-based models to exploit fine-grained non-textual signals. We propose a soft-token fusion framework that maps numerical and embedding features into the LLM embedding space, allowing heterogeneous recommendation signals to be consumed through the standard token interface. We instantiate the framework in a shared-parameter LLM-based two-tower retrieval model and introduce an interaction-based fusion module that refines embedding and numerical soft tokens before they are inserted into the final LLM input. Experiments on three Amazon recommendation benchmarks show that soft-token fusion improves retrieval performance over LLM-based baselines, and that interaction-based fusion is more effective than direct concatenation of heterogeneous soft tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种软令牌融合框架，将连续数值特征和密集嵌入特征映射到LLM嵌入空间，使LLM能够处理非文本信号。在共享参数的LLM双塔检索模型上实现，并引入基于交互的融合模块。实验表明，软令牌融合提升了检索性能。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的推荐系统主要处理离散文本令牌，而实际推荐流程依赖连续数值特征和嵌入特征，导致细粒度非文本信号无法被利用。
Method: 提出软令牌融合框架，将数值和嵌入特征映射到LLM嵌入空间，并通过交互式融合模块精炼后再插入LLM输入。实例化为共享参数的LLM双塔检索模型。
Result: 在三个亚马逊推荐基准上，软令牌融合提升了检索性能，且交互式融合优于直接拼接。
Conclusion: 该方法使LLM能够利用非文本信号提升推荐系统性能。

summary_sections.result: 在三个亚马逊推荐基准上，软令牌融合提升了检索性能，且交互式融合优于直接拼接。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法使LLM能够利用非文本信号提升推荐系统性能。

papers.title: Runtime Safety Filtering for Learned Small UAS Separation Policies under GNSS Degradation
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based separation assurance for small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (sUAS) achieves near-zero collision rates in simulation, but assumes accurate position and velocity information from Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS). This assumption fails in urban environments, where multipath propagation, signal blockage, and intentional interference degrade navigation integrity. This raises a fundamental architectural question for deploying learned separation policies under GNSS degradation: should runtime safety mechanisms filter the policy's actions or its observations? This work evaluates both approaches for multi-agent sUAS separation under adversarial GNSS degradation. Both architectures first estimate a worst-case traffic state consistent with bounded observation uncertainty, then diverge: action filtering constrains policy outputs via discrete-time control barrier functions evaluated at the worst-case state, while observation filtering presents the worst-case state directly to the policy as corrected input. Experimental results show that action filtering provides negligible safety improvement, while observation filtering reduces near mid-air collisions by 90% and remains robust to the barrier function's tradeoff between separation distance and closing rate. These results suggest that, for policies with learned safety behaviors, preserving the policy's decision authority outperforms overriding its actions with hand-designed constraints.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE/AIAA Digital Avionics Systems Conference (DASC). 9 pages, 8 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对小型无人机系统（sUAS）在GNSS信号降级环境下的安全间隔保持问题，比较了两种运行时安全过滤架构：动作过滤（action filtering）和观测过滤（observation filtering）。实验表明，动作过滤几乎无安全提升，而观测过滤可将近距碰撞（near mid-air collisions）减少90%，且对屏障函数的设计参数具有鲁棒性。结论是保留学习策略的决策权优于手工设计的动作约束。
Motivation: 学习型间隔保持策略在模拟中接近零碰撞，但依赖准确的GNSS位置和速度信息；城市环境中的多径、信号遮挡和干扰会破坏导航完整性，因此需要运行时安全机制，但架构选择（过滤动作还是观测）尚未明确。
Method: 两种架构均先估计与有界观测不确定性一致的最坏情况交通状态，随后分岔：动作过滤使用离散时间控制屏障函数（discrete-time control barrier functions）在最坏状态约束策略输出；观测过滤则将最坏状态直接作为修正输入传递给策略。
Result: 在对抗性GNSS降级的多智能体sUAS间隔保持实验中，动作过滤带来的安全改善可忽略，而观测过滤将近距碰撞降低90%，并对屏障函数在分离距离与接近速率之间的折衷保持鲁棒。
Conclusion: 对于已学习安全行为（learned safety behaviors）的策略，保留其决策权优于用手工设计的约束覆盖其动作。

papers.title: Manifold Constrained Conformal Prediction for Spatial Events
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a new conformal prediction method that constructs calibrated prediction sets over collections of spatial events, such as tropical cyclone genesis and earthquake locations. Forecasting natural hazards has become increasingly important, due to their significant economic impact, and quantifying the uncertainty of predictions is critical for accurate risk assessment. Our approach works by representing spatial point clouds as empirical measures so that we can score them using (sliced) Wasserstein distance, then constraining the resulting distribution-valued prediction set to be supported only near the training data manifold. We derive a coverage lower bound for the intersected sets and show that, in practice, this gap can be made small through a simple data-adaptive selection criterion. Because the resulting set is not analytically tractable, we introduce a modified flow-based sampling procedure, which allows us to represent and apply these prediction sets in practice as ensembles. Numerical experiments on synthetic data, tropical cyclone genesis, and earthquake occurrences show that our method achieves near-nominal coverage, with significantly lower energy distance and manifold distance than highest predictive density region (HDR) baselines along with generative model baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向空间事件（如热带气旋生成、地震发生）的保形预测方法，通过将空间点云表示为经验测度，利用（切片）Wasserstein距离评分，并将预测集约束在训练数据流形附近。理论推导了交集覆盖下界，并设计数据自适应准则使之很小；实际应用中采用基于流的修正采样过程生成预测集。在合成数据、热带气旋和地震数据上的实验表明，该方法达到近名义覆盖率，且能量距离和流形距离显著低于最高概率密度区域（HDR）基线和生成模型基线。
Motivation: 自然灾害预测对风险评估至关重要，但现有保形预测方法难以处理空间事件集合（如点云）的不确定性量化，且预测集往往过于保守或与数据分布不一致。
Method: 将空间点云视为经验测度，用（切片）Wasserstein距离评分；构建保形预测集后，将其与训练数据流形约束相交，推导覆盖下界；并通过数据自适应准则选择阈值使覆盖间隙变小；最后引入基于流的采样过程表示实际预测集。
Result: 在合成数据、热带气旋生成和地震发生任务上，该方法达到接近名义水平的覆盖概率，且能量距离和流形距离显著低于HDR基线和生成模型基线。
Conclusion: 该方法为空间事件集合提供了一种校准且紧致的预测集，尤其适合需要精确不确定性量化的自然灾害风险评估场景。

papers.title: Model Guides You How to Draw: Adaptive Visual Gating for Unified Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) with interleaved reasoning, which generate both textual and visual steps as part of intermediate reasoning traces, have demonstrated great potential for visual mathematical reasoning tasks. However, we identify a key insight in this paradigm: generating intermediate visual reasoning steps is not always beneficial and can even be harmful, as self-generated visual steps may introduce erroneous visual evidence that misleads subsequent reasoning. Moreover, frequently triggering visual steps during reasoning incurs substantial computational and memory overhead, degrading inference efficiency. To address these accuracy and efficiency challenges, we observe that the model's internal signals can indicate whether a visual step will benefit reasoning before the entire visual generation is completed. Specifically, this work identifies two internal signals: 1) Generation Intent, which reflects whether the model has a concrete textual plan for what to draw, and 2) Visual Fidelity, which measures whether the visual generation remains grounded in the original input image. Leveraging these internal signals, we propose AdaViG, a training-free adaptive visual gating method for unified multimodal reasoning. AdaViG dynamically evaluates each triggered visual step at an early visual generation stage and aborts it when both signals are weak, thereby preventing misleading visual evidence from entering the reasoning trace while avoiding unnecessary computation. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that AdaViG improves accuracy by up to 5.7% while reducing visual generation FLOPs by 25.0%-91.0% and wall-clock latency by 15.4%-45.6%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）在交错的推理中生成文本和视觉步骤，但视觉步骤不一定总是有益，甚至可能引入误导。本文发现模型内部信号（生成意图和视觉保真度）可以在视觉生成完成前指示其是否有益，并提出AdaViG，一种无需训练的自适应视觉门控方法，在早期阶段动态评估每个视觉步骤，当两个信号弱时中止它，从而防止误导并减少计算。实验表明，准确率最高提升5.7%，视觉生成FLOPs减少25%-91%，延迟降低15.4%-45.6%。
Motivation: 现有UMMs中生成中间视觉推理步骤可能引入错误视觉证据，误导后续推理，且频繁触发视觉步骤带来计算和内存开销。
Method: 提出AdaViG，基于两个内部信号（生成意图和视觉保真度）的自适应视觉门控方法，在视觉生成早期阶段评估并决定是否中止视觉步骤。
Result: 准确率提升最高5.7%，视觉生成FLOPs减少25.0%-91.0%，延迟降低15.4%-45.6%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法无需训练，通过内部信号动态门控，在提升准确性的同时大幅降低计算开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Silent Failures in Quantized LLM Reasoning: A Taxonomy-Based Analysis of Hollow Convergence and Failure Mode Shifts
papers.abstract_en: We show that post-training quantization can silently alter how large language models reason even when task accuracy is preserved. Using a six-category failure taxonomy validated by two independent human annotators (Cohen's $κ$ = 0.906), we classify 30,000 chain-of-thought outputs from five instruction-tuned LLMs (3B--14B parameters) across three quantization precisions (FP32, FP16, NF4) and four reasoning benchmarks. We find that while accuracy is robust across precisions (maximum 3.1 pp drop), Hollow Convergence (correct answers reached through incomplete or unverifiable reasoning) shows a significant size-dependent shift under NF4, dropping sharply for the two smallest models tested but remaining invariant for models at 12B parameters and above. This effect is also benchmark-specific: GSM8K is categorically immune while LogiQA and ARC-Challenge show the largest shifts. Furthermore, under NF4, Shortcut Collapse rises from 44% to 78% of wrong-answer failures in LLaMA 3.2-3B while Confidence Snowballing collapses from 15.8% to near zero, a qualitative shift invisible to accuracy metrics. Finally, we show Hollow Convergence cannot be reliably detected from surface-level text features (best F1 = 0.53), establishing it as a deployment-relevant failure mode that standard evaluation pipelines cannot catch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究后训练量化如何静默地改变大语言模型的推理过程，即使任务准确率保持稳定。通过六类失败模式分类法（人工标注者一致性κ=0.906），对30,000个链式思维输出进行分类，发现NF4量化下小型模型出现空心收敛（正确但不可靠的推理）和失败模式转变（如捷径崩溃增加、信心雪球减少），且标准评估无法检测这些变化。
Motivation: 现有量化方法仅关注准确率，但可能改变模型推理的可靠性，导致静默失败（如空心收敛），而此类问题无法被传统评估指标捕捉。
Method: 提出六类失败模式分类法，由两名独立人工标注者验证（Cohen's κ=0.906），对5个指令微调LLM（3B-14B参数）在FP32、FP16、NF4三种精度下进行30,000个chain-of-thought输出分类，覆盖四个推理基准。
Result: 准确率最多下降3.1个百分点，但NF4下空心收敛在小型模型中显著下降（规模依赖），GSM8K免疫，LogiQA和ARC-Challenge变化最大；NF4下捷径崩溃从44%升至78%，信心雪球从15.8%降至近零。
Conclusion: 空心收敛无法从表面文本特征可靠检测（最佳F1=0.53），是标准评估无法捕捉的部署相关失败模式。

papers.title: Vilya-1: An all-atom foundation model for macrocycle structure prediction and design
papers.abstract_en: Macrocyclic peptides are an increasingly important therapeutic modality, but existing computational methods for modeling their structures and properties are limited in scope and do not generalize well across the synthetically accessible chemical space. In this work, we introduce Vilya-1, a deep learning model that addresses two central challenges in macrocycle design: sampling biologically relevant conformations across arbitrary chemistries and predicting key developability properties such as membrane permeability. Vilya-1 operates on a uniform all-atom representation and is trained on heterogeneous structural datasets spanning diverse topologies and chemical classes. Across a broad set of macrocycles composed of canonical and non-canonical residues, Vilya-1 substantially improves geometric accuracy relative to physics-based methods, co-folding networks, and deep-learning conformer generators, while maintaining broad chemical coverage that extends to small molecules. Vilya-1 also supports generative applications, enabling the design of novel macrocycles with tailored chemical, structural, and property profiles. Together, these capabilities establish Vilya-1 as a foundation model for accelerating the development of next-generation macrocycle therapeutics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍Vilya-1，一个基于全原子表示的深度学习模型，用于大环肽的结构预测和设计。该模型在多种化学拓扑和类别上训练，相比物理方法、共折叠网络和深度学习方法，提高了几何准确性，并支持生成设计。
Motivation: 现有计算方法在大环肽建模中范围有限，不能很好地推广到合成可及的化学空间。
Method: Vilya-1采用统一的全原子表示，在异构结构数据集上训练，覆盖多种拓扑和化学类别。
Result: 在包含规范和非规范残基的大环肽上，Vilya-1在几何准确性上显著优于物理方法、共折叠网络和深度学习构象生成器，同时保持广泛的化学覆盖。
Conclusion: Vilya-1作为基础模型，可以加速下一代大环肽治疗药物的开发。
