papers.title: Who&When Pro: Can LLMs Really Attribute Failures in AI Agents?
papers.abstract_en: Automated failure attribution uses LLMs to identify where and why agentic systems fail. As agents become more capable, their failures become subtler, making automated attribution increasingly important. We introduce Who&When Pro, a large-scale benchmark for automated failure attribution in agentic systems. Using a strictly controlled pipeline that injects a failure only after exactly replaying a successful prefix, we construct 12,326 failed trajectories with golden labels across 3 modalities and 26 benchmarks covering various scenarios. Beyond benchmarking, we conduct extensive experiments and analyses, revealing systematic patterns in how models attribute failures across modalities, protocols, and model families, and providing empirical guidance for future automated failure attribution systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Who&When Pro 基准，用于自动化归因 AI 智能体系统中的故障。通过严格控制的流水线注入故障，构建了 12,326 条带标签的失败轨迹，涵盖 3 种模态和 26 个基准。实验揭示了模型在归因故障时的系统性模式。
Motivation: 随着 AI 智能体能力增强，其故障更加微妙，自动化故障归因变得重要，但缺乏大规模标准基准。
Method: 设计严格控制的流水线，先精确重放成功前缀，再在固定点注入故障，从而生成带黄金标签的失败轨迹，构建多模态基准 Who&When Pro。
Result: 构建了包含 12,326 条轨迹的基准，覆盖 3 种模态和 26 个场景；实验发现不同模型系列、模态和协议下故障归因存在系统性差异。
Conclusion: 该基准和实证分析为未来自动化故障归因系统提供了指导。

papers.title: Beyond Bayesian Nash: Learning Minimax-Regret Equilibria for Adversarial Team Games under Asymmetric Information
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial team games (ATGs) with asymmetric information, such as adversarial path-finding, goal search, and reachability games on graphs, require strategies that are robust to hidden opponent types, such as a hidden goal flag, and to deception. Under asymmetric information, deception is seen as strategic shifts in the type distribution such that the omniscient opponent can collude with Nature and condition its play on the observed type. Existing risk-neutral solution concepts, such as Bayesian Nash equilibrium (BNE), are sensitive to distribution shifts, while distributionally robust approaches provide guarantees only within a prescribed ambiguity set. To address these limitations, we introduce Probabilistically Robust Minimax-Regret Equilibrium (PR-MRE), a novel equilibrium concept that combines the distribution-free robustness of minimax-regret reasoning with probabilistic information from a nominal type distribution. PR-MRE minimizes worst-case regret over a high-confidence subset of the type space, providing protection against strategic redistribution of probability mass while avoiding the conservatism of fully distribution-free approaches. We show that, for normal-form Bayesian games, PR-MRE can be formulated as a robust bilinear program and derive a tractable semidefinite relaxation. We then adapt this relaxation into a novel meta-solver within a robust double-oracle framework, PRMRE-PSRO, enabling population-based learning of approximate PR-MRE strategies via deep reinforcement learning best responses. Experiments on graph-structured adversarial team games demonstrate that PR-MRE discovers strategies with substantially improved worst-case performance across hidden types compared to risk-neutral equilibrium solutions, resulting in more robust behavior under strategic distribution shifts.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 11 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对不对称信息下的对抗性团队博弈（Adversarial Team Games），提出概率鲁棒最小最大后悔均衡（PR-MRE），该概念结合了minimax-regret的分布无关鲁棒性与名义类型分布的概率信息，通过半定松弛和鲁棒双Oracle框架（PRMRE-PSRO）实现可计算学习。实验表明，在图结构对抗团队博弈中，PR-MRE相比风险中性均衡策略在隐藏类型上显著改善了最坏情况性能。
Motivation: 现有风险中性均衡（如Bayesian Nash Equilibrium）对分布变化敏感，而分布鲁棒方法过于保守。需要一种解概念，既能利用概率信息，又能对抗对手通过策略性重分配概率质量造成的分布偏移。
Method: 引入Probabilistically Robust Minimax-Regret Equilibrium (PR-MRE)，最小化类型空间高置信子集上的最坏情况遗憾。将其形式化为鲁棒双线性规划，推导出可解的半定松弛，并进一步将该松弛纳入鲁棒双Oracle框架PRMRE-PSRO，利用深度强化学习最佳响应进行群体学习。
Result: 在图结构对抗团队博弈的实验中，PR-MRE策略在隐藏类型上显著改善了最坏情况性能，相比风险中性均衡策略表现出更强的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: PR-MRE通过结合minimax-regret与概率信息，在不过度保守的前提下提升了对抗性团队博弈的鲁棒性。

papers.title: An LLM-powered Agentic Recommendation System for Connected TV Content Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Recommendation systems, from traditional multi-stage to recent unified generative architectures, face challenges in incorporating diverse contextual signals, such as trending topics, breaking news, cultural events, and cross-surface user activities, into their ranking pipelines. These systems are designed to consume structured behavioral signals with consistent schemas, and lack the reasoning capability to naturally process unstructured or heterogeneously formatted contextual information. Incorporating such signals typically requires feature engineering, bespoke data pipelines, and carefully tuned heuristics. In this paper, we present an LLM-powered agentic recommendation system designed for Connected TV (CTV) content discovery that addresses these limitations. Our system leverages the reasoning capabilities of large language models to naturally process and synthesize diverse signals across varying schemas and structures, eliminating much of the manual integration inherent in traditional ranking and retrieval systems. Recognizing that current LLM-based solutions still fall short of traditional machine learning models in several recommendation tasks, including retrieval efficiency, personalization precision, and scalability, we adopt an agentic architecture that orchestrates specialized components, allowing each sub-task to be handled by the most suitable method, whether LLM-based or traditional ML. The main contribution of this work is our engineering approach to successfully overcoming the practical limitations of enabling LLM for recommendation, particularly inference latency. We share insights from our work and discuss the trade-offs and lessons learned in building a hybrid system that combines the flexibility of LLMs with the performance of established recommendation techniques.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文提出一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体推荐系统，用于联网电视（CTV）内容发现。该系统利用LLM的推理能力处理不同模式的上下文信号，同时采用智能体架构将子任务分配给最适合的方法（LLM或传统ML），以解决传统推荐系统难以整合非结构化信息的问题。
Motivation: 传统推荐系统依赖特征工程和手工规则，难以自然整合诸如流行趋势、新闻事件等非结构化上下文信息，而当前LLM解决方案在检索效率、个性化精度和可扩展性上仍不如传统模型。
Method: 采用智能体架构，将LLM用于理解和融合异构上下文信号，同时将检索、个性化排序等子任务交由传统ML模型或LLM处理，以最大化各自优势并缓解LLM推理延迟。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验指标，主要贡献为克服LLM应用于推荐时的工程挑战，特别是推理延迟，并分享了混合系统的构建经验与权衡。
Conclusion: 作者强调该工程方法成功结合了LLM的灵活性与传统推荐技术的性能，并讨论了实际部署中的折中考虑。

papers.title: UniPose9D: Universal Category-Agnostic Object Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Object pose estimation is a fundamental problem in 3D vision. Although recent state-of-the-art approaches achieve strong performance, they often overfit to existing benchmarks and exhibit limited generalization to novel categories and unseen scenes. We propose UniPose9D, a category-agnostic foundation model for 9D object pose estimation: given an instance mask/ROI and either an RGB-D observation or an RGB image with predicted depth, the model estimates rotation, translation, and metric size without category labels, CAD models, mean-shape priors, or reference views. Specifically, UniPose9D samples point pairs from the observed object geometry and uses DINOv2 and PointNet features to predict NOCS coordinates for each pair. To improve accuracy, we introduce a point-pair-based RANSAC N-hop Kabsch--Umeyama algorithm with an adaptive threshold. We further employ flow matching to address symmetric ambiguities and construct a large-scale training set by curating and aligning pose annotations from existing public datasets. Experiments across six datasets show that a single unified model can match or surpass specialist methods while generalizing to unseen objects and in-the-wild scenarios. Our code and model are available on https://github.com/qq456cvb/UniPose9D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniPose9D，一种类别无关的物体姿态估计基础模型，无需类别标签、CAD模型或参考视图，即可从RGB-D或RGB图像中估计物体的旋转、平移和度量尺寸。模型通过点对采样、DINOv2和PointNet特征预测NOCS坐标，并引入点对RANSAC N跳Kabsch-Umeyama算法和流匹配处理对称模糊。在六个数据集上，单个统一模型可匹配或超越专有方法，并泛化到未见物体和野外场景。
Motivation: 现有物体姿态估计方法在现有基准上过拟合，对未见类别和场景泛化能力有限，且依赖类别标签、CAD模型等先验信息。
Method: 提出UniPose9D：从点对采样预测NOCS坐标，结合DINOv2和PointNet特征；引入点对RANSAC N跳Kabsch-Umeyama算法和流匹配解决对称性模糊；使用大规模训练集整合对齐现有公开数据。
Result: 在六个数据集上，单个模型匹配或超越专有方法，并泛化到未见物体和野外场景。
Conclusion: 类别无关的物体姿态估计基础模型可减少对先验信息的依赖，实现跨类别的泛化，但未提及其他方面的局限性。

papers.title: Multimodal Routing for Interpretable, Robust, and Auditable Clinical Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Electronic health record (EHR) data are inherently multimodal, and leveraging multiple modalities can improve predictive performance. However, most existing approaches rely on deep fusion, which obscures how individual modalities contribute to predictions and limits the interpretability of multimodal reasoning. We propose an explicit multimodal routing framework for clinical prediction that enables interpretable, robust, and auditable reasoning across three EHR modalities: structured longitudinal variables (L), clinical notes (N), and chest X-rays (I). Our model constructs discrete unimodal, directional bimodal, and trimodal routes to capture both individual modality signals and asymmetric cross-modal interactions. To audit multimodal reasoning and assess robustness, we introduce inference-time route masking, which simulates missing modalities and reweights the remaining routes without retraining. We analyze changes in performance and routing weights under these scenarios to understand model decision-making. We evaluate our framework on multi-label phenotype prediction (K = 25) and binary ICU mortality prediction using trimodal patient stays from MIMIC-IV, revealing systematic differences in modality reliance across clinical condition groups. Overall, our framework offers a transparent, auditable, and practical approach to multimodal clinical prediction, providing interpretability, robustness, and insights into how different data sources drive model decisions.
papers.comment: Accepted at CHASE 2026. 12 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个显式多模态路由框架，用于临床预测任务，利用三种EHR模态（结构化纵向变量、临床笔记、胸部X光片）。通过构造离散单模态、双向双模态和三模态路由，并结合推理时路由掩码技术，实现可解释、鲁棒且可审计的多模态推理。在MIMIC-IV数据集上的多标签表型预测和二元ICU死亡率预测实验中，揭示了不同临床条件组对模态依赖的系统性差异。
Motivation: 现有EHR多模态方法多依赖深度融合，掩盖了各模态对预测的独立贡献，限制了可解释性和多模态推理的可审计性。
Method: 构建显式多模态路由框架，定义离散的单模态、双向双模态和三模态路径，并以推理时路由掩码模拟缺失模态，重新加权剩余路径以评估鲁棒性。
Result: 在MIMIC-IV数据集的多标签表型预测（K=25）和ICU死亡率预测上，该方法表现出可解释性并揭示了不同疾病组对模态依赖的差异。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架提供了一种透明、可审计且实用的多模态临床预测方法，可提升可解释性和鲁棒性，并深入理解各数据源对决策的贡献。

papers.title: Inverse-IMPRESSION: A Graph-based Platform for Molecular Structure Elucidation from Experimental NMR Spectroscopic Properties
papers.abstract_en: Here, we present a platform built on our inverted Graph Transformer Network, IMPRESSION-G2, which can accurately and rapidly reconstruct molecular bonding directly from experimental nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopic information. It comprises three interconnected stages: a one-shot model that predicts bond connectivity between atoms; a structure-correction stage that corrects the predicted structures by removing uncertain bonds and iteratively reassigning them; noise-augmented multi-shot prediction, generating an ensemble of candidate structures, which are ranked to identify the best-fit structure. By integrating a range of $^{1}$H and $^{13}$C NMR data, including two-dimensional (2D) experiments such as COSY, HSQC, and HMBC, the inverse-IMPRESSION platform correctly identifies the structures of 77.8% of molecules with up to 30 heavy atoms (H, C, N, O and F) using simulated NMR data, and 10 of 19 (53%) molecules using experimental NMR data. The experimental structures solved have molecular weights of up to 480 Da and are representative of the complex structures in synthetic and natural products that routinely challenge chemists. The inverse-IMPRESSION framework thus provides the first effective approach for automated molecular structure elucidation using graph-based machine learning on experimental data.
papers.comment: 15-page manuscript (4 figures), plus 59 pages of Supporting Information (45 figures); Submitted to the Journal of the American Chemical Society
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于逆图变换网络（IMPRESSION-G2）的平台inverse-IMPRESSION，用于从实验核磁共振（NMR）光谱数据中快速重建分子结构。该平台包括单步预测、结构校正和噪声增强多步预测三个阶段，利用1H和13C NMR数据及二维实验（COSY, HSQC, HMBC）。在模拟NMR数据上，对最多30个重原子（H, C, N, O, F）的分子正确识别率达77.8%；在实验NMR数据上，对19个分子中10个（53%）正确解析，分子量最高达480 Da。
Motivation: 传统的分子结构解析依赖化学家手动解析NMR谱图，耗时且复杂，尤其对于合成和天然产物中的复杂结构。缺乏一个自动化的、基于图机器学习的有效方法直接处理实验数据。
Method: 提出inverse-IMPRESSION平台，包含三个互连阶段：1) 单步模型预测原子间键连接；2) 结构校正阶段，通过移除不确定键并迭代重新分配来修正预测结构；3) 噪声增强的多步预测，生成候选结构集合并排序以选出最佳结构。核心是逆图变换网络IMPRESSION-G2，集成多种NMR实验数据。
Result: 在模拟NMR数据上，对含最多30个重原子的分子正确识别率达77.8%；在实验NMR数据上，19个分子中正确解析10个（53%），分子量最高480 Da，涵盖了合成和天然产物中的复杂结构。
Conclusion: 该平台首次提供了基于图机器学习的自动化分子结构解析方法，并能有效处理实验NMR数据，有望帮助化学家加速结构鉴定。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一个基于逆图变换网络（IMPRESSION-G2）的平台inverse-IMPRESSION，用于从实验核磁共振（NMR）光谱数据中快速重建分子结构。该平台包括单步预测、结构校正和噪声增强多步预测三个阶段，利用1H和13C NMR数据及二维实验（COSY, HSQC, HMBC）。在模拟NMR数据上，对最多30个重原子（H, C, N, O, F）的分子正确识别率达77.8%；在实验NMR数据上，对19个分子中10个（53%）正确解析，分子量最高达480 Da。

papers.title: A Production-Oriented Framework for Evaluation of SFX Generation
papers.abstract_en: Industrial sound design requires audio generation systems that not only produce realistic audio, but also preserve the perceptual identity of a reference, support controllable variation, and remain efficient for practical workflows. Existing evaluations are usually tied to text-to-audio (TTA), unconditional, or task-specific settings, limiting assessment for reference-guided sound effects (SFX) variation. To address this gap, we present a production-oriented evaluation framework for structured comparison of heterogeneous audio generation and editing methods. Our framework identifies nine production requirements and explicitly accounts for differences in model capabilities, enabling comparison under a common production objective. A two-stage protocol is introduced: (1) a reference-guided audio-to-audio (ATA) variation task, in which all methods are evaluated under the same ESC-50 SFX adaptation setup, and (2) capability-specific analyses of native operations such as SFX morphing, temporal and energy alignment, inpainting, and targeted editing. This framework combines objective metrics (including FAD, ImageBind-based reference alignment, and diversity across generated variants), together with a human study of perceptual identity preservation and transient diagnosis. Our study reveals complementary strengths and trade-offs across baselines for different production needs. Among the full-generation baselines evaluated under a shared ATA setting, AudioX provides the strongest overall trade-off between reference alignment and diversity while still supporting SFX morphing. Other baselines remain most suitable for specific editing operations. Our framework establishes a structured evaluation and decision protocol for reference-guided SFX variation and provides a practical basis for designing future unified industrial audio generation pipelines. Audio demos are on the accompanying web page.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个面向生产的音效生成评估框架，通过参考引导的音频到音频变体任务和特定能力分析（如音效变形、时间对齐、修补等），结合客观指标（FAD、ImageBind对齐度、多样性）和人工感知研究，系统比较了多种音频生成和编辑方法。研究表明AudioX在参考对齐和多样性之间提供了最佳折衷，其他基线更适合特定编辑操作。
Motivation: 现有音效生成评估大多局限于文本到音频、无条件或特定任务设置，缺乏针对参考引导音效变体的结构化比较框架，难以满足工业声音设计中对真实性、感知一致性、可控变化和效率的综合需求。
Method: 提出一个两阶段评估协议：第一阶段是参考引导的音频到音频变体任务，所有方法在ESC-50音效适应设置下统一评估；第二阶段是针对原生操作（如音效变形、时间/能量对齐、修补、定向编辑）的能力特定分析，结合FAD、ImageBind参考对齐、多样性等客观指标和人工感知研究。
Result: 在共享的音频到音频设置下，AudioX在参考对齐和多样性之间提供了最强的整体折衷，同时支持音效变形；其他基线在特定编辑操作上表现更优。
Conclusion: 该框架为参考引导的音效变体建立了结构化的评估与决策协议，为未来统一的工业音频生成流水线设计提供了实用基础。

papers.title: TopoExplore: Topological Discrimination for Archive-Based Exploration
papers.abstract_en: Archive-based exploration methods such as Go-Explore select which visited state to return to using visitation rarity, and frontier methods return to the boundary of the unknown; neither asks whether the unexplored region behind a boundary is enterable at all. Exploration is not just about finding reward - it is about collecting a structurally complete experience for downstream learning and planning. We introduce TopoExplore, which augments Go-Explore cell selection with a periodic topological pass: enclosed unexplored regions (voids) of the visited-set occupancy grid are detected by flood fill (the H1 classes of its cubical complex), and a decaying selection bonus is placed only on their strict entrances (gap or door cells), so sealed regions are never targeted and entered regions retire. On a controlled 18-environment MiniGrid suite (15 seeds, frozen hyperparameters) TopoExplore attains a 1.52x geometric-mean speedup in median steps-to-first-entry over its exact Go-Explore ablation, versus 1.37x for a frontier baseline; frontier exploration degrades when sealed decoy structure appears (0.83-1.48x on decoy environments vs. 1.65-2.11x for TopoExplore), while TopoExplore holds its largest win on hard multi-interaction doors (10.9x). We report an honest negative on Montezuma's Revenge - without wall knowledge, unreachable occupancy artifacts capture the bonus and performance degrades as it grows, isolating the wall-aware entrance test as the load-bearing component - and a preliminary positive on HM3D scanned buildings, where the speedup over Go-Explore tracks scene difficulty (r=0.69) even as frontier selection dominates blanket coverage. The evidence supports a deliberately scoped claim: topology-aware selection pays off where enclosed structure must be discriminated, and remains competitive at open coverage, where frontier methods are strongest, despite not being tuned for that regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TopoExplore，一种拓扑感知的存档探索方法，通过周期性的拓扑检测识别访问集占用网格中的封闭未探索区域（voids），并仅在其严格入口（gap/door cells）施加衰减选择奖励，避免瞄准密封区域。实验表明，在MiniGrid套件上TopoExplore相比Go-Explore消融实现1.52倍几何平均加速，在含密封诱饵结构的环境中优势更明显（1.65-2.11倍），而在蒙特祖玛的复仇因缺乏墙壁知识导致性能下降，在HM3D扫描建筑中加速与场景难度正相关（r=0.69）。
Motivation: 现有存档探索方法（如Go-Explore）仅根据访问稀有性选择状态，前沿方法只返回未知边界，两者均无法判断未探索区域是否可进入，导致探索不完整。
Method: 在Go-Explore的单元选择基础上增加周期性拓扑检测：通过洪泛填充计算访问集占用网格的H1类空洞，仅在其严格入口细胞上放置衰减选择奖励，使密封区域不被瞄准，已进入区域退休。
Result: 在18环境MiniGrid套件上，TopoExplore首次进入中位步骤几何平均加速1.52倍，优于前沿基线1.37倍；含密封诱饵结构环境下前沿退化至0.83-1.48倍，而TopoExplore保持1.65-2.11倍；硬多交互门环境加速达10.9倍。蒙特祖玛的复仇上因墙壁知识缺失导致性能下降；HM3D扫描建筑中加速与场景难度相关性r=0.69。
Conclusion: 拓扑感知选择在需要区分封闭结构时优势显著，且在开放覆盖区域（前沿方法最强）仍具竞争力，但依赖墙壁知识的准确获取。

papers.title: Learning in Curved Weight Space:Exponential-Linear Weight Reparameterization for Improved Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Many neural networks operations have a multiplicative nature rather than additive: halving or doubling a norm are analogous relatively but require unequal optimization distances when taking linear steps. Adaptive optimizers such as Adam normalize updates per coordinate, but update steps remain additive; weights with very different magnitudes receive similarly sized absolute changes, producing very different relative perturbations. We introduce \textbf{\method} (\textbf{\methodshort}), a weight reparameterization for neural networks that combines a sign-aware symmetric-exponential pathway with an identity-like linear pathway. The symmetric-exponential pathway is near-linear for small raw weights but increasingly curved at larger magnitudes. Additive updates in logarithmic space map to magnitude-proportional changes in effective weight space. The linear pathway provides a direct route through the transform that we hypothesize stabilizes optimization, while learnable scale, curvature, and offset parameters control balance between pathways and the curvature of the exponential pathway. These components create a curved parameter-space geometry that empirically improves speed of loss descent over standard linear parameterization. We also identify a useful \emph{mismatched initialization}: raw weights are chosen so a symmetric version of the transform matches Xavier statistics, but training uses an asymmetric forward transform that leaves positive weights at full strength while making negative weights smaller in magnitude; in small-model ablations, this improves early optimization and may act as a form of symmetry breaking. We train transformers on OpenWebText over nine width$\times$depth configurations, \methodshort reaches matched validation loss in 1.32--1.49$\times$ fewer training steps, with the largest widths seeing the biggest gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 Exponential-Linear Weight Reparameterization (ELWR) 的神经网络权重重参数化方法，将对称指数路径与线性路径结合，使加法更新在有效权重空间中产生与幅度成比例的变化，从而改进优化。实验表明，在多种宽度和深度的 Transformer 模型上，ELWR 在 OpenWebText 数据集上达到验证损失所需的训练步骤减少了 1.32-1.49 倍，越宽的模型收益越大。
Motivation: 标准优化中的加法更新对不同量级的权重产生相似的绝对变化，导致相对扰动不均，而许多神经网络操作本质上是乘性的。现有自适应优化器如 Adam 虽按坐标归一化，但更新仍为加法，未能解决权重幅度差异带来的优化不平衡问题。
Method: 引入 ELWR 重参数化，包含一个符号感知的对称指数路径（在小值时近似线性，大值时增加曲率）和一个恒等线性路径。对数空间中的加法更新映射到有效权重空间的幅度比例变化，同时线性路径提供直接梯度通道，可学习的尺度、曲率和偏移参数控制路径平衡及指数曲线的曲率。还提出一种"不匹配初始化"：原始权重设为对称变换匹配 Xavier 统计，但训练使用非对称前向变换（正权重大小不变，负权重幅度减小）以促进早期优化和对称破缺。
Result: 在 OpenWebText 上训练 9 种宽度×深度配置的 Transformer，ELWR 达到匹配验证损失所需的训练步骤减少至原来的 1/1.32 到 1/1.49，即减少了 1.32-1.49 倍，最宽模型收益最大。
Conclusion: ELWR 通过创建弯曲参数空间几何，在实证上加速了损失下降，尤其有利于宽网络，其不匹配初始化有助于早期优化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Workload-Driven Optimization for On-Device Real-Time Subtitle Translation
papers.abstract_en: This report studies on-device English-to-Traditional-Chinese subtitle translation for Taiwan under short inputs, short outputs, batch-size-one inference, low latency, and privacy constraints. These conditions limit the value of optimizations designed for long-context or high-throughput language-model serving. Starting from LMT-60-0.6B, preliminary profiling suggests that vocabulary projection becomes a more important decode-time cost after GGUF quantization reduces the relative cost of Transformer blocks. We replace the original 151k-token vocabulary with a 64k-token subtitle-domain tokenizer, migrate the embedding space, and adapt the model through embedding calibration followed by full supervised fine-tuning. On a fixed 500-example subset of the OpenSubtitles2024 test set, the LocalSubs achieves a 59.2% tie-excluded win rate against Google Translate under GPT-4o pairwise judging. Performance is strongest on short cues and declines as cue length increases. Preliminary Apple M2 Metal measurements on a 64k-vocabulary model show a 1.63$\times$ speedup over a 151k-vocabulary profiling baseline. The raw benchmark configuration is incomplete, so the latency result is treated as preliminary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了在短输入、短输出、单批次推理、低延迟和隐私约束下，设备端英语到繁体中文字幕翻译的优化。从LMT-60-0.6B模型出发，通过GGUF量化、词汇表缩减（从151k降至64k）以及嵌入空间迁移和微调，提出了LocalSubs系统。在OpenSubtitles2024测试集500个子集上，与Google Translate相比取得59.2%的胜率（平局排除），并在Apple M2上实现1.63倍加速。
Motivation: 现有长上下文或高吞吐量语言模型优化方法不适用于短输入短输出的实时字幕翻译场景，且隐私需求要求设备端推理。需要针对词汇投影等解码瓶颈进行专门优化。
Method: 从LMT-60-0.6B模型出发，使用GGUF量化降低Transformer块开销；设计64k词表替换原始151k词表；通过嵌入校准和监督微调迁移词嵌入空间。
Result: 在OpenSubtitles2024子集上，LocalSubs以59.2%的胜率优于Google Translate（平局排除）；Apple M2上64k词表模型相比151k基线加速1.63倍。性能随输入长度增加而下降。
Conclusion: 缩减词表并微调可以在设备端实时字幕翻译中取得竞争性结果，但延迟结果为初步数据，配置尚不完整。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Optimizing ARDL Models for Retail Sales Forecasting and Fair Pricing
papers.abstract_en: Pricing food products to balance profitability with consumer welfare is a central challenge for retailers. Dynamic pricing is widely used to maximize revenue, yet most pricing models optimize business objectives while overlooking consumer fairness. This paper studies the risk of consumer exploitation under dynamic food pricing in Canada and proposes a methodology that embeds fairness constraints directly into retail sales forecasting. We model total retail trade sales with a log--log Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) specification, in which the coefficient on a product price is a sales elasticity, and pose the pricing problem as maximizing forecast sales subject to price bounds anchored to the Consumer Price Index (CPI). We solve this problem with both Linear Programming (LP) and Simulated Annealing (SA), under single-product and multi-product configurations. A key finding is that the fitted nominal elasticities are positive. As a result, an unconstrained sales-maximizer would push every price to its upper bound, and the CPI ceiling is the safeguard that prevents this. Simulated Annealing instead settles on conservative, interior prices that lower consumer cost while still meeting the sales target. We benchmark forecast accuracy against naive, seasonal-naive, ARIMA, and SARIMA baselines, and a CPI-deflated re-specification shows that the positive nominal elasticities are largely an inflation-driven artifact. The result is a transparent, fairness-aware pricing framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何在动态食品定价中融入消费者公平性约束，使用对数-对数自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型预测零售销售，并通过线性规划和模拟退火求解以CPI为上限的定价优化问题。关键发现是名义弹性为正，导致无约束优化会推高价格，而CPI上限和模拟退火算法能产生保守、公平的定价。
Motivation: 现有动态定价模型多只优化商业目标，忽视消费者公平性，可能导致消费者剥削风险。
Method: 采用对数-对数ARDL模型估计价格弹性，将定价问题建模为在CPI锚定的价格上限下最大化预测销售额，并用线性规划（单产品）和模拟退火（多产品）求解。
Result: 发现拟合的名义弹性为正，无约束销售最大化会导致价格推到上限；CPI上限和模拟退火算法能产生降低消费者成本且满足销售目标的保守价格。
Conclusion: 提出一个透明、公平感知的定价框架，并指出正弹性主要由通胀驱动。

papers.title: A Foundation Model for Multimodal Event Sequences in Financial Applications
papers.abstract_en: Predictive modeling is a core component of modern financial services, where a wide range of tasks are traditionally addressed using separate models trained on manually engineered tabular features. This task-specific approach limits reuse and makes it difficult to fully exploit heterogeneous data sources such as transaction histories and digital interaction signals. In this paper, we present an approach based on pretraining a foundation transformer model on multimodal sequences of user events. Events from multiple data sources are unified into a single chronological sequence, enabling early fusion of heterogeneous modalities and learning of general-purpose representations via a next-event prediction objective. These representations are combined with existing engineered user features, on top of which lightweight neural models are trained for multiple downstream tasks. The proposed system outperforms traditional task-specific models while reducing development overhead. The approach was deployed in production at one of the biggest banks in Eastern Europe, resulting in measurable improvements in business metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于预训练Transformer的多模态事件序列基础模型，将用户交易历史和数字交互信号等异构数据统一为时间序列，通过下一事件预测目标学习通用表示，再结合现有工程特征训练轻量级下游模型。该系统已在东欧某大型银行生产环境中部署，相比传统任务专用模型提升了业务指标。
Motivation: 现有金融预测模型通常为每个任务单独训练，难以充分利用交易记录和数字交互信号等异构数据源，且复用性差。
Method: 将多种数据源的用户事件统一为单一时间序列，采用Transformer架构通过下一事件预测目标进行预训练，学习多模态融合的通用表示，然后与现有工程特征结合，训练轻量级神经网络处理多个下游任务。
Result: 在多个下游任务上超越传统任务专用模型，并减少了开发开销；生产部署后带来可衡量的业务指标提升。
Conclusion: 多模态事件序列基础模型能有效融合异构数据源，为金融领域提供可复用的通用表示，降低开发成本并提升性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Knowledge-Based Multi-Agent Framework for Security Control Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Hardening IT on-premises environments can be a daunting task for teams without access to adequate cybersecurity expertise. In this regard, Decision Support Systems (DSS) with embedded expert knowledge can assist users by guiding them with security recommendations to meet their objectives. This work proposes a Security DSS that recommends security control sub-families given minimal user requirements indicating coverage of different security dimensions. It leverages a curated, unified dataset from both well-known Information Security (InfoSec) and academic sources. This DSS is defined as a non-zero-sum, simultaneous game that is grounded in a Multi-Agent Influence Diagram (MAID) model and explores the decision space over 7 security dimensions or agents, using no-regret online learning to ultimately find the security control sub-families that best fit the requirements while incurring minimal under- and over-provisioning of security resources. This work was validated in terms of performance and accuracy, among others, for varying dataset sizes. It shows exceptional satisfaction coverage results of 99% when using as little as ~65% of the SW-implementable security controls, running in 1.2-35.7 seconds; and more moderate coverage results of 73%-77% when using ~29% of the controls, resolving in 0.8-13.8 seconds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于知识的网络安全决策支持系统（DSS），通过多智能体影响图（MAID）模型和非零和同时博弈，在7个安全维度上推荐安全控制子族。系统使用无遗憾在线学习优化资源分配，在统一知识库上验证，结果显示使用约65%的可实现安全控制即可达到99%的满意度覆盖，运行时间1.2-35.7秒。
Motivation: IT本地环境加固缺乏网络安全专业知识，现有决策支持系统难以在最小化过度/不足配置的同时满足用户安全需求。
Method: 构建包含已知信息安全和学术来源的统一数据集，将安全推荐问题建模为非零和同时博弈，基于多智能体影响图（MAID）模型，并使用无遗憾在线学习探索7个安全维度的决策空间。
Result: 使用约65%的可实现安全控制时达到99%的满意度覆盖，运行时间1.2-35.7秒；使用约29%的控制时覆盖率为73%-77%，运行时间0.8-13.8秒。
Conclusion: 本文提出的安全DSS在低资源使用下实现了高满意度覆盖率，验证了基于博弈论和多智能体方法在安全控制推荐中的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence Across the Cardiac Amyloidosis Diagnostic Pathway: From Single-Modality Detection to Multimodal Clinical Integration
papers.abstract_en: Cardiac amyloidosis (CA) is increasingly recognized but remains substantially underdiagnosed, because its clinical and imaging phenotype overlaps with more common cardiomyopathies. Definitive subtype assignment and management further require integration of multimodal evidence to distinguish transthyretin from light chain disease. Machine learning and deep learning have been applied across the diagnostic and management pathway. These applications span ECG, echocardiography, and health record-based case finding, as well as CMR and nuclear interpretation, including SPECT/CT biomarker quantification, prognostic modeling, and treatment response assessment. This narrative review synthesizes these studies by clinical tasks, namely screening, detection, quantification, prognosis, and treatment response monitoring, rather than by input modality. This task-based organization clarifies why apparently similar AI models require different cohorts, reference standards, evaluation metrics, and implementation thresholds. The evidence reveals a maturity gradient. Binary detection and AI assisted quantification on bone scintigraphy and SPECT/CT are closest to clinical translation. Detection is supported by large externally validated cohorts, and quantification by interpretable, outcome linked measurement of myocardial tracer burden. By contrast, subtype aware classification, prognostic risk stratification, and treatment response monitoring remain at an early stage. These tasks are limited by small cohorts, enriched retrospective designs, heterogeneous labels, incomplete external validation, and uncertain calibration in realistic prevalence settings. Across tasks, high discrimination alone is insufficient.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇叙述性综述，系统总结了机器学习与深度学习在心脏淀粉样变（CA）诊断与管理全流程中的应用。按筛查、检测、量化、预后和治疗反应监测等临床任务组织文献，而非按输入模态，揭示了不同任务在队列规模、参考标准、评估指标和实施阈值上的显著差异。综述指出，二元检测与AI辅助量化（尤其在骨显像和SPECT/CT上）最接近临床转化，而亚型分类、预后分层和治疗反应监测仍处于早期阶段，受限于小样本、回顾性设计、标签异质性和校准不足。
Motivation: 心脏淀粉样变虽渐被认识，但因表型重叠而严重漏诊，且亚型区分（转甲状腺素蛋白与轻链型）需整合多模态证据。现有AI研究分散于不同模态，缺乏统一的临床任务导向视角以明确各任务的成熟度和转化障碍。
Method: 采用叙述性综述方法，将现有研究按临床任务（筛查、检测、量化、预后、治疗反应监测）重新组织，而非按ECG、超声、CMR、核医学等输入模态分类。通过任务导向分析，比较不同任务所需的队列、金标准、评估指标和实施门槛。
Result: 综述揭示成熟度梯度：二元检测（如骨显像鉴别淀粉样变与非淀粉样变）已有大规模外部验证队列；AI辅助定量（如SPECT/CT心肌示踪剂负担）可解释且与预后关联；而亚型分类、预后风险分层和治疗反应监测尚处于早期，受限于小样本、回顾性设计、标签不一致及在真实患病率下的校准不足。
Conclusion: 仅凭高区分度不足以实现临床转化；需关注任务特异性的验证标准、校准能力和实际部署条件。不同临床任务处于不同成熟阶段，二元检测和量化最接近应用，复杂决策任务仍需更多研究。

papers.title: SMETA-ZSL:Semantic Meta-Alignment for Zero-Shot Threat Classification
papers.abstract_en: Cybersecurity systems must adapt rapidly to emerging threats. However, labeled data for new threat categories is unavailable when those threats first appear. Generalized zero-shot learning offers a natural solution by enabling recognition of unseen classes through auxiliary semantic knowledge rather than labeled examples. Large language models are particularly promising in this setting because they can convert unstructured CTI reports into semantic prototypes for emerging threats. However, applying language-driven zero-shot learning to cybersecurity is difficult due to strong semantic overlap between threat descriptions, heterogeneity between behavioral attributes and text, severe class imbalance, and open-set conditions where unseen threats are unknown during training. We propose SMETA-ZSL, that learns semantic prototypes from overlapping language descriptions through contrastive finetuning, aligns behavioral features through episodic meta-learning and knowledge distillation, and performs adaptive routing for generalization across seen-unseen classes. Across 7 benchmarks, SMETA-ZSL delivers the strongest overall generalized zero-shot performance under the strictest inductive setting, surpassing prior methods by 10.8 points on average, with gains up to 18.1 points. Github:https://github.com/Security-And-Intelligence-Lab-UTEP/SMETA-ZSL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SMETA-ZSL，一种用于零样本威胁分类的语义元对齐方法，通过对比微调学习语义原型、使用情景元学习和知识蒸馏对齐行为特征，并采用自适应路由在已知和未知类别间泛化。在7个基准测试上，归纳式广义零样本分类平均超过先前方法10.8个百分点，最高提升18.1个百分点。
Motivation: 网络安全系统需快速适应新兴威胁，但新威胁类别缺乏标注数据。现有语言驱动的零样本学习面临威胁描述语义重叠、行为与文本异质性、严重类别不平衡和开放集条件等挑战。
Method: SMETA-ZSL通过对比微调从重叠语言描述中学习语义原型，通过情景元学习和知识蒸馏对齐行为特征，并使用自适应路由在已知和未知类别间泛化。
Result: 在7个基准测试上，SMETA-ZSL在严格的归纳设置下取得最优广义零样本性能，平均超过先前方法10.8个百分点，最高提升18.1个百分点。
Conclusion: SMETA-ZSL有效解决了网络安全中零样本学习的多个困难，显著提升了威胁分类的泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Faithful by Design: Evaluating and Improving LLM-Generated Clinical Trial Summaries for Multi-Stakeholder Audiences
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used to summarize clinical trial results for healthcare providers, patients, and payers, but their tendency to hallucinate poses significant risks in this high-stakes context. This study introduces a benchmark evaluation framework for measuring the faithfulness of LLM-generated clinical trial summaries across three stakeholder audiences. The framework consists of 200 stratified trials drawn from the Aggregate Analysis of ClinicalTrials.gov database, evaluated using audience-specific prompt templates and a six-dimension faithfulness annotation schema. Baseline measurements were established for GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Gemini 2.5 Flash across 1,800 generated summaries scored using a cross-encoder natural language inference (NLI) model. Unsupported Claims was identified as the dominant failure mode across all three models, with a mean annotation score of 1.55 out of three. A knowledge-graph-augmented retrieval system was developed and evaluated against the baseline, producing statistically significant improvements in NLI-based faithfulness scores (entailment +0.0125, faithfulness +0.0130, p < 0.0001). Improvement pathways were model-dependent, with GPT-4o improving primarily through contradiction reduction while Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Gemini 2.5 Flash improved through increased entailment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型在生成临床试验摘要时出现的幻觉问题，提出了一个评估忠实度的基准框架。该框架包含来自ClinicalTrials.gov数据库的200个分层试验，使用面向不同受众的提示模板和六维忠实度标注模式进行评估。在GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet 4.6和Gemini 2.5 Flash上建立了基线，并开发了知识图谱增强检索系统，在NLI忠实度评分上取得了统计显著的改进。
Motivation: 大语言模型在总结临床试验结果时容易产生幻觉，这对医疗决策构成风险，但缺乏系统评估其忠实度的框架。
Method: 构建200个分层临床试验的基准，采用面向三种受众（医疗提供者、患者、支付方）的提示模板和六维忠实度标注模式，使用交叉编码器NLI模型评分，并开发知识图谱增强检索系统。
Result: 在1800个生成摘要上，未支持主张是主要失败模式（平均得分1.55/3）。知识图谱增强系统使NLI忠实度评分显著提升（蕴涵+0.0125，忠实度+0.0130，p<0.0001），且改进路径因模型而异。
Conclusion: 本文强调了临床试验摘要中忠实度评估的重要性，并展示了知识图谱增强方法在减少幻觉方面的有效性，但改进依赖模型选择。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Banshee: Target Switch Attacks on Gimbal-Stabilized Visual Tracking Systems via Acoustic Injection
papers.abstract_en: Gimbal-stabilized visual tracking is critical for modern autonomous systems such as Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). While prior work shows acoustic signals can disturb gimbal internals, the impact of such attacks on real-world applications like UAV tracking and following remains underexplored. Existing demonstrations largely overlook practical challenges for real-world attacks, such as object-motion uncertainty and runtime latency. To bridge this gap, we present Banshee, the first physically realizable attack that induces target switching in UAV visual tracking systems by exploiting acoustic vulnerabilities in gimbal-camera systems. Banshee generates carefully crafted acoustic waveforms that induce optimized adversarial gimbal oscillations, causing directionally biased camera-view drifts that break inter-frame target associations. Consequently, the onboard tracker is driven to switch from the original target to an attacker-selected object with high probability, with occasional target loss. Banshee achieves a 93.6% success rate in simulation across two commercial gimbal systems and five trackers. Real-world benchtop and in-flight black-box attacks against a commercial drone across varied scenarios show an overall 95.5% attack success rate. Our results reveal a practical cross-domain vulnerability between acoustics and vision, highlighting the need for robust designs of gimbal systems and applications. Our code is available at: https://github.com/U1ltra/Banshee.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Banshee 攻击，通过声学注入诱导云台振动，使无人机视觉跟踪系统发生目标切换。仿真成功率达93.6%，实物攻击成功率达95.5%，揭示了声学与视觉之间的跨域安全漏洞。
Motivation: 现有研究未充分探索声学攻击对实际无人机跟踪应用的影响，尤其是目标运动不确定性和运行时延迟等现实挑战。
Method: 生成精心设计的声学波形，引起云台优化振动，导致相机视野定向漂移，破坏帧间目标关联，从而迫使跟踪器切换到攻击者选择的目标。
Result: 在两种商用云台系统和五种跟踪器上仿真成功率达93.6%；真实世界台架与飞行黑盒攻击成功率达95.5%。
Conclusion: 揭示了声学与视觉之间的实际跨域漏洞，强调需加强云台系统及应用设计的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Partition Trees for Nearest Neighbor Search
papers.abstract_en: We study nearest neighbor search from the perspective of data-driven algorithm design: given a dataset $P \subset \mathbb{R}^d$ of size $n$ and sample access to a query distribution over $\mathbb{R}^d$, the goal is to learn a data structure optimized for queries drawn from that specific distribution. We focus on the class of balanced halfspace trees, which naturally abstracts space-partitioning frameworks like locality-sensitive hashing. Assuming Gaussian-like marginal conditions on the dataset and query distribution, we give an efficient algorithm that learns a tree achieving $o(nd)$ query time, provided that a perfect tree exists. At the core of our algorithmic approach is the balanced halfspace cut problem, where we are given a distribution over $\mathbb{R}^d \times \mathbb{R}^d$ and must find a balanced halfspace that minimizes the fraction of cut pairs. We prove that without distributional assumptions, finding the optimal balanced halfspace is NP-hard. To circumvent this computational barrier, we design an efficient improper learning algorithm: if the optimal halfspace cuts an $α$ fraction of pairs, our algorithm outputs a balanced polynomial threshold function of degree $\tilde{O}(1/\varepsilon^2)$ that cuts at most an $O(\sqrt{α+\varepsilon})$ fraction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从数据驱动算法设计角度研究最近邻搜索，针对给定查询分布学习一种平衡半空间树（balanced halfspace tree）数据结构。在数据集和查询分布满足类高斯边际条件下，若存在完美树，则给出一个高效算法实现 o(nd) 查询时间。核心是平衡半空间切割问题，证明无分布假设时寻找最优切割是 NP 难的，并设计了一个非适定学习算法：若最优半空间切割 α 比例的对，算法输出一个次数为 Õ(1/ε²) 的平衡多项式阈值函数，切割比例至多 O(√(α+ε))。
Motivation: 传统最近邻搜索数据结构通常针对最坏情况查询设计，而实际查询往往服从特定分布，因此希望学习针对该分布优化的数据结构，以提高查询效率。
Method: 提出平衡半空间切割（balanced halfspace cut）问题，并给出一个非适定学习算法：若最优半空间切割 α 比例的对，算法输出一个平衡多项式阈值函数，切割比例至多 O(√(α+ε))，从而构建平衡半空间树。
Result: 在数据集和查询分布满足类高斯边际条件下，若存在完美树，算法实现 o(nd) 查询时间；无分布假设时，最优平衡半空间切割问题是 NP 难的。
Conclusion: 论文表明在分布假设下可以高效学习最近邻搜索的数据结构，并揭示了一般情况下最优切割的计算困难。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Depth-Efficient Quantum Topological Data Analysis for Regime-Specific Detection of Financial Stress
papers.abstract_en: We present, to our knowledge, the first adaptation of Pauli Correlation Encoding (PCE) to quantum topological data analysis, reformulating Betti number estimation as a depth-efficient variational optimization over a compressed qubit register. From a Takens embedding and Vietoris--Rips filtration of S&P~500 returns, we extract combinatorial Laplacians and recast null-space counting as a continuous-PCE Rayleigh-quotient minimization with variational deflation, encoding $n_k$ simplex indices into $O(n_k^{1/κ})$ qubits with shallow, ancilla-free circuits. Because the resulting loss is rational rather than bilinear in the correlators, the barren-plateau bound of~\cite{Sciorilli25} does not transfer; empirically the gradient variance decays only polynomially, with no exponential barren plateau, over $n=4$--$12$ qubits. The classical stage matches ripser~\cite{bauer2021ripser} on all 190 sliding windows (2007-2009). On the real market Laplacians ($β_1=1$--$22$), warm-starting from a classical null-space surrogate allows PCE-VQE to recover $β_1$ exactly at every scale, placing the obstacle in the optimisation landscape rather than the encoding. Chronologically split classification gives in-regime ROC AUC $0.818$, but out-of-distribution evaluation on the 2020 COVID shock and 2022 rate cycle (AUC $0.009$, $0.515$) shows the calibration does not generalize across crisis regimes.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables, Accepted to IEEE International Conference of Quantum Computing and Engineering - QCE 2026 in the Quantum Applications (QAPP) Technical Papers track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将Pauli相关编码（PCE）应用于量子拓扑数据分析，通过深度高效的变分优化重新表述贝蒂数估计，在压缩的量子比特寄存器上实现。基于S&P 500收益的Takens嵌入和Vietoris-Rips过滤，提取组合拉普拉斯算子，将零空间计数转化为连续PCE瑞利商最小化，并用变分缩减技术将n_k个单纯形索引编码为O(n_k^{1/κ})个量子比特，使用浅层无辅助电路。在经典阶段，所有190个滑动窗口（2007-2009）与ripser匹配。在真实市场拉普拉斯算子上，从经典零空间代理热启动可使PCE-VQE精确恢复每个尺度的β_1。域内分类ROC AUC为0.818，但在2020年COVID冲击和2022年利率周期上的分布外评估（AUC分别为0.009和0.515）表明校准无法跨危机泛化。
Motivation: 金融压力检测需要能够识别不同危机制度的方法，而现有量子拓扑数据分析方法在深度和效率上存在局限，且泛化能力未经检验。
Method: 提出Pauli相关编码（PCE）的量子拓扑数据分析，将贝蒂数估计转化为变分优化问题，通过压缩量子比特寄存器和浅层电路实现深度高效，并采用变分缩减技术处理多个特征值。
Result: 在S&P 500数据上，经典阶段与ripser完全匹配；量子阶段精确恢复贝蒂数。域内分类ROC AUC为0.818，但跨制度泛化极差（COVID AUC 0.009，2022利率周期AUC 0.515）。
Conclusion: 论文表明，尽管量子拓扑数据分析在域内表现良好，但其校准无法泛化到不同的危机制度，障碍在于优化景观而非编码本身。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When Classical Baselines Are Tuned as Carefully as the Quantum Model, Does Quantum Reservoir Computing Still Win?
papers.abstract_en: Can a small quantum computer forecast a changing signal better than an ordinary classical method? Many studies say yes, but the classical methods they compare against are often left in a basic, untuned state while the quantum model is carefully optimised. We ask what happens when the classical competitor is given exactly the same care: the same size and the same amount of tuning effort. We study two popular reasons a quantum reservoir is thought to help, using exact simulations of small quantum systems (up to eleven qubits) on prediction tasks. In both cases the quantum advantage disappears once the comparison is fair. In the first, extra quantum measurements add nothing that a simple classical formula of the same size does not already provide. In the second, a feedback loop genuinely helps the quantum model, turning a useless setup into a working predictor, yet a well-tuned classical network still predicts slightly more accurately, and the gap is statistically reliable. Our point is not that quantum reservoirs can never win, but that two of their commonly cited advantages do not hold up against fair classical competitors at this scale. We provide these matched comparisons as a simple, reusable checklist for honest benchmarking. All results are fully reproducible from fixed random seeds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过公平对比实验发现，当经典基线模型获得与量子模型相同规模的调优（包括同样的参数数量和调优工作量）时，量子水库计算（quantum reservoir computing）在小型系统（最多11量子比特）预测任务上的优势消失。具体地，额外的量子测量并不比同等大小的简单经典公式提供更多信息；而在反馈环路场景中，尽管量子模型从无预测能力变为有预测能力，但调优后的经典网络仍预测更精确，且差距统计显著。论文提供了一套可复现的公平基准检测清单。
Motivation: 许多量子计算研究在比较中常将经典基线保持在基础、未调优状态，而量子模型经过精心优化，导致比较不公。本文旨在检验当经典模型获得同等调优时，量子水库计算的两个常见优势（额外测量信息和反馈环路）是否依然成立。
Method: 使用精确模拟的小型量子系统（最多11量子比特）在预测任务上，将量子水库（quantum reservoir）与同等大小、同等调优努力的经典模型进行公平比较；对两个常见优势场景分别设计实验。
Result: 公平比较下，两个场景中量子优势均消失。第一场景中额外量子测量不提供优于简单经典公式的信息；第二场景中量子模型依赖反馈环路获得预测能力，但调优后的经典网络预测更精确且差距统计显著。
Conclusion: 本文结论并非量子水库永远无法获胜，而是在小型系统（最多11量子比特）上两个被引用的常见优势无法经受公平的经典基线比较。研究提供了可复现的公平基准检测清单，供后续研究使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do These Violent Delights Have Violent Ends? Measuring the Post-Merge Fate of Agentic Code
papers.abstract_en: Agentic coding tools are increasingly used to make autonomous repository-level changes to real-world projects. Prior work has largely evaluated these contributions at the pre-merge stage, through outcomes such as pull request acceptance and review effort. Far less is known about what happens to agentic code post-merge. Yet merge success alone does not reveal whether a contribution will remain stable or require bug fixes and other corrective maintenance downstream. We conduct a longitudinal empirical analysis of agentic and human contributions across 182 repositories, tracking their post-merge fate over time, characterizing the intent of subsequent modifications, and analyzing the defects and vulnerabilities they introduce. While the overall maintenance rates are similar, agentic contributions require significantly higher rates of corrective maintenance and introduce more security weaknesses and dependency vulnerabilities. We also find statistically significant evidence that agentic maintenance burden is associated with repository characteristics. In particular, each 10 percentage-point increase in a project's no-review rate is associated with roughly a 6% increase in agentic maintenance burden on average. As coding agents become pervasive in software development, our findings highlight the need to evaluate and design agentic tools not only to produce mergeable changes, but to produce contributions that remain secure and maintainable.

Method: 对182个仓库中智能体与人类贡献进行纵向分析，追踪合并后修改意图，分类缺陷和漏洞，并建立统计模型关联仓库特征与维护负担。
Result: 智能体贡献与人类贡献整体维护率相似，但智能体贡献的修正性维护率显著更高，且引入更多安全弱点和依赖漏洞。每10个百分点无审查率增加与约6%的智能体维护负担增加相关。

papers.title: An End-to-End Hybrid Quantum--Classical Sampling Workflow for Discrete Markov Random Fields: A Reproducible Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Sampling from discrete Markov random fields (MRFs) is a hard problem. We study amplitude-encoded i.i.d. sampling for small MRFs where $2^n$ target probabilities are precomputed classically. This removes quantum exponential speedup but allows a clean comparison against classical MCMC based on independent circuit samples ($τ\approx 1$). Across 60 instances spanning five graph families (1k-step burn-in, 3k retained samples), the mean ESS ratios of Quantum to Single-Site Gibbs, Block Gibbs, Tuned-Block, and Parallel Tempering are $16.35$, $7.29$, $1.82$, and $1.79$, showing modern classical samplers substantially close this gap. Amortizing $O(2^n)$ preprocessing into wall-clock time, exact inverse-CDF sampling yields $17.7\text{M}$ ESS/s versus $488\text{K}$ ESS/s for the quantum sampler ($36\times$ mean rate, $153\times$ per-instance), confirming no wall-clock advantage. We characterize MCMC autocorrelation costs and benchmark amplitude-encoded state preparation at $n \in \{8,10,12\}$. An MPS scaling study ($n \le 40$) shows bond dimension $χ=32$ achieves $F=0.721\pm0.059$ at $n=40$. Finally, a matched-budget VQC vs. MPS comparison at $n \in \{8,10,12\}$ shows VQC fidelities fall far below MPS: $(F_{\mathrm{VQC}}, F_{\mathrm{MPS}}) = (0.31, 0.99), (0.21, 0.96), (0.17, 0.88)$ at compressions $10.7\times$, $34.1\times$, and $113.8\times$.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 9 tables, Accepted to IEEE International Conference of Quantum Computing and Engineering - QCE 2026 in the Quantum End-to-End Hybrid Case Studies (QECS) Technical Papers track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过一个可复现的案例研究，提出了一种端到端的混合量子-经典采样工作流，用于离散马尔可夫随机场（MRF）。在60个实例上的实验表明，经典MCMC采样器（如并行回火）的ESS比率与量子采样器相当，且预处理代价使量子方法在墙钟时间上无优势。此外，矩阵乘积态（MPS）在保真度上远超变分量子电路（VQC）。
Motivation: 从离散MRF中采样是困难问题，现有量子方法声称有加速潜力，但缺乏与经典先进采样器的公平比较和实际时间代价分析。
Method: 采用振幅编码实现独立同分布采样，其中目标概率由经典预计算得；与经典MCMC（单点Gibbs、块Gibbs、调优块、并行回火）比较，基于有效样本量（ESS）和墙钟时间评估性能；并在更大量级上对比MPS与VQC的保真度。
Result: 量子采样器的平均ESS比率相对于经典采样器为16.35、7.29、1.82、1.79，经典现代采样器大幅缩小差距；墙钟时间上经典逆CDF采样比量子采样快36倍；MPS在n=40时保真度0.721，而VQC在n=12时仅0.17。
Conclusion: 该案例表明，对于离散MRF，经典采样器在竞争性设置下没有量子优势；预处理和电路采样开销是关键瓶颈。

papers.title: Next-Dense-Stride Prediction for Multimodal Autoregressive Visual Modeling
papers.abstract_en: We introduce DenseAR, a new generative paradigm that reformulates autoregressive image generation as coarse-to-fine next-dense-stride prediction using a compact single-scale tokenizer. Our key insight is that traversing a single-scale latent grid with progressively denser strides naturally captures the transition from global structure to fine detail. This addresses two limitations of existing autoregressive models at once: the slow inference of raster-order autoregression, which DenseAR avoids by predicting multiple tokens in parallel, and the heavy cost of multi-scale approaches, which need long, multi-resolution token sequences to achieve coarse-to-fine prediction. Building on our efficient framework and the flexibility of autoregressive modeling, we further extend DenseAR to a unified model that handles multiple modalities and imaging tasks within a single backbone. We validate DenseAR on both medical and natural images. On multi-contrast brain MRI, a single DenseAR model unifies cross-modal translation, modality-conditioned generation, and tumor segmentation, while remaining competitive with task-specific methods. On ImageNet, DenseAR improves class-conditional generation quality (FID and IS) over both a single-grid baseline without stride ordering and a multi-scale tokenizer-based baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DenseAR，一种新的生成范式，通过粗到细的密集步幅预测实现自回归图像生成。使用紧凑的单尺度分词器，在单尺度潜网格上以逐渐密集的步幅遍历，从全局结构过渡到细节。解决了栅格顺序自回归的慢推理和多尺度方法的高成本问题。在医学图像（多对比脑MRI）和自然图像（ImageNet）上验证，支持多种模态和任务。
Motivation: 现有自回归模型存在栅格顺序推理慢、多尺度方法需要长序列的问题。本文旨在提出一种高效的自回归框架，同时实现粗到细生成和多任务统一。
Method: 提出 DenseAR，采用单尺度分词器，通过定义不同的步长（stride）对潜网格进行逐步密集的预测，将自回归生成转化为粗到细的密集步幅预测。支持多模态和任务（跨模态翻译、条件生成、分割）的统一模型。
Result: 在多对比脑MRI上，单个DenseAR模型在跨模态翻译、条件生成和肿瘤分割上与任务专用方法竞争。在ImageNet上，DenseAR相比单网格基线（无步幅排序）和多尺度分词基线提升了类条件生成质量（FID和IS）。
Conclusion: DenseAR通过粗到细的密集步幅预测有效改进了自回归图像生成，并展示了统一多模态任务的潜力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: What You Train Is What You Get: Gender Bias, Training Composition, and Post-Hoc Mitigation in Audio Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Audio deepfake detection models determine whether speech is genuine or artificially generated, but high overall accuracy can mask substantial performance disparities across demographic groups. In this work, we investigate gender bias in audio deepfake detection using the ASVspoof5 dataset. We use ASVspoof5 under a controlled custom split designed to isolate gender-composition effects. We train attack-specific models on nine training sets with different gender compositions, ranging from female-only to male-only. We use a ResNet18 classifier with LogSpectrogram and WavLM-Base+ features, and we evaluated six post-hoc threshold calibration methods. Experimental results show that training data composition strongly predicts bias direction, with the underrepresented gender performing worse at test time. WavLM-Base+ features are shown to produce gender performance gaps 3.0 to 4.3 times larger than LogSpectrogram under identical training conditions, and balanced training is found to reduce LogSpectrogram bias but leave WavLM bias largely intact. Moreover, all six calibration strategies, including Oracle calibration with full test-set label access, leave the Equal Error Rate gap unchanged at 1.317 pp, confirming that threshold adjustment cannot correct underlying score distribution disparities. Overall, these findings suggest that gender fairness in audio deepfake detection must be addressed at training time, as post-hoc methods can only partially mitigate the resulting disparities
papers.comment: This manuscript is a preprint and is currently under review for the Special Section on Trustworthy and Reliable AI in IEEE Transactions on Reliability
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究音频深度伪造检测中的性别偏见，使用ASVspoof5数据集，通过控制性别组成划分训练集，训练攻击特定模型，并评估六种后处理阈值校准方法。实验发现训练数据组成强烈预测偏见方向，WavLM特征比LogSpectrogram产生更大的性别性能差距，且所有校准方法都无法校正等错误率差距，表明性别公平必须在训练时解决。
Motivation: 现有音频深度伪造检测模型整体准确率高，但可能掩盖不同人口统计群体间的显著性能差异，本文专门针对性别偏见问题。
Method: 使用ASVspoof5数据集的受控自定义划分，构建九种不同性别组成的训练集（从全女性到全男性），训练基于ResNet18分类器，使用LogSpectrogram和WavLM-Base+特征，评估六种后处理阈值校准方法（包括Oracle校准）。
Result: 训练数据组成强烈预测偏见方向，测试时训练集中代表性不足的性别表现更差。WavLM-Base+特征产生的性别性能差距比LogSpectrogram大3.0-4.3倍。平衡训练可减少LogSpectrogram的偏见，但对WavLM偏见影响不大。所有六种校准策略（包括Oracle校准）均无法改变等错误率差距（保持在1.317个百分点）。
Conclusion: 性别公平必须在训练时解决，后处理方法只能部分缓解差异。

papers.title: Do Transformer Temporal Heads and Post-Pooling Motion Gates Help CorrNet-based CSLR? An Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: CorrNet is a strong baseline for continuous sign language recognition (CSLR) because it models inter-frame correlations inside the visual encoding stage. In this paper, we study two natural extensions of a reproduced CorrNet system: replacing the BiLSTM temporal head with a Transformer encoder, and injecting motion cues after temporal pooling. We find that the Transformer head does not outperform the BiLSTM baseline, even with a training strategy adjusted for the Transformer, and the two heads have almost the same computational and runtime cost. For the second extension, we design a lightweight module called MotionGate. In our experiments, MotionGate consistently collapses to an identity-like mapping: the gate loses motion selectivity, and the injected residual becomes a weak, non-selective perturbation of the pooled features. These results suggest that explicit motion injection after CorrNet's correlation-based encoding is largely redundant, and that natural-looking architectural extensions in CSLR should be tested carefully instead of being assumed to help.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对CorrNet连续手语识别（CSLR）系统进行了两个自然扩展的实证研究：用Transformer编码器替换BiLSTM时序头，以及在时序池化后注入运动线索。实验发现Transformer头并未超越BiLSTM基线，且两者计算成本相近；设计的MotionGate模块退化为恒等映射，表明显式运动注入在CorrNet的相关性编码后是冗余的。这些结果提醒，CSLR中看似合理的架构扩展应谨慎验证，而非默认有效。
Motivation: CorrNet是CSLR的强基线，但其时序头和运动建模是否有进一步改进空间尚不清楚。本文旨在验证两个直观扩展（Transformer时序头和运动线索注入）是否真正有效，以填补这一实证空白。
Method: 基于复现的CorrNet系统，分别进行两组实验：1）用Transformer编码器替换BiLSTM时序头，并调整训练策略；2）设计轻量模块MotionGate，在时序池化后注入运动线索。
Result: Transformer头未超越BiLSTM基线，两者计算和运行时间几乎相同；MotionGate始终退化为恒等映射，失去运动选择性，注入的残差变为微弱非选择性扰动。
Conclusion: 研究提示，在CorrNet这种已利用帧间相关性的编码后，显式运动注入是冗余的；CSLR中自然扩展应谨慎测试，而非假设有效。本文局限性在于仅在一个复现系统上实验，未探索其他架构或更大规模数据。

papers.title: Remembering Distinct Items, Not Tokens: A Learnable Dirichlet-Process Cache Between State-Space Models and Attention
papers.abstract_en: Fixed-state sequence models compress an unbounded past into a bounded state, which caps their associative recall at roughly the state dimension; attention escapes the cap by keeping a key-value entry for every token, at quadratic compute and a cache that grows with the sequence. We study the middle ground: a sparse cache that allocates a slot only when an input is novel, so its size tracks the number of distinct items rather than the number of tokens. The allocation rule is the DP-means clustering rule, the small-variance limit of a Dirichlet-process mixture, used not as latent-variable inference but as the key-value memory operator for a deep recurrent backbone. We develop it in two forms, a static cache with a fixed concentration and a surprise-adaptive variant whose concentration follows the recent novelty rate. On a controlled associative-recall benchmark with redundancy we show that the cache matches full-attention recall while storing only the distinct items, that it dominates a fixed-budget eviction cache on the recall-versus-size frontier, and that on a state-space backbone it answers both a recall query and a long-range aggregate at the lowest memory of any model tested. The allocation is learnable end to end: a two-parameter novelty-threshold gate trained on the task loss alone recovers the rule exactly, whereas an over-parameterized gate fails, so the operative ingredient is the inductive bias rather than capacity. The evidence is a family of controlled mechanism studies at modest scale, with the distinct-items property confirmed on four real streams (recommendation, systems logs, clinical events, and insurance claims); a real-backbone, real-corpus language validation is pursued in a companion study.

TL;DR: 本文研究介于固定状态序列模型和完全注意力之间的中间地带：一个稀疏缓存，仅当输入新颖时才分配槽位，因此缓存大小跟踪不同项目的数量而非token数量。分配规则基于DP-means聚类规则，是Dirichlet过程混合的小方差极限，用作深度递归骨干网络的键值记忆操作符。作者开发了两种形式：固定浓度的静态缓存和自适应性变体。在受控关联回忆基准上，该缓存匹配全注意力回忆且仅存储不同项目，在回忆-大小边界上优于固定预算驱逐缓存，在状态空间骨干上以最低内存同时回答回忆查询和长程聚合。分配是可端到端学习的：一个两参数新颖性阈值门在任务损失上训练准确恢复规则，而过参数化门失败，因此有效成分是归纳偏差而非容量。在四个真实流上验证了不同项目属性。
Motivation: 固定状态序列模型将无限历史压缩为有界状态，其关联回忆能力受限于状态维度；注意力通过为每个token保留键值条目来突破上限，但计算量二次且缓存随序列增长。本文研究中间地带：一个稀疏缓存，仅当输入新颖时分配槽位，从而在保持回忆能力的同时控制缓存大小。
Method: 提出基于DP-means聚类规则的键值记忆操作符，作为深度递归骨干网络的缓存机制。包括静态缓存（固定浓度参数）和自适应性变体（浓度跟随最近新颖率）。分配通过学习两个参数的新颖性阈值门实现，训练仅使用任务损失。
Result: 在受控关联回忆基准上，该缓存匹配全注意力回忆且仅存储不同项目；在回忆-大小边界上优于固定预算驱逐缓存；在状态空间骨干上以最低内存同时回答回忆查询和长程聚合。分配学习实验表明两参数门恢复规则，而过参数化门失败。在四个真实流（推荐、系统日志、临床事件、保险索赔）上确认了不同项目属性。
Conclusion: 本文的证据源于一系列中等规模的受控机制研究，在四个真实流上确认了不同项目属性；真实骨干、真实语料语言验证在伴随研究中进行。

papers.title: Bridging the Catalog-to-Real Gap: Scalable Product Recognition via Multi-Stage Contrastive Learning
papers.abstract_en: Automated product recognition is a cornerstone of modern retail intelligence; however, accurately matching real-world, in-store images against extensive corporate catalogs remains a major scalability bottleneck for large-scale applications. In this work, we address this challenge by reformulating the task as an embedding-based cross-domain retrieval problem rather than a standard closed-set classification task. Specifically, we define the objective as retrieving the most corresponding catalog reference image for a given real-world product query crop from an expansive inventory. To bridge the severe domain gap between pristine studio packshots and noisy in-store queries, we introduce a novel catalog-to-real multi-stage contrastive learning paradigm (Cat2Real). This framework fine-tunes a vision backbone by systematically exploiting both item-level and image-level similarities to drive targeted hard negative mining. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that our paradigm scales seamlessly to unseen products and categories, yielding outstanding zero-shot generalization performance even in the complete absence of real-world training images for novel inventory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大规模零售中目录图像与真实商店图像之间的域差距，提出Cat2Real多阶段对比学习框架，将产品识别转化为嵌入空间中的跨域检索问题。通过物品级和图像级相似性进行难负例挖掘，在零样本场景下实现对新产品的泛化。
Motivation: 现有方法在匹配真实商店图像与大规模目录图像时面临可扩展性瓶颈，标准闭集分类无法处理域差距和开放集问题。
Method: 提出多阶段对比学习范式Cat2Real，利用物品级和图像级相似性进行难负例挖掘，微调视觉骨干网络，无需真实训练图像即可泛化到未见产品。
Result: 在未见产品和类别上取得了突出的零样本泛化性能。
Conclusion: 该方法可扩展到大规模零售场景，弥补目录到真实的差距。

papers.title: Nonparametric Bayesian Inverse Reinforcement Learning with Data-Parallel Gibbs Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Inverse Reinforcement Learning recovers reward functions from expert demonstrations, but standard formulations assume that all demonstrations come from a single expert. When demonstrations are pooled from multiple experts with distinct preferences, parametric methods recover an averaged reward that fits no individual expert well. We implement Nonparametric Bayesian Inverse Reinforcement Learning with a Dirichlet Process prior over reward functions, allowing the number of latent reward types to be inferred jointly with the rewards themselves. Inference uses a collapsed Gibbs sampler combining a Chinese Restaurant Process update for cluster assignments with a Metropolis-Hastings update for reward weights, and soft value iteration as the inner planning routine. We evaluate on a 10x10 ObjectWorld grid with two and three ground-truth reward types. The serial sampler recovers K=2 with Adjusted Rand Index of 1.000, substantially outperforming a Maximum Entropy IRL baseline (ARI=0.000). Extension to K=3 shows that the sampler correctly identifies the number of clusters in all runs; assignment ARI of 0.48-0.58 reflects behavioral overlap between expert types that persists across grid instantiations, revealing that reliable K=3 evaluation on ObjectWorld requires controlled object placement rather than random seeding. We further parallelize the sampler across CPU cores using Ray on HPC hardware, achieving a peak speedup of 4.79x at 8 workers, and characterize a throughput-versus-accuracy tradeoff arising from the consensus merge heuristic used during state aggregation. Code and a containerized environment are available at https://github.com/dasashreeya/np_bayes_irl.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文实现了一种基于狄利克雷过程先验的非参数贝叶斯逆强化学习方法，通过collapsed Gibbs采样推断多专家演示中的潜在奖励类型数量及奖励函数。在10x10 ObjectWorld网格环境中，该方法在两种真实奖励类型下完美恢复聚类（ARI=1.000），显著优于最大熵IRL基线（ARI=0.000）；在三种类型下也能正确识别聚类数，但分配ARI为0.48-0.58，揭示了行为重叠问题。此外，通过Ray在HPC上实现数据并行Gibbs采样，在8个worker时达到4.79倍加速，并分析了共识合并启发式带来的吞吐量-精度权衡。
Motivation: 标准逆强化学习假设所有演示来自单一专家，当演示来自多个偏好不同的专家时，参数化方法只能恢复一个平均奖励函数，无法拟合任何个体专家，限制了实际应用。
Method: 采用狄利克雷过程先验对奖励函数建模，使用collapsed Gibbs采样：用Chinese Restaurant Process更新聚类分配，Metropolis-Hastings更新奖励权重，内层规划采用soft值迭代。并行化方面，利用Ray在HPC多核CPU上实现数据并行采样，并通过共识合并启发式进行状态聚合。
Result: 在10x10 ObjectWorld网格上，两种奖励类型时聚类调整兰德指数（ARI）为1.000，而最大熵IRL基线为0.000；三种类型时所有运行均正确识别聚类数，但分配ARI为0.48-0.58。并行采样在8个worker时达到4.79倍加速，但共识合并导致一定程度精度下降。
Conclusion: 该方法能自动推断专家类型数量并恢复奖励函数，在网格环境上验证了有效性，同时展示了并行采样的加速效果和精度-吞吐量权衡。未来工作可探索更复杂环境及改进聚类分配质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ShapKO: Shapley-Adaptive Modality Knockout for Robust Multimodal Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal medical models often degrade when inputs are missing, a common scenario in real-world clinical workflows. Separately, even when all modalities are present, modality dominance is observed during training, where optimization over-relies on a highly predictive modality and undertrains complementary sources, resulting in poor robustness under partial availability. While training-time modality knockout improves missing-modality robustness, existing approaches use static masking rates that cannot adapt to evolving modality utility during training. We introduce ShapKO (Shapley-Adaptive Modality Knockout), a dynamic training strategy that learns modality-specific knockout probabilities based on validation utility. ShapKO periodically evaluates performance across modality subsets, estimates modality importance via Shapley values, and updates masking probabilities to suppress dominant modalities more frequently. This adaptive process promotes complementary representations, while requiring no architectural modifications. We evaluate ShapKO on three datasets covering multitask clinical classification, survival prediction, and cancer detection. ShapKO consistently improves performance under modality absence and yields interpretable trajectories of learned masking behavior. Code is available at: https://github.com/sumona00/ShapKO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ShapKO，一种基于Shapley值的动态模态缺失训练策略，通过周期性评估模态子集性能并更新缺失概率，抑制主导模态、促进互补表征，在多模态医学模型缺失模态时提升鲁棒性。在三个医学数据集（多任务临床分类、生存预测、癌症检测）上，ShapKO在模态缺失下持续改进性能。
Motivation: 多模态医学模型在临床中常面临输入缺失，且训练时存在模态主导问题（过度依赖高预测性模态），现有训练时模态缺失方法使用静态掩码率，无法适应模态效用变化。
Method: ShapKO动态学习模态特定的缺失概率：周期性评估模态子集性能，用Shapley值估计模态重要性，据此更新掩码概率以更频繁地抑制主导模态，无需修改架构。
Result: 在三个医学数据集上，ShapKO在模态缺失情况下持续提升性能，并产生可解释的掩码行为轨迹。
Conclusion: ShapKO提供了一种无需架构修改的动态训练策略，有效提升多模态模型在缺失模态时的鲁棒性，但摘要未提及对完整模态性能的影响或与其他方法的详细对比。

papers.title: A Dual-Stream Challenge-Response Protocol for Ocular Liveness Verification
papers.abstract_en: Ocular biometric systems face sophisticated presentation attacks, including high-resolution video replays and real-time generative deepfakes, which easily bypass static liveness checks. Current Presentation Attack Detection (PAD) frameworks typically rely on isolated physiological metrics, such as gaze tracking or the Pupillary Light Reflex (PLR), which can be spoofed independently. This paper proposes a Spatio-Luminance Sensor Fusion protocol, which introduces a dual-stream challenge-response framework for ocular liveness verification by uniting these metrics into a simultaneous authentication challenge. By generating a randomized, time-varying visual stimulus that fluctuates in both spatial trajectory and luminance intensity, we construct a mathematically coupled state-space likelihood model, termed the Synchronization Matrix, to evaluate the continuous cross-correlation between the expected biological latencies of smooth pursuit tracking and pupillary constriction. Using Monte Carlo simulation grounded in literature-derived latency distributions, we demonstrate theoretical separability between genuine and simulated attack conditions, and show that a multi-round challenge design improves the detection of generative deepfakes when a non-zero rendering-latency gap exists. This work provides a simulation-supported theoretical framework for next-generation dynamic spoofing defense in ocular and iris biometrics; human-subject validation is identified as necessary future work before deployment claims can be made.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Simulation-based theoretical framework; human-subject validation identified as future work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出一种双流挑战-响应协议用于眼部活体验证，通过同时评估平滑追踪和瞳孔反射的交叉相关性来抵御视频重放和生成式深度伪造攻击。蒙特卡洛模拟表明该方法理论上能区分真实与欺骗，尤其当攻击存在非零渲染延迟时。
Motivation: 现有眼部活体检测依赖孤立生理指标，易被独立欺骗，需要更鲁棒的联合验证。
Method: 提出 Spatio-Luminance Sensor Fusion 协议，使用随机时空和亮度刺激，构建同步矩阵评估平滑追踪与瞳孔收缩的延迟交叉相关性。
Result: 基于文献延迟分布的蒙特卡洛模拟显示理论可分离性，多轮挑战设计在非零渲染延迟下提升对生成式深度伪造的检测。
Conclusion: 提供模拟支持的理论框架，但人类验证是部署前必要未来工作。

papers.title: CLIR-Bench: Benchmarking Multimodal Question Answering over Irregular Clinical Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Clinical time series are central to patient monitoring, risk assessment, and clinical decision support. However, they are often sparse, irregularly sampled, and asynchronous, making it difficult for models to identify the temporal evidence required for clinical Question Answering (QA). Existing benchmarks primarily focus on regularly sampled time-series QA or medical QA over static data, and therefore rarely assess whether models can faithfully ground their answers in irregular temporal observations. To fill this gap, we introduce CLIR-Bench, a benchmark for irregular clinical time series QA constructed from de-identified ICU records through a principled four-stage pipeline. CLIR-Bench contains 6,600 QA instances spanning 11 clinical variables, organized into four capability dimensions and 11 tasks. Each question is linked to explicit temporal evidence and task-specific answer derivation rules, enabling evaluation of both answer accuracy and evidence use. Experiments show that existing generalist models struggle to retrieve and reason over sparse clinical evidence, highlighting the need for stronger irregular time-series reasoning methods. Our code and data are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/winall/CLIR-Bench.

papers.title: Serving the Long Tail: Training-Free LLM Candidate Generation for Vacation Rental Marketplaces
papers.abstract_en: Vacation rental marketplaces face a structural imbalance on the supply side: a small fraction of properties receive most user interactions, while the long tail of new, niche, and seasonal listings generates too little behavioral signal for collaborative filtering to serve effectively. At Vrbo, item-based k-nearest neighbors (IBKNN) is a core candidate generation channel, but leaves tens of thousands of properties with no candidates and produces weak neighborhoods for sparsely interacted ones. We present a training-free, LLM-based candidate generation pipeline that complements IBKNN using static property metadata alone. An off-the-shelf LLM synthesizes diverse semantic queries per property, a pre-trained text encoder embeds them, and an approximate nearest-neighbor index retrieves candidates from an 11.7M-property catalog. A Union fusion strategy merges these with IBKNN while preserving the behavioral channel's ordering, guaranteeing no degradation on well-served properties, and a downstream learning-to-rank model re-scores the fused pool. Evaluated on 1.6M focal properties, the system extends candidate coverage to tens of thousands of properties IBKNN cannot reach, delivers its largest gains on the long-tail segment where behavioral methods are weakest, and matches or beats IBKNN at every K on shared properties. A downstream learning-to-rank stage further lifts the fused pool, yielding a complete candidate generation and re-ranking stack that serves the long tail without regressing well-served properties. We additionally show that Union fusion collapses the recall gap between a 3B open-weights LLM and frontier API-based models from 27-46% to under 1%, supporting self-hosted small-model deployment at marketplace catalog scale.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对度假租赁市场中长尾属性的候选生成问题，提出一种基于LLM的无训练候选生成管道，与传统的基于物品的K近邻（IBKNN）互补，通过Union融合策略扩展覆盖面，并在下游学习排序模型中提升表现。
Motivation: 度假租赁市场存在结构性的供需不平衡：少数属性获得大部分交互，而长尾（新、小众、季节性）属性缺乏行为信号，导致协同过滤方法难以有效服务。Vrbo的IBKNN候选生成通道使得数万属性没有候选，稀疏交互的属性产生弱邻域。
Method: 提出基于LLM的无训练候选生成管道，仅使用静态属性元数据。离线的LLM为每个属性合成多样化的语义查询，预训练文本编码器嵌入，近似最近邻索引从1170万个属性目录中检索候选。通过Union融合策略与IBKNN合并，保留行为通道的顺序，保证对服务良好的属性无退化，下游学习排序模型对融合池重新打分。
Result: 在160万个焦点属性上评估，系统将候选覆盖扩展到IBKNN无法到达的数万个属性，在行为方法最弱的长尾段获得最大增益，在共享属性上每个K匹配或超越IBKNN。融合后学习排序进一步提升。Union融合将3B开源LLM与前沿API模型之间的召回差距从27-46%缩小到不足1%，支持自托管的小模型部署。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法通过Union融合策略，在不退化服务良好属性的前提下，有效服务于长尾属性，并支持大规模市场目录下的小模型部署。

papers.title: Prompting-MammAlps: Fine-Grained Text-to-Video Retrieval for Camera-Trap Data
papers.abstract_en: Automatically retrieving videos from large camera-trap datasets remains challenging. Text-to-Video retrieval (TVR) methods based on large video-language models (VLMs) have potential to retrieve events of interest by describing them with simple text queries. However, current methods often lack spatiotemporal understanding and do not generalize well to ecological data. In this work, we introduce Prompting-MammAlps, the first camera-trap TVR benchmark, and propose a fine-grained and interpretable TVR method. Specifically, we trained a vision transformer to perform spatiotemporal action localization, and convert its output to structured text, describing each video. Independently, ethology-inspired queries are processed by a Large-Language Model (LLM) based coding agent to parse the structured text per video and retrieve videos accordingly. We harnessed the LLM to use functions from a custom parsing library to minimize the risk of LLM hallucinations and to improve method interpretability. This retrieval approach applied on the Prompting-MammAlps benchmark achieved a set-based F1-score of 34\% on a test set of 135 ecologically-relevant queries and 775 candidate videos. In comparison the best zero-shot VLM achieved a F1-score of 18\%, while also lacking interpretability. Project page: https://cnai.epfl.ch/prompting-mammalps

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Prompting-MammAlps，首个相机陷阱数据的文本-视频检索（TVR）基准，并设计了一种细粒度、可解释的检索方法。方法训练视觉Transformer进行时空动作定位，将输出转为结构化文本，再通过基于LLM的编码代理解析文本并检索视频。在135个生态查询和775个候选视频的测试集上，方法达到34%的集合F1分数，而最佳零样本VLM仅18%，且缺乏可解释性。
Motivation: 现有TVR方法缺乏时空理解能力，且对生态数据泛化性差，无法有效检索相机陷阱视频中的特定事件。
Method: 训练视觉Transformer进行时空动作定位，将输出转为描述每段视频的结构化文本；同时，基于行为学设计的查询由LLM编码代理处理，通过自定义解析库的函数调用减少幻觉并提升可解释性。
Result: 在Prompting-MammAlps基准的135个查询和775个候选视频上，方法取得34%的集合F1分数，优于最佳零样本VLM的18%。
Conclusion: 该方法通过结构化文本和LLM解析实现了可解释的视频检索，并在相机陷阱数据上显著超过零样本VLM，但F1分数仍较低，提示进一步改进空间。

papers.title: Nonlinear Axiomatic Attribution for Cooperative Games
papers.abstract_en: The Shapley value is a widely used concept in attribution problems, as it uniquely satisfies the axioms of linearity, consistency, equal treatment, and efficiency. Often, the inclusion AUC metric is used to evaluate the quality of player rankings, in order to identify positively participating players. However, it can be established that the Shapley value is not always reliable for this purpose. The core issue lies in its linearity: the Shapley value acts as a linear operator with an excessively large null space, which is likely to contain non-negligible perturbations that remain indistinguishable to the operator. To address this limitation, we explore the design of nonlinear axiomatic attribution methods. Inspired by the least core, which is a popular nonlinear substitute for the Shapley value, we introduce a class of nonlinear attribution methods that retain the remaining necessary axioms. Each method yields a contribution vector that is the unique optimal solution to a minimization problem, which aims to approximate utility functions as faithfully as possible. In terms of the inclusion AUC metric, our experiments demonstrate the potential effectiveness of these methods compared to Shapley value variants that relax only the efficiency axiom. Our code is available at https://github.com/watml/nonlinear-axiom.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Shapley值在线性归因中存在的零空间过大问题，提出一类非线性公理归因方法。该方法受最小核的启发，保留了除线性外的其余必要公理，并通过最小化逼近效用函数的优化问题得到唯一贡献向量。实验表明，在包含AUC指标上，该方法比仅松弛效率公理的Shapley值变体更有效。
Motivation: Shapley值作为线性算子具有过大的零空间，可能包含不可忽略的扰动而导致归因不可靠，尤其在识别正向参与玩家时表现不佳。
Method: 借鉴最小核的思想，设计一类非线性公理归因方法，保留线性、一致性、公平性和效率等公理中的非线部分，将贡献向量定义为最小化与效用函数逼近误差的优化问题的唯一解。
Result: 在包含AUC指标上，实验显示所提方法优于仅松弛效率公理的Shapley值变体，表明非线性归因在排序质量上的潜力。
Conclusion: 论文强调了非线性公理归因在克服Shapley值线性缺陷上的有效性，并提供了开源代码。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Neural Posterior Estimation for Inferring Weak Lensing Shear
authors: the LSST Dark Energy Science Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: The prevailing approach to inferring weak gravitational lensing shear from images involves detecting galaxies, estimating their ellipticities, and calibrating these estimates to correct for image noise, selection bias, and model misspecification. Characterizing the statistical model and assumptions underlying this pipeline is challenging, which makes it difficult to propagate uncertainty through its various stages. As an alternative, we propose to infer shear using neural posterior estimation (NPE), a type of simulation-based inference. We train a deep neural network to map a simulated multiband image to a variational distribution over the underlying shear field, thereby folding galaxy detection, deblending, measurement, and calibration into a single implicit inference step. Once trained, the network accounts for all features present in the simulated images, including potential sources of bias. In experiments on simulated constant-shear images with increasingly complex observational effects, NPE produces accurate and well-calibrated posterior approximations for both shear components in the presence of blended galaxies, spatially varying point spread functions, stars, and detector artifacts. These results demonstrate that NPE can be a viable shear estimation method in settings where all anticipated features and artifacts can be simulated, a requirement that will become increasingly feasible as simulation fidelity improves in the coming decades.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出使用神经后验估计（NPE）来推断弱引力透镜剪切，将图像中的星系检测、去混叠、测量和校准整合为单个隐式推理步骤。在包含混合星系、空间变化点扩散函数、恒星和探测器伪影的模拟常数剪切图像上，NPE 产生了准确且校准良好的后验近似。该方法需要能够模拟所有预期特征和伪影，随着模拟保真度提高，其可行性将增强。
Motivation: 传统弱透镜剪切推断方法涉及多个步骤（星系检测、椭圆率估计、校准），其统计模型和假设难以刻画，导致不确定性传播困难。
Method: 训练深度神经网络将模拟多波段图像映射到剪切场的变分分布，通过模拟推断（simulation-based inference）方式将检测、去混叠、测量和校准隐含地纳入一个步骤。
Result: 在模拟常数剪切图像上，NPE 对两个剪切分量均产生了准确且校准良好的后验近似，即使存在混合星系、空间变化点扩散函数、恒星和探测器伪影等复杂观测效应。
Conclusion: NPE 在可模拟所有预期特征和伪影的设置中是一种可行的剪切估计方法，随着未来模拟保真度提升，其应用场景将更加广泛。

papers.title: Robo-ValueRL: Reliable Value Estimation for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Offline-to-online reinforcement learning is promising for generalizable robotic manipulation, yet its full-stack complexity obscures reproduction and diagnosis. Within such systems, value estimation plays a central role in prioritizing heterogeneous data for policy improvement. Despite its importance, the central question remains underexplored: how value-function reliability shapes policy optimization in offline-to-online reinforcement learning. To answer this question, we propose Robo-ValueRL, a unified framework that enables reliable value estimation and systematically traces its downstream effects on policy pretraining and online improvement. Concretely, Robo-ValueRL learns a history-conditioned value estimator and evaluates its reliability through global-progress and local-preference metrics. These resulting value estimates are propagated into quality-conditioned consistency-policy pretraining and a residual adaptation module on online rollouts, providing a unified testbed for analyzing how value reliability shapes downstream policy performance. Across 240 hours of offline demonstrations and over 3,000 online rollout trajectories, our extensive experiments show that downstream performance is strongly associated with value reliability. Reliable value functions provide better action-quality estimates, allowing value-guided offline RL to scale more effectively than quality-agnostic behavior cloning, and stabilize online improvement by prioritizing high-quality rollout data. Integrating reliable value guidance through offline pretraining with online improvement, our system achieves 86% success on millimeter-level precise chip insertion and 84% on generalizable block disassembly. We hope these findings highlight the importance of value-guided data utilization for effective policy improvement from heterogeneous robotic experience.
papers.comment: Please refer to our website: https://gewu-lab.github.io/Robo-ValueRL/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Robo-ValueRL 框架，用于离策略到在线强化学习中的可靠价值估计，并系统分析价值函数可靠性如何影响策略预训练和在线提升。在 240 小时离线演示和 3000 条在线轨迹上实验，发现可靠价值函数能提升动作质量估计、使离线 RL 优于行为克隆，并稳定在线改进。系统在毫米级精确芯片插入任务达到 86% 成功率，在可泛化积木拆卸任务达到 84% 成功率。
Motivation: 离策略到在线强化学习系统中价值估计对策略优化至关重要，但价值函数可靠性如何影响策略优化这一核心问题尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出 Robo-ValueRL 框架，学习历史条件价值估计器，通过全局进度和局部偏好指标评估其可靠性，并将价值估计传播到质量条件一致性策略预训练和在线轨迹的残差自适应模块。
Result: 实验表明下游性能与价值可靠性强相关；可靠价值函数提供更好的动作质量估计，使值引导的离线 RL 比质量无关的行为克隆更有效，并通过优先使用高质量轨迹数据稳定在线改进。系统在芯片插入和积木拆卸任务分别达到 86% 和 84% 成功率。
Conclusion: 该框架强调了价值引导的数据利用对于从异构机器人经验中实现有效策略改进的重要性。
