papers.title: From Direction to Magnitude: How Multimodal Instruction-Tuning Reorganizes the Geometric Encoding of Identity-Specifying Prompts in Transformer Hidden States
papers.abstract_en: We investigate whether identity-specifying system prompts produce statistically distinguishable geometric fingerprints in the hidden-state trajectories of four open-weight transformer language models spanning four post-training regimes: no training (Gemma-4-E4B base), multimodal RLHF (Gemma-4-E4B-it), RL distillation (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B), and SFT (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct). Three prompt conditions (an identity-specifying axis prompt, a length-matched generic-assistant prompt, and a 26-token vanilla baseline) are compared via five geometric metrics, principally the 1-Wasserstein distance between edge-wise distributions of Ollivier-Ricci curvature on k-NN trajectory graphs. Claims rest on trajectory-level permutation tests with multiple geometric controls (teacher-forced content controls, temporal-chain vs k-NN topology, ABT-projected k-NN, angular vs Euclidean graph construction, B=5000 permutations on borderline statistics). The central finding is a qualitative reorganization of identity encoding across the instruction-tuning boundary: in the base model the fingerprint is direction-coded (separation 0.034, p=0.002 under angular k-NN); in the multimodal instruction-tuned model it migrates into the magnitude (angular separation collapses to p=0.439 while Euclidean survives at p=0.042, and the mean norm of the first generated state inverts its length-ordering, being lowest for the identity prompt). This direction-to-magnitude reorganization is specific to the multimodal instruction-tuning regime, absent under RL distillation and SFT. A teacher-forced control attributes ~30% of the free-running cosine signal to prompt-driven effects. We position W_1 on edge-wise Ollivier-Ricci distributions on k-NN trajectory graphs as a methodological contribution of independent interest.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 8 tables. Working draft v0.3. Uses Ollivier-Ricci curvature and edge-wise Wasserstein-1 as primary geometric statistic; four models (Gemma-4-E4B, Gemma-4-E4B-it, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究身份指定系统提示（identity-specifying system prompts）在四种开放权重Transformer语言模型的隐藏状态轨迹中是否产生统计上可区分的几何指纹，涵盖无训练、多模态RLHF、RL蒸馏和SFT四种后训练范式。通过多种几何指标（主要是基于Ollivier-Ricci曲率边缘分布的1-Wasserstein距离）比较三种提示条件，发现多模态指令调优导致身份编码从方向编码重组为幅度编码。
Motivation: 探索身份指定提示在变压器隐藏状态中是否具有可区分的几何模式，以及不同后训练范式如何影响这种编码。
Method: 使用四种模型（Gemma-4-E4B base/it, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct），三种提示条件，通过k-NN轨迹图上Ollivier-Ricci曲率边缘分布的1-Wasserstein距离等几何指标进行统计分析，并进行排列检验和教师强制控制实验。
Result: 在基础模型中身份编码是方向编码（角度k-NN下分离度0.034，p=0.002）；在多模态指令调优模型中迁移到幅度编码（角度分离p=0.439，欧氏距离p=0.042，且第一个生成状态的平均范数长度反转）。这种重组仅出现在多模态指令调优中，RL蒸馏和SFT没有观察到。
Conclusion: 多模态指令调优重新组织了身份指定提示的几何编码，从方向转向幅度。作者还将基于Ollivier-Ricci曲率边缘分布的W_1距离作为一种独立的方法贡献。

papers.title: Exploring Agentic Workflows for Generating High Quality Math Visual Aids
papers.abstract_en: Mathematical diagrams play a crucial role in K 12 education, both as problem components and as scaffolding for student comprehension. However, current AI tools, including Large Language Models (LLMs), struggle to reliably generate accurate and pedagogically sound visual diagrams, even when provided with detailed descriptions. A significant gap therefore remains in the reliable generation of diagrams for middle school mathematics. To address this, we introduce an agentic workflow that enables LLM agents to evaluate the quality of generated visuals and use this feedback to iteratively improve their outputs. This self improvement loop aims to enhance the accuracy and educational appropriateness of AI generated diagrams. Our research investigates two questions. First, can LLMs accurately generate quality assurance questions for a visual aid given specific criteria for visual quality? Second, given valid quality assurance questions, can Vision Language Models effectively evaluate generated K 12 visual aids and use the resulting feedback to improve them iteratively? We conduct an exploratory evaluation of our agentic workflow and identify key areas for improvement, including stronger spatial reasoning and more comprehensive coverage of diagram features in the generated quality assurance questions. Our results provide preliminary evidence that this approach can improve the reliability and educational value of AI generated mathematical diagrams.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 9 figures. Exploratory course project on agentic workflows for generating and evaluating K 12 mathematical diagrams
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对K-12数学教育中AI工具难以生成准确且教育合理的视觉图表的问题，提出一种智能体工作流（agentic workflow），利用LLM代理生成质量保证问题，并让视觉语言模型（VLM）基于这些问题评估和迭代改进图表生成。初步探索表明，该方法能提升生成图表的可靠性和教育价值，但在空间推理和质量保证问题覆盖方面仍有改进空间。
Motivation: 当前AI工具（包括LLM）在根据详细描述生成数学图表时，难以保证准确性和教学合理性，这限制了它们在K-12教育中的应用。
Method: 提出一个智能体工作流：首先由LLM根据视觉质量标准自动生成质量保证问题，然后由VLM评估生成图表的符合程度，并将反馈用于迭代优化图表生成过程。
Result: 初步评估显示该方法能提升AI生成数学图表的可靠性和教育价值，但发现质量保证问题在空间推理和图表特征覆盖方面存在不足。
Conclusion: 本工作为通过智能体迭代反馈改善AI生成数学图表提供了初步证据，但需要进一步强化空间推理能力和问题生成的全面性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reliability-Aware Ensemble Classification Under Class Imbalance: A Calibration Study on Liquid-Based Cervical Cytology
papers.abstract_en: Cervical cytology classification models are typically evaluated on curated, class-balanced benchmarks, but real-world liquid-based cytology (LBC) collections are often small and class-imbalanced. This paper presents a class-imbalance-aware and calibration-aware ensemble classification study on the Mendeley LBC dataset, using its native four-class Bethesda taxonomy (NILM, LSIL, HSIL, SCC) rather than a collapsed binary formulation. Three lightweight architectures (Swin-Tiny, TinyViT-5M, DenseNet121) are trained directly on Mendeley LBC using weighted random sampling to counteract class imbalance, and compared against two soft-voting ensembles (Hybrid-2, Hybrid-3). Post-hoc temperature scaling is fit on a held-out calibration subset carved out of the training portion of each cross-validation fold, distinct from both the training data used to fit model weights and the evaluation fold used for final metrics, avoiding the optimistic calibration estimates that result when the same data is used for both purposes. Calibration substantially reduces expected calibration error, Brier score, and negative log-likelihood for every model and ensemble configuration tested, while discrimination metrics (accuracy, macro-F1, macro-AUROC) remain essentially unchanged. Ensemble size shows no consistent additional reliability benefit over the best individual model once all configurations are properly calibrated. Confusion matrices show that all classification errors, across every configuration, are confined to the boundary between high-grade lesions (HSIL) and carcinoma (SCC); no errors involve the negative (NILM) or low-grade (LSIL) categories. These results suggest that, for this dataset, calibration is the dominant lever for reliability, not ensemble size, though this conclusion should be read in light of the dataset's modest size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对宫颈液基细胞学分类中的类别不平衡与校准问题，在Mendeley LBC数据集上使用四类Bethesda分类法，比较了三种轻量架构（Swin-Tiny、TinyViT-5M、DenseNet121）及其软投票集成。通过加权随机采样缓解不平衡，并在交叉验证中独立划分校准子集进行温度缩放。校准显著降低了预期校准误差、Brier分数和负对数似然，但判别指标基本不变；集成规模在正确校准后未带来额外可靠性收益。所有错误均局限于HSIL与SCC之间，不涉及阴性或低级别类别。
Motivation: 真实世界的液基细胞学数据集通常规模小且类别高度不平衡，而现有评价多基于平衡的基准，缺乏对校准和可靠性的系统研究。
Method: 使用加权随机采样训练三个轻量模型（Swin-Tiny、TinyViT-5M、DenseNet121），并构建两个软投票集成（Hybrid-2、Hybrid-3）。在每折交叉验证中，从训练部分划出独立子集拟合温度缩放参数，避免校准数据污染。
Result: 校准后所有模型和集成的期望校准误差、Brier分数和负对数似然大幅降低，而准确率、宏F1和宏AUROC基本不变。最佳单个模型校准后与集成性能相当，且所有错误仅发生在HSIL与SCC之间。
Conclusion: 对于该数据集，校准是可靠性的主导因素，而非集成规模；但结论受限于数据集规模较小。

papers.title: Does YOLO26 Truly Offer Advantages Over Its Predecessors for Edge Deployment? A Benchmark Study in Aquaculture
papers.abstract_en: The recently introduced YOLO26 architecture incorporates NMS-free end-to-end inference and is optimized for deployment on resource-constrained CPU-based devices, making it well-suited for edge-based aquaculture applications. However, its performance, operational efficiency, and deployment suitability have not been systematically validated in aquaculture-specific scenarios. This study presents a comprehensive benchmark of YOLO26 against three Ultralytics predecessors (YOLOv5u, YOLOv8, and YOLO11) across nano, small, and medium model scales for fish mortality detection, a critical indicator of fish population health and welfare. Twelve model variants were evaluated for detection accuracy, training efficiency across seven dataset sizes, and inference performance on high-performance NVIDIA A100 GPUs and a CPU-only Raspberry Pi 5 edge platform. All models achieved comparable performance on the full dataset, with mAP50 differing by only 1.04 percentage points, indicating that architectural generation has little influence on final detection accuracy when sufficient training data are available. However, clear trade-offs emerged in data efficiency and deployment performance. YOLOv8 achieved 90% mAP50 with only 400 training images, whereas the YOLO26 nano and small variants required 1,000 images to reach comparable accuracy. Conversely, YOLO26n achieved the highest inference speed on the Raspberry Pi 5 (7.51 FPS), while YOLOv5mu outperformed all contemporary medium-scale architectures on CPU-based hardware. These results show that architectural novelty alone is insufficient for model selection and that training data availability, target hardware, and inference requirements should be considered jointly when selecting object detection models for practical edge AI deployment in aquaculture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对YOLO26及其前代模型（YOLOv5u、YOLOv8、YOLO11）在水产养殖边缘部署场景下进行基准测试，评估检测精度、训练数据效率和推理性能。实验表明，在完整数据集上所有模型性能接近（mAP50仅差1.04个百分点），但YOLOv8数据效率更高（400张图片达到90% mAP50），YOLO26n在树莓派5上推理最快（7.51 FPS）。结论是架构新颖性不足以指导模型选择，需综合考虑数据可用性、硬件和推理需求。
Motivation: 新提出的YOLO26虽然宣称适合边缘部署，但在水产养殖特定场景下的性能、效率和部署适用性尚未被系统验证。
Method: 对YOLO26与YOLOv5u、YOLOv8、YOLO11的nano、small、medium共12种变体进行基准测试，包括检测精度（mAP50）、数据效率（不同训练集大小）和推理性能（NVIDIA A100 GPU和树莓派5 CPU）。
Result: 所有模型在完整数据集上mAP50差距仅1.04个百分点；YOLOv8仅需400张训练图片即达90% mAP50，而YOLO26 nano和small需1000张；YOLO26n在树莓派5上推理速度最快（7.51 FPS），YOLOv5mu在CPU硬件上优于所有中等规模架构。
Conclusion: 架构新颖性不足以指导模型选择，应联合考虑训练数据量、目标硬件和推理需求。

papers.title: Generative Testing of Automated Speech Recognition Systems
papers.abstract_en: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems have achieved high accuracy with transformer-based models, enabling deployment in critical applications. However, they remain vulnerable to adversarial manipulation, particularly in black-box settings where attacks must preserve perceptual naturalness. This work introduces GATAS, a black-box testing approach that generates failure inducing inputs by operating in the phoneme-level latent space of a text- to-speech model. Instead of perturbing waveforms directly, the approach interpolates latent representations to induce transcription errors while remaining within the manifold of natural speech. The attack is formulated as a multi-objective optimization problem balancing semantic divergence and perceptual quality. Our empirical evaluation against both white-box and black-box baselines shows that GATAS achieves a 98% success rate while producing lower distortion and higher perceptual quality, as confirmed by human studies. Despite operating without gradient access, GATAS remains competitive against white-box methods, highlighting that representation and perceptual alignment are more critical than access to model internals. Overall, our results demonstrate that untargeted latent-space optimization enables the efficient generation of realistic and effective test cases for ASR systems.

papers.title: A Strong Balanced-Softmax Classifier-Retraining Baseline for Long-Tailed Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Long-tailed recognition methods often modify losses, margins, or representations to reduce the dominance of frequent classes. We ask whether, after Balanced Softmax training, the remaining tail error can be reduced by retraining only the classifier. We evaluate BS-cRT, a two-stage procedure that trains a backbone and cosine classifier with Balanced Softmax, freezes the backbone, and updates only the classifier on balanced episodic batches. The second stage keeps the empirical-prior Balanced Softmax objective and uses raw cosine logits at inference. Across CIFAR-100-LT, CIFAR-10-LT, ImageNet-LT, and Places-LT, this classifier-only step consistently improves Few-shot accuracy over the matched Balanced Softmax checkpoint. At imbalance factor 100, Few-shot gains are +5.15 points on CIFAR-100-LT and +5.83 on CIFAR-10-LT; on ImageNet-LT and Places-LT, gains are +6.92 and +9.78 points, respectively, with a Top-1/Few-shot trade-off on ImageNet-LT. We also analyze Counterfactual Boundary Risk Minimization (CBRM), a boundary-probe extension using prototype-based features near decision boundaries. CBRM identifies two failure modes: scaled-logit cosine margins destabilize training, and corrected hardest-negative probes remain head-class anchored. The results support BS-cRT as a practical classifier-side baseline and indicate that boundary supervision must account for class frequency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BS-cRT两阶段方法：先用Balanced Softmax训练backbone和余弦分类器，再冻结backbone仅重新训练分类器。在CIFAR-100-LT、CIFAR-10-LT、ImageNet-LT和Places-LT上，Few-shot准确率相比原检查点分别提升+5.15、+5.83、+6.92和+9.78点（不平衡因子100）。同时分析CBRM发现缩放余弦边界和困难负样本中心化问题。
Motivation: 现有长尾识别方法通常修改损失函数或表征，但能否在Balanced Softmax训练后仅通过重新训练分类器进一步减少尾类错误尚不清楚。
Method: 两阶段流程：1) 用Balanced Softmax训练backbone和余弦分类器；2) 冻结backbone，在平衡的episodic批次上仅更新分类器，保持Balanced Softmax目标并使用原始余弦logit推理。
Result: 在CIFAR-100-LT、CIFAR-10-LT、ImageNet-LT和Places-LT上，Few-shot准确率分别提升+5.15、+5.83、+6.92和+9.78点（不平衡因子100），但ImageNet-LT上存在Top-1/Few-shot权衡。
Conclusion: BS-cRT作为实用的分类器侧基线有效，但边界监督必须考虑类别频率；CBRM发现缩放余弦边界和头类锚定问题。

papers.title: Slide-Level Active Learning Reduces Annotation Burden in H&E images
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning-based segmentation of histopathology whole-slide images (WSIs) requires large amounts of pixel-level annotations, which are costly and time-consuming to obtain. Active learning (AL) has been proposed to reduce this effort, but existing methods exhibit three key limitations. Uncertainty estimation is unreliable on partially annotated WSIs, patch-level acquisition is inconsistent with slide-level annotation workflows, and class imbalance in multi-class settings is not explicitly addressed. To address these challenges, we propose SHAL (Slide-level Hybrid Active Learning), a patient-level AL framework for annotation-efficient multi-class histopathology segmentation. SHAL integrates three complementary components: a foreground-aware strategy that suppresses bias from unlabeled background regions, a stage-adaptive mechanism that hybridizes predictive entropy and epistemic uncertainty across learning stages, and a class-aware strategy that prioritizes diagnostically relevant tissue classes. SHAL is evaluated on the TCGA colorectal cancer dataset. It achieves the highest Macro Dice at the full annotation budget (0.846) and reaches Dice greater than or equal to 0.80 using only 26 percent of the budget (50 of 190 slides), whereas competing methods reach this threshold only at 37 percent (70 slides). Across five independent external cohorts, SHAL attains the highest mean external Macro Dice (0.815) and the smallest internal-to-external generalization gap among all methods (0.025 at Round 3 and 0.026 at the full budget). The results indicate that patient-level hybrid uncertainty acquisition reduces annotation cost without sacrificing cross-domain generalization in computational pathology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SHAL（Slide-level Hybrid Active Learning），一种面向HE染色组织病理学全切片图像（WSI）多类分割的患者级主动学习框架。SHAL集成了前景感知策略（抑制未标注背景区域偏差）、阶段自适应机制（混合预测熵与认知不确定性）和类别感知策略（优先标注诊断相关组织类别）。在TCGA结直肠癌数据集上，SHAL在全标注预算下达到最高Macro Dice（0.846），仅用26%预算（50/190张切片）即可达到Dice≥0.80，而对比方法需37%预算（70张切片）。在五个独立外部队列中，SHAL获得最高平均外部Macro Dice（0.815）和最小的内外部泛化差距（第3轮0.025，全预算0.026）。
Motivation: 现有主动学习方法在部分标注的WSI上存在三个局限：不确定性估计不可靠、补丁级获取与切片级标注工作流不一致、多类设置中未显式处理类别不平衡。
Method: 提出SHAL框架，包含三个互补组件：前景感知策略抑制未标注背景区域偏差；阶段自适应机制在不同学习阶段混合预测熵与认知不确定性；类别感知策略优先考虑诊断相关的组织类别。
Result: 在TCGA数据集上，全标注预算下Macro Dice为0.846，仅用26%的标注预算（50/190切片）即达到Dice≥0.80（对比方法需37%预算，70切片）。在五个外部队列中，平均外部Macro Dice为0.815，内外部泛化差距最小（第3轮0.025，全预算0.026）。
Conclusion: 患者级混合不确定性获取方法能减少标注成本且不牺牲跨域泛化能力，适用于计算病理学。

papers.title: Tracking Intermittent Particles with Self-Learned Visual Features
papers.abstract_en: In time-lapse fluorescence imaging, single-particle-tracking is a powerful tool to monitor the dynamics of objects of interest, and extract information about biological processes. However, tracked particles can be subject to occlusion and intermittent detectability. When these phenomena persist over a few frames, tracking algorithms tend to produce multiple tracklets for the same particle. In this work, we introduce self-supervised learning of visual features to compare tracked particles, and we exploit both visual and positional distances to robustly stitch tracklets representing the same particle. We demonstrate the performance of our stitching framework on time-lapse fluorescence sequences of Hydra vulgaris neurons. Results show high stitching precision, and reduction of errors made by previous algorithms on the same data by a factor of two.
papers.journal_ref: 2023 IEEE 20th International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI), Apr 2023, Cartagena, France. pp.1-5
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时间序列荧光成像中粒子因遮挡和间歇性检测导致的轨道片段断裂问题，提出利用自监督学习视觉特征来比较粒子，并结合视觉和位置距离鲁棒地拼接属于同一粒子的轨道片段。在Hydra vulgaris神经元荧光序列上的实验表明，该框架实现了高拼接精度，并将先前算法的错误减少一半。
Motivation: 时间序列荧光成像中，粒子常因遮挡和间歇性检测导致跟踪算法产生多个轨道片段，影响动态分析的准确性。
Method: 引入自监督学习的视觉特征来比较粒子，融合视觉相似度和位置距离，实现轨道片段的鲁棒拼接。
Result: 在Hydra vulgaris神经元荧光序列上，拼接精度高，且将先前算法的错误率降低为原来的二分之一。
Conclusion: 自监督视觉特征有效提升了间歇性粒子轨道拼接的准确性，有望应用于生物成像中的长期粒子追踪。

papers.title: Robustness and Stability Analysis of Differentiable Shift-Variant FBP for Cone-Beam CT under Challenging Acquisition Settings
papers.abstract_en: The differentiable shift-variant filtered backprojection (SV-FBP) framework enables data-driven estimation of redundancy weights for cone-beam CT reconstruction under general source trajectories, removing the need for analytically derived weighting schemes. In this work, we present a systematic study of the robustness and adaptability of differentiable SV-FBP under challenging acquisition settings. We show that the framework remains stable across highly irregular and discontinuous trajectories, indicating that reconstruction performance is largely insensitive to trajectory ordering or continuity. Instead, the spatial distribution of sampling points plays a more dominant role. Under sparse-view conditions, differentiable SV-FBP achieves competitive reconstruction quality while providing an order-of-magnitude reduction in computation time compared to iterative reconstruction methods at moderate sampling densities. However, we identify a clear transition regime under severe undersampling, where the absence of iterative data consistency leads to performance degradation. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the framework remains applicable to non-planar multi-isocenter geometries, such as Lissajous-saddle trajectories, without requiring architectural modifications. These findings provide new insights into the behavior and limitations of the differentiable SV-FBP model and highlight it as a flexible and efficient solution for non-standard and robotic CBCT acquisition scenarios.

papers.journal_ref: Machine.Learning.for.Biomedical.Imaging. 2026 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了可微移变滤波反投影（SV-FBP）框架在锥束CT挑战性采集设置下的鲁棒性和稳定性。结果表明，该框架对高度不规则和非连续轨迹保持稳定，重建性能对轨迹顺序或连续性不敏感，而采样点空间分布起主导作用。在稀疏视角条件下，可微SV-FBP在中等采样密度下重建质量有竞争力，计算时间比迭代重建方法低一个数量级，但在严重欠采样时因缺乏迭代数据一致性而性能下降。框架无需修改架构即可适用于非平面多中心几何（如Lissajous-saddle轨迹）。
Motivation: 去除解析推导权重方案的可微SV-FBP框架需要系统验证其在非标准轨迹和稀疏视角等挑战性采集条件下的鲁棒性和适应性，以支持其用于非标准和机器人锥束CT采集场景。
Method: 采用可微SV-FBP框架，通过数据驱动估计冗余权重，并在多种挑战性采集设置（不规则轨迹、稀疏视角、非平面多中心几何）下进行系统实验研究。
Result: 可微SV-FBP在高度不规则轨迹下稳定，计算时间比迭代重建方法低一个数量级（中等采样密度），但在严重欠采样时性能下降。框架无需修改即可用于Lissajous-saddle等非平面多中心几何。
Conclusion: 可微SV-FBP是非标准和机器人锥束CT采集场景中灵活高效的解决方案，但其在严重欠采样下的局限性需要通过引入迭代数据一致性来克服。

papers.title: TDSal: Task-Based Top-Down Saliency Prediction Model
papers.abstract_en: Visual saliency aims to predict the regions of an image most likely to attract human visual attention. While most saliency models assume free-viewing conditions, human attention is often shaped by explicit task goals. In this work, we address task-driven saliency prediction by proposing a model that conditions visual attention on natural-language task descriptions. The model produces task-dependent saliency maps that reflect how attention shifts under different viewing intents. Through quantitative and qualitative analysis, we show that incorporating explicit task semantics enables more faithful modeling of goal-directed visual attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TDSal 模型，通过自然语言任务描述来预测任务驱动的视觉显著性，生成与观看意图相关的显著性图。定性及定量实验表明，引入显式任务语义能够更准确地建模目标导向的视觉注意力。
Motivation: 现有显著性预测模型大多假设自由观看条件，而实际中人类注意力常受具体任务目标影响，缺乏对任务驱动注意力的建模。
Method: 提出一个基于自然语言任务描述的视觉显著性预测模型，将任务语义作为条件输入，生成任务相关的显著性图。
Result: 通过定量和定性分析，显示显式任务语义能够更忠实地建模目标导向的视觉注意力。
Conclusion: 该工作表明结合任务描述有助于提升显著性模型在目标驱动场景下的表现。

papers.title: Towards Objective Dysgraphia Detection: A Multi-Branch Deep Learning Approach for Online Handwriting Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Dysgraphia is a specific learning disability that is prevalent among school-age children. It affects handwriting coherence, quality, fluency, and legibility, often hindering academic achievement and early learning development. This motor coordination disorder is typically diagnosed through subjective assessments based on clinician observation, which can be timeconsuming and prone to variability. In this paper, we introduce a deep learning-based framework for objective dysgraphia detection using online handwriting data captured via digitizing tablets. The proposed framework relies on two complementary branches: the first pipeline extracts both handcrafted and embedding-based kinematic features directly from raw temporal signals, while the second leverages image-based representations of the temporal signals generated using continuous wavelet transforms (CWT) and Gramian Angular Fields (GAF). The resulting features are then fused to leverage the complementary strengths of both representations. The four representations were evaluated separately and jointly using the publicly available DiaGraMo dataset, showing that the fusion of GAF, MOMENT, and hand-crafted kinematic features outperforms each individual representation, as well as other fusion schemes. These findings highlight the potential of the complementarity of image and signal based representations for more objective dysgraphia detection.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于深度学习的多分支框架，用于客观检测学龄儿童的书写障碍（dysgraphia）。框架结合了手部特征和基于图像的表征（连续小波变换和格拉姆角场），并在DiaGraMo数据集上验证了融合方法的优越性。
Motivation: 传统书写障碍诊断依赖临床医生主观评估，耗时且存在变异；需要客观、自动化的检测方法。
Method: 提出双分支深度学习框架：第一分支从原始时间序列提取手工和嵌入式的运动学特征；第二分支通过连续小波变换（CWT）和格拉姆角场（GAF）生成图像表征，并将多模态特征融合。
Result: 在DiaGraMo数据集上，融合GAF、MOMENT和手工运动学特征的方法优于单独使用任何表征或其他融合方案，表明信号与图像表征的互补性有助于客观检测。
Conclusion: 该框架展示了多模态表征融合在书写障碍客观检测中的潜力，但摘要未提及局限性与泛化性。

papers.title: More Structure, Not More Capacity: Object-Centric Representations for Visuomotor Imitation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation policies rely on pre-trained vision models that give either a global scene embedding or a dense patch grid. Both mix task-relevant and task-irrelevant features. Object-centric slot representations are a structured alternative: they group features into a few per-object slots. We test what this structure buys on ManiSkill3 PickCube-v1, with a frozen encoder and a held-out-seed evaluation. Holding the policy, goal token, rendering, and calibration fixed and changing only the encoder, a frozen object-centric SPOT representation (DINO ViT-B/16 + Slot Attention) reaches 55.0$\pm$2.9% success, 22.4% above a dense DINO global-feature baseline (32.6 $\pm$ 1.5%), with the same trainable policy and no encoder fine-tuning. More tokens alone do not help: a dense patch grid with 16x the tokens performs no better than the global feature. Adding an explicit 2D spatial goal and native-resolution rendering raises the full system to 68.7$\pm$4.2%, just below a privileged 3D-oracle upper bound (71.7$\pm$4.1%). An automated kinematic failure taxonomy then separates spatial-precision (Near-Miss) failures from object-tracking (No-Grasp) failures: spatial grounding reduces Near-Miss while leaving No- Grasp unchanged. The same taxonomy transfers to the harder StackCube-v1 and points to occlusion as the main bottleneck.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究目标中心表示（object-centric representations）在机器人模仿学习中的作用，发现结构化的槽表示（slot representations）比全局特征或密集补丁网格更有效。在ManiSkill3 PickCube-v1任务中，使用冻结的SPOT表示（DINO ViT-B/16 + Slot Attention）达到55.0%成功率，比密集DINO全局特征基线高22.4%，且增加空间信息后性能接近特权3D oracle。此外，通过自动运动学失败分类分析失败原因。
Motivation: 现有机器人策略依赖预训练视觉模型产生全局嵌入或密集补丁网格，两者混合了任务相关与无关特征。目标中心表示作为一种结构化替代方案，有望解耦特征，但尚不清楚其在模仿学习中的实际收益。
Method: 采用目标中心槽表示（SPOT，基于DINO ViT-B/16和Slot Attention），冻结编码器，仅训练策略；与全局特征、密集补丁网格等基线对比；引入显式2D空间目标和原生分辨率渲染；并开发自动化运动学失败分类法（区分Near-Miss和No-Grasp失败）。
Result: 在ManiSkill3 PickCube-v1上，冻结SPOT表示成功率为55.0±2.9%，比密集DINO全局特征基线（32.6±1.5%）高22.4%；密集补丁网格（16倍token）性能不优于全局特征；加入空间信息和原生分辨率后全系统达68.7±4.2%，接近特权3D oracle（71.7±4.1%）。失败分类表明空间接地减少Near-Miss，但不影响No-Grasp。在StackCube-v1上，遮挡被识别为主要瓶颈。
Conclusion: 目标中心表示的结构性改进而非增加容量是提升机器人模仿学习的关键；该方法在简单任务中接近特权3D oracle性能，但需解决遮挡问题以应对更复杂场景。

papers.title: Memory-Conditioned Tool Calling for Camera-First Visual Agents
papers.abstract_en: Recognition tells an agent what is in an image; personal memory affects what is worth looking up next. In a camera-first setting the user can send only an image, so the agent must form the lookups. We study whether personal visual memory improves agent-side tool choice and tool arguments, and thereby more user-aligned multi-tool lookups. The design uses a three-layer personal visual memory (profile, short-term focus, observations) that is loaded on each turn to condition an LLM tool-calling loop under camera-first intake, and includes conflict-aware write-back intended to refresh the user model for later captures. On 800 images paired with synthetic memory blocks constructed for controlled ablation, removing the full three-layer memory block reduces tool-query relevance by 0.47 points absolute (4.21 -> 3.74 on a 5-point scale; 11.2% relative) and end-to-end utility by 0.082 absolute (0.842 -> 0.760; 9.7% relative). These results measure memory conditioning of tool policy under image-only intake with fixed synthetic blocks, not multi-session write-back from live user histories.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Equal contribution: Xiaofan Wu, Xi Zeng. Corresponding author: xiaofan@chance.vision
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨在仅输入图像的相机优先设置下，如何利用个人视觉记忆来改进智能代理的工具调用。设计了一种三层个人视觉记忆（档案、短期焦点、观察）结构，在每个回合加载以调节LLM工具调用循环，并包含冲突感知回写。在800张图像配合合成记忆块的受控消融实验中，移除完整记忆块导致工具查询相关性下降0.47（5分制下降11.2%），端到端效用下降0.082（9.7%）。
Motivation: 现有视觉代理在仅接收图像时，缺乏个人记忆来指导下一步应该查找什么，导致工具选择和参数不够符合用户意图。
Method: 提出三层个人视觉记忆（profile, short-term focus, observations），在每个回合加载以调节LLM工具调用循环，并包含冲突感知回写以更新用户模型。
Result: 在800张图像与合成记忆块的消融实验中，移除完整三层记忆块使工具查询相关性从4.21降至3.74（绝对下降0.47，相对11.2%），端到端效用从0.842降至0.760（绝对下降0.082，相对9.7%）。
Conclusion: 个人视觉记忆能显著改善基于图像输入的工具调用策略，但当前实验基于固定合成记忆块，尚未验证多会话回写来自真实用户历史的效果。

papers.title: Performance Benchmarking and Optimisation of Clustering Algorithms for Local and Non-Local Similarity Measure in Medical Image Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Medical imaging generates high-resolution images posing significant storage, transmission, and computational challenges. While low-rank matrix approximation (LoRMA) techniques offer efficient compression by exploiting structural redundancy, global approaches often fail to preserve local details critical for diagnosis. This paper focuses on clustering techniques that exploit non-local self-similarity to identify structurally similar regions in medical images. These clusters can be used for post-processing tasks such as adaptive image compression. We evaluate five clustering techniques: k-means, mini-batch k-means, agglomerative hierarchical clustering, balanced iterative reducing and clustering using hierarchies (BIRCH), and bisecting k-means across MRI, ultrasound, and chest X-ray modalities. All clustering techniques were optimised using random search, and cluster quality was assessed using the Silhouette score, the Davies-Bouldin (DB) index, and the Calinski-Harabasz (CH) index. Results demonstrate that standard k-means and bisecting k-means generally achieve strong cluster cohesion and separation across modalities. However, they tend to form a small number of clusters with high intra-cluster variability, limiting their effectiveness for post-processing tasks such as adaptive compression. Agglomerative clustering outperformed other techniques for MRI and ultrasound in terms of intra-cluster homogeneity, making it more suitable for preserving fine diagnostic details. For chest X-rays, mini-batch k-means achieved the best balance between clustering quality and intra-cluster compactness. BIRCH consistently underperformed across all modalities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在MRI、超声和胸部X光三种医学影像模态上，系统比较了k-means、mini-batch k-means、凝聚层次聚类、BIRCH和二分k-means五种聚类算法。通过随机搜索优化超参数，使用轮廓系数、Davies-Bouldin指数和Calinski-Harabasz指数评估聚类质量。结果表明标准k-means和二分k-means具有较好的类内紧密性和类间分离性，但易形成少量高方差簇；凝聚聚类在MRI和超声上类内均匀性最优；mini-batch k-means在X光上平衡了质量和紧凑性；BIRCH在所有模态上表现最差。
Motivation: 医学图像压缩中，全局低秩近似方法常丢失局部诊断细节，而基于非局部自相似性的聚类可保留结构相似区域，但缺乏不同聚类技术在该场景下的系统性比较与优化。
Method: 选取五种聚类算法（k-means、mini-batch k-means、凝聚层次聚类、BIRCH、二分k-means），通过随机搜索进行超参数优化，在MRI、超声和胸部X光图像上评估聚类质量，使用轮廓系数、DB指数和CH指数衡量。
Result: 标准k-means和二分k-means在多数模态下获得高簇内紧密性和簇间分离性，但簇内变异较大；凝聚聚类在MRI和超声上类内均匀性最优；mini-batch k-means在胸部X光上实现最佳质量与紧凑性平衡；BIRCH在所有模态均表现不佳。
Conclusion: 凝聚聚类适合保留精细诊断细节，mini-batch k-means适合X光图像中自适应压缩的预处理，而BIRCH不推荐用于医学图像聚类。

papers.title: Learning Predictive Ambiguity Sets for Decision-Focused Distributionally Robust Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Predict-then-optimize systems usually compress uncertainty into a point forecast and then solve a downstream optimization problem as if the forecast were reliable. Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) offers protection against misspecification, but the ambiguity set is often centered at historical samples and uses a fixed radius. We propose \emph{learned predictive ambiguity sets} (LPAS): a deep contextual model outputs a finite nominal scenario distribution, a state-dependent Wasserstein radius, and optionally an anisotropic ground metric. These outputs define a contextual ambiguity set that feeds a DRO decision layer. The radius is trained by a combination of conditional quantile calibration, size regularization, and downstream decision loss, so that robustness is adaptive rather than globally fixed. We derive the finite dual form used by the decision layer, present a staged training algorithm, and evaluate the method on distributionally robust portfolio optimization with 20 S&P 500 constituents from 2018--2026. The proposed method substantially improves over equal-weight, predict-then-optimize, and historical Wasserstein DRO baselines, achieving 26.28% annualized return, Sharpe ratio 1.30, final wealth 1.61, and lower tail loss than a deep fixed-radius DRO baseline while using a smaller average radius. The results show that learned ambiguity radii can recover most of the performance of strong fixed-radius DRO while reducing unnecessary conservatism and improving regime adaptivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出学习预测歧义集（LPAS）用于决策驱动的分布鲁棒优化。LPAS通过深度上下文模型输出名义情景分布、状态依赖的Wasserstein半径和可选各向异性地面度量，从而构造上下文歧义集。半径通过条件分位数校准、规模正则化和下游决策损失联合训练。在2018-2026年标普500成分股的分布鲁棒投资组合优化中，LPAS实现了26.28%的年化收益率、1.30的夏普比率和1.61的最终财富，同时平均半径小于固定半径DRO基线。
Motivation: 预测-优化系统通常将不确定性压缩为点预测，然后求解下游优化问题，但点预测可能不可靠。分布鲁棒优化（DRO）提供对误设的保护，但歧义集通常以历史样本为中心并使用固定半径，缺乏适应性。
Method: 提出学习预测歧义集（LPAS）：深度上下文模型输出有限名义情景分布、状态依赖的Wasserstein半径和可选各向异性地面度量。半径通过条件分位数校准、规模正则化和下游决策损失训练，使鲁棒性自适应而非全局固定。推导了决策层使用的有限对偶形式，并提出了分阶段训练算法。
Result: 在20只标普500成分股（2018-2026）的分布鲁棒投资组合优化中，LPAS优于等权重、预测-优化和历史Wasserstein DRO基线，实现26.28%年化收益、1.30夏普比率、1.61最终财富，且尾部损失低于深度固定半径DRO基线，同时使用更小的平均半径。
Conclusion: 学习到的歧义半径可以恢复强固定半径DRO的大部分性能，同时减少不必要的保守性并提高机制适应性。

summary_sections.method: 提出学习预测歧义集（LPAS）：深度上下文模型输出有限名义情景分布、状态依赖的Wasserstein半径和可选各向异性地面度量。半径通过条件分位数校准、规模正则化和下游决策损失训练，使鲁棒性自适应而非全局固定。推导了决策层使用的有限对偶形式，并提出了分阶段训练算法。
summary_sections.result: 在20只标普500成分股（2018-2026）的分布鲁棒投资组合优化中，LPAS优于等权重、预测-优化和历史Wasserstein DRO基线，实现26.28%年化收益、1.30夏普比率、1.61最终财富，且尾部损失低于深度固定半径DRO基线，同时使用更小的平均半径。
summary_sections.conclusion: 学习到的歧义半径可以恢复强固定半径DRO的大部分性能，同时减少不必要的保守性并提高机制适应性。

papers.title: TS-Mask VLA: 2D Temporal-Spatial Masking for Vision-Language-Action Model with Effective Bridging
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models aim to understand natural-language instructions and visual observations, and to generate and execute corresponding actions as embodied agents. Recently, autoregressive token-based action generation has driven the development of many representative VLA models. However, this paradigm often reduces action generation to next-token prediction, thereby lacking explicit modeling of the spatiotemporal structure of action sequences and the disentanglement between vision-language representations and actions, which can limit performance in long-horizon and complex scenarios. In this paper, we propose TS-Mask VLA, a vision-language-action framework for robot manipulation. TS-Mask VLA is built upon two key designs: (1) a Discrete Diffusion Action Expert equipped with a Bridge Attention conditioning bridge, which enables multi-layer conditioning from the VLM and facilitates more accurate and stable action generation; and (2) a temporal-spatial 2D masking strategy for discrete action tokens that strengthens the model's understanding of cross-time dependencies and inter-dimensional coupling, leading to more structurally consistent action sequences. We conduct extensive experiments on simulation benchmarks and real-world tasks. On LIBERO, TS-Mask VLA achieves a 95.7 percent average success rate with only 0.5B parameters, outperforming significantly larger models. On CALVIN, it attains the best average sequence length of 4.19 and strong long-horizon performance. Comprehensive analyses and ablations further validate the effectiveness of our design.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TS-Mask VLA，一种用于机器人操作的视觉-语言-动作框架，通过离散扩散动作专家和桥接注意力机制实现多层级视觉语言模型条件作用，并采用时空2D掩码策略以增强动作序列的结构一致性。在LIBERO和CALVIN模拟基准及真实世界任务上取得了显著性能，以0.5B参数在LIBERO上达到95.7%的平均成功率。
Motivation: 现有自回归令牌生成动作的方法缺乏对动作序列时空结构的显式建模，且视觉语言表示与动作之间的解耦不足，限制了长时域和复杂场景下的性能。
Method: 构建两个关键设计：(1) 离散扩散动作专家（Discrete Diffusion Action Expert）配合桥接注意力（Bridge Attention）条件桥，实现从VLM的多层条件作用以稳定动作生成；(2) 针对离散动作令牌的时空2D掩码策略，加强跨时间依赖和维度间耦合。
Result: 在LIBERO上以0.5B参数达到95.7%平均成功率，优于更大的模型；在CALVIN上获得最佳平均序列长度4.19和强长时域性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提的时空掩码和条件桥接设计能有效提升VLA模型在机器人操作任务中的性能和结构一致性。

papers.title: Estimation, Prediction, and Assortment Optimization for Markov Chain Choice Models with Panel Data
papers.abstract_en: We propose a framework for the Markov chain (MC) choice model with panel data, including parameter estimation, personalized choice prediction, and personalized assortment optimization. In contrast to the traditional setting, which assumes that each transaction is independently drawn from a random utility model, our framework accounts for dependencies among transactions for the same customer in historical data, captured by partial-ordering preference information. To the best of our knowledge, our framework initiates the study of choice modeling with panel data under MC. As our primary result, we propose novel expectation-maximization (EM) algorithms for MC parameter estimation by incorporating partial-ordering-based customer preference information. On synthetic datasets and the sushi dataset, our EM algorithms outperform the traditional EM algorithm of Simsek and Topaloglu (Operations Research, 66, 2018) and multinomial-logit-based partial-order benchmarks adapted from Jagabathula and Vulcano (Management Science, 64, 2018). As our secondary contribution, we present hardness and computational results for conditional choice prediction and assortment optimization problems. These results complement our estimation framework and clarify the computational landscape of conditional choice and assortment optimization, which may be of independent interest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对面板数据下的马尔可夫链（MC）选择模型，提出了包含参数估计、个性化选择预测和个性化品类优化的统一框架。与传统假设每笔交易独立同分布不同，该框架利用顾客历史交易中的偏序偏好信息建模依赖关系。提出了基于偏序的期望最大化（EM）算法，在合成数据集和寿司数据集上优于传统EM算法和多项logit偏序基准。此外，还给出了条件选择预测和品类优化问题的难度与计算结果。
Motivation: 现有马尔可夫链选择模型通常假设交易独立，忽略了同一顾客历史交易间的依赖关系。面板数据中包含了同一顾客的多次交易，如何利用这种依赖关系改进参数估计和预测是一个开放问题。
Method: 提出基于偏序偏好信息的期望最大化（EM）算法用于MC参数估计，同时研究条件选择预测和品类优化问题的计算复杂度。
Result: 在合成数据集和寿司数据集上，所提EM算法优于Simsek和Topaloglu (2018)的传统EM算法以及基于多项logit的偏序基准。此外，提供了条件选择预测和品类优化问题的硬度结果。
Conclusion: 该框架首次将面板数据引入马尔可夫链选择模型，并展示了利用偏序信息提升估计性能的潜力。计算复杂度结果对相关研究有独立参考价值。

papers.title: RUBRIC: Realism--Utility Balanced Ranking for Imbalanced Classification
papers.abstract_en: Class imbalance poses a fundamental challenge in risk-sensitive applications such as fraud detection and medical diagnosis, where minority-class samples are scarce yet critical for accurate classification. Existing oversampling methods generate synthetic samples to rebalance class distributions; however, they often produce large numbers of low-quality candidates that distort decision boundaries or introduce artifacts, leading to overfitting and degraded generalization. In this work, we introduce RUBRIC, a generator-agnostic filtering framework that formulates synthetic sample selection as a quality-over-quantity optimization problem. RUBRIC ranks candidates using a realism-utility trade-off: realism is quantified by a learned discriminator that distinguishes real samples from synthetic samples, while utility captures proximity to the decision boundary through a concave margin-based scoring function. We show that, under mild regularity conditions, the proposed filtering strategy monotonically tightens the generalization bound for margin-based classifiers by jointly reducing distribution shift and suppressing near-negative tail contributions. Through extensive experiments on credit-card fraud detection and other imbalanced benchmarks, we demonstrate that RUBRIC improves F1-macro and recall while maintaining comparable ROC-AUC across several generators. We also provide explicit lambda-sensitivity analysis to show how users can recover AUPRC when ranking quality is prioritized.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RUBRIC 框架，一种生成器无关的过滤方法，通过平衡真实性和实用性来筛选合成样本，以改善不平衡分类中的过拟合和泛化问题。在信用卡欺诈检测等基准上，RUBRIC 提升了 F1-macro 和召回率，同时保持了相当的 ROC-AUC。
Motivation: 现有过采样方法生成大量低质量合成样本，扭曲决策边界或引入伪影，导致过拟合和泛化能力下降。
Method: RUBRIC 将合成样本选择建模为质量-数量优化问题，使用学习判别器量化真实性，通过基于边际的凹评分函数量化实用性，并联合优化以减少分布偏移和抑制近负尾部贡献。
Result: 在信用卡欺诈检测等不平衡基准上，RUBRIC 改进了 F1-macro 和召回率，同时保持了相当的 ROC-AUC。提供了 λ 敏感性分析以调整 AUPRC。
Conclusion: RUBRIC 是一种有效的合成样本过滤策略，可提升不平衡分类器的泛化性能，适用于风险敏感应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RASR: Range-Aware Scale Recovery for Metric UAV Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Under Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) denial, a UAV controller still needs a distance and heading command it can execute, making accurate metric last-meter navigation essential. Dense pair-geometry foundation models transfer relative structure well, yet the distance scale of their raw metric outputs remains poorly calibrated. Under the relative error metric of PairUAV, correcting only the average scale can still leave costly, distance-dependent residuals near the goal. To address this scale mismatch, Range-Aware Scale Recovery (RASR) separates a transferable scale-recovery core from a protocol-specific calibration module in a per-pair system fixed at inference. The core compresses frozen Matching And Stereo 3D Reconstruction (MASt3R)-style geometry into a compact descriptor and uses global calibration to recover the dominant metric signal. Range-bucket residual correction and command-grid alignment stay inside the calibration module, so they match the command format and evaluation protocol of PairUAV. On the UAVs in Multimedia 2026 PairUAV online evaluation, RASR reaches a total score of 0.003189. Under the PairUAV protocol, frozen pair geometry thus yields stable per-pair distance and heading estimates, while every protocol-specific adjustment stays confined to a calibration module fixed before inference. Code and materials are available at https://github.com/lht-research/rasr-pairuav.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 4 figures. Technical report for the UAVM 2026 PairUAV Challenge
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RASR方法，用于解决无人机在GNSS拒止环境下导航中距离尺度不准确的问题。RASR将可迁移的尺度恢复核心与协议特定的校准模块分离，在PairUAV评估中取得0.003189的总分。方法基于MASt3R几何模型和全局校准，并通过范围桶残差校正和对齐命令网格。
Motivation: 现有的密集对几何基础模型能很好地传递相对结构，但原始度量输出的距离尺度校准不佳，在PairUAV相对误差指标下，仅校正平均尺度仍会在接近目标时留下代价高昂的、与距离相关的残差。
Method: RASR将可迁移的尺度恢复核心与协议特定的校准模块分离，核心压缩冻结的MASt3R几何为紧凑描述符并使用全局校准恢复主导度量信号，校准模块包含范围桶残差校正和命令网格对齐。
Result: 在UAVs in Multimedia 2026 PairUAV在线评估中，RASR达到总分为0.003189。
Conclusion: 在PairUAV协议下，冻结的配对几何提供稳定的每对距离和航向估计，而每个协议特定调整都限制在校准模块中，该模块在推理前固定。

papers.title: CHM-Net: Center Heatmap-driven Macro-Micro Modeling Network for MRI-based Microbial Density Stratification
papers.abstract_en: Microbial density is clinically important for tumor assessment and treatment decision-making, and recent advances in deep learning suggest that it can be non-invasively inferred from multimodal MRI. In this work, MRI-based Microbial Density Stratification (MRI-MDS) is first investigated as a patient-level representation learning task, and Center Heatmap-driven Macro-micro modeling Network (CHM-Net) is introduced for this task. CHM-Net first establishes the link between imaging phenotypes and microbial states through center heatmap-guided small-lesion response localization. Building upon this, it constructs patient-level macro-micro evidence from localized heatmap responses for microbial density prediction. Experiments on the novel GBNPC 2026 dataset constructed for MRI-MDS demonstrate the effectiveness of CHM-Net, achieving superior performance over representative baselines with a 12.06% absolute ACC gain over the strongest competing result. Additionally, auxiliary validation on two 3D medical image datasets further verifies its robustness across volumetric medical image classification scenarios. The project is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CHM-Net-942E/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将MRI-based Microbial Density Stratification (MRI-MDS) 作为患者级表示学习任务，提出中心热图驱动的宏观-微观建模网络 (CHM-Net)。CHM-Net通过中心热图引导的小病灶响应定位建立影像表型与微生物状态之间的联系，并利用局部热图响应构建患者级宏观-微观证据用于微生物密度预测。在GBNPC 2026数据集上，CHM-Net相比最强基线获得12.06%的绝对准确率提升，并在两个3D医学图像数据集上验证了鲁棒性。
Motivation: 微生物密度在肿瘤评估和治疗决策中具有临床重要性，但非侵入性推断仍具挑战。现有工作未将其作为患者级表示学习任务进行系统研究。
Method: 提出CHM-Net，包含中心热图引导的小病灶响应定位模块，用于建立影像表型与微生物状态的链接；然后基于定位的热图响应构建患者级宏观-微观证据，用于密度预测。
Result: 在GBNPC 2026数据集上，CHM-Net取得最佳性能，绝对准确率比最强基线提升12.06%。在另外两个3D医学图像分类数据集上验证了方法的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: CHM-Net有效结合了宏观-微观建模，在MRI-MDS任务上优于现有方法，并具有泛化能力。

papers.title: Detangled: A Framework for Creating, Editing, and Inferencing Feature Rich Hair Strands
papers.abstract_en: We present a framework for understanding and generating feature rich hair strands. Drawing upon both scientific and cultural expertise, we define strand texture as the various distinctive patterns (curling, switchbacks, twist, etc.) that are formed by forces internal to a hair strand. We begin by proposing a novel five-dimensional parameter space, intended to be a bijection with naturally occurring hair strand textures. This encoding is both qualitatively accessible, allowing users to readily locate their own hair in the parameter space, and quantitatively precise, allowing the generation of individual strands from texture inputs. Importantly, strand texture should be independent from the overall strand direction. In order to disentangle strand texture from the overall strand direction, we identify centerline geometry and use it to map strands into a canonical space (a strand texture space). We construct centerlines using a novel method that cleanly distills complex hair grooms, separating the strand texture from the overall style (parameterized by style guides). We enable the creation of new strands conforming to our parametric description of texture via a generative artificial intelligence approach supervised by a separate neural network trained to label candidate strands according to our five-parameter description. The ability to create new strands conforming to any desired texture enables groom editing using either texture transfer or user-provided inputs. We demonstrate results on a variety of hair types.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个框架，用于理解、生成和编辑具有丰富纹理的发丝。通过定义发丝纹理为发丝内部力形成的独特模式，提出一个五维参数空间，与自然发丝纹理一一对应。该空间既可定性访问，也可定量精确生成发丝。通过中心线几何将发丝纹理与整体方向解耦，并利用生成式AI创建符合参数描述的新发丝。展示了对多种发型的编辑结果。
Motivation: 现有发丝建模难以解耦纹理与整体方向，且缺乏对丰富纹理（如卷曲、扭转）的统一参数化描述。
Method: 提出五维参数空间表征发丝纹理，通过中心线几何将发丝映射到规范纹理空间，实现纹理与方向解耦。使用生成式AI（由分类神经网络监督）根据参数创建新发丝，支持纹理转移和用户输入编辑。
Result: 摘要声称该方法能够生成多种发型的纹理效果，并实现纹理编辑，但未提供具体定量指标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调框架在发丝纹理建模中的解耦能力和编辑灵活性。

papers.title: A Structural Interpretation of GELU and Threshold-Transmission Activations via the First-Order Loss Function
papers.abstract_en: The Gaussian Error Linear Unit is usually motivated as the expected output of an input-dependent Bernoulli gate. This work gives an alternative interpretation: GELU is the expected output of a hard linear gate with a Gaussian random threshold. This view provides a generative interpretation for the Bernoulli gate: the gate opens once the input clears a latent Gaussian threshold. This interpretation stems from a decomposition based on well-known results in stochastic inventory theory and leads to a threshold-transmission family that includes ReLU, GELU, SiLU/Swish, and hard swish as special cases. By considering a latent uniform threshold, we recover a hard-swish-like piecewise-polynomial gate whose nonlinear transition is confined to a finite interval, yielding fixed- and learned-width variants. Controlled experiments on compact vision and language models show that calibrated or learned uniform-threshold gates are consistently competitive with GELU, ReLU, and SiLU/Swish, improve over them in most tested settings, and use the finite transition region nontrivially.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GELU激活函数的一种新解释：它是带高斯随机阈值的硬线性门控的期望输出。基于随机库存理论中的经典结果，推导出一个阈值传输（threshold-transmission）激活函数族，包括ReLU、GELU、SiLU/Swish和hard swish等特例。通过引入均匀随机阈值，得到一种硬swish-like分段多项式门控，其非线性过渡限于有限区间。在小型视觉和语言模型上的受控实验表明，校准或学习的均匀阈值门控与GELU、ReLU、SiLU/Swish相比具有竞争力，在多数测试设置中表现更优。
Motivation: 现有GELU通常被解释为输入相关伯努利门控的期望输出，本文旨在提供另一种生成式解释，并推广到更一般的阈值传输激活函数族。
Method: 基于随机库存理论中的经典结果，将激活函数视为带随机阈值（高斯或均匀）的硬线性门控的期望输出，从而统一ReLU、GELU、SiLU/Swish等激活函数。
Result: 在小型视觉和语言模型上的实验表明，均匀阈值门控（包括固定宽度和可学习宽度变体）在多数测试设置中优于或持平于GELU、ReLU和SiLU/Swish。
Conclusion: 本文从阈值传输角度统一了多种常用激活函数，并验证了均匀阈值门控的有效性和实用性。

papers.title: SUNTA: Hierarchical Video Prediction with Surprise-based Chunking
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical state-space models (HSSMs) offer a promising approach to long-horizon prediction by segmenting sequences into temporal chunks. However, their performance hinges on how chunk boundaries are determined. While prior HSSMs typically rely on fixed-length chunking or similarity-based boundary detection, these methods often misalign with the intrinsic temporal structure of the data. We argue that chunking should instead be driven by prediction errors, which more directly indicate when longer-range context becomes necessary. Nevertheless, integrating surprise-based chunking into HSSMs introduces critical challenges, including hierarchical collapse during end-to-end training and the absence of surprise signals during open-loop prediction. To address these issues, we propose Surprise-based Nested Temporal Abstraction (SUNTA), a method that employs a decoupled training strategy to preserve surprise signals and uses internal inconsistency as a top-down surprise metric to determine chunk boundaries within imagined rollouts. Experiments on video prediction tasks in 2D and 3D environments demonstrate that SUNTA outperforms baselines, uniquely maintaining accurate predictions over 250 timesteps, whereas all baselines degrade within the first 10 timesteps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SUNTA方法，一种基于预测误差（惊喜）的分层视频预测方法，通过解耦训练策略和内部不一致性作为自上而下的惊喜度量，在2D和3D环境中实现超过250时间步的准确预测，而基线模型在10步内性能下降。
Motivation: 现有分层状态空间模型（HSSM）使用固定长度或相似性分块，与数据内在时间结构不匹配。作者认为分块应由预测误差驱动，但将基于惊喜的分块集成到HSSM面临训练中层次崩溃和开环预测缺惊喜信号等挑战。
Method: 提出SUNTA，采用解耦训练策略保留惊喜信号，并使用内部不一致性作为自上而下的惊喜度量，在想象展开中确定分块边界。
Result: 在2D和3D环境视频预测任务中，SUNTA优于基线，能在250时间步内保持准确预测，而所有基线在10步内退化。
Conclusion: 基于惊喜的分块能更好匹配数据时间结构，解码和训练策略可推广到其他分层预测模型。

papers.title: Reliability-Aware CT-MRI Registration: A Quality Engineering Framework with Stability Analysis and Risk Classification
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal CT-MRI registration is central to image-guided radiotherapy, surgical navigation, and diagnostic workflows, but most pipelines report only aggregate quality metrics without per-case reliability signals. We propose a reliability-aware framework that converts registration quality into Green/Yellow/Red risk categories using data-learned thresholds. CT images were registered to T1-weighted MRI using rigid and affine transformations on 90 paired slices from 18 patients across brain, abdominal, and neck anatomies. Reliability was assessed using Delta NMI, Delta SSIM, Dice overlap, registration stability, and inverse consistency error, combined into a single score R. Thresholds learned from training patients were applied unchanged to held-out test patients. Affine registration outperformed rigid registration on NMI and SSIM, yielding 44% Green classifications versus 33% for rigid. Reliability-filtered registrations improved the average alignment profile compared with unfiltered methods. Per-anatomy analysis showed substantial variation, with stronger reliability for abdominal registrations than brain registrations. Weight sensitivity analysis identified Dice overlap as the dominant reliability component. The proposed framework provides an interpretable quality-control layer for multimodal registration, while risk thresholds reflect statistical rather than clinical validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可靠性感知的CT-MRI多模态图像配准框架，将配准质量转化为绿/黄/红风险类别。使用18位患者的90个配对切片（脑、腹、颈部）进行刚性和仿射配准，通过Delta NMI、Delta SSIM等指标组合成单一可靠性分数R，并在测试集上验证。仿射配准优于刚性，分类为绿的比例更高。可靠性过滤后配准平均对齐质量提升。不同解剖部位差异大，腹部可靠性强于脑部。权重敏感性分析显示Dice重叠度是主导成分。框架提供可解释的质量控制层，但风险阈值基于统计而非临床验证。
Motivation: 现有多模态配准通常只报告整体质量指标，缺乏每个病例的可靠性信号，无法判断单次配准的可信度。
Method: 提出可靠性感知框架，使用数据学习阈值将配准质量分为绿/黄/红三类。结合Delta NMI、Delta SSIM、Dice重叠度、配准稳定性和逆一致性误差，组合为单一可靠性分数R。
Result: 在脑、腹、颈部数据集上，仿射配准的NMI和SSIM优于刚性，产生44%绿分类（刚性33%）。可靠性过滤后平均对齐改善。腹部配准可靠性强于脑部。Dice重叠度是主要影响因子。
Conclusion: 框架提供可解释的质量控制层，但风险阈值基于统计而非临床验证，需进一步临床验证。

papers.title: Safety from Honesty in a Disinterested AI Predictor
papers.abstract_en: As AI systems become more capable, training procedures that optimize for downstream outcomes risk introducing implicit agency: goal-directed behavior that designers never specified. We present a formal safety argument for the Scientist AI (SAI) Predictor, trained to approximate the Bayesian posterior conditioned on a dataset of "epistemically contextualized" natural-language statements. We argue that such a Predictor can honestly predict agents, actions, and their consequences without itself being an agent that selects outputs to achieve goals. This rests on data representation and on the training procedure. Epistemic contextualization of text distinguishes latent factual claims from communication acts, so expressions of goals are treated as evidence to be explained rather than drives the model adopts. With a posterior-seeking training objective, this is intended to drive the Predictor toward calibrated, cautious predictions. Training proceeds so downstream effects of deploying a prediction never serve as a reward signal; any agency the system needs is supplied by explicit scaffolding constrained by guardrails. We prove that, under assumptions on the training dynamics and on the argued sparsity of dangerous Predictors, the probability that training produces a Predictor whose guarded deployment carries residual harm above a specified threshold is small: a dangerous Predictor would have to underestimate harm in a coordinated way across many queries while such coordinated patterns are rare under the initialization distribution and receive no direct training signal. Safety and accuracy are jointly supported in this framework, since the constraints that secure accuracy are the same ones that make coordinated deception costly. These guarantees against misalignment and agency arising from within the Predictor itself do not preclude the use of the Predictor as part of an agentic system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个关于“科学家AI预测器”（SAI Predictor）的形式化安全论证。该预测器被训练用于近似基于“认知语境化”自然语言陈述数据集的贝叶斯后验。作者论证，这样的预测器可以诚实预测智能体、行动及其后果，而本身并非一个为了达成目标而选择输出的智能体。通过数据表示和训练过程的设计，确保预测器校准且谨慎，并证明在特定假设下，训练产生危险预测器的概率很小。
Motivation: 随着AI系统能力增强，优化下游结果的训练程序可能引入隐式目标导向行为（即设计者未指定的代理性）。本文旨在提供一种形式化安全保证，防止AI预测器自身产生代理性和不诚实行为。
Method: 提出SAI Predictor框架，训练目标为近似贝叶斯后验，使用认知语境化文本表示区分事实与沟通行为，并采用后验寻求训练目标，使预测器校准且谨慎。训练不将部署预测的下游效应作为奖励信号，系统所需代理性由受显式约束的脚手架提供。在训练动态和危险预测器稀疏性的假设下，证明危险预测器出现的概率很小。
Result: 摘要证明，在既定假设下，训练产生一个受保护部署带来超过指定阈值残余危害的预测器的概率很小。安全性和准确性在此框架中得到联合支持，因为确保准确性的约束也使得协调欺骗代价高昂。
Conclusion: 本文提供的形式化保证表明，通过特定数据表示和训练程序，预测器本身可以避免代理性和不诚实，但该保证不排除预测器被用作智能体系统的一部分。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CMSL: Constructive Multi-Sequence Learning for Recommendation Systems
papers.abstract_en: Sequence learning has emerged as the promising paradigm in recommendation systems, surpassing traditional Deep Learning Recommendation Models (DLRM) by capturing the temporal nuances of user behavior. However, current state-of-the-art architectures operate under a limiting analogy: they treat user history as a monolithic chronological sequence like a sentence in a Large Language Model (LLM). We observe a fundamental divergence between natural language and recommendation data: unlike the linear, logical flow of text, user history is inherently multi-faceted. A user's journey is a fragmented reflection of diverse interests, resulting in much weaker coherence between items than is found in LLM training data. This lack of structural unity leads to context pollution. In single-sequence modeling, unrelated behaviors compete for the same attention budget. This "noisy" signal dilutes the model's focus, effectively capping its ability to discern high-intent patterns from background activity. To address this, we propose Constructive Multi-Sequence Learning (CMSL), a paradigm shift from passive sequence ingestion to active "context engineering" that constructs multiple coherent sequences in latent space. CMSL leverages a learnable Sequence Construction Module to disentangle user history into "pure" thematic strands, followed by a linear attention mechanism to efficiently model these strands at scale. CMSL has been deployed across ranking and retrieval tasks and across four major surfaces at Meta.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出构造性多序列学习（CMSL），通过可学习的序列构建模块将用户历史解耦为多个主题纯净的序列，并采用线性注意力机制高效建模，以解决单序列建模中的上下文污染问题。该方法已在Meta的排序和检索任务及四个主要推荐表面部署。
Motivation: 现有序列推荐方法将用户行为建模为单一单调序列，忽略了用户行为的多面性，导致弱相干性和上下文污染，限制了模型对高意图模式的识别能力。
Method: 提出CMSL，包含一个可学习的序列构建模块，在潜在空间中将用户历史解耦为多个主题纯净的序列，然后使用线性注意力机制对这些序列进行高效建模。
Result: 摘要未报告具体量化指标，但强调该方法已成功部署于Meta的排序和检索任务及四个主要推荐表面。
Conclusion: CMSL通过主动构造多序列而非被动接受单序列，实现了从被动序列摄入到主动上下文工程的范式转变，为推荐系统中的序列学习提供了新方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Forget, Anticipate and Adapt: Test Time Training for Long Videos
papers.abstract_en: Test Time Training (TTT) is a mechanism in which a model adapts to an incoming test-sample by performing some self-supervised (SSL) task and updating its weights even during inference. This procedure does not require labels at test-time. This paper focuses on TTT for long-videos. A major concern with existing approaches is: 1) they perform TTT updates using a sliding window containing frames in the past, whose compute increases linearly with the size of window. This becomes computationally intractable when the videos are hours long. 2) TTT is performed even when temporally close frames look similar, thereby consuming a lot of compute. We present the Frame Forgetting Network (FFN) that: 1) operates on only three frames within the sliding window, namely the frame that exits, the current frame and the frame after that. The model still manages to retain temporal context and work for hours long-videos; 2) mathematically define a surprise metric: how much new information the incoming frame contains with respect to the past seen frame. This facilitates determining how to modify the effective window size during TTT and constitutes the core mechanism of an adaptive windowing algorithm. Additionally, we curate a dataset EpicTours containing up to 3 hour long videos of walking city-tours, whereas earlier datasets on this problem were only 5 min long. We demonstrate FFNs empirical effectiveness on dense-segmentation, video classification tasks, generalization to depth-estimation, and multi-hour long videos.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出帧遗忘网络（Frame Forgetting Network, FFN），针对长视频测试时训练（TTT）中计算量随窗口大小线性增长以及相邻帧相似导致冗余更新的问题，仅用滑动窗口中的三帧（退出帧、当前帧和下一帧）保持时序上下文，并定义惊喜度（surprise metric）度量新帧包含的新信息量，实现自适应窗口大小。在长达3小时的城市导览视频数据集EpicTours上，FFN在密集分割、视频分类等任务上有效，并泛化到深度估计。
Motivation: 现有TTT方法使用包含过去帧的滑动窗口，计算量随窗口大小线性增长，无法处理数小时的长视频；同时，时序相近的帧视觉相似时仍执行TTT，浪费计算资源。
Method: 提出FFN，仅处理滑动窗口中的三帧（退出帧、当前帧和下一帧）；定义惊喜度指标衡量新帧相对于过去帧的信息量，据此自适应调整有效窗口大小，作为自适应窗口算法的核心机制。
Result: 在自建长达3小时的EpicTours数据集上，FFN在密集分割和视频分类任务上表现有效，并泛化到深度估计任务。
Conclusion: FFN通过仅用三帧和自适应窗口机制，显著降低长视频TTT的计算开销，同时在多类视频任务上保持性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Low-Latency Fraud Detection Layer for Detecting Adversarial Interaction Patterns in LLM-Powered Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM)-powered agents demonstrate strong capabilities in autonomous task execution, tool use, and multi-step reasoning. However, their increasing autonomy also introduces a new attack surface: adversarial interactions can manipulate agent behavior through direct prompt injection, indirect content attacks, and multi-turn escalation strategies. Existing defense strategies focus on prompt-level filtering and rule-based guardrails, which are often insufficient when risk emerges gradually across interaction sequences. In this work, we propose a complementary defense mechanism: a low-latency fraud detection layer for detecting adversarial interaction patterns in LLM-powered agents. Instead of determining whether a single prompt is malicious, our approach models risk over interaction trajectories using structured runtime features derived from prompt characteristics, session dynamics, tool usage, execution context, and fraud-inspired signals. The detection layer can be implemented using lightweight models leading to low-latency real-time deployments. To evaluate the framework, we construct a synthetic corpus of 12,000 multi-turn agent interactions generated from parameterized templates that simulate realistic agentic workflows. Using 42 structured features and an XGBoost classifier, our detector achieves over 9 times faster than LLM-based detectors. Through the experiment and ablation studies, our work suggests that interaction-level behavioral detection should become a core component of deployment-time defense for LLM-powered agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种低延迟的欺诈检测层，用于识别LLM代理中的对抗性交互模式。该方法通过分析交互轨迹的结构化运行时特征（如提示特征、会话动态、工具使用等），使用轻量级XGBoost模型实现实时检测。在合成的12,000条多轮交互数据集上，该检测器速度比基于LLM的检测器快9倍以上。
Motivation: 现有针对LLM代理的防御主要基于单提示过滤和规则护栏，难以检测跨交互序列逐渐累积的风险，存在安全漏洞。
Method: 构建一个独立的检测层，从交互轨迹中提取42个结构化特征（包括提示特征、会话动态、工具使用、执行上下文和欺诈信号），使用XGBoost分类器进行低延迟实时检测。
Result: 在包含12,000条多轮交互的合成语料库上，该检测器速度比基于LLM的检测器快9倍以上，且通过消融实验验证了特征有效性。
Conclusion: 交互级别的行为检测应成为LLM代理部署时防御的核心组件，以弥补提示级防御的不足。

papers.title: SegWithU: Uncertainty as Perturbation Energy for Single-Forward-Pass Risk-Aware Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable uncertainty estimation is critical for medical image segmentation, where automated contours feed downstream quantification and clinical decision support. Many strong uncertainty methods require repeated inference, while efficient single-forward-pass alternatives often provide weaker failure ranking or rely on restrictive feature-space assumptions. We present $\textbf{SegWithU}$, a post-hoc framework that augments a frozen pretrained segmentation backbone with a lightweight uncertainty head. SegWithU taps intermediate backbone features and models uncertainty as perturbation energy in a compact probe space using rank-1 posterior probes. It produces two voxel-wise uncertainty maps: a calibration-oriented map for probability tempering and a ranking-oriented map for error detection and selective prediction. Across ACDC, BraTS2024, and LiTS, SegWithU is the strongest and most consistent single-forward-pass baseline, achieving AUROC/AURC of $0.9838/2.4885$, $0.9946/0.2660$, and $0.9925/0.8193$, respectively, while preserving segmentation quality. These results suggest that perturbation-based uncertainty modeling is an effective and practical route to reliability-aware medical segmentation. Source code is available at https://github.com/ProjectNeura/SegWithU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SegWithU是一个后处理框架，为冻结的预训练医学图像分割骨干附加轻量级不确定性头，通过秩-1后验探针将不确定性建模为紧凑探针空间中的扰动能量。该方法产生两种体素级不确定性图：用于概率校准的校准图和用于错误检测/选择性预测的排序图。在ACDC、BraTS2024和LiTS数据集上，SegWithU以单次前向传播取得了AUROC/AURC分别为0.9838/2.4885、0.9946/0.2660和0.9925/0.8193，同时保持分割质量。
Motivation: 医学图像分割需要可靠的不确定性估计，但现有方法要么需要多次推理（效率低），要么单次前向传播方法失败排名较弱或依赖限制性特征空间假设。
Method: 在冻结的预训练分割骨干上添加轻量级不确定性头，利用中间特征，通过秩-1后验探针在紧凑探针空间中建模扰动能量，输出两种体素级不确定性图：校准导向图和排序导向图。
Result: 在ACDC、BraTS2024和LiTS上，SegWithU作为单次前向传播基线，AUROC/AURC分别达0.9838/2.4885、0.9946/0.2660和0.9925/0.8193，分割质量不受损。
Conclusion: 基于扰动的不确定性建模是实现可靠医学分割的有效且实用途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Semantic Richness or Geometric Reasoning? The Fragility of VLM's Visual Invariance
papers.abstract_en: This work investigates the fundamental fragility of state-of-the-art Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under basic geometric transformations. While modern VLMs excel at semantic tasks such as recognizing objects in canonical orientations and describing complex scenes, they exhibit systematic failures at a more fundamental level: lack of robust spatial invariance and equivariance required to reliably determine object identity under simple rotations, scaling, and identity transformations. We demonstrate this limitation through a systematic evaluation across diverse visual domains, including symbolic sketches, natural photographs, and abstract art. Performance drops sharply as semantic content becomes sparse, and this behavior is observed across architectures, model capacities, and prompting strategies. Overall, our results reveal a systematic gap between semantic understanding and spatial reasoning in current VLMs, highlighting the need for stronger geometric grounding in future multimodal systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了当前最先进的视觉语言模型（VLM）在基本几何变换（如旋转、缩放、恒等变换）下的鲁棒性。结果表明，尽管VLM在语义任务上表现优异，但在判断物体身份时缺乏空间不变性和等变性，尤其在语义内容稀疏时性能急剧下降，且该现象跨架构、容量和提示策略普遍存在。
Motivation: 现有VLM在语义理解上表现出色，但其对简单几何变换的鲁棒性尚未被系统研究，这限制了模型在需要空间推理的任务中的可靠性。
Method: 通过在不同视觉领域（符号草图、自然照片、抽象艺术）上设计包含旋转、缩放和恒等变换的评估基准，测试多种VLM架构、模型规模和提示策略，分析性能变化模式。
Result: VLM在几何变换下性能显著下降，语义内容越稀疏下降越明显；该脆弱性在不同架构和模型容量中一致出现，提示策略无法缓解。
Conclusion: 当前VLM在语义理解与空间推理之间存在系统性差距，未来的多模态系统需要更强的几何基础。

papers.title: Neural Collapse Dynamics: Depth, Activation, Regularisation, and Feature Norm Threshold
papers.abstract_en: Neural collapse (NC) -- the convergence of penultimate-layer features to a simplex equiangular tight frame -- is well understood at equilibrium, but the dynamics governing its onset remain poorly characterised. We identify a simple and predictive regularity: NC occurs when the mean feature norm reaches a model-dataset-specific critical value, fn*, that is largely invariant to training conditions. This value concentrates tightly within each (model, dataset) pair (CV < 8%); training dynamics primarily affect the rate at which fn approaches fn*, rather than the value itself. In standard training trajectories, the crossing of fn below fn* consistently precedes NC onset, providing a practical predictor with a mean lead time of 62 epochs (MAE 24 epochs). A direct intervention experiment confirms fn* is a stable attractor of the gradient flow -- perturbations to feature scale are self-corrected during training, with convergence to the same value regardless of direction (p>0.2). Completing the (architecture)x(dataset) grid reveals the paper's strongest result: ResNet-20 on MNIST gives fn* = 5.867 -- a +458% architecture effect versus only +68% on CIFAR-10. The grid is strongly non-additive; fn* cannot be decomposed into independent architecture and dataset contributions. Four structural regularities emerge: (1) depth has a non-monotonic effect on collapse speed; (2) activation jointly determines both collapse speed and fn*; (3) weight decay defines a three-regime phase diagram -- too little slows, an optimal range is fastest, and too much prevents collapse; (4) width monotonically accelerates collapse while shifting fn* by at most 13%. These results establish feature-norm dynamics as an actionable diagnostic for predicting NC timing, suggesting that norm-threshold behaviour is a general mechanism underlying delayed representational reorganisation in deep networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究发现神经崩溃（NC）的发生取决于平均特征范数达到一个模型-数据集特异性的临界值 fn*，该值对训练条件高度不变。在标准训练中，fn 低于 fn* 的交叉点平均提前 62 个 epoch 预测 NC 的 onset，且 fn* 是梯度流的稳定吸引子。通过系统性网格实验，揭示了深度、激活函数、权重衰减和宽度对 NC 动力学的结构规律。
Motivation: 神经崩溃在平衡态已被充分理解，但其 onset 的动态特征尚不清楚，论文旨在识别预测 NC 时间点的关键机制。
Method: 通过实验观察特征范数动力学，识别临界值 fn*，并通过干预实验验证其稳定性；在（架构×数据集）网格上系统研究深度、激活、正则化、宽度的影响。
Result: fn* 在（模型，数据集）对内高度集中（CV<8%），交叉点平均提前 62 epoch 预测 NC onset；架构效应显著（ResNet-20 on MNIST 的 fn* 比 CIFAR-10 高 458%）；深度非单调，激活联合影响速度和 fn*，权重衰减有三相图，宽度单调加速 collapse 但仅移动 fn* 最多 13%。
Conclusion: 特征范数动力学可作为预测 NC 时机的可操作诊断工具，范数阈值行为是深层网络延迟表示重组的通用机制。

summary_sections.result: fn* 在（模型，数据集）对内高度集中（CV<8%），交叉点平均提前 62 epoch 预测 NC onset；架构效应显著（ResNet-20 on MNIST 的 fn* 比 CIFAR-10 高 458%）；深度非单调，激活联合影响速度和 fn*，权重衰减有三相图，宽度单调加速 collapse 但仅移动 fn* 最多 13%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 特征范数动力学可作为预测 NC 时机的可操作诊断工具，范数阈值行为是深层网络延迟表示重组的通用机制。

papers.title: Open, Reliable, and Collective: A Community-Driven Framework for Tool-Using AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-integrated LLMs retrieve information, perform computations, and take real-world actions, but their reliability depends on both tool-use accuracy and intrinsic tool accuracy, including tool correctness, stability, and safety. While prior work primarily emphasizes tool use, intrinsic tool accuracy remains underexamined. We introduce OpenTools, a community-driven and maintainable toolbox for discovering, using, evaluating, and contributing open-source tools. OpenTools standardizes tool interfaces, converts documented Python functions into reviewable bundles, supports maintainer-triggered evaluation, and combines non-executing risk inspection with optional advisory LLM review. A public web demo allows users to run tools and agents, inspect evidence, contribute tests, and submit tools for maintainer review, while MCP enables controlled access from external applications. Experiments show that community-contributed, task-specific tools yield relative gains of 6% to 22% over an existing toolbox across multiple agent architectures, highlighting the importance of intrinsic tool accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OpenTools，一个社区驱动的开源工具箱框架，用于发现、使用、评估和贡献工具集成LLM。该框架标准化工具接口，将文档化Python函数转换为可审查包，结合非执行风险检查与可选的LLM审查，并通过公共Web演示支持用户运行和贡献。实验表明，社区贡献的任务特定工具在多种智能体架构上相比现有工具箱获得6%-22%的相对增益，凸显了内在工具准确性（工具正确性、稳定性、安全性）的重要性。
Motivation: 现有工作主要关注工具使用准确性，但内在工具准确性（如工具正确性、稳定性和安全性）未被充分研究，且缺乏社区维护的标准化工具箱。
Method: OpenTools通过标准化工具接口、将文档化Python函数转换为可审查的bundle、支持维护者触发的评估，以及结合非执行风险检查和可选的LLM审查，实现工具的可发现、可重用和可贡献。
Result: 实验显示，社区贡献的任务特定工具在多个智能体架构上相比现有工具箱获得6%-22%的相对增益。
Conclusion: 社区驱动的工具贡献和标准化评估能显著提升工具集成LLM的可靠性，强调内在工具准确性的关键作用。

papers.title: VehAnchor: Metadata-Free Metric Scale Recovery from Vehicle Cues in Aerial Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous aerial robots operating in GPS-denied or communication-degraded environments frequently lose access to camera metadata and telemetry, leaving onboard perception systems unable to recover the absolute metric scale of the scene. As LLM/VLM-based planners are increasingly adopted as high-level agents for embodied systems, their ability to reason about physical dimensions becomes safety-critical -- yet our experiments show that five state-of-the-art VLMs suffer from \emph{spatial scale hallucinations}, with median area estimation errors exceeding 50\%. We propose VehAnchor, a lightweight, deterministic \emph{Geometric Perception Skill} designed as a callable tool that any LLM-based agent can invoke to recover Ground Sample Distance (GSD) from ubiquitous environmental anchors: small vehicles detected via oriented bounding boxes, whose modal pixel length is robustly estimated through kernel density estimation and converted to GSD using a pre-calibrated reference length. The tool returns both a GSD estimate and a composite confidence score, enabling the calling agent to autonomously decide whether to trust the measurement or fall back to alternative strategies. On the DOTA~v1.5 benchmark, VehAnchor achieves 6.87\% median GSD error on 306~images. Integrated with SAM-based segmentation for downstream area measurement, the pipeline yields 19.7\% median error on a 100-entry benchmark -- with 2.6$\times$ lower category dependence and 4$\times$ fewer catastrophic failures than the best VLM baseline -- demonstrating that equipping agents with deterministic geometric tools is essential for safe autonomous spatial reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出VehAnchor，一种轻量级、确定性的几何感知技能，用于在缺乏相机元数据的情况下，从航拍图像中的车辆线索恢复绝对度量尺度（地面采样距离GSD）。在DOTA v1.5上中位GSD误差6.87%，集成到SAM分割管道后面积测量中位误差19.7%，优于五种最先进VLM的空间推理能力。
Motivation: GPS拒止或通信降级环境中自主空中机器人无法获取相机元数据和遥测，导致无法恢复场景的绝对度量尺度；同时VLM存在空间尺度幻觉，中位面积估计误差超过50%，需要一种轻量级确定性工具替代。
Method: 利用定向边界框检测小型车辆，通过核密度估计稳健估计模态像素长度，结合预校准参考长度转换为GSD，并返回复合置信度分数供代理自主决策。
Result: 在DOTA v1.5的306张图像上中位GSD误差6.87%；集成SAM分割后，100个样本的基准面积测量中位误差19.7%，类别依赖度比最佳VLM基线低2.6倍，灾难性失败少4倍。
Conclusion: 为自主代理配备确定性几何工具对安全空间推理至关重要，VehAnchor可作为LLM基础代理的可调用工具。

papers.title: MetaState: Persistent Working Memory Enhances Reasoning in Discrete Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising a masked sequence. However, standard dLLMs condition each denoising step solely on the current hard-masked sequence, while intermediate continuous representations are discarded after sampling and remasking. We term this bottleneck the \textbf{Information Island} issue: continuous information remains isolated within individual denoising steps and fails to propagate across the trajectory. This bottleneck is especially harmful for reasoning, which requires intermediate reasoning state to be preserved and updated across many denoising steps. To address this limitation, we introduce \textbf{MetaState}, a lightweight recurrent augmentation that equips a frozen dLLM backbone with persistent, fixed-size working memory. MetaState comprises three modules with a shared time conditioner: a cross-attention \textbf{Mixer} that reads backbone activations into memory slots, a GRU-style \textbf{Updater} that integrates information across steps, and a cross-attention \textbf{Injector} that writes the updated memory back into the backbone. We train these modules with a dedicated $K$-step unrolling pipeline to learn multi-step dynamics. MetaState adds only ${\sim}0.6\%$ trainable parameters while keeping the backbone frozen, and consistently improves reasoning performance over frozen baselines on mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, with an average gain of 4.5 percentage points across all evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MetaState，一种轻量级循环增强模块，为离散扩散语言模型（dLLMs）添加持久工作记忆，解决连续信息在去噪步骤间无法传播的“信息孤岛”问题。该方法在冻结主干模型上仅增加约0.6%的可训练参数，在数学推理和代码生成基准上平均提升4.5个百分点。
Motivation: 标准离散扩散语言模型每个去噪步骤仅依赖当前硬掩码序列，中间连续表示被舍弃，导致关键推理状态无法在步骤间传递，限制了推理能力。
Method: MetaState包含三个模块：交叉注意力Mixer读取主干激活到记忆槽、GRU风格Updater跨步整合信息、交叉注意力Injector将更新后的记忆写回主干。通过K步展开训练学习多步动态。
Result: 在数学推理和代码生成基准上，MetaState相对于冻结基线平均提升4.5个百分点，且仅增加约0.6%的可训练参数。
Conclusion: MetaState有效解决了离散扩散语言模型的信息孤岛问题，通过轻量级工作记忆增强显著提升推理性能，且主干模型保持冻结。

papers.title: FIRE-Bench: Evaluating AI Agents on the Rediscovery of Scientific Insights
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agents powered by large language models (LLMs) promise to accelerate scientific discovery end-to-end, but rigorously evaluating their capacity for verifiable discovery remains a central challenge. Existing benchmarks face a trade-off: they either heavily rely on LLM-as-judge evaluations of automatically generated research outputs or optimize convenient yet isolated performance metrics that provide coarse proxies for scientific insight. To address this gap, we introduce FIRE-Bench (Full-cycle Insight Rediscovery Evaluation), a benchmark that evaluates agents through the rediscovery of established findings from recent, high-impact machine learning research. Agents are given only a high-level research question extracted from a published, verified study and must autonomously explore ideas, design experiments, implement code, execute their plans, and derive conclusions supported by empirical evidence. We evaluate a range of state-of-the-art agents with frontier LLMs backbones like gpt-5 on FIRE-Bench. Our results show that full-cycle scientific research remains challenging for current agent systems: even the strongest agents achieve limited rediscovery success (<50 F1), exhibit high variance across runs, and display recurring failure modes in experimental design, execution, and evidence-based reasoning. FIRE-Bench provides a rigorous and diagnostic framework for measuring progress toward reliable agent-driven scientific discovery.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 3 figures, 16 tables; ICML 2026 Camera-ready Version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FIRE-Bench（完整周期洞察再发现评估基准），用于评测基于大语言模型（LLM）的自主智能体在重新发现已有机器学习研究发现方面的能力。智能体仅需一个高层次研究问题，自主完成探索想法、设计实验、编写代码、执行并得出基于证据的结论。实验表明，当前最强智能体（如 gpt-5）的再发现成功率有限（F1<50），且存在高方差和多种重复失败模式。
Motivation: 现有基准面临权衡：要么严重依赖 LLM 作为法官评估自动生成的研究输出，要么优化便捷但孤立的性能指标，无法严格评估智能体的可验证科学发现能力。
Method: FIRE-Bench 要求智能体从已发表验证的高影响力机器学习研究中提取高层次研究问题，自主进行想法探索、实验设计、代码实现、计划执行以及基于实证的结论推导。作者使用 gpt-5 等前沿 LLM 作为后端，评估了多种最先进智能体。
Result: 最强智能体在 FIRE-Bench 上仅取得有限再发现成功率（F1<50），不同运行之间方差高，并在实验设计、执行和基于证据的推理方面出现常见失败模式。
Conclusion: FIRE-Bench 为衡量向可靠智能体驱动科学发现进展提供了严格的诊断框架，同时表明当前智能体系统在完整周期科学研究上仍面临重大挑战。

papers.title: Referential Regimes: Transformation-Invariant Identity for Neutral Substrates
papers.abstract_en: Data systems increasingly operate under persistent legal, political, and analytic disagreement, where no single interpretive authority can be assumed. A neutral substrate provides stable shared reference without requiring agreement about causal or normative interpretation: it fixes reference structurally and leaves interpretation to extension layers. This paper derives the identity structure such a substrate requires using a small transformation algebra. Identity is treated as transformation-invariance: a referent is individuated by the admissible operations that preserve it. Once routine record operations are fixed, individuation becomes a structural calculation. That calculation exposes a mismatch between reference kinds and identity regimes. An accountability substrate must refer to six carrier kinds: obligation-bearers, rules, occurrences, scopes, records, and plain referents. Three kinds have more than one admissible basis. A scope may be fixed by extension or structure; a rule by content or structure; a plain referent by locus or object. Decomposition separates the scope readings, refinement separates the rule readings, and forking separates the plain-referent readings. Counting reference kinds gives six, while transformation analysis forces at least nine identity regimes. The three additional regimes add no new kind to the inventory. They arise from identity behavior under ordinary operations, and any attempt to collapse them reappears as a hidden regime that persistent disagreement cannot hold fixed. The result is a conditional lower bound. A richer transformation basis may leave the bound unchanged or force further splits, but it cannot erase a distinction witnessed here. The additional regimes correspond to distinctions often handled by modeling convention, but such conventions cannot substitute for regime-level identity commitments under persistent disagreement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对数据系统在持久法律、政治和分析分歧下需要中性基板的问题，提出使用变换代数推导身份结构。通过对六种载体种类（义务承担者、规则、事件、范围、记录和普通指代者）的变换不变性分析，发现至少需要九种身份制度，比种类多出三种。这些额外制度源于常规操作下的身份行为，且无法通过建模约定替代。
Motivation: 现有数据系统缺乏在持久分歧下提供稳定共享参考的机制，需要一种不依赖解释权威的中性基板，但这样的基板需要明确身份结构。
Method: 利用小变换代数，将身份视为变换不变性，通过固定常规记录操作后，对载体种类进行结构计算，区分出六种载体种类和九种身份制度，并通过分解、细化和分叉等操作分离不同意义。
Result: 证明了载体种类与身份制度之间存在数量不匹配：六种载体种类对应至少九种身份制度，且这些额外制度无法被消除，否则会作为隐藏制度重新出现，形成条件下界。
Conclusion: 中性基板必须区分九种身份制度，而非六种载体种类；建模约定无法替代制度级的身份承诺，尤其在持久分歧下。

papers.title: Mini Amusement Parks (MAPs): A Testbed for Modelling Business Decisions
papers.abstract_en: Despite rapid progress in artificial intelligence, current systems struggle with the interconnected challenges that define real-world decision making. Practical domains, such as business management, require optimizing an open-ended and multi-faceted objective, actively learning environment dynamics from sparse experience, planning over long horizons in stochastic settings, and reasoning over spatial information. Yet existing human--AI benchmarks isolate subsets of these capabilities, limiting our ability to assess holistic decision-making competence. We introduce Mini Amusement Parks (MAPs), an amusement-park simulator designed to evaluate an agent's ability to model its environment, anticipate long-term consequences under uncertainty, and strategically operate a complex business. We provide human baselines and a comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art LLM agents, finding that humans outperform these systems by 6.5x on easy mode and 9.8x on medium mode. Our analysis reveals persistent weaknesses in long-horizon optimization, sample-efficient learning, spatial reasoning, and world modelling. By unifying these challenges within a single environment, MAPs offers a new foundation for benchmarking agents capable of adaptable decision making. Code: https://github.com/Skyfall-Research/MAPs
