papers.title: OpenEM: Large-scale multi-structural 3D datasets for electromagnetic methods
papers.abstract_en: Electromagnetic (EM) methods, owing to their efficiency and non-invasive nature, have become one of the most widely used techniques in geological exploration. Nevertheless, data processing for these methods remains highly time-consuming and labor-intensive. With the remarkable success of deep learning, applying such techniques to EM methods has emerged as a promising research direction to overcome the limitations of conventional approaches. The effectiveness of deep learning methods depends heavily on the quality of datasets, which directly influences model performance and generalization ability. Existing application studies often construct datasets from random one-dimensional or structurally simple threedimensional (3D) models, which fail to represent the complexity of real geological environments. Furthermore, the absence of standardized, publicly available 3D geoelectric datasets continues to hinder progress in deep learning based EM exploration. To address these limitations, we present OpenEM, a large-scale, multi-structural 3D geoelectric dataset that encompasses a broad range of geologically plausible subsurface structures. OpenEM consists of nine categories of geoelectric models, spanning from simple configurations with anomalous bodies in half-space to more complex structures such as flat layers, folded layers, flat faults, curved faults and their corresponding variants with anomalous bodies. In addition, we provide a 3D model generator that enables fully controllable 3D model construction, allowing flexible and extensible augmentation of OpenEM. OpenEM provides a unified, comprehensive, and large-scale dataset for common EM exploration systems to accelerate the application of deep learning in electromagnetic methods. The complete dataset and 3D model generator is publicly available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17141981.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OpenEM是一个大规模、多结构的三维地电数据集，旨在推动深度学习在地球物理电磁勘探中的应用。该数据集包含九类地质模型，从简单到复杂，并提供可控的三维模型生成器以支持数据增强。
Motivation: 现有电磁勘探数据处理耗时费力，深度学习虽有潜力但缺乏高质量、标准化的三维地电数据集，限制了模型性能与泛化能力。
Method: 构建了涵盖半空间异常体、平坦/褶皱层、平坦/弯曲断层及其变体等九类地质模型的3D数据集，同时开发了完全可控的3D模型生成器用于灵活扩展。
Result: OpenEM提供了统一、全面、大规模的数据集，旨在加速深度学习在电磁勘探中的应用。数据集和生成器已公开。
Conclusion: OpenEM填补了标准化三维地电数据集的空白，为电磁勘探深度学习研究提供基础平台，但摘要未提及具体实验验证。

papers.title: Generalized and Unified Equivalences between Hardness and Pseudoentropy
papers.abstract_en: Pseudoentropy characterizations give quantitatively precise formulations of the relationship between computational hardness and computational randomness. We prove a unified pseudoentropy characterization that generalizes and strengthens previous results in both uniform and nonuniform models of computation. Our characterization applies to a general family of entropy notions, including Shannon entropy and min-entropy as special cases. Moreover, the characterizations for these different entropy notions can be witnessed simultaneously by a single universal function, which captures both computational hardness and computational randomness. A key technical insight is that weight-restricted calibration, from the recent literature on algorithmic fairness, together with standard computational indistinguishability (known as multiaccuracy in the fairness literature), suffices for proving pseudoentropy characterizations for general entropy notions. To obtain this combination of properties, we prove an enhanced version of the Leakage Simulation Lemma (Jetchev and Pietrzak, 2014), which in turn extends the Complexity Theoretic-Regularity Lemma (Trevisan, Tulsiani, and Vadhan, 2009) from boolean functions to ones over a larger alphabet. Our Enhanced Regularity/Leakage-Simulation Lemma enables us to obtain an exponential improvement in the dependence on the alphabet size compared with the pseudoentropy characterizations of Casacuberta, Dwork, and Vadhan (2024), which are based on the stronger notion of multicalibration. We also show that this exponential dependence on the alphabet size is inevitable for multicalibration and even for the weaker notion of calibrated multiaccuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明了一个统一的伪熵刻画，推广并强化了均匀和非均匀计算模型中的先前结果。该刻画适用于包括香农熵和最小熵在内的一般熵族，且不同熵的刻画可由单个通用函数同时实现。关键技术见解是权重限制校准与标准计算不可区分性（公平性文献中的多准确性）足以证明一般熵的伪熵刻画。为了获得这些性质的组合，作者证明了泄漏模拟引理的增强版本，该引理将复杂性理论正则性引理从布尔函数扩展到更大字母表上的函数，相较于基于多校准的先前结果，在字母表大小依赖性上实现了指数级改进。
Motivation: 伪熵刻画提供了计算复杂性与计算随机性之间关系的精确量化表述，但现有结果在不同的计算模型（均匀/非均匀）和熵概念（如香农熵、最小熵）上缺乏统一性，且字母表大小的影响未得到充分优化。
Method: 引入权重限制校准（来自算法公平性文献）与计算不可区分性（多准确性）的结合，证明增强版泄漏模拟引理，从而将复杂性理论正则性引理扩展到更大字母表上的函数，并证明多校准甚至校准后的多准确性必然导致字母表大小的指数依赖性。
Result: 得到了一个统一的伪熵刻画，同时适用于香农熵和最小熵等多种熵概念，且字母表大小依赖性相比Casacuberta等人（2024）基于多校准的结果实现了指数级改进，同时证明该指数依赖性是不可避免的。
Conclusion: 该工作统一并加强了计算复杂性与伪熵关系的理论刻画，揭示了权重限制校准与计算不可区分性在其中的核心作用，并为未来研究提供了更高效的工具。

papers.title: Memory Savings at What Cost? A Study of Alternatives to Backpropagation
papers.abstract_en: Forward-mode automatic differentiation (FmAD) and zero-order (ZO) optimization are increasingly proposed as memory-efficient, backpropagation-free alternatives for large language model (LLM) fine-tuning, yet their benefits are typically evaluated only against standard backpropagation (BP), omitting memory-efficient variants such as activation checkpointing. We present a unified theoretical and empirical comparison of BP, checkpointed BP, FmAD, and ZO for LLM and vision-language model training, showing that while FmAD and ZO reduce activation memory, they trade memory for higher computational cost and longer wall-clock time to convergence, resulting in lower accuracy and slower training, especially under constrained perturbation budgets. Across models, BP with checkpointing outperforms FmAD and ZO variants, including variance-reduced methods, achieving up to 31.1% higher accuracy, 34.8% faster convergence, and 3.8x fewer computations at comparable memory usage, while also revealing instability-related failure modes in FmAD and ZO. Overall, our results correct a one-sided benchmarking narrative by showing that memory-efficient methods entail fundamentally different trade-offs, and that ignoring these distinctions has led to misleading conclusions about LLM optimization in prior work. Our source code is available at {https://github.com/Astuary/Gradient_Estimation_Methods}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了前向自动微分（FmAD）和零阶优化（ZO）与标准反向传播（BP）及激活检查点变体在大型语言模型和视觉-语言模型训练中的性能。结果表明，虽然FmAD和ZO减少了激活内存，但以更高的计算成本和更长的收敛时间为代价，在内存使用相当的情况下，带检查点的BP在准确率、收敛速度和计算量上均显著优于它们。
Motivation: 现有研究往往仅将FmAD和ZO与标准BP比较，忽略了像激活检查点这样的内存高效变体，导致对内存节省方法的优劣评估不全面。
Method: 对BP、检查点BP、FmAD和ZO（包括方差缩减变体）进行统一的理论和实证比较，基于LLM和视觉-语言模型训练任务。
Result: 检查点BP相比FmAD和ZO变体，在类似内存使用下实现了最高31.1%的更高准确率、34.8%的更快收敛速度和3.8倍更少的计算量，并揭示了FmAD和ZO的不稳定性失败模式。
Conclusion: 内存高效的方法带来了根本不同的权衡，忽略这些区别会导致对LLM优化的误导性结论。

papers.title: BiomechGPT: Extending Motion-Language Models to Clinical Motion Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Advances in markerless motion capture are making high-quality biomechanical data increasingly accessible, creating a growing need for scalable downstream analytics. Building a bespoke pipeline for each analysis task is time-consuming, motivating models that can flexibly handle diverse clinical questions within a single framework. Recent work has shown that fine-tuning language models to accept tokenized motion as an additional modality enables descriptive captioning of movement, raising the question of whether these models are also capable of clinically relevant motion understanding, where diverse tasks and annotations provide a natural testbed. We investigate whether such a multimodal motion--language model can answer detailed, clinically meaningful questions about movement. We collected 71 hours of biomechanical data from 750 participants, many with movement impairments, performing tasks commonly used in clinical assessment. To further expand the training dataset, we designed a cross-format tokenizer that directly encodes motion data from heterogeneous formats into a shared latent space without paired data, allowing a second dataset to be incorporated and enabling pooling annotations across datasets. From these tokenized representations, we constructed a multimodal dataset of motion-related question--answer pairs and used it to train BiomechGPT, a multimodal biomechanics--language model. BiomechGPT achieves competitive performance across a range of clinically relevant tasks, with performance scaling with both dataset and model size. It offers a new way for clinicians and researchers to interact with biomechanical data and represents a promising direction for rehabilitation-focused movement analysis. Project page: https://intelligentsensingandrehabilitation.github.io/BiomechGPT/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BiomechGPT，一种多模态生物力学-语言模型，通过将运动数据编码为词元（tokens）并与语言模型结合，实现临床运动理解。模型在750名参与者的71小时生物力学数据上训练，包含跨格式分词器（tokenizer）以融合异构数据。BiomechGPT在多项临床相关任务上取得竞争性能，并随数据和模型规模提升。
Motivation: 标记捕捉（markerless motion capture）产生大量生物力学数据，但为每个分析任务构建定制管线耗时费力，亟需一个单一框架内灵活处理多种临床问题的模型。
Method: 收集含运动障碍的750人71小时生物力学数据；设计跨格式分词器将异构运动数据编码为共享隐空间；构建多模态问答数据集并训练BiomechGPT（生物力学-语言模型）。
Result: BiomechGPT在多项临床相关任务上取得竞争性能，且性能随数据和模型规模增加而提升。
Conclusion: 该模型为临床医生和研究人员提供了与生物力学数据交互的新方式，代表了康复导向运动分析的有前景方向。

papers.title: Sense and Sensitivity: Examining the Influence of Semantic Recall on Long Context Code Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for understanding large codebases, but whether they understand operational semantics of long code context or rely on pattern matching shortcuts remains unclear. We distinguish between lexical recall (retrieving code verbatim) and semantic recall (understanding operational semantics). Evaluating 10 state-of-the-art LLMs, we find that while frontier models achieve near-perfect, position-independent lexical recall, semantic recall degrades severely when code is centrally positioned in long contexts. We introduce semantic recall sensitivity to measure whether tasks require understanding of code's operational semantics vs. permit pattern matching shortcuts. Through a novel counterfactual measurement method, we show that models rely heavily on pattern matching shortcuts to solve existing code understanding benchmarks. We propose a new task SemTrace, which achieves high semantic recall sensitivity through unpredictable operations; LLMs' accuracy exhibits severe positional effects, with median accuracy drops of 92.73% versus CRUXEval's 53.36% as the relevant code snippet approaches the middle of the input code context. Our findings suggest current evaluations substantially underestimate semantic recall failures in long context code understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型在长上下文代码理解中是否真正理解操作语义（语义回忆）还是依赖模式匹配（词汇回忆）。通过反事实测量方法，发现即使前沿模型词汇回忆接近完美，语义回忆在代码位于长上下文中央时显著下降，并提出新任务SemTrace，其语义回忆灵敏度更高，揭示了当前基准低估了语义回忆失败。
Motivation: 现有LLM在长上下文代码理解中是否真正理解操作语义尚不明确，可能依赖模式匹配捷径，导致对模型能力的错误估计。
Method: 区分词汇回忆与语义回忆，提出语义回忆灵敏度衡量是否需要理解操作语义；设计反事实测量方法，并构建新任务SemTrace，使用不可预测操作来消除模式匹配。
Result: 在10个LLM上，语义回忆在代码位于长上下文中央时严重退化；SemTrace上模型准确率的中位数下降92.73%，而CRUXEval下降53.36%。
Conclusion: 当前代码理解基准低估了语义回忆失败，尤其在长上下文中央位置；未来需设计更敏感的基准来真实评估LLM的语义理解能力。

papers.title: A Learning-Based Ansatz Satisfying Boundary Conditions in Variational Problems
papers.abstract_en: Recently, innovative adaptations of the Ritz method incorporating deep learning have been developed, known as the Deep Ritz Method. This approach employs a neural network as the trial function for variational problems. However, the neural network does not inherently satisfy the boundary conditions of the variational problem. To address this issue, the Deep Ritz Method introduces a penalty term into the functional, which is strongly dependent on hyperparameters and may lead to misleading results during the optimization process. In this work, we propose an ansatz that inherently satisfies the boundary conditions of the variational problem, thereby eliminating the need for penalty terms. A key contribution of this study is that all supporting theorems and corollaries are established in Sobolev norms, which constitute the natural framework for variational problems, as the functional depends explicitly on the solution and its derivatives. This provides a rigorous justification for the expressiveness and admissibility of the proposed ansatz within the Ritz method. The results demonstrate that the proposed ansatz not only avoids misleading optimization outcomes but also reduces complexity while maintaining accuracy, highlighting its practical effectiveness for solving variational problems.

papers.title: Parameter estimation for land-surface models using Neural Physics
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel inverse-modelling approach that estimates the parameters of a simple land-surface model (LSM) by assimilating data into a differentiable, physics-based forward model formulated using convolutional operations. The governing equations are expressed within the Neural Physics framework, allowing direct gradient-based optimisation of time-dependent parameters without the need to derive and maintain adjoint formulations. The model parameters are estimated by minimising the mismatch between model predictions and synthetic or observational data. Although differentiability is enabled through machine-learning libraries, the forward model itself remains entirely physics-based and neither the forward model nor the parameter estimation procedure involve training. To evaluate the approach, we first generate synthetic observations of soil temperature by running the forward model with known parameter values and subsequently treat these parameters as unknown in an inverse problem. We show that observations of soil temperature at a single depth are insufficient to reliably constrain the model parameters. Using observations at two depths, however, does yield reliable parameter estimates, although the individual contributions of latent and sensible heat fluxes cannot be distinguished. We also apply the approach to urban flux tower data from Phoenix, United States, and show that the thermal conductivity, volumetric heat capacity and the combined sensible-latent heat transfer coefficient can be reliably estimated whilst using an observed value for the effective surface albedo. The resulting model accurately predicts the outgoing longwave radiation, conductive soil fluxes and the combined sensible-latent heat fluxes, demonstrating that the Neural Physics framework can be used to accurately determine the parameters of the particular LSM used here...
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Neural Physics的反演方法，通过将数据同化到可微分的基于卷积的物理前向模型中，来估计简单陆面模型（LSM）的参数。该方法利用机器学习库实现微分性，但前向模型完全基于物理，无需训练。通过合成土壤温度观测和凤凰城城市通量数据验证，表明在两个深度观测下可可靠估计参数，如热导率、体积热容量和组合感热-潜热交换系数，并能准确预测出射长波辐射和土壤热通量等。
Motivation: 传统陆面模型参数估计通常需要推导并维护伴随公式（adjoint formulations），过程复杂。论文旨在提出一种更简便的逆建模方法，利用可微分物理模型直接进行梯度优化，无需训练过程。
Method: 将陆面模型的控制方程用卷积操作表述，集成到Neural Physics框架中，从而使得模型可微分。通过最小化模型预测与观测数据（合成或真实）的差异来直接优化时变参数，无需传统伴随方法或训练神经网络。
Result: 合成实验表明，单个深度土壤温度观测不足以可靠约束参数，而两个深度观测可得到可靠估计，但无法区分感热和潜热通量的独立贡献。应用于凤凰城城市通量数据，可可靠估计热导率、体积热容量和组合感热-潜热交换系数，模型能准确预测出射长波辐射、传导土壤热通量和组合感热-潜热通量。
Conclusion: Neural Physics框架可用于准确确定简单陆面模型的参数，为陆面模型参数估计提供了一种无需训练的可微分物理方法。

papers.title: Measuring AI Ability to Complete Long Software Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Despite rapid progress on AI benchmarks, the real-world meaning of benchmark performance remains unclear. To quantify the capabilities of AI systems in terms of human capabilities, we propose a new metric: 50%-task-completion time horizon. This is the time humans typically take to complete tasks that AI models can complete with 50% success rate. We first timed humans with relevant domain expertise on a combination of RE-Bench, HCAST, and 66 novel shorter tasks. On these tasks, current frontier AI models such as Claude 3.7 Sonnet have a 50% time horizon of around 50 minutes. Furthermore, frontier AI time horizon has been doubling approximately every seven months since 2019, though the trend may have accelerated in 2024. The increase in AI models' time horizons seems to be primarily driven by greater reliability and ability to adapt to mistakes, combined with better logical reasoning and tool use capabilities. We discuss the limitations of our results -- including their degree of external validity -- and the implications of increased autonomy for dangerous capabilities. If these results generalize to real-world software tasks, extrapolation of this trend predicts that within 5 years, AI systems will be capable of automating many software tasks that currently take humans a month.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新指标——50%任务完成时间视界（50%-task-completion time horizon），用于衡量AI系统在人类通常完成软件任务所需时间内的能力。通过计时人类专家在RE-Bench、HCAST和66个新短任务上的表现，发现当前前沿AI模型（如Claude 3.7 Sonnet）的50%时间视界约为50分钟，且自2019年以来每约7个月翻一番，这一趋势可能由可靠性、适应错误能力及逻辑推理和工具使用能力的提升驱动。论文讨论了结果的外部效度局限及对危险能力的潜在影响，并预测若趋势外推，5年内AI将能自动化目前人类需一个月完成的许多软件任务。
Motivation: 现有AI基准测试的进步难以直接对应现实世界中的能力含义，需要一种以人类能力为参照的度量来量化AI系统的实际任务完成水平。
Method: 定义50%任务完成时间视界，即人类通常完成AI模型能以50%成功率完成的任务所需的时间；通过计时人类专家在多个基准（RE-Bench、HCAST及66个新短任务）上的表现，并与前沿AI模型（如Claude 3.7 Sonnet）进行比较。
Result: 当前前沿AI模型的50%时间视界约为50分钟；自2019年以来，该时间视界每约7个月翻一番，2024年可能加速；提升主要源自可靠性、错误适应能力及逻辑推理和工具使用能力的增强。
Conclusion: 若结果能泛化到真实软件任务，外推趋势表明5年内AI将能自动化目前人类需一个月完成的许多软件任务，但结果的外部效度有限，且需警惕自主性提升带来的危险能力风险。

papers.title: Training Diagonal Linear Networks with Stochastic Sharpness-Aware Minimization
papers.abstract_en: We analyze the landscape and training dynamics of diagonal linear networks in a linear regression task, with the network parameters being perturbed by isotropic normal noise during training. The addition of such noise may be interpreted as a stochastic form of sharpness-aware minimization (SAM) and we prove several results that relate its action on the underlying landscape and training dynamics to the sharpness of the loss. In particular, the noise induces a weighted mixture of fractional norm penalties on the network parameters, which forces the individual layers to balance at a fast rate and changes the underlying landscape to favor solutions that result from a shrinkage-thresholding operator applied to the true parameter. We show that balancing the layers equates to minimizing the average sharpness, as well as the trace of the Hessian matrix, among all possible factorizations of the same linear predictor. Further, we characterize how the noise level of the normal perturbations acts as a regularization parameter, with exact descriptions of its effect on shrinkage, thresholding, and balancing speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在线性回归任务中，分析了被各向同性高斯噪声扰动参数的对角线性网络的训练动态和损失景观。噪声可解释为随机形式的锐度感知最小化（SAM），理论表明噪声会引入网络参数的分数范数惩罚的加权混合，迫使各层快速平衡，并改变损失景观以偏好来自真实参数的收缩-阈值算子解。平衡层等价于在所有相同线性预测器的因式分解中最小化平均锐度和海森矩阵迹。噪声水平作为正则化参数，其效果被精确刻画。
Motivation: 理解随机SAM（通过噪声扰动）如何影响线性网络的训练动态，特别是锐度、正则化和层平衡之间的内在关系。
Method: 解析对角线性网络在线性回归任务中，参数被各向同性高斯噪声扰动时的训练动态，通过理论推导将噪声效应等价为加权混合的分数范数惩罚，并分析其对层平衡和景观偏好的影响。
Result: 噪声诱导的惩罚迫使各层以快速速率平衡，且平衡层等价于在所有相同预测器的因式分解中最小化平均锐度和海森矩阵迹。噪声水平作为正则化参数，精确描述了其在收缩、阈值和平衡速度上的效果。
Conclusion: 论文从理论上揭示了随机SAM通过噪声扰动在线性网络中扮演的角色，即通过分数范数惩罚引导模型偏好锐度更小的解，并为理解SAM的正则化机制提供了理论依据。

papers.title: Device-Cloud Collaborative LLM Inference with Multi-Modal, Multi-Task, Multi-Turn Conversations
papers.abstract_en: Compared to traditional machine learning models, recent large language models (LLMs) can exhibit multi-task-solving capabilities through multi-modal data sources and multi-turn conversations. These unique characteristics of LLMs, together with their large model size, make their deployment more challenging. Specifically, (i) deploying LLMs on devices faces computational, memory, and energy resource issues, while (ii) deploying them in the cloud cannot guarantee real-time service and incurs communication/usage costs. In this paper, we design TMO, a device-cloud LLM inference system with Three-M Offloading: Multi-modal, Multi-task, and Multi-turn. TMO incorporates (i) a lightweight on-device LLM that can process simple tasks at high speed and (ii) a large-scale cloud LLM that can handle multi-modal data sources. We develop a resource-constrained reinforcement learning (RCRL) strategy for TMO that optimizes the inference location (i.e., device vs. cloud) and multi-modal data sources to use for each task in multi-turn conversations, aiming to maximize the long-term reward (response quality, latency, and usage cost) while adhering to resource constraints. We also contribute M4A1, a new dataset we curated across multiple modalities, tasks, conversation turns, and LLM configurations, enabling evaluation of offloading decisions. We demonstrate the effectiveness of TMO compared to several exploration-decision and LLM-as-Router baselines, showing significant improvements in latency, cost, and response quality. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/liangqiyuan/TMO.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TMO，一个设备-云协同的大语言模型（LLM）推理系统，支持多模态、多任务、多轮对话的卸载决策。TMO结合轻量级设备端LLM和云端LLM，使用资源受限强化学习（RCRL）优化推理位置和数据源选择，以最大化长期奖励（响应质量、延迟和成本）。同时贡献了M4A1数据集，实验表明TMO在延迟、成本和响应质量上优于基线。
Motivation: 大语言模型在设备端部署受限于计算和内存，云端部署则存在实时性和成本问题。现有系统未联合优化多模态、多任务、多轮对话场景下的卸载决策。
Method: 设计TMO系统，包含轻量级设备端LLM和云端LLM；提出资源受限强化学习（RCRL）策略，在资源约束下优化每个任务的推理位置和多模态数据源选择，最大化长期累积奖励。
Result: 与多种探索决策基线和LLM-as-Router基线相比，TMO在延迟、使用成本和响应质量上均取得显著提升。
Conclusion: TMO有效解决了LLM在多模态、多任务、多轮对话场景下的设备-云协同推理问题，但未提及在其他领域（如天气预测）的适用性。

summary_sections.motivation: 大语言模型在设备端部署受限于计算和内存，云端部署则存在实时性和成本问题。现有系统未联合优化多模态、多任务、多轮对话场景下的卸载决策。
summary_sections.method: 设计TMO系统，包含轻量级设备端LLM和云端LLM；提出资源受限强化学习（RCRL）策略，在资源约束下优化每个任务的推理位置和多模态数据源选择，最大化长期累积奖励。
summary_sections.result: 与多种探索决策基线和LLM-as-Router基线相比，TMO在延迟、使用成本和响应质量上均取得显著提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: TMO有效解决了LLM在多模态、多任务、多轮对话场景下的设备-云协同推理问题，但未提及在其他领域（如天气预测）的适用性。

papers.title: Asynchronous Perception Machine For Efficient Test-Time-Training
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we propose Asynchronous Perception Machine (APM), a computationally-efficient architecture for test-time-training (TTT). APM can process patches of an image one at a time in any order asymmetrically and still encode semantic-awareness in the net. We demonstrate APM's ability to recognize out-of-distribution images without dataset-specific pre-training, augmentation or any-pretext task. APM offers competitive performance over existing TTT approaches. To perform TTT, APM just distills test sample's representation once. APM possesses a unique property: it can learn using just this single representation and starts predicting semantically-aware features. APM demostrates potential applications beyond test-time-training: APM can scale up to a dataset of 2D images and yield semantic-clusterings in a single forward pass. APM also provides first empirical evidence towards validating GLOM's insight, i.e. input percept is a field. Therefore, APM helps us converge towards an implementation which can do both interpolation and perception on a shared-connectionist hardware. Our code is publicly available at this link: https://rajatmodi62.github.io/apm_project_page/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出异步感知机（APM），一种计算高效的测试时训练架构。APM可逐个异步处理图像块，编码语义感知，无需数据集特定预训练即可识别分布外图像。仅需一次蒸馏测试样本表示即可训练，并能扩展到2D图像数据集做语义聚类，首次为GLOM的“输入感知是场”提供经验证据。
Motivation: 现有测试时训练方法计算成本高或需要特定预训练任务，APM旨在提供更高效且无需预训练的架构。
Method: APM架构允许异步处理图像块，一次一个、任意顺序，在网络中编码语义感知。测试时训练仅需蒸馏测试样本的一次表示，网络即可学习并预测。
Result: 在分布外图像识别任务上达到与现有方法竞争的性能，不需数据集特定预训练；一次前向传播即可对2D图像数据集进行语义聚类；首次实证支持GLOM的见解。
Conclusion: APM在测试时训练之外有潜在应用，有助于实现共享连接硬件上的插值和感知。

papers.title: On Occlusions in Video Action Detection: Benchmark Datasets And Training Recipes
papers.abstract_en: This paper explores the impact of occlusions in video action detection. We facilitate this study by introducing five new benchmark datasets namely O-UCF and O-JHMDB consisting of synthetically controlled static/dynamic occlusions, OVIS-UCF and OVIS-JHMDB consisting of occlusions with realistic motions and Real-OUCF for occlusions in realistic-world scenarios. We formally confirm an intuitive expectation: existing models suffer a lot as occlusion severity is increased and exhibit different behaviours when occluders are static vs when they are moving. We discover several intriguing phenomenon emerging in neural nets: 1) transformers can naturally outperform CNN models which might have even used occlusion as a form of data augmentation during training 2) incorporating symbolic-components like capsules to such backbones allows them to bind to occluders never even seen during training and 3) Islands of agreement can emerge in realistic images/videos without instance-level supervision, distillation or contrastive-based objectives2(eg. video-textual training). Such emergent properties allow us to derive simple yet effective training recipes which lead to robust occlusion models inductively satisfying the first two stages of the binding mechanism (grouping/segregation). Models leveraging these recipes outperform existing video action-detectors under occlusion by 32.3% on O-UCF, 32.7% on O-JHMDB & 2.6% on Real-OUCF in terms of the vMAP metric. The code for this work has been released at https://github.com/rajatmodi62/OccludedActionBenchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了视频动作检测中的遮挡问题，提出了五个新的基准数据集（O-UCF、O-JHMDB、OVIS-UCF、OVIS-JHMDB、Real-OUCF），涵盖静态、动态及真实场景遮挡。实验表明现有模型在遮挡严重时性能显著下降，并发现Transformer优于CNN、胶囊网络可泛化到未见遮挡、图像/视频中无需实例级监督即可出现共识区域等有趣现象。基于这些发现，作者提出了简单有效的训练方法，使模型在遮挡下性能提升（O-UCF上vMAP提高32.3%，O-JHMDB提高32.7%，Real-OUCF提高2.6%）。
Motivation: 视频动作检测中遮挡普遍存在但缺乏系统性研究，现有模型在遮挡下的性能退化程度未知，且静态与动态遮挡的影响差异未被量化。
Method: 构建五个带标注的遮挡基准数据集，系统评估CNN和Transformer等模型在不同遮挡类型和严重程度下的性能，并分析神经网络中出现的涌现现象（如Transformer的鲁棒性、胶囊网络的绑定能力、图像中的共识区域），据此设计训练策略。
Result: 在O-UCF、O-JHMDB和Real-OUCF上，所提方法分别将vMAP指标提升32.3%、32.7%和2.6%，超越了现有视频动作检测器。
Conclusion: 论文指出，结合胶囊网络等符号组件的Transformer骨架可通过简单的训练配方在遮挡场景下显著提升检测性能，并强调无需实例级监督的共识区域涌现特性。

papers.title: Calibrated Hybrid CNN-Transformer for Retinal OCT Classification
papers.abstract_en: Deep models for retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT) classification report high accuracy but rarely report whether their confidence can be trusted -- a gap that matters when a wrong-but-confident reading delays sight-saving treatment. We pair a hybrid convolutional-Transformer encoder with a gradient-boosting (XGBoost) classification head and a three-part clinical safety layer: confidence calibration, out-of-distribution (OOD) rejection, and per-prediction uncertainty flagging. On four-class OCT (84,495 scans) the model reaches 95.4% accuracy while cutting calibration error twelve-fold (expected calibration error, ECE = 0.0024), so the confidence it reports tracks its true accuracy. To our knowledge this is the first OCT classifier to validate all three safety mechanisms jointly, with public weights and reproducible multi-seed evaluation.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Code, model weights, and REST inference API are available on GitHub and HuggingFace
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个混合CNN-Transformer架构结合梯度提升分类头(XGBoost)的视网膜OCT分类模型，并引入了三部分临床安全层：置信度校准、分布外样本拒绝和逐预测不确定性标记。在四个类别的OCT数据集（84,495张扫描）上达到95.4%准确率，并将预期校准误差(ECE)降至0.0024（降低12倍）。据作者所知，这是第一个同时验证这三种安全机制的OCT分类器，并公开了权重和可复现的多种子评估。
Motivation: 现有的视网膜OCT分类深度学习模型虽然准确率高，但很少报告置信度是否可信；错误但高置信度的预测可能延误治疗，存在安全缺口。
Method: 采用混合卷积-Transformer编码器，搭配XGBoost分类头，并设计了三部分临床安全层：置信度校准、分布外(OOD)拒绝、逐预测不确定性标记。
Result: 在四类OCT数据集上达到95.4%准确率，校准误差降低12倍（ECE=0.0024）。
Conclusion: 这是第一个同时验证置信度校准、OOD拒绝和逐预测不确定性标记这三种安全机制的OCT分类器，并提供公开权重和可复现评估。

papers.title: An Autonomous Scientific Knowledge Generation Framework for AI-Driven Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming scientific discovery, but its effectiveness is fundamentally limited by the availability of structured scientific knowledge. Although existing databases have accelerated data-driven materials research, much of the knowledge needed for predictive modeling and inverse design remains embedded in unstructured scientific literature. We present an Autonomous Scientific Knowledge Generation Framework that transforms scientific publications into a Unified AI-Ready Scientific Knowledge Base. The framework integrates ontology-guided literature acquisition, hybrid scientific knowledge extraction, semantic harmonization, knowledge fusion, and validation within a unified workflow. Rather than treating literature retrieval, information extraction, and database construction as separate tasks, the framework progressively converts scientific publications into structured, semantically consistent, and provenance-preserving knowledge suitable for AI-driven reasoning. As a proof of concept, the framework was applied to electro-optic materials. Autonomous literature acquisition retrieved and validated about 1,000 publications from multiple scholarly repositories. A representative subset of eight publications was processed through the complete workflow, generating 29 structured scientific records that were harmonized into 7 canonical scientific records. The results demonstrate the complete transformation from scientific literature to an AI-ready scientific knowledge base while preserving quantitative measurements, operating conditions, provenance, and scientific context. The proposed framework provides a scalable, domain-independent foundation for predictive AI, generative AI, and closed-loop AI-driven scientific discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个自主科学知识生成框架，将科学出版物转化为统一的人工智能就绪科学知识库，应用于电光材料领域。框架集成了本体引导的文献获取、混合科学知识提取、语义协调、知识融合和验证。实验展示了从约1000篇出版物中处理8篇代表性文献，生成29条结构化记录并协调为7条规范记录的完整流程。
Motivation: 现有数据库加速了数据驱动材料研究，但预测建模和逆向设计所需的知识仍嵌在非结构化的科学文献中，限制了AI在科学发现中的有效性。
Method: 提出自主科学知识生成框架，包括本体引导文献获取、混合科学知识提取、语义协调、知识融合和验证，形成统一工作流，将出版物转化为结构化、语义一致、保留来源的知识。
Result: 框架应用于电光材料，自动获取约1000篇出版物，处理8篇代表性文献后生成29条结构化记录，并协调为7条规范记录，保留了定量测量、操作条件、来源和科学上下文。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了一个可扩展、领域无关的基础，支持预测性AI、生成式AI和闭环AI驱动的科学发现。

papers.title: A Unified Model for Highly Accurate ECG-Free Dynamic Coronary Roadmapping Using Spatio-Temporal Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Percutaneous Coronary Intervention (PCI) is a minimally invasive procedure used to restore coronary blood flow obstructed by atherosclerotic plaque. During PCI, repeated injections of iodine-based contrast agents are required to visualize the coronary arteries and guide interventional devices. However, frequent contrast injections increase radiation exposure and the risk of contrast-induced nephropathy, with acute kidney injury reported in up to 30% of patients with renal impairment. Dynamic Coronary Roadmapping (DRM) reduces these risks by overlaying a precomputed angiographic vessel map onto live fluoroscopy and continuously updating it throughout the procedure. Accurate DRM relies on precise cardiac phase matching between angiography and fluoroscopy, together with reliable catheter tip tracking for motion compensation. These tasks remain challenging in ECG-free settings and when only limited manual annotations are available. We present a unified DRM framework that simultaneously performs cardiac phase matching and catheter tip tracking for accurate real-time guidance. Our method employs a large-scale spatio-temporal encoder pretrained on 16 million X-ray frames to learn cardiac motion dynamics. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first application of large-scale spatio-temporal pretraining for motion compensation in DRM. We further introduce auxiliary tasks based on ECG R-peak detection and catheter tip tracking, improving optimization while eliminating the need for extensive catheter mask annotations. Finally, a majority-voting postprocessing strategy aggregates temporal predictions, improving robustness and providing a confidence score that correlates with phase-matching error. Comprehensive evaluation on clinical X-ray datasets demonstrates state-of-the-art performance, achieving low temporal misalignment and robust phase-matching accuracy suitable for real-time DRM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的动态冠状动脉路图（DRM）框架，利用时空Transformer同时实现心脏相位匹配和导管尖端跟踪，无需心电图信号。模型在1600万X射线帧上预训练，引入ECG R波检测和导管尖端跟踪辅助任务，并通过多数投票后处理提高鲁棒性。在临床数据集上达到先进水平，适用于实时PCI导航。
Motivation: 在经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）中，频繁的造影剂注射增加辐射暴露和造影剂肾病风险。动态冠状动脉路图（DRM）可减少这些风险，但现有方法依赖心电图（ECG）进行心脏相位匹配，且需要大量手动标注。
Method: 提出一个统一DRM框架，使用大规模时空编码器（在1600万X射线帧上预训练）同时执行心脏相位匹配和导管尖端跟踪。引入ECG R波检测和导管尖端跟踪作为辅助任务，消除对导管掩膜标注的依赖。采用多数投票后处理聚合时间预测，提供与相位匹配误差相关的置信度分数。
Result: 在临床X射线数据集上，该方法实现了低时间错位和稳健的相位匹配精度，达到最先进性能，适用于实时DRM。
Conclusion: 该框架是首个将大规模时空预训练用于DRM运动补偿的工作，消除了对ECG信号的依赖，并减少了对人工标注的需求。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Trivial Prompt Reframing Bypasses Safety Guardrails in Googleś MedGemma-4B
papers.abstract_en: Open-weight medical language models are increasingly used as the base of patient-facing and clinician-support applications. Their model cards prohibit specific behaviors -- recommending exact drug dosages, issuing definitive diagnoses, prescribing treatments, adjudicating drug-drug interactions, and advising that emergency care can be skipped -- yet a model card describes intended behavior, not robust behavior. We quantify that gap for MedGemma-4B-it under attacks that require no technical sophistication. We build a fully factorial benchmark of 5 guarded-behavior concepts x 50 deterministically templated questions x 6 lay-accessible attack manners x 3 repetitions (4,500 generations), serve the model locally through Ollama under default sampling, and code every response refuse/hedge/comply with three independent judges (an LLM judge, a transparent regex judge, and an NLI-entailment judge). Under the primary LLM judge the overall Attack Success Rate (ASR, the fraction coded comply) is 38.0%. The two framings that reinterpret the request as legitimate dominate: recasting a question as a "medical board exam" item raises ASR from a 29.0% baseline to 53.1% (+24.0 points), and an appeal to an alleged doctor's authority raises it to 43.7% (+14.7); crude instruction-override prefixes have no significant effect. Robustness is dominated by topic: the drug-interaction guardrail is nearly absent (83.2% ASR) while the emergency-deferral guardrail is strong (4.7%) -- and the authority framing is the only attack that breaches it. We report Wilson confidence intervals, cluster-bootstrap effect sizes, a cluster-robust logistic regression, Cochran's Q, per-manner McNemar tests, and inter-judge reliability (Fleiss' kappa = 0.26); absolute ASR is judge-dependent while the ordering of attacks and topics is not. Our findings motivate stronger deployment-time guardrails for open medical models.

papers.title: Spectral Origins of the Self-Correction Blind Spot in Autoregressive Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large autoregressive language models exhibit a self-correction blind spot: they reliably fix identical errors when attributed to an external source yet fail to fix the same errors in their own outputs. Prior work has documented this phenomenon empirically, through controlled error injection, error-depth decompositions, RL-based verifier-corrector training, and intrinsic self-verification, but offers no formal model of why generating a token suppresses the ability to detect its error, no quantitative activation condition for correction markers, and no convergence guarantee for reinforcement-learning-based self-correction. We close these gaps with SPARC, a spectral-algebraic theory of self-correction in autoregressive generation. We define the error-propagation operator as the product of per-step attention Jacobians on the residual stream and prove that the blind spot arises if and only if the spectral radius of this operator is at least one. We derive a sharp activation threshold, given as a function of the spectral radius, that a correction marker must exceed, recovering the 89.3\% blind-spot reduction observed with a simple ``Wait'' marker. We further prove that RL-based verifier-corrector training converges at a rate proportional to the squared coupling strength over the square root of the number of samples if and only if the verifier-corrector coupling matrix has spectral norm below one, and that this criterion is invariant across residual-stream autoregressive modalities, unifying text LLMs and autoregressive image and video generation. Experiments across four backbones and a visual autoregressive probe validate every theorem, with spectral predictions matching measured blind-spot rates within 3.2\% RMSE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPARC，一个自回归生成中自校正盲点的谱代数理论。该理论将误差传播算子定义为残差流上逐步注意力 Jacobian 矩阵的乘积，证明盲点出现当且仅当该算子的谱半径≥1，并推导出校正标志必须超过的激活阈值。理论还证明了基于强化学习的 verifier-corrector 训练在耦合矩阵谱范数<1时收敛，且该条件跨模态（文本 LLM、自回归图像/视频生成）不变。实验在四个骨干模型和视觉自回归探针上验证了理论，谱预测与盲点率的 RMSE 在 3.2% 以内。
Motivation: 现有研究虽然通过受控误差注入、误差深度分解、RL 训练等方法实证了自校正盲点现象，但缺乏形式化模型解释为何生成 token 会抑制错误检测能力，没有量化校正标志的激活条件，也没有 RL 自校正的收敛保证。
Method: 定义误差传播算子为残差流上注意力 Jacobian 矩阵的乘积，推导盲点出现的充要条件（谱半径≥1）；推导校正标志必须超过的激活阈值（谱半径的函数）；证明 RL verifier-corrector 训练在耦合矩阵谱范数<1时收敛，且该条件跨模态不变。
Result: 实验在四个骨干模型和视觉自回归探针上验证了所有定理，谱预测与实测盲点率的 RMSE 为 3.2%；一个简单的 'Wait' 标志实现了 89.3% 的盲点减少。
Conclusion: 本文统一了文本 LLM 和自回归图像/视频生成中的自校正机制，提供了收敛保证和定量条件。

papers.title: Quota Marketplace: Dynamic Pricing for Efficient Allocation of ML Training Resources
papers.abstract_en: The escalating demand for Machine Learning (ML) training resources in recent years has resulted in a substantial gap between the high demand and the available supply. Efficient allocation of these scarce and expensive resources is crucial for organizations to maximize their return on investment. Existing resource allocation mechanisms, like Karma [OSDI'23], are designed to guarantee Pareto efficiency and max-min fairness in settings with dynamic (time-varying) user demands, but fail to preserve these key properties in the presence of demands with heterogeneous values. Given the ubiquity and inevitability of heterogeneity in organizational values of different workloads, effective resource allocation policies must accommodate these variations. In this paper, we describe the design, implementation, deployment, and theoretical analysis of Quota Marketplace, a market-based mechanism to efficiently allocate ML training chips (like GPUs), explicitly addressing scenarios with demands of heterogeneous value. We detail the implementation of this mechanism within Google and present metrics that demonstrate its impact. We also discuss many business-critical requirements that the Quota Marketplace handles quite effectively, and document the gains and opportunities it has unlocked. We establish theoretically how this market-based approach achieves the essential properties of Pareto efficiency and max-min fairness by allowing the users to express the value of their workloads and enabling dynamic resource pricing based on supply and demand fluctuations. Ultimately, the market facilitates resource allocation that aligns with organizational priorities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文描述了 Quota Marketplace，一种基于市场的机制，用于高效分配机器学习训练资源（如 GPU），特别针对具有异质性价值的需求场景。该机制在 Google 内部实现并部署，在保证帕累托效率和最大最小公平性的同时，允许用户表达工作负载价值，并根据供需动态定价。
Motivation: 现有资源分配机制（如 Karma）在用户需求动态变化时能保证帕累托效率和最大最小公平性，但无法处理具有异质性价值的需求，而组织中不同工作负载的价值差异普遍存在，需要有效的分配策略。
Method: 提出一种市场机制，允许用户为工作负载出价，根据供需波动动态定价，通过理论分析证明该机制能实现帕累托效率和最大最小公平性，并在 Google 内部实现和部署。
Result: 在 Google 内部部署后，展示了该机制的影响指标，并讨论了其有效处理的业务关键需求，以及带来的收益和机会。
Conclusion: 该市场机制通过允许用户表达工作负载价值并基于供需动态定价，实现了帕累托效率和最大最小公平性，使资源分配与组织优先级对齐。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Discovering Latent Response Laws in Forced Physical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Governing equations provide compact descriptions of physical systems, yet the variables in which they are simple are often hidden in high-dimensional measurements. This challenge is sharper for forced systems, whose responses depend on both intrinsic dynamics and time-dependent inputs. Here we introduce FLARE, a forced latent autoencoder for response equations that learns compact response coordinates, identifies sparse input-dependent latent dynamics and decodes equation rollouts to full responses. By estimating latent dimension from data and separating state estimation from external forcing, FLARE enables forecasts to be initialized from past responses and driven by prescribed future inputs. Across known dynamical systems, application-scale forced responses and visual observations, FLARE recovers compact forced dynamics and predicts long-horizon high-dimensional responses under inputs not used for training. By turning learned coordinates into a dynamical interface, FLARE extends equation discovery to systems whose effective states are hidden within complex observations, providing a route for interpretable modelling and prediction of high-dimensional responses in forced dynamical systems.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 5 figures and 2 tables. Supplementary Information provided as an ancillary file
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FLARE（Forced Latent Autoencoder for Response Equations），一种从高维测量数据中学习受迫物理系统紧凑潜在动力学方程的方法。FLARE通过估计潜在维度、分离状态估计与外部强迫，能够利用过去响应初始化预测并由未来输入驱动，在已知动力系统、工程受迫响应和视觉观测数据上恢复紧凑动力学并实现长期高维预测。
Motivation: 受迫物理系统的响应同时依赖内在动力学和时变输入，而控制变量往往隐蔽在高维测量中，现有方程发现方法难以处理这种隐藏状态问题。
Method: FLARE包含一个受迫潜在自编码器，学习紧凑响应坐标，识别稀疏的输入依赖潜在动力学，并从方程滚动解码得到完整响应。它从数据估计潜在维度，将状态估计与外部强迫分离。
Result: 在已知动力系统、应用尺度受迫响应和视觉观测上，FLARE恢复了紧凑受迫动力学，并在未参与训练的输入下实现了长期高维响应预测。
Conclusion: FLARE将学习到的坐标转化为动态接口，将方程发现扩展到有效状态隐藏于复杂观测中的系统，为受迫动力系统高维响应的可解释建模和预测提供路径。
Relevance: 70

papers.title: The Silent Freeze: Predicting When Low-Precision Training Stops Learning
papers.abstract_en: Training in reduced floating-point precision can silently halt learning: when a gradient-descent weight update falls below half the unit in the last place (ULP) of the weight, it rounds away and that coordinate freezes while its gradient is still nonzero. The freeze is deterministic, governed by a per-coordinate half-ULP condition, and predictable from a high-precision trajectory and the target mantissa length alone, without low-precision data. In a small GPT trained under the standard AdamW-plus-cosine recipe with bf16-equivalent stored weights, training proceeds normally and then permanently freezes just past mid-run, within four steps of the a-priori prediction. In a $124$-million-parameter GPT-2 transformer whose weights are constrained to the $8$-bit floating-point grid after every optimizer step, with no master weights, the dense weights freeze at initialization in both fp8 formats -- predicted \emph{a priori} from an fp32 reference -- and validation loss plateaus while full precision keeps improving. Stochastic rounding removes the persistent freeze, and the same reference predicts that too. The condition transfers across frozen-feature regression, a mantissa-truncation emulator spanning $128\times$ in precision, small networks, and a CNN on MNIST: a computable axis of low-precision training, not diffuse noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究低精度训练中权重更新因舍入误差而冻结的现象，提出基于半ULP条件的确定性冻结预测方法，并在GPT和CNN实验中验证预测准确性。
Motivation: 低精度训练中梯度更新可能因舍入误差而停止，导致学习提前终止，但该现象的预测机制尚不明确。
Method: 通过分析权重更新与ULP的关系，推导出半ULP冻结条件，并利用高精度轨迹和目标尾数位数进行先验预测，无需低精度数据。
Result: 在bf16等效的GPT训练中，模型在中途精确预测步数内冻结；在8位浮点GPT-2中，权重在初始化时冻结，验证损失停滞；随机舍入可消除持续冻结。
Conclusion: 低精度训练的冻结现象是可预测的确定性过程，而非随机噪声，且条件可跨模型和数据集转移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: JEPA for AI-Native 6G: Predictive Representations and Open Challenges
papers.abstract_en: Sixth-generation (6G) networks are moving toward AI-native operation, where learning modules are embedded across the radio access network (RAN), edge, and core. This transition requires learning from limited labels, heterogeneous wireless and network data, partial observations, non-stationary propagation, and latency-constrained control loops. Joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) is a promising self-supervised paradigm for this setting because it predicts missing or future representations in latent space instead of reconstructing raw measurements or using contrastive negative samples. This article presents a wireless-oriented tutorial on JEPA for 6G intelligence. We define the JEPA training mechanism, describe how CSI, beam measurements, KPIs, topology graphs, and sensing observations can be tokenized and masked, and position the learned encoder as a predictive representation layer for RAN, O-RAN, edge, and core functions, with task-specific heads or controllers producing final decisions. Then we present an illustrative, beam-management case study suggesting that a wireless-aware target, specifically an auxiliary future beam-energy target during self-supervised pretraining, can improve label efficiency and robustness across shifted deployment conditions relative to a supervised source domain. Finally, we outline open challenges in multi-timescale prediction, action-conditioned modeling, distributed training, trustworthiness, efficient deployment, benchmarking, and standardization.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Tutorial and review on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) for AI-native 6G. Submitted to IEEE Communications Magazine
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇面向AI原生6G网络的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的教程与综述。文章定义了JEPA的训练机制，描述了如何将无线信道状态信息、波束测量、KPI、拓扑图和感知观测进行标记化与掩码处理，并将学习到的编码器作为预测表示层用于RAN、O-RAN、边缘和核心功能。通过一个波束管理案例研究表明，在自监督预训练中加入辅助的未来波束能量目标，可以提高标签效率和在部署条件变化下的鲁棒性。最后概述了多时间尺度预测、动作条件建模、分布式训练、可信性、高效部署、基准测试和标准化等开放挑战。
Motivation: 6G网络正走向AI原生操作，需要在有限标签、异构无线数据、部分观测、非平稳传播和延迟约束控制环下进行学习。现有的自监督方法（如重建或对比学习）可能不适用于无线环境，因此需要一种在潜在空间预测表示的新范式。
Method: 本文提供无线导向的JEPA教程，核心是定义JEPA训练机制：将无线数据（如CSI、波束测量、KPI）tokenize并mask，然后让编码器在潜在空间预测缺失或未来的表示，而不重构原始信号或使用负样本对比学习。通过一个波束管理案例研究，提出在自监督预训练中引入辅助的未来波束能量目标。
Result: 案例研究表明，所提出的无线感知目标（辅助未来波束能量目标）相比有监督源域，能提高标签效率和在不同部署条件下的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: JEPA是6G AI原生的有前途范式，但面临多时间尺度预测、动作条件建模、分布式训练、可信性、高效部署、基准测试和标准化等挑战，需要进一步研究。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Metadata-Free Meta-Reweighted Direct Preference Optimization under Noisy Preference Labels
papers.abstract_en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has become an important method for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences because it removes the need for explicit reward modeling and reinforcement learning optimization. However, its performance depends heavily on the quality of preference data, and noisy preference data in real-world settings can weaken alignment performance. To address this issue, we propose a bilevel optimization framework and prove, under certain assumptions, that this framework can recover the DPO optimum under clean data. We further derive a prior form for the learnable weighting function under asymmetric label-flipping noise. Considering that high-quality metadata may be difficult to obtain, we propose a task-agnostic meta-knowledge-driven method that enables meta-learning even when metadata is completely unavailable. To reduce the high cost of higher-order gradients in LLM meta-learning, we combine central-difference approximation with LoRA fine-tuning and develop a scalable training scheme. Experiments on TL;DR summarization and Anthropic HH single-turn dialogue show that the proposed method improves training performance over multiple DPO baselines under different noise rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)在噪声偏好数据下对齐性能下降的问题，提出基于双层优化的元重加权框架，理论上证明能在干净数据下恢复DPO最优解，并推导了非对称标签翻转噪声下的可学习权重先验形式。结合中心差分近似和LoRA微调实现可扩展训练。实验在TL;DR摘要和Anthropic HH对话任务上验证了改进效果。
Motivation: DPO依赖于高质量偏好数据，而实际中的噪声偏好数据会削弱对齐性能。
Method: 提出双层优化框架，理论证明能在干净数据下恢复DPO最优解；推导非对称标签翻转噪声下的可学习权重先验形式；使用任务无关的元知识驱动方法，在元数据完全不可用时实现元学习；结合中心差分近似和LoRA微调降低高阶梯度成本。
Result: 在TL;DR摘要和Anthropic HH单轮对话上，所提方法在多种噪声率下均优于多个DPO基线。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确强调局限性，但指出方法在噪声偏好数据下改善了DPO训练性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Large Multimodal Model-Based Environment-Aware Mobility Management
papers.abstract_en: Recently, large language models (LLMs) have been successfully adopted in various fields, including wireless communications, robotics, and autonomous vehicles, owing to their outstanding adaptability and reasoning abilities. Despite their huge potential, the application of LLMs for mobility management is relatively scarce since it requires not only analyzing wireless measurements but also predicting dynamic user trajectories and making real-time handover decisions across densely deployed small base stations (SBSs). In this paper, we propose an environment-aware mobility management scheme based on large multimodal models (LMMs), which extend capabilities of LLMs to process multimodal sensing data. By leveraging LMMs, the proposed scheme extracts contextual information on the surrounding environments from RGB-D images to capture user equipment (UE) mobility patterns and identify signal reflections and blockages caused by static reflectors and dynamic obstacles. Using the extracted environmental information, the proposed scheme learns the intrinsic mapping from UE and SBS positions to channel capacity, referred to as channel capacity map (CCM), from which future channel capacities along UE trajectories are predicted. Based on the predicted channel capacities, we determine proactive handover decisions maximizing the cumulative channel capacities. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme achieves substantial channel capacity improvements over conventional deep learning (DL)-based approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于大型多模态模型（LMM）的环境感知移动管理方案，利用RGB-D图像提取环境上下文信息（如用户设备移动模式、信号反射与遮挡），学习信道容量图（CCM）以预测未来信道容量，并据此做出主动切换决策。仿真结果表明，该方案在累积信道容量上显著优于传统深度学习方法。
Motivation: 现有大型语言模型（LLM）在无线通信等领域的应用广泛，但在移动管理方面应用较少，因为移动管理需要分析无线测量、预测动态用户轨迹并在密集部署的小基站间做出实时切换决策。
Method: 基于LMM从RGB-D图像中提取环境上下文信息，学习用户设备与基站位置到信道容量的映射（CCM），预测未来信道容量，并据此确定最大化累积信道容量的主动切换策略。
Result: 仿真结果显示，所提方案在累积信道容量上相比传统深度学习方法有显著提升。
Conclusion: LMM通过处理多模态传感数据，能够有效提取环境信息并改善移动管理中的信道容量性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agentic Context Learning with Self-Discovered Specification
papers.abstract_en: Context learning is an emerging inference-time task where LLMs must learn and apply novel, task-specific knowledge from intricate contexts absent from pre-training; even frontier models score under 24% task success. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive empirical study to understand why this setting remains difficult. A natural hypothesis is that failures stem from content access; yet across twelve retrieval, reflection, and verification baselines on CL-Bench, an extensive context learning benchmark, we find limited gains over direct full-context prompting. Further failure analysis reveals a key finding: unlike typical long-context tasks such as long document understanding, context learning requires not only recovering local content but also acquiring local specifications that are often unspecified in the query but distributed across the context: domain-specific formats, local rules, and completeness conditions. Across all 31,592 rubric items, we find that 55.4% clearly evaluate specification acquisition, while only 22.6% evaluate content acquisition. Moreover, despite 76.7% of specifications being unspecified in the user query, 95.5% are traceable to the context, indicating these are learnable obligations rather than hidden requirements. To validate this diagnosis, we design a deliberately simple intervention PSCI (private specification-contract induction) which extracts local specifications and enforces them through adversarial checking and repair; PSCI achieves state-of-the-art 28.14% with GPT-5.1 (+5.59 pp absolute and +24.8% relative) on CL-Bench, replicated on Qwen3.5-27B (+5.28 pp) and Gemini 3 Pro (+6.17 pp). Seventeen ablations further isolate the role of task-specific specifications. Overall, our results suggest context learning hinges on not only content acquisition but also specification acquisition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过实证研究发现，上下文学习（context learning）的难点主要在于获取任务特定的局部规范（local specifications），而非仅检索内容。在CL-Bench基准上，现有检索、反思和验证方法提升有限；进一步分析显示55.4%的评分项评估规范获取，76.7%的规范在用户查询中未明确给出但可从上下文中追溯。为此，作者提出简单的PSCI（私有规范-契约归纳）方法，通过提取局部规范并利用对抗性检查与修复进行强制执行，在GPT-5.1上达到28.14%的SOTA性能，并在Qwen3.5-27B和Gemini 3 Pro上得到验证。
Motivation: 现有LLM在上下文学习任务上表现不佳（如GPT-5.1任务成功率低于24%），而传统假设认为问题在于内容访问；但实验表明检索等方法改进有限，因此需深入探究失败原因。
Method: 通过对CL-Bench中所有31,592个评分项的系统分析，发现大多数任务涉及规范获取而非内容获取；据此设计PSCI方法，先提取上下文中的局部规范，再通过对抗性检查与修复强制执行这些规范。
Result: PSCI在CL-Bench上取得SOTA：GPT-5.1提升5.59个百分点（+24.8%相对提升），Qwen3.5-27B提升5.28个百分点，Gemini 3 Pro提升6.17个百分点；17项消融实验验证了任务特定规范的作用。
Conclusion: 上下文学习的瓶颈在于规范获取而非简单的内容检索；通过显式提取和强制执行局部规范可显著提升性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Comprehensive Survey and Systematic Real-World Evaluation of Embodied Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Navigation is a fundamental capability of autonomous systems, yet most existing approaches rely on highly structured models and strong prior assumptions, limiting their robustness in open and uncertain real-world environments. Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) offers a promising direction by enabling robots to integrate natural language understanding with visual perception in a data-driven manner. Although VLN has attracted increasing research attention, systematic methodological taxonomy and real-world validation remain limited. This survey presents a comprehensive review of VLN research. Specifically, state-of-the-art methods are organized along two orthogonal dimensions: action paradigms, including hierarchical and monolithic frameworks, and model paradigms, including discriminative and generative approaches. A critical analysis of their respective strengths and limitations is provided. Additionally, we conduct a systematic real-world evaluation of representative VLN system configurations on a physical robotic platform. Experiments across ten diverse real-world scenes show a substantial performance gap between simulation and real-world deployment under the tested configurations: a representative monolithic RGB-only method achieves 61% success in simulation but drops to 22% in real-world deployment, while a hierarchical framework achieves a higher real-world success rate of 51%, suggesting stronger robustness in our evaluation setting. Finally, we highlight key challenges in perception, decision-making, and control that must be addressed in future research.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted by IEEE TASE 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对具身视觉-语言导航（VLN）领域进行了全面综述，将现有方法按动作范式（分层 vs. 整体）和模型范式（判别 vs. 生成）两个维度分类，并分析了各自的优缺点。此外，论文在真实机器人平台上对不同VLN系统配置进行了系统性评估，在10个真实场景中发现仿真与真实部署之间存在显著性能差距：代表性的单模态RGB方法在仿真中成功率为61%，但在真实环境中降至22%，而分层框架在真实环境中达到51%的成功率，表现出更强的鲁棒性。最后，论文指出了感知、决策和控制方面的关键挑战。
Motivation: 现有VLN研究缺乏系统的方法论分类和真实世界验证，导致对方法在实际开放环境中的鲁棒性理解不足。
Method: 提出一个二维分类体系（动作范式和模型范式），对现有方法进行梳理；并在物理机器人平台上对不同VLN系统配置进行系统性的真实世界评估。
Result: 在10个真实场景中，代表性单模态RGB方法仿真成功率61%但真实部署仅22%，而分层框架真实成功率51%，表明分层框架更鲁棒。
Conclusion: VLN研究存在显著的仿真-真实差距，未来需解决感知、决策和控制中的挑战以提升真实部署性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gauge dependence and structured-output corruption in sign-branched repetition penalties: measurements across models, inference stacks, and alternative repetition controls
papers.abstract_en: The multiplicative repetition penalty shipped across the LLM inference ecosystem (HuggingFace, vLLM, llama.cpp, and a dozen further engines) branches on the sign of each raw logit (divide positives by theta, multiply negatives). But the softmax is unchanged by adding a constant to every logit, so a model's logit zero-point is arbitrary, and the sign-branch reads that arbitrary point. The sign-branch is itself the accepted fix for an earlier bug, so the accepted fix branches on a quantity the training objective leaves unconstrained. Two measurable consequences follow. (1) The penalty is not well-defined: re-centring a model's logits by a constant is a provable no-op at theta=1, yet at a routine theta=1.3 it changes 58-96% of greedy tokens, where subtractive and normalized penalties change none; real checkpoints sit at widely different zero-points, so a fixed repetition_penalty is a different operation on every model. (2) It corrupts structured output: on 200 real-world JSON schemas, theta=1.3 drops the rate of valid, schema-conformant output from 97% to 23%. In our measurements, applying the penalty to normalized log-probabilities instead of raw logits removes both effects. HuggingFace already ships that operator (LogitNormalization); today it is off by default and applied after the penalty. This note gives the mechanism, the measurements (five models up to 7B, base and RLHF, on WikiText-103 prefixes; two code models on HumanEval and JSONSchemaBench; both effects replicated inside vLLM and llama.cpp through their own samplers on the same inputs), and the normalized variant.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了LLM推理生态系统中广泛使用的乘法重复惩罚（repetition penalty）的计量依赖问题。惩罚根据原始logit的符号进行分支，但由于软最大（softmax）对logit加常数不变，该分支读取了任意零点，导致惩罚定义不明确，并在常用的theta=1.3参数下改变58-96%的贪婪token，同时严重损坏结构化输出（JSON schema有效输出从97%降至23%）。作者提出将惩罚应用于归一化的log概率而非原始logit，可消除上述问题。
Motivation: 现有的乘法重复惩罚在符号分支上依赖于模型logit的任意零点，导致同一超参数在不同模型上产生不一致效果，并损坏结构化输出。该问题在主流推理栈（HuggingFace、vLLM、llama.cpp等）中普遍存在，需要澄清机制并提出修复方案。
Method: 通过理论分析指出符号分支的零点依赖性，提出将重复惩罚应用于归一化的log概率（即使用LogitNormalization）而非原始logit。在多个模型（最高7B，包括基座和RLHF版本）及推理栈上进行实验测量，验证了问题的普遍性和修复的有效性。
Result: 在theta=1.3时，重新居中logits导致58-96%的贪婪token改变；在200个真实JSON schema上，惩罚将有效输出率从97%降至23%。而使用归一化log概率的惩罚则完全避免了这两个问题。
Conclusion: 乘法重复惩罚的符号分支存在根本性缺陷，推荐默认启用LogitNormalization并将其应用于惩罚之前，以消除零点依赖和结构化输出损坏。HuggingFace已具备该操作，但当前默认关闭且应用顺序错误。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reverse Engineering Compliance: A Dual-Graph Verification Framework for Auditing Legacy IT Security Concepts
papers.abstract_en: The NIS-2 Directive increases the need for continuous, auditable compliance evidence and motivates a shift from document-based compliance toward machine-readable compliance artifacts. The Open Security Controls Assessment Language (OSCAL) is a standard for this purpose, which the German Federal Office for Information Security (BSI) is adapting with Grundschutz++. However, companies are still managing extensive legacy IT security concepts (IT-SCs), and migrating them without verification could transfer outdated assets into the new format. While existing research primarily addresses the generation of new concepts, there is a lack of a verification framework that extracts legacy IT-SCs into an auditable intermediate representation, deterministically compares the extracted graph with an independently constructed reference state, and exports schema-valid OSCAL artifacts. This paper introduces the Automated Security Concept Structure Extraction and Reverse Topology-checking (ASSERT) Framework, which addresses this gap by using ontology-based extraction of legacy documents into formal document graphs, a five-class graph difference against a verified reference graph, and the export into schema-valid OSCAL outputs for system description and assessment evidence. Using the BSI's RecPlast dataset, we compare a local open-weight model and a commercial model across three configurations with different levels of reference-ontology exposure. The evaluation shows that ASSERT makes document-infrastructure inconsistencies measurable, but reveals a trade-off between discovering undocumented entities and enforcing a schema.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Computer, Information and Telecommunication Systems (IEEE CITS), Piraeus-Athens, Greece, July 22-24, 2026. 8 pages, 1 figure
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ASSERT框架，用于从遗留IT安全概念文档中提取结构化信息，并通过双图校验确保合规性。该框架利用本体抽取生成文档图，与参考图进行五类差异比较，并导出符合OSCAL标准的工件。在BSI的RecPlast数据集上评估显示，ASSERT能够量化文档与基础设施的不一致性，但存在发现未记录实体与强制执行模式之间的权衡。
Motivation: NIS-2指令要求持续的、可审计的合规证据，但企业仍在使用大量遗留IT安全概念文档。现有研究主要关注新概念的生成，缺乏能够提取遗留文档、进行确定性比较并导出标准化合规工件的验证框架。
Method: 提出ASSERT框架，包含三个步骤：基于本体的遗留文档结构提取（构建形式化文档图）、与独立构建的参考图进行五类图差异比较（包括节点/边匹配、添加、删除、修改）、以及导出符合OSCAL模式的系统描述和评估证据。
Result: 在BSI的RecPlast数据集上，比较了本地开源模型与商业模型在三种配置下的表现。结果显示ASSERT能够量化文档与基础设施的不一致性，但存在发现未记录实体与强制执行模式之间的权衡。
Conclusion: ASSERT框架为遗留IT安全概念文档向机器可读合规工件的迁移提供了可验证的途径，但需要平衡完整性与规范性。

papers.title: Semantic Drift and the Stability of Operator Control in Reasoning-Class Decision Support Systems
papers.abstract_en: The article investigates the fundamental problem of ensuring the stability of operator control and preserving goal-targeting in hybrid human-machine decision support systems (DSS) of a new generation. Based on a two-month continuous longitudinal experiment on the joint design of a monograph-format textual array, the latent phenomenon of semantic context drift in large language models of deep logical reasoning (Reasoning LLMs) is verified and described. A mathematical model of interaction in the human-machine interface is proposed, and an original metric is introduced - the operator control stability coefficient, which takes into account the non-linear contextual pressure of hidden reasoning chains. Within the paradigm of the cognitome theory, a critical point of control functions inversion is captured. Engineering recommendations are formulated for implementing dynamic relational arbitration loops based on a modified hierarchical similarity model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过两月纵向实验研究大型语言模型在深度逻辑推理中的语义上下文漂移现象，提出操作员控制稳定性系数，并在认知组学范式下发现控制函数反转的临界点。
Motivation: 确保新一代混合人机决策支持系统中操作员控制的稳定性和目标保持，应对深层推理链带来的上下文非线性压力。
Method: 通过连续两月纵向实验验证语义上下文漂移，提出人机交互数学模型和操作员控制稳定性系数，基于修正层次相似性模型设计动态关系仲裁回路。
Result: 验证并描述了推理型LLM中语义上下文漂移的潜在现象，捕捉到控制函数反转的临界点。
Conclusion: 本文给出了工程建议，但研究限于文本阵列联合设计场景，且主要关注概念验证。

papers.title: PHITSBench: an execution-scored benchmark for AI-assisted PHITS radiation-transport input generation using natural language
papers.abstract_en: We introduce PHITSBench, an execution-scored benchmark for the Monte Carlo Particle and Heavy Ion Transport code System (PHITS). PHITSBench comprises 282 transport-scorable tasks spanning three common workflow categories: parameter editing (Edit), syntax repair (Repair ), and complete simulation generation from natural-language descriptions (Reproduce). Each task is evaluated using a Composite Metric Score that combines execution success with agreement between generated and reference transport observables. Using PHITSBench, we evaluate five GPT-5.4-based configurations ranging from zero-shot prompting to knowledge-augmented and agentic workflows. Without domain-specific knowledge, the model performs well on editing and repair tasks (95% and 70% success, respectively) but fails to generate correct simulations from scratch (0% success on the Reproduce track). A structured, machine-readable PHITS knowledge catalog, supplied alongside the user manual, raises single-shot Reproduce-task success to 57%. Agentic execution provides a further improvement to 66-73%, but at increased computational cost. Failure analysis shows that the remaining errors are dominated by incorrect selection and configuration of physical observables rather than syntax generation. These results suggest that future progress in AI-assisted radiation-transport modeling will depend as much on machine-readable knowledge bases, curated domain-training datasets, and execution-grounded evaluation environments as on advances in foundation models themselves.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍PHITSBench，一个基于执行分数的基准，用于评估AI辅助PHITS辐射传输输入生成。包含282个任务，覆盖参数编辑、语法修复和从自然语言生成完整模拟三类。评估多种GPT-5.4配置，结果显示无领域知识时编辑和修复成功率高，但零样本生成成功率为0%；加入结构化知识库后生成任务成功率提升至57%，代理执行进一步升至66-73%，但计算成本增加。错误主要由物理可观测量的选择配置导致。
Motivation: 现有AI辅助科学模拟缺乏执行驱动的基准，难以评估模型在实际科学工作流中的可用性。
Method: 构建PHITSBench，包含282个可执行评分任务，分为编辑、修复和重现三类；采用复合度量评分，结合执行成功率和生成结果与参考观测的一致性。
Result: 无领域知识时，编辑任务成功率95%，修复任务70%，生成任务0%；加入结构化PHITS知识目录后单次生成成功率达57%；代理执行提升至66-73%，但成本增加。
Conclusion: 未来AI辅助辐射传输建模的进展不仅依赖基础模型，同样需要机器可读知识库、领域训练数据和执行驱动评估环境。

papers.title: MVMGNN;Multi-View Masked Graph Neural Network for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis using Structural MRI
papers.abstract_en: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a common neurodegenerative disorder, and early diagnosis is of great significance for delaying disease progression and enabling timely intervention. Mild cognitive impairment (MCI), which represents an intermediate clinical stage between cognitively normal aging and AD. Structural magnetic resonance imaging (sMRI) provides detailed characterization of anatomical structures and plays an important role in AD-related brain analysis. However, existing sMRI-based brain network methods typically rely on a single graph construction strategy, limiting their ability to jointly capture spatial relationships and morphological similarities between brain regions. To address these issues, this paper proposes an sMRI-based multi-view masked graph neural network model (MVMGNN) for AD diagnosis. A joint node-edge masking mechanism is proposed to simultaneously select radiomics feature dimensions and structural connections, reducing redundancy during graph learning. Furthermore, a patient-level cross-view gated fusion mechanism is proposed to integrate multi-view representations. Experimental results on the ADNI dataset demonstrate that MVMGNN outperforms several competing approaches in AD classification. Interpretability analysis further demonstrates that MVMGNN is able to identify key brain regions associated with AD, providing useful insights into discriminative patterns in sMRI-based brain networks.Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/chenzhao2023/MVMGNN_AD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于结构磁共振成像（sMRI）的多视图掩码图神经网络（MVMGNN），用于阿尔茨海默病（AD）诊断。该方法通过联合节点-边掩码机制同时选择影像组学特征维度和结构连接，减少图学习中的冗余；并通过跨视图门控融合机制整合多视图表示。在ADNI数据集上的实验表明，MVMGNN在AD分类任务上优于多种对比方法，且可解释性分析能识别与AD相关的关键脑区。
Motivation: 现有基于sMRI的脑网络方法通常依赖单一图构建策略，难以同时捕捉脑区之间的空间关系和形态相似性，限制了诊断性能。
Method: 提出MVMGNN模型，包含联合节点-边掩码机制（同时选择影像组学特征维度和结构连接）和跨视图门控融合机制（整合多视图表示），并在图神经网络中应用掩码自监督学习。
Result: 在ADNI数据集上，MVMGNN在AD分类任务中优于多种竞争方法，并通过可解释性分析识别出与AD相关的关键脑区。
Conclusion: MVMGNN通过多视图掩码机制有效利用了sMRI中的多模态信息，为AD诊断提供了有前景的方法，且代码已开源。

papers.title: Adversarially Guided Diffusion for LiDAR Range Image Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: LiDAR semantic segmentation is a key perception task in autonomous driving, where false predictions can affect downstream planning and safety-critical decision-making. Although adversarial attacks, and specifically adversarial examples, have been widely studied for image classification and 3D point cloud segmentation, unrestricted adversarial examples remain largely unexplored in the space of 2D range images, which are projections of 3D point clouds. The proposed method is, to the best of our knowledge, the first diffusion-based unrestricted adversarial attack against 2D range-image segmentation, using adversarial guidance from a segmentation loss. By applying guidance directly during sampling, the method produces unrestricted adversarial examples that remain close to the learned LiDAR data manifold while inducing structured segmentation errors. Experiments on the SemanticKITTI dataset using RangeNet++ and CENet segmentation networks demonstrate that the attack provides adjustable degradation across guidance strengths and transfers across segmentation architectures. Compared with norm-bounded FGSM and SegPGD baselines, the proposed attack offers a distinct effectiveness-realism trade-off, achieving controllable white-box and transfer degradation while maintaining competitive distributional and visual realism.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 1st Workshop on Secure and Trustworthy AI (STAI 2026), co-located with the European Conference on Machine Learning and Principles and Practice of Knowledge Discovery in Databases (ECML PKDD 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个基于扩散模型的无约束对抗攻击方法，针对LiDAR距离图像的语义分割任务。通过从分割损失中获取对抗引导，在采样过程中直接施加引导，生成位于LiDAR数据流形附近且能引发结构化分割错误的对抗样本。在SemanticKITTI数据集上使用RangeNet++和CENet网络进行实验，表明该方法可调节攻击强度，并在不同分割架构间迁移。与FGSM和SegPGD基线相比，该方法在有效性和真实性之间提供了可调节的权衡。
Motivation: LiDAR语义分割在自动驾驶中至关重要，但现有对抗攻击研究多集中于图像分类和3D点云分割，针对2D距离图像的无约束对抗样本研究不足。
Method: 提出扩散模型驱动的对抗攻击，利用分割损失作为引导，在采样过程中直接施加对抗引导，生成位于LiDAR数据流形附近的对抗样本。
Result: 在SemanticKITTI数据集上，该方法对RangeNet++和CENet网络实现可调节的攻击效果，并展现出跨架构迁移性；与FGSM和SegPGD相比，在有效性和真实性间提供了可调节的权衡。
Conclusion: 该扩散引导方法为LiDAR距离图像提供了首个无约束对抗攻击，可调节攻击强度并保持数据分布真实性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Length Penalties Make Chain-of-Thought Less Monitorable
papers.abstract_en: Length-penalized reinforcement learning can shorten chain-of-thought reasoning while hiding an influence that drives the model's answer. In our experiments, training with length penalties does not stop misleading hints from steering models, even though the models' chains of thought mention the hint much less often. A token-accuracy evaluation would count these runs as successful because they use fewer reasoning tokens with little accuracy loss; it would miss whether the remaining trace still shows what drove the answer. We train Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-14B variants with different target chain lengths, then evaluate them with biasing-hint interventions on held-out MMLU-Pro-R and four transfer benchmarks. Compression sharply cuts reasoning tokens, preserves most multiple-choice accuracy, and leaves hint influence near baseline. At the strongest target, lower-bound faithfulness falls to 63.1% of baseline for Qwen3-14B and 69.4% for Qwen3-4B; the raw rate at which a monitor catches hint use falls from 69% to 49% and from 60% to 48%. To separate length from content, we randomly delete sentences from uncompressed baseline chains until the remaining text matches the compressed length. Even after this length matching, compressed chains disclose the hint 7-35 percentage points less often than baseline chains that we shorten at random, for both Qwen3 sizes and all five evaluation distributions. Compression therefore does more than shorten reasoning, preferentially removing the cues a monitor needs to see what influenced the answer. Together, these results reveal a compression-monitorability frontier in which cheaper reasoning can preserve answers while making the influences behind them harder to detect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长度惩罚的强化学习对链式思维推理可监控性的影响。实验表明，长度惩罚虽能缩短推理步骤并保持准确率，但会隐藏驱动答案的误导性提示，使监控者更难检测到提示的使用。压缩不仅缩短推理，还优先移除监控所需的线索，揭示了压缩与可监控性之间的权衡。
Motivation: 现有链式思维推理中，长度惩罚可能提高效率但牺牲可解释性，而token准确率评估忽略了监控线索的丢失，需要系统研究压缩对可监控性的影响。
Method: 训练Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-14B变体，使用不同目标链长度，并在MMLU-Pro-R和四个迁移基准上通过偏置提示干预评估。通过随机删除句子匹配长度进行对比实验。
Result: 压缩大幅减少推理token，保持多数多项选择准确率，提示影响接近基线。最低忠实度降至基线63.1%（14B）和69.4%（4B）；监控捕捉率从69%降至49%（14B）和60%至48%（4B）。压缩链披露提示的频率比随机缩短基线低7-35个百分点。
Conclusion: 长度惩罚导致压缩-可监控性前沿：更便宜的推理可保留答案但使影响更难检测，监控者难辨驱动因素。

papers.title: Lifelong Representations: A Survey on Continual Self-Supervised Learning for Vision Models
papers.abstract_en: Traditionally, continual learning has assumed access to labeled data, yet many real-world applications -- such as lifelong robotics -- require models to adapt continuously from unlabeled streams. This has led to the development of continual self-supervised learning (CSSL), a rapidly growing area that lacks a dedicated, systematic review. In this work, we present a comprehensive survey of CSSL for vision, with connections to emerging vision-language settings. First, we analyze existing evaluation protocols and highlight inconsistencies that hinder fair comparison. We then examine why self-supervised objectives exhibit improved robustness to catastrophic forgetting, relating this to task-agnostic representations and smoother loss landscapes. Next, we organize existing methods into a unified taxonomy based on their forgetting-mitigation strategies, including distillation, replay, regularization, architectural approaches, model merging, and objective-level adaptation. Finally, we identify open challenges such as scalability and the need for fast adaptability. We argue that advancing CSSL requires moving beyond small-scale benchmarks towards continual pre-training paradigms for large-scale systems.
papers.comment: This work has been accepted for publication in IEEE EAIS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对视觉模型中持续自监督学习（CSSL）的全面综述，涵盖评估协议、遗忘机制分析、方法分类（蒸馏、回放、正则化、架构、模型合并、目标自适应）以及开放挑战。文章强调需要从基于任务的标注数据转向无标签流的持续学习，并讨论了与视觉-语言场景的连接。
Motivation: 传统持续学习假设有标签数据，但现实应用（如机器人）需要从无标签流中持续适应。CSSL领域快速发展但缺乏系统性综述，阻碍了公平比较和进步。
Method: 通过文献分析，总结现有CSSL评估协议的不一致性，解释自监督目标对灾难性遗忘的鲁棒性（任务无关表示、更平滑损失景观），并提出基于遗忘缓解策略的统一分类法。
Result: 识别出CSSL方法的主要类别（蒸馏、回放、正则化、架构、模型合并、目标自适应），并指出当前基准规模小、缺乏快速适应性等挑战。
Conclusion: 推动CSSL需要超越小规模基准，迈向大规模系统的持续预训练范式。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Compression Asymmetry and Trajectory Binding in Noise-Anchored Diffusion Inversion
papers.abstract_en: Real-image diffusion inversion is governed by a tight quality-cost trade-off, with costs incurred in computation, storage, or per-image optimization. We study this trade-off through the forward Gaussian noise anchor that defines a diffusion trajectory and isolate two mechanisms behind effective stored-noise inversion. First, diffusion noise exhibits an element-wise compression asymmetry: int8 full-dimensional anchors preserve reconstruction, whereas low-dimensional subspace summaries are much less reliable, often collapsing even at comparable or smaller payloads; the element-wise over subspace ordering persists across five stored-noise inversion methods. Second, inversion is trajectory-bound and score-prior coupled: the matched forward anchor and a trained score network are both necessary, arguing against a purely algebraic-identity explanation. Together, these findings specify what to store and how to use it. They lead to Noise-Anchored Reverse Correction (NARC), a training-free inversion primitive that stores a single int8 latent anchor and reuses it with a fixed, noise-level-dependent anchor-weight schedule: strong anchoring when the reverse trajectory is noise-dominated, then relaxed anchoring as image detail emerges. On PIE-Bench++ with Stable Diffusion 1.5, NARC outperforms five modern non-exact baselines and improves PSNR by +3.24 dB over PnP DirectInv while using about 400x less inversion storage than PnP DirectInv. The compression asymmetry, anchor specificity, and editing plug-in also transfer to SDXL 1024^2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究真实图像扩散反演中的质量-成本权衡，通过前向高斯噪声锚点（noise anchor）分析存储噪声反演的两个机制：压缩不对称性和轨迹绑定。发现元素级int8全维锚点优于低维子空间摘要，且反演需要匹配的前向锚点和训练好的分数网络。提出无训练的反演原语NARC（噪声锚点反向校正），在PIE-Bench++上以Stable Diffusion 1.5为骨干，PSNR比PnP DirectInv高3.24 dB，存储量减少约400倍。该方法也适用于SDXL 1024×1024。
Motivation: 真实图像扩散反演存在严格的质量-成本权衡，现有方法在计算、存储或逐图像优化上成本高昂。需要理解有效的存储噪声反演机制，以降低存储开销同时保持重建质量。
Method: 通过前向高斯噪声锚点定义扩散轨迹，分析压缩不对称性和轨迹绑定两个机制。提出NARC，一种无训练的反演原语，存储单个int8潜在锚点，并采用依赖噪声水平的固定锚点权重调度：反向轨迹噪声主导时强锚定，图像细节出现时放松锚定。
Result: 在PIE-Bench++上，NARC在Stable Diffusion 1.5上比五种现代非精确基线更优，PSNR比PnP DirectInv高3.24 dB，且反演存储减少约400倍。压缩不对称性、锚点特异性和编辑插件也迁移到SDXL 1024×1024。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了扩散反演中存储噪声的关键机制，并提出了高效的NARC方法，实现了低存储开销下的高质量反演。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Patterns to Maze Structures: SMT-Based Path Synthesis and 2D/3D Construction
papers.abstract_en: We present a pipeline for constructing maze structures from input patterns such as text or shapes. The central path-synthesis problem is encoded in Satisfiability Modulo Theories as global constraints on adjacency, continuity, and pattern-constrained coverage, allowing each fixed-bound instance to be solved in one call. The resulting path is either a planar, self-avoiding route or a layered traversal with prescribed over--under crossings, and it serves as a scaffold for constructing planar mazes and three-dimensional realizations of woven mazes. This report extends the published Bridges 2026 conference paper with more representative SMT-LIB examples and a fuller account of how synthesized paths become concrete maze constructions in planar and three-dimensional form.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个从输入模式（如文本或形状）自动构建迷宫结构的管道。核心路径合成问题被编码为SMT（Satisfiability Modulo Theories）的全局约束，包括邻接、连续性和模式约束覆盖，每个固定边界实例通过一次SMT调用求解。得到的路径是平面自回避路线或带有规定上下交叉的分层遍历，作为构建平面迷宫和三维编织迷宫实现的骨架。
Motivation: 从输入模式自动生成迷宫结构缺乏系统化的路径合成方法，现有方法难以同时满足邻接、连续性和模式约束。
Method: 采用SMT编码全局约束（邻接、连续性、模式约束覆盖），每个固定边界实例一次调用求解，得到路径作为迷宫构建的骨架。
Result: 该方法能生成平面自回避路线或带有规定上下交叉的分层遍历路径，并成功用于构建平面迷宫和三维编织迷宫。
Conclusion: 论文扩展了Bridges 2026会议论文，提供了更多SMT-LIB示例和更全面的管道描述，展示了从模式到迷宫的自动化合成能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Real-World Wearable Motion Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: The modern-day surge in popularity of wearable devices poses a fundamentally unique motion capture problem: reconstructing full-body movement from any set of sensing hardware worn at a given moment. Yet, most research efforts assume fixed sensor configurations (e.g. IMU suits or HMD-centric rigs) and cannot generalize across them. In contrast, we argue that motion capture should prioritize unobtrusive and lightweight devices such as smartphones, smartwatches, smart glasses, and smart insoles, and study the interplay between them. To this end, we make three contributions. First, we present a large-scale multi-modal dataset synchronizing these consumer-grade sensors with ground-truth 3D motion, spanning 50 diverse activities including everyday tasks, sports, and social interactions. Second, we propose WHIP, a baseline generative model that reconstructs motion from arbitrary subsets of available sensors, robustly handling missing modalities and producing physically plausible motions. Third, we conduct a systematic study of sensor complementarity, quantifying how different modalities complement one another. Code and dataset are available at https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/WHIP/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对从任意可穿戴传感器子集重建全身运动的问题，提出了WHIP生成模型，并构建了包含智能手机、智能手表等消费级传感器与真实3D运动同步的大规模多模态数据集。摘要指出该方法能够鲁棒处理缺失模态，生成物理合理的运动，并系统研究了不同传感器之间的互补性。
Motivation: 现有运动捕捉方法大多假设固定传感器配置（如IMU套件或头显），无法泛化到日常轻量设备（如手机、手表）的任意组合，限制了实际应用。
Method: 提出了WHIP基线生成模型，能够从任意可用的传感器子集中重建运动，通过处理缺失模态和施加物理约束生成合理运动；同时构建了覆盖50种活动的多模态数据集。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值，但指出模型能处理任意传感器子集并产生物理合理运动，且通过系统实验量化了不同传感器模态的互补性。
Conclusion: 论文主张可穿戴运动捕捉应优先采用非侵入性轻量设备，并通过开源数据集和基线WHIP模型为未来研究提供基准。

papers.title: A Generalized Deep Non-negative Matrix Factorization Approach for SAR Automatic Target Recognition
papers.abstract_en: The deep nonnegative matrix factorization (DNMF) technique is proposed to address the low interpretability of deep learning-based methods in extracting multilayer features from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) target samples. However, existing DNMF methods employ a layer-by-layer decomposition strategy, which is prone to causing error accumulation and local optimum, thereby hindering a consistent improvement in recognition accuracy as the number of layer increases. In this paper, a robust multilayer feature extraction method, termed generalized deep non-negative matrix factorization (G-DNMF), is proposed to address the above challenges in SAR automatic target recognition (ATR). The G-DNMF aims global optimality and derives the update rules for each parameter using lagrangian multiplier method. The new update formula indicates that both the DNMF method based on the encoding matrix and the mixing matrix are special cases of the proposed method, theoretically demonstrating the universality of proposed method. In general, the proposed method discards the layer-by-layer decomposition strategy, thereby effectively mitigating the risk of local optima and eliminating error accumulation, leading to a significant improvement in DNMF's multi-layer feature extraction capability. The experimental results, by presenting the feature images extracted from each layer by G-DNMF and the reconstructed original images, verified the proposed method's pure additive understanding of multi-layer features and demonstrated its interpretability. The experimental results based on MSTAR and OpenSARship datasets show that G-DNMF outperforms existing DNMF algorithms and their derivatives in terms of stability and recognition performance.

TL;DR: 本文针对SAR目标识别中深度非负矩阵分解（DNMF）方法因逐层分解导致的误差累积和局部最优问题，提出一种广义深度非负矩阵分解（G-DNMF）方法。该方法通过拉格朗日乘子法推导全局最优更新规则，理论上证明编码矩阵和混合矩阵的DNMF都是其特例，从而避免逐层分解，提升多层特征提取能力。在MSTAR和OpenSARship数据集上，G-DNMF在稳定性和识别性能上优于现有DNMF算法。
Motivation: 现有基于深度学习的SAR目标识别方法可解释性低，而DNMF方法虽可提取多层特征，但逐层分解策略易导致误差累积和局部最优，阻碍识别精度随层数增加而持续提升。
Method: 提出广义深度非负矩阵分解（G-DNMF），抛弃逐层分解策略，利用拉格朗日乘子法推导全局最优的更新规则，从理论上统一了基于编码矩阵和混合矩阵的DNMF变体，旨在实现全局最优解。
Result: 在MSTAR和OpenSARship数据集上的实验表明，G-DNMF在稳定性和识别性能上优于现有DNMF算法及其衍生方法，并通过各层特征图像和重构原始图像验证了其多层特征的纯加性理解及可解释性。
Conclusion: 作者强调G-DNMF通过全局优化有效缓解局部最优和误差累积，显著提升DNMF的多层特征提取能力，但未讨论在更复杂场景或更大规模数据上的泛化性能。
