papers.title: Time Imprint: Learning Time-Aware Representations in Multi-Modal Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Multi-Modal Knowledge Graphs (MMKGs) enrich entities with multiple modalities such as text and images, yet entities with highly similar multi-modal features remain difficult to distinguish. Temporal information of an entity can serve as an additional modality to disambiguate such entities, but existing approaches rarely treat time as a separate modality alongside text and images due to two major challenges: (1) sparse temporal semantics, which hinder alignment with richer modalities, and (2) multiple timestamps, which introduce noise or reduce robustness in representation learning. To address these challenges, we propose Time Imprint, a framework that treats time as an entity-level modality and jointly aligns temporal, textual, and visual representations via a three-view contrastive objective. Additionally, to mitigate multi-timestamp ambiguity, Time Imprint studies a compact timestamp subset selection design space and aggregates the selected timestamps into a discriminative temporal embedding with attention pooling, balancing temporal specificity and robustness. Experiments on three MMKG benchmarks demonstrate that Time Imprint achieves state-of-the-art link prediction performance, improving Hits@1 by up to 6.07\% overall and yielding up to 58\% gains on the subset of the top-1\% ambiguity samples. We further examine different fusion strategies and the sensitivity to timestamp availability and quality, clarifying when and why time-as-modality is most beneficial, while adding only modest training overhead. We release our code at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Time-Imprint.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Time Imprint框架，将时间作为多模态知识图谱(MMKG)中实体的一种独立模态，通过三视图对比学习对齐时间、文本和视觉表示，并设计紧凑时间戳子集选择和注意力池化来缓解多时间戳噪声。在三个MMKG基准上，链接预测的Hits@1提升最高6.07%，且在top-1%歧义样本上提升达58%。
Motivation: 现有MMKG方法难以区分多模态特征高度相似的实体，而时间信息可作为辅助模态，但面临时间语义稀疏和多时间戳带来的噪声与鲁棒性问题。
Method: Time Imprint框架将时间视为实体级模态，通过三视图对比损失联合对齐时间、文本和视觉嵌入；并设计紧凑时间戳子集选择空间和注意力池化聚合选定时间戳，平衡时间特异性与鲁棒性。
Result: 在三个MMKG基准上，链接预测Hits@1整体提升最多6.07%，top-1%歧义样本子集上提升58%。实验还分析了不同融合策略及对时间戳可用性和质量的敏感性。
Conclusion: 将时间作为独立模态能有效提升MMKG实体区分能力，尤其在高度歧义样本上收益显著，且训练开销适度。

papers.title: Maximizing Human Efficiency in Large-Scale Robot Post-Training via VLAC-Cut Guided Pipeline
papers.abstract_en: When adapting Vision Language Action (VLA) models to downstream tasks, multiple rounds of post training are required because a single round of data cannot resolve all issues, making continuous iterations necessary to progressively address the weaknesses exposed in previous rounds. In this report, we aim to maximize human efficiency during post-training, defined as the policy improvement and task throughput achieved per unit of human labor and time. We propose a human-efficient post-training pipeline that enables a small number of human operators to supervise multiple robots. The pipeline is built around a specialized division of labor: a trained Teleoperator focuses on high-value remote interventions and recovery demonstrations, while a Floor Operator monitors multiple robots, triggers takeovers, and performs physical resets. This role specialization reduces task switching, lowers operator training costs, and allows limited human labor to supervise more robot interaction across a larger fleet. To improve data utilization efficiency, we introduce VLAC-CUT as an automatic rollout curation tool. It segments autonomous robot trajectories into progress-making, idle, failure-inducing, and recovery portions, preserving useful segments while filtering harmful or uninformative ones. The curated rollout data are combined with Human-in-the-Loop data for the next post-training round. We validate the proposed pipeline on four real-world manipulation tasks. Across iterative post-training rounds, the final policies achieve 80\%--95\% success rates and improve task throughput by 1.7$\times$--4.2$\times$ over the base model. Under the same human-intervention budget, VLAC-CUT guided rollout reuse outperforms HITL-only training in both success rate and throughput.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种最大化人类效率的后训练pipeline，用于将视觉语言动作模型适配到机器人下游任务。该pipeline通过专门分工（远程操作员负责高价值干预，地面操作员监控多台机器人）和自动回滚筛选工具VLAC-CUT，提升数据利用效率和任务吞吐量。在四个真实操作任务上，多轮后训练后策略成功率达到80%-95%，吞吐量提升1.7-4.2倍。
Motivation: 单轮数据无法解决所有问题，多轮后训练需要大量人工干预，现有方法在人类效率（单位人力时间内的策略改进和任务完成量）上存在瓶颈。
Method: 提出分工式pipeline：训练有素的远程操作员进行高价值干预和恢复演示，地面操作员监控多台机器人并触发接管和物理重置。同时引入VLAC-CUT自动将机器人轨迹分割为进展、空闲、失败和恢复段，筛选有用数据与人工干预数据结合用于下一轮后训练。
Result: 在四个真实操作任务上，最终策略实现80%-95%的成功率；任务吞吐量相比基础模型提升1.7-4.2倍；在相同人工干预预算下，VLAC-CUT引导的回滚重用优于纯人机交互训练。
Conclusion: 作者强调自动化回滚筛选（VLAC-CUT）与角色分工的结合能显著提升机器人后训练中的人类效率。

papers.title: EvoCUA-1.5: Online Reinforcement Learning for Multi-turn Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents must solve long-horizon tasks through repeated interaction with partially observable, multimodal desktop environments. Although imitation learning and offline trajectory refinement provide strong priors, static traces cannot cover the causal feedback loop of real computer use: each action changes the screen state, future action space, and recovery options. EvoCUA-1.5 extends self-evolving computer-use agents from offline experience learning to online reinforcement learning, where policies interact with executable sandbox environments and improve from verifiable task outcomes. Online RL in this setting requires more than directly reusing single-turn language-RL recipes. Multi-turn interaction introduces context-managed observations, sparse terminal rewards, variable-length trajectories, and slow environment feedback. EvoCUA-1.5 addresses these challenges with Step-Level Policy Optimization (STEPO), which preserves trajectory-level advantage balance after decomposition into step-level samples; policy-aware filtering and pass-rate calibration over verifiable synthesized tasks; Dynamic Tri-Adaptive Curriculum (DTAC), which combines learnable tasks, difficult positive replay, and controlled infeasible-task exposure; and a fully asynchronous RL infrastructure with staleness control and mini-group batching. Experiments show that these components improve training stability and downstream performance. EvoCUA-1.5 achieves 63.2\% success on OSWorld-Verified, outperforming comparable 32B/35B-scale open-weight baselines and even approaching models with significantly larger parameter counts. Overall, EvoCUA-1.5 provides a practical framework for scaling online RL in multi-turn computer-use agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoCUA-1.5 将自进化计算机使用智能体从离线经验学习扩展到在线强化学习，提出 Step-Level Policy Optimization (STEPO)、Dynamic Tri-Adaptive Curriculum (DTAC) 以及异步 RL 基础设施，解决多轮交互中的稀疏奖励等挑战，在 OSWorld-Verified 上达到 63.2% 的成功率，优于同规模基线。
Motivation: 现有计算机使用智能体依赖离线轨迹，无法覆盖真实交互中的因果反馈循环（每个动作改变屏幕状态与后续动作空间）。
Method: 提出 STEPO（将轨迹级优势平衡分解为步级样本）、策略感知过滤与通过率校准、DTAC（可学习任务、困难正反馈与不可行任务暴露的联合课程），以及带过时控制和小组批处理的异步 RL 框架。
Result: 在 OSWorld-Verified 上达到 63.2% 成功率，优于 32B/35B 规模开源基线，甚至接近更大参数量的模型。
Conclusion: EvoCUA-1.5 为多轮计算机使用智能体的在线 RL 提供了实用框架，证明了组件组合对训练稳定性和下游性能的提升。

papers.title: A Risk-Field Enhanced Closed-Loop Digital Twin Framework for Autonomous Driving Safety Validation
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving systems require reliable safety validation before real-world deployment. However, large-scale road testing is costly, difffcult to reproduce, and inefffcient for exposing rare safety-critical scenarios. Conventional simulation improves repeatability, but an offfine simulator alone cannot continuously connect physical trafffc states, virtual reconstruction, algorithm evaluation, and scenario evolution. This paper proposes a risk-ffeld enhanced closed-loop digital twin framework for autonomous driving safety validation. The framework integrates physical data acquisition, data synchronization, virtual twin reconstruction, risk-aware scenario generation, autonomous driving algorithm evaluation, and safety analysis. A driving risk ffeld is introduced as a uniffed intermediate representation to describe obstacle, lane-departure, road-boundary, time-to-collision, and comfort-related risks around the ego vehicle. The risk ffeld ranks high-risk scenarios in the digital twin scenario library and provides dense safety guidance for reinforcement learning-based driving policies. A simulation-style evaluation protocol is designed to compare conventional reinforcement learning baselines, risk-penalty baselines, and the proposed risk-ffeld guided method. The study indicates that embedding explicit risk structure into digital twins can make autonomous driving validation more targeted, interpretable, and reusable, while its practical effectiveness remains bounded by model ffdelity, risk calibration, and sim-to-real transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种风险场增强的闭环数字孪生框架，用于自动驾驶安全验证。该框架集成了物理数据采集、数据同步、虚拟孪生重建、风险感知场景生成、算法评估和安全分析。通过引入驾驶风险场作为统一中间表示，描述障碍物、车道偏离、道路边界、碰撞时间和舒适性风险，用于排序高风险场景并提供安全引导。仿真评估对比了强化学习基线、风险惩罚基线和风险场引导方法，结果表明嵌入显式风险结构可使验证更具针对性、可解释性和可复用性，但实际效果受模型保真度、风险校准和模拟到现实迁移的限制。
Motivation: 自动驾驶系统在真实部署前需要可靠的安全验证，但大规模道路测试成本高、难以复现且对稀有安全关键场景暴露效率低；传统仿真可重复但离线模拟无法连续连接物理交通状态、虚拟重建、算法评估和场景演化。
Method: 提出风险场增强的闭环数字孪生框架，包括物理数据采集与同步、虚拟孪生重建、风险感知场景生成、自动驾驶算法评估和安全分析；引入驾驶风险场描述自车周围的障碍物、车道偏离、道路边界、碰撞时间和舒适性等风险，用于排序高风险场景并为强化学习驾驶策略提供密集安全引导。
Result: 摘要报告通过仿真评估对比了传统强化学习基线、风险惩罚基线和风险场引导方法，表明风险场引导方法可使验证更具针对性、可解释性和可复用性。
Conclusion: 嵌入显式风险结构到数字孪生可提升自动驾驶验证的针对性和可解释性，但实际有效性受模型保真度、风险校准和模拟到现实迁移的限制。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 嵌入显式风险结构到数字孪生可提升自动驾驶验证的针对性和可解释性，但实际有效性受模型保真度、风险校准和模拟到现实迁移的限制。

papers.title: Verification of Adaptive Agentic Controllers through Finite Rule Revision
papers.abstract_en: Industrial agentic AI systems increasingly exhibit a gap between prototype capability and production deployment. In particular, adaptive agents may generate plausible outputs while remaining difficult to verify under non-determinism, confidentiality constraints, limited context, and weak observability. This paper formulates a bounded verification protocol for adaptive agentic controllers represented by finite symbolic rules, explicit diagnostic predicates, explanation logs, and held-out re-evaluation. The central research question is: when an adaptive agentic controller is represented through finite rules, explicit diagnostic predicates, explanation logs, and held-out re-evaluation, which classes of controller failure can be detected, locally repaired, or rejected without relying on unrestricted human-in-the-loop judgment? The proposed framework treats the controller as a finite revisable object. Diagnostic failures are mapped to predefined rule-level edits, including rule addition, rule deletion, and priority revision. Repaired controllers are then evaluated on held-out simulation seeds or cloned initial states. Experiments in a stylized financially constrained inventory-control benchmark show three outcomes: resource-induced failures that remain non-repairable by one rule edit, partial repairs that are rejected because they violate thresholds or guardrails, and a local one-step repair of an order-volatility failure induced by removing a smoothing rule. The contribution is methodological and provides a simulation-compatible procedure for testing whether specific controller-level failures can be made observable, explainable, locally revisable, and empirically re-tested under controlled conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工业自适应智能体系统在原型与部署间的差距，提出一种通过有限规则修订进行验证的协议。该协议将控制器视为有限可修订对象，通过显式诊断谓词、解释日志和留出重评估来检测、局部修复或拒绝对控制器故障。在财务约束的库存控制基准实验中，展示了不可修复、部分拒绝和局部修复三类结果。
Motivation: 自适应智能体在非确定性、保密约束、有限上下文和弱可观测性下难以验证，存在从原型到部署的可靠性鸿沟。
Method: 提出有界验证协议：将控制器表示为有限符号规则集，故障映射为预定义的规则级编辑（添加、删除、优先级修订），修复后在留出仿真种子上测试。
Result: 在库存控制基准中，观察到资源性故障不可通过单规则编辑修复、部分修复因违反阈值被拒绝，以及移除平滑规则可局部修复订单波动故障。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种仿真兼容的流程，用于测试特定控制器级故障是否可观测、可解释、可局部修订并在受控条件下重新测试。

papers.title: Low-Power License Plate Detection and Recognition on a RISC-V Multi-Core MCU-Based Vision System
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we present the first (to the best of our knowledge) demonstration of a low-power MCU-based edge device for Automatic License Plate Recognition (ALPR). The design leverages on a 9-core RISC-V processor, GAP8, coupled with a QVGA ultra-low-power greyscale imager. The proposed visual processing pipeline uses a multi-model inference approach based on SSDlite-MobilenetV2 for license plate detection and LPRNet for optical character recognition, reaching a 38.9% mAP score for the first task and a recognition rate of >99.13% for the latter on public datasets. On real-world data, the pipeline recognizes registration numbers when the size of LP crops is as small as 30x5 pixels. Thanks to the applied compression and optimization strategies, the multi-model inference (687 MMAC) achieves a throughput of 1.09 FPS at a power cost of 117 mW when running on GAP8. Our solution is the first MCU-class device embedding such a level of network complexity, resulting to be 73x more energy-efficient w.r.t. precedent mobile-class ALPR system featuring a Raspberry Pi3. The proposed design does not resort to any hardwired acceleration engines, thus retaining full flexibility for future algorithmic improvements.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次在基于RISC-V多核MCU的低功耗边缘设备上实现自动车牌识别（ALPR）。系统采用GAP8处理器（9核RISC-V）和超低功耗灰度图像传感器，通过SSDlite-MobilenetV2检测车牌、LPRNet进行字符识别，在公开数据集上分别达到38.9% mAP和>99.13%的识别率。优化后的多模型推理（687 MMAC）在117 mW功耗下实现1.09 FPS，能效比树莓派3方案提升73倍。
Motivation: 现有ALPR系统依赖高性能GPU或移动级设备（如树莓派），功耗高、成本大，缺乏超低功耗MCU级解决方案。
Method: 提出基于GAP8多核RISC-V处理器的视觉流水线，采用SSDlite-MobilenetV2检测车牌区域，LPRNet识别字符，并应用压缩与优化策略降低计算量。
Result: 在公开数据集上，车牌检测mAP为38.9%，字符识别率>99.13%；实际场景中可识别30x5像素的小车牌。系统在117 mW功耗下达到1.09 FPS，能效比树莓派3方案高73倍。
Conclusion: 该设计是首个MCU级ALPR系统，未使用硬连线加速器，保留了算法改进的灵活性，适用于低功耗边缘场景。

papers.title: Listen to the Features: Voice Anonymization Driven by Content Embedding Matching over Signal Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: The paper presents a voice anonymization model focusing on preserving content rather than producing realistic speech. It relies on content embeddings extracted from a frozen pretrained wav2vec2 encoder. These embeddings are decoded into an anonymized signal using vector quantization and a HiFi-GAN vocoder, both trained on LibriTTS without any waveform reconstruction loss or speaker embedding mapping. The training objective enforces that embeddings of the anonymized signal match those of the original one. While training, an auxiliary speaker classification branch with a gradient reversal layer is used to discard speakerspecific information. Results show that this straightforward embedding-based approach achieves very low WER (2.53) with an anonymization performance (EER 13.39) ranking within first level for VPC. Notably, emotions are partially preserved (UAR 43.91), even without a supporting training objective, while the anonymized voice is audible without reconstruction loss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于内容嵌入匹配的语音匿名化模型，使用冻结的wav2vec2编码器提取内容嵌入，通过向量量化和HiFi-GAN声码器重构信号，训练目标强制匿名信号的嵌入与原始信号匹配，并利用梯度反转层去除说话人信息。实验显示该方法在保持内容（WER 2.53）的同时实现良好匿名化（EER 13.39），且部分保留情感（UAR 43.91）。
Motivation: 现有语音匿名化方法通常追求生成逼真语音，可能牺牲内容保留或引入伪影；本文旨在直接以内容保真度为目标，避免波形重建损失和说话人嵌入映射。
Method: 使用预训练wav2vec2提取内容嵌入，通过向量量化码本和HiFi-GAN解码器生成匿名信号；训练损失约束匿名信号的嵌入匹配原始嵌入，并辅以带有梯度反转层的说话人分类分支。
Result: 在LibriTTS上训练后，匿名语音的词错误率（WER）为2.53，等错误率（EER）为13.39（达到VPC第一级），情感保留率（UAR）为43.91。
Conclusion: 该嵌入匹配方法在无需重建损失的情况下实现了内容保留和可接受的匿名化，情感部分保留表明嵌入中蕴含情感信息。

papers.title: Norm Enforcement for AI Agents: Robustly Shaping Behavior in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are increasingly deployed in shared environments where they pursue diverse goals and compete for rewards. This multi-agent competition can lead to behaviors that serve individual gains at collective cost -- for instance, marketing agents may post misleading content as a result of competing for engagement on social media. Human societies address such problems through norms that constrain acceptable behavior, supported by enforcement mechanisms that detect and penalize violations. Motivated by this, we study norm enforcement mechanisms for language model agents. We find that simple enforcement mechanisms are exploited by misaligned agents for competitive advantage, even when they are not explicitly trained or prompted to do so. We thus turn our attention to designing more robust mechanisms, and identify two key ingredients: estimating each agent's reliability over time, and updating this estimate with escalating penalties for repeated misbehavior. Across three simulated environments and a variety of agent populations, mechanisms built on these principles resist exploitation, while still penalizing norm violations at comparable or lower cost than baselines. Our results position norm enforcement mechanisms as scalable levers for shaping agents' behavior, but only when designed to anticipate becoming part of the system they govern. Our code and data are available at https://yaowenye.com/norm-enforcement.
papers.comment: ICML2026 Trustworthy AI for Good Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究面向语言模型智能体的规范执行机制，以抑制多智能体竞争中的自利行为。实验表明简单机制易被恶意智能体利用，因此提出基于可靠性估计和逐步升级惩罚的鲁棒机制，在三个模拟环境中有效抵抗利用。
Motivation: 多智能体环境中追求个体收益的行为可能损害集体利益，人类通过规范及执行机制解决此问题，但现有规范执行机制易被恶意智能体利用。
Method: 提出两种关键成分：随时间估计每个智能体的可靠性，并对重复违规行为逐步升级惩罚力度。
Result: 在三个模拟环境和多种智能体群体中，基于这些原则的机制能够抵抗利用，同时以与基线相当或更低的成本惩罚违规行为。
Conclusion: 规范执行机制可以成为塑造智能体行为的可扩展杠杆，但必须预见其会成为所治理系统的一部分。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Much Does Correctness Cost? Budgeted Placement of Strong Correctors in a Weak Multi-Agent Swarm
papers.abstract_en: A cheap swarm of unreliable agents can be steered to a correct consensus by a few strong, expensive "oracle" correctors. We ask how much one must spend, and where to place the oracles. We model the swarm as a consensus on a graph in which each oracle pins one node toward the truth at a cost-coupled, concave strength, and measure quality by the coherence H(R)=tr M(R)^{-1}. Our first result is that H stays submodular (each added oracle helps less than the last) even when the oracles differ in strength, so a cost-benefit greedy comes within 1-1/e of the best placement at any budget. Inverting the budget gives the budget-correctness frontier B*(eps), the least spend that guarantees an eps-correct consensus: closed-form on the complete graph, and a minimal oracle count k* when oracles cost the same. Whether a budget then buys a few strong oracles or many medium onese curvature of the cost-quality law: diminishing returns favour spreadsharply increasion. Measured onthe Qwen3 ladder (0.6-32B), the law is concave for math verificatio convex foremergent code tracing, so the verdict is genuinely task-dependent.https://github.com/YehudaItkin/budgeted-oracle-placemen

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在弱多智能体蜂群中，通过放置少数强修正器（oracle）来引导群体达成正确共识的问题，考虑预算约束和oracle成本-强度凹性。证明共识相干性H(R)保持子模性，从而贪心算法可达(1-1/e)近似最优，并推导出预算-正确性前沿。在Qwen3模型上实验表明，数学验证任务中成本-质量律呈凹性（倾向分散放置），而代码追踪任务呈凸性（倾向集中），结论依赖于任务。
Motivation: 在由不可靠智能体组成的廉价蜂群中，如何利用少量昂贵但准确的修正器高效引导共识，同时考虑预算限制。
Method: 将蜂群建模为图上的共识过程，每个oracle以成本耦合的凹强度固定一个节点向真相，用相干性H(R)=tr M(R)^{-1}衡量质量。证明H保持子模性，从而提出贪心算法；通过求逆预算得到闭式解（完全图）和最小oracle数量k*。
Result: 贪心算法在任意预算下达到(1-1/e)近似最优；完全图上给出预算-正确性前沿闭式解；在Qwen3模型上实验显示，任务性质决定成本-质量律的凹凸性。
Conclusion: 强调预算分配策略依赖于任务特性：凹性时分散放置更优，凸性时集中放置更优。

papers.title: OmniSCS: Omni Safety-Critical Scenario Synthesis for Autonomous Driving via a Fully Editable Driving World
papers.abstract_en: The synthesis of safety-critical scenarios (SCS) and their evaluation through closed-loop simulations are crucial for developing robust autonomous driving systems. A key aspect of this process involves editing agent states in both appearance and trajectory levels within existing scenes. However, current methods struggle to preserve data fidelity after scene editing and fail to efficiently generate high-quality SCS through such modifications. To overcome these limitations, we propose OmniSCS, an innovative system that generates photorealistic SCS with high physical fidelity while enabling closed-loop testing in synthetic environments. OmniSCS comprises two key modules: 1) A Fully Editable Driving World Construction module that maintains high-fidelity agent appearance and background during scene editing via dual-strategy agent reconstruction and depth-refinement background reconstruction methods. 2) A SCS Synthesis module that facilitates object insertion and agent trajectory editing to synthesize diverse SCS while preserving data fidelity. Experiments on nuScenes, Waymo, and KITTI datasets show that OmniSCS outperforms state-of-the-art methods in edited scene fidelity. We further validate its ability to enhance autonomous driving algorithms and support real-time (13Hz) closed-loop testing. Overall, OmniSCS provides a safer, more effective, and cost-efficient solution for SCS optimization and testing in autonomous driving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniSCS，一种用于自动驾驶安全关键场景（SCS）合成的系统，能在保持高物理逼真度和数据保真度的同时，支持闭环测试。系统包含全可编辑驾驶世界构建模块和SCS合成模块，通过在nuScenes、Waymo和KITTI数据集上的实验，证明其在编辑场景保真度上优于现有方法，并能以13Hz实时运行。
Motivation: 现有方法在编辑自动驾驶场景中的智能体状态时难以保持数据保真度，且无法高效生成高质量安全关键场景，亟需一种既能保持高保真度又能支持闭环测试的场景合成方法。
Method: OmniSCS包括两个模块：1）全可编辑驾驶世界构建模块，通过双策略智能体重建和深度细化背景重建方法，在场景编辑中保持高保真智能体外观和背景；2）SCS合成模块，支持对象插入和轨迹编辑以合成多样化安全关键场景，同时保持数据保真度。
Result: 在nuScenes、Waymo和KITTI数据集上，OmniSCS在编辑场景保真度上优于现有方法，并成功增强自动驾驶算法性能，支持实时（13Hz）闭环测试。
Conclusion: OmniSCS为自动驾驶安全关键场景的优化和测试提供了更安全、有效且成本效益高的解决方案，但其有效性可能受限于不同驾驶场景的泛化能力和计算资源需求。

papers.title: Knowledge-Constrained Shape Optimization with a Mixture-of-Experts Neural Operator for High-Confidence Design
papers.abstract_en: Engineering shape optimization faces challenges in both expert-dependent problem setup and surrogate-model reliability. In practical aerodynamic design, optimization settings such as editable regions, deformation ranges, and design-preservation constraints are typically specified manually by experienced engineers, while surrogate-based optimization may become unreliable for heterogeneous geometry databases and out-of-distribution designs. To address these challenges, we propose a knowledge-constrained shape-optimization framework that translates knowledge-based constraints and user intent into quantifiable parameters of DFFD-based deformation operators, enabling engineering-aware and controllable constrained optimization. We further develop a Mixture-of-Experts Neural Operator (MoE-NO) to improve drag prediction and trend consistency over heterogeneous aerodynamic datasets. Based on the MoE-NO encoder and Mahalanobis distance, an uncertainty-estimation strategy is introduced to detect out-of-distribution geometries and selectively trigger physics-solver feedback for local sample enrichment. Experiments on in-house MPV, SUV, and Sedan datasets show that MoE-NO achieves a test-set MAPE of $1.16\%$ and a trend-prediction accuracy of $94.34\%$, outperforming the best baseline results of $1.52\%$ and $90.34\%$, respectively. Vehicle shape-optimization experiments further yield CFD-validated drag coefficient reductions of approximately $4\%$ to $10\%$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出知识约束形状优化框架，将工程知识转化为DFFF变形算子的可量化参数，实现可控优化。同时开发混合专家神经算子（MoE-NO）改进异质气动数据集的阻力预测与趋势一致性，并基于MoE-NO编码器和马氏距离引入不确定性估计策略检测分布外几何体，触发物理求解器反馈进行局部样本丰富。实验显示MoE-NO在MPV、SUV和Sedan数据集上测试集MAPE为1.16%，趋势预测准确率94.34%，优于基线；形状优化实验经CFD验证阻力系数降低约4%-10%。
Motivation: 工程形状优化中，优化设置（如可编辑区域、变形范围、设计保持约束）通常依赖工程师手动指定，且基于代理的优化在异质几何数据库和分布外设计上可能不可靠。
Method: 提出知识约束优化框架，将知识约束和用户意图转化为DFFF变形算子的可量化参数；开发混合专家神经算子（MoE-NO）改进阻力预测；基于MoE-NO编码器和马氏距离的不确定性估计策略检测分布外几何体并触发物理求解器反馈。
Result: MoE-NO在MPV、SUV和Sedan数据集上测试集MAPE为1.16%，趋势预测准确率94.34%，优于基线（1.52%和90.34%）；车辆形状优化实验经CFD验证阻力系数降低约4%-10%。
Conclusion: 该框架通过知识约束和不确定性估计提高了优化可靠性和预测精度，适用于高置信度工程设计。

papers.title: BatteryLake: Agentic, Physics-Grounded Curation of Heterogeneous Battery Aging Data and Benchmarking
papers.abstract_en: Public battery aging datasets are a critical asset for advanced health management, but their practical use is often limited by inconsistent formats, unclear schemas, and metadata scattered across repositories and publications. Current curation remains largely manual and hard to reproduce, while general-purpose data integration tools miss the domain-specific semantics of electrochemical time-series data. We present BatteryLake, a governed data lakehouse that turns raw public battery data into benchmark-ready assets through an agentic, physics-grounded curation framework, with three contributions. First, LLM agents extract metadata and synthesize dataset-specific converters, grounding every output in verbatim evidence and abstaining when none supports a value. Second, a human-in-the-loop mechanism frames verification as selective prediction and gates admitted data through 26 schema, statistical, and physical-plausibility rules. Third, we release an open benchmark of 41 datasets from over 25 institutions, with standardized SOH and RUL tasks, three split protocols, and eight baseline model families. The platform, benchmark, and curation protocol are publicly available at https://tianwen1209.github.io/batterylake/.
papers.comment: The platform, benchmark, and curation protocol are publicly available at https://tianwen1209.github.io/batterylake/

TL;DR: BatteryLake 是一个基于代理和物理约束的电池老化数据湖，通过 LLM 智能体自动提取元数据并合成转换器，结合人机回环验证机制，将 41 个公开数据集标准化为基准就绪资产，并提供 SOH 和 RUL 任务的标准化基准。
Motivation: 公共电池老化数据集格式不一致、元数据分散，手动整理难以复现，缺乏针对电化学时序数据的领域特定工具。
Method: 使用 LLM 代理提取元数据并生成数据集特异性转换器，输出基于逐字证据，无证据时弃权；人机回环机制通过 26 条模式、统计和物理合理性规则验证数据质量。
Result: 发布了来自 25 多个机构的 41 个数据集的标准基准，包含标准化 SOH 和 RUL 任务、三种划分协议和八个基线模型族。
Conclusion: 平台、基准和整理协议已公开，旨在提升电池老化数据的可用性和可复现性。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Structure Anchoring With Capture-Aware Prototype Calibration for Cross-Environment RF Fingerprinting
papers.abstract_en: Radio frequency fingerprint identification (RFFI) uses transmitter-specific hardware imperfections as a physicallayer identity cue for Internet of Things (IoT) devices, but deep RFFI models often degrade when the acquisition environment changes. In multi-antenna reception, this degradation is not merely a generic distribution shift. It is also shaped by receiver-array topology, frequency-offset dynamics, and capturedependent target structure, which can distort embeddings and move source-trained decision boundaries. This article proposes physics-informed structure anchoring with capture-aware prototype calibration (PISA-CAPC), a framework that separates source representation anchoring from fixed-backbone target calibration. The representation stage organizes antenna tokens with a topology graph and modulates the graph using CFO-derived acquisition-dynamics descriptors. Bounded contextual residual suppression is then applied around the identity representation. At deployment, unlabeled capture-aware prototype calibration (U-CAPC) calibrates target decision scores through capturelocal prototype evidence under a fixed representation, mitigating boundary shift without requiring target-domain backbone updates or target labels. On a measured ten-transmitter multiantenna WiFi benchmark, PISA-CAPC achieves 0.9257 targetdomain mean Macro-F1 under a balanced transductive setting. Ablations confirm that topology-guided structure anchoring, contextual residual suppression, and capture-aware calibration contribute complementary gains. These results establish PISACAPC as a fixed-backbone route to cross-environment RFFI, coupling physically motivated representation learning with labelfree, capture-aware decision calibration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对跨环境射频指纹识别（RFFI）中环境变化导致模型退化的问题，提出PISA-CAPC框架。该框架利用物理信息引导的结构锚定和捕获感知原型校准，在固定骨干网络下实现无标签目标域校准。在十发射器多天线WiFi基准上，目标域平均Macro-F1达到0.9257。
Motivation: 深度RFFI模型在采集环境变化时性能下降，这种退化不仅是分布偏移，还受接收阵列拓扑、频率偏移动态和捕获依赖的目标结构影响。
Method: 提出PISA-CAPC框架，分两步：表示阶段用拓扑图组织天线令牌，并用CFO导出的采集动态描述符调制图，然后对身份表示施加有界上下文残差抑制；部署阶段，无标签捕获感知原型校准（U-CAPC）在固定表示下通过捕获局部原型证据校准目标决策分数。
Result: 在十发射器多天线WiFi基准上，PISA-CAPC在平衡转导设置下目标域平均Macro-F1达到0.9257。消融实验证实各组件贡献互补。
Conclusion: 该框架为跨环境RFFI提供了一条固定骨干路线，结合物理激励的表示学习和无标签、捕获感知的决策校准。

papers.title: ReflectWorld-MM: An Entity-Oriented Multi-Media Memory System for Open-Ended Video Streams
papers.abstract_en: Building assistants that can continually watch the world, remember what they see, and reason over their accumulated experience is a long-standing goal, and recently multimodal agents equipped with long-term memory over video streams have attracted increasing interest. Unfortunately, existing systems either keep their memory inside the model context or in a flat feature store, and organize it around frames rather than around the persistent entities a stream is really about, which confines them to bounded videos and weakens their ability to track who and what reappears over time. In this paper, we propose ReflectWorld-MM, an entity-oriented multi-media memory system for open-ended video streams. It consists of three parts. The first is a perception front-end that turns a streaming video into entity-resolved observations under a bounded short-term memory. The second is a hierarchical long-term memory, grounded in human memory theory, that couples a multi-scale episodic memory, an evolving entity-centric semantic memory, and a procedural memory. The third is a complete realization, built for real-world operation, that ingests arbitrary streams and plugs into off-the-shelf assistants. Across six long-video and lifelong-memory benchmarks, ReflectWorld-MM achieves the best accuracy on all six, outperforming strong memory agents and a frontier model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReflectWorld-MM，一个面向开放视频流的实体导向多媒体记忆系统。系统包含感知前端将流视频转化为实体解析的观察，以及基于人类记忆理论的分层长期记忆，包括多尺度情景记忆、演化中的实体中心语义记忆和程序记忆。在六个长视频和终身记忆基准上取得最佳准确率。
Motivation: 现有系统将记忆保持在模型上下文或扁平特征存储中，围绕帧组织而非围绕流中持续存在的实体，限制了其处理边界视频并追踪随时间重复出现的实体能力。
Method: 提出三部分系统：1）感知前端在有限短期记忆下将流视频转化为实体解析观察；2）基于人类记忆理论的分层长期记忆，耦合多尺度情景记忆、演化实体中心语义记忆和程序记忆；3）完整实现，可接入任意流和现成助手。
Result: 在六个长视频和终身记忆基准上，ReflectWorld-MM在所有基准上取得最佳准确率，优于强记忆智能体和前沿模型。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该实体导向系统能有效处理开放视频流中的长期记忆和实体追踪。

papers.title: RSLoRA: Training-free Rank Allocation for LoRA via Representational Sensitivity Probing
papers.abstract_en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a cornerstone of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT); however, the conventional practice of uniform rank assignment ignores the functional heterogeneity of neural layers. Existing rank allocation methods typically struggle with a trade-off between computational intensity and heuristic simplicity: training-based methods suffer from prohibitive overhead, while pre-allocation methods fail to capture the dynamic task-specific representation manifold. In this paper, we propose RSLoRA (Representational Sensitivity LoRA), a training-free and gradient-free rank allocator driven by activation-space geometry. We identify a "sensitivity regime shift" across layers, observing that static weight analysis and local gradients are insufficient to reflect how updates reshape a model's internal representations. To address this, RSLoRA introduces a virtual representational probing mechanism. By simulating adaptation through structured low-rank noise and measuring the resulting manifold displacement by using Effective Rank and Frechet Distance, we identify high-sensitivity modules that require higher rank capacity. Our framework effectively bridges the gap between expert-crafted heuristics and actual representational impact. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that RSLoRA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art allocators (e.g., AdaLoRA, GoRA) across mainstream benchmarks. By eliminating the need for iterative training-time adjustments and backward gradients, RSLoRA provides a highly efficient, robust, and representation-aware solution for large-scale model adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RSLoRA，一种无需训练或梯度的秩分配方法，通过激活空间的几何特性为LoRA各层分配不同秩。该方法引入虚拟表示探测机制，模拟低秩扰动并测量流形位移，从而识别高敏感模块。在多个基准上，RSLoRA超越AdaLoRA、GoRA等现有分配器。
Motivation: 传统LoRA使用统一秩分配，忽略层间功能异质性；现有秩分配方法要么计算开销大，要么启发式规则无法捕捉任务特定的表示流形。
Method: RSLoRA是一种无训练、无梯度的秩分配器，通过激活空间几何驱动。它利用结构化低秩噪声模拟适配，并计算有效秩（Effective Rank）和弗雷歇距离（Frechet Distance）来衡量流形位移，从而确定高敏感模块并分配更高秩。
Result: 摘要报告RSLoRA在主流基准上持续优于最新的分配器（如AdaLoRA、GoRA），且无需迭代训练调整或反向梯度。
Conclusion: RSLoRA提供了高效、鲁棒且表示感知的大模型适配方案，弥合了专家启发式与实际表示影响之间的差距。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出RSLoRA，一种无需训练或梯度的秩分配方法，通过激活空间的几何特性为LoRA各层分配不同秩。该方法引入虚拟表示探测机制，模拟低秩扰动并测量流形位移，从而识别高敏感模块。在多个基准上，RSLoRA超越AdaLoRA、GoRA等现有分配器。
summary_sections.motivation: 传统LoRA使用统一秩分配，忽略层间功能异质性；现有秩分配方法要么计算开销大，要么启发式规则无法捕捉任务特定的表示流形。
summary_sections.method: RSLoRA是一种无训练、无梯度的秩分配器，通过激活空间几何驱动。它利用结构化低秩噪声模拟适配，并计算有效秩（Effective Rank）和弗雷歇距离（Frechet Distance）来衡量流形位移，从而确定高敏感模块并分配更高秩。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告RSLoRA在主流基准上持续优于最新的分配器（如AdaLoRA、GoRA），且无需迭代训练调整或反向梯度。
summary_sections.conclusion: RSLoRA提供了高效、鲁棒且表示感知的大模型适配方案，弥合了专家启发式与实际表示影响之间的差距。

papers.title: LegalFarePlan: A Label-Setting Framework for Fare-Transparent Urban Rail Route Planning under Non-Additive Fare Rules
papers.abstract_en: Urban rail fare systems may be non-additive: the fare of a single paid journey from an origin to a destination can differ from the sum of fares over multiple legally separated journey legs. This paper presents LegalFarePlan, a fare-transparent route-planning framework that models legal exit-and-reentry operations as explicit, auditable constraints. Given a transit network, fare function, transfer rules, station-level exit/re-entry costs, an extra-time budget, and a split limit, the planner computes explainable route plans over paid journey segments. The artifact implements Dijkstra shortest-time and direct route-planner baselines, a greedy split heuristic, bounded exact label-setting, and Pareto-frontier search. Evaluation uses controlled synthetic data and a 57-station semi-synthetic benchmark with 360 OD pairs. On the semi-synthetic benchmark, bounded exact search identifies positive modeled fare reductions for 71.11% of OD pairs, with mean reduction 3.78 and maximum reduction 9.0 synthetic fare units under a 45-minute extra-time budget. These results demonstrate method behavior and reproducibility; they are not empirical conclusions about MTR or any transit operator.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 tables; author preprint version, not the conference camera-ready version

papers.title: Cross-Subject Modeling for Widefield Calcium Imaging via Atlas-Aligned Spatiotemporal Tokenization
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale, multi-subject widefield calcium imaging provides unprecedented access to brain-wide cortical dynamics. However, the high dimensionality, complex spatiotemporal structure, and substantial task-irrelevant activity in widefield recordings have largely restricted modeling efforts to single-session analyses, limiting scalability and generalization. While multi-subject pretrained models have been explored for some neural modalities, multi-subject models for widefield calcium imaging have not yet been demonstrated; further, subject-invariant zero-shot behavior decoding remains elusive for multi-subject models across neural modalities more broadly. As a first step toward foundation modeling of widefield data, we introduce WiCAT, a multi-subject model that leverages self-supervised pretraining to both outperform single-session models and enable zero-shot behavior decoding on unseen subjects. WiCAT introduces an atlas-grounded tokenization scheme without session-specific components and learns globally shared spatiotemporal representations. Across multiple widefield datasets, the pretrained model supports lightweight downstream decoding, transfers across subjects, tasks, and datasets, and outperforms baseline models. Notably, the model also achieves robust zero-shot continuous behavior decoding and left-out brain region reconstruction on unseen subjects.
papers.comment: Published at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026. Code available at: https://github.com/ShanechiLab/WiCAT
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WiCAT，一种用于宽场钙成像（widefield calcium imaging）的多主体自监督预训练模型。通过基于图谱的时空分词（atlas-aligned spatiotemporal tokenization）和全局共享表示学习，WiCAT在多个数据集上提升了跨主体、跨任务的行为解码性能，并首次实现了对未见主体的零样本连续行为解码和脑区重建。
Motivation: 现有宽场钙成像建模多局限于单会话分析，难以扩展和泛化；多主体预训练模型已在其他神经模态中探索，但宽场钙成像领域尚未有成功示范，且跨主体零样本行为解码仍具挑战。
Method: 提出WiCAT，采用基于图谱的分词方案（无会话特定组件），通过自监督预训练学习全局共享的时空表示，避免了单会话模型中的主题特定偏置。
Result: 在多个宽场钙成像数据集上，WiCAT预训练模型支持轻量级下游解码，跨主体、任务和数据集迁移，性能优于基线模型；并实现了对未见主体的鲁棒零样本连续行为解码和留出脑区重建。
Conclusion: 该工作标志着向宽场钙成像基础模型迈出第一步，证明了多主体自监督预训练在宽场钙成像中的有效性，可推广至其他大规模神经数据。

papers.title: Unified Backbone Refinement for Diffusion Models via Internal-Latent Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, with performance closely related to the denoising backbones that parameterize the score function. In this paper, we present a systematic, phase-aware analysis of diffusion components and show that abrupt, early-stage fluctuations in deep latents are strongly associated with artifacts. Guided by these findings, we introduce DUNE (Diffusion Unified Network refiNEr), a training-free refinement framework that detects abrupt deviations in deep low-noise internal latents using a shared EMA-based criterion, and applies backbone-specific suppression to the detector-selected entries. Although derived from U-Net, the same detect-suppress principle extends naturally to Transformer-based diffusion models by acting on the latents of deep self-attention blocks. Extensive experiments across multiple backbones indicate that DUNE improves fidelity while reducing hallucinations, offering new insight into where and when diffusion backbones should be controlled.
papers.comment: 45 pages, 23 figures. Accepted at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DUNE，一种无需训练的扩散模型骨干网络精炼框架，通过分析内部隐变量的早期突变来检测并抑制伪影，提升生成保真度并减少幻觉。实验表明该方法在 U-Net 和 Transformer 骨干上均有效。
Motivation: 扩散模型生成质量与去噪骨干网络密切相关，但现有方法缺乏对内部隐变量动态的系统分析，导致伪影难以消除。
Method: DUNE 框架基于 EMA 标准检测低噪声阶段内部隐变量的突变，并对检测到的条目施加骨干网络特定的抑制操作。
Result: 实验表明 DUNE 能提升生成保真度，减少幻觉，且通用性适用于 U-Net 和 Transformer 骨干。
Conclusion: 论文揭示了扩散骨干网络控制的关键时机和位置，为训练后精炼提供了新思路。

papers.title: Data-Driven Forward and Inverse Modeling of V-Beam Thermal Sensors
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a machine learning framework for data-driven inverse design of V-beam thermal sensors. The goal is to determine the optimal sensor geometry: beam inclination angle, beam length and beam width that achieves a target displacement under a given temperature. The design should also provide the geometry with minimum structure volume and minimum mechanical stress the sensor must support. This problem is ill-posed as for a given displacement there are multiple possible geometric configurations, causing direct regression methods to fail. We document a series of five exploratory trials that progressively revealed the nature of the problem culminating in a two-phase solution: a neural network forward model trained to map geometry and material constants to sensor responses, a gradient-descent inverse optimization over the frozen forward model, minimizing stress and volume simultaneously. The proposed pipeline utilizes a 3000-sample dataset and achieves a MAPE of 4.76% for predicting the displacement, more than 70% of predictions having MAPE of under 5%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个机器学习框架，用于V-beam热传感器的数据驱动逆设计，通过两阶段方法（前向神经网络模型+梯度下降逆优化）确定最优几何参数，在3000样本数据集上实现位移预测MAPE为4.76%。
Motivation: V-beam热传感器逆设计问题存在不适定性：给定位移下多种几何配置可行，直接回归方法失效。需要同时优化结构体积和机械应力。
Method: 两阶段方案：首先训练前向神经网络模型映射几何与材料常数到传感器响应；然后冻结前向模型，通过梯度下降逆优化同时最小化应力和体积。
Result: 在3000样本数据集上，位移预测的MAPE为4.76%，超过70%的预测MAPE低于5%。
Conclusion: 数据驱动逆设计框架有效解决V-beam热传感器的多解问题，但当前依赖仿真数据，需验证实际传感器性能。

papers.title: Task-Conditioned Synthetic Data Generation for Improving Machine Learning Performance in Agricultural Prediction Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Machine Learning (ML) algorithms have been widely used to estimate agricultural variables across diverse contexts. However, because the quantity and quality of training data strongly influence performance of ML algorithms, their use can be constrained by limited or incomplete reference data. Synthetic Data Generation (SDG) offers a practical approach to address this issue by producing artificial but realistic samples that preserve key characteristics of the original data. Building on teacher-student knowledge transfer and in-context learning for tabular data, this study proposes a Task-Conditioned SDG (TCSDG) algorithm that pairs a Bayesian Network generator with a transformer-based tabular foundation model (TabICL). The proposed algorithm was evaluated on two agricultural prediction tasks: crop yield prediction and crop type classification. Six benchmark SDG algorithms were also utilized to compare their performance with that of TCSDG. Across twelve study sites, two training-data fractions, four multiplication ratios, and three predictive ML algorithms, augmenting the original data with TCSDG-generated synthetic data improved ML performance in 89% of the crop type classification experiments and 74% of the crop yield prediction experiments. TCSDG also substantially outperformed benchmark SDG algorithms and was the only method to consistently improve ML performance across both tasks at the aggregate level. The study demonstrates that carefully designed and processed synthetic data can improve ML performance in precision-agriculture applications. TCSDG offers a practical and extensible framework for generating synthetic data that supports downstream ML agricultural prediction. The full implementation of TCSDG is publicly available as open source at https://github.com/HamidEbrahimy/TCSDG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种任务条件合成数据生成算法（TCSDG），结合贝叶斯网络生成器和基于transformer的表格基础模型（TabICL），用于农业预测任务。在12个研究站点、不同训练数据比例和乘法比例下，TCSDG生成的合成数据在89%的作物类型分类实验和74%的作物产量预测实验中提升了机器学习性能，且优于六个基准SDG算法。
Motivation: 农业预测中训练数据数量和质量有限，限制了机器学习性能。合成数据生成可提供人工但真实的样本，但现有方法缺乏任务特定性。
Method: 提出TCSDG算法，包含贝叶斯网络生成器和TabICL transformer模型，通过教师-学生知识迁移和上下文学习生成任务条件化合成表格数据。
Result: 在12个研究站点、两种训练数据比例、四种倍增比例和三种预测算法下，TCSDG在89%的作物类型分类和74%的作物产量预测实验中提升性能，并显著优于六个基准方法。
Conclusion: 精心设计的合成数据可提升精准农业中的机器学习性能，TCSDG提供了可扩展的实用框架，代码开源。

papers.title: MorphologyFM: A Foundation Model for Morphology-Aware Representation Learning from ECG and Pulse Oximetry Waveforms
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for learning transferable representations from large scale biomedical data, yet existing approaches for physiological waveforms primarily optimize reconstruction or forecasting objectives that do not explicitly preserve clinically meaningful waveform morphology. Electrocardiograms (ECGs) and pulse oximetry (SpO2) waveforms encode rich cardiovascular and hemodynamic information through their morphological structure. In this work, we introduce MorphologyFM, a multimodal foundation model pretrained on paired ECG and SpO2 waveforms from the MIMIC critical care database using a morphology aware self supervised learning objective. MorphologyFM combines morphology guided masking, cross modal representation learning, and contrastive latent alignment to learn representations that capture clinically relevant physiological structure without requiring manual annotations. We evaluate MorphologyFM across multiple downstream prediction tasks, including arrhythmia classification, hypoxemia prediction, mortality prediction, and length of stay estimation, demonstrating consistent improvements over representative self supervised learning methods, including Masked Autoencoders (MAE), contrastive learning, Barlow Twins, and Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA). Furthermore, we show that jointly modeling ECG and SpO2 waveforms produces more transferable representations than single modality pretraining. Our results establish waveform morphology as a powerful inductive bias for self supervised physiological representation learning and introduce MorphologyFM as a general purpose foundation model for continuous physiological monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MorphologyFM 是一个基于形态感知自监督学习的心电图和脉搏血氧波形基础模型，利用 MIMIC 数据库中的配对波形训练，结合形态引导掩码、跨模态表示学习和对比潜在对齐，在心律失常分类、低氧血症预测等下游任务中优于 MAE、对比学习等方法。
Motivation: 现有生理波形基础模型主要优化重构或预测目标，未能显式保留临床意义的波形形态，而心电图和脉搏血氧波形的形态结构包含丰富的心血管和血流动力学信息。
Method: 提出 MorphologyFM，采用形态感知自监督学习目标，包含形态引导掩码、跨模态表示学习和对比潜在对齐，对心电图和脉搏血氧波形进行联合建模。

papers.title: Replicating Belief, Not Bits: Epistemic State Replication for Agentic Systems
papers.abstract_en: In distributed systems, the classical State Machine Replication (SMR) model assumes that correct replicas execute deterministic transitions to yield identical bitwise states. However, the rise of agentic distributed systems -- where autonomous, stochastic, and model-driven agents orchestrate infrastructure -- presents scenarios where deterministic, bitwise replication is insufficient. Replicas operating with generative models may exhibit divergent reasoning paths, summaries, and token boundaries, yet reach semantically equivalent and correct operational decisions. Forcing bitwise agreement across these stochastic participants degrades execution flexibility, induces context amnesia, and limits performance. We argue that in such settings replicas should agree on belief, not bits. We propose Epistemic State Replication (ESR), a belief-replication layer for agentic distributed systems that shifts the replication boundary from data visibility to knowledge visibility. We formalize the epistemic node state as a pair K = (L, B) separating the deterministic, immutable evidence log (L) from the stochastic, evolving belief lineage (B). To govern execution safety, we define Semantic Linearizability, which requires operations to reflect the latest committed operational meaning within a verifier-bounded semantic compatibility metric, and Bounded Eventual Coherence, which bounds expected semantic divergence under fair delivery, monotonic evidence, bounded verifier disturbance, and a contractive graft operator. We outline protocols for propagating derived insights using structured epistemic deltas, and formalize Verifiable Semantic Rollbacks to prune faulty premises from belief lineages without inducing context amnesia. We prototype ESR and report preliminary simulation results that show feasibility under the stated assumptions and illustrate reductions in secondary cognitive faults.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文针对智能体分布式系统中生成式模型的随机性导致确定性状态复制失效的问题，提出认知状态复制（Epistemic State Replication, ESR）。ESR将复制边界从数据可见性提升到知识可见性，允许语义等价但位不一致的状态。形式化定义节点状态为确定性日志与随机信念谱系的组合，并给出语义线性化、有界最终一致性等协议。原型模拟显示在假设条件下可行，并减少二次认知故障。
Motivation: 经典状态机复制要求确定性位一致，但生成式智能体系统的随机性导致位一致不现实且浪费，需要信念级一致。
Method: 形式化认知节点状态为K=(L,B)，分离确定性日志和信念谱系；定义语义线性化、有界最终一致性等协议；通过结构化认知增量传播见解；可验证语义回滚修剪错误前提。
Result: 原型模拟显示在所假设条件下可行，并减少二次认知故障。
Conclusion: 智能体分布式系统应复制信念而非比特，ESR提供了框架和协议，初步实验支持可行性。

papers.title: SupplyNetPy: An Open-Source Python Library for High-Fidelity Modeling and Simulation of Arbitrary Supply Chain and Inventory Networks
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces SupplyNetPy, an open-source, well-documented Python library for modeling and discrete-event simulation of supply chain networks with arbitrary multi-echelon structures. It supports multiple replenishment policies, perishable inventory, node disruptions, and stochastic demand and lead times. All components are extensible via inheritance. Users describe a supply chain as a graph with node and link attributes, while the library handles simulation, providing logs and extensive node and network level performance reports. This paper presents the motivation, design, key features, and architecture of SupplyNetPy, along with detailed validation results (against analytical benchmarks, a commercial tool, and a published case study). A key motivation behind SupplyNetPy's development is programmatic generation and simulation of complex models, enabling design-space exploration, what-if analysis, training data generation, and supply chain digital twins.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SupplyNetPy 是一个开源的 Python 库，用于对具有任意多级结构的供应链网络进行高保真建模和离散事件仿真。它支持多种补货策略、易腐库存、节点中断以及随机需求和提前期，所有组件均可通过继承扩展。用户将供应链描述为带有节点和边属性的图，库负责仿真并提供详细的节点和网络级性能报告。验证结果包括与解析基准、商业工具和已发表案例研究的对比。
Motivation: 现有供应链仿真工具在灵活性、可扩展性和对复杂多级结构的支持方面存在不足，难以用于设计空间探索、假设分析、训练数据生成和数字孪生等场景。
Method: SupplyNetPy 采用基于图模型的方法，将供应链描述为有向图，节点代表实体（如仓库、零售商），边代表物料流。库使用离散事件仿真引擎，提供多种预定义补货策略（如 (R,Q)、(s,S) 等），支持易腐库存的动态过期处理，以及节点故障和随机需求/提前期模拟。所有组件都设计为可通过继承进行扩展。
Result: 摘要报告了详细的验证结果，包括与解析模型、商业软件 AnyLogic 及已发表案例研究的一致性测试，表明 SupplyNetPy 在仿真精度和性能上达到或超过现有工具。
Conclusion: SupplyNetPy 通过开源、文档完备和高度可扩展的设计，为供应链研究人员和从业人员提供了一个强大的仿真工具，特别适用于大规模模型生成和自动化分析。

papers.title: A Theory of Least Autonomy in AI
papers.abstract_en: Least privilege, the principle that an identity should hold only the permissions strictly required for its task, has been a foundational primitive of access control for decades. We argue that this principle is insufficient for agentic AI systems, which do not merely hold permissions but can combine, approve, and amplify them across workflows and system boundaries. We propose least autonomy as an appropriate generalization and develop a formal theory. First, we define a compositional blast radius d(a,b) that measures structural separation between actions in an enterprise hierarchy, combining an ultrametric tree with lattice-valued confidentiality, integrity, and control-context labels. Second, we define a directed agent influence graph G(theta). An arc from U to V requires a directed shared-resource write-to-read meeting or a conservative undirected agent-to-agent (A2A) communication meeting, and a meeting-conditioned influence potential at or above an externally selected policy threshold theta. A catalogue-radius profile supports calibration and audit of theta. Finally, we define a collusion predicate over graph reachability that detects authorization composition, decision manipulation, and cross-domain capability composition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出最小权限原则（least privilege）不足以应对具有自主决策能力的AI系统，提出最小自治（least autonomy）作为泛化概念，并构建形式化理论。该理论定义了组合爆炸半径（blast radius）度量动作间的结构分离，引入带策略阈值的代理影响力图（agent influence graph），并给出检测授权组合、决策操纵、跨域能力组合的共谋谓词（collusion predicate）。
Motivation: 现有访问控制的最小权限原则仅关注静态权限分配，但自主AI系统可以组合、批准和放大权限，导致权限扩散风险。需要新的理论基础来约束自主系统的行为范围。
Method: 提出形式化理论：(1) 基于超度量树和格值标签定义爆炸半径 d(a,b)；(2) 定义有向代理影响力图 G(θ)，边源自共享资源写-读或代理间通信，并通过策略阈值 θ 过滤；(3) 定义基于图可达性的共谋谓词，用于检测授权组合、决策操纵和跨域能力组合。
Result: 论文提出目录-半径剖面（catalogue-radius profile）支持策略阈值 θ 的校准与审计，但摘要未给出具体实证结果或数值指标。
Conclusion: 最小自治是比最小权限更适用于AI系统的原则，其形式化理论为分析和限制自主系统的行为空间提供了基础工具。

papers.title: Scaffolding the Strategist: Architecture-Dependent Reasoning Interventions in Hotelling Spatial Markets
papers.abstract_en: We investigate whether structured reasoning interventions improve the strategic economic reasoning of large language models, and whether their effects depend on model architecture. Using Hotelling's linear city model as a diagnostic vehicle, we evaluate GPT-4.1-mini (a standard instruction-following model) and GPT-5-mini (a reasoning-optimized model) under five conditions - an unscaffolded baseline and four reasoning interventions - across eight questions spanning deductive and abductive reasoning, three prompt framings, and three repetitions per condition, yielding 720 individually judged responses. We find a statistically significant crossover interaction between scaffolding type and model architecture ($t(7) = 4.79$, $p = 0.002$, $d = 1.69$): commitment scaffolding improves the standard model ($+0.21$) while degrading the reasoning model ($-0.63$), and principled separation shows the opposite pattern ($-0.40$ vs. $+0.31$). Both crossovers are individually significant (commitment: $p = 0.040$; separation: $p = 0.002$) and hold across all eight questions with 7/8 directional consistency. Adversarial stress-testing harms both models, with $2.6\times$ greater degradation for the reasoning model ($-1.47$ vs. $-0.57$; $p = 0.038$), and the damage correlates negatively with baseline difficulty ($R^2 = 0.36$, $p = 0.014$). We further document a persistent declarative-procedural gap in which both models identify correct strategies at rates far exceeding their ability to execute them; separation fully closes this gap for the reasoning model while no intervention helps the standard model.
papers.comment: 26 pages (11 main + 15 appendix), 6 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on LLM Reasoning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究结构化推理干预对大型语言模型战略经济推理能力的影响，并分析模型架构是否调节这种影响。使用Hotelling线性城市模型作为诊断任务，评估GPT-4.1-mini（标准模型）和GPT-5-mini（推理优化模型）在五种条件下的表现。结果发现干预类型与架构之间存在显著的交叉交互作用，承诺干预提升标准模型但损害推理模型，而原则性分离则相反。此外，对抗性压力测试对推理模型的负面影响更大，且存在陈述-程序性差距，分离干预可消除推理模型的这一差距，但对标准模型无效。
Motivation: 探究结构化推理干预是否能提升大语言模型的战略经济推理能力，以及这种效果是否依赖于模型架构。
Method: 以Hotelling线性城市模型为诊断工具，评估GPT-4.1-mini和GPT-5-mini在五种条件（无干预基线及四种推理干预）下，针对八个涵盖演绎和溯因推理的问题，结合三种提示框架，每种条件重复三次，共720个独立判断。
Result: 发现承诺干预使标准模型提升0.21但推理模型下降0.63；原则性分离则相反（-0.40 vs +0.31）。对抗性压力测试使推理模型退化幅度是标准模型的2.6倍（-1.47 vs -0.57）。陈述-程序性差距方面，分离干预完全消除推理模型的差距，但无干预能帮助标准模型。
Conclusion: 推理干预的效果因模型架构而异，且模型在执行策略时存在识别与执行的差距。选择干预策略需考虑模型类型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SWIFT: A Small-World Interaction Framework for Flow-Aware Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Accurate trajectory prediction in autonomous driving hinges on modeling dynamic and context-dependent interactions among traffic agents. However, most existing approaches are purely data-driven and lack structural priors, which limits their generalization under distribution shifts. In this work, interaction modeling is revisited through the structure and dynamics of traffic networks, and SWIFT (Small-World Interaction Framework for Trajectory prediction) is proposed as a unified framework that integrates small-world networks with traffic flow theory. SWIFT introduces structural inductive biases via a Small-World Interaction Network that captures both local and global dependencies, and a Flow Regime Encoder that adapts the interaction structure to scene-level traffic states. Interaction reasoning is further enhanced through a multi-relational graph module that explicitly encodes direct and higher-order agent relationships. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets, nuScenes, MoCAD, and NGSIM, show that SWIFT consistently outperforms strong baselines in prediction accuracy across diverse traffic regimes. Beyond accuracy, SWIFT exhibits improved generalization to unseen locations and regimes, robustness under noisy observations, and strong performance with limited training data, supporting the effectiveness of its structure-aware design.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SWIFT框架，将小世界网络与交通流理论结合，用于自动驾驶轨迹预测。方法包括小世界交互网络、流状态编码器和多关系图模块，在nuScenes、MoCAD、NGSIM数据集上超越强基线，并展示良好泛化性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动轨迹预测方法缺乏结构先验，在分布偏移下泛化能力有限。
Method: 集成小世界网络与交通流理论：小世界交互网络捕获局部和全局依赖，流状态编码器适应场景交通状态，多关系图模块编码直接和高阶关系。

papers.title: A Dynamic Scene Interaction Reasoning Framework for Scene-level Lane-Change Intention and Trajectory Prediction of Multiple Interacting Vehicles
papers.abstract_en: Safe motion planning in advanced driver-assistance systems and autonomous vehicles requires an accurate understanding of how the surrounding traffic scene is likely to evolve. However, many existing lane-change prediction methods remain centered on a single target vehicle, while multi-agent forecasting approaches often describe scene evolution only through future positions and provide limited explicit information about the maneuver associated with each vehicle. This study proposes a dynamic scene graph attention framework that predicts the lane-change intention and future trajectory of every relevant vehicle within a local traffic scene. The scene is represented as a time-varying interaction graph in which vehicles are modeled as nodes and their spatial and kinematic relationships are encoded through explicit edge features. Temporal graph-attention message passing captures evolving inter-vehicle dependencies and pre-maneuver cues, while an intention-guided decoder links each predicted maneuver to its corresponding future motion. A scene-level consistency objective further encourages compatible multi-vehicle futures. Experiments on the NGSIM I-80, NGSIM US-101, and highD datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over competing baselines. DSiGAT achieves intention prediction accuracies of 90.12% and 90.97% on NGSIM I-80 and US-101, respectively, and reduces trajectory RMSE by up to 52.94% relative to the strongest baseline. It also produces lower inter-agent collision rates and joint displacement errors, indicating more coherent scene-level predictions. Ablation, sensitivity, robustness, and qualitative analyses further validate the contribution of the proposed components and the effectiveness of the scene-focused formulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出动态场景图注意力框架（DSiGAT），用于预测交通场景中所有相关车辆的车道变更意图和未来轨迹。场景建模为时变交互图，通过时序图注意力消息传递捕捉车辆间动态依赖关系，意图引导解码器将预测的机动与未来运动关联，并引入场景级一致性目标。在NGSIM I-80、US-101和highD数据集上，意图预测准确率达90%以上，轨迹RMSE相比最强基线降低最多52.94%。
Motivation: 现有车道变更预测方法多聚焦单一目标车辆，多智能体预测仅输出未来位置，缺乏对车辆机动的显式信息，导致场景级理解不足。
Method: 构建动态场景图，车辆为节点，时空与运动学关系编码为边特征；使用时序图注意力消息传递更新节点表征；意图引导解码器联合预测车道变更意图与轨迹；场景级一致性损失促进多车预测的一致性。
Result: 在NGSIM I-80和US-101上意图预测准确率分别为90.12%和90.97%；轨迹RMSE较最强基线降低52.94%；碰撞率和联合位移误差更低。
Conclusion: 基于场景图的交互推理能有效提升多车车道变更意图与轨迹预测的准确性和一致性，消融和敏感性分析验证了各组件的贡献。

papers.title: Coresets Before Score Sets: Evaluation-Unsupervised Prompt Subset Selection for LLM Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: We study LLM benchmark coreset selection: selecting a small subset of prompts over multiple benchmarks whose induced model scores and rankings approximate those obtained from the full benchmark suite. In evaluation-unsupervised benchmark coreset selection (our approach), the selection algorithm uses no model evaluation outcomes, and operates on a fine granularity by producing subsets of prompts over multiple benchmarks rather than producing a sub-collection of entire benchmarks. We use submodular subset selection, and we develop and evaluate many different submodular functions for this purpose, including determinantal point process (DPP) based approaches, submodular mutual information functions, and facility location-based functions. On a new large-scale suite of 35 heterogeneous benchmarks spanning five different capability categories, 18 frontier LLMs, and over 61K prompts, we find that the facility location (FL) function operating exclusively on inexpensive semantic prompt embeddings preserves LLM scores better than twelve separate score-based and diversity-based baselines, across a range of coreset budgets. Moreover, we show our proposed objective is not limited to the evaluation-unsupervised regime: in the setting where only a handful of whole benchmarks must be selected and a large amount of model scores are available, the same objective matches or outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on the MMLU and MTEB leaderboards, while being substantially cheaper to compute. Together, our results suggest that submodularity, in general, is a strong and reliable tool for benchmark compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了LLM基准测试的coreset选择问题，即从多个基准测试中选取一小部分提示子集，使其诱导的模型分数和排名尽可能接近完整基准套件的结果。作者提出了一种评估无监督的prompt子集选择方法，利用子模函数（包括设施位置函数、行列式点过程等）在仅基于语义嵌入的情况下进行选择。在包含35个异构基准测试、18个前沿LLM和超过6.1万提示的大规模套件上，设施位置函数在保持LLM分数方面优于12种基线方法。
Motivation: 现有LLM基准测试评估成本高昂，需要大量提示和模型评估。本文旨在通过选择代表性强的提示子集来压缩基准套件，同时保持评估结果的准确性，从而降低评估成本。
Method: 提出评估无监督的基准coreset选择框架，使用子模函数从多个基准测试中直接选择提示子集，而不依赖任何模型评估结果。具体比较了设施位置、行列式点过程和子模互信息等多种函数，其中最有效的设施位置函数仅基于廉价语义嵌入。
Result: 在35个基准测试、18个LLM和6.1万提示的大规模实验中，设施位置函数在多种coreset预算下均优于12种基于分数和多样性的基线方法。此外，在仅需选择少量完整基准测试的场景下，该目标函数在MMLU和MTEB排行榜上匹配或超越现有方法，且计算成本更低。
Conclusion: 结果表明子模性（特别是设施位置函数）是基准压缩的可靠工具，可在无监督设置下高效保持评估准确性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Q-Score: A Quantum-Native Scoring Function for Molecular Docking
papers.abstract_en: Molecular docking predicts how a small molecule binds to a protein and is a key bottleneck in drug discovery. Classical scoring functions sum empirical pairwise contacts, blind to quantum-mechanical effects like orbital charge transfer that govern binding specificity. We introduce Q-Score, encoding GNN-predicted orbital donor-acceptor energies into a weighted graph and scoring binding by solving a maximum-weight vertex clique problem via Digitized-Counterdiabatic QAOA. Each interaction anchor maps to one qubit and compatibility constraints become edges. Across 11 protein targets, DC-QAOA recovers the exact optimum on 8 at 10 qubits. On 1000 AI-generated molecules, Q-Score is orthogonal to classical scoring with Spearman rho of 0.05, driven by orbital quality with rho of 0.90, and free of molecular-weight bias, enriching for strong orbital interactions at twice the random rate. DC-QAOA achieves a mean approximation ratio of 0.94 with 52 percent exact. Execution of 1000 circuits on IBM Eagle confirms 6-qubit solvability on NISQ hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出Q-Score，一种基于量子计算的分子对接打分函数，利用GNN预测的轨道供体-受体能量构建加权图，通过数字计数绝热量子近似优化算法（DC-QAOA）求解最大权重顶点团问题。在11个蛋白质靶点上，DC-QAOA在10量子位时恢复8个精确最优解。在1000个AI生成分子上，Q-Score与经典打分正交（Spearman ρ=0.05），且无分子量偏差。DC-QAOA平均近似比0.94，52%精确。在IBM Eagle上执行1000电路验证了6量子位在NISQ硬件上的可解性。
Motivation: 经典打分函数只求和经验对间接触，忽略量子力学效应如轨道电荷转移，这些效应决定了结合特异性。
Method: 将GNN预测的轨道供体-受体能量编码到加权图中，通过DC-QAOA求解最大权重顶点团问题。每个相互作用锚点映射到一个量子比特，兼容性约束作为边。
Result: 在11个蛋白质靶点上，DC-QAOA在10量子位时恢复8个精确最优解。在1000个AI生成分子上，Q-Score与经典打分正交（Spearman ρ=0.05），且无分子量偏差。DC-QAOA平均近似比0.94，52%精确。在IBM Eagle上验证了6量子位可解。
Conclusion: 摘要指出Q-Score是第一个量子驱动的分子对接打分函数，能捕获经典方法遗漏的轨道相互作用信息，且与经典打分正交，为药物发现提供了新的量子优势方向。

papers.title: Saturation-Aware Robust Trajectory Optimization for Reusable Launch Vehicles via Differentiable Physics
papers.abstract_en: The high-angle-of-attack flip maneuver of reusable launch vehicles presents significant challenges for robust trajectory optimization due to the combined effects of highly nonlinear dynamics, aerodynamic uncertainties, and actuator saturation. This paper presents a differentiable physics framework for saturation-aware robust trajectory optimization. At its core, a Differentiable Particle Tube Control (DPTC) scheme is developed to optimize uncertainty evolution through an ensemble-based distribution shaping strategy. State uncertainty is represented by a Lagrangian particle ensemble, while hard actuator projection operators are embedded directly into the computational graph, enabling the joint optimization of the nominal feedforward trajectory and a time-varying feedback policy via end-to-end backpropagation. The proposed framework is evaluated against an automatic differentiation-based Successive Convexification (AD-SCvx) baseline combined with a conventional covariance steering feedback strategy. Six-degree-of-freedom Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that, although the baseline achieves nominal fuel-optimal solutions, its unconstrained feedback formulation becomes susceptible to actuator saturation under aerodynamic disturbances, leading to degraded closed-loop robustness. In contrast, the proposed DPTC framework proactively performs a constraint-aware performance trade-off by relaxing spatial tracking to preserve critical control authority. These results demonstrate that integrating differentiable physics with ensemble-based optimization provides an effective and practical framework for robust guidance in highly constrained aerospace flight systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对可重复使用运载火箭的高攻角翻转机动，提出一种基于可微物理的饱和感知鲁棒轨迹优化框架。核心是开发了可微粒子管控制（DPTC）方案，通过基于集合的分布整形策略优化不确定性演化，将硬执行器投影算子嵌入计算图，实现标称前馈轨迹与时变反馈策略的端到端联合优化。六自由度蒙特卡洛仿真表明，相比自动微分逐次凸化（AD-SCvx）基线，DPTC能主动进行约束感知的性能权衡，通过放松空间跟踪来保留关键控制权限，从而在气动干扰下避免执行器饱和，提升闭环鲁棒性。
Motivation: 可重复使用运载火箭的高攻角翻转机动面临高度非线性动力学、气动不确定性及执行器饱和的复合挑战，现有轨迹优化方法难以同时处理这些因素。
Method: 提出可微粒子管控制（DPTC）方案，采用拉格朗日粒子系综表示状态不确定性，将硬执行器投影算子直接嵌入计算图，通过端到端反向传播联合优化标称前馈轨迹和时变反馈策略。
Result: 六自由度蒙特卡洛仿真表明，AD-SCvx基线在标称情况下可得到燃料最优解，但其无约束反馈形式在气动干扰下易受执行器饱和影响，导致闭环鲁棒性下降；而DPTC通过放松空间跟踪主动权衡性能，保留关键控制权限，鲁棒性更优。
Conclusion: 摘要结论指出，将可微物理与基于集合的优化相结合，为高度约束的航空航天飞行系统提供了有效且实用的鲁棒制导框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AGM-like Paraconsistent Partial Meet Abductive Expansion Operation
papers.abstract_en: In his 1996 doctoral thesis, Maurice Pagnucco created the first AGM-like abductive expansion operation. Taking his operation as a basis, as well as a taxonomy -- inspired by Atocha Aliseda -- responsible for highlighting and formalizing the main components of abductive reasoning, the main aim of this paper is to present a new paraconsistent AGM-like abductive expansion operation -- capable of assimilating contradictory explanatory hypotheses without trivialization and the consequent absurd epistemic state -- with its postulates and its transitively relational partial meet construction. To a large extent, the formal development presented in this paper was only made possible by the recent creation of the paraconsistent logic RCbr, an LFI (Logics of Formal Inconsistencies) that establishes properties especially relevant to belief revision contexts, in particular, the ability to be self-extensional -- i.e., to satisfy the replacement property. This is the first of two papers: the paraconsistent abductive expansion operation announced here -- which is part of a new system called AGMpabd -- despite bringing many interesting features, does not assign any relevant epistemic role to the paraconsistent operators of negation and consistency. Only in a second paper will an analogous paraconsistent abductive expansion operation -- which is part of another new system, AGMcircabd -- be enhanced in this direction. Nevertheless, to the best of my knowledge, the operation developed in this paper is the first of its kind in the AGM literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于Maurice Pagnucco的AGM式溯因扩展操作以及Atocha Aliseda的溯因分类法，提出了一种新的次协调AGM式溯因扩展操作，能够在不导致平凡化和荒谬认知状态的情况下吸收矛盾的解释性假设。该操作依托新近提出的次协调逻辑RCbr（一种形式不一致逻辑LFI），该逻辑满足自外延性（替换性质）。文中给出了该操作的公设及传递关系偏交构造，它是新系统AGMpabd的一部分，但尚未赋予次协调否定和一致性算子实质性认知角色。
Motivation: 现有AGM式溯因扩展操作无法处理矛盾假设，会导致认知状态平凡化，而现实中溯因推理常面临不一致信息。
Method: 基于Pagnucco的AGM式溯因扩展操作和Aliseda的溯因分类，利用次协调逻辑RCbr中的自外延性，定义了一种新的次协调偏交构造，并给出相应公设。
Result: 首次在AGM文献中提出了能够吸收矛盾解释性假设且不平凡化的次协调溯因扩展操作。
Conclusion: 该操作是AGMpabd系统的第一部分，但尚未让次协调否定和一致性算子发挥核心作用，后续将在一个名为AGMcircabd的新系统中增强这一方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Universal Language of CSI:Unifying Wireless Sensing Across Devices and Environments
papers.abstract_en: WiFi sensing based on Channel State Information (CSI) promises ubiquitous, device-free perception, yet current research remains trapped in a Tower of Babel - fragmented into isolated silos where models are tailored to specific hardware dialects, fixed environments, and narrow tasks. The primary bottleneck is the Heterogeneity Gap: the disparity in signal dimensions, sampling rates, and semantic labels that prevents cross-system understanding. To bridge this gap, we propose a foundation-model framework that treats CSI not merely as raw signals but as a structured language with a learnable universal grammar. We first curate and standardize a large collection of heterogeneous real-world CSI datasets, establishing a unified infrastructure that allows incompatible signal formats to be treated as a single corpus. Second, we introduce a modular architecture that acts as a universal translator where lightweight dataset-specific adapters tokenize diverse signal inputs into a shared latent vocabulary, while a shared self-supervised Transformer backbone learns the temporal syntax of human motion and environmental dynamics. This design decouples sensing semantics from hardware syntax. Extensive evaluations show that by mastering this universal language, our approach consistently outperforms task-specific baselines and exhibits strong generalization capability in new environments, achieving superior efficiency in few-shot scenarios. By effectively absorbing heterogeneity, the framework offers a path toward robust, general-purpose wireless sensing, mirroring the linguistic generalization observed in Large Language Models. The code implementation is available at: https://github.com/cjychenjiayi/WiLLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对不同设备、环境和任务下CSI信号异构性导致模型碎片化的问题，提出将CSI视为一种结构化语言，通过构建统一数据集、设计模块化架构（数据集特定适配器+共享自监督Transformer骨干），学习通用语义表示，实现跨设备和环境的无线感知。实验表明该方法在多场景下优于任务特定基线，且具备强泛化能力。
Motivation: 当前WiFi感知研究基于CSI，但模型对特定设备、环境和任务高度定制，缺乏跨系统通用性。主要瓶颈是异构性差距（信号维度、采样率、语义标签不一致）。
Method: 提出基础模型框架：1）收集并标准化大量异构真实CSI数据集形成统一语料库；2）轻量级数据集特定适配器将不同信号映射到共享潜在词汇；3）共享自监督Transformer骨干学习人体运动和环境动态的时间语法。解耦感知语义与硬件语法。
Result: 评估表明该方法在多数任务上优于任务特定基线，在新环境中表现出强泛化能力，在少样本场景效率更高。
Conclusion: 通过有效吸收异构性，该框架为鲁棒通用无线感知提供路径，类似于大型语言模型的语言泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Ramanujan Challenge For AI
papers.abstract_en: To help evaluate the mathematical skills of current AI systems, we present a set of formulas for fundamental mathematical constants. These problems are attractive for AI evaluation because they are concrete and can be checked numerically to arbitrary precision, yet proving them may require non-obvious mathematics. Mathematical constants such as $π$, $e$, Catalan's constant, and special values of the Riemann zeta function have fascinated mathematicians for centuries. The search for formulas evaluating mathematical constants has produced some of the most beautiful mathematics in the field, especially in cases that yield irrationality proofs or fast convergence rates. Ramanujan's legacy is emblematic of this tradition. The list we provide contains two types of problems: formulas whose proofs are known to the authors but will remain encrypted for a short initial period; and formulas that are not yet proven. We are curious to see the achievements of AI in both cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一组关于π、e、Catalan常数、Riemann ζ函数等数学常数的公式，用于评估当前AI系统的数学能力。这些公式可数值验证到任意精度，但证明可能需要非平凡的数学知识。挑战包含已知证明但暂时加密的公式以及尚未被证明的公式。
Motivation: 现有AI系统的数学能力评估缺乏具体且可量化的基准，而数学常数公式的发现和证明既具挑战性又便于数值验证，适合作为测试AI数学推理能力的任务。
Conclusion: 通过观察AI在已知证明和未证明公式上的表现，可以评估其数学推理水平。作者期待看到AI在这一领域的进展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Feedback-Coupled Memory Systems in Continuous Time
papers.abstract_en: The Feedback-Coupled Memory Systems (FCMS) architecture formalizes closed-loop coordination through four abstract operators, two of which - the agent update operator $f_i$ and the environmental update operator $Ψ$ - are left axiomatically undefined in the original framework. To address this, $f_i$ is defined by Mechanism-Based Intelligence (MBI), where agents update locally through a decentralized price mechanism and economic principles, and $Ψ$ is defined by the Coupled Memory Graph Process (CMGP), a non-Markovian framework where the environment is treated as a physical substrate that records and responds to trajectory history coherently without external forcing. The resulting continuous-time FCMS instantiation achieves Lyapunov global dissipativity governed by the computable threshold $4β^2 < 2ημγ^2$. This generalizes both the discrete FCMS stability condition $4ηβ^2 < γ$ and CMGP's physical bifurcation threshold $α_c = 1/K$, confirming that memory dissipation must outpace feedback gain as a universal organizing principle. Numerical simulation with $N=2$ agents and mean-field validation at $N=10^6$ confirm the stability threshold and the self-reinforcing coordination cascade that emerges when it is violated.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 4 figures. Extends arXiv:2603.11560 to continuous time. Code: github.com/stevefatz95/fcms-continuous
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出连续时间下的反馈耦合记忆系统（FCMS）架构，通过机制智能（Mechanism-Based Intelligence, MBI）定义代理更新算子f_i，通过耦合记忆图过程（Coupled Memory Graph Process, CMGP）定义环境更新算子Ψ。推导出Lyapunov全局耗散性条件4β²<2ημγ²，推广了离散FCMS和CMGP的稳定性阈值。数值实验验证了稳定性边界及超越时的自强化协调级联现象。
Motivation: 原始FCMS框架中代理更新算子f_i和环境更新算子Ψ缺少具体定义，限制了其连续时间扩展。本文旨在明确这两个算子，实现连续时间闭环协调的严格数学形式化。
Method: 将f_i建模为基于去中心化价格机制和经济学原理的MBI，将Ψ建模为非马尔可夫CMGP，使环境作为物理基质记录并响应轨迹历史。通过Lyapunov方法分析系统稳定性，推导全局耗散性条件。
Result: 获得连续时间FCMS的Lyapunov全局耗散性阈值4β²<2ημγ²，该条件统一了离散FCMS条件4ηβ²<γ和CMGP的物理分岔阈值α_c=1/K。N=2与N=10^6的均场仿真确认了稳定性阈值和当阈值被违反时出现的自强化协调级联。
Conclusion: 摘要强调记忆耗散必须压制反馈增益是通用组织原则，连续时间FCMS扩展为复杂自适应系统提供了数学框架，但实际应用需满足特定参数约束。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Closed-Loop Control with Rule-Aligned Small Language Models and Multi-Agent Self-Correction
papers.abstract_en: A key step toward autonomous industrial operation is the ability to create and reconfigure control policies from natural-language requirement specifications, with minimal or no manual redesign. In this setting, policy generation by AI agents can be a credible path when paired with a plant-aware validator (e.g., a digital twin) that can check generated candidate actions before execution. However, practical deployment is constrained by inference latency and compute footprint: large cloud-based models are often too slow, opaque, or data-sensitive for edge closed-loop use. This work investigates whether a compact Small Language Model (SLM) can be retrained for control reasoning and embedded in a validator-guided correction loop. We use a Qwen2.5-1.5B model aligned via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), combined with (i) an action agent, (ii) a symbolic/digital-twin-style validation layer, and (iii) a reprompting agent that iteratively steers outputs toward valid actions. In randomized thermal-control simulations (30 experiments with 500 steps each), the framework achieves 91.5% average action-alignment accuracy (86.3%--100% across cases) at 3.84\,s mean inference latency. Under symbolic re-mapping, it maintains a 95% in-range rate, indicating robust physical regulation despite reduced token-level agreement. These results support SLM+validator architectures as a practical path toward reconfigurable autonomous control at the edge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索使用小型语言模型（SLM）进行闭环控制，通过GRPO对齐Qwen2.5-1.5B模型，并集成动作智能体、数字孪生验证层和重新提示智能体构成自我修正循环。在随机热控制模拟中，该方法达到91.5%的平均动作对齐准确率（86.3%-100%），推理延迟3.84秒，验证了SLM+验证器架构在边缘可重构自主控制中的实用性。
Motivation: 从自然语言需求规范自动生成控制策略是实现自主工业操作的关键，但大型云模型推理延迟高、计算开销大，不适合边缘闭环部署。需要一种紧凑、低延迟的解决方案。
Method: 采用Qwen2.5-1.5B小语言模型，通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行规则对齐，结合动作智能体生成候选动作、符号/数字孪生验证层检查动作有效性，以及重新提示智能体迭代修正输出，形成闭环控制回路。
Result: 在30次随机热控制模拟实验（每500步）中，平均动作对齐准确率91.5%（范围86.3%-100%），平均推理延迟3.84秒；符号重映射下保持95%的在范围内比率，表明物理调节稳健。
Conclusion: SLM与验证器相结合的架构为边缘端可重构自主控制提供了一条实用路径，兼顾了准确性和实时性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Interfacial Spectral Memory as a State Variable for Finite-Depth Salt-Finger Exchange
papers.abstract_en: Thermohaline interfaces in the ocean are often treated through local double-diffusive favorability, yet finite interfaces can also inherit roughness from prior waves, stirring, intrusions, and earlier mixing events. Such inherited geometry can matter because salt fingering does not develop from a flat abstract surface in many geophysical settings. We use controlled three-dimensional direct simulations to test whether the spectral state of a finite rough interface changes the pathway by which salt-finger activity develops between adjacent layers. The density ratio, diffusivity ratio, Prandtl number, interface thickness, roughness amplitude, domain, resolution, and analysis window are held fixed; only the imposed roughness spectrum and, for one pair, the realization are changed. Broad low-mode memory produces the largest cumulative salt exchange and the earliest finite-depth contact. High-annulus memory remains localized and intermediate-scale dominated. Mixed memory produces delayed scale transfer and scalar-rich structure that is robust in integrated exchange and broad-memory measures across a second realization, while local plume timing and probe amplitudes remain realization-sensitive. The simulations therefore support treating interfacial spectral memory as an additional state variable for finite-depth double-diffusive exchange, complementary to local thermodynamic descriptors.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to Deep Sea Research I
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过三维直接数值模拟研究有限深度粗糙界面的谱记忆对盐指交换路径的影响。固定密度比、扩散率比、普朗特数、界面厚度、粗糙度振幅等参数，仅改变粗糙度谱，发现宽低模态记忆产生最大累积盐交换和最早有限深度接触，高环模态记忆保持局部化，混合记忆产生延迟尺度传递和丰富标量结构。支持将界面谱记忆作为有限深度双扩散交换的附加状态变量。
Motivation: 海洋中的温盐界面常通过局地双扩散有利性处理，但有限界面可能继承先前波、搅动、侵入和混合事件的粗糙度；这种继承的几何形状可能影响盐指活动的发展，而现有研究缺乏对界面谱记忆效应的系统理解。
Method: 采用受控的三维直接数值模拟，固定所有其他参数（密度比、扩散率比、普朗特数、界面厚度、粗糙度振幅等），仅改变施加的粗糙度谱（以及一次实现），比较不同谱记忆下的盐指活动发展路径。
Result: 宽低模态记忆产生最大累积盐交换和最早有限深度接触；高环模态记忆保持局部化且以中间尺度为主；混合记忆产生延迟尺度转移和丰富的标量结构，积分交换和宽模态度量在第二次实现中保持稳健，但局部羽流定时和探针振幅对实现敏感。
Conclusion: 模拟支持将界面谱记忆作为有限深度双扩散交换的附加状态变量，与局地热力学描述符互补。

summary_sections.motivation: 海洋中的温盐界面常通过局地双扩散有利性处理，但有限界面可能继承先前波、搅动、侵入和混合事件的粗糙度；这种继承的几何形状可能影响盐指活动的发展，而现有研究缺乏对界面谱记忆效应的系统理解。
summary_sections.method: 采用受控的三维直接数值模拟，固定所有其他参数（密度比、扩散率比、普朗特数、界面厚度、粗糙度振幅等），仅改变施加的粗糙度谱（以及一次实现），比较不同谱记忆下的盐指活动发展路径。
summary_sections.result: 宽低模态记忆产生最大累积盐交换和最早有限深度接触；高环模态记忆保持局部化且以中间尺度为主；混合记忆产生延迟尺度转移和丰富的标量结构，积分交换和宽模态度量在第二次实现中保持稳健，但局部羽流定时和探针振幅对实现敏感。
summary_sections.conclusion: 模拟支持将界面谱记忆作为有限深度双扩散交换的附加状态变量，与局地热力学描述符互补。

papers.title: ERP Data Provisioning Financial Control Testing
papers.abstract_en: Financial control testing increasingly depends on representative enterprise resource planning (ERP) data in quality environments, yet direct production copies expose personal, supplier, banking, and commercially sensitive records. This work presents Secure ERP Quality Provisioning for Financial Control Testing (SEQ-FCT), a governed data-provisioning framework that combines deterministic masking, synthetic scenario expansion, referential tokenization, policy-based release approval, and automated validation for reconciliation, fraud-rule testing, and audit analytics. A single synthetic dataset is used for evaluation. It contains 186,000 finance-process records from six subsidiaries over 2022-2025, including accounts payable invoices, payments, general-ledger journals, accounts receivable receipts, and bank-statement lines. The dataset includes entity relationships, monetary values, approval paths, tax attributes, banking markers, exception labels, fraud-rule triggers, and control-failure outcomes. Because the dataset is synthetic, reported results demonstrate controlled internal consistency rather than production validation. Against a production-clone upper bound, static masking, rules-only synthesis, conditional tabular generative synthesis, and a hybrid baseline, SEQ-FCT achieved 0.932 reconciliation F1, 0.887 fraud-trigger recall, 0.914 control-failure F1, and an estimated leakage-risk score of 0.018. The analysis indicates that financial process behavior can be preserved more reliably when masking, synthetic data, and governance checks are evaluated as a single release pipeline instead of independent utilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SEQ-FCT框架，用于在财务控制测试中安全供给ERP数据。该框架结合确定性掩码、合成场景扩展、引用标记化、基于策略的发布审批和自动验证，在包含186,000条记录的合成数据集上评估了 reconciliation、欺诈规则测试和审计分析性能。与生产克隆上界等基线相比，SEQ-FCT在 reconciliation F1、欺诈触发召回率、控制失败F1和泄漏风险评分上表现更优。
Motivation: 财务控制测试依赖代表性ERP数据，但直接使用生产副本会暴露个人、供应商、银行等敏感信息，现有方法缺乏统一的保护与验证框架。
Method: 提出SEQ-FCT框架，包括确定性掩码、合成场景扩展、引用标记化、基于策略的发布审批以及自动验证，并将掩码、合成数据和治理检查整合为单一发布流程。
Result: 在合成数据集上，SEQ-FCT达到0.932 reconciliation F1、0.887欺诈触发召回率、0.914控制失败F1，估计泄漏风险评分0.018，优于静态掩码、规则合成、条件制表生成合成和混合基线。
Conclusion: 将掩码、合成数据和治理检查作为单一发布流程评估，比作为独立工具更可靠地保留财务流程行为。
